MsgJp: "筆跡が新しい日記のページが落ちている"
MsgEn:
"The handwriting is from a page that has fallen
out of a new diary."

MsgJp:
これほどに醜く、滑稽な姿の魔物は見た事が無い
変な話だが――自分があの魔物として
生まれなかった事に、感謝を覚えてすらいる
MsgEn:
It's strange that I have never previously seen
monsters of such an ugly,
comical figure like this...I should remember to
be thankful, to have not been born into
this world as one of those monsters.

MsgJp:
戦いを重ねるごとに、憎めなく思えてきたが――
愛着が湧く前に、希少素材が入手できて良かった
MsgEn:
Whenever I had fought a battle, my mind was clear
of hatred...
It was good that rare materials made themselves
available before I got too
hot-headed.

MsgJp:
さらに、戦いの中でこの地の魔物が
使っていた武器を入手する事もできた
故郷で流通していた物よりも
高度に鍛えられている
MsgEn:
In addition, by battling the demon that laid
claim to
this place, I was able to get the weapon I had
been using forged to a
higher quality than those circulating around my
hometown.

MsgJp:
新たに訪れたこの地で、まだまだ知らない事は多い
素材だけでなく、多くの知識も
持ち帰る事ができそうだ
MsgEn:
There are many things still unknown to me about
this
new place. Perhaps I may not only bring materials
home, but also a
wealth of knowledge.

MsgJp: 起こるのは良い事ばかり――心配は杞憂だったのだ
MsgEn:
Only good things have occurred...I was needlessly
worried.

MsgJp: "筆跡が新しい日記のページが落ちている"
MsgEn:
"Bad fate"
...Aah, have you been creeping up on me without a
sound?

MsgJp:
数多の魔物を打ち倒し、
実力をつけていく手応えは確かに感じていた――
だからこそ、慢心があったのかもしれない
MsgEn:
I certainly felt the way to put my skills to the
test,
was to defeat a multitude of monsters...
Perhaps I was too overconfident in my ability.

MsgJp:
先の戦いで手負いだとしても、油断があったとしても
こうも簡単に囲まれるとは情けない――
MsgEn:
Even if you purposely throw the previous battle,
and even if you
were unprepared, it is pitiful to be surrounded
as easily as this...

MsgJp:
暗闇の先から、盗賊たちの息遣いが聞こえる
この緊張を破るきっかけがあれば、
飢えた狼のように一斉に飛びかかる気なのだろう
MsgEn:
From the darkness, you can hear the thieves
breathing as
they wait for a chance to break the tension in
the air.
Perhaps they're going to jump out and strike in
unison like starving wolves.

MsgJp:
全てを塔に置いてきたことだけが、唯一の救いだ
あの妖しき宝は、盗賊ごときに渡すのは惜しいからな
MsgEn:
Putting everything into the tower, may prove to
be my salvation.
That bewitching treasure, it would be regrettable
to hand it over to someone such as a thief.

MsgJp:
"良くない運命"
――あぁ、音も無く忍び寄られていたのか
MsgEn:
"Bad fate"
...Aah, have you been creeping up on me without a
sound?

MsgJp: "日記の１ページが落ちている"
MsgEn: "A page out of a diary has fallen down."

MsgJp:
遺跡の奥底に坐していたあの魔物――
レスタニアに生息しているそれと姿形は似ているけど
より凶暴で、俊敏だったように感じます
MsgEn:
That demon dwelling within the depths of the
ruins...
It looks similar to those that inhabit Lestania,
but feels far more
ferocious and agile.

MsgJp:
それとは別に、見知った魔物も見かけました
同様の進化を遂げたのか、何らかの手段で
向こうからこちらへ渡って来たのか――
MsgEn:
That aside, I also saw a monster I recognized.
Have you evolved in a similar way by some means?
Did you cross over to here from there...?

MsgJp:
しかし、我々の知っていた倒し方が通用したせいか
ベンジャミン様は少し興奮しておられるようでした
MsgEn:
However, it seemed that Benjamin was a bit excited
because the method of killing we knew had worked.

MsgJp:
ベンジャミン様の命でこの日記をつけるように
なってから、心の機微と出来事のつながりが
整理でき、人の感情が推測できるように
なってきた気がします――
MsgEn:
Since I had begun to record Benjamin's life in
this diary,
I feel it is now possible to organize the link
between the subtleties of the mind,
and the events of one's life to better understand
how they feel...

MsgJp:
この調子で、もう少し――
主人の心に寄り添えるポーンになりたいものです
MsgEn:
In this manner, just a little further...
I'll become a pawn that is closer to my master's
heart.

MsgJp: "日記の１ページが落ちている"
MsgEn: "A page out of a diary has fallen down."

MsgJp:
本当にこのモロー樹林の侵食は、深刻なようです
侵食の治療はなんとか可能であるものの
根本的な原因が何か判明していない以上――
かからないに越したことはありません
MsgEn:
It seems that the corruption of the "Morrow
Forest" has gotten
serious. Although the treatment of corruption is
somehow possible, I do not know
what has initially caused it to form...
It's best that I don't take anything from here.

MsgJp:
今回の探索で、侵食には重度なものになると
より凶暴化し、感染力が上がる事が分かりました
相貌も変化し、正視に耐えられぬ姿になることも――
MsgEn:
During this investigation, I've learned that the
corruption
seems to become more of an issue when it reaches
a severe level. Upon which,
the infectivity increases, and the appearance
changes to form a figure that one
could not bear to look at...

MsgJp:
レスタニアとフィンダムの迷宮を巡り
希少素材を回収する旅も、もう長くなりますが――
MsgEn:
Adventures through the labyrinths of Lestania
and Phindym to collect rare materials, have only
gotten longer...

MsgJp:
ベンジャミン様は集めた素材を
すべて装備品に変え、ご友人が滞在していた地
滞在したであろう地の最奥に
納めていくことを続けておられます
MsgEn:
Master Benjamin gathered all of the materials
collected thus far,
and used them to form equipment here in the land
where your friend had stayed.
In the most remote parts of this place, he
continuously offers up what he has created.

MsgJp:
4部位それぞれで行う――
ということは、残るはあと2ヶ所
真意は分かりかねますが、我々は付き従うのみです
MsgEn:
"Do this in each of the four sites"...
That means there are two sites still remaining.
We may not understand the intention behind this,
but we tag along regardless.

MsgJp: "日記の１ページが落ちている"
MsgEn: "A page out of a diary has fallen down."

MsgJp:
この大陸は、その気候や生態、文化など
全てにおいて異なる点が多く見られます
MsgEn:
On this continent, the climate, ecology, culture,
and etc,
are all so different than everything we knew.

MsgJp:
特に、この水路で見たあのサルのような魔物――
姿形はレスタニアに生息しているものに
似ていますが、決定的に違うのは、そのトゲ――
MsgEn:
Particularly, monsters like the ape we had seen
in this waterway..
Its appearance is similar to those inhabiting
Lestania,
but decisively different, because of those
thorns...

MsgJp:
しかしこの魔物からも、レスタニアでは見る事の無い
希少な素材を回収できました
これで、水路に降りた目的を達成したはずです
MsgEn:
However, from this demon we were able to recover
one of the rare materials that did not exist in
Lestania.
With this, we should have achieved the purpose of
why we came into this waterway.

MsgJp:
――ベンジャミン様は
ご友人の遺体と日記を発見してから
以前にも増して寡黙になられたようです――
MsgEn:
...Master Benjamin seems to become more withdrawn
the more we stumble upon the diaries of his
acquaintances who have likely
fallen...

MsgJp:
時折、酷く悔しそうな表情をされます――
しかしその真意までは
ポーンの私には判らないのです
MsgEn:
Occasionally, I will have a look of chagrin on my
face...
but the intention behind it, is one that my pawn
can't understand.

MsgJp: "誰かの日記の１ページが落ちている"
MsgEn: "A page of someone's diary has fallen"

MsgJp:
あの話は本当だったのか――
氷魔がごく稀に落とすという
強力な希少素材――
MsgEn:
Was the story true?
The one about the ice demon that drops a powerful
rare material?

MsgJp:
村の情報屋が言うことには
今までその姿かたちを見た者はいないらしい
MsgEn:
The information broker in the village said that
there has been nobody that has seen the figure
until just now.

MsgJp:
ならばなぜ、情報屋がその存在を知っているのか？
そんな怪しい話、どうせ戯言に違いないと
たかをくくっていたが――
MsgEn:
So pray tell, how does the information broker
know of its existence?
Such a suspicious story, it must be a load of
crap...

MsgJp:
まさか本当に存在していたとはな！
ああ、触れているだけで
手のひらがピリピリと痛むほどの冷気を感じる
どれほどの魔力を秘めているのか――
MsgEn:
It certainly did exist, and must've existed for a
while now!
Oh, just touching it has made a painful tingling
chill linger in my palm.
Just how much magickal power is hidden within
it...?

MsgJp:
他にもこういった物が無いか
調べてみる価値はあるな――
MsgEn:
Are there others like this?
It may be worth investigating further...

MsgJp: "誰かの日記の１ページが落ちている"
MsgEn: "A page of someone's diary has fallen"

MsgJp:
危ない所だった――
ただでさえ怪力で厄介なサイクロプスが
侵食によって、およそ生物とは
思えない力を発揮していた
MsgEn:
It was a dangerous place...
Even a simple Cyclops, already troublesome due to
its sturdiness,
was demonstrating an unexpected strength when
corrupted by these strange
organisms.

MsgJp:
まともに相手をしていたら、今頃命は無かっただろう
今こうして日記を書いている手も、震えが止まらない
MsgEn:
If I did not have a decent partner, I would not
currently be alive.
Even as I write this, my hands cannot stop
trembling.

MsgJp:
なんとか手に入れたこのおぞましい貴重素材――
見た目はひどいものだが、
祈祷師や好事家あたりが見れば大喜びするだろう
MsgEn:
I did manage to acquire this valuable and hideous
material somehow...
Although it's a terrible sight to behold, you
would be delighted to see the prices the
shamans and dilettantes have offered for it.

MsgJp:
しかし、金にするのが本当に正しい用途なのか？
もっと集めることで、何か作り出せるのかもしれない
MsgEn:
But, is this really the right way to use it;
making money?
Perhaps by gathering more, something useful might
be made from it.

MsgJp:
例えば、それが武器だとしたら――
大きな力を持つはずだ
MsgEn:
For example, if formed into a weapon...it should
be imbued with great power.

MsgJp: "誰かの日記の１ページが落ちている"
MsgEn: "A page of someone's diary has fallen"

MsgJp:
俺も腕には自信があるつもりだが、
正直言って今回はヒヤリとさせられた――
侵食されたグリフィンとは、これほど凶暴なものか
MsgEn:
I am confident in my weapons, but if I am honest,
this time I may have made a mistake...
Is this Infected Griffin as ferocious as they say?

MsgJp:
さすがに今回ばかりは、落命すら覚悟した
まだ命がある事、感謝せねば――
MsgEn:
As one would expect, even though I was prepared
to die,
I still live, and I must not take that for
granted...

MsgJp:
ともあれ、そろそろ収集物も増えてきた――
持ち歩くにも動きづらいため
ひとまとまりにして保管しておくことにしよう
MsgEn:
Anyway, my collection has recently grown in
size...
I've decided to keep it all in one place, as it
is getting hard
to carry it around everywhere with me.

MsgJp:
魔物の巣になるばかりの
うち捨てられた建物があった
村に置き去るよりは、そこの方が安心だろう
MsgEn:
There was an abandoned building nearby.
It would be much more secure to put it there,
than to leave it
in the village, only for it to become some
monster's nest.

MsgJp:
印象的なその姿――
我がアジトを『塔』と名付けよう
MsgEn:
What an impressive figure...
My own secret hideout, I'll call it the "Tower".

MsgJp: "古い日記のページが落ちている"
MsgEn: "A page from an old diary has fallen down."

MsgJp:
ベヘモットを倒し、宝を入手できたのは良かったが
それを塔まで持ち帰るのに苦労した――
MsgEn:
It was satisfying to beat that behemoth and get
treasure from it,
but I had a hard time bringing it back to the
tower...

MsgJp:
戦いの最中だけでなく、
帰り道にすらアイツに苦労させられるとは――
苦労した分、この素材が何に
使えるのかという期待は高まる一方だ
MsgEn:
Not only during the battles,
but even on the way back to that guy I have
suffered hardships...
Due to these struggles, the expectations I have
for what this
material can be used for are rising.

MsgJp:
ここしばらくの収穫は
我ながら好調すぎるほどだ
日頃の感謝もあり、例の情報屋に話してみたが――
MsgEn:
The harvest here has been great for a while and
I've felt the need to show gratitude because of
it.
For example, I spoke to the information broker...

MsgJp:
青い顔になって、そんなものを集めるのは
すぐ止めるようにと強く言われた
なんでも、"良くない運命"を引き寄せるとか――
嘘をついている表情ではないが――
にわかに信じがたい
MsgEn:
They became pale in the face, and said that
collecting
such things must be stopped at once.
Doing anything else, would be inviting "bad
fate"...
By the look on their face, they weren't lying...
It's still hard to believe though.

MsgJp: 向かう所敵無し、これほどの絶好調だと言うのに――
MsgEn:
I'm unbeatable though, and would say this is
going to go perfectly well...

MsgJp: "筆跡が新しい日記のページが落ちている"
MsgEn:
"The handwriting is from a page that has fallen
out of a new diary."

MsgJp:
見た目は何ともおぞましく
邪悪な魔法は強力だったが
叩き落としてしまえば、たやすいものだった――
MsgEn:
What a horrible sight.
Dark magick worked incredibly well against it,
and when it was knocked down, it was easy to slay
it...

MsgJp:
こんな魔物に、数多の人々が言葉無き姿に
変えられたかと思うと、何ともやるせない
MsgEn:
To think that many people were changed into
speechless statues
by such a demon, is deeply depressing...

MsgJp:
ともあれ、希少素材は入手した
せめてメドゥーサの犠牲となった人々に
安らかな眠りが与えられるよう――祈るしかない
MsgEn:
Anyway, as soon as we collect the rare material
from it,
we have to say a prayer for the souls that have
fell victim at the hands of the Medusa...
I have no choice but to pray...

MsgJp:
この素材に、どれだけの
人間の怨念が込められているか
いや――今まで集めてきた全てが
同じ宿因にあるのだろう
MsgEn:
This material...
Are there remnants of human grudges is trapped
within?
It's unpleasant...but it seems to be used for the
same purpose as
everything else we've collected up until now in
the inn.

MsgJp:
――それを考えれば、集めると
"良くない運命"を引き寄せるという
いつか聞いた話も頷けるように思う
MsgEn:
...Given that, if one collects things like these
they say it will invite a "bad fate".
I think the stories I've heard will someday
become true...

MsgJp: "日記の１ページが落ちている"
MsgEn: "A page out of a diary has fallen down."

MsgJp:
侵食の進んだ、危険な土地ではありましたが――
退治した大型魔物に侵食の気配は無く
今まで同様強敵だったものの、少し安心しました
MsgEn:
Although the land was highly corrupted and
dangerous -
there was no sign of infestation in the large
monsters that we eliminated.
And although they were as powerful as ever, we
were a bit relieved.

MsgJp:
しかし、このような土地で侵食されず生息するとは
移り住んだばかりなのか、抗体があるのか――
MsgEn:
However, to live in a land like this without
being infected...
Is it because they just moved in, or do they have
antibodies?

MsgJp:
ベンジャミン様はその美しい魔物からも素材を
回収すると、装備品をまた一つ作成されました
この装備もまた――塔に納めるおつもりなのでしょう
MsgEn:
Master Benjamin collected materials from that
beautiful demon and created another piece of
equipment.
This equipment also intended to be stored in the
tower.

MsgJp:
先日立ち寄った拠点で耳に入って来たのですが――
フィンダムには、偉大な人物が亡くなった際
装具や装飾品を副葬品として埋葬する文化が
あるそうなのです
MsgEn:
I overheard at a stopover the other day... that
there is a tradition in Phindym where when great
men die, they are buried with their equipment and
ornaments as burial accessories.

MsgJp:
ベンジャミン様がご友人の足跡を巡りながら
作成した装備品を埋葬していくのは――
フィンダムの流儀に則った弔い、なのかもしれません
MsgEn:
Perhaps Master Benjamin, while tracing the
footsteps of his friend, is burying the equipment
he created—an homage following the Phindym
tradition.

MsgJp: "日記の１ページが落ちている"
MsgEn: "A page out of a diary has fallen down."

MsgJp:
驚くべき発見です！
ピクシーが、これほど高度な社会的序列を築いて
いたとは――しかも、その強固さは
比較対象にされることの多いゴブリン以上です
MsgEn:
It is a surprising discovery!
I had no idea that Pixies had built such a high
level of social hierarchy - and moreover, its
strength is greater than that of the commonly
compared Goblin.

MsgJp:
ベンジャミン様はいつになくご機嫌が良いようで
なんと――ご自分のことを
少し話してくださいました！
MsgEn:
Mr. Benjamin seemed to be in an unusually good
mood and, by golly... he told us a little about
himself!

MsgJp:
まず、亡きご友人について
フィンダム人唯一の友人であること――
彼の志に敬意を表し、弔いの旅を続けていること――
MsgEn:
First and foremost, I pay my respects to my late
comrade, the only friend of a Phindymian. I
continue my journey in tribute to his aspirations
and in mourning.

MsgJp:
さらに、旅が終わったら二度と
このようなことが起きないよう
冒険者の集いを作り、助け合えるように
したいということ
MsgEn:
Furthermore, once our journey concludes, I wish
to establish a gathering of adventurers to ensure
that such events never happen again, and to foster
mutual assistance.

MsgJp:
そして最も感動したのは、我々にも
その一端を担わせてくださるということ――
ポーンでありながら、仲間として
認められたような気さえしました
MsgEn:
And what moved me the most was that we were
allowed to play a part in it as well. Even as
pawns, it felt like we were recognized as
companions.

MsgJp: "日記の１ページが落ちている"
MsgEn: "A page out of a diary has fallen down."

MsgJp:
この森の最奥で待ち構えていた魔物は
一度対峙した記憶のある魔物――
その腕力は相変わらず脅威でしたが
危なげなく突破することができました
MsgEn:
The creature that lay in wait at the deepest part
of this forest was a creature I had once faced
before. Its strength remained as formidable as
ever, but we were able to overcome it without much
trouble.

MsgJp:
癒しの力を当てることで
あの奇妙な触手の威力を
一定時間抑えることができるようなのです
MsgEn:
It seems that applying the power of healing can
temporarily suppress the strange tentacles' power.

MsgJp:
ところで――
最近は侵食されている魔物と対峙することが多く
ベンジャミン様はよく咳き込み
どこか苦しそうなご様子です
MsgEn:
By the way -
Recently, Master Benjamin has been facing many
infected enemies, and often coughs with a somewhat
painful appearance.

MsgJp:
覚者は竜の力を得ているとはいえ
病には罹りますし、ごくゆっくりと老衰もする――
一言で申し上げるならば、心配です
MsgEn:
While Arisen possess the power of the dragon,
they can still fall ill, and age gradually as
well. In a word, it is a cause for concern.

MsgJp:
どうも、後ろ向きなことばかり考えてしまいます
「弔い」という目的を果たした時
あの方はどうなってしまわれるのでしょう
最悪の場合を想像してしまう私を、お許しください
MsgEn:
I find myself constantly dwelling on negative
thoughts. When we achieve the "mourning" purpose,
I wonder what will become of that person. Please
forgive me for imagining the worst-case scenario.

MsgJp: "日記の１ページが落ちている"
MsgEn: "A page out of a diary has fallen down."

MsgJp:
侵食されている魔物の行動には、
いくつかのパターンが見られます
MsgEn:
There are several patterns observed in the
behavior of the infected creatures.

MsgJp:
とにかく凶暴性が助長されるもの
侵食前と変わらない行動サイクルを持つもの
そしてこの魔物のように侵食から逃れようと
もがき苦しむもの――
MsgEn:
There are those whose aggressiveness is
exacerbated, those that maintain the same
behavioral cycle as before infection, and those
like this creature, who struggle in agony, trying
to escape from the corruption.

MsgJp:
その姿は哀れを誘いますが――
侵食によって箍の外れた力は、一瞬でも
気を緩めればこちらが命を落とすほどです
MsgEn:
Their appearance evokes pity, but the power
unleashed by Corruption is so dangerous that even
a momentary lapse in concentration could cost us
our lives.

MsgJp:
この度の魔物は強敵でしたが
それ以上に苦戦しました
ベンジャミン様の動きが鈍く、我々が
それを庇っていたためです
MsgEn:
The creatures we faced this time were formidable
foes, but what made it even more challenging was
that Master Benjamin's movements were slow, and we
were protecting him.

MsgJp:
このままでは、ベンジャミン様のご友人を弔うはずが
我々自身の弔い旅になってしまうかもしれません
帰還し、ゆっくり休養いただけるまであと少し――
MsgEn:
If this continues, our journey to mourn Master
Benjamin's late friend might turn into our own
mourning journey. We'll have to return and rest a
little while longer until Master Benjamin can
recuperate.

MsgJp: "日記の１ページが落ちている"
MsgEn: "A page out of a diary has fallen down."

MsgJp:
最後の戦いは、壮絶を極めました
侵食の悪魔――
相手はまさに、その言葉にふさわしい怪物でした
MsgEn:
The final battle was truly epic. The demon of
infection—our adversary was undoubtedly a monster
befitting those words.

MsgJp:
最後の力を振り絞り、何とか止めを刺したものの――
我々従者は深手を負ってしまったのです
MsgEn:
We mustered our last ounce of strength and
managed to strike the finishing blow, but as a
result, we, the servants, sustained serious
injuries.

MsgJp:
傷つき、動けない我々を残し
ベンジャミン様は一人、行ってしまわれました
目的を達するためには足手まといは不要――
そういうことなのでしょう
MsgEn:
Leaving us wounded and immobilized behind, Master
Benjamin went on alone. To achieve the objective,
we can't have anything slowing us down—perhaps
that was the reason.

MsgJp:
導きを失った私たちは
ただ愚直に、主の帰りを待つことしかできません
最後の魔窟殿へ独りで向かった、傷だらけの主を――
MsgEn:
We, who have lost our guidance, can do nothing
but earnestly await the return of our master. Our
master, who ventured alone to the final demon's
lair, battered and bruised.

MsgJp:
戻られたあの方を暖かく迎えるため
一体何をすべきか、ベンジャミン様と交わした言葉を
思い起こしながら考えてみようと思います
MsgEn:
I will think about what we should do to warmly
welcome them back based on the words exchanged
with Master Benjamin, with the aim of greeting
them upon their return.

MsgJp: "手記と思われる紙の切れ端が落ちている"
MsgEn: "Scraps of a paper note seem to have fallen down."

MsgJp: "塔"とは一体、どこにあるのだろう？
MsgEn: This "Tower" of his, where the heck is it?

MsgJp:
用心深い彼のことだ、たやすく見つかる場所に
あるとは思っていないが――
日記によると、全てをそこに置いてきたのだとか
MsgEn:
He's very cautious, so I don't think he's in a
place
that can be easily found...
According to the diary, he says everything has
been placed there?

MsgJp:
「全て」がすなわち宝を意味するならば
盗賊を警戒して巧妙に隠す意図も理解できる
――物に執着があるとは、少々意外だったが
MsgEn:
If by everyhing he means "treasure",
you can understand his intention to hide it from
any would-be thieves.
...It's still a bit surprising that there is an
obsessed with such
things though.

MsgJp:
とはいえ、彼の足取りを順に追っていけば
いつかは"塔"に辿り着くだろう
MsgEn:
Nevertheless, if we retrace his steps
we will arrive at the tower in due time.

MsgJp:
彼が命尽きる時まで追い求めた宝――
その遺志を継ぎ、形にして納めることで
彼と私、お互いにとって良い弔いになるはずだ
MsgEn:
The treasure that he had chased after until the
time of his death...
By carrying on his will, and shaping it, both he
and I, will have lavish funerals.

MsgJp: "手記と思われる紙の切れ端が落ちている"
MsgEn: "Scraps of a paper note seem to have fallen down."

MsgJp:
魔物を狩り、呪われた宝から
鎧を造りだす時間を除けば
一時も休むことなく進み、彼の痕跡を追っている
MsgEn:
Between hunting monsters, and putting aside time to
craft armor from the cursed treasure...
I have no time to take breaks, and must carefully
retrace his steps.

MsgJp:
だが、フィンダムでの無理が祟り
咳は酷くなる一方で、従者どもに心配された
MsgEn:
However, this cursed land of Phindym has given me
an unnatural cough, which has made my pawns
worried.

MsgJp:
いや、正しくは「そう見える」と言うべきか
彼らがまるで人間のような仕草を見せるたび
怖気と虚しさを感じるのだ
MsgEn:
No, I should say they "look like they are".
Everytime they show a gesture or expression like
a human being,
it feels unnerving and empty.

MsgJp:
家族も故郷も失い、救いを求めて心臓を捧げ
得たものがこんな傀儡だったとは――
工作や戦いの腕が優れているとはいえ
当時は愕然としたものだ
MsgEn:
To lose my family and hometown, seeking salvation
and dedicating my heart,
only to receive a puppet such as this...
Although their inherent skill in crafting and
combat are outstanding, at the time,
I was appalled.

MsgJp:
弔いをしてやれるような――
生涯で友と言える相手は、彼くらいだろう
MsgEn:
I'm going to mourn...
The partner that would be known as a friend in
his life, they would not be able to.

MsgJp: "手記と思われる紙の切れ端が落ちている"
MsgEn: "Scraps of a paper note seem to have fallen down."

MsgJp:
従者が時たま、本当に人の心を
持っているのではないかと錯覚するような
表情を見せるようになってきた――
MsgEn: Occasionally, a follower has a truly human heart.

MsgJp:
今までろくに話もしなかったことを後悔しそうだ
身体がひどく弱っているせいで
精神が落ち込みやすくなっているのだろうか
MsgEn:
I'm starting to regret not having spoken much
until now. Could it be that my spirit is easily
downcast because my body is in such a weakened
state?

MsgJp:
心の奥底で、凶暴な衝動が
揺らめくのも感じるのだ
今まで見てきたおぞましい魔物のように
私も変わってしまうのだろうか――
MsgEn:
Deep in my heart, I can feel the flickering of a
violent impulse. Just like the hideous enemies I
have seen before, will I also end up
changing—transforming into something horrifying?

MsgJp:
長く関わりすぎたのだ
大きな力を持つ物は人を強く引きつけるが
それが淀み――侵されていれば、悲劇を呼ぶ
MsgEn:
It is because they possess great power that they
strongly attract people, but if that power
stagnates or is invaded, it will bring tragedy.

MsgJp:
残すは遙かに見える塔のみ
頼もしき従者と共に
どうか、辿り着かせてくれ――竜よ
MsgEn:
All that remains is the tower in the distance.
Please, with my reliable attendants, guide me to
reach it, oh, Dragon.

MsgJp:
押収した小型のナイフ
刃が鈍いため殺傷能力は低いと思われる
柄に文字が刻んであり、B-A-S-I-Tと読める
MsgEn:
Seized small knife.
The blade appears to be dull, so its killing
power is likely low.
The handle has the characters engraved, and it
can be read as B-A-S-I-T.

MsgJp:
メガドのゴロツキリーダーが
自警のため自主的に作成した市民名簿
一般市民だけでなく、闇に生きる
はみ出し者たちまでが網羅されている
本人の超記憶能力と照らし合わせているため
正確性は高いらしい
MsgEn:
Megado's Thug Leader created a citizen register
voluntarily for self-defense.
Not only regular citizens, but also those who
live in the dark, including outcasts, are
included.
Due to their extraordinary memory abilities, the
accuracy of the register is said to be high.

MsgJp:
メガドを縄張りにする子供から聞いた目撃証言
" <NPC 691>は数度にわたって彼らの縄張りに
　踏み込み、覚者たちを尾行するための
　事前調査を行っていた "
という旨の内容
MsgEn:
Approximate eyewitness testimony from a child in
the Megado's territory:
"<NPC 691> trespassed into their territory
several times, conducting preliminary
investigations to tail the Arisen Corps members."

MsgJp:
汚い字でメモが書き込んである
" ＜20時　対象を確認＞
　　場所：メガド居住区侯爵邸前
　　人数：2名
　　報告：ターゲットがレジスタンスと接触
　　　　　隠れ家へ向かうと思われるため
　　　　　引き続き、追跡監視の任務続行 "
以下、同じような記録が淡々と続いている
MsgEn:
The memo is written in messy handwriting.
"<20:00 Target Confirmation>
Location: In front of the Megado Residential
District Marquis Mansion
Number of People: 2
Report: Target has made contact with the
Resistance and is believed to be heading towards
their hideout. The mission of tracking and
surveillance will continue."
Similar records continue in a matter-of-fact
manner.

MsgJp:
憲兵が落とした日々の巡回記録
複数の憲兵により異なる筆跡で書かれているが
どれも書式は共通している
" ＜22時　対象を確認＞
　　場所：メガド居住区東小門前
　　人数：5名
　　報告：通報のあった結社集会の現場を発見
　　　　　構成員は全て市民のため
　　　　　その場で拘束・連行し、任務完了 "
以下、同じような記録が淡々と続いている
MsgEn:
Daily Patrol Records Dropped by the Military
Police.
Written in different handwriting by multiple
military policemen,
but all the formats are the same.
"<22:00 Confirm target>
Location: Megado Residential Area, East Gate
Number of people: 5
Report: Discovered the site of a reported
association gathering
All members are citizens
Arrested and taken into custody on the spot,
mission complete"
Following that, similar records continue in a
steady manner.

MsgJp:
元憲兵の男が、獄中で書いた手記
" 任務で小さなミスを犯し、侯爵の怒りを
　買ったために投獄された "
という内容で、獄中の苦しい状況などが
克明に描写されている
ところどころがシミで汚れており読みづらい
MsgEn:
Memoirs Written by a Former Military Police
Officer in Prison
The handwritten memoirs of a former military
police officer, who was imprisoned after
committing a minor mistake on a mission and
incurring the wrath of a nobleman.
The memoirs vividly depict the harsh conditions
experienced in prison, although some parts are
difficult to read due to stains.

MsgJp:
連絡が途絶えた一人息子を想う父の
愛情が詰まった手作りのお守り
息子を憲兵隊に送り出す際に
渡し損ねたことを悔やむ日々が
傷だらけの表面に現れている
MsgEn:
A handmade amulet filled with a father's love,
yearning for his son who he lost contact with. The
days of regret for not being able to hand it over
when sending his son off to the Military Police
are evident on its scarred surface.

MsgJp:
<NPC 586>と密通していたオークが
持っていた文書
オークの暗号文字で書かれており
読むことはできない
MsgEn:
The document was in the possession of an Orc who
was in secret communication with <NPC 586>.
It is written in Orc code letters and cannot be
read.

MsgJp:
オークの専門家が人語に翻訳してくれた
オーク軍の密通文書
" オーク軍は要請に応え、
　メガドに援軍を手配した "
という旨の内容
MsgEn:
The Orc specialist has translated the
confidential communication documents of the Orc
army into human language.
"Orc Forces responded to the request and arranged
for reinforcements to be sent to Megado."

MsgJp:
オークの被害を受けた少女から聞いた
街に増加するオークについての目撃証言
" 近頃急速に街中で目撃数が増加している
　オークたちは何かを探している様子
　人なのか物なのか、任務なのかは不明 "
という旨の内容で、出没し始めた時期は
<NPC 586>の死亡・オークの尋問開始と
重なっている模様
MsgEn:
From a girl who was affected by the Orcs'
rampage, an eyewitness account about the
increasing number of sightings of Orcs in the
city.
"The number of sightings in the city has been
rapidly increasing lately. The Orcs seem to be
looking for something. Whether it's a person or an
object, or if it's a mission, is unknown."
It seems that their appearance coincides with the
death of <NPC 586> and the start of Orc
interrogations.

MsgJp:
<NPC 681>侯爵が描かれた肖像画
高価な貴族画ではなく
個人が安価に所有できる量産品である
雑な取扱いによる傷みはあるが、
顔かたちは十分に確認できる状態
MsgEn:
Portrait depicting <NPC 681>, a marquis.
Not an expensive aristocratic painting, but a
mass-produced item that individuals can afford.
There may be some damage due to rough handling,
but the facial features are clearly discernible.

MsgJp:
ある兵士から聞いた、メガド占領時に
<NPC 681>が行った英雄的行為の証言
" ナヴィド侯爵は死の危険を冒し、果敢にも
  人間への残虐な仕打ちを止めるよう
  オーク軍と交渉した
  その後も市民の統率者として、オーク側との
  橋渡しを行い、犠牲者を抑える功績を残す "
という旨の内容
MsgEn:
Testimony of the heroic deeds performed by <NPC 681>
 during the Megado occupation, as told by a
soldier:
"Lord Navid bravely risked his life and daringly
negotiated with the Orc army to put an end to
their cruel treatment of humans. Even after that,
as a leader of the citizens, he acted as a bridge
between the Orc side, leaving behind the
achievement of minimizing casualties."

MsgJp:
侯爵家を出入りしていた戦士が
偶然入手した謎の帳簿
かなり使い込まれているようで
几帳面な字で文字と数字が羅列されている
"オーク"という言葉が頻出している
MsgEn:
A soldier who frequented the Marquis' household
happened to come across a mysterious ledger.
It appears to have been heavily used, with neat
handwriting and a series of characters and numbers
listed.
The word "Orc" is frequently mentioned.

MsgJp:
捕えたオークから尋問によって全てを吐かせた
<NPC 681>とオーク軍の機密についての証言
" メガド陥落は、悲観した<NPC 681>侯爵の
  手引きによって引き起こされた事件であり
  陥落後も彼はオーク軍と取引し
  捕虜の統括に対する報酬を受け取っていた "
という旨の内容となっている
MsgEn:
The capture of <NPC 681> and interrogation of the
orc revealed the following confidential
information:
'Megado's fall was an event instigated through
the guidance of the despairing Marquis <NPC 681>.
Even after the fall, he continued to deal with the
Orc army and received rewards for overseeing the
prisoners.'

MsgJp:
監修ガクシャ・制作セリンで捏造した
オーク軍の手配書
" 人間に寝返った伝令兵を捜索中 "
という旨の内容になっており
尋問で使用すれば
裏切りに対する報復を恐れるオークを
騙すことが出来るかもしれない
MsgEn:
A fabricated wanted poster created by Supervisor
Raksha and produced by Selin,
"Searching for a defected messenger soldier"
It contains a message that may deceive the Orcs,
who fear retaliation for their betrayal, when used
for interrogation.

巨大な節足動物が脱皮により脱ぎ捨てた抜け殻の一部

but it holds intense heat within, turning it into
a molten projectile.

An ore with intense heat, its interior is often
molten.
Occasionally cracked, it shines with a red glow.

呪印が刻み込まれた骨の欠片

Bone Crafting Material: Fragment of Bone with
Cursed Seal

markings engraved on it.

human.

on its surface.

power.

original form is unknown.

War Ready armor strengthened with enhanced
dominance.

Orc who has achieved great war merit.

A sinister mass of power that can only be
obtained during a specific period.

MsgEn:
A gem that resembles a glowing moth, it
transforms into a beautiful and radiant "Luminous
Mandra Lamp" when used as fertilizer for the
Mandragora.

MsgJp:
赤と白のまだら模様の苔が生えた珍しい宝石
マンドラゴラに肥料として与えると、王の威厳が溢れる
「おうさまマンドラゴラ」に変身する
MsgEn:
A rare gem with a mottled pattern of red and
white moss growing on it.
When used as fertilizer for the Mandragora, it
transforms into the majestic "King Mandragora".

MsgJp:
入手機会が限られたクラフト用素材
鮮紅色に輝く宝石と王族の紋章が印象的なコイン
記念品として作られたもので貨幣としては使われない
MsgEn:
Crafting materials with limited availability:
A coin with a striking deep green color and the
impressive coat of arms of the royal family.
It is made as a commemorative item and is not
used as currency.

MsgJp:
宝石系のクラフト用素材
鋭く光り輝く黄色の宝石
MsgEn:
Gem Crafting Material:
A beautiful gem that shines yellow.

MsgJp:
黒呪の迷宮でのみ入手できるアイテム
頑丈な造りに強固な封印が施された箱
開けるには特殊な技術が必要
MsgEn:
An item that can only be obtained in the
Bitterblack Maze.
A sturdy box with a strong seal.
Special techniques are required to open it.

MsgJp:
木材系のクラフト用素材
美しい縞模様の木目が人気の木材
特に質が良く、家具の素材として最適なもの
MsgEn:
Wood Crafting Material:
A popular wood with beautiful striped grain
patterns.
It has excellent quality and is particularly
suitable as a material for furniture.

MsgJp:
鉱石系のクラフト用素材
レスタニア産の大理石
一部神殿内の装飾にも使われている
MsgEn:
Ore Crafting Material:
Lestanian marble, mined in Lestania.
Also used for decoration in certain temple
interiors.

MsgJp:
宝石系のクラフト用素材
質・大きさ共に不揃いな宝石の欠片
アクセサリーには向かないが
家具や室内の装飾に多用される
MsgEn:
Gem crafting material with irregular quality and
size.
Not suitable for accessories but commonly used
for furniture and interior decorations.

MsgJp:
白竜神殿への日々の貢献を認めて発行されるメダル
集めることでそれに応じた品物と交換することができる
MsgEn:
Medals issued in recognition of daily
contributions to the White Dragon Temple.
By collecting them, you can exchange them for
corresponding items.

MsgJp:
壊れかけの石造りの鍵
強力な闇の力を帯びており、異なる
大陸へ繋がる扉を開く
MsgEn:
A partially broken stone key imbued with powerful
dark magick, capable of opening a door leading to a
different continent.

MsgJp:
草花系のクラフト用素材
数センチほどにしか育たない草ではあるが
芯なる樹と同じ色に輝く不思議な植物
MsgEn:
Floral Crafting Material:
While it only grows a few centimeters tall, this
mysterious plant shines with the same color as the
core tree.

MsgJp:
木材系のクラフト用素材
王家の秘術により強い竜力をこめられた木材
典礼時にのみ持ちだされ、隅には小さく
王家の紋章が刻印されている
MsgEn:
Wood Crafting Material:
Wood imbued with powerful dragon energy through
the royal secret technique.
It is only brought out during ceremonies, and the
royal crest is engraved discreetly in one corner.

MsgJp:
魔道書系のクラフト用素材
僧侶や貴族によって管理されている書物の一部
レスタニアの歴史が詳細に記載されている
MsgEn:
Materials for crafting magickal grimoires.
Part of the books that are managed by priests and
noblemen.
Detailed accounts of Lestania's history.

MsgJp:
砂系のクラフト用素材
メルゴダ繁栄時の名残りとして
時折見られる純度の高い砂金
MsgEn:
Sand Crafting Material:
Occasionally found as a remnant of Mergoda's
prosperity, this gold sand is of high purity.

MsgJp:
特殊なクラフトに用いる素材
ポーンのみが扱うことができる液体
MsgEn:
A liquid that only Pawns can handle, used for
special Crafts.

MsgJp:
金属系のクラフト用素材
軟らかく加工しやすいが、武具として仕上げると
比類なき硬度と輝きを放つ非常に稀少な金属
MsgEn:
Metal Crafting Material:
A very rare metal that, when processed as armor,
emits an unparalleled hardness and brilliance.
It is soft and easy to work with, making it ideal
for crafting.

MsgJp:
皮革系のクラフト用素材
非常に強力な闇の力を持った鱗
見る者の意識すら吸い込むような限りない黒
MsgEn:
Pelt Crafting Material:
Scales imbued with an incredibly powerful
darkness.
Endless black that consumes the consciousness of
those who behold it.

MsgJp:
宝石系のクラフト用素材
鋭く尖った黒水晶
内部に何らかの力が絶えず渦巻いているのが見える
MsgEn:
Gem Crafting Material:
Sharply pointed smoky quartz.
You can constantly see some kind of power
swirling inside.

MsgJp:
皮革系のクラフト用素材
非常に強力な闇の力を持った鱗
闇に覆われる空のような複雑な色を見せる
MsgEn:
Pelt Crafting Material:
Scales imbued with an incredibly powerful dark
energy.
They display a complex color reminiscent of a sky
shrouded in darkness.

MsgJp:
羽根系のクラフト用素材
膨大で不安定な竜力により変形した黒竜の翼膜
MsgEn:
Feather Crafting Material:
Wing membrane of a black dragon deformed by vast
and unstable dragon force.

MsgJp:
爪牙系のクラフト用素材
大きく曲がった黒竜の爪
闇の竜力に満ちて鋭く輝く
MsgEn:
Fang Crafting Material:
Large, twisted black dragon fang.
Filled with dark dragon force, it gleams sharply.

MsgJp:
角系のクラフト用素材
触れる者の善悪の判断を曖昧にするほどの
非常に強い魔力を秘めたバフォメットの角
MsgEn:
Horn Crafting Material:
Baphomet's horn harboring an extremely strong
magick that blurs the moral judgment of those who
touch it.

MsgJp:
金属系のクラフト用素材
比類なき硬度と竜力を持つ未知の金属塊
MsgEn:
Metal Crafting Material:
An unknown lump of metal with unparalleled
hardness and Dragon Force.

MsgJp:
鉱石系のクラフト用素材
鉄や鉛を金銀に変える触媒となる人造鉱石
古の錬金術師らによって造り出されたが
完成にはいたっておらず、性質は安定しない
MsgEn:
Ore Crafting Material:
A synthetic ore that serves as a catalyst to
transform iron and lead into gold and silver.
It was created by ancient alchemists but remains
incomplete, with its properties being unstable.

MsgJp:
布系のクラフト用素材
ダウ渓谷から毎年少量のみ出荷される絹の生地
光沢美しくなめらかで、高級衣類に使われる
MsgEn:
Cloth Crafting Material:
Derived from silk fabric that is shipped only in
small quantities every year from Dowe Valley.
It has a beautiful glossy and smooth texture, and
is used for luxury clothing.

もこもことした手触りの良い毛糸
手編み初心者にも扱いやすいことで評判
MsgEn:
String Crafting Material:
Fluffy and soft to the touch.
Well-renowned for being easy to handle even for
beginners in knitting.

MsgJp:
草花系のクラフト用素材
紙を作るのに適した繊維質な植物
作られた紙に想いをしたためると
相手に伝わりやすいという噂がある
MsgEn:
Floral Crafting Material:
A fibrous plant suitable for making paper.
There is a rumor that when you write your
thoughts on the paper made from it, they are
easier to convey to others.

戦士の理性を奪うための魔印が
記された呪符
MsgEn:
Crafting material for Grimoires of Magick.
An amulet inscribed with a magickal seal designed
to steal the rationality of soldiers.

MsgJp:
草花系のクラフト用素材
白竜神殿内薬園の一角にて神官たちに育てられた綿花
微量の竜力を帯びている貴重品
MsgEn:
Floral Crafting Material:
A valuable commodity, cotton, grown by the
priests in a corner of the medicinal garden inside
the White Dragon Temple.
It contains a small amount of Dragon Force.

MsgJp:
雑多なクラフト用素材
非常に凝った細工を施された銀の鎖
異国から渡ったとも、人の手による作ではないとも
いわれている
MsgEn:
Miscellaneous Crafting Material:
A silver chain adorned with intricate
craftsmanship, said to have come from a foreign
land or to be the work of non-human hands.

MsgJp:
雑多なクラフト用素材
強力な消化液で骨を吸収し
自らの外殻として構成する虫
消化液、外殻ともに素材として有用
MsgEn:
Miscellaneous Crafting Material:
Insects that absorb bones with powerful digestive
fluid and use them to form their own exoskeleton.
Both the digestive fluid and the exoskeleton are
useful as materials.

MsgJp:
液体系のクラフト用素材
オークが獲物の皮を処理する際に使う液体
独特の風合いと頑丈さを出すが、奇妙な臭いが残る
MsgEn:
Liquid Crafting Material:
Liquid used by orcs to process animal skins.
Gives a unique texture and sturdiness, but leaves
a strange smell.

MsgJp:
金属系のクラフト用素材
衝撃を加えると美しい音色が響く金属
扱いには注意を要する
MsgEn:
Metal Crafting Material:
A metal that produces a beautiful tone when
struck.
Handle with care.

MsgJp:
砂系のクラフト用素材
亡霊が宿った泥
顔のようなものが浮かんだり、弾ける気泡と共に
声のような音が聞こえることがある
MsgEn:
Sand Crafting Material
Mud inhabited by spirits.
Sometimes, faces appear on it, and with bursting
bubbles, sounds like voices can be heard.

MsgJp:
草花系のクラフト用素材
甘い香りを放つ小さな群青色の花
香料や染料など用途が多い
MsgEn:
Floral Crafting Material:
A small cluster of indigo flowers that emit a
sweet fragrance.
They have various uses, such as for fragrance and
dye.

MsgJp:
宝石系のクラフト用素材
黄色に輝く美しい宝石
MsgEn:
Gem Crafting Material:
A beautiful gem that shines yellow.

Deal a great amount damage to Abaddon after you
inflict a certain amount of damage to its weak
point. <COL ffdc78>LV UP Further increases bonus
damage.</COL>

<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に追撃のダメージがより増加</COL>
MsgEn:
Deal a great amount damage to Baphomet after you
inflict a certain amount of damage to its weak
point. <COL ffdc78>LV UP Further increases bonus
damage.</COL>

MsgJp:
黒騎士の弱点部位に一定量のダメージを与えると
大ダメージを与える追撃が発生する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に追撃のダメージがより増加</COL>
MsgEn:
Deal a great amount damage to Black Knight after
you inflict a certain amount of damage to its weak
point. <COL ffdc78>LV UP Further increases bonus
damage.</COL>

MsgJp:
黒竜の弱点部位、または黒竜により召喚された竜晶に
一定量のダメージを与えると、大ダメージを与える追撃が発生する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に追撃のダメージがより増加</COL>
MsgEn:
Deal a great amount damage to Black Dragon and
the summoned Dragon Crystal after you inflict a
certain amount of damage to them. <COL ffdc78>LV
UP Further increases bonus damage.</COL>

MsgJp:
大ダメージを受けるアバドーンの攻撃＜キラーアルベ＞の
ダメージを軽減する。残り体力が少ない場合は発動しない
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎にダメージをさらに軽減</COL>
MsgEn:
Reduces damage of fatal attacks from Abaddon.
Does not activate if your health is low. <COL ffdc78>
LV UP Further reduces damage.</COL>

MsgJp:
敵が攻撃を放ったタイミングで、攻撃してきた部位や周囲の
弱点部位を攻撃すると《精霊竜の反撃アイコン》が増加する
アイコンが満了になると破壊可能部位へのダメージが大幅に増加する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎にダメージがより増加</COL>
MsgEn:
When an enemy strikes, attacking the part used by
the attack will increase the [Spirit Dragon
Counterattack Gauge]. When the gauge is full,
damage to destructible parts is greatly increased.
<COL ffdc78>LV UP Further increases bonus
damage.</COL>

MsgJp:
闇炎の状態異常にかかった際に回復までの時間を短縮する
回復までの時間は、付与される毎にやや増減する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に回復までの時間がさらに短縮</COL>
MsgEn:
Shorten the recovery time of Dark Flame
debilitation. The time needed slightly increases
or decreases each time this is triggered. <COL ffdc78>
LV UP Further shortens the recovery
time.</COL>

MsgJp:
敵の＜魔法攻撃力上昇＞に合わせて
魔法攻撃のダメージを無効化するバリアを展開する
バリア展開中は筋力／魔力／疲労攻力／チャンス攻力が増加するが
魔法攻撃を受けるか時間経過によりバリアの耐久値は減少する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎にステータスアップ効果／バリアの耐久値がより上昇</COL>
MsgEn:
Create a barrier to disable the [Magick Attack
Increase] buff from the enemy. While inside the
barrier, Strength/Magick/Chance Attack/Exhaust
Attack are increased. The durability of the
barrier deteriorates over time and magick damage
taken. <COL ffdc78>LV UP Further increases the
stat bonus and duration of the barrier.</COL>

MsgJp:
敵の＜物理攻撃力上昇＞に合わせて
物理攻撃のダメージを無効化するバリアを展開する
バリア展開中は筋力／魔力／疲労攻力／チャンス攻力が増加するが
物理攻撃を受けるか時間経過によりバリアの耐久値は減少する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎にステータスアップ効果／バリアの耐久値がより上昇</COL>
MsgEn:
Create a barrier to disable the [Physical Attack
Increase] buff from the enemy. While inside the
barrier, Strength/Magick/Chance Attack/Exhaust
Attack are increased. The durability of the
barrier deteriorates over time and physical damage
taken. <COL ffdc78>LV UP Further increases the
stat bonus and duration of the barrier.</COL>

MsgJp:
敵の＜鎧硬化＞に合わせて
吹き飛ばし力が増加し、鎧硬化状態を解除しやすくなる
鎧硬化状態を解除すると、敵が体勢を崩している間
筋力／魔力／疲労攻力／チャンス攻力が増加する追加効果が発動する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎にステータスアップ効果がより上昇</COL>
MsgEn:
Knockdown Power increases in response to [Armor
Harden] state triggered by the enemy, making it
easier to break through their armor. When the
enemy is in the staggered state,
Strength/Magick/Exhaust Attack/Chance Attack
increase. <COL ffdc78>LV UP Further increases the
stat bonus.</COL>

MsgJp:
ボス撃破時に獲得できる宝箱報酬が増加する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に報酬がより増加</COL>
MsgEn:
Increases the reward from chests after killing
the boss. <COL ffdc78>LV UP Further increases the
reward.</COL>

MsgJp:
黄金竜の攻撃により、敵の特定の攻撃を中断する
攻撃を中断すると＜破滅の力＞の蓄積量が減少する
<COL ffdc78>LV UP毎に破滅の力の減少量がより増加</COL>
MsgEn:
The Golden Dragon attacks, trying to interrupt a
specific attack of the enemy. If the interruption
succeeds, the [Power of Destruction] is lowered.
<COL ffdc78>LV UP Further decreases the
Destruction power.</COL>

MsgJp: ミシアルの登場
レオの覚悟
レオとの別れ
EX3.5-SP1
EX3.5-SP3
EX3.5-SP2
なんだおまえは？　あ？　レオの使い？
MsgEn: Who are you? Huh? Leo's messenger?

MsgJp:
おい、声を低く――奴らに聞かせるな
――それで、なんの用だ
MsgEn:
Hey, lower your voice - don't let them hear you.
So, what do you want?

MsgJp: 撤収？　はん！レオめ――

あいつは昔からそうだ
自信たっぷりな態度で間違えやがる
MsgEn:
He's always been like that, making
mistakes with a confident attitude.

MsgJp: おい、何をコソコソ――
MsgEn: Hey, what are you whispering about―!

MsgJp: 騎士団風情に聞かせる話なんぞないわ！
MsgEn:
You're not going to hear any tales fit 
for a noble knight from me!

MsgJp:
その言葉、聞き捨てならない！
あんたも元は騎士だろう？
MsgEn:
I can't just let that slide!
Weren't you a knight yourself, once upon a time?

MsgJp: ならば――

んな昔のことは忘れたぜ！
もう５０年前だからな！
MsgEn:
I've forgotten about such ancient things!
It's already been 50 years!

MsgJp: いやいやいや――

確かに俺がいた頃の騎士団は
誇り高き戦闘集団だった
MsgEn:
Indeed, the Knights' Order back when I was there
was a proud and elite combat unit.

MsgJp: ところが、今の騎士団はどうだ！？
MsgEn: But, what is the current Knights' Order!?

MsgJp: ――言ってみろ
口先だけの腰抜け集団だって言ってるんだよ！
MsgEn:
I'm saying they're a group of cowards who only
talk big!

MsgJp:
な？　魔物討伐の優先権があるってなら
さっさとやっつけろよ！
MsgEn:
Right? If there's an important task to slay monsters,
then hurry up and get rid of them already!

MsgJp:
何度も倒している！
しかし、倒しても、また現れるのだ
MsgEn:
We have defeated them many times!
But no matter how many times we do,
they keeps reappearing.

MsgJp:
どこかに巣窟があり、そこを叩かねば
ならないと協議しているところへ貴様が来て――
MsgEn:
There is a nest somewhere, and we must strike it.
And just as we were discussing this, you came―

MsgJp: ほら来た言い訳騎士団！
MsgEn: Oh, there's the Knights' Order; always making excuses!

MsgJp: くっ――
今度はなんだ？　奴らに聞かせるなよ
MsgEn: What is it this time? Don't let them hear you.

MsgJp:
なんだと！？
魔物を倒しただって？
MsgEn:
What did you say!?
You took care of it?

MsgJp: 今、なんと言った？

騎士団さんよ、人が悪いぜ
魔物はすっかり倒したらしいじゃねえか
MsgEn:
Hey, knights! Cut the slack. It seems the
monsters are all defeated.

MsgJp:
ったく！
おれたちは帰る！　ああ、帰るぞ！
MsgEn:
Right then, we're going back! 
Yeah, time to head home!

MsgJp: なんの話だ――
おまえ、騎士団副長のハインツだろ？
MsgEn:
You're the vice captain of the Knights, 
Heinz, yeah?

MsgJp:
そこまで出世するってのは
よほど話のわかる奴に違いねえ
MsgEn:
To have climbed the ranks that far,
you must be pretty reasonable.

MsgJp:
だから、ここの魔物を退治したのは
あんたか部下の誰かってことにしておけ
MsgEn:
So, let's just say that you or one of your
subordinates took care of the problem here.

MsgJp: それから新入り、おまえ――

いろいろ文句はあるだろうが全部飲み込め
疑問も飲み込め
MsgEn:
You may some complaints about this,
but just forget about them.
Swallow your doubts as well.

MsgJp:
ここにいる全員、おまえの手柄は忘れない
だが、公式には騎士団が倒したことにする
MsgEn:
Everyone here will never forget your achievement,
but officially, we'll credit the knighthood for
handling it.

MsgJp: いいな？
はん！　その手には乗るか！
MsgEn: Hah! You think I'll fall for that?!

MsgJp:
恩を売りつけようというのか？
貸しを作っておこうという魂胆か！？
MsgEn:
Are you trying to curry my favor?
Or is your intention to create a debt!?

MsgJp: ハインツ！
はっ！

怒声が木々に響き渡っているが――
揉め事ではないだろうな
MsgEn:
I heard raised voices echoing through the trees, 
but it doesn't look like there's a fight.

MsgJp:
信じられないことだが、騎士と見れば
因縁をつける志の低い覚者もいるようだ
MsgEn:
It's hard to believe, but there are some
low-minded Arisen who pick fights with Knights at
the slightest provocation.

MsgJp: まさか挑発に――
MsgEn: Of course,  we wouldn't actually take the bait...

MsgJp: とんでもありません！

騎士団長さんよ、信じてやりな
こいつはおれたちの不作法をいさめただけだ
MsgEn:
Oh Captain of the Knights, please believe me.
This person merely reprimanded our rudeness.

MsgJp:
ハインツたち、いい仕事をしたぜ？
魔物はもういない――静かなもんだ

――ほう
任務はすでに完了したというのか
MsgEn:
Oh, so it's true that the mission 
has already been completed?

MsgJp:
ふむ――
レオから報告を受けて慌ててここへ来たが
MsgEn:
Hmm...
I hurried here upon receiving a report
from Leo, but...

MsgJp:
取り越し苦労だったようだな
では、一同、神殿へ戻るがいい
MsgEn:
It seems that I was overly worried.
Well then, everyone, let us return to the Temple.

MsgJp: よし、じゃあ、覚者も解散だ！
MsgEn:
Alright, then. It's time for the Arisen to
head back as well!

MsgJp:
お疲れだったな
特におまえ――よくこらえた、いい根性だ
MsgEn:
Good work, everyone.
Especially you—you really hung in there. 
That shows some real grit.

MsgJp: おや――

こんなところで――
奇遇だな
MsgEn:
In a place like this...
What a coincidence.

MsgJp: ――いや
――なるほど

我々白騎団の捜索だけでは
心許ない――
MsgEn:
We cannot rely solely on our White Knights search
efforts...

MsgJp: ジョゼフ殿のご判断か
――ふむ

ともあれ、メイリーフ嬢は
このあたりにはいない
MsgEn: Anyway, Lady Mayleaf is not around this area.

MsgJp:
森にいるとすれば
さらに奥――
MsgEn: If she's in the forest, it must be further inside.

MsgJp:
いや待て――
これはトロールの足跡！？
MsgEn:
Wait, could it be...
These are the footprints of a Troll!?

MsgJp:
はるか向こうまで続いているようだ
新しいぞ――？
MsgEn:
It seems to continue far beyond. Is there
something new...?

MsgJp: メイリーフ嬢はすでに！？
ここ、お友達のお墓なの――
MsgEn: This is the grave of a friend...

MsgJp:
わたしがもっと幼かった頃――
あの子も同い年で――
MsgEn:
When I was younger...
That child was also the same age as me...

MsgJp:
どこへ行くにも――
何をするのも一緒だった――
MsgEn:
Wherever we go—
Whatever we do—it's together—

MsgJp:
でも、あの子は――
大人になって――
わたしを遠ざけるようになった――
MsgEn: She started keeping her distance from me—

MsgJp:
わたしがいつまでたっても
少女のままだったから――
MsgEn: Because I will forever remain a young girl—

MsgJp:
彼女となら
ずっと仲良くできると思っていたのに――
MsgEn:
I thought I could always get along with her,
but...

MsgJp: でも、無理だった――

結局、あの子は
わたしを遠ざけたまま――
MsgEn: In the end, that child keeps me at a distance...

MsgJp:
わたしを怪物扱いしたまま
自分はしわくちゃに老いて――
MsgEn:
Continuing to treat me like a monster, they age,
becoming wrinkled...

MsgJp: 死んでしまったの

それ以来、人間とは
仲良くならないようにしてるんだ
MsgEn:
Since then, I have been avoiding getting close to
humans.

MsgJp:
いつも距離を置いて
お互い、つかず、離れず、ね
MsgEn:
Always keeping a distance,
Neither too close nor too far, that's how we
should be, you know.

MsgJp: あれ？

わたしが人間じゃないって
話したかな？
MsgEn: Did I ever say that I'm not human?

MsgJp: わたしは――エルフなの

人間とは
生きている時間が違うの

あなたは――
あなたやレオやイリスは特別
MsgEn: You are... You, Leo, and Iris are special.

MsgJp: だって、覚者だからね
覚者は心臓がなくて――

心臓が時を刻まないから――
年を取らないんだよね
MsgEn:
Because the heart doesn't mark the passage of
time -
it doesn't age, you know.

MsgJp: 仲良くしてね？

わたしはゆっくりだけど
年を取る――
あなたたちは取らない――

わたしの背が伸びて
胸がふくらんだり――
MsgEn: My height has grown, and my chest has swelled...

MsgJp:
腰が曲がって
お婆さんになったり――
MsgEn: My back bends and I become an old lady.

MsgJp: 全部、見ていてね

はい――これで告白はお・わ・り
じゃあ、また、神殿で！
MsgEn:
Yes... With this, the confession is o-ver.
Well then, I'll see you again at the Temple!

MsgJp: 待ってくれよー！

はぁ――はぁ――
ジョゼフ様のご命令でね

メイリーフを見つけて
仲良くなっておけって――
MsgEn: He told me to find Mayleaf and befriend her-

MsgJp: ――なんだろうね、いったい

逃げた方がいいって！ 
キリがないぞ！？
MsgEn: It's better to run away! There's no end to this!

MsgJp: 誰かっ！　誰か助けて！
きみとは――二度目だな
MsgEn: That's the second time you and I have done this.

MsgJp:
そういえば
自己紹介がまだだった
――キースヒルトだ
ふっ――

我々の出会いは
いつも慌ただしいな
さて――

メイリーフの行方には
心当たりがある
MsgEn: I have an idea about the whereabouts of Mayleaf.

MsgJp:
あの子の保護は
僕に任せてくれ
MsgEn: Please entrust the protection of that child to me.

MsgJp:
彼女の身を案じることに
かけては――
MsgEn: When it comes to caring for her well-being...

MsgJp: 僕の方が上だと自負している
MsgEn: I take pride in believing that I am superior.

MsgJp: きみは神殿に戻って――
MsgEn: You should return to the Temple...

MsgJp:
自陣の結束を
確認しておいた方がいい
MsgEn: You should make sure your forces are united.

MsgJp:
人の繋がりなど――
脆いものだから
MsgEn:
Human connections and the like—
They are fragile things.

MsgJp:
ねえ、急いで神殿へ戻ろう
嫌な予感がする
MsgEn:
Hey, let's hurry and return to the Temple.
I have a bad feeling about this.

MsgJp:
――いや
嫌なものを見たっていうか――
MsgEn:
- No... It's more like I saw something
unpleasant...

MsgJp:
狙いはエルフだぞ！　いいな？
小さいぞ！　見逃すな！
MsgEn:
The target is an elf, got it? Small one! Don't
let them escape!

MsgJp: エルフ！　エルフ！

メイリーフ
俺から離れるな！
奴らは僕が引きつける
メイリーフを頼む
いや、敵は俺たちが引き受ける
MsgEn: No, we'll take on the enemy.

MsgJp:
あんたみたいな優男に
あの大軍は無理だ
MsgEn:
A delicate man like you can't handle that massive
army.

MsgJp: エルフ！？
そう――ただの優男ではない
MsgEn: I'm not just some delicate man.

MsgJp:
さあ、愚かなオークどもよ！
エルフの命欲しくば――いざ！
MsgEn:
Now, foolish Orcs!
If you desire the lives of the Elves,
then come forth!

MsgJp: 応援に行かないの？
MsgEn: Don't you want to go and help?

MsgJp:
エルフなら
うまく逃げ切るさ
MsgEn:
An Elf like him, should be able to escape
successfully.

MsgJp:
ただ今より、ここを最前線とする！
戦士たちよ！　退くな！　下がるな！
MsgEn:
From this moment on, this place shall be the
forefront!
Soldiers, do not retreat! Do not step back!

MsgJp:
なんだ？
何が起こっている！？
ほーら、こい、こい、こっちへこい！
MsgEn: Come on, come on, come over here!

MsgJp:
モゴック――エルフ野郎の居場所がわかった
エルテ・ディナンだ
MsgEn:
Mogok... I found the whereabouts of that Elf
bastard.
It's Erte Deenan.

MsgJp: ははっ！　ズールよ、そりゃいい

ろくでなしども！　引き上げるぞ！
エルテ・ディナンへ行く
MsgEn: Rotten scoundrels! We're going to Erte Deenan!

MsgJp:
ああ、ハインツ、丁度良かった
わたしを神殿まで連れて帰ってくれ
MsgEn:
Ah, Heinz, just in time.
Please take me back to the Temple.

MsgJp:
それはもちろん！
このわたしと――
MsgEn:
Of course!
Leave it to me.

MsgJp: ローガンとデュークにお任せください
MsgEn: Logan and Duke, you're with me.

MsgJp:
世話になったな
年寄りの世話は終わりだ
MsgEn:
I'm indebted to you.
But don't worry, you don't have to spend 
more time looking after the elderly.

MsgJp: では、神殿で会おう
MsgEn: Then, let's meet at the temple.

MsgJp: あれ？
なんだか、久しぶりだね
MsgEn: It's been a while, hasn't it?

MsgJp:
一番最近会ったのはキノザ――
ううん、《禊の神殿》だ
MsgEn:
Our most recent meeting was in Kinoza—
No, it was in the [Temple of Purification].

MsgJp: あの時は迷惑をかけちゃったな
MsgEn: I caused you trouble back then.

MsgJp:
いや、違うよね？
前回会ったのはアークの中だった
MsgEn:
No, that's not right, is it?
The last time we met was inside the Ark.

MsgJp:
あの時、あんたもいたよね？
レオと一緒に――
MsgEn:
Back then, you were there too, right?
Together with Leo...

MsgJp: ねえ、レオは？

そう――来てないんだ
え？　伝言？
MsgEn: No... they haven't come yet. Huh? A message?

MsgJp:
「命がけで身を隠せ」――か
うん、了解
MsgEn: "Hide yourself at all costs" — Got it.

MsgJp: じゃあ、こっちからもレオに伝えて
MsgEn:
Well, then, let's also convey it to Leo from our
side.

MsgJp: 「村に迷惑をかけたくないから山に隠れる」って
MsgEn:
"I don't want to be a nuisance to the village, so
I'll hide in the mountains," is what you're
saying, right?

MsgJp: ――ふう

さて、わたし、行くよ
――神殿のみんなによろしく
MsgEn:
Well, I'm off.
—Please give my regards to everyone at the
Temple.

MsgJp: 始まりは、荒波を海岸に叩きつけた強い風
MsgEn:
It all began with a strong wind that slammed the
rough waves onto the shore.

MsgJp: 続いて水平線に現れた黒雲は、夜のとばりの如く
MsgEn:
The black clouds that appeared on the horizon
continued, like a veil of night,

MsgJp: レスタニアを覆い、重い雨で大地を穿った
MsgEn:
Covering Lestania, it pierced the earth with
heavy rain.

MsgJp: これほどの自然の猛威は白竜の記憶にもなかった
MsgEn:
This level of natural devastation was not even
recorded in the White Dragon's memory.

MsgJp: 人々は怖れ、おののき、祈った
MsgEn: The people were afraid, trembling, and prayed.

MsgJp: その祈りを知ってか知らずか――
MsgEn:
Whether the White Dragon knew about those prayers
or not...

MsgJp: 白竜は、覚者たちを神殿に集めるよう
MsgEn:
The White Dragon commanded the Arisen to gather
in the temple.

MsgJp: 神官に命じた
では、各自、割り当てに従い現地へ向かってくれ
MsgEn:
Now, each of you, follow your assigned location
and go there.

MsgJp: 状況の把握が目的だが、優先すべきは人命だ
MsgEn:
Although the purpose is to assess the situation,
saving lives should be the priority.

MsgJp: 我が使いたちよ
怯える民に白竜の加護を伝えよ！
MsgEn:
Deliver the protection of the White Dragon to the
frightened people!

MsgJp: まだ息がある
が、若い女は面倒だ、おまえに任せる
MsgEn:
Ugh, young women are such trouble.
I'll leave this to you.

MsgJp: おいおいおい！
――小娘ってのは、いつも俺の想像を越えやがる
MsgEn: Ladies... They never fail to surprise me!

MsgJp: よっ――
うっ――
んっうっ――
うぉっ！
オマイ！　またオマイか！

あの時はよくもやってくれたなあ！
ああ、覚えているとも！
MsgEn:
You really pulled it off back then!
Ah yes, I remember it well!

MsgJp:
踏んづけて地面にめり込ませてやりたいが
今は忙しい
MsgEn:
I'd like to stomp you into the ground,
but I'm too busy right now.

MsgJp: ――オレは、特別な女を探している
MsgEn: —I am looking for a special woman.

MsgJp:
オマイ、オレの手先になって、女を
探さないか？
MsgEn: Will you be my henchman and help me find a woman?

MsgJp:
――ふん、また邪魔する気だな！
つくづく、面倒な奴め！
MsgEn:
Hmph, once again you intend to interfere!
You truly are a bothersome individual!

MsgJp: ふん――調子に乗るがいい――
MsgEn: Hmph, you better not get too carried away.

MsgJp:
だがな、オマイらはオレを見るたびに
怖れおののくことになるぞ
MsgEn:
But you all, every time you lay eyes on me, you
end up trembling in fear.

MsgJp:
オレの主（あるじ）は
ディアマンテスだと思っておろうが――
MsgEn:
My master is...
I know you think he's Diamantes, but...

MsgJp: 我が主は、ああ偉大なり、黒き鎧の騎士！
MsgEn:
My Lord, oh how magnificent you are, the Knight
in black armor!

MsgJp:
オレは黒騎士の不死身のポーン
何度でも蘇り、オマイの前に立ちふさがってやるわ
MsgEn:
I am the undying Pawn of the Black Knight.
I will resurrect countless times and stand before
you.

MsgJp:
女を差し出さねば
オマイらの悪夢は永遠に終わらんぞ！
MsgEn:
If you don't hand over the woman, your nightmares
will never end!

MsgJp: しっかし、ズールが黒騎士のポーンだったとは！
MsgEn: But to think Zuhl is a Pawn of the Black Knight!

MsgJp:
セシリー、知ってた？
君がここにいた理由と関係ある？
MsgEn:
Cecily, did you know?
Does it have anything to do with the reason you
are here?

MsgJp: ――何も思い出せないんです
わたしが追われる理由――
MsgEn: The reason why I am being chased—

MsgJp:
――ずっと考えているんです
雨が目に入ってつらかったこと――
MsgEn:
I have been thinking about it all the time.
The pain of rain getting into my eyes -

MsgJp:
間近に迫る黒騎士がおそろしかったこと――
生き延びねばならないと決意していたこと――
MsgEn:
The terrifying Black Knight approaching—
The determination to survive—

MsgJp: 覚えているのはそれだけです

わたし、どこかの島に
あなたを飛ばしてしまったそうですね
MsgEn:
I heard that I accidentally sent you to some
island, didn't I?

MsgJp:
場所を覚えていますか？
今一度、そこへ行けないでしょうか？
MsgEn:
Do you remember the place?
Can you go there again?

MsgJp:
騎士団が全力で探してるよ
大丈夫、きっと見つかるって
MsgEn:
The Knights are searching with all their might.
Don't worry, they will surely find it.

MsgJp: 隊長、神殿へ戻りましょう
MsgEn: Captain, let's return to the temple.

MsgJp:
島のことが気になるし、ズールの件も報告しないと
ジョゼフ様、今頃、ぷりぷり怒ってますって
MsgEn:
I'm curious about the island, and I need to
report about Zuhl as well.
Master Joseph must be furious by now.

MsgJp: 怯むな！　戦え！
みな、よく聞け！
心強い援軍が来てくれた
統率の右腕と呼ばれし者だ――
MsgEn:
Known as the right-hand of our
commander.

MsgJp: さあ、もうひと揉みしてやろうぞ！
MsgEn: Now, let's give it a final pounding!

MsgJp: ふん
はっ
うぉおおお――はっ！！
うぉおおお――
column9: Knight of the White Guard Order

MsgJp: うぉおおお――
column9: Knight of the White Guard Order

MsgJp: うっ―はっ！！
はっ！！
ぐはっ！
ぐはっ！
ぐはっ！
おおっ！！
おおっ！！
column9: Knight of the White Guard Order

MsgJp: おおっ！！
column9: Knight of the White Guard Order

MsgJp:
わはははは！
これは気分がいい
加勢、感謝する
おつかれさま、隊長

セシリーがあんまり心配するから
連れてきちゃった
MsgEn:
Because Cecily was so worried, I ended up
bringing her along.

MsgJp: 見事な戦いぶりでした！

人々が覚者を頼りにする理由が
わかったような気がします
MsgEn:
I feel like I understand why people rely on Arisen
now.

MsgJp: 竜に選ばれ、竜を守る者
MsgEn: Chosen by the dragon, defender of the dragon.

MsgJp:
それだけの力を授けられているからね
もちろん、その力は、竜とレスタニアのために使うの
MsgEn:
Because I have been bestowed with such power, I
will use it for the sake of the dragons and
Lestania, of course.

MsgJp: 素敵ですね――
でもね――不安もある
MsgEn: But you know, there are also worries.

MsgJp:
ずっと先の話だけど、覚者の誰かが
白竜様を引き継ぐことになるんだよね
MsgEn:
It's a story far in the future, but someday,
someone among the Arisen will inherit the White
Dragon.

MsgJp: 新しい白竜として、レスタニアに君臨するの
MsgEn:
To become the new White Dragon and reign over
Lestania.

MsgJp:
不安っていうのはね、その時、竜になれなかった
覚者はどうなっちゃうんだろうってこと
MsgEn:
You see, the unease comes from wondering what
happens to the Arisen who couldn't become dragons
at that time.

MsgJp: 竜に力を返して――死んじゃうのかな？
MsgEn:
Returning power to the dragon... will it mean
I'll die?

MsgJp:
それとも――よぼよぼになって
しわくちゃで生きながらえるのかな――
MsgEn:
Or maybe... will I just become feeble and
shriveled, barely surviving...

MsgJp: なんてね！

レスタニアの大地のため――
暮らす人々のために使命をまっとうする――
MsgEn:
For the land of Lestania—
For the people who inhabit it, I will fulfill my
mission—

MsgJp:
未来はどうあれ、後悔のない今を生きること――
わたしにはとても素敵に映りました
MsgEn:
No matter what the future holds, living in the
present without regrets - that is what seemed
really wonderful to me.

MsgJp: ま、そうだね、ちょっと照れくさいけど、その通り！
MsgEn:
Well, yeah, it's a little embarrassing but it's
true!

MsgJp: イリスを覚えているな？
セシリーよ

おまえは知るまいが、かつて、覚者仲間に
イリスという女がいた
MsgEn:
You may not know, but there was once a woman
named Iris who was a fellow Arisen.

MsgJp:
人懐こく、明るい娘だったが
心の中に闇を抱えていた
MsgEn:
She was a friendly and cheerful girl, but she
carried darkness within her heart.

MsgJp: その闇を、邪悪な力に利用されてな――
MsgEn: That darkness, was used by an evil power...

MsgJp: 結果、オレはイリスを殺した
MsgEn: As a result, I had to kill Iris.

MsgJp:
心中、お察しします
でも、わたしには――関係ありません
MsgEn:
I understand your feelings.
However, it does not concern me.

MsgJp: 見たところ、おまえの闇は深そうだ
MsgEn: It seems like your darkness runs deep.

MsgJp:
わかりません
それよりも、ロイグに会わせてください！
MsgEn:
You're not making sense.
Please let me see Loeg!

MsgJp: ロイグ？
無事で何よりだ、セシリー
族長ガラダの娘、セシリーだろ？
MsgEn:
The daughter of tribe chief Gearóid, Cecily,
right?

MsgJp:
そうです！　わたしの父はガラダ
そう、わたしは――ガラダの娘です！
MsgEn:
That's right! My father is Gearóid.
Yes, I am... Gearóid's daughter!

MsgJp:
他には、他には何か知りませんか？
教えてください！
MsgEn: Do you know anything else? Please tell me!

MsgJp:
黒騎士に追われている理由！
わたしの、内なる力と――
MsgEn:
The reason I'm being chased by the Black Knight!  
It's my dormant power, and—

MsgJp: この焼けるような使命感の正体は！？
MsgEn:
What is the true nature of this burning sense of
purpose!?

MsgJp: 悪いけど――知らないんだ

わたしが知っているのは
君が黒騎士に追われているという事実だけ
MsgEn:
The only thing I know is that you are being
pursued by the Black Knight.

MsgJp:
理由は知らない
なんとかして助けようと思った
MsgEn:
I don't know the reason, but I wanted to find a
way to help.

MsgJp: でも、その望みは叶わず、こうして、ここに――
MsgEn: But, that wish was not granted, and so, here...

MsgJp: そうですか――
どうしてセシリーを助けようと思ったの？
MsgEn: Why did you think of helping Cecily?

MsgJp:
取り繕っても仕方がないから正直に言うと――
族長の娘だからさ
MsgEn:
There's no point in lying, you're the daughter
of the chief of the tribe after all.

MsgJp: 族長に一目置かれたかった
MsgEn: I wanted to earn the respect of the chief.

MsgJp: なーんだ、ロマンティックな話かと――
MsgEn: Well, what a romantic story it turned out to be...

MsgJp: ん？
わっ（リアクション）
わっ（リアクション）
わっ（リアクション）
わっ（リアクション）
見つけたぞ！　女を渡せ！
MsgEn: I found her! Hand over the woman!

MsgJp:
はぁ――はぁ――
オレが倒れたら――黒騎士様が動き出すぞ
MsgEn:
Haa... haa...
When I fall... the Black Knight will move.

MsgJp: 魔物どもが主の意思により動くとなれば――
MsgEn:
If these monsters move according to their
master's will...

MsgJp:
クックックッ――
もはやレスタニアに安寧はない――
MsgEn:
Kukukku...
There will be no peace in Lestania anymore...

MsgJp:
すっごい捨て台詞だったよね
これで腐れ縁に終止符！　やったね！
MsgEn:
That was a really cliché line, wasn't it?
This puts an end to our cursed fate! We did it!

MsgJp:
口惜しい――どうして記憶が戻らないの？
どうして？
MsgEn:
How frustrating... Why can't I regain my memories?
Why?

MsgJp: ロイグ――どうした

大地を巡る竜力が淀み、集まる場所がある
そこで竜力を取り入れれば――
MsgEn:
Dragon Force, the power of dragons that
circulates through the earth, gathers in a certain
place. By harnessing the Dragon Force there...

MsgJp:
覚者は更なる力を手に入れることができる
いつか話してくれただろう？
MsgEn:
Arisen can obtain even greater power.
Didn't you mention it before?

MsgJp:
その地を、教えてほしい
レオ――レスタニアの危機だ
MsgEn:
I want you to tell me about that place, Leo—
Lestania is in danger.

MsgJp: ふん――
――ひさしぶりだ

生まれ合わせた時代のせいで
俺たちは理から外れた覚者になった
MsgEn:
Because of the era we were born into, we have
become Arisen who are outside of order.

MsgJp:
多勢は心強いが――
その代償は分散した竜の力
MsgEn:
While having many allies is reassuring, the price
for that is the dispersed power of the dragons.

MsgJp:
納得しているつもりだったが
黄金竜との対決で、考えずにはいられなかった
MsgEn:
I thought I understood and accepted it, but I
couldn't help but think during the confrontation
with the Golden Dragon.

MsgJp: なぜあいつを倒せないのか――
MsgEn: Why can't we defeat that guy—

MsgJp: それは、俺が弱いからだ

竜の力を存分に継承していないことを
思わずにはいられない
MsgEn:
I can't help but think that they haven't fully
inherited the power of the dragon.

MsgJp:
時代の巡り合わせだからと
したり顔ではいられない
MsgEn:
We can't just pretend it's just a coincidence of
the times.

MsgJp: 以来、神殿を離れ――
MsgEn: Since then, I have left the temple...

MsgJp:
俺は、分散してしまった力を補う方法を
探し求めてきた
MsgEn:
I have been searching for ways to replenish the
dispersed power.

MsgJp: ――いいだろう

覚者とは、竜の敵と戦う者
言ったのは俺だったな――
MsgEn:
What is an Arisen? It is one who fights against
the enemies of dragons.
It was I who said that —

MsgJp: ともに権利を主張して、力を手に入れようか
MsgEn: Shall we both claim our rights and obtain power?

MsgJp:
その力を合わせれば、黒騎士など
たやすく討伐できるだろう
MsgEn:
If we combine our powers, we should be able to
easily defeat the Black Knight and others.

MsgJp: ヴァネッサ様、あれを！
まるで何かを恐れているようだ
MsgEn: It seems as though they are afraid of something.

MsgJp: ここ連日の不吉な予兆は私も感じている
MsgEn:
I also feel the ominous signs that have been
occurring here in recent days.

MsgJp:
よし、万一の事態に備え
急ぎ神殿にも事の次第を伝えよ
MsgEn:
Alright, prepare for any unforeseen circumstances
and quickly inform the Temple of the situation.

MsgJp:
地図が示しているのはこのあたり――
いや、まさにここだな
MsgEn:
What the map is showing is this area right here—
No, it's exactly here.

MsgJp: それらしいものは何もない、が――
MsgEn: There's nothing that seems to be like it, but...

MsgJp:
――わたしはわかったぞ
ここは特別な場所だ
MsgEn:
—I understand.
This is a special place.

MsgJp: おまえは思い出せないのか？
レオが統率になって間もない頃だ
MsgEn: It was around the time when Leo took command.

MsgJp: ほら、わたしとおまえ、そしてイリス――
あいつは演習と称し、わたしたち４人でここを訪れた
MsgEn:
He called it a training exercise and brought the
four of us here.

MsgJp:
だが、それはオーク相手の連戦に疲れ切った
わたしたちを労う、レオの気づかいだった
MsgEn:
However, it was Leo's thoughtfulness,
acknowledging our exhaustion from the continuous
battles with the orcs.

MsgEn:
Perhaps they thought that the bond between Arisen
was a treasure.

Since that incident, I haven't been able to go
out like this.

今となっては、覚者隊が同じ境遇といえるだろう――
エリオット、リズ、ガルドリン――

Now, the Arisen Corps would be able to say that
they are in the same situation as well -
Elliot, Lise, and Gurdolin -

MsgJp:
仲間への想いは、レオと共に戦い続けた
あんたなら一番分かっているはずだ

The feelings for my companions have endured, as I
continued to fight alongside Leo.
You, of all people, should understand that the
most.

残る俺たちの結束を気にしてるんだろうよ

You're probably concerned about the unity of the
rest of us.

ふっ――とんだお節介だな
しかし実にレオらしい
MsgEn:
Hmph... Quite meddlesome, aren't you?
However, it's very much like Leo.

MsgJp:
私たち覚者とレスタニアの未来には
まだまだ試練が待ち受けているだろう

In the future of us Arisen and Lestania, there
are still many trials awaiting us.

ああ、その日に備え俺たちが
レオのメッセージを心に刻んでおかないとな

Ah, we must engrave Leo's message in our hearts
in preparation for that day.

long-lasting turmoil has come to an end.

竜たちの大陸はそれぞれの問題を抱えたまま

the future.

道しるべなき旅に出た者――

comrades and press forward...

watch over them.

人と竜が等しく生きる時代の訪れ――
その時代を切り開いた英雄は

The arrival of an era where humans and dragons
live as equals—

竜や王ではなく
仲間と共に戦い抜いたひとりの覚者であった

Not a dragon or a king, but a single Arisen who
fought alongside comrades.

最悪の展開じゃねえか！

What the hell is this!
This is the worst outcome!

MsgJp: おい、さっさと引き上げるぞ

セシリーを運べ！
俺はロイグだ！
MsgEn:
Move Cecily!
Leave Loeg to me!

MsgJp: あっ！？
おっ――
おお――
はっ！
うわっ！！
ぐっ―
あっ―
うっ
うっ――あっ――
んっ―んっん――
ふん！
ぎゃぁぁぁ――
来ます――黒騎士の気配がします
MsgEn: Here it comes - I sense the presence of the Black Knight.

MsgJp: 死に損なったか、セシリー――
MsgEn: Did you fail to die, Cecily...

MsgJp: ――行くぞ！
ぬぁっ
うっ！
うっ！
うっ！
うっ！
ズール！？
フバァッッッ――
でも、まるっきり魔物じゃない！？
MsgEn: But it's not entirely an enemy!?

MsgJp: そうまでして蘇りたいかねえ
MsgEn:
Do you really want to go to such lengths just to
be revived?

MsgJp: セシリー、逃げて！
所詮、定めにはあらがえぬ！
MsgEn: After all, you can't go against fate!

MsgJp: レオ！？
邪魔をするか――
MsgEn: Are you getting in the way?

MsgJp: おまえの目――
その輝きは、生ある世界を見つめるためにある
MsgEn:
The brilliance exists to gaze upon the living
world.

MsgJp: 守れなくて、なんのための覚者だ！
MsgEn:
If I can't protect, what's the point of being an
Arisen?

MsgJp: もう誰も失わない！
MsgEn: No one will be lost anymore!

MsgJp: そのために手にした強さだ
MsgEn:
That is the strength I have gained for that
purpose.

MsgJp: その力、今差し出せというのなら――
MsgEn: If you ask me to present that power now...

MsgJp: ――俺が！
あとの世は――
おまえに託そう！
MsgEn: I will entrust it to you!

MsgJp: 貴様――
果たせぬ夢など――
MsgEn: There is no dream that cannot be realized!

MsgJp: ない！
レオオオオオオ！！！
はっ！
うっ！
うっ！
うっ！
わっ！！
うっっ――
づあっ！
ぬんっ！！

ぐっっ――
うぉぉぉ――
うっおおおぉぉ！！
うおおおお！
ぬぅぅん！
（力を込めた咆哮）
やはり、フィンダムに乗り込むしかありません
MsgEn: Indeed, there is no choice but to leave for Phindym.

MsgJp:
ゲートの向こう側へ渡り
原因を取り除かなくては――
MsgEn:
Cross over to the other side of the gate and
eliminate the cause—

MsgJp: しばらくの間、時間をください

一方通行のこの、"ゲート"――
わたしの力で、必ず開きます
MsgEn:
This one-way "gate"—
I will definitely open it with my power.

MsgJp:
再び一つとなった覚者たちは
諸悪の根源と目された黒騎士を退けることに成功した
MsgEn:
Once again, the Arisen have come together as one.
They have succeeded in repelling the Black
Knight, who was considered the root of all evil.

MsgJp: しかし、侵食魔が跋扈する状況は、まだ変わらない
MsgEn:
However, the situation where the Infected rampage
is still unchanged.

MsgJp: フィンダム大陸へ渡る準備が粛々と進む中――
MsgEn:
As preparations steadily progress for the journey
to the continent of Phindym...

MsgJp: 覚者たちはひとときの安息を夢見た――
MsgEn: The Arisen dream of a moment of respite...

MsgJp: 準備ができました

クラウスが言うには――
中は、もの凄い力でねじ曲げられた空間か――
MsgEn:
According to Klaus, the interior is a space that
has been bent with tremendous force.

MsgJp:
離れた大地と大地が結ばれるほど
圧縮された空間か――
MsgEn:
It's a space so compressed that distant lands and
ours are connected, right?

MsgJp:
どっちにしても、安全なんか
これっぽちも保証されていないんです
MsgEn:
Either way, there is no guarantee of safety
whatsoever.

MsgJp: 今、言う？
これでお別れだったりして――

わたしは、一度通り抜けている
セシリーもな
MsgEn: I have already passed through once, as has Cecily.

MsgJp:
何かあっても、ちょっとばかり
記憶をなくす程度さ
MsgEn:
Even if something were to happen, I'd only lose a
bit of my memory.

MsgJp:
いつまでグダグダ言ってやがる
覚悟決めろ
MsgEn:
Until when are you going to keep blabbering on?
Make up your mind and prepare yourself.

MsgJp: ――ありがとうございます
それでは――開きます――
おっ（リアクション）
おっ（リアクション）
おっ（リアクション）
うわっ――（リアクション）
うわっ――（リアクション）
うわっ――（リアクション）
一体ここで何が起きているんだ？
MsgEn: What on earth is happening here?
column9: Knight of the White Guard Order

MsgJp:
おい、見ろ！
この妖しく輝く礎を――
MsgEn:
Hey, look!
Behold this mysteriously shining Portcrystal...
column9: Knight of the White Guard Order

MsgJp: はじめてみるな
column9: Knight of the White Guard Order

MsgJp: な、なんだ！？
column9: Knight of the White Guard Order

MsgJp: うっ
column9: Knight of the White Guard Order

MsgJp: あああああああ！
column9: Knight of the White Guard Order

MsgJp: 斥候からの情報によると――
敵は二手に分かれて待ち受けているそうだ
MsgEn: The enemy is waiting in two different locations.

MsgJp: こちらも隊を二つに分け、迎え撃つ！
MsgEn:
We will also divide the squad into two and
counter-attack!

MsgJp: それぞれの場所まで案内しよう
MsgEn:
I will guide you each to your respective
locations.

MsgJp: 聞いての通りだ
私の側から向かう者はついてこい
MsgEn: Those who are going with me, follow.

MsgJp: さぁ、出発するぞ！
ただいま、フィンダム

みなさん、ようこそ
ここがわたしの故郷――フィンダムです
MsgEn:
Everyone, welcome.
This is my home - Phindym.

MsgJp:
フィンダムの芯なる樹――この世界の中心だ
でも、病んで、死にかけている
MsgEn:
Phindym's Core Tree - The Center of this World.
However, it is sick and on the brink of death.

MsgJp: うわ――

ここはわたしの故郷なんだ
かつてはナバド村と呼ばれていた
MsgEn:
This is my hometown.
It used to be called the Village of Nabhadh.

MsgJp:
子供の頃に流行病があって――
でも、フィンダムには対処法がなくてね
MsgEn:
When I was a child, there was an epidemic...
But, there was no cure in Phindym.

MsgJp: そもそも、病は、報いや罰だと考えられていたんだ
MsgEn:
Originally, illness was thought of as retribution
or punishment.

MsgJp:
ただ死を待つだけの日々――
人がバタバタと死んでいった
MsgEn:
Just waiting for death every day, people died one
after another.

MsgJp: やりきれない話だね
でも、フィンダムは変わりました

怯えて死を待つだけの時代に、父が終止符を
打ったのです
MsgEn:
In an era where people merely awaited death in
fear, my father put an end to it.

MsgJp:
今、父は"芯なる樹"を救うために奮闘しています
フィンダムの未来は明るい――そう信じています
MsgEn:
Now, my father is struggling to save the "Core
Tree".
I believe that the future of Phindym is bright -
what I truly believe.

MsgJp:
"芯なる樹"が腐るってのは、竜が病気に
なるようなものか？
MsgEn:
Is it like the [Core Tree] is rotting, causing
the dragons to become sick?

MsgJp:
"芯なる樹"と竜は不可分
だから、そう言っても、間違いではない
MsgEn:
The [Core Tree] and the Dragon are inseparable.
So, saying that is not wrong.

MsgJp:
腐敗の原因を作ったのは
どこからか現れた、あの黒騎士だ
MsgEn:
The one who caused the corruption was none other
than that Black Knight.

MsgJp:
黒騎士は倒したから、あとはどうやって
この世界を救うか――だね
MsgEn:
Now that we've defeated the Black Knight, the
only thing left is how to save this world, right?

MsgJp:
精霊竜ウィルミアと話さなくてはなりません
もちろん、父にも帰還を報告しないと――
MsgEn:
I must speak with the Spirit Dragon Willmia.
Of course, I must also report my return to my
father...

MsgJp:
おいおいなんだあれは！？
向かってくるぞ！
MsgEn:
Oh, what is that!?
They're coming towards us!

MsgJp: 竜――精霊竜ウィルミアです！
会いに来てくれるなんて！
MsgEn: To think you came to see me!

MsgJp: いや、様子がおかしい！
セシリー、逃げろ！
うわっー
うわっー
うわっー
うわっー
うわっー

セシリー！？
無事に戻ったというのは本当だったのだな
MsgEn: Cecily!? So it was true that you returned safely.

MsgJp: 一緒に来たってずーっと言ってるじゃねえかよ！
MsgEn: You keep saying that you came together with me!

MsgJp: この方は、レスタニアを護りし白竜の覚者です
MsgEn:
This person is the Arisen of the White Dragon,
who protects Lestania.

MsgJp: あれもレスタニアから来た覚者だと言っている
MsgEn:
They also claim to be an Arisen who came from
Lestania.

MsgJp:
遙か彼方にレスタニアなる大地があり、白き竜と
民が暮らしている
MsgEn:
Far beyond, there is the land of Lestania where
the white dragon and its people live.

MsgJp:
だが、竜と覚者は一対の契り
白き竜には幾人もの覚者がいるなどとは――
MsgEn:
However, there are many Arisen who have formed a
bond with the White Dragon...

MsgJp:
世界は、わたしたちの想像より、ずっと広くて
在り方も多様なのです
MsgEn:
The world is much larger and more diverse
than we can imagine.

MsgJp:
覚者になると同時に姿を消し――
戻って来たと思えば異国と、その覚者の話だ
MsgEn:
Upon becoming an Arisen, they disappeared at the
same time - it's as if they vanished.
Then, when they returned, it was a story of a
foreign land and a new Arisen.

MsgJp: 我らとておまえを信じたい
MsgEn: We want to believe in you.

MsgJp:
おまえたちの言葉が真実だと言うのならば
我らを納得させる、証を見せてほしい
MsgEn:
If you claim that your words are the truth, then
please show us the proof that will convince us.

MsgJp: 古来より伝わる方法で力とその正しさを示すのだ
MsgEn:
Demonstrate your power and its righteousness
through the methods passed down since ancient
times.

MsgJp: ホオオオオ――！！
ハアッ――ハアッ――フ―！！
セヤッ！！
ハアッ―！！
これはこれはみなさん――
目的は、これですか？

冗談じゃない――
復讐を台無しにされてたまるか！
MsgEn:
This is no joke—
I won't stand for my revenge being ruined!

MsgJp:
腐った"芯なる樹"とともに
皆、朽ち果ててしまえ！
MsgEn:
With the rotten [Core Tree], everyone, wither
away!

MsgJp: あなたが――したの？

ロイグ――
あなたが"芯なる樹"を――

故郷が病魔に侵された時――
誰もが、これは理、運命だと、背を向けた
MsgEn:
When our hometown is invaded by the disease,
everyone turned their backs, believing it to be
the order of fate.

MsgJp: 竜も助けてはくれなかった
MsgEn: Even the Dragons did not come to help.

MsgJp:
悲しいが、歯を食いしばるしかなかった
このフィンダムで育てば誰もがそうなる
MsgEn:
It's sad, but we had no choice but to grit our
teeth.
Everyone in Phindym goes through the same.

MsgJp:
しかし、苦しむ両親を見ているうちに
背を向けた人々が憎くなった
MsgEn:
However, as I watched my suffering parents, I
began to despise those who turned their backs.

MsgJp: 何もしない竜に失望した
MsgEn: I was disappointed in the dragon that did nothing.

MsgJp:
ほどなく父は気が触れて――
世を呪う言葉を残して死んだ
MsgEn:
Before long, my father lost his sanity—
Leaving behind words cursing the world, he died.

MsgJp: わたしはその言葉に囚われたのさ
MsgEn: I became trapped by those words.

MsgJp: 乞い、願っていると、手段が手に入った
MsgEn:
I begged and wished, and a means came into my
hands.

MsgJp:
ああ――
"芯なる樹"に毒素を植え付けてやった
MsgEn:
Ah...
I implanted toxins into the [Core Tree].

MsgJp: するとどうだ

"芯なる樹"を救おうと、おまえたちは右往左往
死は理ではないのか？　運命ではなかったのか？
MsgEn:
In your efforts to save the [Core Tree,] you are
all in a state of confusion.
Is death not part of the order? Was it not meant
to be our destiny?

MsgJp:
わかるぞ？
自分たちの命だけは惜しいんだろう？
MsgEn:
Do you understand?
Are you only concerned about your own lives?

MsgJp:
"理"など方便
身勝手な奴らめ
MsgEn:
"Justice" and such are all just excuses, you
self-centered lot!

MsgJp: ロイグ、レスタニアを思い出して？
フィンダムも、あんなふうになれるかもしれない
MsgEn: Phindym, too, could perhaps become like that.

MsgJp: 無理だね
わたしが全力で阻止するからな！
MsgEn: I will do everything I can to stop you!

MsgJp: ウォーウ、ウォウ、ウォウォウォーウ

魔物と化してもなおわたしを慕う
かわいいケモノたちよ――
MsgEn:
Cute little creatures who still adore me even
when I've become a monster...

MsgJp: さあ行け！

――なぜだ！　どういうことだ！？
黒騎士よ！　どこにいる！
MsgEn:
Why! What is happening!?
Black Knight! Where are you?

MsgJp: 今さらわたしを見捨てるのか！
MsgEn: Are you abandoning me now, of all times!

MsgJp:
ロイグが？
黒い霧に――！！
おい、近づくな！
そこ！　足元に――
《原始の雫》！
まだ希望は消えていない――
これで――フィンダムは救われます！
MsgEn: With this, Phindym will be saved!

MsgJp: 時が来たようだ
MsgEn: It seems the time has come.

MsgJp:
長く閉ざされていた"精霊の地"
芯なる樹の樹内へ通じる聖門を――
MsgEn:
"The Spirit Land" that has long been sealed is a
sacred gate that leads into the inner part of the
[Core Tree]...

MsgJp: その、選ばれし者が解き開く時が来たのだ
MsgEn: The time has come for the chosen one to unlock it.

MsgJp:
選ばれし者、即ち、覚者！
覚者、即ち、セシリー！
MsgEn:
Chosen one, that is, Arisen!
Arisen, that is, Cecily!

MsgJp: 大地、竜、人の未来はおまえに託された
MsgEn:
The future of the land, dragons, and humanity is
entrusted to you.

MsgJp:
わたしに――
できるでしょうか
できるとも
おまえには、心強い友がいるではないか
MsgEn: You have a strong friend by your side, don't you?

MsgJp:
精霊竜にも、わたしにもなかったものを
おまえは手に入れたのだ
MsgEn:
You have obtained something that neither the
Spirit Dragon, nor I, have ever had.

MsgJp: 隊長、そしてみなさん――

このフィンダムを救うため
力を貸してください
MsgEn: Please lend us your strength to save Phindym.

MsgJp:
わたしと共に――
この大地に、最後の希望を灯すために――
MsgEn:
With me—
To kindle the final hope in this land—

MsgJp: どうか、よろしくお願いします

フィンダムは毒に侵され――
病に倒れかけた大地だった
MsgEn:
Phindym was poisoned, the land on the verge of
falling ill.

MsgJp:
レスタニアから渡った覚者たちは
フィンダムの覚者を助け、戦い――
MsgEn:
Arisen who ventured from Lestania came to fight
alongside Arisen of Phindym.

MsgJp: ついに、大地を癒やす手段を手に入れた
MsgEn: Finally, they obtained a means to heal the land.

MsgJp: そしてフィンダムの未来を託されし覚者――
MsgEn:
And thus, the Arisen entrusted with the future of
Phindym—

MsgJp:
セシリーは《原始の雫》について学び
やがて来る、治療の時を待った
MsgEn:
Cecily learned about the [Primeval Drops] and
waited for the moment of healing to come.

MsgJp:
我々が"精霊の地"と呼んでいるこの先の
土地について説明しておこう
MsgEn:
Let me describe the land beyond, that we call
"The Spirit Land".

MsgJp:
"精霊の地"とは芯なる樹へと続く、樹層一帯
自由に出入りできるのは竜だけだ
MsgEn:
The [Spirit Land] is the area around the
surrounding the Core Tree, which extends to the
canopy.
Only dragons can enter and leave freely.

MsgJp:
我々が出入りするあの門も
普段は、固く閉じてある
MsgEn:
That gate where we enter and exit is usually
tightly sealed.

MsgJp: 知っての通り――

芯なる樹は、いまやフィンダム全域に
毒素を送り出す病巣――
MsgEn:
The Core Tree has become an infected hive that
sends toxins throughout Phindym.

MsgJp:
治療のためには樹の中心まで
行かねばならない
MsgEn:
In order to cure it, we must go to the center of
the Tree.

MsgJp:
毒によって侵された根は
この《原始の雫》で浄化できるだろう
MsgEn:
The roots that have been infested with poison can
be purified with these [Primeval Drops].

MsgJp:
おそらく樹内は
魔物の巣窟となっているはず――
MsgEn: Perhaps the tree is a nest of monsters.

MsgJp:
隊長、あなたは先行して魔物を排除し
樹の中心を目指して欲しい
MsgEn:
Captain, I want you to go ahead and eliminate the
enemies and head for the center of the Tree.

MsgJp: 道中の安全を確保する大切な役割ですね
MsgEn:
Ensuring safety along the way is an important
role.

MsgJp: 掃除かあ、嫌いなんだけどなあ

わたしも、後を追い
樹内での手助けをいたそう
MsgEn: I'll follow after and assist you inside the tree.

MsgJp:
《原始の雫》 が手に入ることは二度とない
頼り続けで心苦しいが、よろしく頼む
MsgEn:
We may never get another chance to obtain the
[Primeval Drops].
I'm sorry I keep asking you for help, but I'm
counting on you.

MsgJp: 精霊竜ウィルミアだ

竜はもう、かつての竜ではない
残念ながら――
MsgEn:
The dragon is no longer the Dragon 
it once was.
Alas...

MsgJp: 我々は間に合わなかったのだ
MsgEn: We didn't make it in time.

MsgJp: 覚者よ、白竜の覚者よ
MsgEn: Oh, Arisen, Arisen of the White Dragon.

MsgJp: 頼もしくなりましたね
MsgEn: You have become reliable, haven't you?

MsgJp: 精霊竜の継承、大変にごくろうさまでした
MsgEn:
Thank you very much for your hard work in
inheriting the Spirit Dragon.

MsgJp:
精霊竜が、竜としての理を取り戻したことで
レスタニアの危機は回避されました
MsgEn:
The Spirit Dragon, regaining its draconic
essence, averted the crisis in Lestania.

MsgJp:
しかし、白竜がまだ回復の途上にあることを
思うと――油断は禁物です
MsgEn:
However, I think that the White Dragon is still
in the process of recovering - you can never let
your guard down!

MsgJp:
世界は五大竜と呼ばれる竜たちによって
守られています
MsgEn:
The world is protected by the dragons known as
the Five Great Dragons.

MsgJp: 白竜、精霊竜、そして黒竜――
MsgEn:
The White Dragon, the Spirit Dragon, and the
Black Dragon...

MsgJp:
黒き竜の、闇で蠢く思惑の断片に
あなたも、触れたはずです
MsgEn:
You, too, must have been touched by the fragments
of the black dragon's thoughts stirring in the
darkness.

MsgJp:
残りの二竜も
ほどなく、あなたは知ることになるでしょう
MsgEn:
The remaining two dragons will also soon become
known to you.

MsgJp: レスタニアの、本当の危機はこれからです
MsgEn: The true crisis of Lestania is yet to come.

MsgJp:
強くなりなさい
そう、レオのように――
交わることを禁じられた大陸が――
MsgEn: The continents that were forbidden to intersect...

MsgJp: ――異なる竜の大陸がレスタニアで交差した
MsgEn:
...the continents of different dragons
intersected in Lestania.

MsgJp: 竜たちですら気づいていなかったが――
MsgEn: Even the Dragons didn't realize it, but...

MsgJp:
世界は、その瞬間、理という鋳型から
取り出されたのだ
MsgEn:
The world was taken out of the path of Order at
that moment.

MsgJp:
はて――それはいったい誰の仕業だろうか
何を望んだ結果なのだろうか
MsgEn:
Huh... who could have done such a thing?
And what did they want to achieve?

MsgJp:
時にレスタニア歴、３２４年
竜の理を解く、物語は動きだした
MsgEn:
In the year 324 of the Lestania Era, the tale of
unraveling the dragon's order began to unfold.

MsgJp: 見て、あそこ！　空に黒い渦ができてる！
MsgEn:
Look, over there! A black vortex is forming in
the sky!

MsgJp:
何かが――ああ、大地の竜力が
吸い上げられているようです！
MsgEn:
Something... oh, the very Dragon Force of the
land seems to be being drained!

MsgJp: おいおいおい！
急いでガラダの元へ向かうぞ！
MsgEn: Hurry, let's head to Gearóid's location!

MsgJp: 敵襲！　戦闘態勢！
みんな、こっちだ！
おい、時間を稼ぐぞ！

やはり以前より状況は悪化しているようだ
魔物がより凶暴になっている
MsgEn:
The situation is getting worse than before.
The monsters seem even more ferocious.

MsgJp: この森のどこかに、礎があるはずなんだ
MsgEn:
There should be a portcrystal somewhere in this
forest.

MsgJp:
レスタニアの礎と同じ力を持つものだ
手分けして探そう
MsgEn:
They possess the same power as that of the
Portcrystal of Lestania.
Let's split up and search.

MsgJp: あれ、礎じゃない？
MsgEn: Oh, is that not a Portcrystal?

MsgJp: これこれ、いつもの、この感じ！
MsgEn: This is it, the usual, this feeling!

MsgJp: リムを使って行き来できるってことだよね？
MsgEn:
Using Rift Crystals allows us to travel back and
forth, right?

MsgJp: 隊長、あそこに入り口が！
MsgEn: Captain, there's an entrance over there!

MsgJp:
セシリー！？
ああ、無事で良かった！
MsgEn:
Cecily!?
Ah, I'm glad you're safe!

MsgJp: どこにいたんだ！？
心配かけてごめんなさい

――お父さんはどこですか？
ロイグは戻ってる？
MsgEn:
Where is your father?
Is Loeg back?

MsgJp: ロイグの行方はわからないが――
MsgEn: We don't know Loeg's whereabouts, but...

MsgJp:
ガラダは"芯なる樹"の治療薬、《原始の雫》を求め
三人の戦士とともに、魔の峡谷へと旅立った
MsgEn:
Gearóid and three soldiers set out for the demons
canyon in search of the [Primeval Drop], the cure
for the [Core Tree].

MsgJp: たった四人で！？
わたしも行かなくちゃ！
気持ちはわかるぞ、セシリー
MsgEn: I understand how you feel, Cecily.

MsgJp:
だが、ガラダに同行したのは屈強の戦士たち
もう少し、信頼してやれ
MsgEn:
But the soldiers who accompanied Gearóid are
strong and reliable.
Trust them a bit more.

MsgJp: 見たところ、お連れさんも疲れているようだ
MsgEn:
From what I can see, it seems like your companion
is also tired, Ser.

MsgJp:
故郷を素通りさせてしまってはガラダに
会わせる顔がない
MsgEn:
I can't face letting Gearóid
see me if I let her pass by my hometown unnoticed.

MsgJp:
わたし――
ここからの眺めが、大好きなんです
MsgEn:
This view from here...
I just love it.

MsgJp:
夜明け前、朝、雨の日、夕方、月明かりの夜――
色々な姿を見せてくれます
MsgEn:
Before dawn, in the morning, on a rainy day, in
the evening, on a moonlit night...
The view changes to show many forms.

MsgJp:
覚者に選ばれた時
誇らしくもあったけど、本当は不安でした
MsgEn:
When I was chosen to be Arisen, I felt proud, but
really anxious.

MsgJp:
託された期待や希望に応えられるのかな？
もう――押し潰されそうでした
MsgEn:
Would I be able to live up to the expectations
and hopes entrusted to me?
I was already... I was about to buckle.

MsgJp: でも、レスタニアであなたたちと過ごすうちに――
MsgEn:
But, while spending time with all of you in
Lestania...

MsgJp:
覚者の生き方が
ひとつじゃないことを知りました
MsgEn:
I realized that being Arisen doesn't mean having
just one way of life.

MsgJp:
みんなが、それぞれの大切なものを守るため
がんばって、歩いている
MsgEn:
Everyone is doing their best to protect what is
important to each of us.

MsgJp: しっかり、一歩、一歩
わたしも、それでいいんだって
MsgEn: I realized, that's enough for me.

MsgJp: 隊長？　ありがとう――
わたし
もう迷いません
大地が侵食されたせいなのか――
MsgEn: Is it because the land has been corrupted...

MsgJp: このあたりも、殺気立った魔物が多いですね
MsgEn:
There are a lot of hostile creatures around here,
aren't there?

MsgJp: ああ、さっきのも、そんな感じだった
MsgEn: Ah, it felt like that earlier too.

MsgJp: ちょっと、ちょっと――
あれ！
やばくない！？
あれがダナ村に突っ込んだら――
MsgEn: If that thing charges into Dana Village—

MsgJp: 大惨事になりますよ！！
MsgEn: It will be a huge disaster!!

MsgJp:
おい、隊長とダナ村に連絡だ！
それとセシリーの親父さんにもな
MsgEn:
Hey, contact the captain and Dana Village!
Also, let Cecily's father know!

MsgJp: 隊長ッ！
隊長ぉ――！　こっち！
暴走が始まりやがった
MsgEn: It's starting to go out of control.

MsgJp:
リズ、エリオット！
雑魚は俺たちで相手するぞ
MsgEn:
Lise, Elliot!
We'll take care of the weaker enemies.

MsgJp: 隊長、アイツを頼んだぜ！
MsgEn: Captain, take care of that one!

MsgJp: え？　ええっ！？
し、死んでますよ、大勢死んでます
世の末って、戦場のこと！？
MsgEn: The end of the world is a battlefield!?

MsgJp: どこの戦場だよ！　全部終わっただろうが
MsgEn:
But which battlefield?
Everything is already over, isn't it?

MsgJp: オーク戦争に逆戻り！？
MsgEn: Have we gone back to the Orc War!?

MsgJp:
落ち着こう
わたしたち、オークならお手のもの
MsgEn: Keep calm. We can handle Orcs.

MsgJp: あっちからも！　数が増えてます！
MsgEn: We're flanked!　Their numbers are growing!

MsgJp: おい隊長、指示はねえのか！
MsgEn: Oi Captain, give the order already!

MsgJp: こっち
だ、だれ！？
今、重要？　死にたい？
MsgEn: Is that important right now? Do you want to die?

MsgJp: どこへ行くの？
いいから走って！
ここで迎撃！
ふんっ（リアクションボイス）
よし！（リアクションボイス）
ふぅ――（リアクションボイス）
うまくいったみたい
見ない顔だね――
わたしはジリアン
ジリアン、急げ！
見つかれば次はない！
MsgEn: If you're discovered here, there will be no next time!

MsgJp: クインタス、今行く！
付いてきて

おい、そろそろ教えろ
ここはどこだ？　どこへ行く？
MsgEn:
Hey, it's about time you told us.
Where are we?　Where are we going?

MsgJp: 質問されるのって、うれしいものだね
MsgEn: How nice to be asked a question.

MsgJp: 最近は、誰も――何も訊いてくれない
MsgEn: Recently, no one... Nobody asks anymore.

MsgJp:
答えを知っても、この世の中が
変わるわけじゃないから――
