is only hatred left.

MsgJp:
憎しみを抱えながら戦うのは――
きっと悲しいぞ？
だが、これからはそういう時代なのかもな
MsgEn:
Waging war while harbouring bitter hatred within—
It can't be anything but bleak, can it?
But perhaps this is the age we've entered now.

MsgJp:
イリスに会ったらたまには顔を出すように
伝えてくれ
MsgEn:
If you meet Iris, please tell her to show her
face once in a while.

MsgJp: もしやおまえはわたしと同類ではないのか？

小ぎれいな神殿よりも最前線の砦が好き――
着飾った街の住人よりも
薄汚れた鎧カブトの戦士を愛おしく思う――
MsgEn:
I prefer the frontline fortress over the tidy
temple— I cherish the dirty armored soldier more
than the well-dressed residents of the city...

MsgJp: ならば遠慮せず、いつでもここに来い
MsgEn:
Then you don't need to hold back. Please go wild
outside the fortress.

MsgJp: 不覚だ――面目ない――
MsgEn: I am not Arisen - I am ashamed -

MsgJp:
しかし、案ずるな
わたしはもう未来を見ている
もうオークの好きにはさせないさ
MsgEn:
But don't fret.
I've already seen the future.
I won't let the orcs have their way anymore.

MsgJp:
神殿はどうだ？
ここの体制の立て直しが一段落ついたら
顔を出そうと思っているんだ
MsgEn:
How's the temple going? I'm thinking of showing
up when I'm done rebuilding this place.

MsgJp: うわさでは神殿の雰囲気が変わったのだとか
MsgEn:
Rumor has it that the atmosphere of
the temple has changed.

MsgJp:
悲壮感に満ちているらしいな
正直、行く気が失せる
MsgEn:
It seems filled with a sense of tragedy.
Honestly, I lose my motivation to go.

MsgJp:
ここにいても白竜の目覚めは感じられるんだ
だから、わたしもおまえと同じ時に
竜力を受け取っている
MsgEn:
I can feel the awakening of the
White Dragon even here.
So I also receive Dragon Force at
the same time as you.

MsgJp:
そして、その恩に報いることを考える
ああ――いつも考えている
MsgEn:
And think about repaying the favor.
Oh—I think about it all the time!

MsgJp:
ミシアルが謁見の間から出たらしいな
もっと引っ張り出してやるといい
MsgEn:
Mysial seems to have come out of the Audience
Chamber. It would be good to get
them out even more.

MsgJp:
――いや、誘っても無理か
――うん、無理だな
MsgEn:
... Nah, even if I asked, it
probably wouldn't work....
Yeah, it wouldn't.

MsgJp:
最前線だったこの砦も
今では時折小競り合いが起こる程度だ
MsgEn:
This fort, which used to be the front line, now
sees only occasional skirmishes.

MsgJp:
殺気で肌がヒリヒリ傷むような戦場――
そんな場所を探して旅に出ようか
――最近、そんなことを思うんだ
MsgEn:
A battlefield where the skin stings with a
killing intent - Should I search for such a place
and embark on a journey? Lately, I've been
thinking about such things.

MsgJp:
イリスの行方を知っているか？
身を隠すように言ってやった方が
いいかもしれないぞ？
MsgEn:
Do you know where Iris is? It might be better
to tell her to hide.

MsgJp:
ふん――そうか
さすがレオだ
MsgEn: Hmph—so that's it. As expected of Leo.

MsgJp:
神殿が大変だと聞いているが――
おまえは戻った方が良くはないか？
MsgEn:
I heard that the temple is in trouble— Wouldn't
it be better for you to come back?

MsgJp: ここの指揮は部下に任せようと思う
MsgEn:
I think I'll leave the command here
to my subordinates.

MsgJp:
引き継ぎが終わり次第わたしも神殿へ行く
向こうで会おうではないか
MsgEn:
Once the handover is complete, I will
also go to the temple.
Let's meet there, shall we?

MsgJp:
レオのことは心配するな
すべて良かれと思ってしていることだろう
MsgEn:
Don't worry about Leo. I'm sure he's doing
everything for the best.

MsgJp: 行動が愚かだが――昔からだ
MsgEn:
My actions may be foolish, but it has
always been this way.

MsgJp:
くそっ――
このあたりの魔物が騒がしくなってな
なかなか離れることができないのだ
MsgEn:
Damn it—The enemies around here are getting
noisy. I can't seem to get away easily.

MsgJp:
ここにはわたしがいる
――わかるか？
MsgEn:
I will make a stand here.
You understand?

MsgJp:
ここの守りは堅い――そういうことだ
思う存分、戦ってこい
MsgEn:
The defense here is strong—That's what I'm
talking about. Go ahead and fight to
your heart's content.

MsgJp:
報せを聞いて駆けつけたぞ
おまえは最前線にいたのだろう？
ご苦労だったな
MsgEn:
I rushed over upon hearing the report. Were you
at the front line? You've worked hard.

MsgJp:
今度手柄話を聞かせてくれ
盛大にうらやましがってやろう
MsgEn:
Tell me your achievements next time. I'll
celebrate them with great envy.

MsgJp:
ん？
俺と仲良くなりたいっての？
MsgEn: Hmm? You want to be friends with me?

MsgJp:
世間話ねえ
そんな気分じゃないんだよな――
MsgEn: Chatting is not on my mind right now—

MsgJp:
なああんた、ひまなら俺と――
あ、ひまじゃない？　そりゃ失礼
MsgEn:
Hey, if you're free, how about spending some time
with me... Oh, you're not? Well, that was rude.

MsgJp:
自由に生きるってのは
思ったほど楽じゃないんだな、これが
MsgEn:
Living free is not as easy as I thought
it would be.

MsgJp:
あんた、この世界がどうなるのが理想？
なーんて、俺も考えたことないけどな
MsgEn:
What would you like the world to be like?
I've never really thought about it.

MsgJp:
苦難の時代だなんて言うやつもいるけど
俺は結構楽しんでるよ
MsgEn:
Some say it's a hard time.
I'm having a pretty good time.

MsgJp:
まいったまいった――
次から次へと魔物がよぉ
MsgEn:
Oh dear, oh dear— One monster after
another, I tell you!

MsgJp:
覚者のことを便利屋みたいに
思ってる奴、いるよな――
MsgEn:
There are people who think of Arisen
as a handyman, right?

MsgJp:
俺、聞き流すの得意でさ――
それでもいいなら、どうぞ
――さあ、話せ！
MsgEn:
I'm good at just listening, you know—If that's
really okay, then go ahead. Now, speak up!

MsgJp:
昨日と違う今日、今日と違う明日――
世界はその繰り返しでできてるんだ
――てな
MsgEn:
Today is different from yesterday, and tomorrow
will be different from today—The world is made up
of such repetitions... That's what it means.

MsgJp:
一期一会――いい言葉だね
俺、商品、客――
すべての出会いが、そうなんだな
MsgEn:
Once-in-a-lifetime encounter...
That's a nice phrase.
Me, the product, the client— Every
encounter is like that.

MsgJp:
あんたもいっぱしの覚者を気取るなら
身につけるモノは厳選しなよ
どうだい、ひとつ見繕ってやろうか？
MsgEn:
If you're going to pretend to be an Arisen, be
selective about what you wear. How about I
pick something for you?

MsgJp:
こんな時代なのに商品が行き来しているのは
凄いことだ――
俺たち、誇っていいと思うぞ
MsgEn:
It's amazing how much product is coming and going
in these times—I think we should all be proud!

MsgJp:
金なら、余ってるんじゃないのか？
安くするぜ、取引していきなよ
MsgEn:
I'm sure you've got plenty of money. I'll give
you a discount. Make a deal with me.

MsgJp: よぉ、調子はどうだ？

その臭い――戦う覚者という感じで
悪くはないが、日常も大切にな
MsgEn:
Wow, you stink. You certainly smell the part,
Arisen, but it couldn't hurt to take a
bath every now and then.

MsgJp:
時間があるなら世のため人のために
駆け回るのも悪くないぞ
金にもなるしな
MsgEn:
If you have time, it's not a bad idea to run
around for the sake of the world and for others.
It can even bring you money as well.

MsgJp:
いろんな覚者がいる
いろんな生き方がある
とても自然なことだと思うね
MsgEn:
There are various Arisen.
There are various ways of living.
I think it's a very natural thing.

MsgJp:
へえ――なんだか見違えたな
一皮むけたってやつだ
MsgEn:
Oh, wow—something about you has really changed.
It's like you've shed a whole new skin.

MsgJp:
珍しいものを見つけたら声をかけてくれよな
場合によっては高値で引き取って
やれるかもしれないぜ？
MsgEn:
If you find something rare, please let me know.
Depending on the situation, I might be able to
take it off your hands for a high price, you know?

MsgJp:
アークでは、いや、参った――
でも、探せば珍品があったかもな
MsgEn:
The Ark, no, I give up—But if you look, there
might be rare items.

MsgJp:
遠出したのか？
このあたりにはない花とか素材とか――
MsgEn:
Did you go far? Maybe you found flowers or
materials that aren't found around here.

MsgJp:
損をすることはないから
目についたら持ち帰るといい
MsgEn:
You've got nothing to lose, so take it
home if you see it.

MsgJp:
戦っても空しい――金を儲けても空しい――
だが、どんな時でも続く覚者人生――
楽しまなくちゃ損だぜ？
MsgEn:
Even if you fight, it's in vain—even if you make
money, it's in vain—But the life of the Arisen
continues no matter what—You have to enjoy it, or
else it's a loss, you know?

MsgJp:
心配してくれる友達がいるなんて幸せ者だ
――イリスがそれを忘れていなければ
何も問題は起こらないさ
MsgEn:
I am a lucky person to have friends who worry
about me. - As long as Iris doesn't forget that,
nothing will go wrong.

MsgJp:
謁見の間の様子はどうだ？
俺はしばらく距離を置くことにするよ
MsgEn:
How is the situation in the Audience Chamber? I'm
going to keep my distance for a while.

MsgJp:
凄いことが始まるらしいな
ひさしぶりに大階段を登ろうか――
MsgEn:
I hear great things are about to begin. Let's
climb the grand staircase for the first
time in a while—

MsgJp:
戦うだけが覚者じゃない――
とはいえ、かつてないほど戦いの機運が
盛りあがっている――
MsgEn:
Being an Arisen is not just about fighting—
However, the momentum for battle has
never been higher...

MsgJp: どんな立ち位置をとるべきか――悩むね
MsgEn: I'm not sure what position I should take.

MsgJp: イリスの顔を見ないけど何か知ってるか？
MsgEn: I don't see Iris around, do you know anything?

MsgJp:
イリスのことは聞いた
友達ではあるが――
MsgEn: I heard about Iris. She is a friend, but - -

MsgJp:
彼女との付き合いが長い
レオに任せるのが一番だな
MsgEn:
It'd be best to leave it to Leo, who has a
long history with her.

MsgJp:
これまでになかったことが立て続けに起こると
何に対しても集中できなくなる
我ながら修行が足りないぜ
MsgEn:
When unprecedented events continue to occur, I
cannot concentrate on anything.
I am lacking in self-discipline!

MsgJp: 長命のエルフが持つ知識は値千金――
MsgEn:
The knowledge that long-lived Elves
possess is invaluable.

MsgJp:
なんてな
損得抜きで、仲良くしたかった
MsgEn:
What a pity.
I wanted to get along with you, no gain or loss.

MsgJp:
白竜が元気だったら、俺は覚者じゃなかった
たとえエルフが死のうが――
なんとも思わなかっただろう
MsgEn:
If the white dragon had been healthy, I wouldn't
have been an Arisen. Even if the elf had died— I
wouldn't have cared.

MsgJp: ――人生の巡り合わせは不思議だよな
MsgEn: Life's encounters are strange, aren't they?

MsgJp:
新たなアーク――
ほとぼりがさめたら個人的に調査もいいな
MsgEn:
A new Ark... It would be nice to personally
investigate once the heat dies down.

MsgJp:
見たぞ――
巫女と歩くなんてどんな気分だ？
MsgEn:
I saw it—How does it feel to walk
with a priestess?

MsgJp: 覚者のことは覚者が始末をつける――
MsgEn:
The Arisen has to take care of
the Arisen's business.

MsgJp:
昔からの習慣だ
覚悟だけはしておこう
MsgEn: It's an old habit. Let's just be prepared.

MsgJp:
しばらくここにいる
同志に向ける武器は持っていないからな
MsgEn:
I'll be here for a while, as I don't have any
weapons to aim at comrades.

MsgJp: 同志に向ける武器はない――
MsgEn: There are no weapons for comrades-in-arms -

MsgJp:
甘いことを言っている場合じゃないのか
くそっ！
MsgEn: You can't be so naive. Damn!

MsgJp: 《謁見の間》はどんな様子だ？
MsgEn: What's going on in the audience chamber?

MsgJp:
さぞ――いや、やめておこう
想像が当たったところでうれしくもなんともない
MsgEn:
Surely - No, let's leave it. Even if my
imagination was correct, it
wouldn't make me happy.

MsgJp:
みんな遠征に夢中になっているようだが
ここの安全が保証されたわけではあるまい？
MsgEn:
Everyone seems to be preoccupied with the
expedition. How can we be assured of the
safety of this place?

MsgJp:
というわけで、こんな言い方はらしくないが――
俺に任せてくれ
MsgEn:
So, although it may not be the most appropriate
way to say it—Leave it to me.

MsgJp:
メルゴダの様子はどうなんだ？
戦いで忙しいかもしれないが
逸品珍品を見逃すなよ？
MsgEn:
How's it going in Mergoda? You may be busy
fighting the battle, but don't miss the gems
and curiosities, okay?

MsgJp:
結局これは過去との戦いだったというわけか――
いや、ずっと続いていたわけだから
まだ過去にはなっていない――
MsgEn:
In the end, this was a battle with the past, so
to speak—No, because it has been continuing for a
long time, it has not become the past yet...

MsgJp:
面倒だな――おまえの手で
過去にしてやるといい
MsgEn:
It's troublesome... It would be good for you to
make a thing of the past with your own hands.

MsgJp:
あちこちで言われて聞き飽きただろうが
俺からも言わせてくれ
MsgEn:
You must have heard it said everywhere by now.
But let me say it too.

MsgJp:
逞しくなったな――貫禄すら漂うよ
さあ、報告があるんだろう？
早くすませて土産話を聞かせてくれ
MsgEn:
You've grown strong—even dignified. Now, you have
a report to give, don't you? Get it over with and
tell me about your souvenirs.

MsgJp: 呑ませてくれ――

今は呑んで――呑んで――
明日からちゃんとするからさ
MsgEn:
Right now, I'm drinking - drinking - I'll
properly do it starting from tomorrow.

MsgJp: ブ、ブラッドオーブ――探さなくちゃ――
MsgEn: B-Blood Orb... I have to find it...

MsgJp:
俺はここで白竜様と倒れた覚者のために
やれることをやるよ
MsgEn:
I will do what I can here for the Arisen who fell
with the White Dragon.

MsgJp: あんたたち、黒騎士を頼むぞ
MsgEn: I entrust you with the Black Knight.

MsgJp:
一時はどうなることかと思ったよ
もしあのまま――
MsgEn:
For a moment, I thought I was done for. If things
had stayed that way -

MsgJp:
――やーめた！　楽しいことだけ
考えるわ
MsgEn: - Never mind! Just think about the fun parts.

MsgJp:
ふう――覚者でいることは大変だけど
お互い、がんばりましょう
MsgEn:
Phew - being an Arisen is tough, but we both just
have to do our best.

MsgJp:
遠くへ行きたいのよ
誰も行ったことがない地へね
MsgEn:
I want to go far away. To a place no one
has ever been before.

MsgJp:
覚者っぽくないって言われるけど――
やっぱり、わかっちゃうよね
MsgEn:
I'm told that I don't seem like an Arisen, but...
I still understand, you know.

MsgJp:
覚者だからって戦いばかりの人は
正直、どうかと思うな
MsgEn:
A person who only seeks constant battles just
because they are an Arisen, honestly, I think
that's questionable.

MsgJp:
レスタニア中のきれいな風景を見たいけど
そういう場所は魔物が集まりがちだよね
MsgEn:
I want to see the beautiful scenery throughout
Lestania, but those kinds of places
tend to attract enemies.

MsgJp:
魔物を倒したら
白竜様が毎回ほめてくれる――
そんなのだったら、やりがいあると思わない？
MsgEn:
If you defeat the enemy, the White Dragon will
praise you every time— If that's the case, don't
you think it's rewarding?

MsgJp:
ごきげんよう
さあ、今日はどこへ行こうかな
MsgEn: Hello. Well, where shall we go today?

MsgJp:
覚者って――孤独よね
普通の人だった頃が懐かしい
――なんてね
MsgEn:
Being Arisen—it's lonely, isn't it? I miss the
time when I was just a normal person.
—Joking, of course!

MsgJp:
覚者の気持ちは覚者にしかわからない
そう思っていたけど――
覚者同士でもわからないこと多いよね
MsgEn:
The feelings of an Arisen can only be understood
by another Arisen, or so I thought... But even
among Arisen, there are many things
we don't understand.

MsgJp:
本当なら覚者は世界にひとりしか存在しない
そんな話を聞いたことがあるの
だったら――これからどうなるんだろうな
MsgEn:
In reality, there should only be one Arisen in
the world Have you ever heard such a story? If
so... what will happen from now on?

MsgJp:
隊長、見てこの腕と足の筋肉！
シュッとして、かっこいいと思わない？
MsgEn:
Captain, look at these arm and leg muscles! Don't
you think they look so cool and shapely?

MsgJp:
最近、やたらと声をかけられるんだけど――
わたしも結構名の売れた覚者になったってこと！？
MsgEn:
Lately, I've been getting a lot of attention and
being approached a lot. Does that mean I've
become quite a renowned Arisen?!

MsgJp:
例えば、ヴァネッサなんて
覚者としても女性としてもひとつの理想型でしょ？
MsgEn:
For example, someone like Vanessa, isn't she an
ideal type both as an Arisen and as a woman?

MsgJp: だからわたしは、あえてそこは目指さないの
MsgEn: So, I intentionally won't aim for that.

MsgJp: 覚者になったことを嘆く気持ちが前はあったけど――
MsgEn:
I used to feel regret about becoming
an Arisen, but...

MsgJp:
今は天職って感じ
ま、仕事じゃないけどね
MsgEn:
It feels like my calling from heaven now. Well,
it's not really a job though.

MsgJp: あら、ごきげんよう

こうして一気に神殿の中枢に食い込めるなんて
ジョゼフ様々！
MsgEn:
I can't believe that we can be in the heart of
the temple all at once like
this. Thank you Joseph!

MsgJp: 精一杯頑張るから、隊長、ひいきしてよね？
MsgEn:
I'll do my best, captain, and you'll
patronize me, right?

MsgJp:
みんなセシリーセシリーって
どうかしちゃったみたい
MsgEn: Everyone seems to be obsessed with Cecily, Cecily.

MsgJp:
まあ、気持ちはわかるけどね
わたしだって、なんとかしてあげたいもの
MsgEn:
Well, I can understand their feelings. I also
want to do something to help.

MsgJp:
時には強く言わないとね
もうお客さんじゃなくて、仲間なんだから
ダメなものはダメ
MsgEn:
Sometimes you have to say it strongly. You're not
a customer anymore, you're a friend. What
doesn't work doesn't work.

MsgJp: あ、セシリーの話ね

エリオットの奴、張り切っちゃって
わたしだって負けないから
侵食魔討伐数勝負はわたしのもの！
MsgEn:
Elliot is all fired up, but I won't lose either.
The number of victories in defeating
the corrupt is mine!

MsgJp:
なんだかみんな落ち着いちゃってさ
いいのかな
MsgEn:
It seems like everyone has calmed down.
Is it okay?

MsgJp:
黒騎士は難敵だよね――
闇雲に戦っても勝てないだろうなぁ
MsgEn:
The Black Knight is a formidable opponent, huh? I
don't think you can win by fighting blindly.

MsgJp:
ロイグは、わたしたちが看病したり
治療のために奔走するのが不思議で
たまらないみたい
MsgEn:
Loeg seems to find it fascinating and
irresistible that we take care of him and go all
out for his treatment.

MsgJp: 人の善意に馴れていないんだね
MsgEn: He's not accustomed to people's goodwill.

MsgJp:
もうさ、わたしは戦うの専門でいいかも
腕を磨いて、口出ししないで
ひたすら戦うよ
MsgEn:
Maybe I'll just specialize in fighting and keep
my skills sharp and stay out of the
way I'll just fight.

MsgJp:
黒騎士が来た時、ロイグは勇敢だったよね
見直しちゃったな
MsgEn:
Loeg was brave when the Black Knight came. It
made me reassess him.

MsgJp:
レオを信じる――
うん、わたしはあの人を信じる！
――って、自分に言い聞かせているところ
MsgEn:
I believe in Leo—Yeah, I believe in that guy!
That's what I keep telling myself.

MsgJp: 隊長、なんだかさ、もう、やるしかないよね！
MsgEn:
Captain, I don't know, I'm just going to
have to do it!

MsgJp:
レオはやっぱりわたしたちのことを考えていて
くれたんだよね
MsgEn: Leo is still thinking about us. He protected us.

MsgJp:
ううん、やっぱり違う
レオが守ったのは
レスタニア全体の未来だよね？
MsgEn:
No, it's different after all. Leo protected the
future of Lestania, right?

MsgJp:
隊長、ほら、遠征？　調査？　散歩？
なんでもいいから、行こうよ
MsgEn:
Captain, hey, expedition? Survey? Walk?
Anything is fine, let's go.

MsgJp:
隊長、レスタニアはどうだった？
問題がないなら、こっちでの任務に専念しない？
MsgEn:
Captain, how was Lestania? If everything is okay,
why don't we just focus on the mission over here?

MsgJp:
このフィンダムって、単純――
ううん、原始的っていうか
洗練されてないっていうか――
MsgEn:
This "Phindym", it's simple— Well, it's
more like primitive...
Not refined...

MsgJp:
ちがうな――ああ、素朴！
この素朴さ、わたしは嫌いじゃないな
MsgEn:
No, it's not - ah, rustic!
I don't mind the simplicity.

MsgJp:
わたしたち、後手後手というか――
遅れちゃってるよね
MsgEn: We're kind of behind the curve...

MsgJp:
ねえ、隊長
急いで、事態の先頭に立とうよ
MsgEn:
Hey captain, hurry up and take the lead
in the situation!

MsgJp:
《原始の雫》を持ち去った犯人は
フィンダムがどうなっても構わない――
やっぱり、幾ら考えても気持がわからないな
MsgEn:
The culprit who took away [Primeval Drops]
doesn't care what happens to Phindym after all— I
still can't understand their feelings no
matter how much I think.

MsgJp: ロイグのしたことは許せないけど――

わたしは憎めないな
フィンダムの人たちはどう裁くつもりなんだろう
MsgEn:
I don't hate. I just wonder how the people of
Phindym are going to judge me.

MsgJp:
なんかさ――
セシリーが、すごく遠い人になっちゃった気がする
MsgEn:
I feel like— Cecily has become a
very distant person.

MsgJp:
でもまあ、仕方ないか
ここはあの子の世界だからね
MsgEn:
But well, I guess there's no helping it. Because
this is her world, you know.

MsgJp:
連戦連戦だからね――
さすがに疲れちゃったかな
MsgEn:
Because it's battle after battle— I suppose I've
finally worn myself out.

MsgJp:
侵食魔退治でも行く？
あー、こんな気持で戦っちゃ
絶対怪我するよね
MsgEn:
Do you want to go fight the corrupted monsters?
Oh, you shouldn't fight like
this, you'll get injured.

MsgJp:
セシリー、普段と変わらないね
どんな気持ちなのかな――
MsgEn:
Cecily, you're still the same as usual. I
wonder how you feel...

MsgJp:
洞が時々、ふわっと輝くの
まるで何かが始まる予兆みたい
MsgEn:
Sometimes the cave's shining softly, as if it's a
prelude to something starting.

MsgJp:
さあ隊長
どこへでも一緒に行くからね
MsgEn: Alright Captain, I'll go with you wherever you go.

MsgJp:
絶望的な状況に呑み込まれてしまう人と
前を向いて進む人の違いって
なんだろうね？
MsgEn:
What's the difference between someone who gets
swallowed up in a hopeless situation and
someone who moves forward?

MsgJp:
解放軍が明るくなったね
メイロワ将軍効果だね
MsgEn:
The Liberation Army has brightened up. It's the
General Meirova effect.

MsgJp:
王子は身も心も盗賊に染まってしまった――
なんてことはないよね？
MsgEn:
The prince became a bandit in body and soul...
It's not true, right?

MsgJp:
王子は無事なのかな
居場所よりも安否の確認が先だよね
MsgEn:
I wonder if the prince is safe. I'd rather know
if he's safe than where he is.

MsgJp:
王子の目的は恩人の盗賊ベルタを救うこと
その気持ちは大切にしないとね
MsgEn:
The prince's goal is to save his benefactor, the
bandit Bertha. We must cherish that sentiment.

MsgJp:
ネド王子、守ってあげたくなっちゃう
小さな弟がいるのってこんな気分？
MsgEn:
Prince Nedo, I feel like I want to protect you.
Is this what it's like to have a little brother?

MsgJp:
ネド王子は前線に立って兵たちを
鼓舞するのが自分の責務だと
考えているみたい
MsgEn:
Prince Nedo seems to think that it is his duty to
encourage the soldiers on the front line.

MsgJp:
空気が汚れた感じがするよね
オークの攻撃臭が漂ってくるからかな
MsgEn:
The air feels polluted, doesn't it? Maybe it's
because the stench of Orc attacks is
lingering in the air.

MsgJp:
ネド王子、顔がいきいきしてるよ
無理してなければいいけど
MsgEn:
Prince Nedo, your face looks so chipper; I hope
you're not forcing yourself.

MsgJp: 待機はつらいなぁ
待機はつらいなぁ

ガルドリンやエリオットと一緒だと
なんだか焦っちゃうんだよね
MsgEn:
When I'm with Gurdolin and Elliot, I
somehow get anxious.

MsgJp:
あの人たち戦闘中はガツガツするから
調子を乱されちゃうんだ
MsgEn:
Those people are too aggressive during combat, so
it throws off my rhythm.

MsgJp:
ネド王子にお礼を言われると
うん、お姉ちゃんもっと頑張るよって
気になるんだよね
MsgEn:
Now that Prince Nedo's thanked me personally, I
feel like I need to redouble my
efforts just for him.

MsgJp: すっかりお姉ちゃん気分
MsgEn: I feel like a big sister now.

MsgJp:
気になることはいろいろあるけれど
先に解放軍の目的を果たさなくちゃね
MsgEn:
There are various things that I am concerned
about, but first, I have to accomplish the
objective of the Liberation Army.

MsgJp:
エリオットとも話したんだ
今は王都の敵に集中しようってね
MsgEn:
I also talked to Elliot. Now let's focus on the
enemies in the Royal Capital.

MsgJp: 隊長――わたし――ううん、なんでもない
だいじょうぶ――だいじょうぶだよ
隊長――わたし、あいつのこと許さないから

迷惑かけちゃったよね
この埋め合わせはするから！
MsgEn:
I caused you trouble, didn't I? I will make
it up to you!

MsgJp:
はぁ――もっとわたしたちを
信じてほしいよねえ
MsgEn:
Haa—I wish they'd believe in us a bit
more, you know.

MsgJp:
ネド王子と再会したら
わたし、ちょっとお説教しちゃうかも？
MsgEn:
If I were to meet Prince Nedo again, I might give
him a little sermon.

MsgJp:
王子のことは心配だけど
メイロワ将軍たちに任せておけば
大丈夫だよね
MsgEn:
I'm worried about the prince, but if we leave it
to General Meirova and the others, it
should be fine, right?

MsgJp:
エリオットさあ、大丈夫大丈夫って言い過ぎ！
その方が気になっちゃうじゃない
MsgEn:
Elliot, come on, you say it's okay too much!
You're making me nervous.

MsgJp: ネド王子はいつか竜になるんだよね
MsgEn: Prince Nedo will become a dragon someday.

MsgJp:
どんな感じなのかな
セシリーとは違うのかな
MsgEn:
I wonder what it feels like. How is it
different from Cecily?

MsgJp: なにかお話ししてくださいな
MsgEn: I'd love to hear some of your adventures.

MsgJp: うふふ――ご機嫌いかがですか？
内緒話は、ジョゼフおじさまに叱られます
MsgEn: Uncle Joseph will scold us for talking in private.

MsgJp:
覚者様は考えたことがありますか？
この世界がどうやって出来たのか――
MsgEn:
Have you ever wondered, Arisen - how
this world came to be?

MsgJp:
白竜だけがこの世界の
すべてを知っている――
早くお話しを聞きたいですね
MsgEn:
The White Dragon alone holds all
this world's secrets...
How I'd love to listen.

MsgJp: 覚者になるって、どんな気分ですか？
MsgEn: What does it feel like to become an Arisen?

MsgJp:
戦争って、どんな時代にもありますね
嫌いな人の方が多いはずなのに
MsgEn:
War exists in every age.
Strange, since most people say they hate it.

MsgJp:
みんなでお歌をうたえば戦いがなくなる――
パメラがそう言うんだけど
きっと、そんなに簡単ではないですよね
MsgEn:
Pamela says wars would end if we
all sang together...
But it's not that simple, right?

MsgJp:
時々、わけもなく悲しくなるの
ううん――わけはあるけど――
話しても誰も戻ってこないから
MsgEn:
Sometimes I feel sad for no reason... Well,
there is a reason, but...
talking won't bring them back.

MsgJp:
白竜も、人間も、覚者も――魔物だって
同じように生きているんだよね
MsgEn:
White Dragon, humans, Arisen - we're all
just living our lives.

MsgJp:
お友達はいつかいなくなるもの――
それでも、ほしいと思ってしまうの
MsgEn:
Friends always leave someday...
Yet I still find myself wanting them anyway.

MsgJp: この風――あの森にも、吹いているのかな
MsgEn:
I wonder, this wind— Is it blowing
in that forest, too?

MsgJp:
真っ直ぐに進む人は
大切なことを忘れがちです
覚者さん、気をつけてね
MsgEn:
People focused only on moving forward tend to
lose sight of what's important.
Take care.

MsgJp: 時は――少し、意地悪です
MsgEn:
Time can be...
a little cruel sometimes.

MsgJp: あれ？　何して遊ぶ？　え？　お話し？
MsgEn:
Oh? Do you want to play?
We could draw, or maybe read a story.

MsgJp: こんにちは、メイリーフです

あ、覚えていてくれましたか？
だとしたら、うれしいです！
MsgEn:
Oh, you remember me?
If so, I'm glad!

MsgJp:
あのね――迷惑かけちゃったけど
仲良くしてね？
MsgEn:
Hey, I'm sorry for causing you trouble, but
let's get along, okay?

MsgJp:
わたしはイリスとも仲良しなんだ
だから、イリスが戻ってわたしもうれしいの
MsgEn:
I'm good friends with Iris, so I'm
glad she's back.

MsgJp:
レオが恐い顔をしていたの――
ちょっとびっくりしちゃった
MsgEn:
Leo had a scary look on his face— I was
a little surprised.

MsgJp: 白竜様、元気になーれ！
MsgEn: Who, don't bully—Peco— I won't do bad things.

MsgJp:
わたしはもう絶対にひとりでは神殿から
出ないからね
MsgEn: I will never leave the Temple alone again!

MsgJp:
あなたにもパメラにもジョゼフ様にも
心配をかけちゃって――
MsgEn:
To both you and Pamela and Master Joseph, I
apologize for causing you worry...

MsgJp:
だからこれからは、必ず、誰かと一緒に――
もちろん、みんなが知ってる誰かと一緒に
お出かけすることにして――
MsgEn:
So from now on, I'll be sure to go out with
someone—of course, someone we all know—and—

MsgJp:
しかも、知らない場所へは行かないって
約束するよ！
MsgEn:
And I promise that I won't go to places
I don't know!

MsgJp:
キースヒルト――無事だよね？
ちゃんと逃げるよね？
MsgEn:
Kieshildt—you're fine, right?
You're going to make it, aren't you?

MsgJp: キースヒルト兄様をお願いします

――つらいよ
こんなにつらいなんて――
MsgEn:
—This is painful.
How can it be this painful...

MsgJp:
わたしのせいなのかな――
わたしが悪かったのかな――
MsgEn:
Is this my fault...?
Am I to blame...?

MsgJp:
わたしはこれからキースヒルトのぶんまで
生きるから――
MsgEn: I'm going to live on, for Kieshildt...

MsgJp:
ううん、死んでしまった人、全員のぶん
わたしは生きるの――そう決めたの
MsgEn:
No, for all those who have died. I'm going to
live - I've decided.

MsgJp:
どこにも行かないで？
誰にもいなくなってほしくないの
MsgEn:
Don't go anywhere. I don't want
anyone to disappear.

MsgJp:
ミシアルとこのあたりを歩いたって本当？
どうしてうちに寄ってくれなかったの！？
MsgEn:
Mysial, is it true that you walked around this
area? Why didn't you come visit me?

MsgJp:
何か怖いことが起こりそうな――
そんな気がするよ？
MsgEn: I feel like something scary is about to happen—

MsgJp:
空気がビリビリ震えているの――
これは良くないことのシルシなの――
MsgEn:
The air is tingling - This is the
sign of something bad -

MsgJp: ねえねえ、イリスはどこにいるの？

わたしを遠くに連れ出したことで
みんな怒っているから教えてくれないの？
MsgEn:
Why won't you tell me? Is it because everyone is
angry with you for taking me far away?

MsgJp:
どうしよう――ミシアルが――
でも、お願い――イリスを怒らないで！
MsgEn:
What should I do...
Mysial is so upset...
Please don't be angry with Iris!

MsgJp:
ミシアルみたいに白竜と仲良くなるよ
応援して――ね？
MsgEn:
I'll make friends with the White
Dragon, like Mysial.
You'll support me—right?

MsgJp:
わたしじゃダメかもしれないけど
それでも応援してね
MsgEn:
I might not be good enough, but please
support me anyway.

MsgJp:
みんな行っちゃうの？
ちゃんと帰ってきてね？
MsgEn:
Are you all leaving?
You'll come back, won't you?

MsgJp: もう、誰もいなくなったら、いやだよ？
MsgEn: I don't want everyone to disappear already.

MsgJp:
力を貸してください――って
白竜様にお祈りしてるの
MsgEn:
I'm praying to Lord White Dragon.
Please lend me your strength...

MsgJp: でも、全然起きてくれないの
MsgEn: But they still won't wake up at all.

MsgJp:
がんばれ！
がんばれっ！
MsgEn:
Come on!
You can do it!

MsgJp:
おかえりなさい！
ええと、わたしね――ええと――
MsgEn: Welcome back! Um, as for me... um...

MsgJp:
あ、ごめんなさい
わたしじゃなくて、まず、白竜様だよね？
MsgEn:
Oh, I'm sorry.
Lord White Dragon first, right?

MsgJp: 白竜様も、早く元気になるといいね
MsgEn: I hope The White Dragon gets well soon.

MsgJp:
黒騎士はどこへ行ったの？
行方がわからないなんてこわい！
MsgEn:
Where did The Black Knight go? It's scary not
knowing their whereabouts!

MsgJp: リズ、もう聞こえていないみたい――
MsgEn: Lise, I don't think he can hear me anymore—

MsgJp: 隊長さん、気をつけてね
全部終わったんだよね？

こわいことや悲しいことは
もう起こらないんだよね？
MsgEn: Scary and sad things won't happen anymore, right?

MsgJp:
いまは戦いに備える時
語り合うのは、またの機会だ
MsgEn:
Now is the time to prepare for battle.
We'll talk about it another time.

MsgJp: 覚者――白竜の力を預かる者か
MsgEn:
Arisen - the one who holds the power of
The White Dragon.

MsgJp:
――？　ああ、失礼
考え事を少々、ね
MsgEn:
—? Ah, excuse me.
Just thinking about something for a moment, hmm.

MsgJp:
そういうえば覚者と話したことは
あまりなかったな――
今度ゆっくり話そうか
MsgEn:
Come to think of it, I didn't have many
conversations with the Arisen— Shall we talk
in detail next time?

MsgJp:
聞きたいことが山ほどある
そんな顔だね
MsgEn:
There are so many things I want to ask. That's
the kind of expression you have.

MsgJp:
僕はどんなふうに見えるんだい？
生を楽しんでいるように見えるかい？
MsgEn:
How do I look?
Do I look like I'm enjoying life?

MsgJp:
気づかなかったが――
きみはいい目をしているな
MsgEn: I hadn't noticed— you have a good eye.

MsgJp:
覚えていてほしい
取るに足りない――なんでもない――
そういうことが実は大きな意味を持っている
それに気づくのはね、大いなる喜びだよ
MsgEn:
Remember, insignificant—nothing—such things
actually mean a great deal. It's a great joy to
realize that, you know?

MsgJp:
つくづく思うよ
世界はね、複雑なんだ
白と黒、善と悪――
そんな単純な区分けはできないのさ
MsgEn:
I really think the world is,
you know, complicated.
Black and white, good and evil...
there's no such simple division.

MsgJp:
人間は興味深いけど
時に、難解すぎる存在だよ
MsgEn:
Humans are interesting but sometimes, they are
too difficult to understand.

MsgJp:
信じる力はとても大切だ
僕も信じているんだ
帰るべき場所――仲間の無事をね
MsgEn:
The power of belief is very important. I believe
in it too. The place I should return to - the
safety of my comrades.

MsgJp:
朝が好きなんだ
幼いころに感じた、あの風の匂いがするからね
MsgEn:
I like mornings, because it reminds me of the
scent of that wind when I was a child.

MsgJp: ああ、君か
死に急ぐか、若造が
MsgEn: Do you want to hurry up and die, you brat?

MsgJp: 慈悲などやらん、死ね
木偶どもにはもう飽きたわ
MsgEn: I'm tired of these puppets already.

MsgJp:
わからんな――
お前に勝ち目などない
MsgEn: I don't understand— you don't stand a chance.

MsgJp:
殺し合いの最中に――
笑わせてくれるわ
MsgEn: In the midst of the killing, You make me laugh.

MsgJp:
帰れ――殺すぞ？
おまえは好かん
MsgEn: Go home... or I'll kill you. I don't like you.

MsgJp: まだ盾突くか――ならば、死をくれてやる
MsgEn:
If you still dare to defy me— I shall
grant you death.

MsgJp:
殺す、ただ殺す
それが世界だ
MsgEn: Kill, just kill. That's how the world works.

MsgJp:
気づいているだろうが――
おまえらの死は無駄にはならん
ふははは！
MsgEn:
You may have noticed, but...
Your deaths will not be in vain.
Hahaha!

MsgJp:
その命、よこせ
さあ、よこせ！
MsgEn: Give me that life. Come on, give it to me!

MsgJp: ほう――身の程知らずめ
なんだ？　うまい話でもあるのか？
MsgEn: What's that? You got a better offer?

MsgJp:
オマイと話だと？
ガハハハ、笑わせる！
MsgEn: Talking to me? Gahahahaha, you make me laugh!

MsgJp: 遊びたいが、またな
MsgEn: I'd love to play, but see ya.

MsgJp:
俺サマとトモダチになろうってか？
悪くないな、でも、まあヤメとくよ
MsgEn:
You want to become friends with me? Not bad,
but well, I'll pass.

MsgJp:
オマイ、強いんだろ？
ちょいと、試してやろうか？
MsgEn: You, are you strong? Shall I test you a little?

MsgJp: オマイら、まとめてブッ壊すからな
MsgEn: I'll destroy all of you at once!

MsgJp:
あ？　目的だと？
楽しみは秘密にする主義でな
MsgEn:
What?　You said you wanted to do this?
I like to keep my pleasures a secret.

MsgJp:
暴れたいトキに暴れる
それが人生ってヤツだ
MsgEn:
When you want to go wild, just go wild.
That's what life is all about.

MsgJp:
つまんねえな
ここいらにゃ、弱いヤツらしかいねえのか
MsgEn:
Boring.
Are there only weak people around here?

MsgJp:
アレを、アレして――こうなる！
グフ、グフフフフフ！
MsgEn:
Doing that, it becomes like
this! Gufu, gufufufufu!

MsgJp: なんだよ――オマイ、なんだよ！
MsgEn: What is it - you, what is it!

MsgJp:
巡る竜力を感じます――
やっぱり、心地良いものですね
MsgEn:
I feel the Dragon Force circulating around— After
all, it's a pleasant sensation.

MsgJp: 黒騎士のことを考えていました――
MsgEn: I was thinking about The Black Knight...

MsgJp:
こう見えて、結構戦えるつもりです
必要とあればなんなりと
MsgEn:
Despite my appearance, I am prepared to fight
rather well. If necessary, I am willing to
do whatever it takes.

MsgJp:
みなさんの戦い方はとても洗練されていますね
勉強させてもらいます
MsgEn:
Everyone's way of fighting is very refined, isn't
it? I will learn from it.

MsgJp: みなさんとご一緒できて光栄です
MsgEn: It's an honor to be here with you all.

MsgJp: ご恩はいつかお返しさせていただきます
MsgEn: Yes, I will return the favor someday.

MsgJp:
覚者が一目置かれるのは
みなさんの普段の行いが素晴らしいからですよね
MsgEn:
Arisen are respected because of everyone's
wonderful daily conduct, aren't they?

MsgJp: お疲れじゃないですか？

面倒をかけているわたしが言うのも変ですけど――
時々休んでくださいね
MsgEn:
It's strange for someone like me who is causing
trouble to say it, but please
take occasional rests.

MsgJp: はい、なんでしょう

本当に何から何までお世話になってしまって
お礼の言葉もありません
MsgEn:
I really can't thank you enough for
everything you've done for me.

MsgJp:
わたしにできることがあれば言ってください
戦場でも少しはお役に立てると思います
MsgEn:
Let me know if there is anything I can do for you.
I'm sure I can be of some help on the battlefield.

MsgJp:
わかっています
少し――いいえ、かなり焦っています
MsgEn:
I understand I'm a little bit - no,
I'm quite anxious.

MsgJp:
これ以上、ご迷惑をおかけするのが
心苦しくって――
MsgEn: It pains me to cause you any more trouble.

MsgJp:
ロイグ――
あの人はわたしを知っていましたけど
わたしは――
いくら記憶を探ってもロイグが登場しません
MsgEn:
Loeg...
That person knew me.
But I— No matter how much I search my memory,
Loeg does not appear.

MsgJp:
それほど交わりの薄い人なのでしょうか――
もう一度会えれば――話せれば――
MsgEn:
Is he such a distant person to me - If I could
see him again - If I could talk to him -

MsgJp:
不思議です
不安だし、焦りもあるんですけど
MsgEn: It's strange and I feel uneasy and anxious, but.

MsgJp:
以前とは違って――
みなさんと一緒なら、なんとかなる
そんな風に思えるようになりました
MsgEn:
Unlike before - I feel like I can
manage with everyone.

MsgJp:
ロイグと話せればわたしの記憶は
きっと戻ると思います
MsgEn:
If I can talk to Loeg, I'm sure my
memories will come back.

MsgJp:
待っていてくださいね
きっと――
きっと全部思い出しますから
MsgEn:
Please wait for me. I'm sure—I'll definitely
remember everything.

MsgJp:
もっともっとロイグと話すべきですよね？
それはわかっているんです
でも、もどかしくて――
MsgEn:
I should talk to Loeg more often, right? I know
that but it's frustrating.

MsgJp:
わたしたちは勝利に向かって
確実に進んでいるはずですよね
MsgEn: We are definitely on the road to victory.

MsgJp:
もちろん勝利が全てではありませんけど
未来への道しるべになりますよね？
MsgEn:
Of course, winning isn't everything. But it's a
signpost for the future, right?

MsgJp:
ゲートのことはわたしに任せてください
どんなに時間がかかっても
皆さんを必ずフィンダムにご招待します
MsgEn:
Let me take care of the gate. No matter how long
it takes, I promise to bring you all to Phindym!

MsgJp:
早く集落を目指しましょう
何より、森の中は安全とは言えません
MsgEn:
Let's get to the village as soon as possible.
Above all, it is not safe in the forest!

MsgJp:
隊長、急ぎましょう
ガルドリンさんがいい人なのは知っていますが
誤解を招きやすい性格ですから――
胸騒ぎがします！
MsgEn:
Captain, let's hurry. I know Gurdolin is a good
person, but they have a personality that is
easily misunderstood. I have a feeling of unease!

MsgJp:
状況に流されるだけではなく、抵抗を試みる――
フィンダムではまだ新しい考え方です
MsgEn:
Don't just be swept away by the situation, try to
resist—It's still a new idea in Phindym!

MsgJp:
協力してくれる人はまだまだ少ないので
わたしが父を探してあげないと――
MsgEn:
Since there are still very few people who are
willing to help, I have to
find my father myself...

MsgJp:
隊長――
父に――父にもしものことがあれば
わたしは――
MsgEn:
Captain—If something were to happen
to my father—I...

MsgJp:
すいません、今はこんな個人的な思いは
しまっておくべきですよね
MsgEn:
Sorry, I should probably put these personal
thoughts away for now.

MsgJp:
隊長、父は元気になりますよね？
父の傷は、致命傷ではありませんよね？
MsgEn:
Captain, is Father going to be okay? His wounds
are not fatal, right?

MsgJp:
あと少しですよ、隊長
《原始の雫》が芯なる樹を――
ひいてはこのフィンダムを浄化してくれます
MsgEn:
Left: just a little more, Captain. The "Primeval
Drops" will cleanse the core tree- and in turn,
cleanse Phindym for us.

MsgJp:
その後の美しいフィンダムを
皆さん、ご案内しますからね
MsgEn:
I will show everyone the beautiful Phindym
that comes after that.

MsgJp:
《原始の雫》はわたしの命に替えても守ります
隊長たちは魔物退治に専念してください
MsgEn:
I will protect the [Primeval Drops] with my life.
Captain, please focus on defeating the enemies.

MsgJp:
このあたりの侵食魔を一掃すれば
次はいよいよ浄化です
もう少し、よろしくお願いします
MsgEn:
If we completely eliminate these corrupting
monsters in this area, then it will finally be
time for the purification. A little
while longer, please.

MsgJp:
明るい未来――
夢見ても大丈夫ですよね？
MsgEn:
A Bright future...
It's okay to dream, right?

MsgJp: 隊長――あと少しだけ、よろしくお願いしますね
MsgEn:
Captain—I'll be counting on you for a
few more minutes.

MsgJp:
おつかれさまです、隊長
俺のやる気、爆発しそうですよ！
MsgEn:
Captain—I'll be counting on you for a
few more minutes.

MsgJp:
隊長、俺を忙しくしてください
ジョゼフ様のところへは戻りたくないんです
MsgEn:
Captain, please keep me busy I don't want to go
back to Master Joseph.

MsgJp:
レスタニアはまた大変なことになりましたけど――
そのおかげで隊長と一緒に働けて――
MsgEn:
Lestania is in trouble again, but— that allowed
me to work with the captain and—

MsgJp: 不謹慎だけど――俺、うれしいです
MsgEn: I know it's inappropriate—but I'm glad I'm here.

MsgJp:
隊長がレオ統率の右腕なら――
俺は隊長の右腕になります！
MsgEn:
If Captain is Leo's right-hand man, I will be
Captain's right-hand man!

MsgJp:
リズと俺――ある意味、敵同士ですよね
どっちが隊長の信頼を勝ち取るか――みたいな
MsgEn:
Lise and me—In a way, we are enemies, aren't we?
It's like, who will earn the captain's trust?

MsgJp:
セシリーはちょっと固いというか――
真面目すぎるんですよね
MsgEn:
Cecily's a bit stiff, or rather...
She's far too serious.

MsgJp:
オーク戦争の頃、リズはレスタニアを巡って
お宝とか探してたらしいですね
なんだか、遅れを取った気分です
MsgEn:
I heard that during the orc wars, Lise was
cruising around Lestania looking for
treasures and stuff.
I feel like I'm falling behind!

MsgJp:
侵食魔のせいかな――
少し空気が濁った感じ、しませんか？
MsgEn:
Maybe it's the Corruption?
The air seems a little muddy, don't you think?

MsgJp:
隊長――
やっぱり覚者というのは戦ってこそ、ですよね
つくづく、そう思いますよ
MsgEn:
Captain—Indeed, it is through battle that an
Arisen truly shows their worth. I am
deeply convinced of this.

MsgJp:
ガルドリンが細々と賭けを持ちかけてくるんですよね
おかげで――いえ、なんでもありません！
MsgEn:
Gurdolin keeps coming up with small bets, you
know. Thanks to that... Well, never mind!

MsgJp:
戦いに慣れてから、時々ですけど、もっと刺激が
ほしいなんて、考えちゃうんですよ
MsgEn:
After getting used to battles, sometimes, I can't
help but think that I want more excitement.

MsgJp: ダメですよね、こういうこと考えちゃ
MsgEn: It's not good, thinking about things like that.

MsgJp:
ガルドリンのこと、いろんな人から聞くんですけど
どうやら最近は丸くなったというか
落ち着いたというか――
MsgEn:
I hear about Gurdolin from various people, and it
seems that recently, they have become more
well-rounded, or rather, calmer.

MsgJp:
最近のことしか知らない俺にしてみれば
これで！？　って感じですけどね
MsgEn:
From my perspective, as someone who only knows
recent things, I have to say... is this it!? But
well, that's how I feel.

MsgJp:
ジョゼフ様から聞く話に隊長が登場するようになって
どれくらい経つか忘れましたけど――
MsgEn:
It has been some time since Captain made their
debut, or so it feels, as I heard from Ser Joseph.
But I can't exactly remember how long ago it was.

MsgJp: 思うに、隊長って、全然変わってないですよね
MsgEn:
In my opinion, the captain hasn't changed
at all, right?

MsgJp:
リズって、ああ見えて、意外と世の中を
見てるんですよね
自分のことは見えていないようだけど
MsgEn:
Lise looks like that, but she sees the
world surprisingly well.
She doesn't seem to see herself, though.

MsgJp: なんでしょうか、隊長！

セシリーはいい子ですよねえ
力になってあげたいなあ
MsgEn:
Cecily is a good girl, isn't she? I want
to be supportive.

MsgJp:
隊長、急ぎましょう
何もかも、急ぎましょう
MsgEn: Captain, let's hurry! with everything, I mean

MsgJp:
早くセシリーを楽にしてあげないと
こっちまで息が詰まりそうです
MsgEn:
We need to make Cecily feel better
soon. I'm choking up too!

MsgJp:
まあ、楽にすると言っても
どうしたらいいかなんて
わからないんですけどね
MsgEn:
Well, even if I say I want to make it easier, I
don't know what to do, you know?

MsgJp:
騎士団には売れるだけ恩を売っておけなんていう
覚者もいますけど、俺に言わせれば
持ちつ持たれつですよ
MsgEn:
Some Arisen believe in gaining favor with the
Knights' Order as much as possible, but in my
opinion, it's all about mutual support.

MsgJp:
売ったとか買ったとか、借りた貸したなんて
どうでもいいことです――
って、考えられる人になりたいんです、俺
MsgEn:
Selling, buying, borrowing, lending... It's all
trivial stuff. I want to become someone who can
think about more important things—me.

MsgJp:
時々、セシリーが思い詰めた顔をしていますよ？
なんとかしてあげられませんかねえ
もう、見ていられませんよ
MsgEn:
Sometimes, Cecily has a troubled look on her
face, you know? Can't we do something to help her?
I can't bear to watch anymore.

MsgJp:
隊長、レスタニアは広いですね
今回ばかりは痛感しています
MsgEn:
Captain, Lestania is far, isn't it? I am feeling
this particularly keenly this time.

MsgJp:
走っても、戦っても、尽きない敵
ええ、やりがいがありますよ！
MsgEn:
Running, fighting, and endless enemies.
Yes, it's challenging!

MsgJp: 俺、連戦でちょっと疲れちゃって――
MsgEn: I'm a little tired from the consecutive battles...

MsgJp:
もちろん、何かあれば動きますから
それ以外はここでジッとさせてください
MsgEn:
Of course, if you need me to move, I'll move.
Otherwise, please let me stay put here.

MsgJp:
俺は隊長の右腕を自認してますから
誰が戻ろうと、去ろうと、そこだけは
変わりませんからね
もちろん、ものすごく期待はしていますけど――
MsgEn: Of course, I have really high expectations, but -

MsgJp:
セシリーの記憶が戻っても問題が
解決するわけじゃないんですよね
鍛錬して、腕を磨いておこうかな
MsgEn:
Even if Cecily's memory returns, it doesn't mean
the problem will be solved, right? Maybe I should
train and sharpen my skills.

MsgJp: 黒騎士対策が急務ってところですかね
MsgEn:
Is countermeasures against the Black Knight
the urgent matter here?

MsgJp:
記憶が戻るとか、どうでも良くなりましたね
せめて意識が戻ってくれれば――
MsgEn:
Back to memory, or whatever, it doesn't matter
anymore. At least if consciousness can return—

MsgJp:
隊長、急ぎましょうよ
急いては事をし損じるなんて
言ってる場合じゃありません！
MsgEn:
Captain, let's hurry up. There's no time to waste
by rushing. We can't afford to
be talking about it!

MsgJp:
白竜様以外の竜の覚者と一緒に戦うなんて
こんな機会はもうないかもしれませんよね？
MsgEn:
Isn't it unlikely to ever have the opportunity to
fight alongside any dragon's Arisen other
than the White Dragon?

MsgJp:
隊長と一緒にいられるだけでも幸せなのに
その師匠筋のレオ統率の生き様まで
間近で見られて――俺、胸が熱いです
MsgEn:
I am happy just being able to be with the
captain, And now, witnessing the way of life of
Leo up close... My heart is burning.

MsgJp:
耳を澄ますと、聞き慣れない音がしますね
空気が濃くて、ねっとりとまとわりつくような――
MsgEn:
When you listen carefully, you can hear
unfamiliar sounds. The air is thick and sticky,
as if it is enveloping you.

MsgJp:
気にしすぎですかね――
やっぱり、ビビってるんですかね
MsgEn:
Is it because I'm worrying too much - Am I just
being scared after all?

MsgJp: ガルドリンは俺が見つけてみせますよ

あの人は認めないでしょうけど
俺たち、結構、心が通じ合っているような
気がするんですよね
MsgEn:
That person might not admit it, but I feel like
our hearts are somewhat connected, you know?

MsgJp:
ロイグはどこでしょうね
ガルドリンも、はぐれたきりらしいですよ
MsgEn: Where can Loeg be? Gurdolin also seems to be lost.

MsgJp:
セシリーのお父さんは
それなりに強い戦士に育った娘の帰りを
待っていたのではないでしょうか？
MsgEn:
I think Cecily's father was waiting for his
daughter to return after she grew up to be a
strong warrior in her own right.

MsgJp:
本当は娘と一緒に行きたかったけど
いつまでも待っているわけにはいかず――
MsgEn:
I really wanted to go with my daughter, but I
couldn't wait forever to...

MsgJp:
とすれば、セシリーを早く帰してやれなかった
俺たちの責任も、あるのかもしれません
MsgEn:
If that's the case, maybe it's our fault for not
getting Cecily home sooner.

MsgJp:
族長が回復したらすぐに出発できるように
身体を温めておきましょう
電光石火の、雫奪回作戦です！
MsgEn:
Once the clan chief has recovered, we can depart
immediately, so let's keep our bodies warm. It's
time for the lightning-fast operation
to reclaim the drop!

MsgJp:
あははは
なんだかセシリーが大きく見えますよね
ここで居心地悪そうにしてた時とは
別人のようです
MsgEn:
Ahahahaha!
Somehow, Cecily looks bigger, doesn't she?
She seems like a completely different person from
when she was feeling uncomfortable here.

MsgJp:
フィンダムの中心部に向かうんですよね
しかも、世界を救うために――
これって、凄いことだなあ
MsgEn:
We're heading to the heart of Phindym, to save
the world— This is awesome!

MsgJp:
さあ、まだ魔物はいますよ！
休んでいるヒマなんてありません
MsgEn:
Well, there are still enemies here!
There is no time to rest.

MsgJp:
胸騒ぎが止まりません――
なんでしょう、これ
MsgEn: I can't stop the excitement— What is this?

MsgJp:
わははは！
隊長、もう感情を抑えられません
早く決めちゃいましょう！
MsgEn:
Wahaha! Captain, I can't contain my emotions
anymore. Let's decide quickly!

MsgJp:
理というのは――
見方によっちゃあ、酷なものですね
MsgEn:
Depending on how you look at it, order can be a
cruel thing, you know.

MsgJp:
俺たちをここに連れてきた竜の思惑なんて
わかりませんけど、アッカーシェランには
俺たちの援助が必要です
MsgEn:
I don't understand the intentions of the dragon
that brought us here, but Acre Selund
needs our assistance.

MsgJp: 俺は、そう確信しています！
この状況、俺たちで変えて見せましょう！
MsgEn:
Let's change this situation, and show what
we can do!

MsgJp: 王子はどこですかねえ
MsgEn: Where is the prince, I wonder?

MsgJp:
聞くところによると西方はなかなか
厄介な地域らしいですよ
MsgEn:
According to reports, the western region is said
to be quite troublesome area.

MsgJp: 王家の威光もあまり届いていないとか
MsgEn:
The royal family's authority does not
seem to reach very far.

MsgJp:
隊長、アッカーシェランの歴史や政治とは
距離を置いた方が得策ですよね
MsgEn:
Captain, it's in your best interest to keep your
distance from Acre Selund's history and politics

MsgJp:
王子救出に夢中になっていましけど
"悪しき竜"はどこにいるんでしょうね
MsgEn:
I'm currently focused on rescuing the prince, but
where could the "Evil Dragon" be?

MsgJp: 邪魔する気もないみたいですし
MsgEn: And they don't seem to want to interfere.

MsgJp:
王子はまだまだ子供で頼りないけど
そのおかげで解放軍は一丸となる――
MsgEn:
The prince is still a child and unreliable, but
thanks to that, the liberation army
will unite as one.

MsgJp:
俺でさえ、守ってやりたいと
思いますからね
MsgEn: Even I, want to protect you.

MsgJp:
ネド王子、王子らしくあろうとして
無理してる気がするんですけど
隊長、どう思います？
MsgEn:
Prince Nedo, I feel like he's trying to be more
like a prince and forcing himself.
Captain, what do you think?

MsgJp:
武器、防具――装備品、全ての手入れは
完璧です！
MsgEn:
Weapons, armor—equipment, all taken
care of perfectly!

MsgJp: "悪しき竜"の言葉を覚えていますか？
MsgEn: Do you remember the words of the "Evil Dragon"?

MsgJp:
絶望の大陸を楽しめって――
俺たち、挑発されてますよ？
乗ってやりましょうか！？
MsgEn:
"Enjoy the Land of Despair" - we are being
provoked. Shall we ride?!

MsgJp:
休める時には休む
これ、俺たちよく忘れちゃいますよね
MsgEn: Rest when you can. We often forget this!

MsgJp:
休める時には休む
これ、俺たちよく忘れちゃいますよね
MsgEn:
Rest when you can.
We often forget this!

MsgJp: やっぱり覚者は戦ってこそ、ですね
MsgEn: After all, an Arisen should fight.

MsgJp:
これも広い意味で白竜様をお守りする
覚者ならではの戦いですから
MsgEn:
This is also a battle in the broad sense of
protecting the White Dragon, that only
the Arisen can fight.

MsgJp:
ジョゼフ様じゃありませんが――
事がうまく運ぶほど"悪しき竜"の
動向が気になっちゃいますね
MsgEn:
I'm not Joseph, but— the more things go well, the
more I wonder what the "evil dragon" is up to.

MsgJp:
解放軍が増員されれば俺たちの負担も
多少は減るでしょうから、黒い騎士のことは
その時に考えましょう
MsgEn:
If the liberation army is increased, our burden
will be reduced, so let's think about the black
knight at that time!

MsgJp:
鎧の中身が誰だろうと目の前に現れたら
俺は戦うだけですよ！

隊長、どうしましょう
何から手をつけていいのか――
MsgEn:
Captain, what should we do...
I don't even know where to start.

MsgJp:
早くなんとかしないと俺たちまで
動けなくなりますね
MsgEn:
If we don't do something soon, even we will
become unable to move.

MsgJp:
やりましょう、隊長
俺、レスタニアもアッカーシェランも
全部引き受けますよ！
MsgEn:
Let's do it, Captain.
I'll take care of Lestania, Acre Selund, I'll
take care of everything!

MsgJp:
黒騎士を倒して白竜様の力と
メガドを取り戻しましょう！
MsgEn:
Let's defeat the Black Knight and restore the
power of the White Dragon and Megado!

MsgJp:
いやー、なんか、鼻歌出ちゃいますよ
ついつい浮かれちゃうんです
MsgEn:
Well, somehow, a song just slips out.
I can't help but get carried away.

MsgJp: ネド王子が我々と離れたがっている――
MsgEn: Prince Nedo wants to leave us—

MsgJp:
これまでの経緯を思うと
それは考えにくいですよね
MsgEn: Given what we've been through, that's unlikely.

MsgJp:
この時間に何かできることが
あるかもしれませんね？
MsgEn:
At this time, there may be something we
can do, right?

MsgJp:
体力増強とか地勢確認とか――
考えてみましょうか
MsgEn:
Maybe we should think about increasing our
strength, or checking the terrain...

MsgJp:
俺はいつ、どんな時でも隊長の右腕です
頼りにしてくださいね
MsgEn:
I'm the captain's right hand man whenever and
however you need me.
You can count on me.

MsgJp:
大丈夫ですってば！
みんな心配しすぎですよ
MsgEn:
I'm fine!
Everyone is worrying too much.

MsgJp:
あははは――
少し張り切り過ぎました
MsgEn: Ahahaha— I got a little too carried away.

MsgJp:
落ち着いたらキノザのお湯に浸かって
養生するつもりです
MsgEn:
Once I get settled down, I plan to soak in the
Kinoza hot spring for recuperation.

MsgJp:
まだ勝手がわからなくてね
無礼があったら教えてくれ
MsgEn:
I'm still getting the hang of this. Let me
know if I'm being rude.

MsgJp:
わたしがここにいる意味――
それをね、ずっと考えているんだ
MsgEn: I've been thinking about what I'm here for.

MsgJp: 君たちから学ぶべきことは本当に多いよ
MsgEn: I really have a lot to learn from you guys.

MsgJp:
幾つもの出会いが――
わたしをここまで連れてきたのだろうね
MsgEn: How many encounters have brought me here?

MsgJp:
わたしも覚者だったら――
君たちを見ているとそう思わずにはいられない
MsgEn:
If I were also an Arisen...
I can't help but think of that when I
look at all of you.

MsgJp:
人生の分岐路なんて、通過してみないと
わからないものだね――最近、そう思うんだ
MsgEn:
You don't know the crossroads of life until you
pass through them; that's what I've
been thinking lately.

MsgJp:
――ああ、失礼
昔のことをね――故郷のことを思い出していた
MsgEn:
Ah, excuse me, I was reminiscing about the old
days, thinking about my hometown.

MsgJp:
人は変わるね――ああ、良くも悪くも
変わるものさ
MsgEn:
People change... Yes, for better or
worse, we change.

MsgJp: なんだろう

レオはいい奴だ
付き合いが浅くても、それだけはわかるよ
MsgEn:
Leo is a good guy. Even though we don't know each
other well, that much is clear.

MsgJp:
少し休ませてくれ
いろいろ考えたいんだ
MsgEn: I need some rest. I've got a lot to think about.

MsgJp: セシリーは眠っているようにしか見えないな

セシリーは助かるんだろう？
君たちが動いているんだから不安はない
そう言い聞かせてはいるんだけどね

セシリーが元気になって本当に良かった
わたしの提案が彼女を危機に追いやった
わけだからね
MsgEn:
I'm glad Cecily has regained her health. It was
my suggestion that put her in
crisis, so that's why.

MsgJp:
ああこの空気――
やっぱりたまらなくおいしいよ
MsgEn:
Ah, this sky...
It really is quite exquisite.

MsgJp:
娘から色々と聞いたが――
わたしも一度はレスタニアを見たいものだ
MsgEn:
My daughter has told me so much about it— I wish
I could see Lestania at least once.

MsgJp:
フィンダムは変わりつつある
暮らす者たちの意識は確実に変わっている
MsgEn:
Phindym is changing.
The attitude of the people living here is
definitely changing.

MsgJp:
芯なる樹が病めば、竜も、大地も
人も、魔物さえも病んでしまう
MsgEn:
If the core tree falls ill, the dragons and the
earth will also suffer. Even humans, and the
monsters, will fall ill!

MsgJp: そう――全ては巡る竜力で繋がっているのだ
MsgEn:
That's right—Everything is connected by the
power of the dragons.

MsgJp:
今にして思えばとても奇妙に思えるのだ
なぜ魔物と戦うように、病魔や厄災と
戦おうとしなかったのか――
MsgEn:
Thinking about it now, it seems very strange.
Why didn't I try to fight against sickness and
disaster, just as I would fight against enemies?

MsgJp:
フィンダムはもうずいぶん犠牲を払ったはずだが――
まだまだ足りないのだろうか
MsgEn:
Phindym must have sacrificed a lot already - Is
it still not enough?

MsgJp:
あの黒騎士が、どこから来たのか――
この凶事は黒騎士の仕業なのだろうか――
MsgEn:
Where did that black knight come from—Is the
black knight responsible for this evil?

MsgJp:
黒騎士が凶事に便乗したのか――
して、その目的は？　わからぬことばかりだ
MsgEn:
Did the Black Knight take advantage of the
calamity? And what is their goal? I can't
understand anything.

MsgJp:
――セシリーは良い子だろう？
わたしの自慢の娘だ
MsgEn:
.... Cecily's a sweet girl, isn't she?
She's my pride and joy.

MsgJp: それなのに、途方もない重荷を負わせてしまったな
MsgEn:
And yet, I ended up burdening you
with an enormous load.

MsgJp:
不思議なものだ
この、病み、淀んだ空気にも馴れてしまうものだな
MsgEn:
It's strange. You become accustomed even to this
sickly, stagnant atmosphere.

MsgJp:
精霊竜ウィルミアは美しく愛らしい竜だ
今でも目を閉じると、優雅に飛ぶ姿が目に浮かぶ
MsgEn:
The spirit dragon Willmia is a beautiful and
lovely dragon. Even now, when I close my eyes, I
can see its graceful flying figure.

MsgJp: レスタニアの人よ、なんなりと

レスタニアの覚者たちよ
心苦しい限りだが、このフィンダム
まだまだ安定への道半ば――
MsgEn:
Arisen of Lestania.
As much as it pains me, this is a Phindym still
halfway on the path to stability...

MsgJp: 最後まで、我々とともに歩んでくれ
MsgEn: Please continue to walk with us, until the end.

MsgJp: 《原始の雫》とセシリーを頼んだよ
MsgEn: Rely on the [Primeval Drops] and Cecily.

MsgJp:
樹内への侵入者という意味では
我々も、魔物もそれほど違わない
もし、ウィルミアに攻撃されたら――
そうだな、全力で逃げるのが得策だろう
MsgEn:
In terms of intruders into the forest, both us
and the enemy are not much different. If we are
attacked by Willmia...
Yeah, the best recourse would be escape,
using all our strength.

MsgJp:
浄化はすでに始まっているのだが――
想像以上に時間がかかるようだ
MsgEn:
The purification has already begun - but it seems
to be taking longer than anticipated.

MsgJp:
もう何もいうまい
これはさだめだ
抗うことを許されない種類のさだめもある
MsgEn:
I have nothing more to say.
This is fate.
There are types of fate that are not
allowed to be resisted.

MsgJp:
今はただ待とう――
娘はまた帰ってくる
MsgEn:
I will simply wait for now; my daughter
will come home again.

MsgJp: 竜として生まれ変わってな
MsgEn: To be reborn as a dragon.

MsgJp: さあ、早く為すべき事を！
MsgEn: Now, quickly do what needs to be done!

MsgJp:
我々はずっとここにいるし、あなたたちの
応援をしているよ
MsgEn: We'll be here all the way, supporting you!

MsgJp: 話すことなどない
MsgEn: There is nothing to say anymore.

MsgJp: 身の程を知れ
聞く耳持たぬわ
MsgEn: I refuse to listen to you.

MsgJp: 消えろ
笑止――
耳障りな声だ
思い上がるな
自惚れるな
半端覚者め――失せろ
貴様らの世界観で我が遠謀深慮ははかれぬ
MsgEn: Our cunning cannot be understood by your worldview

MsgJp: ふん、身の程知らずめ

アッカーシェランは、本当は良いところなんです
落ち着いたら案内させてくださいね
MsgEn:
Acre Selund is actually a nice place. Please let
me guide you once you settle down.

MsgJp: 悪しき竜は憎き敵――国の仇です
MsgEn:
The Evil Dragon is a hated enemy -
the nation's foe.

MsgJp:
けれども、隊長さんたちと会わせてくれたこと――
これだけは感謝しています
MsgEn:
However, I am grateful for allowing me to
meet with the captains.

MsgJp:
いつもなんのおもてなしもできずに
申し訳ありません――ごめんなさい
MsgEn:
I apologize for not being able to provide any
hospitality. I'm sorry.

MsgJp: ジリアンは本当に頼りになります

このアッカーシェランには他にもあのような
勇気ある人がいるのでしょうか
MsgEn:
Are there any other brave people like
that in Acre Selund?

MsgJp:
僕は王子なのですが、王族としての教育半ばで
城にいられなくなってしまいました
MsgEn:
I am a prince, but I had to leave the castle
halfway through my royal education.

MsgJp: 不作法があったら――お詫びします
MsgEn: If there was any rudeness— I apologize.

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍は王家の一番の家臣です
困ったことがあったらメイロワに言ってくださいね
MsgEn:
General Meirova is the king's most loyal
retainer. If you have any trouble,
please let Meirova know.

MsgJp:
悪しき竜に荒らされたアッカーシェラン――
みんなで力を合わせて元に戻すんです！
MsgEn:
Acre Selund has been ravaged by The Evil Dragon—
We all have to work together to restore it!

MsgJp: 僕には病で命を落とした姉がいました
MsgEn: I had a sister who passed away from illness.

MsgJp:
姉が王座を継ぐと思っていたので――
内緒ですよ？　こんな立場に戸惑っています
MsgEn:
I thought my sister would
inherit the throne, so...
It's a secret, you know? I'm
confused in this position.

MsgJp: 隊長、エリオット、ガルドリン、リズ――

たとえこの先に、何が起ころうと
皆さんの名前はアッカーシェランの歴史に
刻まれることでしょう
MsgEn:
Whatever happens next, your names will be etched
in Acre Selund's history.

MsgJp:
天はその者に耐えられる苦難しか与えない
と聞きます
MsgEn:
Heaven only bestows hardships that one can
endure, or so I hear

MsgJp:
どう思いますか？
たとえ思いはどうあれ、その通りだと
言ってくださいね
MsgEn:
What do you think? No matter what you think,
please say it exactly as it is.

MsgJp: はい、僕に用でしょうか？
MsgEn: Yes, you wanted to see me?

MsgJp:
覚者として――そして戦士として
いろいろ教えてくださいね
MsgEn:
As an Arisen—and a warrior, I hope you
can teach me a lot!

MsgJp:
陣の奧で守られているだけなんて
僕はいやですから
MsgEn:
Yes, I don't want to just be protected at the
back of the battlefield.

MsgJp:
隊長さん、僕は人々の希望であらねば
なりません
MsgEn: Captain, I must be the hope of the people

MsgJp:
それには、どう振る舞えばよいのか――
なかなかの難問です
MsgEn:
And how should one behave in that situation? It's
quite a difficult problem.

MsgJp:
緊張しますね
いくさはいつもこうなのですか？
MsgEn:
I'm nervous, aren't you? Is it always like
this before a battle?

MsgJp:
僕はまだまだです
もっともっと強くならなくてはなりません
MsgEn:
I am still lacking. I must become
stronger, much stronger.

MsgJp:
秘密の入り口が見つかったら
あとは任せてください
MsgEn:
Once you find the secret entrance we'll
take care of the rest.

MsgJp: 扉の先は必ず展望城へと通じているはずです
MsgEn:
The path beyond the door must lead
to Lookout Castle.

MsgJp:
少なくとも、王家の秘密の扉は
存在したわけですから
MsgEn:
At the very least, the secret door of the
royal family existed.

MsgJp:
隊長さん、ありがとうございます
ここまで来られたのも隊長さんたちの
おかげです
MsgEn:
Thank you, Captain. It's thanks to you all that
we've made it this far.

MsgJp:
こうして再び展望城に立つことができるとは――
感慨無量です
MsgEn:
To be able to stand in Lookout Castle again like
this—it's an indescribable feeling.

MsgJp:
隠れている同志を見つけ出すと同時に
不安な日々を送ってきた人々に
僕たちが来ていることを知らせる目的もあります
MsgEn:
The purpose is to find our comrades in hiding and
at the same time to let those who have been
living in uncertainty know that we are coming!

MsgJp: よろしくお願いします！

僕は各所の兵たちを回って声をかけたら
石塔のところで皆さんをお待ちします
MsgEn:
I'll go around to all the soldiers in the various
locations and call them out.
I'll meet you all at the stone tower.

MsgJp:
僕は各所の兵たちを回って声をかけたら
石塔のところで皆さんをお待ちします
MsgEn:
I'll go around to all the soldiers in the various
locations and call them out.
I'll meet you all at the stone tower.

MsgJp:
ああ隊長さん
いてくれると心強いです！
MsgEn: Oh Captain, It's reassuring to have you here!

MsgJp:
さあ、みなさん
思いを果たして白竜様のもとへ！
MsgEn:
Now, everyone, Let's fulfill our wishes and go
to The White Dragon!

MsgJp:
ああ隊長さん
落ち着いたら将軍やジリアンと一緒に
レスタニアにお邪魔しますからね
MsgEn:
Oh Captain, when things settle down, I'll be
visiting you and the General and
Gillian in Lestania!

MsgJp:
白竜様やジョゼフ様にお礼とご挨拶を
しなくてはなりません
MsgEn:
I have to express my gratitude and greetings to
Lord White Dragon and Master Joseph

MsgJp: エリオットは一見頼りないけど、腕は立つ
MsgEn: Elliot is seemingly unreliable, but he is skilled.

MsgJp: レスタニア者は一筋縄ではいかないね
MsgEn: Lestania citizens are not easy to deal with.

MsgJp: リズはああ見えて、かなりしっかりした子だね
MsgEn:
Lise, believe it or not, is a
pretty reliable girl.

MsgJp: 人は見かけによらない――そんな言葉を思い出したよ
MsgEn: Appearances are deceiving—I remember that saying.

MsgJp: ガルドリンは――見たとおりの人物のようだ
MsgEn: Gurdolin—seems to be exactly what he looks like.

MsgJp:
言葉の荒さも人の良さを隠すためのもの
まるでアッカーシェランの男のようにわかりやすい
MsgEn:
The harshness of words is also a means to conceal
one's goodness, just like a man from Acre Selund,
it is easy to understand.

MsgJp:
隊長――あなたは不思議な人だな
あなたならなんとかしてくれる
――そう思わせてくれるよ
MsgEn:
Captain—you are an intriguing person I believe
you can do something—You make me think that way.

MsgJp:
そういう人のことを、このアッカーシェランでは
"竜に愛されてる"と言うのさ
MsgEn:
We in Acre Selund call such a person
"loved by the dragon."

MsgJp:
レスタニアも同じだろうけど
このアッカーシェランにも長い歴史があってね――
MsgEn:
Lestania is probably the same but Acre Selund
also has a long history—

MsgJp:
たいていは家と家、人と魔物の対立の歴史なんだ
竜との対立なんて初めてのことさ
MsgEn:
Usually, it is a history of conflict between
houses and houses, and people and monsters. It's
the first time there's been a
conflict with dragons.

MsgJp:
わたし、悪しき竜が現れるまでは野や山を見ても
何も思わなかったんだ
MsgEn:
Until the evil dragon appeared, I didn't think
anything of the fields and mountains.

MsgJp:
だけどね
自由に歩き回れるわけじゃなくなってからは
愛おしくてたまらない――勝手だよね
MsgEn:
But you know, ever since I can no longer freely
wander around, I cherish it so
much—it's selfish, isn't it?

MsgJp: レスタニアには覚者が大勢いるんだろう？
MsgEn: Are there a lot of Arisen in Lestania?

MsgJp:
みんな強いのか？　一流の戦士なのか？
白翼覚者隊という生え抜きの部隊もあるんだよね
MsgEn:
Are they all strong? Are they
first-class warriors?
There's also a freshly minted unit called the
White Wing Arisen Corps.

MsgJp: ――戦いが、いっぱいあるんだな
MsgEn: —I'm sure there's a lot of fighting going on.

MsgJp: 白竜は長く病んでいると聞いている
MsgEn:
I have heard that The White Dragon has been
ill for a long time.

MsgJp:
早く良くなるといいな
竜はいつでも心身ともに健やかでいてくれないと
世が闇に覆われてしまうようだ
MsgEn:
I hope you get better soon.
The world seems to be covered in darkness if the
dragon is not always healthy both
mentally, and physically.

MsgJp: えーと、なに？

こっちにいる間はわたしと一緒に
行動してもらうからね
MsgEn: You'll be working with me while you're here.

MsgJp:
将軍がいれば全体の士気もあがる
そういう人だよ、メイロワ将軍は
MsgEn:
Having a general boosts overall morale. That's
the kind of person General Meirova is.

MsgJp:
ネド王子とは、将軍に連れられて
挨拶に行って――それだけ
MsgEn:
Prince Nedo and I were taken by the General to
greet him—that's it.

MsgJp:
それでも、王子のためなら
戦えるし、王子を思えば希望を抱ける
MsgEn:
Still, if it's for the prince, I can fight, and
if I think of the prince, I can hold onto hope.

MsgJp:
――みんな同じさ
王家は、そういう一族なんだ
MsgEn: —all the same. The Royals are that kind of family.

MsgJp:
今はネド王子が最優先
それ以外は考えたくないの
MsgEn:
Right now, Prince Nedo is the top priority. I
don't want to think about anything else.

MsgJp:
王子は状況に屈することなく
積極的に動いているみたいだね
MsgEn:
The prince seems to be actively moving forward
without succumbing to the circumstances.

MsgJp:
頼もしいと言えば頼もしいけど
本音を言うと――いや、やめておくよ
MsgEn:
I'd say you're reliable, but... To tell you the
truth—no, I shouldn't.

MsgJp:
ネド王子と一緒の時間を作ってよ
良き助言者になってほしい
MsgEn:
Make time to be with Prince Nedo.
Be a good advisor.

MsgJp:
オークどもの動きが活発だ
ふん、"悪しき竜"の言いなりのくせに
MsgEn:
The Orcs are quite active, huh? Hmph, even though
they're under the control of the "Evil Dragon".

MsgJp:
アッカーシェラン全土のオークが
動き始めたら、こっちも戦力を
分散する必要があるから――マズいね
MsgEn:
If all the orcs in Acre Selund start moving,
we'll need to disperse our forces as
well - that's not good.

MsgJp:
"悪しき竜"が現れたってね
今度来たら、逃がさないよ
MsgEn:
I heard an "evil dragon" showed up. If he comes
again, I won't let him get away.

MsgJp:
イェルハルドの近くで戦うのは
とても勉強になるよ
MsgEn: Fighting near Gerhard is very educational.

MsgJp:
イェルハルドの近くで戦うのは
とても勉強になるよ
MsgEn: Fighting near Gerhard is very educational.

MsgJp:
戦いが終わったらさ――
城で会おうね
MsgEn:
When the battle is over—I'll see you
at the castle.

MsgJp:
はあ――いいね、やっぱり
この城は、落ち着くよ
MsgEn: Ha—good, I knew it. This castle is so relaxing!

MsgJp: ここに来て解放軍を増強できそうなんだ
MsgEn:
It seems like we can strengthen the Liberation
Army by coming here.

MsgJp:
人数が増えると作戦の選択肢も増えるし
あなたたちの負担も減るからね
MsgEn:
The more people we have, the more operational
options we have, and the less work
you guys have to do.

MsgJp:
わたしたちはとにかく城内を駆け回って
混乱を誘いつつ敵の部隊を削る――いい？
MsgEn:
We will run around inside the castle, causing
confusion and chipping away at the
enemy's forces—sound good?

MsgJp: ここにいてもいいの？
MsgEn: Is it okay if I stay here?

MsgJp: 借りを返すときが来たようだね
MsgEn: It seems that the time has come to repay the debt.

MsgJp: そっちも、こっちも、とりあえず一段落だね
MsgEn:
Both there and here, we have made
some progress for now.

MsgJp:
王子はアッカーシェランのただひとりの
覚者なんだ
MsgEn: The Prince is the only Arisen of Acre Selund.

MsgJp:
王子の気持ち、わたしたちの気持ちが
どうあっても、選択肢はないよね
MsgEn:
The prince's feelings, our feelings, no matter
what, there is no option.

MsgJp:
焦っても仕方がないよね
――そう自分に言い聞かせてるよ
MsgEn:
There's no point in rushing... that's what I
keep telling myself.

MsgJp:
ふと気づくと、あなたたちに頼っている
自分に気づいて、あれ？って思うんだよね
MsgEn:
When you suddenly realize, you depend on yourself
and think, huh? When I suddenly realize it, I
find myself relying on you guys. I become aware
of myself and think, "Huh?"

MsgJp: 王子も――そんな風に考えたのかな
MsgEn: Did the prince also think that way?

MsgJp:
悪しき竜との決戦がすぐそこにあるのに
気になることが多すぎるの
MsgEn:
The battle against the Evil Dragon is right
around the corner, but there are too many things
that I'm worried about.

MsgJp:
死ぬかもしれないんだから、スッキリして
おきたいけど――贅沢なのかな
MsgEn:
Since I might die, I want to feel refreshed, but
is that being extravagant?

MsgJp: いよいよ決戦――

静かに、ギュッと――
覚悟を固めているのさ

こっちの状況が落ち着いたら
かならず訪ねていくから――
MsgEn:
Once this situation here settles down, I will
definitely come to visit.

MsgJp: 案内してくれる？

こんなこと
苦しんでいる民たちにはけして言えないが
MsgEn:
I can't say this to the people who
are suffering, but...

MsgJp:
おぬしたちのような戦士たちとともに戦えるのは
武人の誉れ、喜びだ
MsgEn:
It is an honor and joy to fight alongside
warriors like us. Soldiers.

MsgJp:
アッカー家の方々は家臣を大切にする家柄
その恩に報いることが今のわしの責務
MsgEn:
The Acre family values their retainers, And it is
now my duty to repay their kindness.

MsgJp:
おぬし達は、そんなわしへの贈り物にちがいない
贈り主のことは考えないようにするよ
MsgEn:
You all are undoubtedly a gift for someone like
me. Let's not think about the giver.

MsgJp:
ジリアンはわしの孫だ
こんなことになるまで、ほとんど話したことも
なかったが
娘に似て良い子に育ったわ
MsgEn:
Gillian is my granddaughter. We hardly talked
much until it came to this, but she has grown up
to be a good child, just like her mother.

MsgJp: よいか、本人には内緒だぞ
MsgEn: Listen, it's a secret from them.

MsgJp:
おぬしは良い部下に恵まれておるな
いや、仲間というべきかな
MsgEn:
You are blessed with good subordinates. No,
perhaps it's better to say comrades.

MsgJp: わしの人生はもう夕暮れ時だ
MsgEn: My life is already in its twilight.

MsgJp:
これまで面白おかしく生かしてくれた
このアッカーシェランに恩返しをしないうちには
立ち去るわけにはいかんのだ
MsgEn:
Up until now, you have made my life interesting
and enjoyable. Before I leave Acre Selund, I must
express my gratitude.

MsgJp:
歳を取るのは悪くないと思ってここまで生きてきたが
こんな危機の最中にジジイでいるのは――
まったく、運命が恨めしいわ
MsgEn:
I have lived thinking that getting older is not a
bad thing, but to be an old man in the midst of
such a crisis... Oh, how I resent my fate.

MsgJp: レスタニアでもオークは臭いらしいな
MsgEn: I hear orcs stink in Lestania too.

MsgJp:
臭いのはこの地のオークだけなら
なんと不公平なことかと
天を呪ってやるところだったぞ
MsgEn:
If it were only the orcs here that smelled, I
would have cursed the heavens for
how unfair it was.

MsgJp:
おぬしほどの者がこの国にいたら
わしは喜んで将軍の座を譲るつもりだ
MsgEn:
But if someone as capable as you were in this
country, I would gladly give up my
position as general.

MsgJp:
そしてわしは、大将軍を名乗るのだ！
はははは！
MsgEn:
And thus, I shall proclaim myself as the
Supreme General! Hahaha!

MsgJp:
人をジジイ扱いする若造に手厳しく仕返しするのが
わしの楽しみでな
MsgEn:
It's my pleasure to give a harsh retaliation to
the young people who treat me like an old man.

MsgJp:
だが、わしは有名になりすぎた
わしのことを誰も知らぬ土地へ行って
若造どもをからかい倒してやりたいわ
MsgEn:
However, I became too famous. I want to go to a
land where no one knows me and make fools
of those youngsters.

MsgJp: おお、そうだな
王子とは必ず再会できる

おぬしらもそう信じてくれ
信じればそれは実現するというではないか
MsgEn:
You all too believe in that. It is said that if
you believe, it will come true.

MsgJp:
気が急くのう――
いかし、急いては事をし損じるというからな
MsgEn:
I'm in a hurry—But, after all, they
say haste makes waste.

MsgJp:
イェルハルドを悪く思わないでくれ
あれもまた忠義の男だ
MsgEn:
Please do not think badly of Gerhard.
He is also a loyal man.

MsgJp:
おぬしたちのことはネド王子には
良く言っておくからな
わしに任せておけ
MsgEn:
I will make sure to speak well of you all to
Prince Nedo. Leave it to me.

MsgJp:
ここだけの話、王子が覚者でなければ
その事実、隠し通すつもりでいたが――
MsgEn:
Confidentially speaking, if the prince isn't an
Arisen, I had intended to conceal that fact...

MsgJp: 胸を撫で下ろしたわい
MsgEn: I breathed a sigh of relief.

MsgJp:
これから先もよろしく頼むぞ
戦慣れしたおぬしらの力が
ぜひとも必要だ
MsgEn:
I kindly ask for your continued support in the
future. Your experience and skills in
battle are indispensable.

MsgJp:
解放軍は少数精鋭
大軍の真っ向ぶつかり合いなど
考えちゃいない
MsgEn:
The Liberation Army is an elite few and they
don't even think about the head-to-head
clashes of large armies.

MsgJp: おぬしら、期待しているぞ
MsgEn: I'm expecting great things from you.

MsgJp: 慎重に――慎重に事を進めるぞ

わしが焦っているように見えたら
おぬしら、遠慮無く諫めてくれよ
MsgEn:
If it appears that I am being impatient, please
do not hesitate to admonish me.

MsgJp:
ふーむ
王家の秘密は記録に残さないのが習わし
地図すらないのだ
MsgEn:
Hmmm, royal secrets are not supposed to be
recorded. We don't even have a map!

MsgJp:
ふーむ
王家の秘密は記録に残さないのが習わし
地図すらないのだ
MsgEn:
Hmmm Royal secrets are not supposed to be
recorded We don't even have a map!

MsgJp:
展望城の城主はネド・アッカー様
そのことをオークどもに思い出させてやるわ
MsgEn:
The lord of Lookout Castle is Prince Nedo Acre. I
will remind those Orcs of that.

MsgJp:
難攻不落と思われたこの城も
あっさりと"悪しき竜"に落とされた
その口惜しさが、わしの原動力だ
MsgEn:
This fortress, which was thought to be
impregnable, was easily taken down by the "Evil
Dragon." The frustration of that defeat
is my driving force.

MsgJp:
敗北は人を強くする
身をもって知ったぞ
MsgEn: Defeat makes us stronger. I've seen it firsthand.

MsgJp:
具体的な話はジリアンから聞いてくれ
もちろんネド王子を尊重してくれよ
MsgEn:
Please listen to Gillian for the specific
details. And of course, please
respect Prince Nedo.

MsgJp: 頼むぞ、レスタニアの強者たちよ
MsgEn: I'm counting on you, strong warriors of Lestania.

MsgJp:
たとえ敵の手に落ちようとも、さすが王都
攻略は容易ではないわい
MsgEn:
Even if it falls into the hands of the enemy, it
is indeed a royal city that will not
be easy to conquer!

MsgJp:
黒騎士はおぬしらに任せるぞ
それが望みであろう？
MsgEn:
I'll leave the black knight to you. That's
what you want, isn't it?

MsgJp:
レスタニアの白竜様はその力を
取り戻したと聞く
MsgEn:
I hear that the White Dragon of Lestania
has regained its power.

MsgJp: 本当に良かったなあ
王子の行動がさっぱりわからん
MsgEn: I can't understand the prince's actions at all.

MsgJp:
――しかし、わしは王子を信じると決めた
おぬしらも王子を見捨てることなく
よろしく頼むぞ
MsgEn:
—But I have decided to trust the prince, and I
hope you will not abandon him.

MsgJp:
すまんな――
わしが謝っても意味はなかろうが
今はこれしか言えん
MsgEn:
I'm sorry— Even if I apologize, it probably won't
mean much, But right now, this is all I can say.

MsgJp:
王子は気が触れたわけでも
心を奪われたわけでもない
となれば、わしの気持ちは決まっている
MsgEn:
The prince is neither crazy nor has he lost his
mind. If that's the case, my feelings
are already decided.

MsgJp:
たとえそれが大きな過ちだとしても不安はないぞ
おぬしらがいるからな
MsgEn:
Even if it's a big mistake, I have no worries
Because you are here.

MsgJp:
ああ忙しい
やることはいっぱいなのに
気が急いて何もできんわ！
MsgEn:
Oh, I'm so busy, I have so much to do! I'm in
such a rush I can't get anything done!

MsgJp: もう進むしかない
MsgEn: There's no choice but to move forward.

MsgJp:
理想はまずネド王子の保護だが
決戦と同時になっても良しとせねばなるまい
時は来たのだ
MsgEn:
The first priority is the protection of Prince
Nedo, but we must also be prepared for the
decisive battle. The time has come.

MsgJp:
王子と相談して決めねばねばならんことが
多々あるのだ
まだまだ休むわけにはいかない
MsgEn:
There are many things that I need to
discuss with the prince.
I can't afford to rest just yet.

MsgJp:
まあ、アッカーシェランのための多忙は
本懐だがな
MsgEn:
Well, being busy for Acre Selund is
my true calling.

MsgJp:
わたしの故郷、ロスギルは古来より魔物の多い土地
よってこう見えて、そこそこ戦えると自負しています
MsgEn:
My hometown, Rothgill, has been a land of
monsters since ancient times.
So, although I look like this, I am proud to say
that I can fight well!

MsgJp: いつか、手合わせ願いたいものですね
MsgEn: I hope to have a chance to spar with you someday.

MsgJp:
若い頃はメイロワ将軍の思いつきのような言動に
振り回されましたが
おかげで身も心も鍛えられましたよ
MsgEn:
When I was younger, I was swept away by General
Meyrowa's thoughtful words and actions, his
impetuous words and deeds. But it has
strengthened me both physically and mentally.

MsgJp:
戦略、戦術――
そんなものが役に立つのは相手が人間の時だけです
MsgEn:
Strategies, tactics— such things are only useful
when the opponent is human!

MsgJp:
いや、オークならば、かろうじて通用するでしょう
しかし、悪しき竜相手では、果たして――
MsgEn:
No, if it's an Orc, it will barely work. However,
when facing the Evil Dragon, I wonder if it
will be effective...

MsgJp:
解放軍とは言っても、寄せ集めです
勝利に欠かせない執念や忠義心の強さは人それぞれ
MsgEn:
Even though they're called the Liberation Army,
they're just a ragtag group. Everyone has their
own determination and loyalty that they can't do
without for victory.

MsgJp:
訓練による意思統一も難しい状況の中で
人々を鼓舞するのは勝利そのものが持つ力に他ならず
MsgEn:
In the midst of a difficult situation where it is
also challenging to achieve unity through
training, the ability to inspire people lies
solely in the power that victory itself holds.

MsgJp: 親鳥が先か卵が先か――みたいな話ですけどね
MsgEn:
It's like the chicken and the egg
problem, you know.

MsgJp:
ほんの一握りの勇気など、悪しき竜のひと啼きで
吹き飛ばされてしまいます
MsgEn:
Even a small handful of courage can be blown away
by a single roar from the Evil Dragon.

MsgJp: 多くの民は――強くはありません
MsgEn: Many of the people... They are not strong.

MsgJp: わたしはかつてメイロワ将軍の腹心の部下でした
MsgEn:
I used to be General Meirova's
trusted subordinate.

MsgJp:
これだけは覚えておいてください
将軍は、悪い人ではありません
MsgEn:
Please remember this: The general is not
a bad person.

MsgJp: ジリアンはどうですか？

メイロワ将軍に振り回されているのであれば
何か助言ができるかもしれない
わたしのところに来るように伝えてください
MsgEn:
If you are being pushed around by General
Meirova, there may be some advice I can give you.
Please let them know to come to me.

MsgJp:
わたしの希望はね――
次の火竜を見たいということです
MsgEn: My hope is— to see the next fire dragon!

MsgJp: アッカーシェランとともに生きる、真っ当な火竜を
MsgEn:
Acre Selund, a dignified Fire
Dragon, living alongside.

MsgJp: 戦乱の世は嫌というほど見てきました

流される血、消えない苦鳴――そうして手に入れた
安定、平和、繁栄を、よそから来た竜に乱され
黙っているわけにはいきません
MsgEn:
The blood that is spilled, the bitter cry that
will not go away - that's how we got stability,
peace, and prosperity, and we can't just sit back
and let a dragon from another land disrupt it!

MsgJp:
わたしが何かに反対したら、そこには何か
理由があると思っていただきたい
MsgEn:
If I oppose something, I would like you to think
that there is a reason behind it.

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍は、反発心だのなんだの
感情のせいにしがちですからね
MsgEn:
General Meirova tends to attribute things to
resentment and emotions, you know.

MsgJp: ふーむ、何用でしょうか？
MsgEn: Hmm, what can I help you with?

MsgJp: おやおや、王子探しは中断ですか？
MsgEn: Oh my, is the search for the prince on hold?

MsgJp: そちらの首尾はいかがです？
MsgEn: How about the progress over there?

MsgJp:
王子は心身ともにご無事であったと
聞いています
MsgEn:
I hear that the Prince is safe, both
physically and mentally.

MsgJp: 良かった――本当に良かった

ネド王子はご無事――
しかも覚者であると聞いていますが
なにぶん、疑い深い性格でしてね
MsgEn:
Prince Nedo is safe— and moreover, I
hear he is an Arisen.
However, he has a suspicious personality.

MsgJp:
この地の守備固めの算段を終えたら
わたしも王子の下へ馳せ参じましょう
MsgEn:
After finishing the defense of this area, I will
also hurry to the prince's side.

MsgJp:
敵の攻勢に対処しつつ"悪しき竜"を
倒す方法も模索しなくてはなりません
MsgEn:
While the focus tends to be only on the infected
monsters, the condition of plants
and soil is also dire.

MsgJp:
こう見えてわたしも武闘派
弱腰になる心配など無用ですよ
MsgEn:
Even though it may not look like it, I am also a
martial artist. There is no need to worry about
me being wishy-washy.

MsgJp:
こちらは問題ありませんよ
ネド王子のお側に仕えてください
MsgEn:
There is no problem here. Please
serve Prince Nedo.

MsgJp:
こちらは問題ありませんよ
ネド王子のお側に仕えてください
MsgEn:
There is no problem here, please
serve Prince Nedo.

MsgJp:
敵は我々が目一杯引きつけますから
ええ、派手にやりますとも
MsgEn:
The enemy will be completely occupied with us.
Yes, we will be very flashy!

MsgJp:
今は兵達を労い、休ませる時です
今少し、時間をください
MsgEn:
Now is the time to commend and give rest to the
soldiers. Please wait a little while.

MsgJp:
漆黒の鎧をまとった騎士のうわさは
聞きましたかな？
MsgEn:
Have you heard the rumors about the knight
wearing jet-black armor?

MsgJp:
その者が現れたことで王都は陥落したとか
いや、それ以上のことは知らないのですが
MsgEn:
The Royal Capital fell because of the appearance
of that person, or so I've heard. Well, I don't
know anything beyond that.

MsgJp:
出撃の準備は整っています
しかし、まだ命令が届きませんのでね
MsgEn:
Preparations for deployment are complete.
However, we have yet to receive orders.

MsgJp:
大戦にも関わらず声が掛からなかったのは
我々は第二の矢として待機せよということ
MsgEn:
Despite the war, the reason why our voices were
not heard is because we were told to wait
as the second arrow.

MsgJp: その時までここで矢尻を研いでおきましょう
MsgEn: Until then, let's sharpen our arrowheads here.

MsgJp: 王都の攻略は失敗に終わったそうですね
MsgEn:
It seems that the capture of the royal
capital ended in failure.

MsgJp:
わたしたちはここで散った者たちの
安息を祈っています
MsgEn: We pray for the repose of those who perished here.

MsgJp:
立ち寄ってくれたことはうれしいのですが
ネド王子とメイロワ将軍のそばに
いてあげてくれると安心なのですがね
MsgEn:
I am glad that you stopped by, but it would be
reassuring if you could stay by the side of
Prince Nedo and General Meirova.

MsgJp:
あなたたちがここにいるということは
向こうは一件落着でしょうか？
MsgEn:
If you guys are here, does that mean it's all
settled on the other side?

MsgJp: いいえ、そうは見えませんね――

そろそろ我々も出陣しましょうかな
たとえ命令がなくても行くつもりですよ
MsgEn:
I think it's time for us to head out.
We're going even if we don't get the orders to go.

MsgJp:
王子の失踪は、ただの家出騒動では
ありません
MsgEn:
The disappearance of the prince is not a simple
case of running away from home.

MsgJp:
王子はアッカーシェランの未来そのもの
なのですからね
MsgEn:
The prince is the future of Acre
Selund, after all.

MsgJp:
王子がお立場を棄てることは考えられない
わたしはただただ王子を信じるのみです
MsgEn:
It is inconceivable that the prince would abandon
his position. I only believe in him!

MsgJp:
ジッとしてなどいられませんね
わたしも最前線に立たせてもらいますよ
MsgEn:
I can't just stand still, I'll stand on
the front line too.

MsgJp:
準備が整い次第、王子のところへ
馳せ参じるつもりです
MsgEn:
As soon as preparations are complete, I plan to
hasten to the prince's side.

MsgJp:
皆さんお疲れさまでした
残りの人生を平穏に送れるように
わたしは日々祈るつもりです
MsgEn:
Thank you all for your hard work. I will pray
every day that you have peace for
the rest of your lives.

MsgJp:
皆さんのぶんも――いやいや、それは
余計なお世話ですかな
MsgEn:
Everyone's share—No, no, is that really
any of your business?

MsgJp:
声がでかくてうるさかったり、反対に、小さくて
聞こえない時はそう言っておくれ
MsgEn:
When my voice is loud and annoying, or on the
contrary, when it's so quiet that you
can't hear, let me know.

MsgJp:
こればっかりは習い性でね
盗賊は、ほら、いろんな状況で仕事をするからさ
MsgEn:
It's all a habit.
Thieves, you see, work in all kinds of situations.

MsgJp:
あたしの名前は誰でも知ってるけど、顔を知っている
人間はそういないよ
MsgEn:
Everyone knows my name, but not everyone
knows my face.

MsgJp:
できればずっとそのままが良かったけど
まあ、そうも言ってられないね
MsgEn:
If possible, I would have preferred to stay as it
was, but well, I can't just keep saying that.

MsgJp:
あたしが投獄されたのは息子の意見を
無視したからなんだ
牢屋の中で、ずいぶん反省したよ
MsgEn:
I was imprisoned because I
ignored my son's opinion.
I felt so much remorse while I was in jail.

MsgJp: それで今の、聞き分けのいいあたしがいるのさ
MsgEn: That's why I'm such a good listener now.

MsgJp: 婆さんだと思ってなめるんじゃないよ？
MsgEn: Don't think I'm just an old lady.

MsgJp:
そのへんの爺さんなら５人でかかってきても
目じゃないさ
MsgEn:
Any old man out there, five of them could come at
you and you wouldn't bat an eye.

MsgJp: あたしは権威ってのが大キライでね

でも、気づいたら
あたしが盗賊界の権威みたいなものさ
ああ、たまらないよ
MsgEn:
But then I realized, I'm like the authority
in the bandit world.
Oh, I can't wait!

MsgJp:
だから、竜と王族には強くあってもらわないと
困るんだ
MsgEn:
So, we need the dragons and royalty
to stay strong.

MsgJp:
これを聞いたからってどうするわけでもないけど
レスタニアにもお宝はあるんだろう？
MsgEn:
Not that I'm going to do anything about this, but
you do have treasures in Lestania, don't you?

MsgJp:
大方、ゴブリンあたりが
ため込んでいるんじゃないかい？
MsgEn: Most likely, the goblins are hoarding them.

MsgJp: 長く生きると、想像もしなかったことが起こるよ
MsgEn: If you live long enough, unexpected things happen.

MsgJp:
悪しき竜のことはそりゃあ一大事だけど
あたしがメイロワと手を組むなんてねえ
MsgEn:
The whole Evil Dragon thing is a big deal, but I
can't believe I'm working with Meirova.

MsgJp:
あんたたちの装備には見たことのない材料が
使われているね――
落ち着いたら、ぜひ、レスタニアへ行ってみたいね
MsgEn:
I've never seen these materials used in your
equipment— I'd love to visit Lestania
when you get settled!

MsgJp:
言っておくけどね
あたしが盗むのは王家のお宝だけさ
MsgEn: Just so you know I only steal royal treasures.

MsgJp:
でも義賊というわけじゃない
施しは好きじゃないからね
MsgEn:
But that doesn't mean I'm a righteous bandit.
I don't like charity.

MsgJp: あたしの息子たちもどこかで戦っているんだろうね
MsgEn: I'm sure my sons are fighting somewhere too.

MsgJp:
まあ、無事でいてくれればそれでいいんだ
生きていれば、また盗賊稼業を楽しめるさ
MsgEn:
Well, just stay safe and that's all that matters.
As long as you're alive, you can enjoy
being a bandit again.

MsgJp: うん、あたしかい？

別にあたしを助けに来たわけじゃ
ないだろう？
MsgEn: You didn't come here to help me, did you?

MsgJp:
ああ、構いやしないよ
で、メイロワ将軍はなんだって？
MsgEn: Ah, I don't mind. So, what about General Meirova?

MsgJp:
あの爺さんが頭を下げれば
解放軍に協力しないことはない
伝えといてくれ
MsgEn:
If that old man bows his head, there's nothing he
won't do to help the Liberation
Army. Please relay this.

MsgJp:
ネド王子、気張りすぎじゃないのかい？
ありゃ、大丈夫かね
MsgEn:
Prince Nedo, aren't you trying too hard?
Oh dear, are you okay?

MsgJp:
とにかくね、敵にここまで来られたら
どうしようもないよ
MsgEn:
Anyway, if the enemy manages to come this far,
there's nothing we can do.

MsgJp: それを忘れずに戦っておくれ

"悪しき竜"と対峙したことで王子はどうやら
気持ちが大きくなっているようだ
MsgEn:
It seems that the prince is feeling better after
confronting the "evil dragon."

MsgJp: これは危険な兆候だよ
入り口だ通路だと王家は隠し事が多いね
MsgEn:
Entrances, corridors, the royal family has
a lot to hide.

MsgJp:
それを暴くのがわたしたちの
楽しみなんだけどさ
MsgEn: That's what we're looking forward to uncovering.

MsgJp: 入り口だ通路だと王家は隠し事が多いね
MsgEn:
Entrances, corridors, the royal family has
a lot to hide.

MsgJp:
それを暴くのがわたしたちの
楽しみなんだけどさ
MsgEn: That's what we're looking forward to uncovering.

MsgJp:
城に忍び込むなんてのは何度もしたけど
斬り込んで行くなんて初めてだ
MsgEn:
I've snuck into the castle many times before, but
this is my first time sneaking in and attacking.

MsgJp: 正直に言って――胸がおどるよ
MsgEn: To be honest... my heart is pounding.

MsgJp:
奪われたものは、ひとつひとつ
取り戻せばいいのさ
MsgEn:
What was taken from us, one by one,
we'll get back.

MsgJp: 盗賊のあたしが言うことじゃないがね
MsgEn:
As a bandit, it's not my place to say,
but you know.

MsgJp:
メガドは王都だからね
それはそれは豊かな町だったよ
盗賊の修行の場さ
MsgEn:
Because Megado is the Royal Capital, it was a
very prosperous city. This is the
training ground for thieves.

MsgJp: 厄介なことになりそうだねえ
MsgEn: Sounds like it's going to be tricky.

MsgJp: 北の盗賊たちと一緒にあたしも行くよ
MsgEn: I'll go with the thieves from the north.

MsgJp:
どうしたんだい
顔色が冴えないね

ああ戻ったんだね
やっぱりあんたたちがいてくれないと
背中が不安だよ
MsgEn:
Oh you're back. I still need you guys. I'm
worried about my back.

MsgJp:
解放軍は再編成中さ
でもね、どんなに頑張ったって
あんたたちのいない穴は埋まらない
MsgEn:
The Liberation Army is regrouping but you know,
no matter how hard we try we can't fill the
hole without you guys.

MsgJp:
そっちにも事情はあるだろうけど
最後まで付き合ってもらうよ
MsgEn:
You may have your own circumstances, but please
stay with me until the end.

MsgJp:
あとは"悪しき竜"だね
ちょっと遠回りしちまったけど
一歩一歩、追い詰めているはずだよ
MsgEn:
The Evil Dragon is the only thing remaining.
Although we took a little detour; Step by step,
we should be cornering it.

MsgJp:
初めて会った頃に比べたら王子は
成長した――そう思った矢先のこれだよ
MsgEn:
Compared to when we first met, the prince has
grown— that's what I thought, and just as
I did, this happened.

MsgJp:
こんな行動をするなんて
まだまだ子供だってことなんだろうね
MsgEn:
Don't act like this. It shows that you're
still a child.

MsgJp:
初めて会った頃に比べたら王子は
成長した――そう思った矢先のこれだよ
MsgEn:
Compared to when we first met, the prince has
grown— that's what I thought, and just as
I did, this happened.

MsgJp:
こんな行動をするなんて
まだまだ子供だってことなんだろうね
MsgEn:
Don't act like this. It shows that you're
still a child.

MsgJp: 孫たちが世話になったね
MsgEn: Thanks for taking care of the grandchildren.

MsgJp:
おっと――
こんな月並みな礼をしちまうとは
あたしも歳を取ったねえ
MsgEn:
Oops—I can't believe I'm resorting to such a
clichéd gesture. I guess I'm getting old.

MsgJp:
王子の不在が噂になり始めたよ
あんたらの耳にも入ると思うけど
放っておきな
MsgEn:
The absence of the prince has started to become a
rumor, you know. But just leave it alone.

MsgJp: あたしがなんとかするからさ

人生ってのはほんと気紛れだね
何が起こるかわからない
MsgEn:
Life is really unpredictable.
You never know what will happen.

MsgJp:
ああ、この歳になっても
驚くようなことはまだまだいっぱい起こるよ
MsgEn:
Oh, even at this age, there are still many
surprising things happening.

MsgJp:
城内は静かなものさ
みんな自分を見つめ直しているんだろうね
MsgEn:
The inside of the castle is quiet.
Everyone is reflecting on themselves.

MsgJp:
王子は重要人物には違いないけど
主人公は解放軍のひとりひとりだ
王子のことばかり思っちゃいられないさ
MsgEn:
The prince must be an important person, but the
hero is one of the liberation army too. You can't
think only about the prince.

MsgJp:
フィンダムの竜に起こったことを
小耳に挟んだよ
MsgEn:
I heard a rumor about what happened
to Phindym's dragon.

MsgJp:
フィンダムへ行って、話を聞いた方が
良さそうだね
MsgEn:
Sounds like it would be better to go to
Phindym and talk to them.

MsgJp:
雑談は苦手でな
――悪いな
MsgEn: I'm not good at chit chat.—sorry.

MsgJp:
言わなかったかな――
わたしは楽しい雑談相手ではない
MsgEn:
Did I not say it? - I'm not a fun person
to chat with.

MsgJp: 人からは見下されるくらいが丁度良い――
MsgEn:
Being looked down upon by others is
just about right.

MsgJp:
わたしなりの哲学だが、理解者は少ない
おまえはどうだ？
MsgEn:
My own philosophy, but few people understand it.
What about you?

MsgJp:
わたしの両親は性格が昼と夜――空と海ほどに
性格が違う人たちだった
MsgEn:
My parents were people whose personalities were
as different as night and day— as different as
the sky and the sea.

MsgJp:
わたしは母とうまが合ったが
はて昼だろうか夜だろうかと時々思うのだ
MsgEn:
I get along with my mother but sometimes I wonder
if we're just day and night.

MsgJp:
苦難が我々を結びつけたことは否定しない
苦難が我々を強くしたことも否定はできない
MsgEn:
I do not deny that suffering has brought us
together. I cannot deny that suffering
has made us stronger.

MsgJp:
しかし――この状況に意味があるとすれば
それくらいだと思わないか？
MsgEn:
However, if there is any meaning to this
situation, wouldn't it be something like that?

MsgJp: ああ、用件を聞こうか
MsgEn: Let's hear what you have to say.

MsgJp:
用がすんだら国へ帰れ
今の我々には監視すら負担になる
MsgEn:
When you finish your task, you can go back to
your country. It's too much work for us now to
even keep an eye on you.

MsgJp:
風が吹いてきた――
これは追い風だ――ああ、感じるぞ
MsgEn:
The words of Master White Dragon—I cannot let
even a single word pass me by.

MsgJp:
将軍が戻ってから流れが変わったな
そういう人なんだよ、あの人は
MsgEn:
The flow has changed since the general returned.
That's the kind of person he is.

MsgJp:
ジリアンはうまく立ち回っているだろうか
交渉上手というわけではないからな――
MsgEn:
I wonder if Gillian is standing up to it well.
She's not exactly a great negotiator.

MsgJp:
王子が盗賊の世話になるとはね
将軍も心中穏やかではないだろうな
MsgEn:
I can't believe the prince is in the care of
bandits. I'm sure the general is
not at peace with that.

MsgJp:
盗賊たちの受け入れ準備をした方が
よいのだろうか――
MsgEn: Should we prepare to receive the bandits?

MsgJp: どうだ？　少しは陣が明るくなったか？
MsgEn:
Well? Has the situation in the camp
improved a bit?

MsgJp:
ネド王子は、自分の身は自分で守ると
頑なだがそうはいかない
MsgEn:
Prince Nedo said he would protect himself.
He's stubborn, but it doesn't work that way.

MsgJp: あんたたちも力を貸してくれ
MsgEn: Please lend me your strength as well

MsgJp:
このティネスの守りを固めるべきか
それとも強固な砦を求めて
遠征すべきか――
MsgEn:
Should we fortify the defenses of Fort Thines, or
should we go on an expedition searching for
a stronger fortress-?

MsgJp: ふむ、将軍と相談してみようか
MsgEn: Hmm, let's consult with the general.

MsgJp: しばらく兵の増強は難しいだろう
MsgEn:
It will be difficult to reinforce the
troops for a while.

MsgJp:
となれば、今いる兵たちの配備を
工夫して難局を乗り切らなければな
MsgEn:
Then, we'll have to get through the harsh
situation by devising a way to deploy
the troops we have now.

MsgJp: １人、３人と兵が増えていく
MsgEn:
The number of soldiers is increasing, one by
one, and three by three.

MsgJp:
日々、少しずつではあるがネド王子を慕って
民たちが集まってくるんだ
MsgEn:
Every day, little by little, the people
gather around Prince Nedo.

MsgJp:
イェルハルドがいるから抜かりはないと
思うが陽動部隊の連中はちゃんと食事を
とっているだろうか
MsgEn:
