MsgJp:
わたしも中を調べるつもりだが
貴君も興味があれば行ってみてくれ
MsgEn:
I'm going to check inside too
if you're interested.

MsgJp:
司祭、霊廟、そしてこの《開かずの路》――
疫病と何か関係がある気がしてならない
MsgEn:
Priests, mausoleums, and this "open road" - I
can't help but think it has something
to do with the plague.

MsgJp:
貴君には手伝ってもらってばかりだな
良ければまた手を貸してくれ
MsgEn:
You've been helping me a lot.
I'd like to give you a hand again,
if you don't mind.

MsgJp:
貴君、《血すすぎ河原》のことは知っているか？
あの場所に、ひときわ体の大きなリザードマンが
棲みつくようになったのだ
MsgEn:
Have you ever heard of the "Blood Soak Riverbed"?
A very large lizardman has come
to inhabit that place!

MsgJp:
河原はテルとも近い
かの大トカゲが村人や家畜を襲う前に
退治してくれないだろうか
MsgEn:
The riverbank is also close to Tel before that
giant lizard attacks villagers and livestock

MsgJp:
――貴君、そういえば例の《開かずの路》へは
行ってみたか？
MsgEn:
By the way, have you tried going to that 'Blocked
Passage' we mentioned before, Ser?

MsgJp:
村の枯れ井戸と繋がっていたとは――
あれが、枯れていなかったらと思うと
ぞっとする話だ
MsgEn:
I didn't realize it was connected to the
village's dry well...
I'd be horrified if it hadn't

MsgJp:
たまに何やら臭うのも
おそらくそのせいだったのだな――
MsgEn:
Sometimes it smells like something, too.
Perhaps that was the reason...

MsgJp:
わたしもあの場所を調べ、手掛かりらしき
先代の手帳を見つけたのだ
もう少し調べがついたら、貴君に伝えよう
MsgEn:
I also checked that place and found a clue that
looks like my predecessor's notebook I'll pass it
on to you when I've done some more research.

MsgJp:
ああ、そう言えば！
渡したいものがあるのだ
MsgEn:
Oh, by the way!
I have something for you.

MsgJp:
貴君のためにこれを取っておいた
どうか、旅に役立ててくれ
MsgEn:
I have kept this for you, please make use
of it on your journey.

MsgJp:
貴君、ハイデルで最も危険な場所は
どこか知っているか？
MsgEn: Do you know the most dangerous place in Hidell?

MsgJp:
それは、東にある教会の地下墓地
《ハイデル地下霊廟》だ
MsgEn:
It is the underground cemetery of the eastern
church, "Hidell Catacombs."

MsgJp:
調査に向かった覚者もほとんど戻らず
さまよい出る亡者も増えたので、
ここしばらく封鎖していたんだが――
MsgEn:
Few of the Arisen who've gone to investigate have
returned and more of the departed have wandered
off, so we've been on lockdown for a while now.
And we're still here.

MsgJp:
貴君ならあの場所を調べることが
できるかもしれん
《ハイデル地下霊廟》を開放しよう
MsgEn:
You might be able to check out that place and
open up the "Hidell Underground Mausoleum!"

MsgJp:
どうするかは委ねるが
行くなら頼みたいことがある
その気があれば、あらためて話しかけてくれ
MsgEn:
I'll leave it to you to decide what to do, but
should you go, there's aught I'd
like to ask of you.
Please speak with me again if so.

MsgJp:
おお、貴君か
良い物資が手に入ったのだ
これを持って行ってくれ
MsgEn:
Oh, it's you.
I've managed to get some good supplies.
Please take this with you.

MsgJp:
テルとハイデルのため力を尽くしてくれた
貴君に、わたしもできることを探してみたのだ
MsgEn:
I wanted to do something for you in return for
all you have done for Tel and Hidell.

MsgJp:
現状手に入る最も良い支援品を
手配しておいた
貴君の恩に報いるには、とうてい足りていないがな
MsgEn:
I've arranged for the best support goods
we can currently get.
Though, I fear it is still far from enough to
repay your kindness.

MsgJp:
これからも、よろしく頼む
テルとハイデルの守り手であってくれ
MsgEn:
Please keep up the good work.
Be a defender of Tel and Hidell.

MsgJp:
よく来たな
今回の支援品だ、受け取ってくれ
MsgEn:
You've made it!
Here are the support goods. Please take them.

MsgJp:
貴君、ハイデルの街道に野盗が度々
出ることは知っているだろう？
MsgEn:
You know, my dear, that the streets of Hidell are
often riddled with wild thieves, don't you?

MsgJp:
ヤツらの名は《黒狼団》
東のアジトに居を構える盗賊集団だ
MsgEn:
Their name is the Black Wolf Bandit Group , a
bandit group that has its hideout in the east.

MsgJp:
神殿から指名手配され姿を消していた
その首領ラダンが、どうやらアジトに
戻ってきたらしい
MsgEn:
The leader, Ladan, who was wanted by the Temple
and disappeared , has apparently
returned to his hideout!

MsgJp:
連中は、高価なアクセサリーや宝飾品を
かなりの量奪っているという話だ
MsgEn:
It is said that they have stolen a considerable
amount of expensive accessories and jewelry .

MsgJp:
今や覚者隊でも騎士団でもなく、貴君が頼りだ
ヤツらの動向に目を光らせておいてくれ
MsgEn:
Now it's not the Arisen Corps or
the Knights, it's you.
Keep an eye out for them.

MsgJp:
やあ、貴君は――
ガルドリンの騒動では世話になったな
MsgEn:
Hey, you— took care of me during
the Gardolyn debacle.

MsgJp:
ところで、あの一件の裏側を
貴君はどこまで知っていた？
MsgEn:
By the way, how much did you know about the
other side of that one ?

MsgJp:
病に倒れた母親をかかえ
苦労している若い娘がいて――
MsgEn:
There's a young girl struggling with
an ailing mother...

MsgJp:
その話を聞いたガルドリンが
魔物退治を巡る賭博を思いついたらしい
もちろん、彼女に金を渡すことが目的だ
MsgEn:
Galdrin heard about it and came up with the idea
of gambling over demon slaying.
The goal, of course, is to get her the money.

MsgJp:
親子はキノザの温泉で湯治をすると
旅立っていった
もしガルドリンに会う機会があったら
わたしが感服していたと伝えてくれ
MsgEn:
The father and son took a hot spring bath in
Kinoza and left If you ever get a chance to meet
Galdrin, tell him I was impressed.

MsgJp:
エリアマスターとはこれでなかなか
難儀な仕事でな――
MsgEn:
Being an Area Master is truly no easy
task, I tell you—

MsgJp:
しかし、覚者の援助をすることで
神殿、そして白竜に貢献していると思うと
大変に誇らしい
MsgEn:
However, I am very proud to think that I am
contributing to the Temple and the White Dragon
by assisting the Arisen!

MsgJp: せいぜい、活用してやってくれ
MsgEn: Please make use of me as much as possible.

MsgJp:
貴君の活躍は
見事なものだったと聞いているぞ
MsgEn: I hear that your performance was brilliant.

MsgJp:
各地のエリアマスターも喜んでいることだろう
もちろん、わたしもだ
ごくろうだった
MsgEn:
Each Area Master in each area will be delighted,
and of course, so am I Thank you
for your hard work

MsgJp: 森の素材はいかが？

いい素材が揃ってるわ
ここにはハーブもキノコも、獣たちも
たくさんいるからね
MsgEn:
We have good materials here Herbs and mushrooms,
as well as animals, are abundant here

MsgJp:
うちではいい木材を扱ってるわよ
森がくれる一番の恵みね
MsgEn:
We deal with good lumber here It's the greatest
gift that the forest provides

MsgJp:
この村では、みんなが森の恵みを
大切にしてるのよ
MsgEn:
In this village, everyone cherishes the
gift of the forest

MsgJp:
らっしゃい！
気に入ったのがあったら
買ってってくれよな！
MsgEn:
Come on in!
If you like what you see, be sure to pick it up!

MsgJp:
森は発見も多いが危険も多い
行くなら十分準備してけよな！
MsgEn:
There's a lot to discover in the forest, but
there's also a lot of danger.
If you're going, be well prepared!

MsgJp:
動物の牙や皮、肉に関しちゃ
リンウッドが一番さ！
ここの男は全員、狩りくらいはできるんだぜ
MsgEn:
When it comes to animal tusks, hides and meat
Lynwood is the best!
All the men here can at least hunt!

MsgJp:
こないだ、リザードマンに
ケツをかじられちまってよ！
いやぁまいったまいった
MsgEn:
The other day, I got my ass chewed
out by a Lizardman !
Well, that's good, that's good, that's good.

MsgJp:
リンウッドによく来たな
用があれば言ってくれ
MsgEn:
Nice to see you in Lynwood.
Let me know if you need anything.

MsgJp:
おお、泊っていくか、だったら
<VAL PRICE_INN>だが、どうする？
MsgEn:
Oh, do you plan to stay? If you are going to
<VAL PRICE_INN>, what will you do?

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

うむ、《弱化の治療》だな
だったら<VAL PRICE_WEAK>だが、どうする？
MsgEn:
Mm, [Weakness Treatment]. Then it's <VAL PRICE_WEAK>.
What do you say?

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

だが見た所、あんたは《弱化》ではないようだ
泊ってゆっくり休むといい
MsgEn:
From the looks of it, you're not [Weakened].
Stay the night and get some rest.

MsgJp:
おお、休んでいくか？
もちろんあんたからお代を取ったりはしないよ
村にとっての大事な問題解決役だからな
MsgEn:
Oh, you want to take a break?
Of course I won't take any money from you.
You're an important problem
solver for the village.

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

村の問題はパトリシアに任せている
良ければ彼女の力になってくれないか
MsgEn:
Patricia is in charge of the village's problems.
You can help her if you'd like.

MsgJp:
ミスリウ森林は歩いたか？
西にはポーン達の聖堂《ポーン郷》
それに多くの自然洞窟や、旧時代の遺跡もある
探索場所には事欠かないぞ
MsgEn:
Have you walked through the Mysree Forest?
To the west is the Cathedral of the Pawns, "Pawn
Township" and there are many natural caves and
ruins from the olden times There is no shortage
of places to explore!

MsgJp:
ゆっくり滞在していってくれ、覚者よ
もし手すきなら、《クエストボード》にも
目を通して貰えるとありがたい
MsgEn:
Take your time and stay with
us, my learned friend.
If you are free, I would also appreciate it if
you could look over the [Quest Board] at

MsgJp:
リンウッドは木こりと狩人の村だ
森で採れる素材が必要なら
ミランダを当たるといい
MsgEn:
Lynwood is a village of lumberjacks and hunters.
If you need materials from the woods, hit Miranda.

MsgJp:
ミスリウ森林の南にぽつんと一軒家が
あるんだがな、そこには女性魔術師が
暮らしてるんだ
MsgEn:
There is a house south of Mysree forest where a
female magician lives.

MsgJp:
エメラダさんっていうんだが
もし魔術師として弟子入りを希望するなら
白鹿亭のパトリシアに認められなきゃいけないぞ
MsgEn:
Her name is Emelada.
If you want to be an apprentice sorceress, you
have to be approved by Patricia of the
White Deer Pavilion.

MsgJp:
彼女の紹介した覚者しか、エメラダさんから
魔術は習えないらしいから
MsgEn:
Because I heard that only the Arisen she
introduced me to can learn witchcraft from Ms.
Emerada.

MsgJp: 《燐光虫の洞窟》には行ったか？
MsgEn: Have you been to Glowworm Cave?

MsgJp:
危険なところなんだが、奥はまるで
星空に迷い込んだかのように美しいらしい
俺も見てみたいもんだなぁ
MsgEn:
It's a dangerous place, but I hear it's so
beautiful in the back it's like you're lost in a
starry sky I wish I could see it too!

MsgJp: やぁ、何か聞きたいことでも？
MsgEn: Hello, is there something you want to ask?

MsgJp:
ミスリウの森には、悪さを働くエイプが
何匹かいるんだ
MsgEn: There are a few bad ape's in the Misliw forest.

MsgJp:
それぞれ、唸り猿、裂き猿、豚喰い猿
ってあだ名がついててね
まぁ家畜は攫うわ狩人は襲うわ
やりたいほうだいでね
MsgEn:
They were nicknamed roaring monkeys, ripping
monkeys, and pig-eating monkeys , respectively.
Well, they kidnap livestock and attack hunters
as much as they want.

MsgJp:
やつらの縄張りは、廃屋が目印だ
臭ったり気味悪いところは注意した方がいい
MsgEn:
Their territory is marked by abandoned houses.
You should be careful where it
smells or looks creepy.

MsgJp:
オークだ戦争だって、悲観したって
どうにもできないしね
ま、なるようになるわよ！
MsgEn:
It's orcs, it's war, it's pessimism.
And there's nothing we can do about it.
Well, it's going to happen!

MsgJp:
難しい顔してるわね、考え事？
気にしない気にしない！
MsgEn:
You look so difficult. Are you thinking?
I don't mind, I don't mind!

MsgJp:
騎士様、覚者様！　頼りにしてるんだから
ほんとよ、ほんと！
MsgEn:
Dear knight, dear Arisen!　I'm counting on you.
Really, really!

MsgJp: あっはは！　こんにちは！

こないだ、でかい木を切り倒そうとしたら
突然そいつが動き始めてなぁ！
MsgEn:
The other day I was about to cut down a big tree
and all of a sudden it started moving!

MsgJp:
エントだよ、エント！
あれは腰を抜かしたよ
MsgEn:
It's an Ent, an Ent!
That scared the hell out of me

MsgJp:
前に、外の川で水浴びしてたんだ
そしたらいつの間にか周りはリザードマン
だらけでなぁ！　ホント肝を冷やしたよ
MsgEn:
I was outside taking a dip in the river and
before I knew it, there were Lizardmen all around
me!　It was really chilling!

MsgJp:
孫のエコールは働き者のいい子なんだが
外へ出たがっててなぁ
危険な目に合わんか心配だよ
MsgEn:
My grandson, Ecole, is a good, hard-working kid,
but he wants to go outside.
I'm worried he's in danger.

MsgJp: おう、なんだい旅人さん

森の奥にはいつの時代のか分からん
古い遺跡があるんだよ
MsgEn:
In the depths of the forest, there is an ancient
ruins from some unknown era

MsgJp:
《古の祭祀場》と呼ばれててなぁ
いったい何のための場所なんだろうなぁ
MsgEn:
It's called the "Ancient Ritual Site".
I wonder what on earth it's for?

MsgJp:
そういえば以前、祭祀場の方から
ものすごい地響きがしたことがあったな――
何が起こったかは知らんが
MsgEn:
You know, I once heard a tremendous ground
shaking from the ritual hall— I
don't know what happened.

MsgJp:
この見張り塔登ってみた？
景色が綺麗だよ！
MsgEn:
Have you tried climbing this watchtower?
The view is beautiful!

MsgJp:
そのうち、あちこち旅をしたいの
この村も好きだけど、他の土地を自分で見て
歩いてみたいんだ
MsgEn:
One of these days I'd like to travel around I
love this village, but I'd like to see the rest
of the land for myself and walk around it.

MsgJp:
マハル達、かくれんぼが大好きでさ
わたしも遊ぶんだけど面白いよ！
森を知らないひとがやると迷っちゃうけどね
MsgEn:
Mahal and his friends love to play hide and seek.
I play too and it's fun!
If you don't know the forest,
though, you'll get lost.

MsgJp: こんにちはっ！

うん？　覚者か
任務で来たのか？
MsgEn: Hm?　You're a Arisen or on a mission?

MsgJp:
たまに森の獣や魔物が村のすぐ近くまで
来ることがある、十分気をつけろよ
MsgEn:
Sometimes forest beasts and monsters come very
close to the village, be very careful!

MsgJp:
われわれ白衛騎士団は、各地の衛兵として
大陸全土を守っている
MsgEn:
We, the Knights of the White Guard, protect the
entire continent as the local guards.

MsgJp: ここはミスリウ森林の村、リンウッドだ
MsgEn: This is the village of Linwood in Mysree Forest.

MsgJp:
森には様々な魔物がいるが
中でも多いのは森小人――
フォレストゴブリン達だ
MsgEn:
There are many different kinds of monsters in the
forest, but the most common are the "little
men of the woods"...
forest goblins.

MsgJp:
村の北東には、やつらの群れる
《森小人の集落》がある
できるだけ近づかんようにな
MsgEn:
To the northeast of the village, there is a
"forest dwarves' village" where they are huddled
Stay away from them as much as possible!

MsgJp:
ねぇねぇ、こないだぼく見たんだよ！
すっごい大きなエント！！
MsgEn:
Hey, hey, I saw something the other day!
A very big entry!

MsgJp:
見張り塔から眺めてたらほんとにいたんだ
でもそのあとどこかいっちゃって――
ホントだよ、ホントに見たんだって！
MsgEn:
I was looking at it from the watchtower and
it was really there.
But then it went away...
It's true, he really saw it!

MsgJp:
なぁ、村からずーっと離れた滝の近くに
古いお墓があるんだ
村のお墓でもないし、誰のお墓なんだろ
MsgEn:
Hey, there's an old grave near the waterfall
that's a long way from the village It's not a
village grave, and I wonder whose grave it is.

MsgJp:
ねぇ、神殿から来たんでしょ！？
いいなー、ぼくも行ってみたいな！
MsgEn:
Hey, you came from the temple!
I wish I could go there!

MsgJp: えっ、なぁに？

わたしねー、大きくなったら
魔法使いになるの！
MsgEn: I'm going to be a wizard when I grow up!

MsgJp:
ねぇねぇ聞いて、前に森の家に住んでる
綺麗な女の人とお話したんだよ！
魔法使いなんだって！
MsgEn:
Hey hey listen, I talked to a beautiful woman who
lives in a house in the forest before!
She said she's a magician!

MsgJp: 今日はかくれんぼしないのかなー、マハル達
MsgEn:
Aren't we playing hide-and-seek today,
Mahal and the others?

MsgJp: こんにちは、旅人さん！

エコール姉ちゃんとよく森に行くんだ！
姉ちゃん、ウサギより足早いんだぜ！
MsgEn:
I often go to the woods with my sister Ekor!
My sister is faster than a rabbit!

MsgJp:
へっへー
前にこっそり《燐光虫の洞窟》まで
いったんだぜ！　怒られちゃったけどな
MsgEn:
Hehehe I sneaked up to the Cave of the
Phosphorescent Worms once
before!　I was pissed, though.

MsgJp:
オレも早く一人前の狩人になるんだ
リンウッドの男だからな！
MsgEn:
I'll be a full-fledged hunter soon.
I'm a Lynwood man!

MsgJp: えっ、オレになんか用？
MsgEn: Huh, do you need something from me?

MsgJp: 白竜さまのご加護があらんことを
MsgEn: May the blessing of the White Dragon be upon you

MsgJp: リムの輝きは常に貴方と共に
MsgEn: Even now, the Rift's glow shields you.

MsgJp:
メンバーの再編をお考えでしたら
なんなりと
MsgEn:
If you are thinking of reorganizing your party
members, please do not hesitate to ask.

MsgJp: 旅の同伴者をお求めですか？　覚者様
MsgEn:
Are you looking for a travel
companion, Ser Arisen?

MsgJp:
ミスリウ一帯の案件なら
私が預かっているわ
MsgEn:
If you're looking for a case in the Mysree area,
I can take care of it.

MsgJp:
リンウッドは深部の森やその周辺とも
昔から交流があるの
MsgEn:
Lynwood has a long history of contact with the
deep forest and its surroundings.

MsgJp:
ポーン郷のカミュ様やエメラダには
よくお世話になってるしね
MsgEn:
Camus and Emerada of the Pawn Cathedral have
taken good care of me.

MsgJp:
洞窟や奥地に行く時は気を付けてね
トロールやエントと出くわしたら大変よ
MsgEn:
Be careful when you travel to the
caves and backcountry.
If you run into a troll or an ent,
there will be trouble.

MsgJp:
森が危なくなって、木材の調達も
難しくなってきたわ
MsgEn:
The forests have become more dangerous, and it's
getting more difficult to gather wood.

MsgJp:
もう知ってるかもしれないけど
《辺境の礎》っていうのが各地に
設置されることになったでしょう
MsgEn:
You may already know that something called
Subcrystal is going to be
installed in various places

MsgJp:
今回、ミスリウの《辺境の礎》全てが
使えるようになったのよ
このことをぜひ貴方にも知らせておこうと思って！
MsgEn:
This time, all of Mysree's "Sub-Portcrystals" are
now available I thought I'd let
you know about this!

MsgJp:
森の中は入り組んでいるから
迷いやすかったり移動に時間がかかりがちだけど
これで少しは楽になると思うわ
MsgEn:
The woods are so convoluted that it's easy to get
lost or take a long time to get around.
I think this will make things a little easier.

MsgJp:
ちょうどいいところに来てくれたわ！
貴方に相談したいことがあったの
MsgEn:
You've come just in time!
There's something I needed to
speak with you about.

MsgJp:
リンウッドからミスリウ森林深部に行く
一本道があるでしょう
その途中に、"子攫いのメリーティア"と呼ばれる
ナイトメアが巣食ってしまったの
MsgEn:
There's a single road that leads from Lynwood to
the depths of Mysree Grove.
A nightmare known as "Maritia the Kidnapper" has
taken up residence along that road.

MsgJp:
ナイトメアの中でも凶悪な個体で
生半可な腕では近付くことすらできないのよ
お願い、貴方に退治を頼めないかしら
MsgEn:
It's the most vicious of the nightmares and with
my lacking skill, I can't even get close to it.
Please, can you help me get rid of it?

MsgJp:
退治してくれるなら出発前に
私に話しかけてちょうだい
くわしく説明するわ
MsgEn:
If you want to exterminate them, talk to me
before you leave and I'll explain more.

MsgJp:
そうそう、貴方に伝えようと思っていたことがあるの
森の中にある遺跡《ミスリウ古墳墓》の封鎖を
解くことにしたのよ
MsgEn:
That's right, I've been meaning to tell you.
I've decided to unseal those ruins in the forest,
the "Mysree Mysree Barrow".

MsgJp:
以前から歴史研究のために解放を
望む声があったんだけど、万が一のことを考えると
封鎖しておかざるをえなかったのよね
MsgEn:
There have been continued calls to release it for
historical research, but not knowing what could
occur, we had to keep it sealed off.

MsgJp:
けど、今は貴方という頼もしい覚者さんが
ミスリウに寄ってくれることだし
この機会にと思ってね！
MsgEn:
But now that a reliable Arisen such as yourself
will be stopping by Mysree, I couldn't
miss this opportunity!

MsgJp:
うーん、覚者さん――
ちょっと相談してもいいかしら
MsgEn: Hmmm, Arisen— Could I speak with you a moment?

MsgJp:
実は、この前封鎖を解いた
《ミスリウ古墳墓》についてなんだけど
さっそく問題が起こっちゃって――
MsgEn:
Actually, about the Mysree Barrow that was
unsealed recently, a problem has
occurred right away...

MsgJp:
あの古墳墓に入った歴史家が
魔物に襲われたらしいんだけど
どんな魔物なのかすらわからないの
MsgEn:
It seems that the historian who entered that
ancient burial mound was attacked by enemies, but
we don't even know what kind of enemies they are

MsgJp:
このままじゃ謎を抱えたまま
あの古墳墓をもう一度
封鎖しないといけなくなるわ
MsgEn:
If we leave it like this, we will have to seal
that ancient burial mound again while
still having this mystery

MsgJp:
貴方の力で何とかならないかしら
調査を頼めるようなら、くわしく
説明するから、もう一度私に声をかけてね
MsgEn:
I wonder if it's possible to solve
this with your power?
If I can ask you to investigate, I will explain
in detail, so please talk to me again

MsgJp:
いつもリンウッドを助けてくれてありがとう
この森の住人を代表してお礼を言うわ！
MsgEn:
Thank you for always helping Lynwood.
I thank you on behalf of all the
residents of this forest!

MsgJp:
私も、もっと貴方の力になりたいんだけど
物資での支援くらいしかできないから――
MsgEn:
I'd like to help you more, too, but I can only
help you with supplies at

MsgJp:
せめてもの気持ちとして、もっといいものを
揃えられるように手配しておいたの
役立ててくれると嬉しいわ
MsgEn:
At the very least, I've arranged to have
something better I hope it helps!

MsgJp:
リンウッドの皆がこうしてられるのも
貴方のお陰よね
MsgEn:
Thanks to you, everyone in Lynwood is able
to do this

MsgJp:
私にできることなんてたかが
知れてるだろうけど、何とか恩返しするわ！
だから、今後ともよろしくね
MsgEn:
I know there's not much I can do but I'll try
to repay you somehow!
So keep up the good work!

MsgJp:
貴方の活躍、噂になってるわよ！
はい、今回のお礼
ぜひまたお願いね！
MsgEn:
Your achievements are being talked about!
Yes, as thanks this time Please let
me rely on you again!

MsgJp:
村の仕事を手伝ってくれて、ありがとう
何かお礼しないとね
MsgEn:
Thank you for helping with the village's work, I
have to thank you for something

MsgJp:
来てくれてありがとう！
これ、リンウッドのみんなで少しずつ
出しあって買ったの
MsgEn:
Thanks for coming!
We all paid a little for this one.

MsgJp: みんなからの、日ごろの感謝の印よ
MsgEn: It's a symbol of our daily gratitude to everyone

MsgJp:
ねぇ、これ、貴方に使ってもらおうと
思ってとっといたの
少しは何かの役に立つかしら
MsgEn:
Hey, I saved this for you.
I hope it's of some use.

MsgJp:
こんにちは
私はエリアマスターのパトリシア
よろしくね
MsgEn:
Hello. I'm Patricia, the Area Master. 
Nice to meet you.

MsgJp:
このミスリウ一帯は、木々が密生しているから
迷わないように注意してね
特に道から外れた時はカンに頼らず
かならず地図を確認するのよ
MsgEn:
This area of Mysree is densely wooded so be
careful not to get lost; 
especially if you are off the path. 
Don't rely on your instincts,
always check the map!

MsgJp:
それと、すこしミスリウ森林の
現状について共有しておくわね
MsgEn:
Also, I'd like to share a bit about the current
status of in the Mysree Forest.

MsgJp:
白竜様の力が衰えてから
森のいたるところで魔物や獣たちが
凶暴化してきているの
MsgEn:
Since the Lord White Dragon's power waned,
monsters and beasts everywhere in the forest have
become more ferocious.

MsgJp:
今は、各所で起こった異変に
順番に対処するしかないという状況よ
特に、洞窟や水辺には注意して
MsgEn:
Right now, we're just dealing with the anomalies
that have occurred in various places in turn.
Be especially careful in caves and near water!

MsgJp:
あと、あなたが信頼できる人だって
分かったら紹介したい人もいるんだけど――
それは、あなたの活躍を見てからに
させてもらうわ
MsgEn:
I also have some people I'd like to introduce you
to if I find out that you're someone I can trust—
I'll let you do that after I see
how well you're doing.

MsgJp:
あ、そうだ
これ使って、大した物じゃないけど
MsgEn:
Oh, yeah.
Use this. It's not much, but...

MsgJp: 村の仕事を手伝ってくれて、ありがとう
MsgEn: Thank you for helping with the village's work.

MsgJp:
あなたのサポートができるよう
物資面で支援するわね
MsgEn:
I'll be happy to assist you with supplies 
to support you.

MsgJp:
さっそくだけど、問題発生よ
リンウッドの北東にフォレストゴブリン達の
集落があるのは知ってる？
MsgEn:
Quickly, we have a problem.
Did you know there is a settlement of forest
goblins northeast of Lynwood?

MsgJp:
その《森小人の集落》で、連中の首領を
見かけたって報告があったの
MsgEn:
I got a report that I saw the head of them in
that "forest dwarves' settlement".

MsgJp:
森小人の長、《緑鬼グリッガ》
前はもっと森の奥地にいたはずなのに
MsgEn:
Chief of the Forest Dwarfs, "Griga the Green
Demon" He used to be in a more
secluded part of the forest.

MsgJp:
もし見かけたら、先手を打てないかしら
貴方にも気をつけておいてほしいの
MsgEn:
If I see you, I'll see if I can get a head start.
I want you to keep an eye out too.

MsgJp:
良い所に来たわね！
《西ミスリウ橋》の修繕がようやく終わったの
MsgEn:
You've come to the right place!
The repairs to the West Mysree Bridge
are finally finished.

MsgJp:
これも、あなたが村の問題解決を
手伝ってくれたお陰よ
ポーン郷との行き来が楽になるんじゃないかしら
MsgEn:
This is all thanks to you helping solve the
village's problems I'm sure it will make it
easier to get to and from Pawn Cathedral.

MsgJp:
橋さえ通れれば、わざわざリム転移を
使うほどの距離でもなくなるからね
MsgEn:
If you can cross the bridge, you won't have to
use Rift Teleport for such short distance.

MsgJp:
貴方に言おうと思ってたことがあったの
村の北東、川沿いに《リンウッド地下水路》
っていう旧時代の水路があるのよ
MsgEn:
I was going to tell you about something there is
an old time waterway along the river northeast of
the village called the Lynwood Underground Canal

MsgJp:
リザードマンが多くて危険だから、
入口を閉鎖してたんだけど、どういうわけか
行商人が入ってしまって――
MsgEn:
There are so many Lizardmen that it's dangerous,
we had to close the entrance, but somehow the
peddlers got in and—

MsgJp:
私が掛けていた鍵が、市販品だった
からかしら――
MsgEn:
I think it was from where the lock I was hanging
was a commercial one—I don't know.

MsgJp:
救援要請があってすぐ水路に向かったん
だけど、もう姿が見えなくてね
もしかしたら近くに居るかもしれないから
少し気にしておいてほしいの
MsgEn:
I went to the canal as soon as I got the call for
help but I can't see him anymore so maybe he's
around I just want you to keep an eye out for him.

MsgJp: 結局彼ら、どうなったのかしら――
MsgEn: I wonder what happened to them in the end?

MsgJp:
貴方の活躍、噂になってるわよ！
これからもお願いね！
MsgEn:
Word is getting out about your success!
Keep up the good work!

MsgJp:
物資の支援くらいしか報いられないから
私の方でも別の品が手に入らないか
当たってみたの
少しでも助けになればいいんだけど
MsgEn:
I can only repay with support for supplies When
I'm not other stuff in my own way I tried hitting
it If I can help even a little bit

MsgJp:
そうだわ！
ちょうど貴方に紹介したい人がいるのよ
MsgEn:
Yes!
I have someone I want to introduce to you

MsgJp:
その人の名はエメラダ
リンウッドの南、《森の一軒家》にいる女性よ
MsgEn:
Her name is Emerada.
She's a woman living in the south of Lynwood, in
the "Lone House in the Forest."

MsgJp:
彼女は私の友人なんだけど
実は、彼女は神殿では非公式の職
《ソーサラー》の師でもあるの
MsgEn:
She's my friend, but unofficially also mentors as
a Sorcerer at the temple.

MsgJp: 私が見込みがあると思った覚者をたまに紹介しているの貴方なら、きっと魔術を良い事に使ってくれる――そう思ってね
MsgEn:
Occasionally, I recommend those
Arisen I find promising.
You'd use magick for good— that's why I chose you.

MsgJp:
ちょっとまずい状況になったの
森に、腐肉が散乱する廃屋がいくつか
あるのは知ってるかしら
MsgEn:
I'm in a bit of a bad situation I wonder if you
know that there are some abandoned houses in the
forest that are littered with carrion.

MsgJp:
あそこはそれぞれ、凶暴なエイプ達の縄張りに
なっててね――
だいぶ前に追い払ったのだけど
いつの間にか戻ってきたらしいのよ
MsgEn:
Each of those places has become the turf of the
vicious apes — we chased them away a long time
ago, but they've been back for some time now.

MsgJp:
猿達は、それぞれ
《唸り猿》《裂き猿》《豚喰い猿》って
呼ばれてるわ
MsgEn:
The monkeys are called "snarling monkeys,"
"ripping monkeys," and "pig-eating
monkeys," respectively.

MsgJp:
森に３か所ある廃屋が彼らのねぐらだから
近くを通る時は注意して
村のみんなにも伝えなきゃ
MsgEn:
There are three abandoned houses in the forest
that serve as their nests, so be careful when
passing by , and make sure to let
everyone in the village know

MsgJp:
――ちょっと聞いてくれる？
《ミスリウ鍾乳洞》っていう、この森で最も深く
危険な巨大洞窟があるんだけど
MsgEn:
—Can I have your attention, please?
There is a huge cave called "Mysree Limestone
Cave", the deepest and most dangerous
cave in this forest.

MsgJp:
少し前からその周辺で、恐ろしい獣の
唸り声や地響きがするようになってね
MsgEn:
Not long ago, I started hearing the roar of a
terrible beast in that neighborhood,
and the earth shaking.

MsgJp:
調査に行ってくれた騎士団が
まだ戻らないのよ――
MsgEn:
The Knights who went to investigate still
haven't come back...

MsgJp:
神殿にも救援要請を出しているんだけど
覚者隊はオークとの戦いでなかなか
手が回らないらしくて
MsgEn:
I've also sent a request for help to the Temple,
but the Arisen Corps is having a hard
time fighting the orcs.

MsgJp:
そこで、相談なんだけど
貴方に確認を頼めないかしら
お願い――、力を貸してちょうだい
MsgEn:
So, I was wondering if I could ask you to
check please—help me out.

MsgJp:
リンウッドの皆がこうしていられるのも
貴方のお陰よね
MsgEn:
Everyone in Lynwood is alive and well
because of you

MsgJp:
私にできることなんてたかだか
知れてるだろうけど、何とか恩返しするわ
補給支援の仕入れ、張り込んだんだから！
MsgEn:
There's not much I can do you know, but I'll
return the favor somehow.
I've stocked up on supply
support and staked it out!

MsgJp:
今後ともよろしくね
ミスリウの勇者さん
MsgEn:
Keep up the good work.
Mysree's Braveheart

MsgJp: 貴方にお願いしたいことがあるの
MsgEn: I need you to do something for me.

MsgJp:
――《古の祭祀場》
あの遺跡に、森にいるのとは異なる
エントが出るようになったらしいの
MsgEn:
――[Ancient Ritual Ground] It seems that Ents have
started appearing in that ancient ritual site,
different from those in the forest.

MsgJp:
――悪いことの前兆でなければ
いいんだけど
MsgEn: —if it's not a sign of bad things, it's fine.

MsgJp:
少し気になることがあるの
あなたに詳しい調査を頼めないかしら
準備ができたら、もう一度声をかけてちょうだい
MsgEn:
I'm a little concerned about something I wonder
if I could ask you to do some further research
When you're ready, give me a shout again.

MsgJp:
小さな村だが、旅の準備くらいは整えられる
必要なことがあれば言ってくれ
MsgEn:
It's a small village, but I can at least get you
ready for your trip.
Let me know if you need anything else.

MsgJp:
休んでいくか？
谷道は慣れないうちは堪えるだろう
MsgEn:
You want to take a break?
The valley road will take some getting used to.

MsgJp:
ここは他の村との行き来が厳しくてな
物資の補給も思うようにいっていない
MsgEn:
It's hard to get to and from the other villages
here and supplies are not coming in as
fast as we would like.

MsgJp:
もし手伝ってもらえるなら、奥にいる
ヘイデンに話を聞いてみてくれ
MsgEn: If you can help, talk to Hayden in the back.

MsgJp:
休憩なら
<VAL PRICE_INN>いただくが、どうする？
疲れは溜めないほうがいいぞ
MsgEn:
If you need a break, I'll take
<VAL PRICE_INN>, what do you say?
You better not be tired.

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

《弱化の治療》なら
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>いただこう、どうかね？
MsgEn:
I'll take <VAL PRICE_WEAK> for the "weakening
cure", how about that?

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

うむ、《弱化の治療》は不要のようだな
必要になればまた言ってくれ
MsgEn:
Mm, looks like you don't need the "weakening
cure" Let me know if you need it again.

MsgJp: ジンゲンへようこそ、旅の方

ああ、休憩なら空いてるベッドを好きに使うといい
ここが何とかやれているのもお前さんの
おかげだからな、休むかね？
MsgEn:
Oh, and if you need a break, you can
use any available bed.
The only reason this place is still going
strong is because of you.
Want to take a break?

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

ジンゲンへようこそ
――こんな状況になっても
ここを気にかけてくれるとは
MsgEn:
Welcome to Jingen —I'm so glad you care about
this place even in this situation.

MsgJp:
ここは魔物も出るし、何より不便だ
どこか平穏に暮らせる場所に引っ越したい――
そう言い続けて、結局ジンゲンで人生を
終えることになるなんて
MsgEn:
This place has monsters and is inconvenient above
all.
I want to move somewhere where I can live
peacefully...
I can't believe I kept saying that and ended up
ending my life
in Jingen.

MsgJp:
年寄りが騒いだところで
何も変わらんよ
どうなろうと、静かに待つしかない
MsgEn:
No matter how much the elderly complain, nothing
will change Whatever happens, all we
can do is wait quietly

MsgJp:
ここまで来て疲れたろう
せめて旅立ちの時間まで
ゆっくり休んでいくといい
MsgEn:
I'm sure you're tired after coming all this way
at least until it's time to leave
to get some rest.

MsgJp: 村から見えるドリード城、あなたは行った？
MsgEn:
Have you been to Dreed Castle visible
from the village?

MsgJp:
私のいい人もあそこに行ってるんだ
財宝を見つけるまで戻らないって息巻いてね――
MsgEn:
My good friend also went there I won't go back
until I find the treasure, they
said with determination—

MsgJp:
しっかりお金を貯めて、店と家を大きくするの！
うーん、でもここ、お客さん少ないのよね
MsgEn:
I will save money and expand the shop and house!
Hmm, but there aren't many customers here

MsgJp:
あーあ、あの人早く戻らないかしら
私が稼ぐから、財宝なんかいいのに
MsgEn:
Oh, I wonder if that person will come back soon I
earn money, so I don't care about treasure

MsgJp:
はぁい、いい取引をしましょう！
できればなるべくたくさんね
MsgEn:
Yes, let's make a good transaction!
As much as possible, please

MsgJp:
あの空を見た？
――もう時間がないみたい
取引できるかぎり、取引しましょう！
MsgEn:
Did you see that sky?
—Seems like there's no time left Let's make
transactions as much as possible!

MsgJp:
色んな夢があったの
お金を貯めて、この店を大きくして
その頃にはドリード城から
私のいい人も帰ってきて――
MsgEn:
I had all kinds of dreams to save up money and
make this place bigger and by that time, my good
man from Dreed Castle came back and—

MsgJp:
ここまできたんだもの
最後まであの人を待ち続けるわ
MsgEn:
We've come this far.
I'll wait for that guy until the end.

MsgJp:
もしかしたら、お金を集めても
もう意味が無いかも知れないけど――
MsgEn:
Maybe raising money for doesn't mean anything
anymore—but—I'm not sure.

MsgJp:
あんたもモノ好きね
こんなとこ、何しに来たの
MsgEn:
You like things too.
What are you doing here?

MsgJp: ふー、だるいわね

散策場所、多いでしょ、ここ
地下墓地とか遺跡とか
MsgEn:
There are a lot of places to explore, right here
, like catacombs and ruins.

MsgJp: あんた、全部行くの？
MsgEn: Are you going to go all of it?

MsgJp: うん、何？

そういえばさ、怖い話があったっけ
村の北に《歌姫の崖座》っていう
場所があんの
MsgEn:
You know, there's a scary story about a place
north of the village called "The
Cliff Seat of the Diva"

MsgJp:
恐ろしげな女の声が響いた時
外に出てた村人――半分くらいが
「持って行かれた」んだってさ
MsgEn:
When the scary woman's voice sounded the
villagers who were outside—about half of
them—were "taken away."

MsgJp: 相当前の話らしいけどさ
MsgEn: It seems to be a story from a while ago.

MsgJp:
いたたたた――！　こ、腰がっ！
くそ、キノザの湯にさえ行ければ――
MsgEn:
Ouch!　My back!
Damn, if only I could get to
Kinoza's hot spring...

MsgJp:
うーむ、どっかにいい薬はないものか
腰さえ治れば谷を降りるんだがなぁ――
MsgEn:
Hmmm, I wonder if there is a good medicine
somewhere If only my back would heal, I'd
be down the valley...

MsgJp:
景色は良いんだが、いかんせん
ジンゲンは道が険しいだろう
どうにもそれがなぁ
MsgEn:
The scenery is nice, but I can't help but think
Jingen will be a steep road I can't help
but think that's it.

MsgJp: あぁ、いたた！　腰に響く
MsgEn: Ah, that hurts! It's throbbing in my back.

MsgJp:
いやぁ、なかなかうまくいかねぇぜ
目当ての品を探すにも、収穫ナシの日が
続くと酒がまずくならぁ
MsgEn:
Well, it's not going so well.
Even if you're looking for something you're
looking for, a day without a harvest can make
your drink go bad...

MsgJp:
ハーピーの野郎――いや、女ども！
頭の上をギャーギャー飛びまわって
うるさくてかなわねぇや
MsgEn:
Harpy's - no, women!
They're flying around on my head
making so much noise!

MsgJp:
登ってる時に限って襲って
きやがるしよぉ！
MsgEn: They attack me only when I'm climbing !

MsgJp:
たまーに渓谷で、でかい魔物を見かけるんだよな
さすがに避けて通るが、ぶっ倒したら
見返りもでかそうだよな
MsgEn:
Sometimes in the canyon, I see a big demon.
I avoid it, as I should, but if I knock it down,
the payback seems to be huge too.

MsgJp: とはいえ、命あっての物種っつーしな
MsgEn: However, life is what we make of it.

MsgJp: おう！　何か用か

《ドリード監視塔》は知ってっか？
何十年か前、白騎団の駐屯所だったらしいが
完全な廃墟だぜ
MsgEn:
Do you know about the Dreed Watchtower? It seems
like it used to be the barracks of the White
Knights several decades ago, but now it's
just a complete ruin.

MsgJp:
ま、それなりに使えるものは残ってそう
だけどな
あの野郎――いや、ギャーギャー喚く
鳥女どもが邪魔しやがるが！
MsgEn:
Well, it looks like there's still some usable
stuff left but that bastard - no, the gawking
bird women are getting in the way!

MsgJp:
魔物の警戒は白騎団が常に行っている
覚者隊に応援を要請する必要はない
MsgEn:
The White Knights are always on the
lookout for monsters.
There is no need to request support
from the Arisen Corps.

MsgJp: 今の所はな

北のバートランド平原は、オーク共の根城に近い
このダウ渓谷にも斥候が入り込むかもしれん
MsgEn:
The Betland Plains to the north are close to the
orcs' stronghold Scouts may enter this
dhow valley as well.

MsgJp: お前達も気をつけろ

ドリード城は、元は白騎団の本丸だったと聞く
白竜様がお元気で、レスタニアが今よりも
開かれていた時代のことだ
MsgEn:
I hear that Dreed Castle used to be the main
castle of the White Knights when the White Dragon
Lord was in good health and Lestania was more
open than it is now.

MsgJp: 今や魔物の巣窟らしいがな
MsgEn: Now I hear it's a den of monsters.

MsgJp: 特に問題はない

村近くの《白砂河原》には
サルファーリザードが多く棲みついている
お前が覚者なら、軽くまとめて退治しておいて
ほしいものだ
MsgEn:
The White Sand Riverbanks near the village is
home to many Sulphur Lizards.
If you are an Arisen, I hope you can kill
them all in one piece.

MsgJp: 白竜様のご加護があらんことを
MsgEn:
May the blessings of The White Dragon
be with you, Arisen.

MsgJp: リムの輝きは常に貴方と共に
MsgEn: Even now, the Rift's glow shields you.

MsgJp:
メンバーの再編でしたら
私にお申し付けください
MsgEn:
For party member reassignments, I'd be honored to
receive your orders.

MsgJp: 旅の同伴者をお求めでしょうか、覚者殿
MsgEn:
Are you looking for a traveling
companion, Master Arisen?

MsgJp:
この関所から北は《バートランド平原》だ
本関所はグリッテン砦の管理下にあるが
ダウのエリアマスター、ヘイデン殿が認めた者は
通してもよいと言われている
MsgEn:
North of this gateway is the Betland Plain.
This gateway is under the control of Fort
Gritten, but Dowe's Area Master, Hayden, allows
those who have been approved to pass.

MsgJp:
俺は鼻がいいほうでな
オークの臭いが強まればすぐ砦に連絡する
MsgEn:
I have a good nose.
If the smell of orcs intensifies, I'll call
the fort right away.

MsgJp:
俺は関所番であることに誇りを感じている
砦より薄くとも、ここは北の地に対する
守りの要なのだ
MsgEn:
I feel proud to be a barrier guard even if
thinner than a fortress, this is the Portcrystal
of defense against the land of the north.

MsgJp: ああ、覚者隊の者か

この関所の通行許可を得た隊士は
バートランド平原の任務も行うことに
なるだろう
MsgEn:
The troopers who are granted passage through this
barrier will also be performing duties
on the Betland Plain

MsgJp:
その際、《グリッテン砦》西側通路の
通行許可も同時に出されるのだ
覚えておくといい
MsgEn:
At that time, you will also be given permission
to pass through the west corridor of "Fort
Gritten" at the same time.
Remember that

MsgJp:
ああ、覚者様！！
あなたのお力をお貸しいただきたい事が――！
MsgEn:
Oh, Arisen!
I have something I need your help with—!

MsgJp:
ジンゲンの上、崖を登ったダウで最も標高の
高い所に《歌姫の崖座》と呼ばれる場所が
あるのですが――
MsgEn:
Above Jingen, at the highest elevation on the
dhow up the cliffs, there is a place called "The
Cliff Seat of the Diva"

MsgJp:
例の魔鳥、《妖歌のローレライ》が
今度こそ本当に姿を現したのです！！
MsgEn:
The demon bird, "Lorelei the Spectator," has
really shown itself this time!

MsgJp:
ジンゲンの民半数を攫い
相当数の覚者と騎士が命を落とし
ようやく撃退した、かの魔物が！
MsgEn:
Half of the people of Jingen were kidnapped, a
considerable number of Arisen and knights lost
their lives, and the demon was finally repelled!

MsgJp:
覚者様にばかり頼ることはできませんが
もし可能であれば――どうか！
依頼を引き受けていただきたいのです
MsgEn:
I can't rely on the memorandum of understanding
all the time, but if it is possible—please!
I would like you to accept my request.

MsgJp:
あなたさまがジンゲンに掛けて下さる
お心遣いの数々――
感謝してもしきれません
MsgEn:
I can't thank you enough for all the kindnesses
that you hang on Jingen...

MsgJp:
あなたこそまさに
白竜様が我々に遣わして下さった恵みです
MsgEn:
You are truly the blessing that the White
Dragon has sent to us!

MsgJp:
比べられるものではありませんが
我々にできる精一杯の礼を用意しました
ジンゲンの民は、あなたと共に
MsgEn:
It's nothing to compare.
We have prepared the best thank you we can.
The people of Jingen are with you.

MsgJp:
あなたさまが村に滞在されるようになって
民の表情も明るくなったかのようです
MsgEn:
Since you have been staying in our village it
seems as if the people's faces have brightened!

MsgJp:
どうか、これを――
そして今後もよろしくお願いいたします
MsgEn: Please let this be— and keep up the good work!

MsgJp:
村の依頼を引き受けて下さり
ありがとうございます
心ばかりですが、我々からの礼でございます
MsgEn:
Thank you for accepting the Village's request
It's a small gesture of gratitude from us!

MsgJp:
いつも懇意にして下さるあなたさまに
何かできることはないかと思い
我々でこれを用意いたしました
MsgEn:
We thought it would be nice to do something for
you, our ever loyal friend and we have
prepared this for you.

MsgJp: いつでもあなたを歓迎いたします

たびたびご足労をお掛けします
ねぎらいとなるか分かりませんが
これを用意いたしました
MsgEn:
Thank you for your frequent visits I don't know
if this is a compliment, but I have
prepared this for you.

MsgJp: どうかお受け取りください

谷道は厳しかったでしょう
つまらぬ物ですが、こちらは立ち寄って
いただいたお礼です
MsgEn:
Must have been tough on the valley roads.
Boring stuff, but here's a thank
you for stopping by and

MsgJp:
遠路はるばるようこそ
ダウ渓谷へはどのような？
MsgEn:
Welcome to the long way to What is it like to
visit the Dowe Valley?

MsgJp:
美しい渓谷に針葉樹林
ドリード城の佇まい――
MsgEn:
Coniferous forests in a beautiful valley The
appearance of Dreed Castle...

MsgJp:
ダウ渓谷は美しい土地です
どうかジンゲンのため、あなたさまのお力を
お貸し下さい
MsgEn:
The Dowe Valley is a beautiful place Please help
us help you for the sake of Jingen!

MsgJp:
谷山の上には、チェスターという青年が
一人で暮らしています
MsgEn:
On top of the valley mountain, a young man
named Chester lives alone

MsgJp:
相当の変わり者ですが、軽業の技術で
右に出る者はいません
MsgEn:
Quite a strange one, but you'll find no one more
skilled in acrobatics!

MsgJp:
あなたが渓谷を愛する方であれば
あの者と気が合う事でしょう
MsgEn:
If you love canyons, you two should
get along well.

MsgJp:
滝の水音に薄い雲、豊かな緑
魔物の脅威さえなければ、ここは実に
穏やかな村なのですが
MsgEn:
The sound of waterfalls, sparse
clouds, and lush greenery.
Were it not for the threat of the monsters, this
would be a truly peaceful village.

MsgJp:
ようこそいらっしゃいました
お伝えすべきことがあるのです
MsgEn:
Welcome!
There is something I must tell you.

MsgJp:
このダウ渓谷に置かれた《辺境の礎》が
全てあなたさまのために解放されました
MsgEn:
The "Sub Portcrystals" placed in this Dowe Valley
have all been released for you!

MsgJp:
この辺りでのあなたさまの格別の働きを
神殿が評価しての配慮とのことです
MsgEn:
I'm told that this is a consideration in
recognition of your exceptional work in
this area by the Temple.

MsgJp:
どうぞ、これを機会に
この美しいダウ渓谷の自然を
すみずみまでご覧ください
MsgEn:
Please take this opportunity to visit and to see
every detail of this beautiful Dowe Valley nature!

MsgJp:
ああ、覚者様！
どうかお力をお貸しください――
ジンゲンの村の危機なのです
MsgEn:
Oh, Ser Arisen!
Please help us— It is a crisis in
the village of Jingen!

MsgJp:
実は、少し前から外で遊んでいた子供が
行方不明になる事件が相次ぎました
MsgEn:
In fact, there has been a spate of missing
children who have been playing outside
for a little while now!

MsgJp:
たまりかねた親たち、年かさの兄弟たち
さらには居合わせた旅の方までが
何人も連れ立って捜索へと旅立ったのですが
ついに一人も戻らず――
MsgEn:
Unable to bear it, the parents and older siblings
and even some travelers who were there set off to
search with a number of others, but finally
none of them returned...

MsgJp:
そして先日、カタコンベ近くで
何体もの石像が発見されました
生生しい、何かから逃げ惑うような姿勢のものが――
MsgEn:
Then, the other day, near the catacombs...
Numerous stone statues were discovered.
Lifelike figures, as if fleeing from something.

MsgJp:
あれは捜索に出た者たちが
石にされたものではないでしょうか――
この村に大きな脅威が迫っているのではと
気が気ではありません
MsgEn:
Could it be that those who went on the search
were turned into stone?
I can't help but feel that a great threat is
looming over this village.

MsgJp:
覚者さま
あの辺りに危険な魔物が潜んでいないか
一度調査していただけないでしょうか
何卒ご一考のほどを――
MsgEn:
Dear Arisen, Could you please investigate once to
see if there are any dangerous monsters
lurking in that area.
Please give it some thought--

MsgJp: 覚者様、実は――

以前、ガーゴイルの群れを討伐してくださった
場所の近くに《見捨てられた井戸》が発見されました
MsgEn:
An "Abandoned Well" has been discovered near the
location where you previously took down
a herd of gargoyles!

MsgJp:
まるで中から逃げ出そうとしているような姿勢の
石像も一緒に見つかったのです
MsgEn:
They also found a stone statue with it, in a
posture as if it were trying
to escape from inside!

MsgJp:
もしかすると、あの辺りの石像はガーゴイルではなく
井戸の中にいる何か恐ろしい魔物から
逃げようとしていたのかも知れません
MsgEn:
Maybe the stone statues in that area were not
gargoyles but were trying to escape from some
horrible demon in the well!

MsgJp:
この村の危機は
まだ去っていないのでは――
MsgEn:
The crisis in this village may not have
gone away yet...

MsgJp: 覚者様、度重なる依頼をお許しください――
MsgEn: Arisen, please forgive the repeated requests.

MsgJp:
実は、《見捨てられた井戸》に近づいた者が
井戸から人の声のような物音が
聞こえた、と申すのです
MsgEn:
As a matter of fact, someone who approached the
Abandoned Well claimed to have heard what sounded
like human voices, coming from the well.

MsgJp:
もちろん魔物の声である可能性も大いにありますが
このままでは我々も諦めがつきません
どうか、井戸の奥を確かめてきては
いただけないでしょうか
MsgEn:
Of course, it could very well be
the voice of a demon.
We are not giving up at this point.
Please, go check the depths of the well.

MsgJp:
引き受けてくださるならば、
あらためて詳しくご説明いたします
MsgEn:
If you accept, please let me know and I'll
explain it to you in more detail.

MsgJp:
あなたこそまさに
白竜様が我々に遣わして下さった恵みです
MsgEn:
You are truly the blessing that the White
Dragon has sent to us!

MsgJp:
あなたさまからの数々お心遣いによって
この村は幾度となく救われております
感謝してもしきれません
MsgEn:
Your kindness has saved our village many times
and we can never thank you enough.

MsgJp:
まだまだ至りませんが
現時点で集めうる限りの支給品をご用意いたします
ジンゲンの民は、これからもあなたさまと共に
MsgEn:
We're not quite there yet, but will provide you
with as many supplies as we can
gather at this time.
The people of Jingen will continue to be with you.

MsgJp: このあたりはすでにごらん頂けましたか？
MsgEn: Have you already seen this area?

MsgJp:
ドリード城の城下として栄えたのは
はるか昔――
MsgEn:
It flourished as the seat of Dreed Castle
a long time ago...

MsgJp:
オークどもの台頭で今や住む者も
ごくわずか――
MsgEn:
With the rise of the orcs, there are now very
few people who live in

MsgJp:
よって、このジンゲンとその周辺は
見捨てられても仕方のない地区です
MsgEn:
Therefore, this Jingen and the surrounding area
is a district that should be abandoned!

MsgJp:
しかしながら、突き放すような厳しさ――
そして険しさ故の美が入り混じる風景に心ひかれ
訪ね来る人々も少なくありません
MsgEn:
However, many people come to visit because they
are attracted by the landscape that combines the
harshness of the place - - and the
beauty of its ruggedness.

MsgJp:
そんな人々に便宜を提供することで
白竜様のお役に立とうと
我々はここに暮らし、精進しております
MsgEn:
We live here and devote ourselves to helping the
Lord White Dragon by providing
convenience to such people.

MsgJp:
わたくしはジンゲンの長――
ダウ渓谷のエリアマスター、ヘイデンと申します
どうぞお見知りおきを
MsgEn:
I am the head of Jingen— I am Hayden, Area Master
of the Dowe Valley Please get to know me.

MsgJp:
村の依頼を引き受けて下さり
ありがとうございます
MsgEn: Thank you for accepting the village's request.

MsgJp:
今後は、覚者様を物資面にて
支援させていただきます
MsgEn:
We will continue to support the
Arisen with supplies.

MsgJp:
――覚者様にお知らせすべき
ことがあるのです
MsgEn:
- There is something I should inform the
esteemed Arisen about.

MsgJp:
村から降りた川べり、《白砂河原》で
このところ、凶暴で大きなラージサルファーの
目撃が相次いでおりまして
MsgEn:
On the riverbank down from the village, the White
Sand River, there have been a number of sightings
of large, ferocious large sulphurs in recent days.

MsgJp:
《タイガーテール・サルファー》と呼び
警戒をしておりました
MsgEn: I was on guard against a "Sulfur Tiger-Tail".

MsgJp:
もし河原へ下りる時は、
十分注意なさることです
MsgEn: If you go down to the riverbank, be very careful!

MsgJp:
――地下墓地、《カタコンベ》
ドリード城近くにある地下墓地は旧時代
罪人を葬る場所であったと言われています
MsgEn:
It is said that the underground catacombs near
Dreed Castle were a burial place for
sinners in ancient times.

MsgJp:
白竜様のお力が弱まり
近年妙に瘴気が溜まりやすくなって
しまっている様子――
MsgEn:
The power of Lord White Dragon has weakened and
the strange miasma that has been accumulating in
recent years seems to have become...

MsgJp:
そこで、危険ではありますが
一度入り口を開放することにいたしました
MsgEn:
So we have decided to open the entrance once
although it is dangerous!

MsgJp:
もし、探索をされるのでしたらどうぞ
積極的に私から勧めはいたしませんが
MsgEn:
If you'd like to explore, please go to I'm not
going to actively encourage you to do so.

MsgJp:
ダウの西に、《ドリード監視塔》という
小塔があるのはご存知ですか
MsgEn:
Did you know that there is a small tower west of
Dowe called the "Dreed Watchtower"?

MsgJp:
一昔前までは、現役の騎士団詰め所でも
あった場所なのですが
今やスノーハーピーが縄張りとする危険地帯
MsgEn:
Not long ago, this was still a
functioning knights' garrison.
Now it's become dangerous Snow Harpy territory."

MsgJp:
この調子で増えられれば
いずれジンゲンにも彼女らが飛来するのは
明白です
MsgEn:
With numbers growing like this, they'll
inevitably come to Jingen - it's certain.

MsgJp:
どうか、群れの中核をなす
《スノーグーラー・ハーピー》を討伐して
くださいませんか
MsgEn:
Could you please eliminate the [Snow Glare Harpy]
that forms the core of the flock?

MsgJp:
あなた様が村に滞在されるようになって
民の表情も明るくなった気がいたします
MsgEn:
Since you came to stay with us, everyone in the
village seems much more cheerful.

MsgJp:
大した支援品ではありませんが
改善の努力をしますので
今後もよろしくお願いいたします
MsgEn:
It's not a great support item, but we
will try to improve it.
Thank you for your continued support!

MsgJp:
覚者様は、いまや相当にダウ渓谷を
よく知る方――
以前お話したとおり、ある人物を紹介
したいのです
MsgEn:
The Arisen now knows the Dowe Valley quite well...
As I told you before, I would like to
introduce someone to you.

MsgJp:
その者の名はチェスター
神殿では伝えられていない職
《シーカー》の技術に長けた若者です
MsgEn:
His name is Chester a position not handed down in
the Temple a young man skilled in the
art of the Seeker.

MsgJp:
ダガ―を駆使する素早い身ごなしと
ロープを用いた跳躍術
MsgEn:
Quick gestures using daggers and leaping
techniques with ropes

MsgJp:
その特性から、暗殺者や盗賊といった
ならず者が好む技術ではありますが
あなたであれば善く使うことができるはず
MsgEn:
Because of its characteristics, it is a technique
favored by ruffians such as assassins and
thieves, but you can use it for good!

MsgJp:
《シーカー》としてさらに腕を磨かれる時が来れば
《渓谷の一軒家》に居る青年、チェスターを
お訪ねください
きっと彼が力となってくれるでしょう
MsgEn:
When the time comes for you to further hone your
skills as a Seeker, please visit Chester, the
young man in the "House in the Valley".
I'm sure he will be able to help you.

MsgJp:
覚者様についてはすでに話を通しておきました
住居の場所については、《スポット情報》で
確認されるとよいでしょう
MsgEn:
I've already talked to you about the Arisen.
You may want to check [Spot Information] for the
location of the Arisen's residence.

MsgJp:
そろそろ切り出そうと思っていたことが
ありまして――
MsgEn: There's something I've been meaning to bring up...

MsgJp:
あなたは相当の実力をお持ちです
それは、このダウを守るためではなく
より多くの人々のため活かされるべき――
MsgEn:
You have considerable skills.
They should be put to use not only to protect
Dowe, but for the good of as many as possible.

MsgJp:
グリッテン砦の北、オークが占領する
バートランドの調査にこそ、覚者様の力が
必要であると思うようになったのです
MsgEn:
I have come to believe that it is precisely to
investigate the orc-occupied Betland, north of
Fort Gritten, that we need the help of the Arisen!

MsgJp:
もちろん、これは私の手前勝手
関所のノーメルに話を通し、バートランドへの
路を開けるよう伝えておきました
オーク侵入の危険と引き換えですが
MsgEn:
Of course, this is my own selfish I spoke to
Nommel at the customs house and told him to open
a path to Betland in exchange for the
risk of an orc invasion.

MsgJp:
《バートランド東関所》、そして
《グリッテン砦の西側通路》どちらからでも
バートランドへ行く事ができるでしょう
MsgEn:
From either the "Betland East Gate" or "The West
Passage of Fort Gritten", you can get to Betland
from either of them.

MsgJp:
先に行かれるかどうかは、お任せします
どうぞよき判断を
MsgEn:
I'll leave it up to you to decide if
you want to go ahead.
Please make a good decision.

MsgJp:
――恐れ入りますが覚者様
あなたにぜひお願いしたいことがあるのです
MsgEn:
—I'm sorry, Ser Arisen, there's something I
would like to ask of you.

MsgJp:
渓谷にある大きな自然洞
《風鳴り洞窟》のことはご存知でしょうか？
MsgEn:
Have you heard about the large natural cave in
the canyon [Wind Sounding Cave]?

MsgJp:
あそこはかつて、ある恐ろしい魔物の
住処でもあったのです
このジンゲンの民の多くが犠牲になりました
MsgEn:
There, it was once the lair of a terrifying
monster, in which many of Jingen's
people fell victim to.

MsgJp:
撃退され姿を消していたのですが
かの魔物が再来したかもしれぬとの
報せがあり、事実であれば一大事
MsgEn:
It was repulsed and disappeared, but there are
reports that the monster may have returned and if
true, that would be a big deal!

MsgJp:
申し訳ありませんが覚者様
その真偽を確かめてはいただけないでしょうか
正式に依頼いたしますので――
MsgEn:
I apologize, Arisen would you be able to
confirm its authenticity?
We will make a formal request for it...

MsgJp:
あなたさまがジンゲンに掛けて下さる
お心遣いの数々――
感謝してもしきれません
MsgEn:
I can't thank you enough for all the kindnesses
that you hang on Jingen...

MsgJp:
あなたこそまさに
白竜様が我々に遣わして下さった恵みです
MsgEn:
You are truly the blessing that the White
Dragon has sent to us!

MsgJp:
比べられるものではありませんが
我々にできる精一杯の礼を用意しました
ジンゲンの民は、これからもあなたと共に
MsgEn:
Although it cannot be compared We have prepared
our utmost gratitude that we can offer The people
of Jingen will continue to stand with you.

MsgJp:
おお、覚者様
《滅びの渦》の調査にいらしたのですか？
MsgEn:
Oh, Arisen-sama , Did you come to investigate the
'Vortex of Destruction'?

MsgJp:
数少ないジンゲンの民ですが
意外にも、あの空を恐れて
逃げだすものはおりませんでした
MsgEn:
Even though there are only a few Seekers left in
Jingen , surprisingly, none of them were
afraid of the sky and fled

MsgJp:
元より、このジンゲンを離れられぬ
愛着のある者が残っていたのでしょう
MsgEn:
From the beginning, it seems that there were some
who couldn't leave Jingen due to their attachment

MsgJp:
諦めた方が良いのやもしれません
しかし、此度もあなたさまならば
お救いくださるのではと
思わずにいられないのです
MsgEn:
It may be better to give up but again I can't
help but think that you can save us

MsgJp: あなたさまこそ、竜が遣わされた恵み
MsgEn: You are the blessing sent by the dragon

MsgJp:
どのような結果になろうとも
あなたを信じるという選択を
後悔はいたしません
MsgEn:
Whatever the outcome, I will not regret my
choice to believe in you!

MsgJp:
ボルドで採れたいい品が揃ってるよ
見てっておくれよ！
安くしとくからさ！
MsgEn:
We've got some good stuff from the
Volden Take a look!
I'll give you a discount!

MsgJp:
ねぇねぇ、知ってるかい？
キノザ鉱泉には泉質が違う３つの温泉があるんだよ
入っていきなよ、お肌スベスベになるよ！
MsgEn:
Hey, hey, did you know?
Kinoza Kosen has three hot springs with
different qualities.
Go ahead and take a bath, your skin will
be smooth and smooth!

MsgJp:
《ボルド大坑道》ってのが、山の中腹にあるのさ
巨人だかが出るってんで閉鎖されちまったが
それでも鉱石掘りにいく連中は今も多いんだよ
MsgEn:
There's a place called the Volden Large Tunnels,
located halfway up the mountain.
It was closed down because giants were appearing,
but there are still many people who
go there to mine ores.

MsgJp:
いらっしゃい！
ボルドの名産品だよ！

良い武器には良い鉱石が要る
当たり前のことだがな！
MsgEn:
Good weapons need good ore.
It's obvious!

MsgJp: 材料への妥協は出来への妥協だ
MsgEn:
Compromising on ingredients means
compromising on the outcome.

MsgJp:
お前が一流の戦士を目指すなら
武器も一流を目指せ
MsgEn:
If you aim to be a top-notch warrior, aim
for top-notch weapons.

MsgJp:
だが、肝心なのは身分相応ってやつだ
それを忘れるなよ
MsgEn:
But what's important is to know your place.
Don't forget that.

MsgJp:
命を賭けて武器を打ち、命を賭けた勇士が
それを振るう
MsgEn:
Putting your life at stake to wield your weapon,
you, the brave warrior.

MsgJp: ――フフ、これ以上のやり甲斐があろうか！
MsgEn:
Hahaha, can there be anything more
worthwhile than this!

MsgJp:
ああ、鍛冶の依頼か？
話を聞こう
MsgEn:
Oh, you're asking for a blacksmith?
Let's talk about it.

MsgJp:
覚者さん、キノザは白竜神殿ほどじゃ
ないにしろ賑やかだろ？
MsgEn:
Arisen, Kinoza is not as busy as the White Dragon
Temple, but it's still busy, right?

MsgJp:
そういうとこにゃ、商売のチャンスも
多いってことさ
MsgEn:
There are a lot of business opportunities
in that kind of place.

MsgJp:
鉱山へ行くにも森方面へ行くにも
なんせ道具は多い方がいい！
MsgEn:
Whether you are going to the mine or to the
forest the more tools you have, the better!

MsgJp:
切らしてるなら補充していきな
じゃんじゃん買ってってくれ
MsgEn: If you're out, go to and buy a bunch of stuff.

MsgJp:
大浴場のロイは、たまーに奇妙な品を
仕入れてくるんだが
一体ありゃ、どっから手に入れてるんだろなぁ
MsgEn:
Roy from the big bathhouse sometimes gets some
strange items I wonder where the
heck he gets them from

MsgJp: よお、らっしゃい！

あ、泊ってく？　だったら
<VAL PRICE_INN>よ
もちろん酒場も自由に使ってね
MsgEn:
Oh, are you staying over?
In that case, it's <VAL PRICE_INN>.
Feel free to use the Tavern as well.

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

温泉浸かってゆっくりしてさ
酒のんで楽しく休んでいくといいわよ！
山掘りも冒険者も、うちは大歓迎よ！
MsgEn:
Soak in the hot springs, relax, have a drink
and have a good rest!
Mountain diggers and adventurers are
welcome at our place!

MsgJp:
自慢の料理も食べていってね！
キノザは料理にも温泉を使ってるんだから
たっぷり元気つけてもらわなきゃ！
MsgEn:
Please try their signature dishes too!
Kinoza uses hot springs in their cooking as well.
You need to get plenty of energy!

MsgJp:
大坑道へ行くなら十分気をつけてよ
鉱石目当ての人がよく行くって言っても
全員無事だったわけじゃないからね
MsgEn:
If you're going to the big
tunnels, be very careful.
Even though people often go there for the ore,
not all of them were safe.

MsgJp:
あ、《弱化の治療》？　だったら
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>よ
大変な目にあったみたいね
MsgEn:
Ah, [Weakness Treatment]? In
that case, the price is
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>.
You seem to have had a tough time.

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

ん～、だけどあなた《弱化》じゃないわよ
ただの疲れすぎじゃないかしら
MsgEn:
Hmmm, but you're not "weakened" I think
you're just too tired.

MsgJp:
はーい、キノザ組合宿へようこそ！
ゆっくりしていってね
MsgEn:
Yes, welcome to the Kinoza Association Inn!
Please make yourself at home.

MsgJp:
あら、休んでく？　じゃあゆっくりしてってよ
宿代はタダよ、あなただけ特別なんだから！
その代わり冒険話を聞かせてね
MsgEn:
Oh, you want to take a break?　Then take your time.
The accommodation is free, you're the
only one who's special!
Tell us about your adventures in return!

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

この辺りって、毒沼やら油田やらいろいろあるでしょ
入っちゃって相当大変な目に合う人も多いのよ
MsgEn:
There are all kinds of poisonous swamps and
oil fields around here.
Many people get into a lot of
trouble if they get in.

MsgJp:
応急処置ができるよう
しっかりと準備してったほうがいいわよ
MsgEn:
You'd better make sure you're prepared
for first aid at

MsgJp:
気を付けてても
魔物にぶっとばされて毒まみれ――
とかしょっちゅうなんだから
MsgEn:
Even if you're careful, you can still get hit by
monsters and covered in poison...

MsgJp:
いやぁ～～！！
それにしても大活躍ですなぁ！
MsgEn:
Oh no!
That's still a great success!

MsgJp:
覚者様様、お陰様でキノザも
穴ぐらの面々も大助かりですよ！
MsgEn:
Thanks to you, Arisen, Kinoza and the hole in the
ground have been a great help to us!

MsgJp:
お礼はしっかりさせてもらいますんで
今後ともよしなに！
MsgEn:
I will give you a proper thanks, so please
continue to be kind!

MsgJp:
私はロイ
この鉱泉の管理とボルド地区のエリアマスターを
兼務してましてね
MsgEn:
I am Roy and I am in charge of managing this hot
spring and the Borudo area master

MsgJp:
覚者さん方には毎度ごひいき
ありがとうございます！
MsgEn:
Thank you very much for your continued
favor to the Arisen !

MsgJp:
キノザに立ち寄った際は、
ゆっくりと温泉で羽を休めて頂いて
問題解決の方、ぜひよろしくお願いしますよ！
MsgEn:
When you stop by Kinoza, please take the time to
relax and rest your wings in the hot springs and
please be the one to solve the problem!

MsgJp:
――この辺りは鉱石の一大産地
なんですが、かつての活気も坑道に出る
巨人族のせいでずいぶん落ちたものです
MsgEn:
This area used to be a major mining region, but
the energy of the past has diminished due to the
appearance of Giants in the mines.

MsgJp:
白竜様がお元気な時分は、それはもう
採掘も往来も盛んだったそうですがね
MsgEn:
When the Lord White Dragon was in good health, I
heard that mining and traffic were very active.

MsgJp:
ともあれ、レスタニアを代表する保養地
キノザの活気は巡り巡って必ずや
白竜様、神殿の皆様にとってよきお力に
なりますとも！！
MsgEn:
Anyway, the vibrancy of Kinoza, the leading
recreational area of Restania , will surely be a
great help to the White Dragon and the Temple !

MsgJp:
レオ統率やイリスさん、ヴァネッサさんにも
よろしくお伝え下さい
MsgEn:
Please send my best wishes to Leo
leadership, Iris and Vanessa at

MsgJp:
それにしても、毎度毎度
あれこれ対処頂いて！
MsgEn:
But still, every time I go to , you
deal with this and that!

MsgJp:
お手数お掛けしてる分、それなりに
応えなきゃあ、風呂番がすたるってもんです
MsgEn:
If we don't respond in a reasonable manner to the
trouble you're taking, we'll all be disappointed.

MsgJp:
いやぁ、何かと手伝ってもらってすみませんね！
助かりますよ
MsgEn:
Well, I'm sorry for all the help
you've been giving me!
I appreciate it.

MsgJp:
支援品の方、融通させてもらいますんで
今後ともよしなに
MsgEn:
I'll be happy to provide you with any
support items you need.
I look forward to working with you in the future.

MsgJp:
いやぁ、何かと手伝ってもらってすみませんね！
助かりますよ
MsgEn:
Well, I'm sorry for all the help
you've been giving me!
I appreciate it.

MsgJp: やぁ、どうもどうも覚者さん！
MsgEn: Hey there, good to see you, Arisen!

MsgJp:
覚者さんが力を貸してくださったお陰ですかね
どうも鉱泉の資源が豊かになってきた
気がしますな！
MsgEn:
Thanks to the help of the Arisen, I feel that the
resources of the mineral
springs are getting richer.

MsgJp:
よければ羽休めも兼ねて、温泉で
ゆっくりしていってくださいよ
MsgEn:
If you'd like, you can also take a break from
your wings and relax at the hot springs

MsgJp:
そうそう！
こいつを持って行ってくださいよ！
覚者さんのため、特別に用意したんですから
MsgEn:
Oh yeah!
Take this guy with you, please!
I prepared it especially for you, Arisen!

MsgJp: どうです、結構な品でしょう？

そうだ覚者さん
あなたにお話があるんですよ
MsgEn: Yes, Arisen I need to talk to you.

MsgJp:
ホボリック洞穴からダウ渓谷へ
つづく谷道のところに、《南壁のひび》って
洞窟があるのはご存知で？
MsgEn:
Hobolik Cave to Dowe Valley Did you know that
there is a cave called "Cracks in the South Face"
at the end of the valley road?

MsgJp:
そこは、中で鉱員が行方不明になるって
ことが続いて閉鎖された洞窟なんですが
私は良い鉱脈が伸びてるんじゃないかと
踏んでましてね――
MsgEn:
It's a cave that was closed after a series of
miners went missing in it.
I thought there might be a good vein
of ore growing there.

MsgJp:
何やら、洞窟内に光るものがあるとか
ないとかで――
MsgEn: Something about shiny things in the cave or not...

MsgJp:
どうです？
あなたなら行けるんじゃないですかね
探検にいっちゃみませんか
内緒で封鎖は解いておきますんで
MsgEn:
What do you think?
Maybe you can go and explore I'll break
the blockade in secret.

MsgJp:
お待ちしておりましたよ！
ささ、これをどうぞ！
日頃の礼です、道中お役に立ててくださいよ
MsgEn:
We've been waiting for you!
Here, take this!
Thank you for all you've done for us. Please
help us along the way.

MsgJp: 覚者さん、いいニュースがあるんですよ！
MsgEn: Arisen, I have some good news!

MsgJp:
ダウ渓谷とボルド鉱山地区を繋ぐ谷道――
《南壁谷》を塞いでた土砂が、ようやく撤去できた
そうでして！
MsgEn:
The valley road connecting the Dowe Valley and
the Volden mining district— The earth and sand
that had been blocking the "South Wall Valley"
has finally been removed And so it was!

MsgJp:
まぁ、《採掘師の隠れ道》を使えば通れはしますが
鉱員でもなければ
あんな危ない道は使いたくありませんからな
MsgEn:
Well, you can get through if you use the "miner's
hidden path" but unless you're a miner you don't
want to use that dangerous path.

MsgJp:
ともあれ、これでダウ渓谷方面、ジンゲン村との
行き来ができるようになりますな
MsgEn:
Anyway, we now have access to Dowe Valley and to
the village of Jingen.

MsgJp:
それにしても、毎度毎度
あれこれ対処頂いて！
MsgEn:
But still, every time I go to , you
deal with this and that!

MsgJp:
お手数お掛けしてる分、それなりに
応えなきゃあ風呂番がすたるってもんです！
MsgEn:
If we don't respond in a reasonable manner to the
trouble you're taking, we'll be
stuck with the bathtub!

MsgJp:
またまた融通させてもらいますんで
今後ともよしなに
MsgEn:
I'll be happy to accommodate you again.
I look forward to working with you in the future.

MsgJp:
よろしければこれをどうぞ
今日は来場者に粗品をお渡ししてるんです
MsgEn:
If you'd like, here it is: We're giving away some
roughage to visitors today.

MsgJp:
今日は覚者さんに、またまた折り入って
相談があるんですよ――
MsgEn:
Today I have another folded consultation with a
memorandum of understanding—.

MsgJp:
実はね、白騎団のかたがたに
討伐要請を出していた厄介なオーガ
《坑道荒らし》ってのがいるんですが――
MsgEn:
As a matter of fact, there is a nasty ogre that
the White Knights have been asked to take
down, the Tunnel Thief...

MsgJp:
どうも騎士さん達の手には負えないようで
むしろ、騎士さん側の被害が増えてるって
状況なんですよ
MsgEn:
In fact, the knights are seemingly unable to
handle the situation, and the
casualties keep mounting.
I'm hearing that's where things stand.

MsgJp:
キノザの西、ボルド小坑道近くの
《山腹の野戦場》で、件のオーガを
やっつけちゃくれませんかね
MsgEn:
Can you please kill the ogre at the "hillside
field" near the Volden small
tunnels, west of Kinoza?

MsgJp:
しかし、オーガも前はもっと山間に
いたってのに、どうしてふもとの方へばかり
降りて来るんでしょう――迷惑な話ですよ
MsgEn:
But why do they keep coming down to the foothills
when the ogre used to be more
mountainous - it's annoying!

MsgJp:
おお、今日は大きなお知らせが
ありますよ！
MsgEn: Oh, we have a big announcement today:

MsgJp:
このボルド鉱山一の大坑道、
《ボルド大坑道》の出入り口を塞いでいた
ガレキが撤去できたんです！
MsgEn:
We were able to remove the debris that was
blocking the entrance and exit of the Volden
Tunnel, the largest tunnel in the Volden Mine!

MsgJp:
これでまた、採掘に再開発も
捗るってもんです！
MsgEn:
This will also allow for
redevelopment progress in mining!

MsgJp:
――とはいえ、元は巨人が現れた
衝撃であちこち崩落したって話です
サイクロプスやなんかが棲みついてる
可能性も――
MsgEn:
—However, it's said that originally there were
Giants who appeared and caused various collapses.
There is also a possibility that a Cyclops or
something similar is inhabiting there.

MsgJp:
そこで覚者さん、ボルドのために一肌
脱いで頂けませんかね
巨人がいないか、一通り奥まで様子を
見て来てもらいたいんですよ
MsgEn:
So, Arisen, could you please take off some skin
for Volden and go to the back to see if there
are any Titans there.

MsgJp:
引き受けてくださるなら
あらためて私にお声掛けを！
MsgEn:
If you would like to take it on, please
contact me at again!

MsgJp:
いやぁ～～！！
それにしても大活躍ですなぁ！
MsgEn:
Oh no!
That's still a great success!

MsgJp:
覚者さまさま、お陰様でキノザも
穴ぐらの面々も大助かりですよ！
MsgEn:
Thanks to you, Arisen, Kinoza and the
hole-in-the-wall guys have been a big help!

MsgJp:
お礼はしっかりさせてもらいますんで
今後ともよしなに！
MsgEn:
I will give you a proper thanks, so please
continue to be kind!

MsgJp:
ああ覚者さん、覚者さん！
またちょっとした問題がありましてね
MsgEn:
Oh, Arisen, Arisen!
We're having a little problem again.

MsgJp:
ムジナ団――だったかな？
ボルド鉱山のふもとに、盗賊たちが
住処にしてる坑道があるんですよ
MsgEn:
The Mujina group - I think it was?
There's a tunnel at the foot of the Volden Mine
where the bandits make their home.

MsgJp: その名もずばり、《盗賊の隠れ家》！
MsgEn: The name of the house is "Thieves' Hideout"!

MsgJp:
前に騎士さんが連中を追いたてた後に
表に出られないよう入り口を塞いで
鍵を預けてくれたんですけどね、
どうもそれが壊されたようで――
MsgEn:
After the knight chased them off before, he
blocked the entrance to prevent them from getting
out and left me a key, but
apparently it was broken...

MsgJp:
我がもの顔で暴れてる奴らの隠れ家に
乗り込んで、一つ懲らしめてやってくださいよ
MsgEn:
Please go to to the hideouts of those who are
raging against themselves and punish
them one by one!

MsgJp:
ヤツら、金目の装身具をずいぶん
略奪してるみたいで、鉱泉の客足にも
響くってもんです
MsgEn:
They seem to be looting a lot of gold-grained
trinkets , which will affect the number of
visitors to the mineral springs

MsgJp:
うーむ困ったことになったんですよ
覚者さん！

ボルド鉱山の頂きに、祠があるのはご存知で？
その祠――《山頂の小堂》付近が
グリフィンの巣になってましてね
MsgEn:
Did you know that there is a shrine at the
top of the Boldt Mine?
That shrine - near the small hall at the top of
the mountain is a Griffin's nest.

MsgJp:
グリフィンがしばしばそこで羽休めをしてたん
ですが、特に厄介なグリフィンが
舞い戻ってきたんですよ！
MsgEn:
Griffins often rested their wings there , but one
particularly nasty griffin came back !

MsgJp:
覚者さん、どうかそのグリフィンを
追い払っちゃくれませんかね？
また、詳しくは追って説明しますんで
MsgEn:
Arisen, can you please get rid of that griffin?
I'll explain the details later.

MsgJp:
当鉱泉はお客様の需要にあわせ
３つの浴場を用意してますよ
MsgEn: We have three bathhouses at to meet your needs!

MsgJp:
どうぞ、ごゆるりと
それぞれのお湯を楽しんでください！
入場キーは受付けのルーシーが販売しております
MsgEn:
Please relax and enjoy each hot tub!
Admission keys are available for sale by
Lucy at the reception!

MsgJp:
私は一応この地域の顔役もやってましてね
組合宿のリビアンともども、自治と仕事の斡旋も
引き受けてるってわけです
MsgEn:
I'm also the face of the community and the union
inn, Livian, and I also take care of the local
government and job placement

MsgJp:
キノザとボルド鉱山のため、良かったら
一肌脱いで頂けませんかね、風呂だけに！
MsgEn:
For the sake of Kinoza and Volden Mine, if you
would like to please give us a
skinful, just for the bath!

MsgJp:
実は、ちょっと私は人外方面の方とも
付き合いがありましてね
MsgEn:
Actually, I have a bit of a relationship with the
non-human side of things, too.

MsgJp:
覚者さんだったら、ご存知じゃありませんか？
穴ぐらに住んでる連中と会ったら
よろしくお伝えください
MsgEn:
If you are an Arisen person, wouldn't you know?
If you see any of the guys living in the cave,
please send them my regards at

MsgJp:
おお、いらっしゃい！
キノザとボルドに関して
私に何かご用で？
MsgEn:
Oh, welcome!
Regarding Kinoza and Volden: What can
I do for you?

MsgJp:
おお、覚者さんにお伝えしたいことがあるんですよ！
《辺境の礎》ってやつがこのボルドでも
使えるようになりましてね
MsgEn:
Oh, I have something to tell you, Arisen!
Subcrystals are now available at here in Volden!

MsgJp:
何でも、行きづらかったところに
一瞬で到着する便利な代物だとか
MsgEn:
I hear it's a convenient way to get to places
you've been trying to get to in an instant.

MsgJp:
キノザの管理者としては、ボルドにいらっしゃるなら
ぜひともこのキノザに寄って一風呂浴びていって
ほしいところですが――
MsgEn:
As the manager of Kinoza, if you're in Volden,
I'd love for you to stop by Kinoza
and take a bath.

MsgJp:
ま、任務の途中や帰りにも、疲れを癒すために
ぜひお湯に浸かっていってくださいよ！
いつでもお待ちしてますんで！
MsgEn:
Well, please visit to soak in the hot water to
relieve your fatigue on your way to
or from your mission!
We're always waiting for you!

MsgJp:
おお、覚者さんじゃないですか！
ちょうどよかった
一つ相談に乗っちゃくれませんか
MsgEn:
Oh, you are an Arisen, aren't you?
I was just in time.
Can you help me with one thing?

MsgJp:
いや、《ボルド大坑道》についてなんですけどね
せっかく再開発も軌道に乗り始めたところだってのに
最近妙な噂が立っちまって鉱員が集まらないんですよ
MsgEn:
No, I'm talking about the Boldt Tunnel.
The redevelopment is just getting back on track.
Lately there have been strange rumors and
it's hard to get miners.

MsgJp:
なんでも、骸骨騎士が坑内を歩いてる――とか
光るドクロがこっちを見てた――とか
気味が悪いでしょう
MsgEn:
Anything, a skeletal knight walking down the mine
shaft-- or a glowing skull looking at me--
or It must be creepy!

MsgJp:
多分何かの魔物がうろついてるんだと思うんですがね
覚者さん、そいつを退治してきてくれませんか
MsgEn:
I think there's probably some kind of
demon hanging around.
Arisen, can you go kill that guy?

MsgJp:
詳しくは追って説明しますんで
一度考えてみてください
このボルドの未来のためと思って、頼みます！
MsgEn:
I'll follow up with more details.
Please think about it once I'm asking you to do
this for the future of this Volden!

MsgJp:
ところで覚者さん、《ボルド大坑道》の中にある
《灼熱の封鎖道》なんですが
ご興味があったりはしませんかね？
MsgEn:
By the way, Arisen, I was wondering if you might
be interested in "Burning Blockade" in the
"Great Volden Tunnel"?

MsgJp:
いえ、というのもですね！
ああいうところには良質な鉱脈が
埋まっていることが多いんですよ
MsgEn:
No, I mean, you know!
There are often good veins of ore buried
in places like that!

MsgJp:
特に私が目を付けているのは
この辺りだけで、それもごく少量しか採れない
貴重なボルディックダイヤってやつでしてね
MsgEn:
I'm particularly interested in which is only
found around here, and only in
very small quantities.
It's called a precious bordic diamond.

MsgJp: ――あるんじゃないか、と――！

あそこは地下のマグマの活性度によって
坑内の気温がやたら上がってしまうってことで
封鎖してたんですが
今なら何とか入れる状態なんですよ
MsgEn:
The mine was closed because the activity of the
magma underground causes the temperature in the
mine to rise dramatically, but it is now in a
state where we can manage to get in.

MsgJp:
今回もこっそり封鎖を解いておきますんで
よかったら、一度中を調査してみてください！
絶対何かあると思うんですよね、あそこは――
MsgEn:
I'll be sneaking off the blockade again this time.
If you'd like, you can
investigate inside once more!
I'm sure there's something in there that--

MsgJp:
おや、ちょうどいいところに！
覚者さんにご相談したいことが
あったんですよ！
MsgEn:
Oh, just in time!
There was something I wanted to
discuss with the Arisen !

MsgJp:
実は私も《灼熱の封鎖道》に入ってみたんですがね
ボルディックダイヤどころか
ジオゴーレムを見つけてしまいまして！
MsgEn:
I actually went into the "Burning Blockade" and
found not only a bordic diamond, but a geo-golem!

MsgJp:
いやぁ、やっぱり封鎖されて長いと
ああいうのが棲みついてしまうんですねぇ
MsgEn:
Well, after all, if it's been blockaded for a
long time, that kind of thing will inhabit it.

MsgJp:
なんとか討伐をお願いできないでしょうか？
詳しくはまた追ってご説明しますので！
MsgEn:
Can you please manage to take them down?
I will explain the details as soon as possible!

MsgJp:
いやぁ～～！！
覚者さんのご活躍には
我々ただもう舌を巻くばかり！
MsgEn:
Oh no!
We at just can't get enough of your work!

MsgJp:
このキノザ鉱泉の管理者として、
そしてボルドのエリアマスターとして
ここはお礼を奮発しないとですな！
MsgEn:
As the manager of Kinoza Mineral Springs, and as
an Area Master of Voldic, we need to spare no
expense to show our gratitude here!

MsgJp:
良いものを取り揃えておきますんで
今後とも、どうぞよしなに！
MsgEn:
We will prepare good things for you so please
continue to favor us in the future!

MsgJp:
いやぁ、温泉は最高だよ！
まさに命の湯、生き返るね！
MsgEn:
Oh, hot springs are the best!
It's truly the water of life, it revitalizes you!

MsgJp:
キノザに来たら、一回はほら
行きたいだろ！？　《豊穣の泉》！！
しかしアレだよ、料金がなぁ
MsgEn:
When you come to Kinoza, you know you want to go
to at least once! You want to go to the Fountain
of Abundance at least once
when you come to Kinoza!
But that's the thing, the price.

MsgJp:
ふー、湯の後は酒場で一杯！
お陰でここを離れられないよ
MsgEn:
Whew, after the hot water, I had a
drink at the bar!
Thanks to you, I'll never leave this place!

MsgJp: やあ、何かな？

覚者がわざわざボルド地方まで任務か
まぁ、大かた温泉目当てだろう？
MsgEn:
So, the Arisen went all the way to the Volden
region on a mission.
Well, they went for the hot springs, didn't they?

MsgJp:
キノザは鉱石と武具の町でもある
白竜神殿や、我ら白騎団
それに覚者にとっても重要な拠点だ
MsgEn:
Kinoza is not only a town of minerals and
armaments, but also serves as a significant base
for the White Dragon Temple, our White Knights,
and is of importance to the Arisen ones as well.

MsgJp:
だからその、なんだ
お前ら覚者が見張りになってもいいと
思うんだがな
MsgEn:
So, you know, what the hell.
I'm sure you Arisen folks could be
on the lookout for

MsgJp:
ハインツ副団長にあったらよろしく伝えてくれ
あと、そろそろ配置変えはどうか、とな
MsgEn:
Please give my regards to Vice Commander Heinz
and also, how about changing the formation soon?

MsgJp: うん？　覚者か
ほら、向こうの山頂に祠が見えるでしょ？
MsgEn:
Look, can you see the shrine at the
summit over there?

MsgJp:
あの《山頂の小堂》は
以前は白竜様と、故人への祈りの場として
大事にされる場所だったそうです
MsgEn:
That "small hall at the top of the mountain" used
to be a place of prayer for the White
Dragon and the deceased

MsgJp:
今はちょくちょく魔物が出る上
でっかい鷲がすぐ傍に巣を作ったとかで
寄りつく人が居なくなったとか
MsgEn:
Nowadays, there are always monsters and a big
eagle has built a nest right next to it, so
there's no one left to hang around.

MsgJp: どこも大変ですよねえ

キノザは人も多いし品も豊富です
商売するにはいい土地なんですが
商売仇が多いのが玉に傷ですねえ
MsgEn:
Kinoza has a lot of people and a lot of goods.
It's a good place to do business.
It's just that there are a lot of business people.

MsgJp:
あたしにとっては、準備と勉強の場って
とこでしょうか
MsgEn: For me, the place to prepare and study is at

MsgJp:
あたしゃ、近々素材を扱う行商を
始めようと思ってるんですよ
MsgEn:
I'm thinking of starting a materials peddling
business in the near future!

MsgJp:
近くに素材を取りにいくにも
なかなかどうして魔物が厄介なんですよ
MsgEn:
It's not easy to gather materials nearby because
of those troublesome monsters.

MsgJp: いい坑道はあちこちにあるんですけどねえ
MsgEn: There are good mines everywhere, but...

MsgJp:
どうも覚者さん
あたしにご用で？
MsgEn:
Hi, Arisen.
You wanted to see me?

MsgJp:
ふー、遠出したいけど勇気がでなくて――
強い護衛を雇うしかないかなぁ
MsgEn:
Whew, I want to go away, but I'm not brave
enough-- I guess I'll just have to
hire a strong escort.

MsgJp:
ゴツゴツした岩みたいな鬼やらトカゲやら
外にはうようよ居るっていうじゃないか
あわわわ
MsgEn:
There are rough-looking monsters or lizards or
something like that, and they say that there are
a lot of them outside.
Ahh...

MsgJp:
よ、よしリンウッドまで行くぞ！
そ、そのうちに――
MsgEn:
Alright, let's go to Lynwood!
And, eventually--

MsgJp: や、やぁ、何か用？
MsgEn: Um, um, do you need something?

MsgJp:
そ、そういえばさ
キノザからちょっと山の麓へ下りて
北に行ったところに《ボルド小坑道》って
場所があるのは知ってるかい？
MsgEn:
Oh, by the way, did you know that there is a
place called "Volden Narrow Tunnels" north of
Kinoza, a little down the foot of the mountain?

MsgJp:
そこはかなり前から怖いオーガがうろつく
ようになったんたけど、派遣された騎士団が
かなりやられちゃったらしいんだ！
MsgEn:
There has been a scary ogre roaming around there
for quite a while now, but the knights who were
sent there got hit pretty hard, I heard!

MsgJp:
戦いの跡がまだ残ってて、《山腹の野戦場》
なんて呼ばれているよ
ううう、おそろしい――！
MsgEn:
There are still battle scars and it's
called [Fieldsides of the
Mountainside] Ugh, horrifying--!

MsgJp:
ふう、貴重な宝石の原石を探しに
ここへ来たのだけれど、魔物が邪魔で
なかなか思うように探せないわ
MsgEn:
I came here to look for precious gemstones, but
the monsters are in the way and I can't find them
as easily as I'd like.

MsgJp:
ねぇあなた、《ボルド大坑道》へは行った？
閉鎖されてから、中はどうなっているのかしら
MsgEn:
Hey, have you been to the Volden Tunnel?
I wonder what's going on in there
since it was closed.

MsgJp:
巨人出現って、サイクロプスかコロッサス
でも出たのかしら
MsgEn:
Giants appeared, were there also
Cyclops or Colossus ?

MsgJp:
魔物の中には、宝石を身体に生やした
ステキな生き物もいるそうなの
MsgEn:
It seems that among the enemies there are also
creatures with gems growing on their bodies like

MsgJp:
まるで宝石そのもの、みたいな魔物も
いるらしいわ
MsgEn:
They say there are monsters that look
just like real gems.

MsgJp: なんとか生け捕りにできないかしら
MsgEn: I wonder if they can be captured alive somehow

MsgJp: その様子、あなたも探索者かしら？
MsgEn: Are you also an adventurer exploring this place?

MsgJp:
ここは《癒しの泉》です
ゆっくり旅のお疲れを癒してくださいね
MsgEn:
This is the "Spring of Healing" Please relax and
heal your fatigue from your journey

MsgJp:
浴場では、ミックスハーブの蒸気も
炊いているんですよ
MsgEn: In the bath, we are also steaming mixed herbs

MsgJp: ごゆっくり
《癒しの泉》のお湯はいかがですか？
MsgEn:
How about the hot spring water at the
"Spring of Healing"?

MsgJp:
ふー、いいお湯！
のぼせないようにしないとねぇ
MsgEn:
Whew, nice hot water!
I'll have to try not to get bloated!

MsgJp:
あんた、異国の覚者なんだろ！？
あのタラスクの討伐してきてくれないかい？
MsgEn:
Are you an Arisen from a foreign land?!
Would you be willing to vanquish
the Tarasque for us?

MsgJp:
引き受けてくれるなら
タラスクの居場所を知ってる子に話を通すから
あたしに話しかけておくれ
MsgEn:
If you're willing to take on the task, I'll have
a conversation with the child who knows the
whereabouts of the Tarasque.
Please speak to me.

MsgJp:
ああ、よく来たね！
あんたがタラスクを退治してくれたおかげで
地鳴りも聞こえなくなったよ！
MsgEn:
Ah, you've come! Thanks to you for defeating the
Tarasque, we can no longer hear the
rumbling of the land!

MsgJp:
最近色んなことが起こるから
うちの戦士たちも疲れててさ――
あんたに助けてもらえて、本当に感謝してるよ
MsgEn:
Lately, so many things have been happening, and
my soldiers are tired... I really
appreciate your help.

MsgJp:
武勇の恩には報いるのが
このダナのならわしだよ！
支援品を格上げしておいたから
またいつでもダナに顔見せにきとくれ！
MsgEn:
It is our custom to repay the debt of bravery.
I have upgraded the support goods for you.
So please feel free to come and show your
face in Dana anytime!

MsgJp:
また困ったことが起きたよ――
こんなに問題が起きるなんて
一体フィンダムはどうしちまったのかね
MsgEn:
Another problem has occurred - I never thought so
many issues would arise.
What on earth happened to Phindym?

MsgJp:
実は、また地鳴りがするようになったんだ
あんたにタラスクを退治してもらったはずなのに
おかしいだろ？
MsgEn:
Actually, the ground is shaking again.
We asked you to defeat the Tarasque, didn't we?
Something's not right.

MsgJp:
あの地鳴り――タラスクのものじゃなかったのかねぇ
もうあたしらには見当もつかないよ
MsgEn:
That shaking ground... it wasn't caused by
the Tarasque, was it?
We have no idea anymore.

MsgJp:
――このファーラナ平原のはずれ
《<SPOT 904>》に、異文化を持った村があるんだ
そこの住人なら何かを知っているかも――
MsgEn:
At the outskirts of the Farana Plains, there's a
village known as <SPOT 904>, inhabited by people of
a different culture.
Those villagers might know something...

MsgJp:
でも、あそこの住人、どうもダナの人間が
嫌いみたいで交流が難しいんだよねぇ――
MsgEn:
But it seems like the people living there really
don't like the residents of Dana, so it's
difficult to interact with them.

MsgJp:
ねぇ、もしよかったらあんたが探りを
入れてきてくれないかい？
通りかかったらでいいからさ
MsgEn:
Hey, if you don't mind, could you do
some probing for me?
If you happen to pass by, that would be great.

MsgJp:
ああ――そういえば、あんた
《マヌンの集落》に顔出してくれたんだろ？
MsgEn:
Ah, by the way, didn't you show up
in Manun Village?

MsgJp:
あそこの長老のエナン――とか
いう人から手紙が届いたんだ
MsgEn:
I received a letter from the elder of
that place, Enan.

MsgJp:
なんでも
「信頼に値する相手だと証明してくれ」
「そのために《<SPOT 901>》
　の魔物を倒してくれ」ってことらしいよ
MsgEn:
It seems they want you to 'prove yourself as a
trustworthy ally.' You can do that by
'defeating the monsters in
<SPOT 901>,' according to the villagers.

MsgJp:
要するに、武勇を見せろってことさ――
マヌンの住人たちって、もしかしたら
あたしらと似た文化を持ってるのかもね
MsgEn:
In short, they're telling us to show our bravery,
you know? The residents of Manun might actually
have a similar culture to ours.

MsgJp:
まぁ、とにかくそういうことなんだ
彼らに"信頼に値する相手"だって証明するため
魔物退治に行ってくれる気になったら
また声かけておくれよ
MsgEn:
Well, anyway, that's how it is.
In order to prove that we are "trustworthy
allies" to them, if you ever feel like going on a
monster extermination, please let us know again.

MsgJp:
そうそう、あんたが
《マヌンの集落》のエナン爺さんに
聞いてきてくれた《知恵の小塔》なんだけどさ
MsgEn:
Oh, that's right. You brought me info about the
Small Tower of Wisdom that you asked Enan from
Manun Village about, didn't you?

MsgJp:
なんでも、あそこに収められた昔の本に
今度こそ手がかりがあるかもっていうから
封鎖を解くことにしたんだ
MsgEn:
Because there might be a clue in the old books
stored there, we decided to lift
the blockade this time.

MsgJp:
今、手の空いてる子たちに
本を漁らせてるところさ
MsgEn:
Now, I'm letting the children who have free
hands search for books.

MsgJp:
古臭い本以外にも色々ありそうだから
あんたも入りたかったら入っていいよ
何か見つけたら、好きに持って帰りな
MsgEn:
Besides old-fashioned books, there seem to be
various other things here.
If you want to join, you're welcome to.
If you find something you like, feel
free to take it home.

MsgJp:
まぁ、わかってるとは思うけど
本の持ち出しは禁止させてもらうけどね
MsgEn:
Well, I think you understand, but I have to
prohibit taking books out.

MsgJp:
ああ！
何だってあんたはいつも
村が危ないって時に来てくれるんだろうね？
MsgEn:
Ah!
Why is it that you always come when the village
is in danger, I wonder?

MsgJp:
実は今、大変なのさ
タラスクみたいな巨大な動くものを
見たって報告があってね――
MsgEn:
Actually, right now things are tough.
There have been reports of a gigantic moving
creature, like a Tarasque.

MsgJp:
最悪、すぐにでも村ごと別の場所へ
移動しなけりゃ踏み潰されちまうかもしれない
そうなったら、あんたにも
手を貸してもらうかも――
MsgEn:
At worst, we may need to move the entire village
to a different location immediately, or else
we might be crushed.
If that happens, I may ask for
your help as well...

MsgJp:
とにかく今は情報を集めることで
手一杯なんだ
何か用があるなら、改めて話しかけてもらえるかい
MsgEn:
Right now, I'm really busy gathering information.
If you have something to discuss, could you
please talk to me again later?

MsgJp:
あんたのお陰で地鳴りも止んで
平和な生活が戻ってきたよ
ずいぶん世話になったね！
MsgEn:
Thanks to you, even the earthquakes have stopped,
and peace has returned to our lives.
We are truly grateful for all your help!

MsgJp:
まだまだ侵食魔はウロウロしちゃいるけど
ダナは戦士の村だ
そこら辺にいる侵食魔くらい、痛くもかゆくもないさ
MsgEn:
The corrupting monsters are still lurking around,
but Dana is a warrior's village.
The infected around here are nothing
to be worried about.

MsgJp:
侵食と地鳴り――
二つの厄介ごとを抱えてたこの村に
手を貸してくれてありがとう
MsgEn:
Corruption and Earthquakes - Thank you for
lending a hand to this village
burdened with two troubles.

MsgJp:
これほど力を貸してもらったんだ
エリアマスターとして
それからダナの族長ピサルの女房として
あんたには十分なお礼をしなきゃならない
MsgEn:
I've received so much help.
As an Area Master, and also as the wife of
Pisarr, the chief of Dana, I must express my
gratitude to you properly.

MsgJp:
とりあえず、あんたへの支給品に
より一層良いものを揃えるってことは
決まってるんだけど――
MsgEn:
For now, it has been decided to gather even
better supplies for you, but...

MsgJp:
それ以外に、どんなお礼をしようか
迷ってるところなんだよ
何せ、この恩を返せるようなお礼なんて
中々思い浮かばないもんだからさ！
MsgEn:
Apart from that, I'm at a loss as to what kind of
gratitude I should express.
After all, it's not easy to come up with a way
to repay this favor!

MsgJp:
まぁ、これからもダナには寄るんだろ？
勇敢な戦士として、いつでも迎えるからさ
お礼についても追々考えていくことにしようか――
MsgEn:
Well, I guess I'll continue relying on Dana from
now on, right?
As a brave soldier, I'll always be there to
welcome you.
Let's think about the expression of gratitude
little by little as well.

MsgJp:
あんた、覚者ってなら竜のために戦うんだろ？
エモノは一体何なんだい？
大剣？　それとも弓？
MsgEn:
Hey, if you're an Arisen, then you fight
for the dragons, right?
So what exactly are those?
Are they like greatswords or bows?

MsgJp:
もしもあんたがそこそこ槍を使えるようなら――
いつか、精霊槍の達人に紹介してやってもいいよ
レスタニアには精霊槍を扱う戦士は
いなさそうだからね
MsgEn:
If you're reasonably skilled with a spear, then
someday I could introduce you to a master
of the Spirit Lance.
There don't seem to be any soldiers in Lestania
who handle Spirit Lances, you see.

MsgJp:
戦士に休息の場を提供するのがわしの仕事だ
宿の手配から弱化回復まで、何でも言ってくれ
MsgEn:
It is my job to provide a place
of rest for warriors.
From arranging accommodations to weakening
recovery, tell me anything you need.

MsgJp:
勇猛な戦士にも休息は必要だ
必要な時に必要なだけ休まねばならん
MsgEn:
Even a brave warrior needs rest.
You must rest as much as
necessary, when necessary.

MsgJp:
寝床を使うなら<VAL PRICE_INN>貰うことになるが
いいか？
MsgEn:
If you use the bed, you will have to pay <VAL PRICE_INN>
gold, but are you okay with that?

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

見ての通り、今は空いている
よし、好きな寝床を使うといい！
MsgEn:
As you can see, it is currently vacant.
Alright, you should use whichever
sleeping spot you like!

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

戦って、一時の休息を楽しむ――
そしてまた戦いに出る！
どうだ、これこそ戦士として理想の生活だろう
MsgEn:
Fight, and enjoy a momentary rest-- And then, go
forth to battle again!
How is it? This is surely the ideal life as
a Soldier, isn't it?

MsgJp:
《弱化の治療》なら
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>必要だが――
MsgEn:
If it's [Weakness Treatment], it's <VAL PRICE_WEAK>.
What do you want to do?

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

ハッハッハ！
弱化にはなっていないようだ
弱気にはなっているようだがな
MsgEn:
Hahaha!
You don't seem to have weakened.
You seem to have become more timid, though.

MsgJp:
わしも今は引退してのんびりしているが
鍛練は怠っていないぞ
MsgEn:
I am also currently retired and enjoying a
leisurely life, but I have not
neglected my training.

MsgJp:
――まずは身の証を立ててから
来るべきじゃないのか？
MsgEn:
First, shouldn't we establish our
credibility before we come?

MsgJp:
身の証を立てる前に
休息を取りたいというなら
そりゃ、かまわんが――
MsgEn:
Before proving your innocence, if you wish to
take some rest, Well then, it's fine...

MsgJp:
ハーイ、色々揃えてるわよ
どうぞ見て行ってね
MsgEn:
Yes, I have various things.
Please feel free to take a look!

MsgJp:
ピサルとラザネイル、素敵でしょ？
ああいう夫婦が理想なのよね
MsgEn:
Pisarr and Razanailt, aren't they wonderful?
That's the ideal kind of couple.

MsgJp:
たくさん覚者がいたら
一人一人が受けられる竜力が少なくならない？
何人もの覚者より、強い覚者が一人いた方が
安心できると思うんだけど
MsgEn:
If there were many Arisen, wouldn't the Dragon
Force that each one can receive be diminished?
I think it would be more reassuring to have one
strong Arisen than a number of Arisen.

MsgJp: あれ？　何も買っていかないの？

あ――もしかして、騒ぎになってた
異国の覚者さん？
MsgEn:
Oh, are you the Arisen from the foreign land that
caused all the commotion?

MsgJp:
――まずは身の証を立ててから
買い物しに来てくれるとうれしいわ
ちょっと信用できないもの
MsgEn:
--First, I would be happy if you could prove your
identity before shopping. I can't
trust you that easily.

MsgJp:
や、やぁ――
クレストのことかな？
MsgEn: Ah, um... Is it about Crests?

MsgJp:
クレストっていうのは、装備に付けられる
特殊な力の結晶らしいよ
僕は管理を任されてるだけなんだけど――
MsgEn:
Crests are apparently crystals that can be
attached to equipment, possessing special powers.
I'm just in charge of managing them...

MsgJp:
僕は子供の頃から線が細くて
戦いでも狩りでも中々手柄を上げられなくて――
MsgEn:
Since I was a child, I have always been frail,
unable to achieve any remarkable feats
in battles or hunts...

MsgJp:
なんて、よそから来た人には
この気持ち、わからないよな
MsgEn:
Oh, someone who comes from elsewhere would never
understand this feeling.

MsgJp:
戦いよりもこういうことの方が向いてるだろうって
ピサルからこの仕事を任されたんだ
自分でもそう思うよ
MsgEn:
I was entrusted with this job by Pisarr, who
believed that I was more suited for something
like this than for battle.
I think so too.

MsgJp:
――だけど、イーヴィの好みは
"誰よりも強い男"なんだよなぁ
MsgEn:
But Evey's preference is for a 'man stronger than
anyone else,' you know.

MsgJp:
あの――
身の証を立ててから来てもらえないかな
こういうのって信用が大事だからさ
MsgEn:
You know, it would be great if you could come
after proving yourself.
Because trust is important in
situations like this.

MsgJp:
戦いに行くの？
パーティの編成なら私がお手伝いするわ！
MsgEn:
Are you going to the battle?
If you need help with party
formation, I can assist you!

MsgJp:
力強く、信頼できる仲間と集まることで
一人ひとりの戦士の働きもよくなるはずよ！
MsgEn:
By gathering together strong and reliable
comrades, the efforts of each individual soldier
should also improve!

MsgJp:
ポーンを呼ぶこともできるけど――
どうする？
MsgEn:
You can also call for Pawns.
What will you do?

MsgJp:
変わった衣装――
それがあなたたちの力を引き出す衣なのね
ううん、見慣れないだけで――素敵よ
MsgEn:
Unusual costumes...
Those clothes bring out your power, don't they?
No, it's just because they're unfamiliar...
They're wonderful.

MsgJp:
あっ――
えっと、異国の方――
身の証を立ててもいない怪しい人と喋ってたら
族長に怒られちゃうから――
MsgEn:
Ah— Um, traveler from a foreign land— Talking to
a suspicious person like me, who hasn't even
proven their identity might anger the clan chief—

MsgJp: ――何だ

この村を纏めているのは
壮健で誇り高き族長、ピサルだ
MsgEn:
The one who leads this village is the robust and
proud chieftain, Pisarr.

MsgJp: 異国の覚者、か――
MsgEn: The Arisen from a foreign land, eh――

MsgJp:
ほう、なるほど
中々鋭い目をしている
MsgEn: Oh, I see. You have quite sharp eyes.

MsgJp: まずは身の証を立てるんだな
おっ、何か用かよ？

武器の手入れはいつでも万全だ！
早いとこ戦いに出て手柄を立てたいぜ
MsgEn:
I always ensure that my weapons are
in perfect condition!
I can't wait to go into battle
and earn some credit!

MsgJp:
俺だってダナの戦士
狩りでもいい働きをしているはずだ！
MsgEn:
I, too, am a soldier of Dana.
I should be able to contribute to the hunt!

MsgJp:
族長が狩りに行く時にでも
同行させてもらえりゃ早いんだけどな――
中々アピールするタイミングが――
MsgEn:
If I could just accompany the chief when they go
hunting, we could expedite things, you know――
It's just difficult to find the right
timing to make my appeal――

MsgJp:
盾も剣も、毎日点検しては磨いてるんだぜ
もちろん鍛錬も欠かさねぇ！
MsgEn:
I inspect and polish my shield and sword every
