day, and of course, I never neglect my training!

MsgJp:
てめぇ、まずは身の証を立ててからにしろよな
この村で怪しげなことしたら承知しねぇぞ
MsgEn:
First, prove yourself before you speak.
I won't tolerate any suspicious
activities in this village.

MsgJp: 私に用か？

村に外敵が侵入しないように
ここで見張っているのだ
MsgEn:
I'm here to watch over this place and to ensure
no enemies invade the village.

MsgJp:
ダナはフィンダムでも知られた勇猛な部族の村だが
子供や年寄り、戦いの苦手な者もいる
彼らを守ってこその部族だ
MsgEn:
Dana is a village known all over Phindym for its
brave and fierce tribe, but it also has children,
elders, and those who are not skilled in combat.
Protecting them is what makes our tribe strong.

MsgJp:
ずっと見張りをしていて疲れないのか、だと？
この程度どうということはない
MsgEn:
Do you mean that you never get tired from keeping
watch? It's nothing to be concerned about.

MsgJp:
私に構ってないで村に入ったらどうだ
大方、ピサルかラザネイルに会いに来たのだろう？
MsgEn:
Why don't you enter the village
instead of ignoring me?
Most likely, you've come to meet Pisarr or
Razanailt, haven't you?

MsgJp: すまないが、まずは身の証を立てるのが先だろう
MsgEn:
I'm sorry, but first you should
prove your identity.

MsgJp: はいはい、何の御用？
MsgEn: Yes, yes. What can I help you with?

MsgJp:
うちも育ち盛りの子が多いからね
山のように用意した食事が
あっという間に無くなるのは見てて気分いいもんさ
MsgEn:
We also have many children who are in their
growing years, you know.
It's satisfying to see the meals we prepared like
a mountain disappear in no time.

MsgJp:
アンタも覚者だったら戦いに出ること、あるんだろ？
この村でしっかり食べて、体を休めて
次の旅立ちに備えるんだよ
MsgEn:
If you are also an Arisen, there must be
something you fight for, right?
Eat well and rest your body in this village, and
prepare yourself for the next journey.

MsgJp:
ふぅ、洗濯物は済んだし
次は家畜の世話でもしに行こうかな
MsgEn:
Phew, the laundry is done.
Now, should I go take care of the livestock?

MsgJp:
あっ――
あんた、さっき表で騒いでた奴らの仲間だね？
MsgEn:
Ah... Are you one of the people who were causing
a ruckus outside earlier?

MsgJp:
本当に覚者だっていうんなら
さっさと身の証を立ててきちまいなよ
そしたらややこしいことも無くなるんだからさ
MsgEn:
If you really claim to be an Arisen, then quickly
prove yourself and settle it.
That way, there won't be any more complications.

MsgJp:
《武霊の庵》のそばにある物見台はサイコーなんだ！
フィンダム全体が見渡せるし
"芯なる樹"がすっごくキレイに見えるよ
MsgEn:
The observation deck next to the Spirit
Arts Hut is awesome!
You can oversee the entire Phindym, and the Core
Tree looks incredibly beautiful.

MsgJp: 何だよ？　ここはオレの場所だかんな！
MsgEn: What's going on? This is my spot, you know!

MsgJp:
ここからは村の中くらいなら見渡せるよ
でも、やっぱり村の外を眺めたいなぁ――
MsgEn:
From here, you can see around the
middle of the village.
But, I still want to gaze at the
outside of the village...

MsgJp:
村の入り口はワイニが守ってる
万が一魔物が村に入ってきたって
ダナは戦士の村だからへっちゃらだ！
MsgEn:
The village entrance is guarded by Wine.
Even if monsters somehow get into the village,
it's no big deal because Dana is
a warrior's village!

MsgJp:
一人前の戦士になったら
ワイニみたいに武器を持って村を守りたいんだ
MsgEn:
Once I become a skilled warrior, I want to
protect the village like Wine
does, wielding a weapon.

MsgJp: ――怪しい人とはあんまり喋っちゃダメなんだ
MsgEn:
- You shouldn't talk too much
with suspicious people.

MsgJp: なによ

これからは腕力だけじゃやってけないわ
知識よ、あらゆる状況に対応できる知識が必要なの！
みんなわかってないの！
MsgEn:
From now on, it won't be enough to rely
on arm strength alone.
Knowledge, I need knowledge that can
adapt to any situation!
Everyone just doesn't understand!

MsgJp:
属性がどうとか弱点がなんだとか
そういう知識だけじゃなくて！
もっと幅広い知識を身に付けたいの――
戦いの役に立つはずよ
MsgEn:
It's not just about knowing
attributes and weaknesses.
I want to acquire a broader range of knowledge.
It should be useful in battle.

MsgJp:
暇なの？
ボーッとしてないで、知識を蓄えるなり
身体を鍛えるなりした方がいいんじゃない？
MsgEn:
Are you free?
Instead of spacing out, it would be better to
accumulate knowledge or train
your body, wouldn't it?

MsgJp:
なんなの、怪しい人ね！
信用してほしいんなら、さっさと身の証を
立ててこればいいじゃない！
MsgEn:
What's the matter? You're such
a suspicious person!
If you want me to trust you, then quickly provide
some proof and establish it!

MsgJp: どうした？

何か面白い話は無いか、だと？
昔話でもすると思ったか
ヌムム――年寄り扱いしおって
MsgEn:
Do you want to hear an
interesting story or something?
Did you think I was going to tell you an old tale?
Gah, treating me like an old man.

MsgJp:
昔話を聞いて喜ぶ暇があれば
将来のために何ができるかを考えるんだな
MsgEn:
If you have time to rejoice in listening to old
tales, then ponder what you can do for the future.

MsgJp:
ダナの村は戦士の村だ
強くあるからこそ、護るべきものを
支えることができるのだ
MsgEn:
Dana's village is a village of Soldiers.
It is because they are strong that they can
protect what needs to be protected and support it.

MsgJp:
確かに――
俺も、そこのオドランも
すでに戦士としての役からは降りておる――
MsgEn:
Indeed, I and Odran over there have already
retired from our roles as soldiers.

MsgJp:
だが！
だからといって日々の研鑽を怠ることはない
若者に道を譲っただけのこと
MsgEn:
However! I will never neglect my daily training
and pursuit of knowledge.
It's just a matter of giving way to
the younger generation.

MsgJp:
お前は今、別のミッションを進行している
ようだな――
MsgEn:
It seems that you are currently engaged in
another Mission, Ser.

MsgJp:
そのミッションの参加を取りやめてから
あらためてここに来るんだな
MsgEn:
After canceling your participation in that
mission, you have come here again.

MsgJp:
自分の今の状況を把握することは
戦う者にとって常に重要なことだ
MsgEn:
Understanding one's current situation is always
important for a warrior.

MsgJp:
覚者だと言う割に
身の証も立てられんのか？
そんなことでは信用できんな
MsgEn:
Even though you claim to be an Arisen, can you
not provide any proof of your abilities?
I can't trust someone who can't even do that.

MsgJp:
アンタ――他のミッションを
受けている最中じゃないか
MsgEn:
Are you――in the middle of
receiving another mission?

MsgJp:
そちらを先に片づけるか、エントリーを
中止してからまた来るんだね
MsgEn:
Shall we tidy up that area first, or should we
cancel the entry and come back later?

MsgJp: さ、用件は何？

――ふぅん
なかなか鍛えてるね
MsgEn: Oh, I see. You're quite well trained.

MsgJp:
大物を狩りに行くなら
レウェラに声をかけて
仲間を集めた方がいいよ
MsgEn:
If you're going to hunt a big game, it's better
to ask Revela for help and gather your comrades.

MsgJp:
覚者が何人も居るってことは
ポーンもいっぱいいるんだろうね
アンタのところの大陸には
MsgEn:
There must be many Arisen, which means there are
probably plenty of Pawns too in your continent.

MsgJp:
いざという時の戦力に
余裕がありそうで羨ましいよ
MsgEn:
It's enviable to have such a surplus of strength
when the time comes.

MsgJp: 身の証を立ててから出直してくるんだね
MsgEn: Come back after proving your worth.

MsgJp:
旅人がこの村を訪れた時は
親身にもてなそうというのが
族長と族長補佐の方針なんです
MsgEn:
When a traveler visits this village, it is the
policy of the Chief and the Chief's assistant to
warmly welcome them.

MsgJp:
この村の族長はガラダ
族長補佐がモードレッドです
もし責任者と話したい、ということでしたら
彼らのところへどうぞ
MsgEn:
The chief of this village is Gearóid.
The chief assistant is Mordred.
If you wish to speak with the leaders,
please go to their place.

MsgJp:
あ、でもエリアマスターの役目は
アルトフェイルが任されているんです！
エリアの情報なら彼に聞いてみてくださいね
MsgEn:
Ah, but the role of the Area Master is
entrusted to Arthfael!
If you're looking for information about the
area, please ask him.

MsgJp: おや、何か？

わたしのことか？
――今は族長補佐をしているが
何事も無ければ、精霊竜の守番長を
務める予定だったのだ
MsgEn:
Is it about me?
- Currently, I am serving as the
assistant to the clan chief.
If nothing goes wrong, I was supposed to be the
head guardian of the Spirit Dragon.

MsgJp:
守番長として務め始めれば
しばらく村には帰って来られない
村にいる間は精一杯族長補佐として働くつもりだ
MsgEn:
If I am to serve as the Chief Guardian, I won't
be able to return to the village for a while.
While I'm here in the village, I intend to work
my hardest as the Deputy Chief.

MsgJp:
これでなかなか忙しいもので
家でゆっくり休む間も無い――
とはいえ、うちの息子が
しっかりした子で助かっている
MsgEn:
With all this, it's quite busy indeed. I have no
time to rest at home.
However, I'm grateful that my son
is a reliable child.

MsgJp:
《芯なる樹》はフィンダムに
暮らす者にとって崇敬の対象であり
同時に、心の拠り所となる景色の一部ともいえる
MsgEn:
The Core Tree is not only revered by those who
live in Phindym, but also considered a part of
the scenic landscape that serves as a
sanctuary for the heart.

MsgJp:
雄大な《芯なる樹》を眺められる場所は
フィンダムのあちこちにある
自分の気に入る場所を探してみるのも
悪くないだろう
MsgEn:
There are various places in Phindym where you can
admire the majestic Core Tree.
It wouldn't hurt to try and find a
place that you like.

MsgJp:
わたしはモルフォール村のモードレッド
ガラダの留守を預かっている
MsgEn:
I am Mordred, from the village of Morfaul,
currently looking after Gearóid's
place while he's away.

MsgJp:
セシリーの恩人はガラダの恩人
そしてわたしの恩人でもある
何もないところだが、くつろいでくれ
MsgEn:
Cecily's benefactor is Gearóid's benefactor,
and also my benefactor.
There isn't much here, but please make
yourself comfortable.

MsgJp:
ガラダが一刻も早く回復するように
客人たちも祈ってくれ
MsgEn:
Please pray for Gearóid's swift recovery, so that
he may heal as soon as possible.

MsgJp:
祈りなど我々の習慣にはなかったが
やってみると、心に刺さったトゲが
抜けていくのがわかるのだ
MsgEn:
Praying was not part of our customs, but when we
tried it, we could feel the thorns being
pulled out of our hearts.

MsgJp:
フィンダムの大地を汚してしまったこと――
おまえたちと出会えたこと――
どちらもわたしは等しく受け入れいている
MsgEn:
I have tarnished the land of Phindym, and yet, I
accept both that and the fact that I have
encountered all of you.

MsgJp:
それがいかんのだろうなあ
善し悪しを区別し、悪しきは排除しなくては
世はいつまでたっても変わらない
MsgEn:
That's the way it goes, isn't it? Distinguishing
between right and wrong, and eliminating the
wicked is necessary. The world won't
change unless we do.

MsgJp:
フィンダムの危機におまえたちの世界と
交流を持てたことを幸運と呼ばずして
なんと呼べばいいのか――
MsgEn:
To have been able to establish a connection with
your world during the crisis in Phindym, what
should I call it if not lucky?

MsgJp: 邪悪な世界と繋がる可能性もあったのだからな
MsgEn:
There was even a possibility of being
connected to an evil world.

MsgJp:
フィンダムはもう大丈夫だ
これからは客人として
この美しい世界を楽しんでくれ
MsgEn:
Phindym is already fine.
From now on, as our esteemed guest, please enjoy
this beautiful world.

MsgJp:
我らの竜の目覚めはまだ先のようだが
大地や空気は徐々に清められている
MsgEn:
It seems that the awakening of our dragon is
still ahead, but the land and the air are
gradually being purified.

MsgJp: セシリーの息吹を感じるよ
ふむ、何か必要なものでも？

フィンダムにあるものは
全て精霊竜様の恵みの賜物だ
何一つとて無駄にしてよいものは無いと心得よ
MsgEn:
Everything in Phindym is a gift from the
Spirit Dragon's blessing.
Remember that nothing is to be wasted, for
everything serves a purpose.

MsgJp: 何だ、用も無いのに話しかけたのか？
MsgEn: Why did you talk to me when you have no business?

MsgJp: ここに保管してある資材を数え直さねば――
MsgEn: I have to count the materials stored here again...

MsgJp:
必要なものがあるなら、遠慮せず言ってくれ
今この大陸に覚者はいない
我々にとっても、君だけが希望だ
MsgEn:
If you need anything, don't hesitate to tell me.
There are no Arisen on this continent right now.
You are our only hope.

MsgJp:
一つ聞きたい
――モルフォールはどんな様子だ？
MsgEn:
I have one question.
What is Morfaul like?

MsgJp:
何が起こるかはわからない
だが、何が起こってもいいように
資材の管理は万全にしておかねば
MsgEn:
We never know what will happen, but in order to
be prepared for anything, we must manage our
resources with utmost care.

MsgJp:
覚悟はしている
――家族への手紙も書いた
あの渦にすべてが飲み込まれようと
精霊竜様のお傍にいるつもりだ
MsgEn:
I am prepared —I have also written a letter to my
family Even if everything is swallowed by that
vortex I intend to stay by the side
of the Spirit Dragon.

MsgJp:
異なる大陸からの客人よ
私でお力になれることでしょうか？
MsgEn:
Guest from a different continent, how may I be
of assistance to you?

MsgJp:
癒しを、救いを求めることは
決して悪いことではないはずです
MsgEn:
Seeking healing, seeking salvation, should
never be a bad thing.

MsgJp:
病にかかるは宿命です
しかし、病んだ"芯なる樹"は助けを求めている――
この現状に、我々はどう対処すればいいのでしょう
MsgEn:
It is fate to fall ill.
However, the ailing [Core Tree] is seeking help.
How should we deal with this situation?

MsgJp:
精霊竜の守番として
我々は全力を尽くす所存です――
MsgEn:
As guardians of the Spirit Dragon We are
determined to do our best —

MsgJp:
旅の方にはこの寝床を
<VAL PRICE_INN>にて貸し出しています
簡素な宿ですが――
休んでいかれますか？
MsgEn:
For travelers, we lend out this sleeping space at
<VAL PRICE_INN>.
It is a modest inn, but...
Would you like to rest here?

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

本日は旅の方のため、宿を解放しております
どうぞ疲れを癒していってください
MsgEn:
Today, we have opened the inn for travelers.
Please rest and heal your fatigue.

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

《弱化の治療》には<VAL PRICE_WEAK>いただいています
時が経てば自然と治るものですが――
今すぐの回復をご希望でしょうか？
MsgEn:
I am receiving <VAL PRICE_WEAK> for [Treat Weakness], yes?
While it usually heals naturally over time, would
you like immediate recovery?

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

おや、困りました――
弱化していないようですよ
気持ちがお疲れなのかもしれません
少しここでゆっくりしていかれては？
MsgEn:
Oh, dear, this is troublesome— It seems that
you are not weakened.
Perhaps you are feeling tired?
Why don't you take a rest here for a while?

MsgJp:
異なる大陸からの客人よ
――空の異変の件で
来てくださったのですか？
MsgEn:
Greetings, visitor from a different continent.
—Did you come here regarding the
abnormality in the sky?

MsgJp:
フィンダムの空に
あのような禍禍しいものが――
MsgEn:
In the sky of Phindym, such a
calamitous presence looms...

MsgJp:
何が起ころうと
我々は精霊竜の守番
ここを離れるわけにはまいりません
MsgEn:
No matter what may happen, We are the guardians
of the Spirit Dragon.
We cannot leave this place

MsgJp:
精霊竜セシリーの心も
常にあなたとともにあることでしょう
MsgEn:
Surely, the heart of the Spirit Dragon
Cecily is always with you.

MsgJp: はい――

この周辺の見張りには自分が出ています
他の２人よりも体力がありますから
MsgEn:
I am on watch duty in this area.
Because I have more stamina than the other two.

MsgJp:
"芯なる樹"から伸びる
各聖域の見回りも自分の仕事です
MsgEn:
It is also my job to patrol each sacred ground
that extends from the [Core Tree].

MsgJp:
――何かあれば一早く気付くことが
できる立場でしょう
MsgEn:
In a position where you can notice anything early
on, if something were to happen.

MsgJp:
精霊竜様のご様子を常に傍で見守る役割
それが"精霊竜の守番"です
誇りに思う者も多いのですよ
MsgEn:
The role of constantly watching over the Spirit
Dragon's condition, that's what it means to be a
"Spirit Dragon Guardian." Many
take pride in this role.

MsgJp:
険しい顔をされていますね
――この状況です、無理もありませんが
MsgEn:
You have a stern expression —Given the
situation, it's understandable

MsgJp:
お一人では危険です
共に進む仲間が必要であれば
自分が手配いたしましょう
MsgEn:
It is dangerous to go alone.
If you need companions to journey together, I
will make arrangements for you.

MsgJp:
マイアとドハティも
落ち着こうと努めているようです
彼らはまだ若い――
それぞれに葛藤があることでしょう
MsgEn:
Maia and Doherty also seem to be
trying to calm down.
They are still young - each surely has
their own struggles.

MsgJp:
あの禍禍しい渦については
あまり話したくありませんね
よく、わからないものですから
MsgEn:
Regarding that ominous whirlpool...
I don't really want to talk about it, because
it's something I don't understand well.

MsgJp:
キンガル峡谷を訪れし異国の覚者よ
このキアランが用件を聞こう
MsgEn:
Oh Arisen from a distant land who has
visited the Kingal Canyon.
Let Ciarán hear your purpose.

MsgJp:
神殿や遺跡に対し、畏怖の念を持つことは大切だ
そうやって伝統が守られ
また、伝統によって我らが守られてきたのだ
MsgEn:
It is important to have a sense of awe towards
temples and ruins. It is through this respect
that traditions are preserved, and it is through
these traditions that we have been protected.

MsgJp:
我らが変化を拒もうと
我らを取り巻く環境は常に変わってゆくのでは――
"侵食"という災厄に触れ
一層そう思うことが多くなった
MsgEn:
As we try to resist change the environment
surrounding us is constantly shifting.
I have come to think this even more after
experiencing the calamity known as "Corruption."

MsgJp:
若者の柔らかい感性が、環境の変化を
敏感に感じ取っているというのであれば
遅かれ早かれ、我らも
意識を改めねばならないのかもしれないと――
MsgEn:
If the sensitive sensibilities of the younger
generation can keenly perceive environmental
changes, then sooner or later, we may need to
reconsider our own awareness as well.

MsgJp:
むむ、話が長くなってしまった
これだからいつもメーヴに呆れられる
すまない
MsgEn:
Hmm, the conversation has become rather lengthy.
This is why Maeve always finds me exasperating.
I apologize.

MsgJp:
村の若者には
伝統を重んじるこの村の空気を
嫌う者もいるようだ
MsgEn:
It seems that some of the village's young people
dislike the atmosphere of this village,
which values tradition.

MsgJp:
族長として頭の痛い問題だ
彼らも成長すればきっと
わかってくれると信じたいが――
MsgEn:
As the clan chief, it's a
headache-inducing problem.
I want to believe that they will
understand, once they grow up.

MsgJp:
キンガルに来るのは初めてだったな
少しこの地について話しておこう
俺はエリアマスターのキアランという
MsgEn:
This was my first time coming to Kingal.
Let me tell you a little bit about this place.
I am Ciarán, one of the Area Masters.

MsgJp:
キンガル峡谷は多くの遺跡や神殿を残す
フィンダム文化の要所的地帯だ
MsgEn:
Kingal Canyon is a crucial region of the Phindym
culture, with many ruins and temples remaining.

MsgJp:
そのような地に住まう者として
我々グリンデュアの民は古来よりの伝承や
伝統の守り手としての側面を持っている
MsgEn:
As inhabitants of such a land, the people of
Glyndwr have long been keepers of ancient
traditions and guardians of our heritage.

MsgJp:
貴君もこの地に留まるのであれば――
キンガルの伝統に敬意を払うべきだ
そうすれば村人との衝突も無いだろう
MsgEn:
If you are going to stay in this land— You should
respect Kingal's traditions.
That way, there will be no
conflict with the villagers.

MsgJp:
他の村は侵食魔との戦いに
やっきになっているようだが
グリンデュアは――また別の問題に直面している
MsgEn:
While other villages are becoming obsessed with
the battle against the Corruption, Glyndwr is
facing another problem.

MsgJp:
遺跡を守ってきたグリンデュアならではの
問題というものがあるのだ――
MsgEn:
Glyndwr, who has protected the ruins, has its own
unique issues to deal with.

MsgJp:
――いや、異国から旅をしてきた者に
このようなこと話すべきではなかったかもしれん
忘れてくれ
MsgEn:
No, perhaps I should not have spoken of such
things to one who has traveled
from a distant land.
Please, forget about it.

MsgJp:
大方、このグリンデュアには少しの間
留まるだけのつもりなのだろう
――この辺りは質の良い鉱石が採れる
それらを拾って帰ることだ
MsgEn:
Most likely, I intend to stay in
Glyndwr for a little while.
This area has some high-quality ore to be mined,
so I plan to gather them and take them back.

MsgJp:
キンガル峡谷は地形の複雑さもあって
なかなか冒険がしづらいのではないか？
少しだが、これを足しにするといい
MsgEn:
Kingal Canyon's complex terrain can make it
challenging for adventurers, don't you think?
Adding a little something to it
could be beneficial.

MsgJp:
グリンデュアの大地――
いや、我々のために尽力してくれて感謝している
これは日々の礼のつもりだ
MsgEn:
The land of Glyndwr, or rather, I'm grateful for
your efforts on our behalf.
This is meant to be a daily
expression of gratitude.

MsgJp:
これを受け取ってくれ
お前のためにと、村の者たちから
自然と集まったものだ
旅に役立ててもらえれば我々も本望だ
MsgEn:
Please accept this.
It is gathered naturally from the
villagers, for your sake.
We would be grateful if you could make use
of it on your journey.

MsgJp:
異国の覚者か――
エリアマスターとして忠告しておこう
MsgEn:
A Foreign Arisen, huh? As an Area Master, let me
give you some advice.

MsgJp:
《<SPOT 945>》に新手の魔物が
出現したらしい
近くを通る時は警戒を怠らぬよう
気を引き締めることだ
MsgEn:
It seems that a new type of
enemy has appeared in [<SPOT 945>].
When passing by nearby, be sure not to neglect
your vigilance and remain on high alert.

MsgJp:
《<SPOT 945>》についてはもちろん問題だが
最近はこのキンガル全域で
魔族が活性化してきている節もある――
MsgEn:
Regarding [<SPOT 945>], of course, there are issues.
However, there seems to be an invigoration of
Fiends throughout the entire region
of Kingal, as of late.

MsgJp:
あんたも命が惜しけりゃ慎重にいくことだ
俺からはそれくらいしか言うことは無いな
MsgEn:
If you value your life, you should
proceed with caution.
That's all I have to say.

MsgJp:
俺なんか、もう命くらいしか
無くして惜しいものも無いからよ
――こればっかりはな
MsgEn:
As for me, I don't really have anything left to
lose except my life – it's all I've got left.

MsgJp:
俺に何度も話しかけてどうするつもりだ？
懐に入り込んで、なけなしの金でも
毟り取るつもりか？
MsgEn:
What's the point of talking to me repeatedly?
Do you plan to get into my pocket and take even
the last bit of money I have?

MsgJp:
ふん、まぁ――
ここなら――

――もう、いつこの人生が終わるかって
これ以上何にも奪われたくないって
そんなことしか考えてなかったんだが
MsgEn:
I've been thinking only about when this life will
end, and how I don't want anything else to
be taken away from me.

MsgJp:
こうして取り戻せたものもあるし
もう少し、生きる努力をしてみても
いいのかもな
MsgEn:
There are things that can be regained like this,
so it might be worth trying a
little harder to live.
Yes.

MsgJp:
いや、でも俺は信じねえぞ
期待すると後が辛い
何が起こっても
「覚悟はできてた」って思いてぇんだ
MsgEn:
No, but I don't believe in it.
Expectations only lead to bitterness in the end.
No matter what happens, I want to think, "I
was prepared for this."

MsgJp:
昔のこと思い出しても
良いことねぇな
MsgEn:
Even when I remember the things from the past,
there's nothing good about it.

MsgJp:
――あ、はい
何でしょう
少し、疲れて――
家族のことを想うと――
MsgEn: When I think about my family...

MsgJp: どうしようも、なかったんです――
MsgEn: There was nothing I could do...

MsgJp:
――ぐすっ
ああ、すみません
家族のことが頭をよぎって――
MsgEn: Thoughts of my family crossed my mind...

MsgJp:
――私も解放軍の一員なのですから
皆さんのために、何かするべきでしょうね
MsgEn:
—Since I'm also a member of the Liberation Army,
I should do something for everyone's sake.

MsgJp:
はぁ――
もう少しだけ、一人でいても良いでしょうか
MsgEn:
Sigh— Is it alright if I stay alone for
a little longer?

MsgJp:
ごめんなさい
話をするのが億劫で――
MsgEn:
I'm sorry.
It's too much of a hassle to talk...

MsgJp:
あ――
な、なんでしょう――

ここに匿ってもらえて、心底感謝しとります
もう、帰る家も無くなったものですから――
MsgEn:
I am deeply grateful for being able to hide here.
I no longer have a home to return to...

MsgJp:
家も、家畜も、今頃全部灰になっているでしょう
――大変な思いをして手に入れてきた財産でした
MsgEn:
The house, the livestock, they must all be
turned to ashes by now.
It was a fortune that we obtained after going
through great hardships.

MsgJp:
何よりも気がかりなのは
離ればなれになった妻のことでして――
ここに一緒にいられたら、それだけで
どんなに気が楽だったか
MsgEn:
The most worrisome thing is the separation from
my wife – it would have been so much more
reassuring if we could have been together here.

MsgJp: ――何か？

ここにもきっとすぐにオークたちが来る――
こんな貧弱な拠点、一たまりも無いわ
MsgEn:
The orcs will surely come here soon... This weak
base is worth nothing.

MsgJp:
オークが攻めてきたら
こんなテントで寝起きしてる私たちなんて
真っ先に殺されるでしょうね
せめて小屋に入れてもらえないかしら――
MsgEn:
If the Orcs were to attack, we, who are sleeping
in such a tent, would surely be
killed first, wouldn't we?
I wonder if they could at least
let us into a cabin...

MsgJp:
もっとしっかりした拠点、どこかに無いかしら
良いところがあれば、そっちに移りたい――
MsgEn:
I wonder if there's a more solid base somewhere.
If there's a good place, I'd like to move there...

MsgJp: よう、元気してる？

休んでいくなら<VAL PRICE_INN>だ
見ての通り、ここって色んな店があるから
ちょっと騒がしいけど――耳栓も貸し出すからさ
それでもいいかい？
MsgEn:
If you want to rest, it's <VAL PRICE_INN>.
As you can see, there are various shops here, so
it might get noisy, but we can provide
earplugs if you'd like.

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

ああ、休みたいのか
えーっと、ベッドは空いてるな――
サービスしとくぜ、好きに使ってってくれ
MsgEn:
Ah, do you want to take a break?
Um, the bed is available...
I'll provide the service, so use
it however you like.

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

《弱化の治療》かい？
よしきた、気合入れて治療するよ
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>だけど、いいかな
MsgEn:
[Weakness Treatment,] huh?
Alright, I'll put my fighting
spirit into the treatment.
It's <VAL PRICE_WEAK>, but is that okay?

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

んー、弱化してないけどな
ほら、気持ちの問題じゃないか？
ちょっとそこら辺で好みの子に
声かけてこれば気も晴れるよ、きっと
MsgEn:
Well, you haven't weakened, you know. It's all
about the state of mind, isn't it?
Just try talking to someone you like around here,
and your spirits will lift for sure.

MsgJp:
どっかに可愛い子いたら教えてくれよ
こんな時だからこそ、楽しみが必要さ！
MsgEn:
If you find a cute girl somewhere, let me know.
Especially at times like this, we need
something to look forward to!

MsgJp:
ちょっと微笑んでくれる可愛い子が
いるってだけで毎日頑張れるってもんだろ？　
ホント、それだけでいいんだよな～
MsgEn:
Just having a cute girl who smiles at me makes me
able to do my best every day.
Really, that's all I need～

MsgJp:
まぁ、どんなに可愛い子がいても
俺のフィアンセには適わないだろうけど――
MsgEn:
Well, no matter how cute of a girl, she wouldn't
be suitable as my fiancee...

MsgJp:
嫌がってたけど、村に残してきたんだよな
だって、こんなとこに連れてくるのも危ないだろ
あいつからは少しの危険だって
遠ざけておきたかったんだ
MsgEn:
I know they didn't want to, but they left me
behind in the village.
Because it's dangerous to bring me to a place
like this, right?
I just wanted to keep a little distance from
them, even if it meant a small danger.

MsgJp:
いらっしゃいませ
幅広く取り揃えてますよ
MsgEn:
Welcome.
We have a wide variety of items.

MsgJp:
いや、恐ろしいことになりましたね――
ティネス砦を奪還できたのは嬉しいことですが
ここもまたいつ魔軍に攻め込まれるか
MsgEn:
No, it's become quite terrifying— While it's good
that we were able to retake Fort Thines, we never
know when the Demon Army will attack here again.

MsgJp:
まぁ、私には昔からやってる
商売くらいしかできませんから
やれることをやるだけです
MsgEn:
Well, since I've been doing business for as long
as I can remember, I can't do
anything else but that.
I'll just do what I can.

MsgJp:
先祖代々、商いをやってきとります
こうしてやれることをやることが
今私らに一番大切なことじゃないですかね
MsgEn:
Throughout generations, we have been
engaged in business.
Isn't it the most important thing for us now
to do what we can do?

MsgJp:
あら、覚者様
新しい武具がご入用でしょうか
MsgEn:
Oh, Ser Arisen.
Do you need new equipment?

MsgJp:
ティネス砦を取り戻せたのも
覚者様のお力あってのことと聞いております
ありがとうございます
MsgEn:
We've heard that Fort Thines was retaken, thanks
to the power of the Arisen. Thank you.

MsgJp:
今まで良いニュースなんて一つもありませんでした
覚者様が来てくださってから、何だか
希望が見えてきたような気がします
MsgEn:
Until now, there hasn't been a
single piece of good news.
But ever since the Arisen arrived, it feels like
we've glimpsed some hope.

MsgJp:
色々取り揃えております
どうぞ見ていってくださいね
MsgEn:
We have a variety of items available.
Please take a look.

MsgJp:
あっ、ハイ！
同行者をお探しでしょうか、覚者様
MsgEn:
Ah, yes! Are you looking for a
companion, Ser Arisen?

MsgJp: 同行者をお探しでしたら、僕がお役に立てますよ！
MsgEn:
If you're looking for a companion, I can
be of help!

MsgJp:
足の速さにはちょっと自信があるんです
人探しなんかも得意なんですよ
MsgEn:
I have a little confidence in my speed, you know.
I'm also good at searching for people.

MsgJp:
覚者様に話しかけていただけるなんて
この任務について良かったです！
MsgEn:
Arisen, please talk to me about the matter of
"Blood Orbs" whenever you need to exchange them.

MsgJp:
あ、覚者様じゃないですか
何のご用でしょうか
MsgEn:
Oh, it's the Arisen, isn't it? How may
I assist you?

MsgJp:
――ハァ
い、いえ、何でもありません！
申し訳ございません

ちょっと――最近眠れなくて
ハッ、も、申し訳ございません
覚者様にお話するようなことではありませんでした
MsgEn:
Just a moment... I've been having
trouble sleeping lately.
Uh, I'm sorry, that's not something to discuss
with someone like you, Arisen.

MsgJp:
い、今までずっと先輩と一緒だったんですが
任地が分かれてしまいまして――
オレ一人では、何とも――
MsgEn:
Well, I've always been with my senior until now,
but our assignments were separated.
I'm not sure if I can manage by myself.

MsgJp: ああ、覚者さまじゃないか！

ティネス砦は覚者さまのお陰で
奪還できたようなところだからね！
また奪われないように、こうして見張ってるよ
MsgEn:
Fort Thines was retaken thanks to your help,
Arisen! We're here to prevent it
from being taken again.

MsgJp:
リキャルドのヤツ、顔真っ青だろ
まぁ仕方ないよねぇ
戦に向いてないんだろうね、可哀想なもんだよ
MsgEn:
Ricardo looks pale, doesn't he? Well,
it can't be helped.
He's not cut out for battle, poor guy.

MsgJp:
もし敵が攻めてきたらさ、アタシがまず
ここで少しでも時間を稼いで――
その間にリキャルドに門を閉めるように
言ってあるんだ
MsgEn:
If the enemy attacks, I'll try to buy some time
here, and during that time, I've told
Ricardo to close the gate.

MsgJp:
ああ、覚者さん
どうかしたか？
MsgEn: Ah, Arisen, is there something you need?

MsgJp:
俺の調子？
まぁまぁだな
絶好調でも、特に悪いわけでもない
見たところ覚者さんもそうだろ
MsgEn:
How am I doing?
I'm doing okay.
I'm not in perfect condition, but I'm not
particularly bad either.
It seems like you're the same, Arisen.

MsgJp:
色々あったし、これからもあるだろうけど
悩んだところで仕方ないからな――
MsgEn:
There have been various things, and there will be
more in the future, but there's no use in
worrying about it...

MsgJp:
覚者さんも色々あると思うけど
あんまり思い悩むより
割り切っていった方がいいぜ
MsgEn:
Arisen, I think there are various things that
even those who have awakened go through.
Instead of worrying too much, it's better
to accept and move on.

MsgJp:
ああ、覚者さまですか
いえ、避難してきた人たちが可哀想でね――
私に何かできれば良いのですが
MsgEn:
Ah, are you an Arisen, Ser?
No, it's just that the people who have taken
refuge here are so pitiful...
If there's anything I can do to
help, please let me know.

MsgJp:
家を焼け出され、財産を全て失い
家族すら亡くしてここに駆け込んでくる人が
いるんですよ――気の毒としか言いようがない
MsgEn:
They have lost their homes, all their
possessions, and even their families, and yet
they come running here... There's no other way to
describe it but unfortunate.

MsgJp:
どうにか避難してきた人たちの力に
なりたいんですが、この砦はまだまだ物資も
人手も不足していますからな
ままならないものです
MsgEn:
I want to be of help to the people who managed to
take shelter here, but this fort is still lacking
in supplies and manpower.
It's not in a good state.

MsgJp:
広場にいるミカエラなど
あの幼さで親も兄弟も亡くしているのですよ
家族の話をすると、目に涙をいっぱい溜めて――
MsgEn:
People like Michaela in the plaza, she lost her
parents and siblings at such a young age.
When she talks about her family,
tears fill her eyes...

MsgJp:
どうかなさいましたか、覚者様
こちらは特に問題ありませんが――
MsgEn:
What's wrong, Lord? We don't have any
particular problems here...

MsgJp:
魔軍に占領されていた間に
この砦もかなり傷んでしまいました
まだ完全に復旧していないところも
あるようですね
MsgEn:
While occupied by the Demon Army, this fortress
has also sustained considerable damage.
There are still parts that have not been
completely restored it seems.

MsgJp:
私も工事を手伝っていますが
この砦が完全にかつての姿に戻るまでは
時間がかかるでしょう――
MsgEn:
I'm also assisting with the construction, but it
will take time for this fortress to fully return
to its former glory.

MsgJp:
仮組の足場には手すりがありません
足を滑らせないよう気を付けてくださいね
いくら覚者様でも、この高さですから
MsgEn:
Be careful as there are no handrails on the
temporary scaffolding.
It's a long way down, even for the Arisen.

MsgJp:
はいはい、何でしょうか
自分でお役に立てることならお手伝いします
MsgEn:
Alright, alright, what can I help you with? If
there's anything I can assist with,
I'll be happy to.

MsgJp:
自分は家も家具も、丸ごと
全部焼かれちまいましたから
また一つ一つ揃えるところからですよ
MsgEn:
I lost everything in the fire – my house,
furniture, everything. I'll have to start
gathering things one by one.

MsgJp:
何の取り柄もないんでね、こうやって
兵士の皆さんの雑用でもやって
ちょっとずつ生きてく道を探っとかないとね
MsgEn:
I don't have any particular talents, so I'm
helping out with various odd jobs for the
soldiers, slowly finding a way to live.

MsgJp:
まだまだ故郷に帰れる状況じゃありませんけど
いつかまた、生まれ育った村に家を建てたいんです
それだけが自分の夢ですよ、ははは
MsgEn:
It's still not a situation where I can
return to my hometown.
But someday, I want to build a house in the
village where I was born and raised.
That's the only dream I have, hahaha.

MsgJp:
こんにちは、覚者さま
えっと、ミカエラです
MsgEn:
Hello, Ser Arisen.
Um, I'm Michaela.

MsgJp:
あのお歌を教えてくれたのが
王子さまだったなんて、知らなかったの
MsgEn:
I didn't know that the prince was the one who
taught me that song.

MsgJp:
王子さまはとっても優しかったよ
わたしが泣いてたから
ずっとそばにいてくれた
MsgEn:
The prince was very kind.
He stayed by my side the whole time I was crying.

MsgJp:
ほんとはね、今も、ひとりでさみしい――
でも、助けてもらったんだから
わたしも頑張ります
MsgEn:
Honestly, I still feel lonely now – but since
you've helped me, I'll do my best.

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

そんな体でここまで来られたなんて
それだけで上等ってものですよ
さぁ、《弱化の治療》は<VAL PRICE_WEAK>です
治療しますよね？
MsgEn:
Just the fact that you made it here in such a
state is impressive in itself.
Now, the cost for [Weakness Treatment] is <VAL PRICE_WEAK>
.
Shall we proceed with the treatment?

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

あらら、覚者様はきっと心が疲れてるんですよ
じゃなければ、《弱化》もしてないのに
治療してほしがるわけないもの
ちょっと眠っていかれたら？
MsgEn:
Oh my, I'm sure the Arisen must be weary.
Otherwise, you wouldn't be seeking treatment
without even being weakened.
Why not rest awhile?

MsgJp:
激戦の野営地でもありませんからね
この城内での体調不良は、大体眠れば
よくなるんです
MsgEn:
This is not a battlefield camp, so you
don't have to worry.
Most of the time, if you rest, your
condition will improve.

MsgJp:
私が一番気を付けたいのは、心の健康――
勝利の喜びで疲れや病気に
気付かなくなっちゃう人が時々いるのよねぇ
MsgEn:
What I'm most concerned about is mental
health—sometimes people get so caught up in the
joy of victory that they don't
notice fatigue or illness.

MsgJp:
今、一番気を付けたいのは、心の健康――
勝利の喜びで疲れや病気に
気付かなくなっちゃう人が時々いるのよねぇ
MsgEn:
The most important thing is mental health—
sometimes people get so caught up in the joy of
victory that they don't notice fatigue or illness.

MsgJp:
メルテムは放っておくと
すぐ傷だらけになるから困ってるんです
覚者様も、あまり無理はなさらないでくださいね
MsgEn:
I'm worried about Meltem because they tend to get
hurt easily if left alone.
Arisen, please try to avoid
overexerting yourself as well.

MsgJp:
おお、覚者さんじゃないか
それで、今日はどの武器が見たいんだ？
MsgEn:
Oh, it's the Arisen! So, which weapon would
you like to see today?

MsgJp:
ああ、ナヤジークさん綺麗だよな
いつかこの状況が落ち着いたら
また歌ってくれないかなぁ
MsgEn:
Ah, Nazik, she's so beautiful, isn't she? I hope
when things settle down, she'll sing for us again.

MsgJp:
俺、昔っから歌姫ナヤジークの
大ファンだったんだよ
芝居も上手くってさぁ――
同じところに居られるのが信じられねぇ
MsgEn:
I've been a big fan of the songstress Nazik since
long ago. Her acting skills are also amazing.
It's unbelievable that we can
be in the same place.

MsgJp:
国ん中はしっちゃかめっちゃかだけど
ツテの類はまだ、意外なことに生きてるんだよ
お陰でちょっと良い武器を仕入れられてるぜ
MsgEn:
Things are chaotic all over the country, but
surprisingly, my connections are still alive.
Thanks to that, I managed to get some
pretty good weapons.

MsgJp:
覚者様、こんにちは
何をいくつご用意しましょう？
MsgEn:
Greetings, Master Arisen. How many of each would
you like me to prepare?

MsgJp:
戦いに出ない人たちの取りまとめも
俺がやってるんですけど
なかなか言うことを聞いてくれなくて――
MsgEn:
I'm the one handling the organization of those
who don't participate in battles, but they're
quite stubborn and don't listen to me.

MsgJp:
武具屋のマルクスさんって
話しかけてもナヤジークさんのことしか
言わないんですよね――正に夢中ってやつです
MsgEn:
Mr. Marcus, the owner of the equipment shop, only
talks about Lady Nazik when you speak to him.
He's completely obsessed, isn't he?

MsgJp:
俺ももうちょっと上手くやれるようになると
いいんですけど、物資を管理するだけでも
精一杯ですよ
MsgEn:
I hope I can get better at this soon, but just
managing the supplies is already a handful for me.

MsgJp: はーい、何にする？

これからまた戦いに出るのかい？
せっかくだから、その前に何か食べておいきよ！
MsgEn:
Are you going into battle again?
You might as well eat something before you go!

MsgJp:
お酒も肉もあるからさ
今日はパーッと食べていくのも
いいんじゃない？
MsgEn:
We have both alcohol and meat.
Wouldn't it be nice to have a hearty meal today?

MsgJp:
そこの、ロスギルから来た兵隊さん
食べっぷりがよくてねぇ
息子のことを思い出すよ
MsgEn:
There you go, Soldier from Rothgill.
You're a good eater, eh?
You remind me of my son!

MsgJp:
ああ、はいはい
旅の同行者探しなら俺がお手伝いします、っと――
MsgEn:
Ah, yes, yes.
I can help you find a travel companion, and--

MsgJp:
ただ楽そうだなと思って
頼み込んでこの仕事に就けてもらったんだけど
結構これがダルいんだよなぁ
MsgEn:
I just thought it looked easy, so I implored him
to let me have this job, but it's pretty dull.

MsgJp:
はぁ――そもそも、俺は色んな人間と
接触する仕事ってのに向いてなかったかも
しれんなぁ～、これは
MsgEn:
Ah, perhaps I wasn't cut out for a job where I
have to bustle with all kinds of
people in the first place.
Yeah, could be.

MsgJp: はいはい、仕事はちゃんとやりますから
MsgEn: Yes, yes, I will do my job well.

MsgJp:
はっ、覚者様！
こちらは異常ありません！

警備を言いつけられているのですが
さすがにこのような場所には
そう人も来ませんね
MsgEn:
I've been told to keep guard. But as expected,
not so many come to a place like this.

MsgJp:
なぜここに警備が要るのかは
私にはわかりませんが――
MsgEn:
Why one would need security here, I
haven't a clue.

MsgJp:
任務とあらば、どのようなことでも
力の限り遂行します！
MsgEn:
Whatever the task may be, we will carry it out to
the best of our ability!

MsgJp:
今、人探しをしているので
手短にお願いしますね――
MsgEn:
I'm looking for someone right now, so I'll
ask you to be brief.

MsgJp:
――家族を探しているんです
ここに来る人は多いので
何か情報を得られないかと――
MsgEn:
I'm looking for my family.
I know lots of folks come by here, so I was
wondering if I could get some information...

MsgJp:
家族も友人も、無事なのかすら
まったく情報が入ってこなくて――
こうして道行く人に聞いて回るしかありません
MsgEn:
My family, my friends, I know not if they're
safe or otherwise...
I have no choice but to ask around.

MsgJp:
家族がみつかるまで、私ずっとここにいます
変に移動したらすれ違うかも知れませんから
MsgEn:
I'll stay here until I find my family.
If I move around too much, we
might not cross paths.

MsgJp: まったく嘆かわしい――

若者や子供までもこんな戦乱に巻き込まれて
痛々しいばかりではないですか
魔軍とやらは一体何が目的なのか――
MsgEn:
It pains me so to see young people, even children
involved in this kind of warfare.
What the hell are these demon armies
trying to accomplish...?

MsgJp:
女王クレス様は竜となられて日が浅かった――
まだ大変に若い竜だったのですな
魔軍はそこを攻めたのです
MsgEn:
Queen Cress had recently become a dragon— a very
young dragon, indeed.
It was at that time that the demon army attacked.

MsgJp:
女王クレス様は、その御母堂であり
先々代の火竜　アデライデ様の覚者であられた
よき時代でしたぞ
MsgEn:
Her Majesty Queen Cress was the Arisen of her
mother, Queen Adelaide, the Arisen of the
previous generation.
It was a prosperous time.

MsgJp:
避難してきた者たちの世話役として
ここにいるのだ
MsgEn: I'm here to aid these refugees.

MsgJp: 何かあるなら、用向きをお聞かせ願いたい
MsgEn:
If there's anything, I'd like to ask the
purpose of your visit.

MsgJp:
すでに老いた身
しかし、できることはあるはず
MsgEn:
I'm already old, but there must be
something we can do.

MsgJp: ハァイ、ご機嫌いかが？
MsgEn: Hi there, how do you fare?

MsgJp:
少し手が空いたから
飲み物でも飲んで休憩しようかと思って
MsgEn:
I've got some free time on my hands, so I thought
I'd grab a drink and take a break.

MsgJp:
ん？　これでも実戦向きなんだからね、私
いつか戦場でご一緒することがあったら
活躍するところを見てよ？
MsgEn:
Huh? Even with this, I'm cut out
for combat, you know.
If we ever meet on the battlefield,
watch me shine, okay?

MsgJp:
兜を被ると、少年みたいに見えるらしくて
仲間たちが慌てるのよね――
「君、いくつだい」「親はどこにいる」
なんて言っちゃって
MsgEn:
They say that I look like a young boy when I wear
my helmet, and my companions get flustered.
They'll ask things like, "How old are you?" and
"Where are your parents?"

MsgJp:
おっ、覚者さんか
どうです、一緒に一杯！
MsgEn:
Oh, are you an Arisen? How's about
we drink together!

MsgJp:
自分はロスギルの出身でしてね
ここの飯もうまいけど、やっぱり翡翠湖の
魚を使った粥が食べたくなります
――故郷の味って、離れて初めて恋しいものですね
MsgEn:
I'm originally from Rothgill, you see.
The food here is good, but I still long for the
fish porridge made with Emerald Lake fish.
―― The taste of home is something you only truly
miss once you're away.

MsgJp:
ロスギルと展望城を繋ぐ伝令として
ここに遣わされたんですけど――
イェルハルド様がご自身で動かれるんで
自分はあんまり仕事が無いんですよね
MsgEn:
I was sent here as a messenger to connect
Rothgill and Lookout Castle, but... Lord Gerhard
prefers to move on his own, so I don't
have much work to do.

MsgJp:
ここにいると色んな人の話が聞けて
何かと面白いですよ！
MsgEn:
I hear many tales from all sorts of people,
it's all so interesting!

MsgJp:
あ？
――何だ、覚者さまじゃねぇか
MsgEn:
Huh?
Oh, what do we have here? It's
an Arisen, isn't it?

MsgJp:
展望城を取り返せたのは嬉しいが
これからどうなるんだか――
MsgEn:
I'm glad we were able to recapture Lookout
Castle, but I wonder what will happen next...

MsgJp:
今まで散々痛めつけられたこの国に
長いこと戦う力なんて残ってると思うか？
俺は、長期戦になったら終わりだと思うぜ
MsgEn:
Do you think this country, having been thoroughly
worn down, still has the strength to
fight for a long time?
I think if it turns into a
protracted war, it's over.

MsgJp:
――色々あるけど、ま、展望城が
取り戻せたのはよ――
嬉しいよな、うん
MsgEn:
All in all, it's great that we were able to
regain Lookout Castle, right?
I'm happy, yeah.

MsgJp:
あ、あの――
何かご用でしょうか――
MsgEn: Oh, um-- How can I help you?

MsgJp:
カトブレパスを見張ってろって言われたんです
でも、ちょっと怖くて――
MsgEn:
My task is to keep watch over the Catoblepas, but
I'm a little scared...

MsgJp:
カトブレパスが頭を振ったりして
涙が飛んできたら、わたし石化しちゃうんですよね？
そうでもないんでしょうか？　うう――
MsgEn:
If a Catoblepas shakes its head and tears come
flying, I'll turn to stone, won't I?
Or is that not the case? Ugh...

MsgJp:
本当は、装備を点検したり
避難してきた子供の面倒を見たり
そういう仕事がしたいんですけど――
MsgEn:
In truth, I'd rather be inspecting gear or and
taking care of the children seeking refuge...

MsgJp:
ううう、カトブレパスって苦手です
ちょっと臭いますし――
MsgEn:
Urgh, Catoblepas is not suited for me.
'Tis right rank...

MsgJp:
よう、珍しいじゃないか
俺になんか用か？
MsgEn:
Well, isn't this unusual? Do you
need something from me?

MsgJp:
門番って立ちっぱなしだから
足腰にくるんだけどさ
――意外と首も凝るんだよなぁ
MsgEn:
Being a gatekeeper means standing still, which
puts a strain on your legs and back.
Surprisingly, it also makes your neck stiff.

MsgJp:
もう二度と展望城が魔軍の手に落ちないように
しっかり見張っとかないとな！
MsgEn:
To ensure that Lookout Castle never falls into
the hands of the demon army again, we
must keep a close watch!

MsgJp:
あのさ、たまにでいいから
門番変わってくれたりしないか？
――いや、冗談だよ
MsgEn:
Hey, wanna switch places for a while?
- Nah, just kidding.

MsgJp: 白竜の覚者、どうかしたか？
MsgEn:
Arisen of the White Dragon, is
there something wrong?

MsgJp:
この展望城を奪還できたのは
あんたの働きのお陰らしいな
――俺からも礼を言うよ
MsgEn:
I hear it was your work that we were able to
recapture the Lookout Castle.
I wish to thank you too, Ser.

MsgJp:
展望城はデカいし、立派だろ
絵葉書にも描かれてるからな
この国の者なら誰でも知ってる
MsgEn:
Lookout Castle is huge and magnificent.
It's even depicted on postcards, you know.
Anyone in this country would know about it.

MsgJp:
どうした、中に入らないのか
あんたなら皆歓迎するだろ
MsgEn:
What's the matter, won't you come inside?
If it's you, everyone will welcome you.

MsgJp: ん？　今忙しいんだけど――
MsgEn: Hm? I'm kind of busy right now--

MsgJp:
この城ってば広いからねぇ
毎日掃除しても追い付かないよ
MsgEn:
This castle is so spacious, you know.
I can't keep up with the cleaning even if
I do it every day.

MsgJp:
ああ、気にしないで
私の家は魔軍に焼かれたってわけじゃないんだ
ここへは働きに来てるだけさ
MsgEn:
Ah, don't worry about it.
My house wasn't burned down by the demon army
or anything like that.
I'm just here to work.

MsgJp:
立派だけど古い建物だからかね
ちょっと掃除の手を抜くと
ほこりがすごいんだ
MsgEn:
It's magnificent, but because it's an old
building, if you slack off on cleaning a little,
the dust becomes unbearable.

MsgJp:
わぁー、覚者さんだ！
こんにちは！

覚者さんの鎧って変わってるね
いいなぁ、僕も着てみたいなぁ
MsgEn:
The armor of the Arisen is quite unique, isn't it?
Ah, wish I could try it on too.

MsgJp:
前に、ちょっとの間だけジリアン様に会ったよ！
強くてキリッとしてて、カッコよかったなぁ～
MsgEn:
I met Master Gillian briefly before! She was
strong and had a sharp presence, so cool～

MsgJp:
ぼくも大きくなったら
王子様に仕える騎士になって
カッコいい鎧をもらうんだ！
MsgEn:
When I grow up, I'm going to become a knight!
I'll serve a prince and get some cool armor!

MsgJp:
おお、覚者さまじゃありませんか
私に何か？
MsgEn:
Oh, an Arisen comes before me.
What can I do for you?

MsgJp:
覚者さまがアッカーシェランに来てくださって
希望が見えてきたと――
みな、そう言っていますよ
MsgEn:
The Arisen has come to Acre Selund, and with
that, hope is in sight— After all,
everyone's saying so.

MsgJp:
解放軍に娘がおりましてね
あの子がここへ連れてきてくれたんです
ここなら安心して眠れるだろうって
優しい子でしょう――
MsgEn:
My daughter is with the Liberation Army, you see.
She brought me here.
She said, "You can sleep peacefully here." Such a
kind soul, isn't she—

MsgJp:
いつか終わると思えば辛い日々も耐えられます
ふふ、「終わるかもしれない」と思えるように
なったからこんなことも言えるんですよね
MsgEn:
If you think that someday it will end, you can
endure even the difficult days.
Well, it's because I've come to think, "It might
end," that I can say such things.

MsgJp:
別の国の覚者――
何だ、話聞く
MsgEn:
Arisen from another country...
Well, what's the story?

MsgJp:
安全守るの、手間かかってる
泊まるなら<VAL PRICE_INN>いる
MsgEn:
Protecting safety is time-consuming.
If you stay, it will cost <VAL PRICE_INN>.

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

金、いらない
安全な寝床、好きに休んでいけ
MsgEn:
Gold, I don't need it.
A safe sleeping place, rest as you please.

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

俺《弱化の治療》できる
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>だ
MsgEn:
If it's [Weakness Treatment], it's <VAL PRICE_WEAK>.
What do you want to do?

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

弱化――？
なってない
気にしすぎだ
MsgEn:
Weakened――?
Not at all.
You're worrying too much.

MsgJp:
お前、珍しい客だ
皆、お前が気になってる
MsgEn:
You're a rare customer.
Everyone is curious about you.

MsgJp:
皆が安全に眠れる
毎日食べられる
何かに襲われない――
これが大事、一番大事だ
MsgEn:
Everyone being able to sleep safely, being able
to eat every day, not being attacked by
anything―― This is important, the
most important thing.

MsgJp:
外に出ると魔物に襲われる
争いに巻き込まれる
病気にもなる――
なら、ここで仲間を守っていきたい
MsgEn:
When you go outside, you will be
attacked by enemies.
You will be drawn into conflicts.
You can even fall ill-- So, I want to
protect my comrades here.

MsgJp:
お前も、大人しくしてるなら
ここにずっと居ていい
好きにしろ
MsgEn:
If you're staying here quietly, you can stay here
as long as you like.
Do as you please.

MsgJp:
オレ、コレ調べてる！
使い方ワカル！　仲間呼ぶなら手伝う！
MsgEn:
I'm researching this!
I understand how to use it! If you call your
comrades, I'll help!

MsgJp:
コレ青く光る――
キレイだろ？
MsgEn: This shines blue— Isn't it beautiful?

MsgJp:
コレ、昔からココにある
ずっとずっと前からある
MsgEn: This has been here since long, long ago.

MsgJp:
オレ、一番コレに詳しい
分からないなら教える
MsgEn:
I'm the most knowledgeable about this.
If you don't know, I'll teach you.

MsgJp:
ナニ？
資材欲しい？

資材、ゴールドと引き換え
ゴールド持ってるか？
MsgEn:
Do you have any Gold?
We can exchange it for materials.

MsgJp:
ゴールド集める
資材買える
――わかった？
MsgEn:
Collect Gold.
Buy Materials.
- Got it?

MsgJp:
ゴールドない？
なら、お前に資材ない
MsgEn:
Don't you have any Gold?
If not, then you don't have any materials either.

MsgJp: ム、何の用ダ！
ココ、魔物来ないか見張ってる
MsgEn: I am keeping watch here, in case enemies appear.

MsgJp:
お前――魔物連れて来てないな？
後つけられたら、困ることなる
MsgEn:
You... haven't brought any enemies, have you?
If you bring them later, it
will become troublesome.

MsgJp:
見張ってないと、村、襲われる
――オレ忙しいだが、オマエひまなのか？
MsgEn:
If we don't keep watch, the
village will be attacked.
- I'm busy, but are you free?

MsgJp: えっと、あの、ナニ？

ココ、安心ヨ
眠れる、食べれる、怖いことナイ――
MsgEn:
Here, you can rest easy.
You can sleep, eat, and there's nothing to fear.

MsgJp:
ちゃんと幸せヨ
外出ようと思ワナイ
MsgEn:
I want to be truly happy.
I don't want to go out.

MsgJp: え、あの――外は怖いカラ――
ハーイ、ナニ？

ネェネェ、手伝って！
クエストボードに
ミンナの"お願い"貼ってるダカラ！
MsgEn:
Hey, hey, can you help me out?
I've posted everyone's "requests" on the
Quest Board, you see!

MsgJp:
クエストボードの"お願い"やっつけてくれたら
お礼もあるヨー！
MsgEn:
If you can help me with the "requests" on the
Quest Board, there will be a reward too!

MsgJp:
クエストボードの"お願い"やっつけて減らす
でもまた"お願い"増える――
ダカラ、ミンナでやっつけよ！
MsgEn:
Complete the requests on the quest board
and whittle them down.
But then, more requests keep coming— So let's all
take care of them together!

MsgJp:
おお、お客人
ワシに何か聞きたいことでも？
MsgEn:
Oh, esteemed customer.
Is there something you would like to ask me?

MsgJp:
ワシは若い頃、一度この集落から出て
他の集落を旅して回ったことがありましてな
MsgEn:
When I was young, I once left this village and
traveled to other villages.

MsgJp:
外はどうだったか、ですか？
こうしてまたこの集落に戻り、この歳に
なるまで過ごしているのです
――もう、お分かりでしょう
MsgEn:
How was it outside, you ask?
Well, I returned to this settlement, and I've
been here until this age.
— You probably understand by now.

MsgJp:
この集落の者は他所と少し言葉が違うでしょう
交流が無いまま過ごすとね
こうなるんですよ
MsgEn:
The people in this settlement might have slightly
different language compared to others.
When you spend your time without much
interaction, this is what happens.

MsgJp:
フィンダム全体で見ても
ワシは年寄りの部類ですわな
この洞窟が外部の災厄から守ってくれるお陰です
MsgEn:
Even in the whole Phindym, I suppose I belong to
the old folks category.
Thanks to this cave, it protects us from
external calamities.

MsgJp:
ようこそ、異国の覚者様
モルフォールにご用でしょうか？
MsgEn:
Welcome, esteemed Arisen.
Are you in need of assistance in Morfaul?

MsgJp:
かつて村を支えてくれていた大地が
突然我々に牙をむくというのは――
頭ではわかっていても、悲しさを覚えるものです
MsgEn:
The fact that the land, which once supported our
village, suddenly shows its fangs towards us...
Even though we understand it in our heads, it
brings forth a sense of sadness.

MsgJp:
この村はまたも危機にさらされています
――異国の覚者様
再三で申し訳なく思う気持ちはあります
しかし、お力を貸していただけないでしょうか
MsgEn:
This village is once again facing a crisis.
――Lord of a foreign land, I apologize for the
repeated inconvenience...
Would you lend us your power?

MsgJp:
ご協力いただける時に
また私にお声をかけていただければ
詳細を知る者にお取り次ぎいたします
MsgEn:
When you are able to assist, please also reach
out to me and I will relay the details to someone
who can provide more information.

MsgJp:
おや、ここモルフォールの族長はガラダですよ
私は彼の信を得て、この地域を
切り盛りしているだけです
MsgEn:
Oh, here in Morfaul, the chieftain is Gearóid.
I just manage this area with his trust.

MsgJp:
モルフォールは代々精霊竜の
守りをしてきた一族の村です
MsgEn:
Morfaul is the village of a clan that has been
protecting the Spirit Dragons for generations.

MsgJp:
精霊竜の守番となったものは、ここから東に行った
《始まりの洞》にて過ごすことになります
村に残った者は彼らを全力で支えるのが務めです
MsgEn:
Those who become guardians of the Spirit Dragon
will spend their time in the Hollow of
Beginnings, located to the east from here.
Those who stay in the village have the duty to
support them with all their might.

MsgJp:
侵食がはびこるこのような状況ですから
族長ガラダの補佐として
モードレッドが就いています
MsgEn:
Given the prevalence of corruption in this
situation, Mordred has taken on the role of
assisting Chief Gearóid.

MsgJp:
彼も最初は精霊竜の守番として
竜のお傍にて務めるはずだったのですよ
MsgEn:
He was also supposed to serve as the guardian of
the Spirit Dragon at first, by its side.

MsgJp:
はじめまして、私はアルトフェイル
このモロー樹林一帯を任されたエリアマスターです
MsgEn:
Nice to meet you, I am Arthfael, the Area Master
entrusted with this entire Morrow Forest.

MsgJp:
モロー樹林はその呼び名の通り
フィンダム大陸の中でも深き森を
数多く有しています
MsgEn:
The Morrow Forest, as its name suggests, is one
of the deep forests found in the
continent of Phindym.

MsgJp:
森の恩恵を受け、これまでは恵まれた
環境であったと言えるでしょう
そう、"侵食"が始まる前までは――
MsgEn:
Thanks to the blessings of the forest, it can be
said that we have been fortunate to exist in a
favorable environment.
Yes, until the "corruption" began to spread...

MsgJp:
現在は村の総力を挙げて
侵食の被害を食い止めるため尽力しています
ここで我々が屈することは、フィンダムが
屈することに等しいと考えています――
MsgEn:
Currently, we are making every effort with the
combined strength of the village to halt the
spread of Corruption.
We believe that surrendering at this point would
be tantamount to Phindym's surrender.

MsgJp:
聞けば、覚者様たちは
セシリーを助けてくださっているとか――
彼女はこの村の出身なのですよ
同胞として感謝いたします
MsgEn:
I've heard that you, as Arisen, are helping Lady
Cecily— She is from this village, you know.
We are grateful for your assistance
as fellow villagers.

MsgJp:
このモルフォールに滞在されている間
何かわからないことがあれば
気がねなく私にお聞きください
MsgEn:
During your stay in Morfaul, if there is anything
you don't understand, please feel free to ask me.

MsgJp:
そうそう、こちらをお持ちください
モルフォールの平穏に貢献してくださった方に
お渡ししているのです
MsgEn:
That's right. Please take this with you.
We give it to those who have contributed to
the peace of Morfaul.

MsgJp:
立ち寄ってくださってありがとうございます
よろしければこちらをお持ちください
日々の感謝の気持ちです
MsgEn:
Thank you for stopping by.
If you don't mind, please take this.
It's a daily expression of gratitude.

MsgJp:
異なる竜に仕える身だというのに
このモルフォールのために日々尽力してくださり
ここを代表して感謝いたします
どうぞ、これをお役立てください
MsgEn:
Even though I am serving a different dragon, I am
grateful for your daily efforts for Morfaul.
Please accept this, and may it be of use to you.

MsgJp:
白き竜の覚者様
実は折り入ってお願いがございます――
MsgEn:
Arisen of the White Dragon, I have a
favor to ask, if I may...

MsgJp:
《<SPOT 907>》の付近、森の南側に
侵食が拡がっていないかを
調査していただけないでしょうか
MsgEn:
Could you please investigate if there is no
spreading of corruption or infected near the
vicinity of [<SPOT 907>], on the south side of the forest?

MsgJp:
もしも侵食が拡がっている形跡が認められれば
それらを排除してくださると幸いです
MsgEn:
If there are any signs of the corruption
spreading, I would be grateful if you
could eliminate them.

MsgJp:
元より《<SPOT 907>》は侵食魔が潜むため
一時立ち入りを禁じていたのですが
どうやら出入り口を塞げばよいというものでも
なさそうなのです
MsgEn:
Because the area around <SPOT 907> is infested with the
Corruption, entry was temporarily prohibited.
However, it seems that simply blocking the
entrance is not a viable solution.

MsgJp:
この侵食という災いに対し
有効な対策を立てられていないというのは
実に不甲斐ないことです
MsgEn:
It is truly disgraceful that we have not been
able to come up with effective measures against
this calamity of corruption.

MsgJp:
侵食について――
事態は悪くなる一方ですね
MsgEn:
About the corruption— The situation is only
getting worse, isn't it?

MsgJp:
先日も、森へ入った者より
侵食魔が群れているところを見たと
報告が入ってきました――
MsgEn:
We have received a report from someone who
recently entered the forest, saying that they saw
a swarm of Infected creatures.

MsgJp:
森へ入ってその恵みを得ることが
できなくなってしまえば
我々の生活は苦しいものとなるでしょう
MsgEn:
If we are unable to enter the forest and obtain
its blessings, our lives will
surely become difficult.

MsgJp:
――森に入った者からの報告を
お聞きになりたいのですか？
ええ、いつでもお話しいたしますよ
私に再び声をおかけください
MsgEn:
- you want to hear the reports from those
who entered the forest?
Yes, I'll be ready to talk whenever.
Please call on me again.

MsgJp:
やはり、侵食に対して"封鎖する"という手段は
気休め程度にしかならないようですね――
MsgEn:
Indeed, "blocking" locations as a means to
counter corruption seems to be nothing more
than a mere illusion.

MsgJp:
封鎖した《<SPOT 906>》から
魔物が這い出てきているようなのです
どこかに抜け道でもあるのでしょう
MsgEn:
It seems that enemies are crawling out
from the blocked spot, <SPOT 906>.
There must be some kind way out somewhere.

MsgJp:
このまま封鎖し続けても後はありません
《<SPOT 906>》も調査の対象とできるよう
封鎖を解除いたしました
MsgEn:
There is no future if we continue to keep
it blocked like this.
In order to include [<SPOT 906>] in the investigation, we
have released the blockade.

MsgJp:
覚者様も、もしよろしければ
一度現状を確認していただけないでしょうか
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen, if you wouldn't mind, could you
please take a moment to review
the current situation?

MsgJp:
侵食についての調査進捗ですか？
――芳しいとはいえませんね
MsgEn:
Is this regarding the progress of the
investigation on corruption?
- It's not going well, I'm afraid.

MsgJp:
やはり、侵食に対しては封鎖して時が過ぎるのを
待つという手は愚策となるようです
MsgEn:
Indeed, it seems that blocking and waiting for
time to pass is a foolish strategy when it
comes to corruption.

MsgJp:
大地が侵食されている以上
侵食のひどいところを封鎖しても
いずれ侵食は他のところに拡がってしまいます
MsgEn:
As long as the earth is being corrupted even if
we block the heavily infected areas the
corruption will eventually spread to other places.

MsgJp:
ここは《モルフォール北門》をも開放し
侵食への対策法を探ってゆこうと考えています
MsgEn:
Here; we also plan to open the "Morfaul Northern
Gate" and explore ways to counter the Infected.

MsgJp:
白き竜の覚者様
異なる大陸の方にこのようなお願いをするのは
心苦しいのですが――どうか、この難局への
お力添えをいただけないでしょうか
MsgEn:
Arisen of the White Dragon,
It pains my heart to make such a request to
someone from a different continent, but could you
please lend us your aid in this dire situation?
We humbly ask for your assistance in overcoming
this adversity.

MsgJp:
覚者様――
人間も侵食される、という話を
お聞きになったことはあるでしょうか
MsgEn:
Oh, honorable Arisen, have you ever heard the
tale of humans being corrupted?

MsgJp:
侵食された人々によって
このモルフォールが危機に晒されているのです
MsgEn:
Morfaul is being exposed to danger by the
infected people who have been corrupted.

MsgJp:
あまり大きな声では申し上げられません
詳しくは、もう一度私に話しかけてください
MsgEn:
I have to speak quietly about this.
Please talk to me again for more details.

MsgJp:
この未曾有の危機はフィンダム全体に
降りかかっているとはいえ――
大変なことというのは重なるものですね
MsgEn:
Yes, even though this unprecedented crisis is
weighing down on all of Phindym... it seems that
difficult times tend to pile up, don't they?

MsgJp:
村全体の落ち着かない空気を察したのか
《<SPOT 942>》に
狂侵ゴアサイクロプスが現れたのです
MsgEn:
Perhaps sensing the unsettled atmosphere of the
entire village, a Severely Infected
Gorecyclops appeared at <SPOT 942>.

MsgJp:
狂侵ゴアサイクロプスは、侵食の犠牲となった
ゴアサイクロプスの成れの果て――
肉体が朽ちる前にさらに侵食が進んでしまった
非常に凶悪な魔物です
MsgEn:
The Severely Infected Gorecyclops is the tragic
result of the corruption, the ultimate fate of a
Gore Cyclops.
The corruption has progressed even further before
its body decayed, making it an extremely vicious
creature.

MsgJp:
装備に不安がある状態で遭遇した際には
逃げることも必要となりましょう
常に冷静なご判断を――
MsgEn:
When faced with a situation where there is
uncertainty about your equipment, it is also
necessary to consider retreating.
Always make calm judgments—

MsgJp:
フィンダム中でも特に侵食の進んだ
このモロー樹林に、絶えず足を運んでくださり
感謝の気持ちしかありません
MsgEn:
Among the lands of Phindym, the Morrow Forest has
been particularly ravaged by the Infected.
I have nothing but gratitude for those who
constantly venture into this
heavily corrupted forest.

MsgJp:
日々のお礼として、この辺りで
役にたちそうな情報をお教えいたしましょう
MsgEn:
As a daily expression of gratitude, allow me to
provide you with some useful
information in this area.

MsgJp:
ここモロー樹林では
《ヘンルーダ》というハーブが採れるのです
小さな花を付ける、一見地味なハーブですので
草花を採取される際には少し注意してご覧ください
MsgEn:
In Morrow Forest here, you can find a herb called
"Wijnruit".
It's a seemingly plain herb that bears small
flowers.
When collecting herbs, please be wary and handle
with caution.

MsgJp:
《ヘンルーダ》は爽やかな香りで
虫を寄せ付けないという効果を持っています
魔物相手にその効果は無いでしょうが――
きっと覚者様のお役に立つことと思いますよ
MsgEn:
"Wijnruit" has a refreshing fragrance
that repels insects.
Its effects may not work against monsters, but
I'm sure it will be helpful to you, Arisen.

MsgJp:
覚者様のお力添えがあるおかげで
モルフォールも何とか持ちこたえられています
MsgEn:
Thanks to the assistance of esteemed Arisen like
yourself, Morfaul has managed to hold on somehow.

MsgJp:
この村を、村人の日々を守ってくださって
ありがとうございます――
MsgEn:
Thank you for protecting this village and its
villagers day by day.

MsgJp:
覚者様により良い支援品をお届けできるよう
村の者で力を合わせて手配しております
これからも、どうぞよろしくお願いいたします
MsgEn:
To provide better support goods for esteemed
Arisen, the villagers are joining forces
to make arrangements.
We humbly ask for your continued support.
Thank you very much.

MsgJp:
覚者様がこの辺りの魔物討伐を進めて
くださったおかげで、奥地へ続く道を埋めていた
がれきを撤去することが叶いました
MsgEn:
Thanks to the efforts of the esteemed Arisen in
defeating the nearby enemies, we were able to
remove the debris that was blocking the path
to the deeper regions.

MsgJp:
今回の整備によって
《<SPOT 909>》へ足を踏み入れることが
できるようになっています、が――
MsgEn:
Thanks to this maintenance, you will now be able
to set foot into [<SPOT 909>], but...

MsgJp:
かの地はこのモルフォール一帯においても
特に侵食の進んだ森のひとつ
MsgEn:
That area is one of the forests in this entire
Morfaul region that has been particularly
ravaged by corruption.

MsgJp:
調査に行かれるときには
くれぐれも装備を揃え、細心の注意を――
MsgEn:
When going on a survey, please make sure to
prepare your equipment properly and
pay close attention--

MsgJp:
侵食の勢いはますます増すばかり――
先日は、村周辺の巡回に出た若者が
妙なものを見たと報告がありました
MsgEn:
The momentum of corruption only continues to
grow-- Recently, a young adventurer who was
patrolling the village noticed something
strange and reported it.

MsgJp:
なんでも爆発のようなものと、侵食胞子が
大量に巻き上がるのを見た――というのです
MsgEn:
I heard that they witnessed something like a
massive explosion, and an abundance of corroding
spores swirling around.

MsgJp:
すぐにでも調査に向かいたいところなのですが
新手の侵食魔が出現しており
危険度の高さから人が近寄ることを
制限せざるをえません
MsgEn:
I would love to head to the investigation
immediately, but there is a new type of
corruption-infected monster appearing, and due to
its high level of danger, we have no choice but
to restrict people from approaching.

MsgJp:
覚者様、どうか危険度の高い
新手の侵食魔を排除していただけないでしょうか
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen, could you please eliminate the highly
dangerous new infected enemies?

MsgJp:
我が村には戦える人員が少なく
覚者様のお力添えなくては
調査に向かうことができないのです――
MsgEn:
In our village, we have a shortage of
capable personnel to fight.
We cannot proceed with the investigation without
the assistance of the Arisen's power.

MsgJp:
討伐に向かっていただけるのならば
再度私にお声をかけてください
今回の件を取りまとめている者に
取り次がせていただきます
MsgEn:
If you are willing to head out for the
subjugation, please reach out to me again.
I will relay your voice to the person in charge
of handling this matter.

MsgJp:
覚者様、この度
崖崩れのあった《<SPOT 944>》付近を
復旧することに成功いたしました
MsgEn:
Dear Arisen, we have successfully restored the
area near <SPOT 944>, where the had cliff collapsed.

MsgJp:
《<SPOT 910>》に入れるようになったので
早速、調査のために
何人か人を向かわせたのですが――
MsgEn:
We've gained access to <SPOT 910> now, and we immediately
sent a few people there for investigation, but—

MsgJp:
なにやら、大地に大穴が――
クレーターというのでしょうか
そういったものができているとの
報告があったのです
MsgEn:
It seems there's a massive hole in the ground— a
crater, you might call it.
We received reports that such a thing has formed.

MsgJp:
一体何が起こっているのか
見当もつきませんが――
MsgEn: I have no idea what's going on, but...

MsgJp:
覚者様も、よろしければ
一度調査に向かってくださるよう
お願いいたします
MsgEn:
If you are willing, Arisen, we would appreciate
it if you could head there for an investigation
when you have the time.

MsgJp:
ああ、白き竜の覚者様――
今一度、お力をお貸しいただけないでしょうか
MsgEn:
Ah, esteemed Arisen of the white dragon.
Could you lend me your power once
again, if you please?

MsgJp:
先日見つかった謎のクレーター
その正体が判明したのです
MsgEn:
The mysterious crater that was
discovered the other day...
Its true identity has been revealed.

MsgJp:
この願いを聞いていただけるのであれば
再び私に話しかけてください
――どうか、お願いいたします
MsgEn:
If you are willing to grant this request,
please speak to me again.
— Please, we beseech you.

MsgJp:
今日もこのモルフォールに足を運んでくださり
ありがとうございます
MsgEn: Thank you for visiting Morfaul once again today.

MsgJp:
白き竜の覚者様
あなたのお力でモルフォールは
侵食の拡大を食い止めることができました
MsgEn:
Lord of the White Dragon, With your power, we
were able to halt the spread of
corruption by Morfaul.

MsgJp:
これからも、フィンダムにいらした際には
ぜひモルフォールにお立ち寄りください
MsgEn:
When you come to Phindym in the future, please
make sure to stop by Morfaul.

MsgJp:
より良い支援品もご用意して
いつでもお待ちしております
MsgEn:
We also have better support
goods prepared for you.
We are always ready to assist you.

MsgJp:
自分の故郷にあなたが足を運んでくだされば
きっとセシリーも喜ぶことでしょう
MsgEn:
If you would come visit my hometown, Cecily
would surely rejoice.

MsgJp:
《原始の雫》の効能に懐疑的な者もいます
しかし、今、他に何を信じれば良いというのでしょう
MsgEn:
There are also those who are skeptical of the
effects of [Primeval Drops].
However, what else should we believe in now?

MsgJp:
レスタニアの覚者たちよ
どうか、我々とともに歩んでください
MsgEn: Arisen of Lestania, please, walk with us.

MsgJp:
フィンダムに生きる我々は"さだめ"に忠実でした
大いなる流れに逆らって、一時、生きのびても
なんになるというのか――
MsgEn:
We, who live in Phindym, remained faithful to
"destiny" Even if it meant going against the
great current and surviving temporarily,
what would we become――

MsgJp:
こんな考え方の犠牲者が大勢いたのは事実
周囲の諦めが殺してしまった者も多い――
それは認めねばなりません
MsgEn:
It is a fact that there were many victims of
such a way of thinking.
Many were killed by the resignation of those
around them - That must be acknowledged.

MsgJp:
ロイグの乱心――黒い騎士の暗躍――
両方ともフィンダムに生きる我々の
気風が招いた凶事ということでしょうか
MsgEn:
Loeg's Madness - The Dark Machinations
of the Black Knight.
Both of these unfortunate events have been
brought upon us, who live in Phindym, by our own
way of life, wouldn't you say?

MsgJp: 何かご用かな？

戦技というものは奥が深い
常に学ばせていただく身だよ
MsgEn:
The art of warfare is profound.
I am always a student, constantly learning.

MsgJp:
宿泊だったら<VAL PRICE_INN>だよ
ハーブで編んだ特製の寝床を
用意してあるけど、どうかな？
MsgEn:
If it's lodging, it'll be <VAL PRICE_INN>.
I have prepared a specially woven bed made of
herbs, how about it?

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

ハーブの香りを楽しめる寝床を用意してある
疲れていたら泊まっていくといいよ
MsgEn:
We have prepared a sleeping area where you can
enjoy the scent of herbs.
If you're tired, feel free to stay overnight.

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

ふむ――この《弱化の治療》には
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>かかりそうだ
いいかな？
MsgEn:
Hmm... for this [Weakness Treatment], it seems
like it will cost <VAL PRICE_WEAK>. Is that alright?

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

おや、弱化していないようだね
元気で何よりだ
MsgEn:
Oh, it seems you haven't [Weakened,] huh?
Being healthy is the most
important thing after all.

MsgJp:
おや、何か必要なものがあるのか？
ここにあるといいんだが――
MsgEn:
Oh, is there something you need?
It would be great if it's something that's here...

MsgJp:
討伐に行くにしろ、採取を楽しむにしろ
出発前の準備は大切だ
その時々に必要なものを選別することだ
MsgEn:
Whether you're going on a quest or simply
enjoying gathering, preparation before
departure is crucial.
It's important to select the necessary
items for each occasion.

MsgJp:
ここ、モルフォール付近の森では
質の良いハーブがよく採れる
我々はそれを生活に役立てているんだ
MsgEn:
Here, in the forest near Morfaul, we often
find high-quality herbs.
We make good use of them in our daily lives.

MsgJp:
採取が目当ての場合でも
回復薬は多めに持っておくんだ
森では何が起こるかわからないぞ
MsgEn:
Even if your purpose is exploration, make sure to
carry plenty of recovery potions.
You never know what could happen in the forest.

MsgJp:
ハァイ、旅の仲間を集めたいの？
私がお手伝いできると思うわ
MsgEn:
Hello, do you want to gather fellow travelers?
I think I can help you with that.

MsgJp:
森へ行くのね
気を付けていってらっしゃい！
MsgEn:
You're going to the forest, huh?
Take care and have a safe journey!

MsgJp:
森の情報はアルトフェイルに聞いてみて
私たちも、何かあれば
まずアルトフェイルに報告してるから
MsgEn:
If you want information about the
forest, ask Arthfael.
We always report to Arthfael first
if anything happens.

MsgJp:
森には危険も多いけど
美味しい木の実なんかの恵みも豊富なの！
――今は侵食っていう問題があるけど
MsgEn:
In the forest, there are many dangers, but there
is also an abundance of blessings, like
delicious nuts and fruits!
- Although now there is a problem of corruption.

MsgJp: ん？　何か？

村には家畜も作物もあるから
隙あらばと狙っている魔物もたくさんいるんだ
だからこうして見張っているのさ
MsgEn:
Because there are both livestock and crops in the
village, there are also many monsters lurking,
waiting for an opportunity.
That's why we are keeping watch like this.

MsgJp:
他の村ではどうか知らないけど
この村では、子供を一人で
村の外に出さない決まりがあるんだ
魔物に狙われたらコトだからね
MsgEn:
I don't know about other villages, but in this
village, there is a rule not to let
children go outside alone.
It's to protect them from being
targeted by enemies.

MsgJp:
僕も子供に同行を頼まれた時には
最優先で引き受けるようにしているよ
MsgEn:
When I'm asked to accompany a child, I always
make it a top priority to accept.

MsgJp:
君は中々の実力を持っていそうだけど――
森に入るなら、友か従者を呼んだ方がいいよ
MsgEn:
You seem to have quite a bit of skill, but if
you're going into the forest, it would be wise to
bring a friend or a servant.

MsgJp: お、畑をいじりながらでもよいかな？
MsgEn:
Oh, can I tinker with the field even
while doing it?

MsgJp: 手間ひまかけるほど、野菜は美味くなるからの――
MsgEn:
The more effort you put into it, the more
delicious the vegetables become.

MsgJp:
こうして大地の恵みを楽しめるのも
精霊竜様あってのこと――
はやく"侵食"が収まればいいんじゃが――
MsgEn:
It's all thanks to the Spirit Dragon that we can
enjoy the blessings of the earth.
I hope the "Corruption" subsides soon.

MsgJp:
おっと、あの辺りは踏まないようにしてくれ
ようやく芽が出始めたところなんじゃ
MsgEn:
Oh, please be careful not to step on that area.
It looks like the buds are
finally starting to sprout.

MsgJp:
実はな、若い頃は精霊竜様のお傍で
守番として仕事をしていたこともあった――
光栄だったよ
MsgEn:
Actually, when I was young, there was a time when
I worked as a guardian by the side of the Spirit
Dragon. It was an honor.

MsgJp: あ、はい――
じ、実は侵食魔に襲われたことがあって――
MsgEn:
Um, actually, I've been attacked by
the Infected before...

MsgJp:
その時はケガするだけで済みましたけど
もし傷口からあの"侵食胞子"が入り込んでいたら
どうなっちゃってたんだろうって――
MsgEn:
At that time, I only ended up with an injury, but
if those "corruption spores" had entered through
the wound, I wonder what would have happened...

MsgJp:
僕はもう村からはあんまり出たくないんですよ
外には侵食魔がいるでしょう
MsgEn:
I don't really want to leave the village anymore.
There are corrupted Infected outside, you know.

MsgJp:
村が侵食魔に襲われないよう
祈るばかりですね――
MsgEn:
We can only pray that the village won't be
attacked by the Corruption.

MsgJp: あ、こんにちは――

僕の仕事ですか？
村の皆のお手伝いをしています
そこのクエストボードを整理したり――
MsgEn:
Is this my job?
I'm helping everyone in the village by organizing
the quest board and...

MsgJp:
まだまだ半人前ですから
皆の仕事内容を
少しずつ教えてもらってるんです
MsgEn:
I'm still just a half-baked novice, so I'm slowly
learning about everyone's job responsibilities.

MsgJp:
父の仕事を手伝いたいのですが――
父は多忙なので、僕がそばにいると
逆に手を煩わせてしまって
MsgEn:
I want to help my father with his work, but...
Since he is very busy, when I am by his side, I
end up just getting in his way instead.

MsgJp:
何かあれば遠慮なくおっしゃってくださいね
旅人に失礼が無いように、と
父に言われています
MsgEn:
If there's anything, please don't
hesitate to speak up.
It's to avoid any disrespect to the traveler, I
have been told by my father.

MsgJp: はいはい、何でしょう

森で採れるハーブは生活に欠かせませんよ
それだけに、森の侵食が進むのは怖くって――
MsgEn:
Herbs harvested from the forest are
indispensable in daily life.
That's why I'm scared to see the forest being
corrupted and overrun.

MsgJp:
草木の侵食が進んでいるところや
侵食魔がいた辺りでは
ハーブを採らないようにしてるんですよ
MsgEn:
In areas where the corruption of vegetation is
advancing, or where there are infected beings, I
make sure not to gather herbs.

MsgJp:
ハーブは料理にも使いますから
気をつけなくちゃって
MsgEn:
Since herbs are also used in cooking, you
have to be careful.

MsgJp:
ふぅ、少し休んだら
干したハーブの様子を見に行かなくちゃ
MsgEn:
Phew.
After taking a little break I should go
check on the dried herbs.

MsgJp: あら、覚者様

異国の地でご不便はありませんか？
セントラムに大体のものは揃っているので
何かご用があれば、ぜひ
MsgEn:
Do you have any inconveniences
in this foreign land?
Most things are available in Centrum, so if you
need anything, please feel free to ask.

MsgJp:
我々としても、どうにか遺跡に踏み込んで
調査を行いたいところだが、封印が施されている
場所もあって手を付けられないでいるのだ
MsgEn:
As for us, we would like to somehow enter the
ruins and conduct investigations, but there are
places that have been sealed and
we cannot touch them.

MsgJp:
村の内では若者たちの不満がくすぶり
村の外では魔物が着々とその勢力を
広めている――悩ましいことだ
MsgEn:
Within the village, the dissatisfaction of the
young people smolders, while outside the village,
the enemy steadily expands its influence - a
troubling situation.

MsgJp:
異国の覚者よ
貴君、この村の者に
何かと話しかけているのか？
MsgEn:
Oh, wise one from a foreign land.
Are you speaking to the people of this
village about something?

MsgJp:
――いや、俺から何か言うことではないが
オイングスが貴君に話したいことが
あるそうだ
MsgEn:
Well, it's not for me to say, but it seems that
Oengus has something he wants to
talk to you about.

MsgJp:
話を聞いてやってもらえるのなら
もう一度俺に話しかけてくれ
取り次がせてもらおう
MsgEn:
If you can listen to my story, please talk to me
again, and I'll make sure to pass it on.

MsgJp:
そういえば、異国の覚者よ――
先日はオイングスの頼みを聞いてもらったそうだな
MsgEn:
By the way, esteemed Arisen from a foreign land,
I heard that you recently helped
Oengus with a request.

MsgJp:
どうやらヤツも最初は秘密にしたかったようだが
キンガルに異変が起きているかもしれない、と
打ち明けてきたのだ
MsgEn:
It seems that he also wanted to keep it a secret
at first, but he confided in me that there may be
a disturbance in Kingal.

MsgJp:
俺からも族長として礼を言おう
村の危機を救ってくれて感謝する
MsgEn:
I, as the chief, shall also express my gratitude.
Thank you for saving the village from crisis.

MsgJp:
――異なる竜に仕えているというのに
フィンダムにも救いの手を差し伸べてくれるとは
貴君も人が良いのだな
MsgEn:
To think that even while serving different
dragons, you would extend a
helping hand to Phindym.
You truly are a kind-hearted person.

MsgJp:
ひとつ――
聞き流してくれて構わんのだが
少し耳を貸してくれないだろうか
MsgEn:
One thing―― I don't mind if you just let it pass
you by, but could you lend me your
ear for a moment?

MsgJp:
《<SPOT 911>》から魔物が這い出して
きているという報告が入ってきている
どうしても中を改めねばならん時がきているようだ
MsgEn:
We have received reports that monsters are
crawling out from [<SPOT 911>].
It seems that the time has come when we
absolutely need to make changes inside.

MsgJp:
異国の者を頼るということに
村の内部ではまだ抵抗する者が多い――
しかし、フィンダムの覚者が不在である今
頼れるのは貴君しかいないのだ
MsgEn:
There are still many within the village who
resist the idea of relying on outsiders.
However, with the absence of Phindym's Arisen,
you are the only one we can depend on right now.

MsgJp:
もし貴君さえよければ
かの遺跡の内部を調べてきて
もらえないだろうか――
意にそわねば、聞かなかったことにしてくれ
MsgEn:
If you're willing, could you investigate the
interior of that ancient ruin?
If you don't feel like it, you can
pretend you didn't hear it.

MsgJp:
この考えは最近確信に変わったのだが
貴君は――心からの良心によって
グリンデュアを救おうとしてくれているのだな
MsgEn:
This belief has turned into a conviction for me
recently, and you... you're trying to save
Glyndwr with all your heart.

MsgJp:
確かに、この未曾有の危機にあって
我らの覚者に頼ることもできないとあっては
貴君の助けを受け入れた方がよいだろう
MsgEn:
Certainly, in this unprecedented crisis, we
can't rely on our Arisen.
It would be better to accept your help.

MsgJp:
――ここは考え込んではいられない
俺は、このグリンデュアの族長として
正式に貴君の助けを請うことにしよう
MsgEn:
I cannot afford to hesitate here. As the chief of
Glyndwr, I have decided to formally
request your assistance.

MsgJp:
村人の中にはまだ貴君のことを
受け入れられない者も多いかもしれないが
どうか、大目に見てやってほしい
MsgEn:
There may still be many villagers who cannot
accept you, but please, be understanding.

MsgJp:
過去を守ることで存続してきた村なのだ
そう簡単に全てを変えられるわけではない――
だが、過去に囚われ前進を拒む姿勢は
俺が正してゆこう
MsgEn:
This village has endured by upholding its past.
It's not so simple to change everything, but I
will rectify the mindset that refuses to move
forward, bound by the past.

MsgJp:
なんといっても、文句を言う者たちも
《<SPOT 947>》に現れた魔物を
打ち倒す力を持ってはいないのだから――
MsgEn:
After all, even those who complain themselves
don't have the power to slay the monsters
that have appeared in
<SPOT 947>...

MsgJp:
あの場に魔物がとどまっているせいで
南東の遺跡の調査に進めない状態なのだ
MsgEn:
We can't continue with the investigation of the
southeastern ruins because monsters are
lingering at that site.

MsgJp:
《<SPOT 947>》の近くを通ることがあれば
魔物を追い払ってくれるよう
頼めないだろうか
MsgEn:
If you happen to pass by near <SPOT 947>, could you please
help drive away the monsters?

MsgJp:
貴君はこの村において
どんどん理解者を増やしているようだな
MsgEn:
It seems that you are steadily increasing your
understanding of this village, Ser.

MsgJp:
先日、シェドレアン大神殿前の橋の
修繕が終わったのは知っているか？
実は、そこへ魔族が現れ
いまだ通行が難しくなっている
MsgEn:
Did you know that the bridge leading into the
Shadolean Great Temple was finally
repaired the other day?
Some terrible abominations have appeared there,
making it still difficult to pass through.

MsgJp:
この件について、ボーデシアが
貴君に言いたいことがあるというのだ
MsgEn:
Boadicea has something to tell you
about this matter.

MsgJp:
今まで若者との間に軋轢を生んでいた
ボーデシアでさえ、貴君に話がしたいと
いうのだから大したものだな――
MsgEn:
Even Boadicea, who has been causing tension among
the young people, wants to talk to you –
that's quite something.

MsgJp:
ああ、ボーデシアに話をしに行くのであれば
俺にもう一度話しかけてほしい
責任を持って取り次がせてもらおう
MsgEn:
Ah, if you're going to talk to Boadicea, please
talk to me again. I'll make sure to
relay it responsibly.

MsgJp:
異国の覚者よ、聞いてほしい――
《<SPOT 912>》はこのキンガルに
おいてもかなり大規模な遺跡だ
MsgEn:
Listen, foreign Arisen. <SPOT 912> is quite a large ruin
even here in Kingal.

MsgJp:
しかし、実はここについても
気軽に調査ができるわけではないのだ
なんといっても、入口は厳重に封印されている
MsgEn:
However, the truth is that you can't just
casually investigate this place.
After all, the entrance is securely sealed.

MsgJp:
《<SPOT 912>》は元々神殿として
使われていた遺跡――
MsgEn:
<SPOT 912> was originally an ancient ruin that served
as a Temple.

MsgJp:
恐らくその場で働いていたと思われる
巫女が《<SPOT 913>》に葬られている
MsgEn:
It is believed that the shrine maiden who was
probably working there is buried at <SPOT 913>.

MsgJp:
彼女の墓である《<SPOT 913>》を
調査することで、封印を解く
手がかりが得られるはずだ
MsgEn:
By investigating her grave at <SPOT 913>, you should be
able to find clues to break the seal.

MsgJp:
我々も調査隊を出そうとは思っているが
まずは貴君に先行して魔物を討ち倒しておいて
もらいたいのだ――頼めるだろうか
MsgEn:
We are also planning to send out an investigation
team, but first, we would like you to take the
lead and defeat the enemies.
Can we count on you for this?

MsgJp:
先日は世話になった――
貴君に《<SPOT 913>》へ先行してもらった
おかげで、後続の調査隊は安全に
調査に集中できたという
MsgEn:
I am grateful for your assistance the other day.
Thanks to you, the subsequent investigation team
was able to safely concentrate on their
investigation after you went ahead to <SPOT 913>.

MsgJp:
さらに、その時の調査によって
《<SPOT 912>》の封印を解くための
手がかりをえることができたのだ
MsgEn:
Furthermore, through the investigation at that
time, we were able to obtain clues to
unlock the seal of <SPOT 912>.

MsgJp:
――だが、悪い知らせもある
封印を解こうとしている動きを
魔物たちに察知されたようだ
MsgEn:
However, there is also bad news.
It seems that the movement to release the seal
has been detected by the enemy monsters.

MsgJp:
《<SPOT 949>》に魔族が現れ
我々の行く手を阻んでいる
それどころか、この村に侵攻しようとする
動きすらあるのだ
MsgEn:
Fiends have appeared in [<SPOT 949>], blocking our path.
Not only that, they are even trying to
invade this village.
I've been wary of their movements.

MsgJp:
異国の――いや、白き竜の覚者よ
我々が封印を解かんとしている間
湧き出でる魔族を討伐してほしい――
MsgEn:
O Arisen of the White Dragon, While we are in the
process of unsealing, We ask that you subdue
the resurgent Fiends.

MsgJp:
うまくいけば、あと少しで
この騒動にも決着がつくはずなのだ――
MsgEn:
If all goes well, there should be a resolution to
this turmoil soon—just a little further to go.

MsgJp:
白き竜の覚者よ――
よい頃合いに来てくれた！
MsgEn:
Oh, Arisen of the White Dragon!
You have come at a good time!

MsgJp:
かねてより封印を解かんと励んでいた
《<SPOT 912>》の封印を
ついに解くことができたのだ！
MsgEn:
I had long striven to break the seal on the <SPOT 912>, and
at last, I have succeeded!

MsgJp:
どうか、かの神殿に赴き
魔族が活性化した理由を
探ってきてもらえないだろうか
MsgEn:
Please, visit the Temple and investigate the
reason behind the Fiends' resurgence.

MsgJp:
引き受けてもらえるのなら
あの辺りの事情について詳しい者を
貴君に紹介しよう
準備ができたら俺に話しかけてくれ
MsgEn:
If you're willing to take on the task, I'll
introduce someone who knows the
situation in that area well.
When you're ready, talk to me.

MsgJp:
グリンデュアの様子を見にきてくれたのか
ありがたいことだ――
MsgEn:
Did you come to see the state of Glyndwr?
I appreciate it.

MsgJp:
あれ以来は静かなものだ――
侵食という災いはいまだ大地をむしばんでいるが
忌まわしい魔族に脅かされることはない
MsgEn:
Since then, it has been quiet— Though the
calamity of corruption still gnaws at the land,
we'll not be threatened by such
loathsome abberations.

MsgJp:
貴君には続けて世話になったな
この辺りに来た時は、今日のように
ぜひ村に寄ってくれ
MsgEn:
I have relied on your kind
assistance for some time now.
When you come to this area, please be sure
to visit the village.

MsgJp:
グリンデュアは貴君のために
より質の良い支援品を集めておくことを
約束しよう
MsgEn:
Glyndwr promises to gather better-quality
support items for you.
It's thanks to your help that we were able to
recapture the Thines fort, after all.

MsgJp:
白き竜の覚者よ――
実は、グリンデュアはまたも
魔族の脅威にさらされているのだ――
MsgEn:
Arisen of the White Dragon, Glyndwr is once again
threatened by the forces of darkness.

MsgJp:
《シェレドアン大神殿》は一因にすぎないと
すれば、どこかに魔族がやってくる
元凶となる場があるはずなのだが――
今のところ見つかっていない
MsgEn:
The "Shadolean Great Temple" is only one factor.
There must be a place where the monsters come
from, the root cause.
But it hasn't been found yet.

MsgJp:
過去の文献をあたることで手がかりが
つかめるかと、文献が多数残されている小塔への
門を開けることにした
MsgEn:
By accessing past records, we hope to find clues.
So, I decided to open the gate to the small
tower, where numerous documents
have been preserved.

MsgJp:
また、このキンガル峡谷のため
手を貸してはもらえないだろうか――
MsgEn: Could you lend a hand for the Kingal Canyon too?

MsgJp:
白き竜の覚者よ
どうか聞いてほしい――
MsgEn:
Oh, Arisen of the White Dragon, I hope
you will listen...

MsgJp:
キンガル峡谷北部には
《<SPOT 914>》という
大規模な遺跡があるのだが――
MsgEn:
In the northern part of Kingal Canyon, there's a
large ruin called the <SPOT 914>, but –

MsgJp:
実は、その遺跡を中心に強力な魔物が
徘徊しているという情報が入ってきているのだ
MsgEn:
In fact, there is information that powerful
enemies are wandering around the ruins.

MsgJp:
我が村の者が魔物と対峙しても
生きて戻ってくることは難しいだろう――
覚者よ、どうかその白き竜の加護によって
魔物を打ち払ってもらえないだろうか
MsgEn:
It is difficult for our villagers to confront the
enemy and return alive.
Arisen, would you please help drive away the
enemies with the protection of the White Dragon?

MsgJp:
――《<SPOT 914>》の近くには
《<SPOT 959>》という
人の住まう塔がある
MsgEn:
Near <SPOT 914>, there is a tower inhabited
by people called <SPOT 959>.

MsgJp:
かの塔に暮らす人々は独自の文化を持つため
交流になかなかの難しさがあるのだが――
MsgEn:
The people who live in that Tower have their own
unique culture, so there are quite a few
difficulties in communication.

MsgJp:
昨今の魔族出現の件にて交渉を重ね、拠点として
門戸を開放するよう約束を取り付けた
MsgEn:
Through repeated negotiations regarding the
recent appearance of Fiends, a promise was
secured to open the gates and
establish a Hall as a base.

MsgJp:
恐らく住民には歓迎されないだろうとは思うが
《<SPOT 959>》を調査の足場として
あるいは旅の疲れを癒すため
役立ててほしい――
MsgEn:
It probably will not be welcomed by the
residents, but you can use <SPOT 959> as a base for your
investigations, or to rest from your travels.

MsgJp:
魔物の討伐を引き受けてもらえるなら
俺にその件を話しかけてくれ
詳しく説明しよう
MsgEn:
If you can take on the task of subduing monsters,
please approach me about that matter.
I'll explain it in detail.

MsgJp:
貴君には度々力を貸してもらっているというのに
不甲斐ないことだが、状況は悪化の
一路を辿るばかりだ――
MsgEn:
I've had you lend your strength many times, and
I'm sorry for my ineffectiveness.
The situation is only getting worse.

MsgJp:
とうとう、これまで儀式に使われていた場にまで
侵食魔の姿が確認されるように
なってしまった――
MsgEn:
Finally, the appearance of the Corruption has
been confirmed in the very place
where rituals were held.

MsgJp:
《<SPOT 953>》――元は大地に
季節の感謝を表す舞踊を奉じる場だったのだ
最近は魔物の凶暴性が高まったがゆえに
安全を考えて中止されていたが――
MsgEn:
[<SPOT 953>] ――Originally, it was a place to
perform a dance that expressed gratitude for
seasons of the earth.
Recently, it has been cancelled for safety
reasons due to the increased aggression of the
enemies.

MsgJp:
侵食は大地だけではなく
我々の文化も蝕んでゆくという一例なのだろうな
――もっと早くに対処していれば――
MsgEn:
Corruption not only consumes the land, but also
serves as an example of how it erodes our culture.
If only we had dealt with it sooner...

MsgJp:
今まで立ち入りを禁じていた
《<SPOT 915>》も
もはや封鎖している意味はないだろう
MsgEn:
There is now no longer any meaning in continuing
to block off <SPOT 915> that was previously
prohibited from being entered.

MsgJp:
封鎖はすでに解いてある――
もしも貴君の調査によって
何らかの手がかりとなるようであれば
ぜひ調べてみてくれ――
MsgEn:
The seal has already been broken. If your
investigation could provide any
clues, please examine it.

MsgJp:
来てくれてよかった――
こちらから貴君へ遣いを出そうかと
思案していたところだ
MsgEn:
I'm glad you came. I was considering sending
someone to you to discuss matters.

MsgJp:
先ほど判明したのだが、小塔に収められた
書物に"スカージ"の名があったのだ
――強大な悪魔の名前だ
MsgEn:
I found out earlier that the book stored in the
small tower has the name "Scourge." It's the name
of a powerful demon.

MsgJp:
今まで魔族が無尽蔵に襲来していたのは
スカージが呼び寄せていたせいだろう
MsgEn:
The reason why the fiends have been invading
endlessly until now is probably because of the
Scourge calling them.

MsgJp:
今、あの強大な魔物に太刀打ちできるのは
白き竜の覚者――貴君だけだろう
どうか、ヤツを討ってくれないだろうか
MsgEn:
Now, the one who can confront that mighty demon
is the White Dragon's Arisen – perhaps you
can defeat it for us?

MsgJp:
今までの敵とは違う、あまりにも
危険すぎる相手だ――
無理にとは言えない――
MsgEn:
This is a different kind of danger from the
enemies we've faced so far – it's not
something we can force.

MsgJp:
だが、もし――
もしも、此度も力を貸してくれるのであれば
再び俺に声をかけてほしい――
MsgEn:
However, if... if you are willing to lend your
strength again this time, please call
on me once more.

MsgJp:
おお、白き竜の覚者よ――
よく来てくれた
MsgEn:
Oh, Arisen of the White Dragon ―― Thank
you for coming.

MsgJp:
侵食という未曾有の災害に見舞われたフィンダム
その中でも、さらに魔族の脅威に繰り返し
さらされたグリンデュアが――今もこうして
あるのは全て貴君の力添えあってこそ
MsgEn:
Phindym was struck by the unprecedented disaster
of Corruption. Even amidst that devastation,
Glyndwr was relentlessly attacked by
monstrosities, but is still here today,
thanks to your support.

MsgJp:
これまでの礼として
今後、貴君への支給品の質をより向上させる
ことを決定した
MsgEn:
As a token of gratitude so far, we have decided
to improve the quality of supplies to
you in the future.

MsgJp:
これは俺だけではなく
このグリンデュアの民の総意だ
どうか受け取ってくれ
MsgEn:
This is not just from me, but the unanimous
decision of the people of
Glyndwr. Please accept it.

MsgJp:
白き竜の覚者よ
きっと来てくれるものと思っていた
MsgEn:
Oh, Arisen of the White Dragon, I believed that
you would surely come.

MsgJp:
今、フィンダムに覚者はいない
セシリーが覚者としてすごしていたならば
――いや、こんなことを言ってもしようがないな
MsgEn:
Currently, there are no Arisen in Phindym.
If Cecily had lived as an Arisen...
No, there's no point in saying such things.

MsgJp:
みな不安がっている
もし、時間があればだが――
頼りに思う貴君に声をかけられれば、少しは
気も安らぐことだろう
MsgEn:
Everyone is feeling anxious. If you have the
time, it would be reassuring for us if you, whom
we rely on, could lend us your voice.

MsgJp:
ガラダがフィンダム中の族長に
いち早く連携を提案してくれた
これは、先日の危機を乗り越えた賜物といえるな
MsgEn:
Gearóid reached out to the chieftains of Phindym,
proposing cooperation swiftly.
This is truly a testament to
overcoming the recent crisis.

MsgJp:
ああ――異国の覚者ね
何の用かしら
MsgEn:
Oh, you're an Arisen from a foreign land.
What do you need?

MsgJp:
ここまで来るのに疲れたって？
一眠りすれば楽になるんじゃない
ここに泊まるなら<VAL PRICE_INN>だけど
泊まっていくの？
MsgEn:
You're tired from coming all this way?
Maybe you'll feel better after a nap.
If you're staying here, it's <VAL PRICE_INN>.
Are you going to stay?

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

疲れてるんなら
ホラ、寝床好きに使っていいから――
で、休んでいくの？
MsgEn:
If you're tired, well, you can use my bed if you
want―― So, are you going to rest?

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

――《弱化の治療》なら
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>よ
まぁ、どうするかは自分次第ね
治療していく？
MsgEn:
If it's [Weakness Treatment,] it's <VAL PRICE_WEAK>.
Well, it's up to you what to do.
Shall we proceed with the treatment?

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

なんだ、弱化してないじゃない
眠いんなら泊まっていきなさいよ
腹が減ってるならシェナの料理を
食べていくといい
MsgEn:
What, you haven't [Weakened,] have you?
If you're tired, why don't you stay the night?
And if you're hungry, it's best to
eat Shena's cuisine.

MsgJp:
あたしはココを切り盛りしてるだけよ
エリアの情報はキアランに聞くのね
MsgEn:
I'm just managing this place.
If you want information about
the area, ask Ciarán.

MsgJp:
キアランはやたら考えこむクセがあるわ
聞きたいことがあるなら要点を絞って聞くことね
じゃないと、話が長くなるから
MsgEn:
Ciarán has a habit of overthinking.
If you have something you want to
ask, make it concise.
Otherwise, the conversation will drag on.

MsgJp:
ん？
キアランはあたしのダンナよ
