考え込むのが好きで、素早く物事を決めないから
拠点の中のことはあたしが回した方が
効率がいいの
MsgEn:
Because I enjoy pondering and don't make quick
decisions, it's more efficient for me to handle
matters within the base.

MsgJp:
少し休んでいく？
疲れた顔のままではここから出せないわね
MsgEn:
Are you going to take a little rest?
You can't go out from here with such a tired face.

MsgJp:
キアランはやたら考え込むでしょう
だから、今は立ち止まって考えるのをやめて
村の皆がいつも通り暮らせるようにってことにだけ
集中するように言ったのよ
MsgEn:
Ciarán tends to ponder a lot, doesn't he?
That's why I told him to stop and not
think too much for now.
Just concentrate on ensuring that everyone in the
village can live as usual.

MsgJp:
それぞれが怯えて
妙なことをし始めないようにね
MsgEn:
So that each person does not start doing
strange things out of fear.

MsgJp:
怖くないといえば嘘になる
でも、眠っているとはいえ精霊竜セシリーがいて
こうして異国の人たちも来てくれてる
MsgEn:
To say that it's not scary would be a lie.
But even though she's asleep, Spirit
Dragon Cecily is here.
And we also have people from foreign lands
like this who have come.

MsgJp:
それに、あたしにはキアランがいる
キアランにはあたしが付いてる
――きっと、それほど悪くないわ
MsgEn:
And, I have Ciarán, and Ciarán has me.
Surely, it's not that bad.

MsgJp:
ダナが戦士を出してくれたって聞いてるわ
きっとあたしたち、"前の騒動"の時よりかは
結束できているのよね
MsgEn:
I heard Dana has sent out warriors. I'm sure
we're more united than during the
"previous incident."

MsgJp: よっ、色々見ていってくれ
MsgEn: Hey, go ahead and take a look at various things.

MsgJp: 何で"大人"って怖がりなんだろうな
MsgEn: I wonder why "adults" are always afraid.

MsgJp:
あのさ、この村で建設的な話ができるのは
マヴェイル兄貴だけだぜ！
――俺はそう思ってる！
MsgEn:
Listen, there's no one else in this village I can
have a constructive conversation with except for
my big brother Mavail. That's what I think.

MsgJp:
"立派な大人"たちは、ほら――
頭が固いんだよな
ああはなりたくないよ
MsgEn:
"Respected adults" are often quite stubborn. I
hope I don't become like that.

MsgJp:
あ、ああ
覚者さんか、いらっしゃい

キアランが普段通り店を開けろっていうから
こうしてるけどさぁ――
MsgEn:
Because Ciarán told me to open the shop as usual,
I'm doing it like this, you know...

MsgJp:
大変なことになったって、頭ではわかってるんだけど
いまいち実感が無いんだ――悪い冗談みたいでさ
かと思えば、急にものすごく怖くなる
どうしたらいいのかな
MsgEn:
I know in my head that things have become really
difficult, but I can't quite grasp the reality of
it—it feels like a bad joke.
And then suddenly, I become incredibly scared.
What should I do?

MsgJp:
あのさ――これで終わりなんかじゃないよな
フィンダムは――まだ、なんとかなるよな
頼むよ、そうだって言ってくれ
MsgEn:
Hey, you know... this can't be the end, right?
Phindym... there has to be a way.
Please, tell me it's true.

MsgJp:
呼んだかい！
さっ、何が食べたい？
MsgEn:
Have you called for me?
Well then, what would you like to eat?

MsgJp:
さぁさぁ、お腹いっぱい食べとくれ！
覚者さんも体が資本でしょ
食べて力付けなきゃ！
MsgEn:
Come on, come on, eat until your belly is full!
Even the Arisen relies on their body.
You have to eat and gain strength!

MsgJp: 何だい、好き嫌いしちゃダメだよ！
MsgEn: What's wrong? You can't be picky!

MsgJp:
ガッカリきた時、活力が出ない時――
そんな時は美味しいものを食べるのが一番だよ！
さ、何が食べたい？
MsgEn:
When you're disappointed, when you lack
vitality―― The best thing to do is eat
something delicious!
So, what do you want to eat?

MsgJp:
覚者さん、お腹いっぱい食べてっとくれ！
こんな時だからこそ、食べるのを
おろそかにしちゃいけないんだから！
MsgEn:
Arisen, please eat until you're full!
Especially at times like this, you
shouldn't neglect to eat !

MsgJp:
明日この世が終わるってわけでもないんだろう？
だったら、今日食べて、明日も食べなきゃ
毎日美味しいものを作るからさ――
MsgEn:
This world isn't ending tomorrow, is it?
So, let's eat today and tomorrow too, I'll make
something delicious every day――

MsgJp:
空を見たかって？
――見たくないから、見てないよ
変に見ちゃったら怖くなるかもしれないからね
MsgEn:
You want to look at the sky?
Well, I haven't looked because I might get scared
if I see something strange.

MsgJp:
みんな、お腹いっぱい食べれば
少しは落ち着くと思うんだけど
緊張しちゃって食べる気にならないみたい
MsgEn:
Everyone might feel a bit calmer if they eat
their fill, but it seems they're
too nervous to eat.

MsgJp: 同行者を探したいなら手を貸そう
MsgEn: If you want to find a companion, let me help you.

MsgJp:
遺跡には近寄るなよ
村の者にはよく言い聞かせてある
異国の覚者とて例外ではない
MsgEn:
Don't approach the ruins. I've made it clear to
the villagers. Even foreign
Arisen are not exceptions.

MsgJp:
自分が異国から来たからといって
ここの掟を軽んじないことだ
MsgEn:
Just because you're from a foreign land doesn't
mean you should disregard the rules here.

MsgJp:
遺跡に近づく者あらば災いが起こる――
そう言い伝えられているのだ
MsgEn:
Trouble is said to befall those who approach the
ruins. This is a well-established belief.

MsgJp:
先人の知恵を無視して
村の平穏は無い
MsgEn:
Ignoring the wisdom of our ancestors, the
village knows no peace.

MsgJp: ううむ――

あの渦、まるでこの世の災いという災いを
かき集めたかのような禍禍しさだ
MsgEn:
That vortex, it exudes a calamitous intent, as if
gathering all the misfortunes of this world.

MsgJp:
用が無いなら話しかけるな
今は気軽に話していられる状況ではない
MsgEn:
If you have no business, do not talk to me.
It is not a situation where we can
speak casually right now.

MsgJp:
フィンダムは災い続きだ
やはり、言い伝えを――先人の知恵を
無視したからこうなっているのでは――
そう考えるのも当然のことだと思わないか
MsgEn:
Phindym has been plagued by disasters.
It's natural to think that it's because they
ignored traditions and wisdom passed
down by their ancestors.

MsgJp: ――何か用でも？
MsgEn: Yes, may I help you with something?

MsgJp:
遺跡には近付くことなかれ――
これは昔からこの村に伝わる掟だ
近付いたら、村に一体どんな災いが起こるか――
MsgEn:
Do not approach the ruins―― This is a rule that
has been passed down in this village
since ancient times.
If you approach, what kind of disaster will
befall the village――

MsgJp:
その昔、神殿に足を踏み入れた者がいたそうな――
無事に神殿を出ることはできたんだが
安心して後ろを振り返った瞬間――
MsgEn:
In the old days, it is said that someone
set foot in the temple.
They managed to get out safely, but the moment
they relaxed and looked back—

MsgJp:
神殿の入り口から伸びた巨大な腕に
ズバーッと頭から切り裂かれた！！
MsgEn:
A massive arm extended from the temple entrance
and slashed them right through,
from the head first!!

MsgJp:
――という話もあるんだぞ
古い場所には近寄らないことだ
MsgEn:
There's a saying that you shouldn't
approach the old places.

MsgJp:
――お前さん
自分だけは強いから
遺跡の災いも怖くないと思ってるんじゃないか？
思い上がりだぞ、それは
MsgEn:
You think you're invincible because you believe
that the danger of the ruins doesn't scare you?
That's just arrogance.

MsgJp:
あの渦を見ろ！
はやくどうにかしてくれ！
MsgEn:
Look at that vortex! Please, do
something about it soon!

MsgJp:
こんな空は見たことがない
ああ、一生見たくなかった！
MsgEn:
I've never seen a sky like this. Oh, I
wish I'd never seen it!

MsgJp:
とんでもないことになるぞ――
災いだ、きっとこれこそが遺跡の災いだ！
MsgEn:
This is going to be a major disaster, I'm sure of
it! A calamity! It must be the
disaster of the ruins!

MsgJp:
どこかに逃げないといけないんじゃないか？
キアランは落ち着くべきだと言っていたが
本当は自分たちだけ逃げるつもりなんじゃ――？
く、口ではなんとでも言えるぞ
MsgEn:
Do we need to escape somewhere?
Ciarán said we should calm down, but are we
really planning to escape on our own?
Hah, you can say anything with
your mouth, can't you?

MsgJp: ああ、異国の覚者さんか
MsgEn: Ah, an Arisen from a foreign land.

MsgJp:
もっと遠くに採掘に行けたらなぁ――
村も潤うし、いいこと尽くめなのにな――
MsgEn:
If only we could go mining further away— The
village would prosper, and it would be all good.—

MsgJp:
この村では遠出は禁じられているんだ
俺の脚なら遠出しても
その日のうちに帰ってこられるのに――
MsgEn:
In this village, going far is prohibited.
Even if it's a long journey, with my legs, I can
return home within the same day--

MsgJp: 覚者さんも何か言われなかったかい
MsgEn: Did they not say something about you, Arisen?

MsgJp:
遺跡に近寄るなー、災いがふりかかるぞー
――とかさ
MsgEn:
Don't get too close to the ruins,
disaster will strike.
Or so they say...

MsgJp:
来てくれたのか！
覚者さんの顔を見たら、何だかほっとしたよ
MsgEn:
You came! When I saw the face of the Arisen I
felt relieved for some reason.

MsgJp:
ダナが精鋭の戦士を出してくれたらしい
あの渦の真下の辺りに向かったんだろう
偉そうな奴らが多い村だと思ってたけど
意外と頼りになるんだな
MsgEn:
It seems that Dana sent out elite soldiers.
They must have headed towards the area right
below that vortex.
I thought this village was full of arrogant
people, but they unexpectedly turned out to be
dependable.

MsgJp:
今は遠出する気にならないよ
できるだけ家族の近くにいたい
万が一の時に、傍にいたいからさ
MsgEn:
Right now, I don't feel like going far away.
I want to be close to my family
as much as possible.
In case something happens, I want
to be by their side.

MsgJp:
アデリンは――
こんな時でも物見台か
後で迎えに行ってやらないと
MsgEn:
Adelin, even in times like these, you're still at
the observatory, huh? I'll have to go
pick you up later.

MsgJp: ――なんでしょう？

遺跡に近づこうなんて思わないでくださいね
あなただけじゃなく、村に災いが
降りかかったらどうするんです
MsgEn:
Please refrain from approaching the ruins.
Not only you, but if the village were to suffer a
disaster, what would you do?

MsgJp:
わたしはね、ビックリするようなことは
何一つ望んでないんですよ
良いことも悪いこともね
MsgEn:
You know, I don't wish for anything surprising at
all, whether it's something good or something bad.

MsgJp:
何事も無いのが一番――
だから、外から何かを持ちこまないでくださいね
MsgEn:
Nothing happening is the best of all.
So, please don't bring anything from the outside.

MsgJp:
若い時は刺激を欲しがりますけどね
何かが変わるのが良いか悪いかなんて
誰も正確に予測できませんよ
MsgEn:
When you're young, you often seek excitement, but
whether it's for better or worse, no one can
predict what will change.

MsgJp:
悪い方にいったらどうするんです
今のままで十分――
MsgEn:
What if it goes wrong? Things are fine
as they are now.

MsgJp:
ああ、怖い、どうしましょう
この気味が悪い空の色――
MsgEn:
Ah, this is scary. What should we do about
this eerie sky color?

MsgJp:
精霊竜セシリーはどうしてまだ目覚めないのかしら
フィンダムが大変なのよ！
どんな理由があったって、眠っている場合じゃないわ
MsgEn:
Why hasn't Spirit Dragon Cecily awakened yet?
Phindym is in great trouble!
No matter what the reason is, it's not the
time to be sleeping.

MsgJp:
ただ平和に暮らしていきたいだけなのに――
どうしてこんなことになるの
MsgEn:
We just want to live in peace, yet...
Why did this happen?

MsgJp:
ねぇ、前みたいに
フィンダムを助けに来てくれたんでしょう？
それとも、わたしたちをどこかへ逃がすために
来てくれたんですか？
MsgEn:
Hey, did you come to help us like you did before?
Or did you come to take us somewhere
and help us escape?

MsgJp: えっと、なぁに？
ママがあんまりよその人と話しちゃダメって――
MsgEn: Mom said I shouldn't talk to strangers...

MsgJp:
ほんとは、村の外の話を
聞かせて欲しいんだけど――
MsgEn:
I actually want you to tell me stories from
outside the village, but...

MsgJp:
ねぇ、色んな村を見てきたんでしょう？
"芯なる樹"を近くで見たことはある？
MsgEn:
Hey, have you seen many villages?
Have you ever seen the Core Tree up close?

MsgJp:
村から出ちゃいけないって言われるけど
いつか色んなところに行ってみたいの
MsgEn:
Although I'm told not to leave the village, I
still have a strong desire to explore
different places someday.

MsgJp:
大人になったら
もっと近くで"芯なる樹"を見にいけるかな――
MsgEn:
When I become an adult, I wonder if I can go see
the [Core Tree] up close...

MsgJp:
空の色が――
この色、きらい
MsgEn:
The color of the sky...
I don't like this color.

MsgJp:
"芯なる樹"はいつだってきれいだって
思ってたけど――この空の色だと
あんまりきれいに見えない――
MsgEn:
I always thought the [Core Tree] was beautiful,
but the sky's color doesn't make
it look as pretty.

MsgJp:
空の渦、怖いのに
一度見始めるとずっと見ちゃうの
それでもっと怖くなるから――
もう見たくない
MsgEn:
I'm scared of the swirling vortex, but once I
start watching, I can't stop.
And that makes it even scarier – I don't
want to see it anymore.

MsgJp:
空はまた元に戻る？
はやく戻ってくれないと、怖い夢を見そう
MsgEn:
Will the sky return to normal? It needs to come
back soon, or I'll have nightmares.

MsgJp:
塔の外からお越しとは――
用があるならお聞きしましょう
MsgEn:
You've come from outside the tower? If you have
business, I'll be happy to listen.

MsgJp:
宿泊をご希望なら<VAL PRICE_INN>です
ここは資源が限られていることもあり
旅人に大盤振る舞いというのはできないのです
それでも、よろしいですか？
MsgEn:
If you're looking for accommodation, it's <VAL PRICE_INN>.
We have limited resources here, so we can't
afford to be extravagant with travelers. Is
that acceptable to you?

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

今は寝床に余裕があります
休みたいなら案内しましょうか？
MsgEn:
There's plenty of room for a bed now. If you want
to rest, shall I show you the way?

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

《弱化の治療》には
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>いただきますよ
なにぶん、物資も限られていますからね
治療をお望みですか？
MsgEn:
For the [Weakness Treatment,] the cost is <VAL PRICE_WEAK>
. We have limited supplies, you see. Do you wish
to receive treatment?

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

弱化にはなっていませんよ
気のせい、ということです
よろしいですね
MsgEn:
You haven't been [Weakened,] you know.
It's just your imagination.
Alright then, understood?

MsgJp:
どうして塔に住んでいるのか、ですか？
我らは守っているのです
この塔に住むことで――
MsgEn:
Why do we live in the tower?
We are here to protect it.
By living in this tower...

MsgJp:
何を守っているのかは――
長老のベレナスにでもお聞きください
我らは祖先より代々、この塔にて"守る"ために
ここにいると聞かされています
MsgEn:
What we are protecting, you should ask
Elder Berenas about it.
We have been told that we are here, generation
after generation, to "protect" this tower.

MsgJp:
きっとダナの住人たちは
彼らの武勇が村を守っていると
思っているでしょうね
MsgEn:
I'm sure the people of Dana think their bravery
is protecting the village.

MsgJp:
私に言わせれば、ダナの侵食が
比較的ゆるやかなのは
村の位置が関係しているだけです
MsgEn:
In my opinion, the relatively slow spread of
corruption in Dana is solely due to
the village's location.

MsgJp:
この場は私が取りまとめていますが
この《イヴァノスの塔》の成り立ちについては
長老のベレナスに聞いてください
MsgEn:
I'm managing this place, but please ask Elder
Berenas about the history of the Tower of Ivannos.

MsgJp:
彼が素直に話すとは思えませんが――
私たちですら、いつも煙に巻かれるのです
MsgEn:
I don't think he'll speak candidly, but even
we often get confused.

MsgJp: よぉ、買い物か？
MsgEn: Hey, are you here for shopping?

MsgJp:
ここの売り物も、皆で必死に集めてきたものだ
無駄遣いはするなよ
MsgEn:
The things being sold here are also items that
we've desperately gathered together.
Don't waste them, okay?

MsgJp:
外から来たところ悪いが、節約に協力してくれ
回復薬を次々に飲むより
仲間に回復してもらうようにするとか――
MsgEn:
I know you've come from the outside, but please
cooperate with our efforts to save resources.
Instead of consuming healing potions one after
another, consider having your companions heal you.

MsgJp:
回復薬一つ仕入れるのに
どれだけ苦労してるか――
MsgEn:
You have no idea how hard it is to get one bottle
of healing potion...

MsgJp: あら？　なになに？

最近の皆、表情が固まっちゃってるわぁ――
なるようにしかならないんだから
考えても無駄無駄～
MsgEn:
Everyone seems to have stiff
expressions these days.
Well, there's no use in worrying when things will
turn out how they will.

MsgJp:
なるようにしかならないし
逆に、なんだってなんとかなるのよ
どうしてかはわからないけど、きっとそうよ～
MsgEn:
It will turn out the way it's meant to be, On the
contrary, anything can be overcome somehow.
I don't know why, but surely that's how it is～

MsgJp:
あ、アナタにも眉間のシワが移っちゃってるわよ！
――なんちゃって、信じた？
MsgEn:
Ah, even you have wrinkles between your brows now!
Just kidding, did you believe me?

MsgJp:
これはこれは――
異なる竜に仕える方――
MsgEn: Oh my, oh my―― One who serves a different dragon――

MsgJp:
この拠点の者は元々"塔を守る一族"――
知らず知らずの内に祖先の教えを受け継いでおる
MsgEn:
The people in this base are originally from the
"family that protects the tower." Unknowingly,
they've inherited the
teachings of their ancestors.

MsgJp: "芯なる樹"のなりたちをお聞きになりたいと？
MsgEn:
You want to hear about the origin of
the Core Tree?

MsgJp:
この辺りの者は皆、子供の頃に聞かされる
たとえ話――その中に実は――
MsgEn:
All the people around here are told a childhood
fable—a story that, unbeknownst to them,
holds a deeper truth.

MsgJp:
いや、異なる竜に仕える方にお話しすることでも
ありませんな――
MsgEn:
No, there's no need to talk to the one who serves
a different dragon. That's not it.

MsgJp:
幼い頃に親に聞かされる昔話、たとえ話――
いつまでも記憶の奥底に眠り続け
決して忘れ去られることの無いそれら――
真実が眠るにふさわしいでしょう
MsgEn:
The bedtime stories and allegories told to us by
our parents when we were young, they continue to
slumber deep in the depths of our memories.
Never to be forgotten, they are deserving of the
truths that lie within.
Until eternity.

MsgJp: やぁ、調子はどうだい

グリンデュアにはよく行くよ
この辺りでは満足に資材を集められんからな
MsgEn:
I often go to Glyndwr.
Around here, it's hard to gather
materials satisfactorily.

MsgJp:
――ちょっと頭が固い奴は多いけど
それはうちも同じだな
MsgEn:
-There are quite a few stubborn people, but
that's the same with us too.

MsgJp:
俺やダレンが集めてきた資材は
ギルロイが管理してくれている
欲しい物があれば彼に言ってくれ
MsgEn:
The materials that I and Darren have gathered are
being managed by Gilroy.
If you want something, please let him know.

MsgJp:
――次に資材を集めに行く時に
欲しいものがあれば俺が取りまとめるんだが
アンタは自由に外に出られるもんな
MsgEn:
- When we go to gather materials next time, if
there's anything you want, I'll handle it for you.
Are you able to go outside freely?

MsgJp:
しかめっ面になっている者が多いだろう？
外の空気を吸ってみればいいのにな
MsgEn:
There are probably many people with
frowns, aren't there?
They should try taking a breath
of fresh air outside.

MsgJp:
よっ、調子どう？
外に行く準備するなら、手伝うよ
MsgEn:
Hey, how are you? If you're preparing to go
outside, I'll help you get ready.

MsgJp:
ライアムの仕事を手伝ってるんで
時々外の拠点に行くんだ
資材調達のついでにちょっと寄り道したりね
MsgEn:
I'm assisting Lyam with his work, so sometimes I
go to other locations.
I might make a little detour while
procuring materials.

MsgJp:
外のことを知るって気持ちいいもんだよ
気分転換になるし、何より楽しい
MsgEn:
It feels great to know about the outside world.
It's refreshing and above all, enjoyable.

MsgJp:
取引に行くのは主にグリンデュアだけど
ダナの方に行くこともあるんだ
MsgEn:
The trade missions are mainly handled by Glyndwr,
but we also go to Dana's side sometimes.

MsgJp:
ムキムキした人が多くて
なんていうか文化の違いを感じるよ
MsgEn:
There are many muscular people here, and it feels
like there are cultural differences.

MsgJp: ああ、レスタニアの覚者様でしたか――
MsgEn: Ah, so you are the Ser Arisen of Lestania――

MsgJp:
最近は侵食がフィンダム全体に
拡がっているそうですね
――ここに閉じこもるばかりでいいのかしら
MsgEn:
It seems that the corruption is spreading
throughout Phindym. Is it okay to
just stay holed up here?

MsgJp:
ここに閉じこもって、一体何を成しているのか
疑問に思うこともあるんです――
でも、塔を守ることも大切だし――
MsgEn:
Sometimes, I wonder what we're accomplishing by
staying here, but protecting the
tower is important too.

MsgJp:
この塔をお掃除して、きれいにして――
でも、外の大地はどんどん穢れて
いっているんでしょう？
MsgEn:
You're cleaning and beautifying this tower, but I
wonder if the outside world is
getting more corrupted?

MsgJp:
ラスニテ一帯で困りごとか？
この辺りのことなら俺が相談に乗ろう
MsgEn:
Are you having trouble in the Rathnite Foothills?
If it's about this area, let me
listen to your concerns.

MsgJp:
ん、誰だお前は？
見ない顔だ――
どこから来たのか明らかにしてもらおうか
MsgEn:
Hmm, who are you? You're not someone I know.
Let's find out where you came from.

MsgJp:
何だ、聞きたいことでもあるのか？
ラスニテ一帯について
俺のところに入ってきている情報なら
いくらでも話してやろう
MsgEn:
What's wrong?
Do you have something you want to ask
about the Rathnite area?
If it's information that has come to me, I can
tell you as much as you want.

MsgJp:
どうした？　様子を見に来てくれたのか？
せっかくだ、少し休んでいくといい
MsgEn:
What's the matter? Did you come to check on me?
Since you're here, it would be nice to
take a little break.

MsgJp:
それにしても、お前もなぜ
ラスニテ山麓に立ち寄ろうと思ったんだ？
これと言って珍しいものも無い場所だろう
力になってもらえるのはありがたいが――
MsgEn:
But why did you also decide to stop by at
the Rathnite Foothills?
It's not a particularly unusual place.
While it's appreciated that you're willing to
help, it's quite unexpected for us.

MsgJp:
この状況で、疲れ切った者に
さらに無理をしろとは――俺は言えん――
動ける人間で動かねばならん
MsgEn:
To ask someone who's already exhausted in this
situation to push even further – I can't say that.
The ones who can move must move.

MsgJp:
せっかくだ、休息は十分取っていってくれ
魔物の襲撃を受けでもすれば
即座に叩き起こすから安心しろ
MsgEn:
Take your time and get plenty of rest.
If the monsters attack, I'll wake you up
immediately, so don't worry.

MsgJp:
悪しき竜、武装をはじめたオークども――
もはや手遅れであることは変わらんが
MsgEn: Evil dragons, armed orcs – it's too late, but...

MsgJp:
手慣らしができる場所ぐらいは教えてやろう
この村を出た川の向こう岸だ
MsgEn:
I will tell you at least a place where you
can get some practice.
It's on the other side of the river, just
outside this village.

MsgJp:
ああ、ここの設備は自由に使っていいが
外に出る時は注意しろよ
MsgEn:
Ah, you are free to use the facilities here, but
please be careful when going outside.

MsgJp:
――こんな状況だ
満足に支援品も出せんのだ
まぁ、無いよりはマシだろう
MsgEn:
-This is the situation we're in.
We can't even provide support goods properly.
Well, I guess it's better than nothing.

MsgJp:
そうだ、これを持っていけ
お前のお陰で、ここら辺でも
少しはマシな支援品が用意できるようになったぞ
MsgEn:
Oh, right, take this with you.
Thanks to you, we've been able to prepare
slightly better supplies around here.

MsgJp:
よく来てくれた！
お前に渡そうと思って取っておいた物だ
――これくらいの支援品は出せるくらい
状況は好転したということだ
MsgEn:
Welcome! I've kept something to give to you.
It's support goods that I saved just for you!
I can provide this level of support now that the
conditions have improved.

MsgJp:
お前らの存在が解放軍内で話題になっている――
一部の兵が再び魔軍に挑み始めたぐらいだ
悪いが力を貸してやってくれ
MsgEn:
Your existence is being talked about within the
Liberation Army— It's just that some soldiers
have started challenging the Demon
Army again, that's all.
I'm sorry, but could you lend us your strength?

MsgJp:
代わりといっちゃあ何だが――
いい素材が取れる場所を教えてやろう
廃村の近くだ、少しマシなもんを
身に付けるといい
MsgEn:
Well, I suppose it's not a bad idea to have a
substitute... Let me tell you a place where you
can find good materials.
It's near an abandoned village, so you might find
something a little better to equip yourself with.

MsgJp:
おう、たったいま厄介な知らせが入った
どうやら魔軍のヤツらが不穏な動きを
始めているようだ
MsgEn:
Oh, just received some troublesome news.
It seems the Demon Army is starting
to act suspiciously.

MsgJp:
早めに叩くか、まとめて叩くか
どう動くかはお前に任せる――
手が空いたら様子を見てきてくれ
MsgEn:
Should I strike early or strike all at once?
I leave it up to you to decide how to move-- When
you have some free time, please come and see
how things are going.

MsgJp:
今日はいい知らせだ
支援できるもんが増やせそうだ
なに、感謝されるほどのことでもない
MsgEn:
Today is good news.
It seems that there will be an increase in
things I can support.
Well, it's not something
deserving of much gratitude.

MsgJp:
驚いたことに
魔軍と解放軍の支配地が変わりつつある――
これが覚者の力ってやつなのか？
MsgEn:
Surprisingly, the territories controlled by the
Demon Army and the Liberation Army are changing...
Is this the power of the Arisen?

MsgJp:
エリアの西側、ダクレイム砦の付近に
地下へと続く遺跡がある――
危険だが、行く価値のある場所だ
MsgEn:
To the west of the area, near Dacreim Fortress,
there is a ruin that leads underground.
It's dangerous, but it's worth a visit.

MsgJp:
おう、いいところに来てくれた――魔軍のヤツら
ロスギルの東でも、妙な動きをみせているようだ
頃合いを見てぶっ叩きに行ってくれ
MsgEn:
Ah, you've come to a good place - those guys from
the Demon Army.
Even in the east of Rothgill, they seem to be
acting strangely.
When the time is right, please go and smack them,
hard.

MsgJp:
王子が――本当に還られるとは――
異国の覚者よ
ネド王子を助けてくれたこと、伏して感謝する！
MsgEn:
The prince... to think he would actually return.
Foreign Arisen, I bow in gratitude
for saving Prince Nedo!

MsgJp:
魔軍戦車カトブレパス――
ダクレイム砦の獣の将――
お前の力があればこの国の状況は変わるかも知れん
MsgEn:
Catoblepas, the War Tank of the Demon Army, and
the Beast Master of Dacreim Fortress.
With your power, the conditions in this country
could potentially change.

MsgJp:
おう、来たか
盗賊団のアジトから北へ進んだところに
かなり古い地下水路があるのは知っているか
MsgEn:
Hey, you finally made it.
Do you know about the pretty old underground
waterways located north of the thieves' hideout?

MsgJp:
たちの悪い魔物どもの棲みかになってるが、
価値の高いものが採れることは間違いない
行くならしっかり準備してけよ
MsgEn:
It's become the den of nasty monsters, but
there's no doubt valuable
items can be found there.
If you're going, make sure you're well-prepared.

MsgJp:
ついにこの話をする時が来たか――
この国を踏み荒らし、我が同胞たちの
命を奪ったあの憎き戦車――
MsgEn:
The time has finally come to talk about this. The
one who ravaged our country, the abominable tank
that took the lives of our fellow compatriots.

MsgJp:
お前ならヤツを打ち倒せるかも知れん
心して聞いてくれ
MsgEn:
Maybe you can defeat that creature...
Listen carefully, with all your heart.

MsgJp:
たったあれだけの戦力で
あのカトブレパスを討伐してくるとは！
なんってやつだ、お前は――！
MsgEn:
To think you would defeat Catoblepas
with such a small force!
Who are you, anyway?!

MsgJp:
破滅までの時間をどう抗うか、って状況だった
この国に、お前は再び光を齎してくれた
ありがとう、覚者よ、いつでもお前を歓迎しよう！
MsgEn:
It was a situation of how to resist the
time until destruction.
In this country, you have
brought light once again.
Thank you, Arisen. We will always welcome you!

MsgJp:
なんだ、他のミッションへエントリー中のようだな
このミッションに出撃するというなら
今エントリーしているミッションを中止してくれ
でないと受け付けられんのだ
MsgEn:
What, it seems like you're currently in the midst
of entering another mission.
If you're going to sortie on this mission, please
cancel the mission you're currently entering.
Otherwise, I won't be able to accept it.

MsgJp:
休みたいのか？　ああ、いいとも！
<VAL PRICE_INN>だよ
すまないな、色々と苦しくてさ――
MsgEn:
Do you want a break? Oh, that's fine with me!
<VAL PRICE_INN>, you know.
Sorry, I've been going through
various hardships...

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

皆疲れてるから
あまり長くは休んでもらえないが――
よかったら、少し休憩していくかい
MsgEn:
Everyone is tired, so you can't rest for too
long, but if you'd like, take a short break.

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

あんたも大変みたいだな――
《弱化の治療》なら
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>だけど、いいかい
MsgEn:
It seems like you're having a tough time too,
huh? If it's [Weakness
Treatment,] it will cost <VAL PRICE_WEAK>
. Is that alright?

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

弱化してないみたいだな
――つらい気持ちは分かるぜ
身体が重く沈んで、何にもしたくなくなる
そんな時は素直に休んだ方がいい
MsgEn:
It seems like you haven't [Weakened,] huh?
- I understand the pain you're feeling.
When your body feels heavy and you don't feel
like doing anything, it's better to
honestly take a rest.

MsgJp:
調子はどうだ？
良くはなくても、悪くなきゃいいんだが
MsgEn:
How are you feeling?
It doesn't have to be good, as long
as it's not bad.

MsgJp:
皆辛いのはわかるけど
沈んでたって仕方ないからな
MsgEn:
I understand that everyone is suffering, but
there's no point in just staying down.

MsgJp:
ほら、気持ちの持ち方ってところも
絶対あるはずだから――
せっかく生きてるんだ
前を向くふりだけでもしないと
MsgEn:
See, there should be a way to change your
perspective – you're still alive after all.
You have to at least pretend to look forward.

MsgJp:
こうして命があること自体を喜ばないと――
そう、昨日してた心配は杞憂だったってね
MsgEn:
To not rejoice in the very fact that we have
life... Yes, it turns out that the worry I had
yesterday was needless.

MsgJp:
何か欲しいものがあるの？
残念だけど、あんまり品ぞろえは
よくないわよ
MsgEn:
Is there something you want? Unfortunately, our
selection isn't very good.

MsgJp:
この状況でアレコレ欲しがる人も
居ないとは思うけど
本当に、最低限の物資しか無くてね
MsgEn:
I don't think there are people who would want
this and that in this situation, but really, we
only have the bare minimum supplies.

MsgJp:
精一杯かき集めてきてコレなのよ
いつまで持つか――
でも、ある物でどうにかするしかないわよね
MsgEn:
I have gathered everything I could, but
this is all we have.
I wonder how long it will last...
But we have no choice but to make
do with what we have.

MsgJp:
あなたも、あんまり泣き言は言わないようにして
みんな我慢してるんだから
MsgEn:
Please try not to complain too much.
Everyone is being patient, you know.

MsgJp:
なんだよ
――用も無いのにこっち見るのやめろよ
MsgEn:
What's the matter?
――Stop looking over here for no reason.

MsgJp:
こんなところに潜んで
一体何になるっていうんだ――
ここでボサッとしてる奴らの気が知れねぇ
MsgEn:
What's the point of lurking around
in a place like this?
I can't understand the mindset of these guys
loafing around here.

MsgJp:
こうしてる間にもどこかの村が
オークに襲われてるんだぜ
――やりきれねぇよ
MsgEn:
While we're here, some village somewhere is being
attacked by Orcs. I can't bear it anymore.

MsgJp:
オレはこんなところにいたくないね
逃げるか戦うか、さっさと決めちまいたい
――ハァ
MsgEn:
I don't want to be in a place like this.
I want to make a decision and either run
away or fight, quickly.
- Haah.

MsgJp:
なんだ、あんた？
わざわざ話しかけるような用でもあるのか？
MsgEn:
What is it, you?
Do you have a reason to talk to me?

MsgJp:
ここまでめちゃくちゃになったら
もう何も信じられねぇ
信じたヤツから死んでくんだからよ
MsgEn:
Once it becomes completely chaotic, I can't
believe in anything anymore.
Because death awaits those whom I believed in.

MsgJp:
あー、見つかっちゃったか
隠れてるつもりだったんだけどなぁ
MsgEn:
Ah, it seems I've been found out. I thought
I was hiding well.

MsgJp:
砦に入れてもらえたのはいいんだけど
人手が足りないからってさ
鎧着せられそうになってびっくりしたよ
MsgEn:
I'm glad they let me into the fortress, but I was
surprised when they tried to put armor on me
because they're short-staffed.

MsgJp:
僕、大きい音がダメになっちゃってさ
血の臭いとかも――
絶対、気が遠くなってくるんだ
弱虫だろ
MsgEn:
I can't handle loud noises, you know.
Even the smell of blood...
It makes me feel dizzy.
I'm such a coward.

MsgJp:
覚者さんはいいなぁ
血が出ても、ちょっとくらいなら死なないんだろ
僕の姉さんはあっという間に顔が
真っ白になっちゃってさ――
MsgEn:
Arisen are amazing, aren't they?
Even if they bleed, they probably won't
die from just a little.
My older sister's face turned completely
pale in an instant...

MsgJp:
あら、覚者様！
砦奪還の英雄じゃないですか
MsgEn:
Oh, Ser Arisen!
You're the hero who recaptured the
fortress, aren't you?

MsgJp:
お聞きになった？
あそこにいるミカエラっていう女の子
あの子の歌から、ネド王子のご存命が
わかったそうですわよ
MsgEn:
Did you hear about it? Thanks to that girl
Michaela over there, we learned that Prince
Nedo's alive from her song.

MsgJp:
ここにいる武装してる人たちってね
元々軍属だった兵士さんもいれば
兵士も民間人も寄せ集めで武装したっていう
解放軍の戦士さんもいるらしいですよ
MsgEn:
The armed individuals here, you see, include not
only former military personnel, but also a mix of
soldiers and civilians who armed themselves.
There are even warriors from the
Liberation Army, it seems.

MsgJp:
私、ここに寄せてもらう前は
近くの洞窟の入り口で雨風を
しのいでたんです――
薄気味悪くて堪らなかったわね――
MsgEn:
Before I came here, I was taking shelter at the
entrance of a nearby cave to escape from the rain
and wind— It was creepy and unbearable...

MsgJp:
あら、覚者さま
こんなところにまで、どうされました？
MsgEn: Oh, Ser Arisen. What brings you to this place?

MsgJp:
オークに捕らわれた人たちを
解放してあげることができて良かった――
危ないところでしたから
MsgEn:
I'm glad I could free the people captured by the
orcs – it was a dangerous situation.

MsgJp:
捕らわれていた人たちは
まだ深く傷ついていて――
無理もないことです
MsgEn:
The people who were captured are still deeply
wounded, and it's completely understandable.

MsgJp:
兵士である私がここに残ることで
みなさん、少しは気持ちが安らぐようですよ
MsgEn:
By remaining here as a soldier, I hope it can
bring some peace of mind to all of you.

MsgJp:
ああ、覚者様
様子を見に来てくださったのですか？
MsgEn:
Oh, Arisen, have you come to check
on the situation?

MsgJp:
この村が解放されたのも
覚者様のお陰と聞いております
ありがとうございます
MsgEn:
I have heard that this village was liberated
thanks to the Arisen.
Thank you.

MsgJp:
まだ気疲れが取れませんでな
いえ、覚者様に気にしていただくようなことでは――
MsgEn:
I still can't shake off my fatigue. No, it's not
something for the Arisen to worry about...

MsgJp:
もう、捕らわれていた時は
色々と覚悟をしていましたので――
まだ緊張が抜けないと言いますか、ね――
MsgEn:
Even when I was captured, I was prepared for
various things. I can't say the tension
has completely eased.

MsgJp: やぁ、覚者様じゃないですか
MsgEn: Oh, if it isn't the Arisen!

MsgJp:
こうして暮らしていけるのも
この村を解放してくださったお陰ですよ
MsgEn:
We are able to live like this thanks to the
liberation of this village.

MsgJp:
これから、ですか？
――いえ、以前と同じように暮らしていきます
MsgEn:
From now on?
—No, we will continue to live as we did before.

MsgJp:
囚われている間、ずっと
前みたいに暮らしたいって思ってたんです
地味な生活、大いに結構ですよ
MsgEn:
While I was imprisoned, I kept thinking I wanted
to live like I used to. A simple
life is more than fine.

MsgJp:
働いて、食べて、寝る
これ以外のことは今のところ
何も望んじゃいません
MsgEn:
Work, eat, sleep – I don't want anything
else for now.

MsgJp:
ふぅ――
あ、ハイハイ！　何がご入用でしょう？
MsgEn: Phew, uh, yes, what can I assist you with?

MsgJp:
そりゃ、辛いことも疲れも溜まってますけどね
働かないことには、ねぇ
MsgEn:
Well, even with the hardships and exhaustion, we
can't just sit around doing nothing, can we?

MsgJp:
うちの店、どうです？
よそのお店ってもっと品揃えが
良かったりするのかしら――
MsgEn:
How do you like our shop? I wonder if other shops
have better selections.

MsgJp:
セイディは――
セイディは、私の姪なんです
MsgEn:
Sadie is...
Sadie is my niece.

MsgJp: だから、私が替わりに育ててやれたらって――
MsgEn: That's why I wanted to take care of her instead...

MsgJp: 覚者さま、こんにちは
オークは臭いからキライ
MsgEn: I hate Orcs because they smell.

MsgJp:
檻の中に入れられたの、すごく嫌だった
覚者さまが助けてくれたんだよね
MsgEn:
I really hated being put in a cage.
Ser Arisen, thank you for saving me.

MsgJp:
ねぇ、覚者さま
ママを知らない？
わたし、ママと違うところに閉じ込められてたの
MsgEn:
Hey, Arisen. Do you know where my mom is?
I was kept somewhere different from her.

MsgJp: はい、何でしょう

そうですね、一応は私が
ここの守備責任者ということになります
MsgEn:
Well, I suppose for now, I will be in charge
of the defense here.

MsgJp:
――ああ、エディの言うことは
気になさらないでください
MsgEn: - Please don't worry about what Eddie says, okay?

MsgJp:
どこも物資、人手共に不足しています
ギリギリですが、あるもので
どうにかするしかないでしょう――
MsgEn:
Supplies and manpower are scarce everywhere.
We're barely managing, but we have no choice but
to make do with what we have until...

MsgJp:
おおっ、覚者様
何かご用でしょうか！
MsgEn:
Oh, Arisen!
What can I do for you?

MsgJp:
早く手柄を立てて、カーティス隊長の
自慢の部下になりたいんですよ
MsgEn:
I want to quickly accomplish great feats and
become Captain Curtis' proudest subordinate.

MsgJp:
いえね、俺ってこう見えて
元は木こりやってたんですよ
でも解放軍に入って、これは運命かも知れないって
MsgEn:
Actually, I used to be a lumberjack. But now I'm
in the Liberation Army, so this might be fate.

MsgJp:
もう何でもいいから
とにかく手柄立てられないかな――
MsgEn:
I don't care about anything anymore, so could I
at least achieve some kind of accomplishment...

MsgJp:
あー、はいはい
何が必要ですかね
MsgEn:
Ah, yes, yes.
What do you need?

MsgJp:
ああ、道具類の手入れはこまめにしてますよ
きっちり使えますんで、安心して
買ってってください
MsgEn:
Ah, I regularly maintain and take care of my
tools, so you can rest assured. Please go
ahead and purchase them.

MsgJp:
はいはい、なんですかね
――俺からは特に用は無いんですけど
MsgEn:
Yes, yes, what is it?
—I don't particularly have any business with you.

MsgJp:
火種は大量に買っといた方がいいですよ
何と言っても、そんなにかさばりませんから
そんでもって無いと大変なことになるでしょう
MsgEn:
It's a good idea to stock up on tinder. After
all, it doesn't take up much space, and
it can be a lifesaver.

MsgJp:
洞窟の奥で火種が切れる――
なんて状況、ゾッとしますからね
MsgEn:
The fire dies out deep in the cave - Such a
situation gives me the chills, you know.

MsgJp: ――何か用かな
MsgEn: Do you have any business with me?

MsgJp:
特に怪我はなさそうだね
よかった
MsgEn:
It doesn't seem like there are any injuries in
particular. That's a relief.

MsgJp:
ここでの任務が終われば
また別の任地に送られるだけだ
ま、それが仕事だから
MsgEn:
Since you're here, how about taking a little
break too, Arisen? You need a good night's sleep
to stay sharp for when it really matters.

MsgJp: 覚者ってのも大変そうだな
MsgEn:
Being an Arisen seems like a tough
job, doesn't it?

MsgJp:
イェルハルド様は多忙だ
ロスギルの村のことなら
まずは俺を通してもらおうか
MsgEn:
Lord Gerhard is busy. If it's about Rothgill
village, it's better to go through me.

MsgJp:
俺が誰かって？
イェルハルド様の筆頭補佐官といえば俺だ
――まぁ、貴方はこの国の者でもない
多少の無礼も大目に見よう
MsgEn:
Who am I, you ask? I'm the chief
assistant to Lord Gerhard.
Well, since you're not from this country, I'll
overlook a little rudeness.

MsgJp:
イェルハルド様はお忙しい
伝言なら俺がことづかろう
MsgEn:
Lord Gerhard is quite busy. If it's a message, I
can take care of it.

MsgJp:
怪しげであっても客人だ
イェルハルド様のためにも
貴方をもてなすよう皆に言っておいた
MsgEn:
Even if it's suspicious, you're a guest.
I've told everyone to treat you well for
Lord Gerhard's sake.

MsgJp:
や、調子どうだい？
戦技のことなら相談に乗るよ
MsgEn:
Hey, how are you doing? If you have any questions
about battle techniques, I'm here to help.

MsgJp:
いやー、いいねぇ
自分の望んだように戦えるっての
羨ましいよ
MsgEn:
Oh, I see. That's nice.
Being able to fight the way you want, I'm envious.

MsgJp:
アタシ？
アタシは今、療養中ってやつさ
体が良くなれば、また村の外に行くつもりだよ
MsgEn:
Me? I'm currently in recovery. Once my body gets
better, I plan to go outside the village again.

MsgJp:
覚者ってのは色んな技を覚えてるもんだね
戦技補佐のしがいがあるよ
MsgEn:
Arisen are skilled in various techniques, huh?
There's satisfaction in
supporting their martial arts.

MsgJp:
ようこそおいでくださいました
さぁ、ゆっくり休んでいってくださいね
MsgEn:
Welcome, please come in and rest. Take
your time to relax.

MsgJp:
ご宿泊は<VAL PRICE_INN>です
ロスギル名物、翡翠湖で採れた魚を使った
お粥もサービスしますよ！
きっと身も心も癒されるはずです
MsgEn:
Your accommodation is <VAL PRICE_INN>.
We'll also serve you some rice porridge made with
fish from the famous Emerald Lake in Rothgill.
It should surely heal your body and soul.

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

ええ、どうぞこのロスギルで
長旅の疲れを癒してください
干し魚を使ったお粥、この辺りの名物なんです
こちらも、よかったら食べていってくださいね！
MsgEn:
Well, feel free to rest in Rothgill.
We have a local specialty, fish porridge
made from dried fish.
It's a famous dish around here. You're welcome to
try it if you'd like!

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

《弱化の治療》ですね！
はい、もちろん承っていますとも
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>ですが、よろしいですか？
MsgEn:
It's [Weakness Treatment], right?
Yes, of course, I can do that.
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>, is that okay?

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

あら、弱化していらっしゃいませんよ？
弱化していないものを治療しろとは――
謎かけみたいですね、フフフ
MsgEn:
Oh, you're not [Weakened,] are you?
To treat something that isn't afflicated...
It's like a riddle, isn't it? Hehehe.

MsgJp:
ロスギルの見どころ、ですか？
それはもちろん、翡翠湖です！
美しい滝もご覧いただけますよ
MsgEn:
What are the highlights of Rothgill? Of course,
it's Emerald Lake! You can also see
beautiful waterfalls.

MsgJp:
翡翠湖で採れる魚は
ロスギルの食生活を支えてくれています
煮てよし、焼いてよし、干してよし、なんです
MsgEn:
The fish caught in Emerald Lake
supports Rothgill's diet.
It can be boiled, grilled, or dried, offering
various culinary options.

MsgJp:
こうしてお仕事をし始めたのも
最近のことなんです
今はどこも大変ですからね
MsgEn:
I only began working like this recently. Things
are tough everywhere right now.

MsgJp:
いらっしゃいませ、覚者様
今日は何をお探しで？
MsgEn:
Welcome, Ser Arisen.
What are you looking for today?

MsgJp:
いや、戦のせいで縮小してしまいましたが
元はもっと大きな店を出してたんですよ
村の外に何店舗も店がありましてね
MsgEn:
No, it's because of the war that it has shrunk,
but we used to have a much bigger shop, you know.
Outside the village, there were
several other stores.

MsgJp:
イェルハルド様はご立派な方ですよ
あの方がいらっしゃらなかったら
この村も今頃オークの拠点になってるところです
MsgEn:
Lord Gerhard is a noble person.
If he wasn't here, this village would have become
an Orc stronghold by now.

MsgJp:
もしこのロスギルが危ない状態になっても――
私はここを離れないって決めてるんです
代々ここで商売してますんで
MsgEn:
Even if Rothgill were in a dangerous state, I
have made the decision not to leave this place.
My family has been running a business
here for generations.

MsgJp: 覚者様、旅の同行者をお探しでしょうか？
MsgEn: Arisen, are you looking for a travel companion?

MsgJp:
お知り合いへのご連絡、それから
ポーンの呼び出しなんかも
お手伝いいたしますよ
MsgEn:
I can help you with contacting acquaintances and
even calling your Pawn.

MsgJp:
こうしていられるのも、イェルハルド様が
しっかりロスギルを治めてくださるお陰ですな
MsgEn:
It is thanks to Lord Gerhard's firm rule over
Rothgill that we are able to stay like this.

MsgJp:
火にあたりながら
細々したものを作るのが好きでして――
何、つまらないものばかりなんですがね
MsgEn:
I enjoy making small things by the fire –
nothing special, though.

MsgJp:
覚者さま、《ブラッドオーブ》の交換であれば
わたしがご相談にのりましょう
MsgEn:
Arisen, if it's for exchanging "Blood Orbs," I'll
be the one to help you.

MsgJp:
こうしてお仕事をしていれば
少しは気もまぎれるというものです
MsgEn:
In this central area of the swamp, there are
harmful monsters gathering.

MsgJp:
エルセンさんは戦が始まる前から、この辺りで
手広く商いをしてらした方なんですよ
こうしてわたしにも、場所を貸してくださっています
MsgEn:
Elsen here has been involved in various
businesses around here even
before the war started.
And they've also lent me this place.

MsgJp:
覚者であれば、きっと色々と
達観していらっしゃるのでしょうね
わたしなどはあれこれ悩みが多くて――
MsgEn:
If you are an Arisen, you must surely have a more
enlightened perspective on things.
I, on the other hand, have many worries...

MsgJp:
おっ、覚者さんじゃないですか
何かご用で？
MsgEn:
Oh, it's the Arisen, isn't it? Do you have
some business with me?

MsgJp:
ロスギルはいいですね
この戦乱の最中にあって
食べる物にも住む場所にも困っていない
イェルハルド殿の見事な手腕によるものでしょう
MsgEn:
Rothgill is nice.
Even in the midst of this chaos, they have no
problems with food and shelter.
Thanks to Lord Gerhard's excellent management.

MsgJp:
そういえば、ロスギル名物の
魚と貝の粥はもう召し上がりましたか？
宿屋で出されるアレです
MsgEn:
By the way, have you tried Rothgill's famous fish
and shellfish porridge?
It's served at the inn.

MsgJp:
他でも食べられますが
やはりロスギルの魚を使っているだけあって
一味違いますよ！
MsgEn:
You can eat this elsewhere, but using Rothgill's
fish does make a difference!

MsgJp:
村から村へ手紙を届ける仕事をしてたんです
こんな状況ですから、みな遠くに住む親せきや
友人を心配して手紙を書くんです
MsgEn:
I used to work delivering letters
from village to village.
With this situation, everyone worries about their
relatives and friends who live far away and
writes letters to them.

MsgJp:
最近は――宛先として書かれている村が
無くなってることも多くなって――
少し疲れましてね
MsgEn:
Recently, many of the villages listed as
destinations are disappearing – it's tiring.

MsgJp:
私に何か用があるなんて
珍しいね？
MsgEn: Do you have business with me? That's unusual.

MsgJp:
ロスギルの人たちは外の状況を
分かっているのかしら？
あまりにものんびりしすぎてない？
MsgEn:
Do the people in Rothgill really understand the
conditions outside? Aren't they too relaxed?

MsgJp:
今はまだ修行中の身だけど
近いうちに、必ず戦士として身を立ててみせるわ
MsgEn:
Right now, I'm still in the midst of training,
but soon I will definitely prove
myself as a Soldier.

MsgJp:
いてもたってもいられないって
こういう気持ちのことを言うのね――
MsgEn:
I just couldn't sit around and do nothing. This
is what I mean by these feelings.

MsgJp:
あれ？　この村の人じゃない人だ
こんにちは
MsgEn: Huh? You're not from this village. Hello.

MsgJp:
うんうん、知ってるよ
戦争が始まったから、村の外に
出ちゃいけないんだよね
MsgEn:
Yeah, I know. We can't leave the
village because of the war.

MsgJp:
外は怖いことがいっぱいあるけど
ロスギルは大丈夫なんでしょ？
MsgEn:
There are many scary things outside,
but is Rothgill safe?

MsgJp:
あなたも外が怖いなら
ずっとロスギルにいてもいいよ！
MsgEn:
If you're also afraid of the outside, you're
welcome to stay in Rothgill!

MsgJp: ――なんだね

――腹でも減ったのか？
そこにある魚をつまんでいってもいいぞ
焼いただけだが、味は保障する
MsgEn:
Are you hungry? You can have some of the fish
over there. They're just roasted, but the
taste is guaranteed.

MsgJp:
戦が始まる前からこうして釣りをしている
うちの親父も、そのまた親父も釣りをして
暮らしてたんだ
MsgEn:
I've been fishing like this even before the war
began. My father and his father
also lived by fishing.

MsgJp:
ロスギルの村人がまだ安定しているのは
魚が獲れさえすれば、少なくとも
食べ物には困らないからだ
――だからこうして釣りをしている
MsgEn:
The villagers in Rothgill are still stable
because as long as they can catch fish, they
won't have any shortage of food.
That's why they are fishing like this.

MsgJp:
あっ、はい
作業をしながらですみません――
MsgEn: Ah, yes. I apologize for working while speaking.

MsgJp:
こうやって魚を干すと
保存がきいて持ち運びも楽だし
旨みが増すんです
MsgEn:
Drying fish like this preserves them and makes
them easy to carry, and also
enhances their flavor.

MsgJp: はぁ、ぼくもずっと釣りをしてたいな――
MsgEn: Sigh, I wish I could fish all day...

MsgJp:
両親はぼくに
立派な騎士になってほしいそうなんです
――でも、ぼくは魚釣りが好きだな
MsgEn:
My parents want me to become a splendid knight,
but I really love fishing.

MsgJp: ん？　どうかした？

ベルタママがいない間
一応ココはあたしがまとめてるからさ
何かあったら聞きにきな
MsgEn:
While Lady Bertha is away, I'll be in charge here
for now. If you have any problems, feel
free to come and ask.

MsgJp:
あたしらなんかは
ママから生まれたわけじゃないけどさ
そういうことじゃないだろ、家族の絆って
MsgEn:
We may not have been born from the same mother,
but that's not what matters when it
comes to family bonds.

MsgJp:
ちょっと荒っぽいヤツもいるかもしれないけど
皆気はいいヤツらだよ
他の拠点とそう変わらないって！
MsgEn:
There might be a few rough ones here, but they're
all good people. Not that
different from other bases!

MsgJp:
俺たちとあんたらに未来があるなら
仲良く過ごすか敵対しあうか――
MsgEn:
If there's a future for us and you, will we spend
it getting along or fighting each other?

MsgJp: お頭次第だろうね

そっちには王子、こっちにはお頭が戻って
絶望的な雰囲気が少し変わった気がするよ
MsgEn:
On one side, we have the prince, and on the other
side, the leader has returned.
The despairing atmosphere feels like it
has changed a little.

MsgJp:
お頭はすっかり王子の取り巻きだ
盗賊稼業はどうなるのかね
MsgEn:
The chief's already surrounded by Prince Nedo's
entourage. What's going to happen to
our thieving business?

MsgJp:
何だ、じっと見て
用でもあんのか？
MsgEn:
What, are you just staring at me?
Do you need something?

MsgJp:
盗賊っていっても
俺らは殺して奪うようなことはしてねぇよ
子供をさらったりもしてねぇ
MsgEn:
We may be thieves, but we don't kill or rob
people. We don't kidnap children either.

MsgJp:
覚者ってのは正義の味方か？
だったら、俺とは気は合わないかもな
MsgEn:
Are Arisen always champions of justice? If that's
the case, we might not get along.

MsgJp:
竜のことはよく知らねぇんだ
王家の人間とその取り巻きが
なんかそれっぽくやってんだろ？
MsgEn:
I don't know much about dragons. It seems like
people from the royal family and their entourage
are doing something related to them, though.

MsgJp:
この騒動はいい気晴らしになる
思う存分暴れてやるよ
MsgEn:
This commotion will be a good diversion. Let's go
wild to our heart's content.

MsgJp:
これからどうなるのかね
先のことが少し気になってきたな
MsgEn:
I wonder what will happen from now on. I'm
starting to get a little worried about the future.

MsgJp:
盗賊の頭脳ってのはキリッと冷めてるものさ
でも、熱く燃えるのも悪くはなかった
MsgEn:
The intellect of a bandit is sharp and cold.
But it wasn't bad to see it burn passionately too.

MsgJp: ああ、どうした

あんた、自分が覚者だってことに
誇りを持ってんだろ？
俺ら盗賊だって同じだ
MsgEn:
You, do you take pride in being an Arisen? We
bandits are the same.

MsgJp:
覚者ってのは思ってたより馴れ馴れしいもんだな
――いや、悪い意味じゃないんだ
MsgEn:
The Arisen are more familiar than I had imagined.
Well, I don't mean it in a bad way.

MsgJp:
そう話しかけられても
あんたのタメになるような話はできないぜ
MsgEn:
Even if you talk to me, I can't tell you anything
that would be of any benefit.

MsgJp:
疲れてるなら一眠りしていくか？
ここは静かだし、見た目よりは
寝心地も悪くないぜ
MsgEn:
If you're tired, would you like to take a nap?
It's quiet here, and the sleeping conditions
aren't as bad as they may look.

MsgJp:
よし、一休みするなら<VAL PRICE_INN>だ
――これで金儲けしようってんじゃない
寝床を整える手間賃みたいなもんだよ
で、休んでいくのか？
MsgEn:
Alright, if you're going to take a break, it's
<VAL PRICE_INN>.
This is not about making money.
It's more like a fee for preparing a comfortable
place to sleep. So, are you going to rest?

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

ああ、今なら好きに休んでいっていいぜ
あんたも覚者とはいえ、疲れ溜まってんだろ？
MsgEn:
Ah, if you feel like it, you can take a break
however you want, you know?
Even though you're an Arisen, you
must be tired, right?

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

《弱化の治療》か
いや、できるんだが俺たちのルールで
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>もらうことにしてるんだ
手持ちはあるのか？
MsgEn:
[Weakening Treatment,] you say?
Well, I can do it, but we've decided to charge
<VAL PRICE_WEAK> for it according to our rules.
Do you have enough on hand?

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

ん？　弱化してるヤツってのは
もっと弱弱しい感じになるんだぜ
あんた、強いみたいだが演技はまだまだだな
MsgEn:
Huh? [Weakened] people tend to
look weaker, you know?
You seem strong, but your acting still needs work.

MsgJp:
寝床がもっとたくさんあれば
保護してる人たちもゆっくり休ませてやれるんだが
MsgEn:
If we had more beds, we could let the people
we're protecting rest more comfortably.

MsgJp:
まぁ、どう言いつくろっても盗賊だから
外でさ迷ってる人に声をかけても
逃げられることの方が多くて――
MsgEn:
Well, even though I may act as a bandit, I've
often talked to people wandering outside.
Most times, they just run away.

MsgJp:
俺たち盗賊団ほど自由な集まりは無いと思うぜ
色んなところへフラフラ行っちまうヤツが
結構多いから、外でも見かけるかもな
MsgEn:
I don't think there's a gathering as
free as our thief gang.
There are quite a few people who wander around in
various places, so you might see them outside too.

MsgJp:
覚者さんか、いらっしゃい
さてと――ご用は何かな？
MsgEn: Welcome, Arisen. Now then, what can I do for you?

MsgJp:
おたく、今日もイカしてるぜ
数々の戦場を乗り越えてきた戦士の目をしてるよ
MsgEn:
You, you're still rocking it today. You have the
eyes of a warrior who's
overcome many battlefields.

MsgJp:
ここにあるものは盗品じゃないから
安心して買い物してってくれ
――俺らはこういう日用品みたいな小物は
狙わない主義でね
MsgEn:
Don't worry; the items here are not stolen. Feel
free to shop with confidence. We have a policy
not to target everyday items like this.

MsgJp:
並べてる商品は大体外の商人から
仕入れてきたもんだ
――ああ、後ろの酒瓶は俺のだけど
MsgEn:
I've mostly purchased the products from outside
merchants – oh, the bottles of alcohol in the
back are mine, though.

MsgJp:
ああ、覚者さま
私に何かご用でも？
MsgEn: Ah, Lord Arisen, do you need something from me?

MsgJp:
何か盗賊の方たちのお手伝いをと思って――
散らばっていた道具なんかを片付けてみたんです
少しはきれいになったかと
MsgEn:
I thought I'd help out with
something for the bandits.
I tried to clean up some of the scattered tools.
I wonder if it's a bit neater now.

MsgJp:
私にできることは無いかと聞いてみても
特に何も無いそうなんです
ただ休んでいるのも申し訳ないし
どうしましょうね――
MsgEn:
When I asked if there was anything I could do to
help, they said there wasn't anything specific.
I feel bad just resting, but what can we do?

MsgJp:
せっかく置いてもらっているのですから
盗賊の方たちのお役に立ちたいのですが――
MsgEn:
We're here because you've left us this chance,
and we'd like to be of service to the bandits.

MsgJp:
ごほっごほっ
ああ、すみません――

げほっごほっ
いや、ちょっとむせただけです
何でもないんですよ
MsgEn:
Cough cough No, I just choked a bit.
It's nothing.

MsgJp:
はは、こうして人間らしく寝られるようになって
身も心も本当に助かりましたよ
木の根っこで丸まって休む日が続きましてね
限界だったんです
MsgEn:
Haha, being able to sleep like a human has
really been a lifesaver.
I've spent days curled up
under tree roots to rest.
I was at my limit.

MsgJp:
ごほん、げほっ
ちょ、ちょっと調子が悪いかなぁ
なんて、ハハハ――
MsgEn:
Ahem, cough Um, umm, I'm feeling a bit
off today Uh, hahaha...

MsgJp:
あっ、覚者さんでしたか
ちょっとここのところ目がかすみまして
よくお顔が見えませんでした
MsgEn:
Ah, so you're an Arisen, aren't you? I apologize,
my vision has been a bit blurry lately, so I
couldn't see your face clearly.

MsgJp:
いやぁ、盗賊の皆さんには
お世話になりました――
げほっ、ごほん
MsgEn:
Well, I must say, I am grateful to all you
bandits for your assistance— *cough* *cough*

MsgJp:
こ、この通り――
ちょっと体調が悪そうに見えるらしくて――
「展望城に行けば医者がいるかもしれん」と
ここまで送っていただきまして、ハハハ――
MsgEn:
Ju-just as you can see... I seemed to look a bit
unwell, and they, um, thought I should head to
Prospect Castle. They said there might be a
doctor there, so they brought me this far, hehe...

MsgJp:
展望城を取り戻せて、本当によかった――
やっと希望が見えてきました
ええ、やっと――
MsgEn:
I'm really glad that we were able to retake
Lookout Castle— Finally, I see a glimmer of
hope Yes, finally...

MsgJp:
お、お気遣いなく――
ええ、大丈夫ですから――
MsgEn: Don't worry about it. Yes, I'm fine.

MsgJp: ええ、アデムはうちの子ですけど――

はぁ――何です？
うちの子へのご用でも、私がお聞きしますから
MsgEn:
Hah... What is it? If you have any business with
my child, I'm the one to talk to.

MsgJp:
――ああ、あなた
何かご用でも？
MsgEn: - Ah, do you have some business with me?

MsgJp:
少しそっとしておいてほしいんですよ
うちの子が傷付いてるの
見てわからないんですか？
MsgEn:
I'd appreciate it if you left us alone for a bit.
My child is hurt. Can't you see that?

MsgJp:
私たち、目の前で家を潰されたんです
この子も、それがショックで――
MsgEn:
They destroyed our homes right before our eyes,
and my child was traumatized...

MsgJp:
さっきからじろじろ見て
一体何なんです？
わたしもアデムも何も持ってませんからね！
MsgEn:
You've been staring at us for a
while now. What is it?
Neither I nor Adem has anything on us!

MsgJp:
ベルタ盗賊団のアジトでお会いしましたね
ほら、《湖畔の洞窟》にある――
MsgEn:
We met at the Bertha's Bandit Group Hideout,
right? It's in the "Lakeside Grotto."

MsgJp:
アデムも少しずつ落ち着いてきています
盗賊の人たちも気にかけてくださって――
あの人たちって、悪人のくせに
子供には優しいんですね
MsgEn:
Adem is slowly settling down too.
The thieves are taking care of us – it's strange
that they're kind to children,
despite being bad people.

MsgJp:
家は潰されましたけど、きっとまた
私がお金を貯めて建て直してみせます
あの子を育てていかなくちゃ
MsgEn:
Our house was destroyed, but I'll surely
save up and rebuild it.
I have to raise my child.

MsgJp:
わたしの息子――
絶対に守り抜いてみせるわ
MsgEn: I will definitely protect my son -

MsgJp: ママ――？
――なんなの――
――こんにちは
うう――
あ、あっちにいって
ママ、ぼくこわいよ
ここにいれば、もうこわくないんでしょ？
MsgEn: If you're here, you're not afraid anymore, right?

MsgJp:
デニスおにいちゃん！
はやくボール投げて！
MsgEn: Brother Dennis! Please throw the ball quickly -

MsgJp:
ここに来てから
ママがやさしくなって――よかった
MsgEn:
Ever since coming here, Mom has become
kinder - I'm glad

MsgJp: ママ、ぼくのことみてる？
やあ・仮
雑談１・仮
雑談２・仮
雑談３・仮
こんにちは・仮
雑談１・仮
雑談２・仮
雑談３・仮
ハァイ・仮
雑談１・仮
雑談２・仮
雑談３・仮
へへへ・仮
雑談１・仮
雑談２・仮
雑談３・仮

まぁ、覚者様
フェルヤナ一帯についてのお話でしょうか？
MsgEn:
Well, Ser Arisen, is this about
the Feryana region?

MsgJp:
あら、どなたでしょうか？
拠点の礎であれば
この隠れ家の外にございます
MsgEn:
Oh, who might you be?
If you're looking for the
Portcrystal, it's outside.

MsgJp:
かりそめのエリアマスターではありますが
この辺りのお話でしたら
わたしがお受けいたしましょう
MsgEn:
While I may be just a temporary Area Master, if
it's about this area I will gladly
take on the task.

MsgJp:
ふふ、おいででしたのね
展望城、ひいてはフェルヤナ一帯について
何か必要な情報が――？
MsgEn:
Ah, you came.
Do you need any information about Lookout Castle
or the surrounding area of Feryana?

MsgJp:
幸い、ここは規模こそ小さくとも全員が食べ、
眠る場所を維持するだけの力はあります
それぞれが力を尽くしてくれた結果です
MsgEn:
Fortunately, even though the scale is small,
everyone has the power to maintain a
place to eat and sleep.
It's the result of everyone's hard work.

MsgJp:
この辺りのエリアマスターは
他にいたはずですが――
この混乱の中、行方が知れません
MsgEn:
There should have been other Area Masters around
here, but in this chaos, their
whereabouts are unknown.

MsgJp:
しかし――誰かがエリアの情報を
取りまとめねばなりません
そこで、わたしがかりそめのエリアマスターを
名乗らせていただいております
MsgEn:
However, someone has to gather
information about the area.
So I'm temporarily calling myself the Area Master.

MsgJp:
戦乱の中、たくさんのものが破壊されました
それは家屋であり、人々の心であり――
そしてアッカーシェランという国が築いてきた
文化すらも犠牲になりつつあります
MsgEn:
In the midst of war, many things were destroyed.
Homes, people's hearts, and even the culture
built by the country of Acre Selund are
becoming sacrifices.

MsgJp:
そう、例えば《展望城》――
あれは文化的にも防衛的にも重要な城
魔軍の手に落ちてしまったのは
大変つらいことです
MsgEn:
Yes, for example, the "Lookout Castle." It's an
important castle both culturally and defensively.
It's been a great hardship for it to fall into
the hands of the Demon Army.

MsgJp:
せっかくですから、覚者様も
少し休んでいかれてはいかがです？
ぐっすりと眠らないといざという時
疲れに足を取られるといいますもの
MsgEn:
Since you're here, how about taking a
little rest, Arisen?
They say that you'll need a good night's
sleep for times of need.

MsgJp:
《展望城》――アッカーシェランの国民としても
わたし個人としても、大変思い入れの深い場所です
MsgEn:
"Lookout Castle" – it's a place I hold dear as a
citizen of Acre Selund and as an individual.

MsgJp:
魔軍の手に落ちたと知った時は
心の一部まで失ったような思いを
したものですが――
MsgEn:
When I learned that it had fallen into the hands
of the Demon Army, I felt as though I had
lost a part of my heart.

MsgJp:
ふふ、今は――
ええ、素直に嬉しいものです！
MsgEn:
Hehe, now— Yes, it's something to be
honestly happy about!

MsgJp:
まさか、わたしがこの辺りの
エリアマスターとして正式に認められることに
なるなんて――
MsgEn:
I never thought I would officially be recognized
as an Area Master around here.

MsgJp:
実は、昔この展望城へも
歌を披露しに来たことがあるのですよ
今度は違う立場で招かれるなんて
人生何が起こるかわからないものです
MsgEn:
Actually, I came to perform here at
Lookout Castle in the past.
It's funny how life can invite you in
different ways this time.

MsgJp:
活動拠点が広くなった分
たくさんの避難者たちを受け入れることが
できるようになりました
MsgEn:
With the expanded operating base, we can now
accommodate many refugees.

MsgJp:
人が多くなると揉め事や悩み事も
増えるようですが――
これも命あってこそのものですものね
MsgEn:
With more people around, disputes and
worries seem to increase.
But that's just part of life.

MsgJp:
覚者様、もしよろしければ
問題を抱える人たちにお力をお貸しください
みな、喜ぶことでしょう
MsgEn:
Arisen, if you're willing, please lend your
strength to those in need.
Everyone would surely appreciate it.

MsgJp:
覚者様、あらためまして
わたしを含め、この村に居るものは皆
戦火を逃れて流れ着いた者ばかり
MsgEn:
Arisen, once again, I must emphasize that
everyone in this village, including myself, are
all refugees who have fled
from the ravages of war.

MsgJp:
あなたは解放軍と共に、このアッカーの地に
希望をもたらす方だと聞いています
MsgEn:
I have heard that you are the one who brings hope
to this land of Acre, alongside
the Liberation Army.

MsgJp:
わたしたちにできる協力は全ていたしましょう
まずはここより近い、安全な場所を
紹介いたします
MsgEn:
Let us cooperate and do everything we can.
First, I will introduce a nearby and
safe location for you.

MsgJp:
どうぞ、こちらを――
支援といっても、この程度しか用意できませんが
何かのお役に立つかもしれません
MsgEn:
Please, take this...
Although it's just a small token of support, it
may be of some use to you.

MsgJp:
覚者様のお力添えもあり
少しは旅の支えとなりそうなものを
手配できるようになってきました
遠慮なさらず、お持ちになってください
MsgEn:
With the assistance of the esteemed Arisen, we
are now able to arrange things that may serve as
a support on your journey.
Please do not hesitate to take them with you.

MsgJp:
覚者様、何もおっしゃらないで――
ただ、これをお持ちください
わたしたちが取り戻した希望、あなた様に
物資として託させてください
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen, please don't say anything...
Just please accept this.
Allow us to entrust you with the hope we have
regained as provisions.

MsgJp:
覚者様
この地にて新たな素材が
取れる場所をお教えします
あなたを守る武具に加工できるかもしれません
MsgEn:
Arisen, I shall reveal a new location in this
area where you can gather materials.
They might be suitable for crafting
protective armor for you.

MsgJp:
それと、もしよろしければ――
僅かな希望を胸に戦う兵たちをお救い下さい
どうか、よろしくお願いいたします――
MsgEn:
Also, if you would, please help the soldiers who
fight with a glimmer of hope in their hearts.
Please, we're counting on you.

MsgJp:
この村からほど近い北の地に
悪しき魔物たちが
集まろうとしているようです――
MsgEn:
It seems that wicked creatures are gathering in
the northern lands near this village.

MsgJp:
ここは、わたしたちに唯一のこされた憩いの村
どうかそのお力をお借りできないでしょうか――
MsgEn:
This is the only remaining
peaceful village for us.
Could we please borrow your power here?

MsgJp:
覚者様、僅かではありますが
支援品を増やすことができるようになりました
力無きわたしたちも、少しでもお役に立てればと
MsgEn:
Arisen, we've managed to increase our
supply of aid items.
Even those of us with little strength want to be
of assistance to you.

MsgJp:
この大陸の南方を統べる展望城――
王家ゆかりのこの城は、軍事だけでなく
貿易、文化面においても重要な城でした
MsgEn:
Lookout Castle, which governs the southern part
of this continent— This castle, with its royal
lineage, was not only important in terms of
military affairs, but also in trade and culture.

MsgJp:
その城下には、貴重な素材が
手に入る地下遺跡が残っているのです
危険な場所ですが、あなたのお力と
なるかも知れません
MsgEn:
Beneath that castle town, there's an underground
ruin that contains valuable materials.
It's a dangerous place, but with your abilities,
it might be possible to obtain them.

MsgJp:
このエリア中心部の湿原に悪しき魔物たちが
集まっているようです
覚者様、力を貸していただけないでしょうか？
MsgEn:
It seems that wicked creatures have gathered in
the central marsh of this area.
Arisen, could you lend your strength?

MsgJp:
展望城の奪還――この報せは
アッカーシェランで生きる者にとって
大きな希望となります
MsgEn:
The recapture of Lookout Castle – this news is a
great hope for those living in Acre Selund.

MsgJp:
長くこの国と共にあった歴史ある城ですから
城自体も、また王家の手に戻ったことを
喜んでいることでしょう！
MsgEn:
Since the castle has a long history with this
nation, it will surely rejoice to be back in the
hands of the royal family!

MsgJp: しかし覚者様、少し急ぐべきかも知れません
MsgEn: However, Arisen, we may need to hurry a little.

MsgJp:
実は――このエリアの脅威は
ジフール砦の骸の将だけではないのです
MsgEn:
In fact, the threat in this area is not just the
Necro Master of Jifule Fortress.

MsgJp:
近頃、民の間で恐ろしき噂が
囁かれています
――いえ、今は奪還の喜びを享受する時でしょうか
このお話はまたの機会にいたしましょう
MsgEn:
Lately, there have been terrifying rumors
circulating among the people...
No, now is the time to savor the joy of recapture.
Let us save this story for another occasion.

MsgJp:
覚者様だからこそお伝えできることなのですが――
ジフール砦の南方、ぬかるみの大地の先に
深い闇に包まれた地下水路があります
MsgEn:
It's because you're the Arisen that I can
share this information.
To the south of Jifule Fortress, beyond the muddy
expanse, there is a subterranean waterway
shrouded in deep darkness.

MsgJp:
すでに命無き魔物たちの巣窟となり果てた
恐ろしい場所ではありますが、そこには
特別な価値を持つモノが眠っているそうです
MsgEn:
Although it has already become a lair for
lifeless creatures, it's a dreadful place.
However, there are items with special
value sleeping there.

MsgJp:
覚者様――
折り入ってお願いがございます
王家の歴史にまつわるとても古い話――
MsgEn:
Esteemed Arisen, I humbly ask for a favor.
A very ancient tale concerning the history
of the royal family...

MsgJp:
このエリアを蝕む、魔軍とは異なる
脅威についてお話しさせてください
MsgEn:
Please allow me to talk about the threat that is
different from the Demon Army
that corrupts this area.

MsgJp:
国の言い伝えとなっていた古き魔物が
再び活動を始めていたなんて――
MsgEn:
The ancient creatures that were supposed to be
legends in the country have started to
become active again.

MsgJp:
そしてその邪悪な魔物を
討ち果たして頂けただなんて！
この国はまたひとつ救われました――
感謝いたします
MsgEn:
To think you would be able to defeat
those evil creatures!
Once again, our country has been saved. Thank you.

MsgJp:
あら――
既に別のミッションを受注されているみたいですね
MsgEn: Oh, you already have another mission? It seems so.

MsgJp:
受注されているミッションを取り消して頂き
再度お尋ねください
MsgEn: Please cancel the accepted missions and ask again.

MsgJp:
黒い鎧の騎士のことでお話しできるのは
その容姿と強さだけです
何しろ混乱していたので――
MsgEn:
I can only speak about the Black-armored Knight
in terms of their appearance and strength. After
all, I was quite confused at the time.

MsgJp:
黒い騎士を見かけたら
すぐにお知らせしますからね
MsgEn:
If you happen to see the Black Knight, please
inform me immediately.

MsgJp:
アッカーシェランがこれからどうなるにせよ
前より悪くなることはないでしょう
MsgEn:
Whatever happens to Acre Selund from now on, at
least it won't get worse than before.

MsgJp:
何しろ我々は今や希望を忘れては
いけないことを知っていますからね
MsgEn:
We mustn't forget that we know how important it
is not to forget hope now.

MsgJp:
わたしが伝えたことで
ジリアンが父上のことを
見直してくれると良いのだがな
MsgEn:
I hope that what I've conveyed will make Gillian
reconsider her feelings toward her father.

MsgJp:
レスタニアの覚者たちよ
我が戦友の娘ジリアンを頼むぞ
MsgEn:
Arisen of Lestania, I entrust you with Gillian,
the daughter of my comrade in battle.

MsgJp:
生きて戦いを終えられることが
これほど嬉しいとはね
MsgEn:
To be able to end the battle and live on, I
am so happy.

MsgJp: 絶望のぬかるみで転ばなくて良かったよ
MsgEn: I'm glad I didn't slip in the quagmire of despair.

MsgJp:
あら、こんにちは！
休んでいかれますか？
それとも、《弱化の回復》？
MsgEn:
Oh, hello!
Are you taking a break?
Or are you hoping to recover from [Weakness]?

MsgJp:
細々とやっているところですので――
休憩されるなら<VAL PRICE_INN>いただいても
よろしいでしょうか？
MsgEn:
Since we are doing things in a small scale— If
you would like to take a break, would it be
acceptable to charge you <VAL PRICE_INN>?

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

辛い時はお互い様、ですもんね
どうぞ、奥にベッドがありますから
疲れがとれるまで休んでいってくださいね！
MsgEn:
When times are tough, it's only fair to
help each other, right?
Please, there's a bed over there. Take a rest
until you're refreshed, okay!

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

《弱化の治療》ですね
<VAL PRICE_WEAK>です
しっかり治療しますから、安心してください！
MsgEn:
[Weakness Treatment,] is it?
It's <VAL PRICE_WEAK>.
Rest assured, I will provide thorough treatment!

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

うーん、わたしが見たところ
《弱化》はしてないみたいです
ここに来るまでに治ったのかしら――
MsgEn:
Hmm, from what I've seen, it doesn't seem like
you've been [Weakened].
I wonder if you healed before coming here...

MsgJp:
あ、わたしばっかり座りながらでごめんなさい
ここに来るまでに足を痛めてしまって
立っていられないんです
MsgEn:
Ah, I'm sorry for sitting here by myself. I
injured my leg before coming here,
so I can't stand.

MsgJp:
村が――鎧を付けた大きな魔物に
襲われたんです
気付いたら家族ともはぐれて――
MsgEn:
The village was attacked by a large
monster wearing armor.
Before I knew it, I got separated from my family.

MsgJp:
でも、逃げてくる途中で
ナヤジークさんに会えたんです
足を痛めたわたしに肩を貸してくださって
それで今、ここにいられています
MsgEn:
However, on the way while I was fleeing, I
encountered Lord Nazik.
He kindly lent me his shoulder as
I had injured my leg.
Thanks to that, I am able to be here now.

MsgJp:
父の真似事から始めたんですけど
医療の勉強をしていてよかったです
こうして皆さんのお役に立てますから
MsgEn:
I started by imitating my father, but I'm
glad I studied medicine.
Because I can help all of you this way.

MsgJp:
よう
要る物があるなら見ていけよ
MsgEn:
If you have something you need, go ahead
and take a look.

MsgJp:
俺もだけど、商人ってのは強いぜ
こんな状況になっても、まだ生きてるコネがある
そこから物やら情報を仕入れられるんだからな
MsgEn:
Not just me, but merchants are strong too.
Even in a situation like this, they still have
connections to keep them alive.
They can gather goods and information from there.

MsgJp:
ちっと展望城に用があってな
今はまだ様子見だが――
MsgEn:
I have something to do at Lookout Castle.
Right now, I'm just observing
the situation though...

MsgJp:
この一軒家が拠点として機能してるのは
ナヤジークのお陰だな
裏手では野菜まで作ってるんだぜ
MsgEn:
This single house is functioning as a
base, thanks to Nazik.
They even grow vegetables in the backyard.

MsgJp:
ああ、どうも
旅の仲間をお探しでしょうか？
MsgEn:
Ah, I see.
Are you looking for travel companions?

MsgJp:
仲間といえば――
私は牛をたくさん飼ってましてね
仲間みたいなもんでしたよ、ええ
MsgEn:
Speaking of companions...
I used to have a lot of oxen, you know.
They were like my companions, yes.

MsgJp:
ここでの生活に不満はありませんが
村に残してきた牛たちが気がかりです
連れて逃げられたら良かったのですが
MsgEn:
I have no complaints about life here, but I am
worried about the cows I left
behind in the village.
It would have been good if I could have
brought them with me.

MsgJp:
ナヤジークさんの案で
近くの高台の上に畑を作ってるんです
あんな風に、家畜小屋も作れたらなぁ――
MsgEn:
With Nazik's suggestion, we are creating a field
on a nearby high hill.
It would be nice if we could also build
livestock sheds like that...

MsgJp: えっと、何か？
MsgEn: Um, is there something you need?

MsgJp: ――はい

あっ、覚者さん
どうしたの？

早くお父さんとお母さんが
迎えに来てくれないかなって――
妹にも会いたい――怖いよ――
MsgEn:
I wish my father and mother would come
pick me up quickly...
I want to see my sister too... I'm scared...

MsgJp:
ぼくがここにいるって、どうしたら
家族に伝わるんだろう？
ぼくも、家族がどこにいるかわからないのに――
MsgEn:
How can I make my presence known to my family?
Even though I don't know where my family is...

MsgJp:
どこに行ったらいいのか
何にもわからなくて――
どうしよう――
MsgEn:
Where should I go?
I don't know anything...
What should I do...

MsgJp:
ナヤジークさんがね
人が多いところに来た方が、お父さんや
お母さんが見つかりやすいかもって
ここに連れてきてくれたんだ
MsgEn:
Nazik told me that if we come to a place with
many people, it might be easier to find
my father or mother.
That's why they brought me here.

MsgJp:
ここにいれば、きっといつか
お父さんたちのことを知ってる人に会えるよね！
だって、これだけたくさんの人がいるんだもん
MsgEn:
If I stay here, I'm sure I'll eventually meet
someone who knows about Dad.
After all, there are so many people here.

MsgJp:
ここに来てから、ちょっと気分が良いよ
アデムと遊ぶのも楽しいしね！
MsgEn:
Since coming here, I've been
feeling a little better.
It's fun playing with Adem, too!

MsgJp:
迷子になった時は変に動くよりも
迎えを待ちなさいって、お父さんが言ってたんだ
MsgEn:
When you get lost, instead of wandering
aimlessly, my father used to say, "Wait for
someone to come and find you."

MsgJp:
俺は村の警備があって
ここを離れられないが――話だけなら
MsgEn:
I am responsible for guarding the village, so I
cannot leave here... but if it's just
talking, then I can.

MsgJp:
ちょっと場所は辺鄙だが
一見平和そうな村に見えるだろう
――最初はただの空き屋だったなんて
俺も信じられない
MsgEn:
The location is a bit remote, but at first
glance, it may seem like a peaceful village.
I can't believe that it was
just an abandoned house.

MsgJp:
疲れてるなら、小屋の中で
休んでいくといい
ここまで来るのも大変だったろう
MsgEn:
If you're tired, it's a good idea to
rest inside the hut.
It must have been tough to come all the way here.

MsgJp:
そこにいるデニスって子なんだが――
すすまみれでトボトボ歩いてるのを
俺が保護してきたんだ
MsgEn:
There's this kid named Dennis over there— I found
him walking slowly, covered in soot, and brought
him under my protection.

MsgJp:
家族とはぐれたのが堪えたらしくて
どうにも元気が出ないみたいだ
まだ子供なのに、可哀想にな――
MsgEn:
It seems like they are feeling down because they
have been separated from their family, and they
can't seem to muster up any energy. Even though
they are still a child, it's quite pitiful.

MsgJp:
ああ、デニスって子は
ナヤジークさんが展望城に連れてったよ
そっちの方が家族も見つかりやすいだろうからってね
MsgEn:
Ah, that child Dennis, Nazik took
him to Lookout Castle.
They said it would be easier to
find a family there.

MsgJp:
家族、無事に見つかるといいんだが――
あの子も期待してたみたいだからな
MsgEn:
I hope the family is found safe and sound.
That child seemed to have high
expectations too, so...

MsgJp: なになに？　私に何か用？
MsgEn:
What is it, what is it? Do you have
something you need from me?

MsgJp:
この村、すごいよねぇ
色んなところから逃げてきた人たちが
それぞれに働いてこんなにうまく回ってるんだって
MsgEn:
This village, isn't it amazing?
People who have escaped from various places are
all working and it's running so smoothly.

MsgJp:
ナヤジークさんって
昔は大女優だったらしいよ～
確かに、今もそんな感じだよね
MsgEn:
Nazik, I heard she used to be a famous
actress back in the day.
Honestly, she still has that kind
of presence even now.

MsgJp:
私も弓の腕はなかなかなんだよ
ま、今はまだそれを見せつける時
じゃないかな～なんて
MsgEn:
My skill with a bow is not bad either, you know?
Well, now is probably not the time to show it off.
Or so I think～

MsgJp:
え？　どうしてこんなところにって――
いやあ、ここら辺なんか怪しいな～って
勘なんだけどね、勘！
MsgEn:
Huh? Why am I in a place like this...?
Well, I have a feeling that this area is a bit
suspicious, you know～ Just using my
intuition, that's all!

MsgJp:
それで、今日はどんな感じにする？
戦技を変えるんでしょ？
MsgEn:
So, how are we going to approach it today?
Are we going to change our tactics?

MsgJp:
展望城も取り返せたことだし
これからグイグイいけそうな気がしてるんだ
――君がいるからかな？
MsgEn:
Now that we've reclaimed Lookout Castle, I feel
like we can go full steam ahead from here....
Is it because you're here?

MsgJp:
まだ立ち直れない人もいれば
慎重な人もいるけど、あたしはちょっとでも
希望を見つけて喜んでいきたいよ
MsgEn:
There are still some people who haven't been able
to recover, and there are also cautious
individuals, but as for me, I want to find even a
glimmer of hope and embrace it joyfully.

MsgJp:
状況に応じて戦技を付け替えてるのね
感心感心！　それってとっても重要だよね
MsgEn:
It seems like you're changing your combat
techniques depending on the situation.
I'm really impressed!
That's extremely important, isn't it?

MsgJp:
あら、覚者様じゃない
今日はどうしました？
MsgEn:
Oh, it's not the Arisen, is it? What can I
do for you today?

MsgJp:
ぐっすり眠ると、心も体も癒されますものね
適切な休養って大切なんですよ
ああ、お代は<VAL PRICE_INN>です
休んでいかれるでしょう？
MsgEn:
When you sleep soundly, both your heart and body
are healed, you know.
Proper rest is really important. Ah, the cost is
<VAL PRICE_INN>.
Will you be taking a rest?

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

そうですね――今はベッドにも空きがあるし
自由に眠っていってもらって大丈夫です
こういう日があってもいいじゃないですか
MsgEn:
I see...
Well, we have plenty of beds available right now,
so feel free to sleep as long as you need.
It's okay to have days like this, you know.

MsgJp:
覚者さんじゃないですか！
城内の散策ですか？
MsgEn:
You are an Arisen, aren't you?
Enjoying a stroll around the castle?

MsgJp:
ずっと落ち込んでたんです
だけど、ここへ来てからは空を眺める
余裕ができました
――覚者さんのおかげですよ！
MsgEn:
I was depressed for quite some time, but since
coming here and looking at the sky, I have
gained some peace of mind.
It's all thanks to you, Arisen!

MsgJp:
この場内には様々な人がいますね
そういえば、盗賊みたいな服を着た
女の子もウロウロしてたなぁ
MsgEn:
All sorts come to this hall, huh.
Oh, by the way, there was a girl about
dressed like a bandit.

MsgJp:
展望城の塔のてっぺんには
もう行かれましたか？
いい眺めですよ
MsgEn:
Have you already been to the top of the
Tower of Lookout Castle?
It's such a great view.

MsgJp:
あら、覚者さんも
景色を眺めに来たの？
MsgEn:
Oh, did you come to view the scenery,
too, Ser Arisen?

MsgJp:
ここっていいところね
ちょっと覗くだけのはずだったんだけど
もうちょっとここに居るつもり
MsgEn:
This place is nice, isn't it?
I was supposed to just take a quick look, but I
think I'll stay here a little longer.

MsgJp:
ふぅ
高いところって空気が澄んでる気がしない？
風が吹いてるせいかな
MsgEn:
Phew. Don't you feel like the air
is clearer up high?
Perhaps it's due to the wind.

MsgJp:
はやく戦、終わらないかなぁ
楽しく盗みに入りたいよね
MsgEn:
I wish the war would end already.
I want to get back to having fun stealing things.

MsgJp:
おおっ、覚者さん！
こんなところでどうした？
MsgEn:
Oh, an Arisen! What are you doing in a
place like this?

MsgJp:
こうしてオークに奪われた村も
取り返せるものなんだな
俺の故郷もいつか――
MsgEn:
As it stands, even a village taken by
Orcs can be reclaimed.
Someday, my hometown too—

MsgJp:
地元では酒場をやってたんだ
戦が落ち着いて、解放軍が解体されたら――
またあの頃の常連を集めて飲みたいよ
MsgEn:
I used to run a tavern in my hometown.
Once the war settles down and the Liberation Army
disbands... I want to gather the regulars from
those days and have a drink together again.

MsgJp:
この村のベイザばあさん
やたらおっかない顔してないか？
オーク相手にもあの調子だったのかな
MsgEn:
Grandma Beza of this village looks
very scary, doesn't she?
I wonder if she was like that with the Orcs.

MsgJp:
――なに？
言いたいことがありそうな顔ね
MsgEn:
...What is it?
You look like you have something to say.

MsgJp: あなたのおかげで、この村はもう安心ね
MsgEn: Thanks to you, this village is safe now.

MsgJp:
私の地元？
まだ無事なはずだけど――
便りが無いからわからないわ
MsgEn:
My hometown? It should still be safe, but... I
don't know because there's no news.

MsgJp:
村人が生きた状態で囚われていたのは
本当に幸運だったわ
MsgEn:
It is truly fortunate that the captured
villagers are still alive.

MsgJp: ん、どうも

解放された村人もだけど
最近は軍の雰囲気もちょっと変わったよ
MsgEn:
Not only among the liberated villagers, but even
the atmosphere within the army
has changed recently.

MsgJp:
暇なら俺の
"なんでもないものコレクション"でも見てく？
MsgEn:
If you're not busy, why don't you check out my
"Collection of insignificant things"?

MsgJp:
あんたに希望っての？
そういうのを見つけたんだよな
それでちょっと落ち着いて眠れるように
なったってやつも多いと思うぜ
MsgEn:
You, do you have hope? That's what I have found.
I think it's made a lot of people able to sleep a
little more peacefully.

MsgJp: やぁ、変わりないかい？

ここら辺も少し落ち着いたからか
たまに小鳥を見かけるようになったよ
オークに怯えて隠れてたんだろうね
MsgEn:
It may be due to things calming down around here,
but I've started to see small birds again.
They must have been hiding, scared of the Orcs.

MsgJp:
朝早い時間に、クラッカーやパンを
少し砕いて小鳥にあげてるんだ
癒されるよ
MsgEn:
Early in the morning, I crumble some crackers or
bread and feed the little birds.
It's deeply soothing.

MsgJp:
周辺の警備やら鍛練やら――
毎日緊張することも多いからね
その合間に楽しみは持っておきたいんだ
MsgEn:
Security around the area and training, you know...
There are many things to be tense about
every day, you know.
So I want to have something enjoyable in between.

MsgJp:
これは覚者様
ご用はなんでしょうかね？
MsgEn:
Ah, Arisen.
What can I do for you?

MsgJp:
一度潰された村ですからね
これから急いで立て直して、覚者さんや
兵士の皆さんのお役に立てるようにしますよ
MsgEn:
It's a village that's been pillaged
once before, you see.
We'll hurry to rebuild it and make ourselves
useful to Ser Arisen and all the soldiers.

MsgJp:
この村が元通りになったら
行き場の無い人たちに住まいを
用意することもできるでしょう
ここからはあたしたちが頑張らないとね
MsgEn:
Once this village is restored to its former
state, we will be able to provide housing for
those who have nowhere else to go.
We'll have to work hard from here on out.

MsgJp:
もうあたしも年なもんだから
後は若い人たちに任せようかと
思ってたけど――
MsgEn:
Since I'm getting older now, I thought I should
leave it to the young ones, but...

MsgJp:
休めるのはもう少し先みたいですよ
やることがたくさんありますからね
MsgEn:
It seems rest will have to wait a little longer.
There's plenty to do, you see.

MsgJp:
これはこれは
まだ何も無い村ですが
ゆっくりしていってください
MsgEn:
Well, well, this village may not have much yet,
but please, make yourself at home
and take it easy.

MsgJp:
魔軍に囚われていた時は
もう自分に明日は無いんだと
毎晩思ってましたよ――
MsgEn:
When I was captured by the demon army, I used to
think every night that tomorrow might not come...

MsgJp:
どうにか私も覚者さんたちの
お力になりたいものです
MsgEn:
I hope to somehow be of assistance to
you, esteemed Arisen.

MsgJp:
――今はまだ、身の回りのことを
どうにかするので精一杯ですけどね
MsgEn:
But right now, I'm doing my best to care for
my personal affairs.

MsgJp:
猟師をやってたんですが
狩りと戦いは違いますから
私が兵士として戦えるかは――
MsgEn:
I used to be a hunter, but hunting and
fighting are different.
Whether I can fight as a soldier...

MsgJp: ああ、覚者さま――

囚われて思ったんです
わたしみたいに、戦うこともできない者は
ただ殺されるのを待つしかできないんだって
MsgEn:
Being captured made me realize that someone like
me, who can't even fight, can only
wait to be killed.

MsgJp:
わたしの人生も燃え溶けていくみたい
解放はされたけど、戦が終わったわけじゃないもの
これからもきっとたくさんの辛いことが――
MsgEn:
It seems like my life is also burning away, I may
be liberated, but the war is not over yet.
Surely, there will be many more
hardships to come...

MsgJp:
どうしたらいいのかしら
こんなはずじゃなかったわ
幸せってどうやって見つけるものだったかしら
MsgEn:
What should I do? This isn't how
it was supposed to be.
I wonder how you're supposed to find happiness.

MsgJp:
覚者様は僕たちのこと
いつまで助けてくれるの――？
MsgEn:
Master Arisen, how long will you continue
to help us?

MsgJp:
もうずっと体の具合がよくないんだ
ううん、戦争が始まる前からだけどね
MsgEn:
My physical condition hasn't been
good for a while now.
Not since before the war started, indeed.

MsgJp:
きっとこれから大変だよね
村を作り直すんだもん
僕の居場所はあるのかな
MsgEn:
I'm sure it's going to be tough from now on,
since we have to rebuild the village.
I wonder if there's a place for me.

MsgJp:
魔軍から生きて解放されたし
兵士さんもたくさん来てくれたけど――
MsgEn:
I was released from the demon army, and many
soldiers came to help, but...

MsgJp: こんにちは・仮
雑談１・仮
雑談２・仮
雑談３・仮
こんにちは・仮
雑談１・仮
雑談２・仮
雑談３・仮
こんにちは・仮
雑談１・仮
雑談２・仮
雑談３・仮
はい、何か

地下に隠れ潜んでいても
情報収集は怠っておりません
この地区のことであれば、何なりと
MsgEn:
Even while hiding underground, I haven't
neglected to gather information.
If it's about this area, feel
free to ask anything.

MsgJp:
新たな情報でしょうか、それとも
何かお困りのことでも――？
MsgEn:
Is there any new information, or is there
something troubling you?

MsgJp:
メガドシスにおいて
アッカー家と覚者様をお支えすることが
第一の使命と考えております
MsgEn:
In Megado, our first and foremost mission is to
support the Acre family and the esteemed Arisen.

MsgJp:
まったく頭が痛くなることばかりですね
――いえ、頭痛持ちというわけでは
ありませんが
MsgEn:
Seems like nothing but headaches, doesn't it?
—Well, I don't mean I suffer from headaches,
but you get the idea.

MsgJp:
残念ながら、この状況です
十分な情報を提供できないのは
私も遺憾に思っています
MsgEn:
Unfortunately, this is the current situation.
Regretfully, I've naught else to provide.

MsgJp:
やるべきことをやるのみ
兵士とはそういったものです
MsgEn:
We do what we have to do.
That's what being a soldier is all about.

MsgJp:
メガドを取り戻せたのは僥倖です
――はやく王宮を奪還したいものです
私たちは、本来あそこにいるべきなのです
MsgEn:
It is a stroke of luck that we were
able to reclaim Megado.
I hope we can retake the Royal Palace soon.
That's where we should be, where we truly belong.

MsgJp:
王族を、王都をお守りするのが
我らメガド王宮近衛隊の使命――
一度その名が折れた悔しさを糧に
明日を切り開くのみです
MsgEn:
Our mission as the Megado Royal Guard is to
protect the Royal Family and the capital.
We must use the regret of our past failures as
fuel to carve out a path
towards a brighter future.

MsgJp:
王子を守りぬかねばなりません
何としても――
MsgEn:
We must protect the prince.
At all costs...

MsgJp:
覚者様のお噂、この北の地まで響いてまいりました
王子を――ネド王子を救い出してくださったとのこと
我々近衛隊一同、心よりの感謝を――
MsgEn:
Word has reached us, esteemed Arisen, that you
have come to this northern land and
rescued Prince Nedo.
The entirety of the Royal Guard expresses our
heartfelt gratitude for your noble deed.

MsgJp:
何かお力となりたいのですが、負傷者が多く
この場を動くことが叶わないのです
MsgEn:
I would like to be of assistance, but there are
many injured individuals, and I am unable to
leave this location.

MsgJp:
くっ――
倉庫から日用品の類をかき集めてまいります
せめてもの支給品とさせていただきたく――
MsgEn:
Hngh...
I shall gather some supplies from the warehouse
and provide them as at least
some form of support...

MsgJp:
無いよりはまし、といった程度かも
しれませんが――これが今お渡しできる品々です
どうかご武運を
MsgEn:
It may be little better than nothing, but this is
the extent of what I can offer you at the moment.
Please accept these items and may you have
good fortune in battle!

MsgJp:
ちょうど良いところにおいでくださいました
今週の支援品を準備していたのです
まだ十分とはいえませんが
ある程度は使えるかと――
MsgEn:
You have come at just the right time.
I was preparing this week's supplies.
It may not be enough, but should be
useful to some extent...

MsgJp:
覚者様、ぜひこちらをお持ちください
微力ながら、日々貴方を支援することが
王家の再興に繋がるとかたく信じております
MsgEn:
Dear Arisen, please take this with you.
I firmly believe that supporting you every day,
to the best of my abilities, will contribute to
the revival of the Royal Family.

MsgJp:
ハァ――各地にて苦境にある者からの
報告が絶えず舞い込んでくるのです
とはいえ、我々もこの有様――
MsgEn:
Haah... We are constantly receiving reports of
distress in various regions.
But even we are in this predicament...

MsgJp:
覚者様、どうか彼らにも
手を差し伸べてはいただけませんか？
その代わりにという訳ではありませんが、
稀少な素材が採れる場所をお伝えしましょう
MsgEn:
Dear esteemed Arisen, would you kindly extend a
helping hand to them as well?
It is not meant as compensation, but allow me to
share with you a location where rare
materials can be found.

MsgJp:
メガドを奪還するのであればニルビリス大橋を
確保すべきでしょう
この橋は城塞都市としての要の一つでもあります
MsgEn:
If we are to reclaim Megado, we should secure the
Great Nilviris Bridge.
This bridge is also one of the key points
in our fortress city.

MsgJp:
しかし、魔軍の連中もそのことは承知の上と見え
橋の防衛を強化しているようです
我々の戦力では突破は叶いませんが
覚者様であれば、あるいは――！
MsgEn:
However, it seems that the demon army is well
aware of this and has strengthened the defense of
the bridge.
With our current forces, breaking through is
impossible.
But if it's the Arisen, perhaps...!

MsgJp:
戦場にて共に戦えず、申し訳ありません
少しでも支援品を増やせるよう
兵たちにも物資の節約を呼びかけている次第です
MsgEn:
We regret that we cannot fight with
you on the battlefield.
We are also asking our soldiers to conserve
supplies so that we can increase our relief
supplies as much as possible!

MsgJp:
覚者様、ご無礼を承知で申し上げますが
見たところ、覚者様の武具はこの地の魔物には
少々不向きなご様子――
MsgEn:
Dear Arisen, please forgive my impoliteness, but
it seems that your equipment may be a little
unsuitable for the creatures of this land...

MsgJp:
良い素材が採れる場をご案内いたしましょう
魔物が徘徊する薄暗き水路ではありますが
覚者様であれば問題にはならないはずです
MsgEn:
Allow me to guide you to a place where you can
gather good materials.
It is a dimly lit waterway where monsters wander,
but it should not be a problem for an
Arisen like yourself.

MsgJp:
実は、悪しき竜による襲撃があった日――
同時にメガド市街に大勢のオークが姿を現したのです
城壁の外と内からの攻撃に、メガドは
一日と持ちませんでした
MsgEn:
On the day of the evil dragon's attack, a large
horde of Orcs simultaneously appeared in
the streets of Megado.
The city fell within a day, overwhelmed by
attacks from both inside and outside the walls.

MsgJp:
今思い返しても、それが妙でして――
悪しき竜の襲撃こそ突然だったものの、それまで
街の防衛に問題はなかったのです
MsgEn:
Even looking back on it now, it was strange— The
attack of the Evil Dragon was sudden, but until
then, there were no problems with the
defense of the town.

MsgJp:
いえ、仮に何者かが魔軍の侵入を手引きしたとして
それを察知できなかった近衛隊の落ち度ということに
変わりはありませんが――
MsgEn:
Even if someone aided the Demon Army's
infiltration, the fact remains that it was a
lapse in judgment on the part of the Royal Guard
that they failed to detect it.

MsgJp:
しかし、我々の情報収集能力とて
低くはないと自負しています
この規模となった今も、魔物が集まりつつある場は
把握しているのですから
MsgEn:
However, we take pride in our ability
to gather information.
Even now, at this scale, we are aware of the
areas where monsters are gathering.

MsgJp:
――我々は"メガド王宮近衛隊"
この都市と、王族をお守りするため編成されました
自力での奪還こそ叶いませんでしたが
再びここに立つことができ、感慨無量です
MsgEn:
We are the 'Megado Royal Palace Royal Guard',
organized to protect this city and the Royal
Family.
Although we were unable to recapture it on our
own, being able to stand here once again fills us
with overwhelming emotions.

MsgJp:
近衛隊元隊長ベイジル
そしてこれまでに散っていった隊員たちの魂も
我々と共に、今ここにあることでしょう
MsgEn:
Former Captain of the Royal Guard, Basil.
And the souls of the noble departed here with us,
now, in this very moment.

MsgJp:
時に――メガドには、王家の命により封鎖している
隠し扉がいくつか存在します
MsgEn:
By the way—Megado has several hidden doors sealed
by the orders of the Royal Family.

MsgJp:
しかし、この非常事態です
覚者様のお力無しに状況を打開できぬことは明白
王宮近衛隊隊長の名に於いて、全てを解放いたします
MsgEn:
However, in this state of emergency, it's clear
that we cannot overcome the situation
without the Arisen's power.
In the name of the Royal Guard's Captain, I
hereby release everything to you.

MsgJp:
城塞都市メガドが完全に"王都"として戻るまで
どうかお力をお貸しください
MsgEn:
Until the fortress city of Megado returns
completely to the "Royal Capital," please
lend us your strength.

MsgJp:
先日覚者様もご覧になったメガド回廊には
さらなる深部が存在します
MsgEn:
In the Megado Corridor, which the esteemed Arisen
has recently witnessed, there exists
even deeper sections.

MsgJp:
脅威となる魔物が跋扈していますが
それだけ、今まで調査の手が入らなかった
場でもあります――
つまり、それだけ貴重な素材が手に入るのです
MsgEn:
There are rampant threats from dangerous
monsters, which is why there hasn't been much
investigation in these areas until now.
In other words, it's an opportunity to
obtain valuable materials.

MsgJp:
異国の覚者様
これよりお話することは
他言無用にお願いいたします
MsgEn:
Master Arisen of a foreign land.
I implore you to keep what I am about to
divulge to you, a secret.

MsgJp:
王家――アッカー家の方々は
代々アッカーシェランを守護してこられました
しかし、輝かしき統治には――
陰となる部分があるのです
MsgEn:
The royal family, the Acres, have protected Acre
Selund from generation to generation.
However, even in the midst of their glorious
rule, there exists a shadow.

MsgJp:
無事のご帰還、お喜び申し上げます
アッカー家の統治無くしてアッカーシェランは無し
王家を守ることは、我らの国を守ることに
他なりません
MsgEn:
We are delighted to welcome your safe return.
Without the rule of House Acre, there
would be no Acre Selund.
Protecting the Royal Family is tantamount to
protecting our nation, nothing less.

MsgJp:
過去の古き傷ともいうべき魔物の征伐
王家に仕える者として最大の感謝を――
MsgEn:
Conquering the ancient wounds, so to
speak, of the monsters.
As a servant of the Royal Family,
I am most grateful...

MsgJp:
覚者様――我々も、再び困難に
立ち向かう覚悟はできています
MsgEn:
Master Arisen, we too are prepared to face
difficulties once again.

MsgJp:
悲観する者もいるでしょうが
ネド王子がご健在です
MsgEn:
There may be some pessimism about, but Prince
Nedo is alive and well.

MsgJp:
それに、我々兵士とて数は減ったものの
厳戒態勢を解いたわけではありません
すぐに動くことができますから
MsgEn:
Furthermore, although the number of soldiers may
have decreased, we have not lifted our state of
high alert. We can still move quickly.

MsgJp:
この世には、理解も及ばぬほどの
圧倒的な力があるのでしょうね
あの渦を見ていると、そう思わされます
MsgEn:
In this world, there is an overwhelming power
that eludes comprehension.
When I behold at that vortex,
that's all I can say.

MsgJp:
メガドの民は強いものです
――不安はあるでしょうが
生きようとしています
MsgEn:
The people of Megado are strong.
—Though they may have fears,
they fight to survive.

MsgJp:
ここまでよく来てくれた
薄暗いところだが、今のところは安全だ
少し足を休めていくといい
MsgEn:
You've come here quite far.
It's dimly lit, but for now, it's safe.
Take a moment to rest your legs.

MsgJp:
こんなことを言うのも気が引けるが
隠れ潜むのも楽なことではない――
寝床の代価として<VAL PRICE_INN>を
貰えないだろうか
MsgEn:
While I may be hesitant to say such things, it is
