time, until we do our best—!

MsgJp:
より主の役に立つための改善
転職、スキル変更、装備、リアクション――
さまざまな手段が考えられるが、しかし――
MsgEn:
Improvements to better serve Master; Career
change, skill development, equipment
upgrades, reactions...
There are various means to consider, however—

MsgJp:
戦い方で気になること、ですか？
おや――何か言いたげな顔ですね
生憎、私は我が振る舞いに誇りを持っておりますよ
MsgEn:
Is there something on your mind?
You seem like you want to say something.
Unfortunately, I take pride in my behavior.

MsgJp:
戦い方で気になること、ですか？
無い――といえば嘘になりますが
主殿のお手を煩わせるほどのことではございません
MsgEn:
Is there anything you are concerned about
in the way we fight?
I'd be lying if I said I didn't.
It's nothing that would bother you, Master.

MsgJp:
戦い方で気になること、ですか？
それは――ええ、残念ながら
私にも完璧ではない点があるのです
無論、弛まぬ研鑽により日々磨かれてはおりますが
MsgEn:
Concerned about tactics, huh?
Well, unfortunately, I have imperfections too.
Of course, I am being constantly polished through
diligent study and practice.

MsgJp:
――何か思うところがあるのですね
私もちょうど、主殿の理想とする戦徒の姿について
自室でゆっくりと伺いたい、そう思っていたのですよ
主の気の向くとき、自室のベルでお呼びください
MsgEn:
I see that there is something on your mind.
I was just thinking that I would like to hear
about the ideal form of the Myrmidons that you,
Lord, envision. When it suits your mood, please
ring the bell in your room to summon me.

MsgJp:
あぁ！　クラフトの静かなる熱とは異なる
貴方と大地を歩むこの高揚感――！！
ポーンとしてこれに勝る充実はありません
MsgEn:
Ahh! Different from the quiet heat of the craft,
this elation of walking the earth with you...!
As a pawn, there is no greater fulfillment.

MsgJp:
覚者殿、体力は常に気配りを
万一貴方の身に何かあったなら、悔しき哉――！
私には、貴方を助け起こす術がないのです
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen, I am always aware of
your physical condition.
If by any chance something were to happen to you,
it would be most regrettable—!
I'd have no means to assist you.

MsgJp:
クラフトでも戦闘でも、ご用命があれば
喜んでお受けしますとも
我が敬愛せし覚者殿
MsgEn:
In crafting or combat, I am happy to lend
assistance whenever you have a request.
You have my utmost respect, Arisen.

MsgJp:
白竜さまはお目が高いと言わざるを得ません
なにせ、貴方さまを覚者に選んだのですから！
MsgEn:
I can't help but say that Lord White Dragon
has exquisite taste.
After all, he chose you, the Arisen!

MsgJp:
あぁ、もし地に膝をつくようなことになれば
私の株が――！
MsgEn:
Ah, if it were to come to bow
down on the ground...
My reputation would be ruined!

MsgJp:
そうそう。野外では足元にご注意くださいね
崖や毒沼、クモにスライム――
気味悪いものを踏んだり、思わぬ怪我をしますから
MsgEn:
Yes, indeed. Please be careful of your
footing in the outdoors.
Cliffs, poisonous swamps, slimes, and spiders—
you could step on something creepy or get
unexpected injuries, you know.

MsgJp:
おぉ、そうだ。ニュースはご覧になりましたか？
近くに良いクエストがあるかもしれませんよ
MsgEn:
Oh, that's right. Have you seen the news?
There might be a good quest nearby, you know.

MsgJp:
ふふっ！
魔物や迷宮とて、さしずめ貴方の引き立て役
貴方さまとともに、偉大な冒険譚の一幕を
演ずる喜び――何ものにも代えがたい
MsgEn:
Hehe! As with enemies or within labyrinths, I am
merely a supporting role for you, Master.
Together with you, I take delight in enacting
scenes only found in grand tales...
Something incomparable to anything else.

MsgJp:
星の数ほどいるポーンの中から
私を選んでくださったこと、
ポーンとしてこの上なき光栄――！
MsgEn:
From among the countless pawns in the sky, the
fact that you have chosen me...
As a pawn, it is the greatest honor!

MsgJp: 必ずや、お役に立ってご覧にいれますとも
MsgEn:
I will definitely do my best to be of
service to you, Lord.

MsgJp:
少し思う所があるのです
現在の私のジョブや容姿、働きぶりは
貴方さまの満足にたるレベルなのか――否か
MsgEn:
There are some thoughts I have.
Regarding my current job, appearance, and
dedication, are they at a level that
satisfies you, Master?

MsgJp:
戦いで気になること？
ありませんよ！
心配してくれてありがとうございます！
MsgEn:
What do you worry about in battles?
There's nothing to worry about!
Thank you for your concern!

MsgJp:
戦いで気になること、ですかぁ
――ううん、何もないですよ！
本当ですって！　心配性だなぁ
MsgEn:
Something bothering you about the battle, huh?
Really, there's nothing!
I swear! You're a worrier, aren't you?

MsgJp:
戦いで気になること？
そうだなぁ――ううん、きっとぼくだけだと思うから
覚者さまは気にしないでください！
本当に大丈夫ですって！
MsgEn:
What concerns you in battle?
Well, um... I think it's probably just me, so
please don't worry, Arisen!
I assure you, everything will be alright!

MsgJp:
あの――覚者さま、実は相談したいことがあって
ぼく、覚者さまのお役にもっと立ちたいから
戦い方を教えてもらえないかな、って思って――
嫌じゃなかったら、お部屋でベルを鳴らしてね
MsgEn:
Lord... There's actually something
I wanted to consult with you about. 
I want to be of more help to you, Lord,
so if you could teach me how to fight... 
If it's no bother to you,
please ring the bell in your room.

MsgJp:
覚者さまと一緒に冒険できて嬉しいなぁ！
次はどんなところへ行って、
どんな敵と戦うんだろう！
MsgEn:
I'm happy to be able to go on an
adventure with you, ser!
Where will we go next and what kind of enemies
will we fight against, I wonder!

MsgJp:
覚者さま、体力は大丈夫ですか？
いつも元気でいてもらわないと
ぼく、心配になります
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen, are you feeling well?
I always want you to be in good health.
I do worry about you.

MsgJp:
クラフトも楽しいですよ
うまく出来たらよし！　ってなるし
まぁ、冒険とはまた違いますけどね
MsgEn:
Crafting is also enjoyable, you know.
And if you do it well, it feels good!
Well, it's different from going on
an adventure, though.

MsgJp:
うまくやって
もっと覚者さまに褒めてもらいたいな！
MsgEn:
I want to do well and receive more
praise from the Arisen.

MsgJp:
うーん。ぼくだけやられたりしたら
脚をひっぱるなぁ
気をつけなきゃ
MsgEn:
Hmmm. If I'm the only one who gets hit...
I'd be pulling your leg.
I've got to be careful.

MsgJp:
覚者さま、足元はいつも気を付けてくださいね！
崖から落ちそうになったり、変な水に
浸かったり、何かあったら大変です
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen, please always be careful of your
footing! You could fall off a cliff or get
submerged in strange water, and it would be quite
troublesome if something were to happen.

MsgJp:
あっ、そうだ！　ニュース見てみませんか？
近くにクエストがあるかもしれませんよ
MsgEn:
Oh, right! Have you seen the news?
There might be a good quest nearby, you know.

MsgJp:
よーし、はりきっていきましょう！！
覚者さまと一緒なら、何でもやれる気がします！
MsgEn:
Alright, let's do our best!!
If I'm with an Arisen, I feel like
I can do anything!

MsgJp:
覚者さまのポーンとして、これからも
お供させてくださいね！
MsgEn:
Arisen, please allow me to serve as
your Pawn from now on!

MsgJp:
ぼく、もっと強くなって
きっと覚者さまを守りますから！
MsgEn:
I will become stronger, and I will
definitely protect the Arisen!

MsgJp:
ぼく、ちゃんと役に立ってますか？
ジョブとかスキルとか、えーと、装備とか――
このままで大丈夫かなぁ
MsgEn:
Am I really being useful?
In terms of my job and skills, err,
equipment and all...
I wonder if things will be alright like this.

MsgJp:
戦いで気になること、ですかい
俺は特にねえが――
覚者様は何かあるんですかい？
MsgEn:
What concerns you in battle?
I don't particularly have any...
Ser Arisen, is there something you need?

MsgJp:
戦いで気になること？
そりゃあ、高みを目指そうとすれば
思うところはいくらでも出るもんで――
MsgEn:
What concerns you in battle?
Well, if you're aiming for greatness, there are
countless things to consider. Yes.

MsgJp:
戦いで気になること、ですかい
あー、覚者様も気付いちまいましたか
戦いに影響しないよう気遣ったつもりなんですが――
迷いは命取り、ってことですかねぇ
MsgEn:
Are you worried about something during combat?
Ah, so you've noticed too, Master.
I thought I was being cautious so as not to be
affected during the battle...
But I guess hesitation can be fatal, huh?

MsgJp:
覚者様、お忙しいとは思うんですがね
俺の戦い方――主人として、見てて気になること
よかったら、聞かせていただけねえかと思って――
自室のベル、いつでもいいんで鳴らしてくだせえや
MsgEn:
Master, I understand that you're busy.
However, there's something that concerns me
as your servant and I was wondering
if I could ask you about it.
If it's convenient for you, could you please ring
the bell in your room whenever you have the time?

MsgJp:
覚者さまとご一緒できて光栄です
そりゃあもう、これ以上のことはありませんよ
俺たちポーンにとっちゃあ
MsgEn:
It is an honor to be able to
accompany an Arisen, Master.
Oh, there is nothing more we Pawns could ask for.

MsgJp:
覚者さま、体調管理はきっちり頼みますよ
何かあってからじゃあ遅いですからね
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen, I will rely on you to manage
your health properly.
It's too late to do something
after something happens.

MsgJp:
物を作るのぁ、得意なんですけどね
やっぱりこうしてあちこちご一緒できるほうが
腕ぁ鳴りますね
MsgEn:
I'm good at making things, but it's better to
work together like this.

MsgJp:
魔物や任務や、厄介事も
あるでしょうが心配いりません
覚者さまはどーんと構えててくださいよ
MsgEn:
There may be enemies, tasks, and nuisances, but
there is no need to worry.
Keep your composure, Arisen.

MsgJp:
ヘマやらかさないように気ぃつけねぇと
異界送りなんざ目も当てられねぇ――
MsgEn:
I have to be careful not to screw up, or I'll end
up banished to the Rift...
it'd be too much to bear.

MsgJp:
野外は崖やら沼やらあるんで注意ですよ
高所から落ちでもしたら、どうにもできねぇんで
MsgEn:
Be careful in the outdoors, there
are cliffs and swamps.
If you should fall from a great height, there's
nothing we can do about it.

MsgJp:
そういや、ニュースの方はどうです？
近くに丁度いいクエストでもありゃ
いってみませんか
MsgEn:
By the way, how about the news?
There might be a suitable quest nearby.
Why don't we give it a try?

MsgJp:
おう、何ですか？
ご命令とあらばいつでも従いますぜ
MsgEn:
Yes, what is it?
I'll always follow your order, and
I'll always follow you.

MsgJp:
俺はほんと、幸せモンですよ
なにせ覚者さまほどの方に
選んでいただいたんですから
MsgEn:
I am truly a fortunate person, you know.
Because I was chosen by someone as
esteemed as an Arisen.

MsgJp:
期待を裏切ることのないよう
精一杯働かせてもらいますぜ！
MsgEn:
To ensure that I'll never disappoint your
expectations, I will work my hardest, I promise!

MsgJp:
あぁ――その、俺ぁお役に立ってますか？
転職に技に、身に付けるモンとか
気に入らねぇとこがありゃ言ってくださいよ
MsgEn:
Ah, um... Am I helpful to you?
In terms of job change and skills, what kind of
things should I learn?
If there's something you don't
like, please let me know.

MsgJp:
戦いで気になること？
ふふ――心配してくれているのね、マスター
大丈夫よ、ありがとう
MsgEn:
What concerns you in battle?
Hehe, you're worried about me, Master.
Don't worry, I'm fine. Thank you.

MsgJp:
戦いで気になること、ね――
マスターが気にするほどのことじゃないわ
だから、大丈夫
MsgEn:
What bothers you in battle...?
It's not something the Master
needs to worry about.
So don't worry, everything will be fine.

MsgJp:
戦いで気になること？
あまり、マスターを心配させたくはないのだけど
ちょっと考えていることがあってね――
ああ大丈夫よ、戦いに手は抜かないわ
MsgEn:
What concerns you in battle?
I don't want to worry my Master too much, but
there's something I've been thinking about...
Oh, don't worry, I won't hold back in battle.

MsgJp:
戦いで気になること――
ええ、実は――二人きりの時に話したいことがあるの
よかったら、聞いて下さらない？
自室でベルを鳴らして頂戴ね
MsgEn:
Something I'm concerned about in this battle...
Yes, actually, there's something I want to talk
to you about when we're alone.
If it's okay, could you listen to it?
Ring the bell in your room, please.

MsgJp:
こうしてお傍に仕えることができて
ほんとうに嬉しいわ、マスター
しっかり働かないとね
MsgEn:
I am so happy to be able to serve
by your side, Master.
I must work diligently, you know.

MsgJp:
体調はどう？　無理はやめてくださいね
大事な身体にもしものことがあったら――
MsgEn:
How are you feeling?
Please don't overdo it.
If something were to happen to
your precious body...

MsgJp:
クラフトでも戦いでも何でも言いつけてね
マスターの為になるなら、
あたしは何だってしますから
MsgEn:
Craft, fight, whatever you want.
If it's for the Master, I'll do anything!

MsgJp:
どんな敵や困難が来ても
お傍で支えると誓うわ
MsgEn:
No matter what enemies or difficulties come your
way, I swear I will stand by your side.

MsgJp:
敵にやられないよう気をつけるわね
マスターに触れて頂けるのは嬉しいけれど
迷惑かけちゃうし
MsgEn:
I'll be careful not to let the enemy get me.
I'm happy to be touched by the Master, but I'm
going to get in trouble.

MsgJp:
足元、外では気を付けてくださいね
危ないところ、結構多いから
崖とか毒溜めとか――
MsgEn:
Be careful where you step, out there.
There are a lot of dangerous places, like cliffs
and poison pits and—

MsgJp:
ねぇ、ニュースも見てみません？
道すがら寄れるクエストもあるかもしれないし
MsgEn:
Hey, why don't you check the news too?
Maybe there are some quests we can
stop by along the way.

MsgJp:
ん？　何ですか？
――じっと見られると恥ずかしいわ
MsgEn:
Hm? What is it?
... It's embarrassing to be stared at like that.

MsgJp:
マスターのポーンとして
一緒に世界を歩き続けることが
あたしの願い、それに幸せ――
MsgEn:
As the Master's pawn, we can continue to
walk the world together.
My wish, and my happiness...

MsgJp:
この時が続くよう、もっと技を磨いて
長くお傍にいられるよう、努力しなくちゃ
MsgEn:
In order to continue this time, I must polish
my skills even more.
I have to make an effort so that I can stay by
your side for a long time.

MsgJp:
そうだわ、マスター
あたしのジョブとかスキル、服とか
これでいいかしら？
大丈夫ならいいんだけど――
MsgEn:
Yes, Master.
My job, skills, clothes and so on, is this okay?
I hope it's up to your standards.

MsgJp:
ハイデル平原は、白竜さまがおわす
今やレスタニアの中心
何とかこの地は死守しなければ――
MsgEn:
The Hidell Plains, 
where the White Dragon resides, 
is now the heart of Lestania. 
We must defend this land...!

MsgJp:
平原は見通しがいいですね
大型の魔物も、遠目に見つけやすいですし
MsgEn:
The plains have good visibility.
Even large enemies are easy to spot from afar.

MsgJp:
レスタニアハーブやベビーハーブが
ハイデルには多く自生しています
薬は何かと入用ですし、見つけたら採取しましょう
MsgEn:
Lestania Herbs and Baby Herbs
are abundant in Hidell.
Medicine is always in high demand, 
so let's gather them when we find them.

MsgJp:
テルはワインづくりが盛んだったとか
近年はやや活力に陰りがあるようですが――
MsgEn:
Tel was known for its thriving wine production.
However, in recent years,
there's been a decline in its vitality.

MsgJp:
南はミスリウ、西はブリア、東はダウに
北はバートランド――
ハイデルはレスタニアの地理的中心でもあります
MsgEn:
South to Mysree, West to Breya,
East to Dowe North to Betland—
Hidell is also the geographic center of Lestania.

MsgJp:
ハイデル平原は、一番落ち着きます
白竜さまのお膝元ですし――
MsgEn:
The Hidell Plains is the most peaceful place 
in the White Dragon's domain—

MsgJp:
ハイデルにこれ以上オークが
侵入してきたら、大変です――
MsgEn:
If any more orcs invade Hidell,
we'll be in trouble...

MsgJp:
ハーブは薬の材料になります
見つけたら多めに採っておいた方が――
MsgEn:
Herbs can be used as ingredients for medicine. 
It's better to gather them in abundance 
when you find them...

MsgJp:
なるべく街道沿いを歩きましょう
少しでも安全なところを
MsgEn:
Keep along the main road as much as possible.
Even if it's just barely so, it's the safest place.

MsgJp:
テルに寄ったら、またアルフレドさんに
ご挨拶しておかないと――
MsgEn:
If you're going to Tel, 
you should greet Ser Alfred again.

MsgJp:
ハイデルは我々ポーンにとっても
もっとも縁深き場所
なにせ、我がマスターとの契約の地ですから！
MsgEn:
Hidell is the most deeply connected 
place for us Pawns. After all, 
it is the land of our contract with our Master!

MsgJp:
おのれ！　オークが少なからず
侵入しているようです
どこから入り込んだのでしょう
MsgEn:
Damn them!
It seems that a significant number
of orcs have infiltrated the castle.
Where could they have possibly come from?

MsgJp:
ハーブを見かけたらありったけ
摘んでおきましょう！
神殿に戻ったら私が薬にしますので！
MsgEn:
If you see any herbs, pick as many as you can!
I will make them into medicine 
when we get back to the temple!

MsgJp:
比較的穏やかなハイデルでも
時に大型の魔物が現れます
気は抜けませんね！
MsgEn:
Even in relatively calm Hidell,
sometimes large enemies appear.
Can't let our guard down, huh!

MsgJp:
ブリアやミスリウへは十分徒歩でいけますよ
もちろん、マスターとなら地の果てまでも！
MsgEn:
You can easily walk to Breya and Mysree.
Of course, with the Arisen, 
even to the ends of the earth!

MsgJp:
ここハイデル平原は、レスタニアの中心に
位置する地
地理的重要は、もちろん随一
MsgEn:
The Hidell Plains, 
located in the center of Lestania, 
is a geographically important land, 
of course, unparalleled in its significance.

MsgJp:
白竜神殿と南のテルを足場に
探索するのが効果的
ボードクエストや民の依頼も、それぞれ異なる
MsgEn:
It is effective to explore the White Dragon 
Temple and the southern Tel as a foothold. 
Board quests and the requests 
of the people are also different.

MsgJp:
ハーブ類は体力回復の薬の原料に
キノコ類はスタミナ剤の原料に、それぞれ有用
可能な限り大量入手を
MsgEn:
Herbs are used as ingredients for healing potions.
Mushrooms are used as ingredients 
for stamina potions.
Obtain them in large quantities if possible.

MsgJp:
ハイデルへのオーク侵入は、大きな脅威
民、神殿双方にとって、グリッテン砦の防備が要
MsgEn:
The orc invasion of Hidell is a major threat
to both the people and the temple,
making the defense of Fort Gritten essential.

MsgJp:
西へ行けば海岸部、南部へ行けば森林地帯
そして東へ行けば渓谷に隣接する
どこへ行くかは主の判断と力量次第
MsgEn:
If you go west, you'll reach the coast, 
if you go south, you'll reach the forested area. 
And if you go east, you'll be next to a valley. 
Where to go depends on the judgment and 
the ability of Master.

MsgJp:
おぉ、麗しきハイデル平原――
それは偉大なる白竜神の座にして
我らが覚者殿の始まりの地――
MsgEn:
Oh, the beautiful Hidell Plains—
It is the seat of the mighty Divine White Dragon,
and the sacred land where our 
Master Arisen first began—

MsgJp:
レスタニアハーブは体力回復効果があるハーブです
ベビーハーブはその新芽ですが、兎が多い場所では
食べられて、なかなか育たないようですね
MsgEn:
Lestania Herb is a herb that has healing effects. 
Baby Herb is its new sprout, 
but it seems that in places with many rabbits, 
it gets eaten and doesn't grow easily.

MsgJp:
ハイデル平原の僻地には、どこからか
入り込んだ無粋なオークもいるとのこと
まったく不愉快ですね
MsgEn:
In the remote corners of the Hidell Plains, 
there are also rude orcs that have
somehow made their way in. 
It's truly unpleasant!

MsgJp:
さて、どの地へ向かうも覚者殿の心のままに――
ハイデルは各地へ続く岐路なれば
MsgEn:
Now, to which land shall we go,
according to the heart of Master Arisen? 
Hidell is a crossroads leading to various lands.

MsgJp:
テルに立ち寄る際には、アルフレド殿にも
面会しておきましょう
支援が受けられるかもしれません
MsgEn:
When you go to Tel, let's also visit Ser Alfred. 
You might be able to receive support.

MsgJp:
ハイデル平原って、大陸のほぼ真ん中に
あるらしいですね
さすがは中心地です！
MsgEn:
The Hidell Plains are said to be located
in the middle of the continent. 
Truly a central hub!

MsgJp:
オークを見つけたらやっつけておきましょう！
ぼく達が留守の間に神殿が襲われたら
大変です
MsgEn:
If you find an orc, let's defeat it!
It would be disastrous if the Temple
were attacked while we are away.

MsgJp:
ハーブ、たくさん摘んでいきませんか？
ぼく、まとめて癒しの薬を作りますから！
MsgEn:
Why don't we pick a bunch of herbs?
I'll make a supply of healing medicine!

MsgJp:
道中見かけたら、廃屋や井戸にも
入ってみませんかぁ？
思わぬ発見があるかもしれませんし
MsgEn:
If you happen to come across it on the road, 
why not enter abandoned houses or wells? 
You might have unexpected discoveries.

MsgJp:
ハイデルにもたまに、サイクロプスとか
大きな魔物が出るみたいですね
どこからやって来るんだろう
MsgEn:
Sometimes in Hidell,
large monsters like Cyclops appear. 
I wonder where they come from.

MsgJp:
白竜神殿とハイデルは、何があっても
死守しなきゃなりませんね
ま、覚者さまがたも騎士団もいるんだ
さすがにどうにかなるこたぁないでしょうが
MsgEn:
The White Dragon Temple and Hidell
must be protected at all costs. 
Well, both the Arisen and the Knights are here, 
so we should be able to handle anything 
that comes our way.

MsgJp:
オークの野郎ども、ハイデルにまで
来やがるたぁいい度胸ですね
見かけたら叩き返してやりましょう
MsgEn:
Those Orc bastards, coming all the way to Hidell. 
What nerve they have. If you see them,
let's fight back and give them a taste
of their own medicine.

MsgJp:
そうだ、調合に使えそうな葉っぱは
持ち帰る方がいいですぜ
癒しの薬は、多いに越したこたぁありません
MsgEn:
It's true, it's better to take home leaves
that seem useful for concoctions.
Having plenty of Healing Potions
is definitely a good thing.

MsgJp:
ハイデルは、なんだかんだで好きですぜ
なんたって俺らポーンにとって
第二の故郷みたいなモンですから
MsgEn:
I actually like Hidell, no matter what.
After all, it's like a second home for us Pawns.

MsgJp:
海岸方面へ向かうも、森へ向かうも、
はたまた地下墓地へ向かうも――
どこへなりともお供しますぜ
MsgEn:
Whether you're headed for the coast,
the woods, or the catacombs...
We'll be with you wherever you go!

MsgJp:
白竜神殿レーゼにグリッテン砦――
マスターたち覚者さまが守る二大拠点が
あるんですもの
ハイデルの平和はきっと守れます
MsgEn:
The White Dragon Temple and Fort Gritten...
The two major bases for the Masters to protect.
I am sure that we can keep the peace in Hidell.

MsgJp:
北の地からオーク達はやってくるみたい
砦や関所があるのに、一体どこから
潜り込むのかしら
MsgEn:
It seems that the Orcs are coming from the north.
Even though there are forts and checkpoints,
I wonder where they are sneaking in from.

MsgJp:
ハーブの群生地は覚えておいた
ほうがいいですよ
お薬の調合に、何かと入用ですから
MsgEn:
It's a good idea to remember where herbs grow, 
you'll need them to prepare your medicines.

MsgJp:
ゴブリンや野盗たちがいなければ
テルやローテスとの往来も
もっと安全になるはずなのに――嫌ね
MsgEn:
If there were no goblins or bandits,
traveling between Tel and Rotes
would surely be safer... How irksome.

MsgJp:
――うふふ。ねぇマスター
今日はこのあたりの探索ですか？
それとも、海辺か森、山へ行きます？
MsgEn:
Hehe. Hey, Master. 
Are we going to explore around here today? 
Or perhaps we'll see the seaside,
the forest, or the mountains?

MsgJp:
白い浜に青い海――
潮風もなかなか心地いいですね
MsgEn:
White beach and blue seas...
The sea breeze is quite pleasant too!

MsgJp:
浜辺には意外な漂流物が
流れ着くことがあるようです
MsgEn: Unexpected driftwood can wash ashore on the beach.

MsgJp:
ブリアでは貝殻やさまざまな砂が
入手できます
見つけたら拾っておきましょう
MsgEn:
In Breya, you can find shells
and various types of sand. 
If you find them, be sure to collect them.

MsgJp:
ローテスは穏やかな村ですね
波の音ものどかで落ち着きます
MsgEn:
Rotes is a peaceful village.
The sound of the waves is peaceful and relaxing.

MsgJp:
この辺りはハイデルに比べると
やや暖かいですね
MsgEn: This area is slightly warmer than Hidell.

MsgJp:
海、きれいですね
明るくって見晴らしもよくて
MsgEn:
The ocean, it's beautiful.
It's bright and has a great view.

MsgJp:
少しだけ風がねばった感じがします
潮のせいでしょうか
MsgEn:
It feels like the wind has become a bit sticky.
Could it be because of the tide?

MsgJp:
あの――、浜には漂流船とか
流れ着いたりもするそうです
どこから来るんでしょう
MsgEn:
You know... They say that on the beach,
there are drifting ships and such, washed ashore.
I wonder where they come from?

MsgJp:
貝殻や羽根がたくさんありそうです
――ちょっとした小物を作れるかも
MsgEn:
There seem to be many shells and feathers.
... I might be able to make some small accessories.

MsgJp:
ローテスから離れた南の浜辺は
危ない所みたいです――
MsgEn:
The beach south of Rotes
appears to be full of dangers.

MsgJp:
うおおお！　海はいつ見ても広いですね！
なぜか心湧きたちます！
MsgEn:
Wow! The sea is always so vast!
For some reason, it fills me with excitement!

MsgJp:
ローテスに近い北の浜辺と
谷を隔てた南の浜辺は敵もかなり違うとか
海岸沿いを探検しましょう！
MsgEn:
The northern beaches near Rotes
and the southern beaches across the valley
have very different enemies.
Let's explore along the coast!

MsgJp:
たまに漂流船や魔物の死体が
浜辺に流れ着くそうです
何か使えるものが見つかるかもしれませんよ！
MsgEn:
Sometimes drifting ships and the corpses
of monsters wash up on the beach. 
You might find something useful!

MsgJp:
ブリアの灯台上は見晴らしが良さそうです
落下注意ですが――！！
MsgEn:
The view is very nice from the top
of the lighthouse in Breya.
Watch the heights, though!!

MsgJp:
岸壁付近はハ―ピーがよく群れていますね
フンが降ってこないとよいのですがっ――！
MsgEn:
Seems Harpies gather near the cliffs.
I hope their droppings don't come
raining down on us!

MsgJp:
海岸は植生、魔物の種類とも平原とは異なる
特に多いのはハ―ピー、
そしてリザードマンなど水棲型
MsgEn:
The coast has different vegetation
and types of enemies compared to the plains. 
Especially abundant are Harpies, 
and aquatic types like Saurians.

MsgJp:
ブリア海岸南部は北部とは異なり
危険度が高い
水竜の目撃例も、多々
MsgEn:
The southern part of Breya Coast
is different from the northern part. 
The danger level is high, with numerous
sightings of water dragons.

MsgJp: 漂流船の発見時は、速やかに検分を
MsgEn:
When a drifting ship is found, 
inspect it immediately.

MsgJp: 波音は、精神衛生にも効果的――
MsgEn: The steady sound of waves is good for the soul...

MsgJp:
海岸部の情報収集であれば、
ローテスへの立ち寄りを勧める
MsgEn:
If it's information gathering along the coast,
I recommend making a stop at Rotes.

MsgJp:
青き海原、揺れるさざ波――
ふ――、アンダーウェア一枚で
浜辺を駆けるも一興かと
MsgEn:
The vast expanse of the azure sea, 
its waves gently lapping against the shore... 
Ah, to run along the beach clad only in my 
undergarments, what a delightful prospect!

MsgJp:
ブリアと言えば、ハ―ピー達が有名ですが
しかし彼女らの子守歌で
居眠りしたくはありませんね
MsgEn:
Breya is indeed famous for its Harpies,
but I wouldn't want to doze off to their lullaby.

MsgJp:
時おり流れ来る小竜の亡骸や
船の残骸を調べれば、役に立つものが
見つかるかもしれません
MsgEn:
Occasionally, the remains of small dragons
and shipwrecks drift ashore. 
Examining these remnants might yield
valuable insights or items of use.

MsgJp:
ローテスから灯台までを往復すれば
結構な運動量になりそうです
MsgEn:
If you go from Rotes to the lighthouse
and back it's going to be quite a workout!

MsgJp:
一般的な貝類や砂の調達に
まさにこの辺りはうってつけかと
MsgEn:
For the procurement of common shells and sand, 
this area serves that purpose perfectly.

MsgJp:
覚者さま、海は広いですね！！
思いっきり泳いだら気持ちいいだろうなぁ
――ヒュージブルさえいなければ
MsgEn:
Master Arisen, the sea is vast, isn't it!!
It must feel great to swim to your heart's content...
If only the Brine weren't there.

MsgJp:
浜辺をぐるっと歩いてみませんか？
裏の浜とか、面白そうな場所も
あるんじゃないでしょうか
MsgEn:
Why don't you take a stroll around the beach? 
There might be interesting places, 
like a hidden beach, don't you think?

MsgJp:
船が漂流してたら見に行ってみましょうよ！
お宝を積んでるかもしれませんよ
MsgEn:
If a boat drifted ashore, let's go take a look!
You never know, it might be loaded with treasure.

MsgJp:
貝殻や砂山を漁るの、楽しいですね！
すごく海にきたーっていう感じがします
MsgEn:
Collecting shells and building sand castles is fun!
It really gives you the feeling of being seaside.

MsgJp:
ブリア海岸はいいところですね！
こののんびりした感じ、好きだなぁ
MsgEn:
The Breya Coast is a nice place!
I love this laid-back feeling.

MsgJp:
海はやっぱいいモンですね
小せぇ不安とか、どうでもよくなりますよ
MsgEn:
The ocean is a great place to be.
All those little worries become irrelevant.

MsgJp:
灯台の上までいってみちゃどうです
結構遠くまで見渡せそうですぜ
MsgEn:
How about going up to the top of the lighthouse?
You can see quite far from there.

MsgJp:
漂流船ってなぁ、どこから流れて
くるんでしょうね
港洞の洋撃船でもねぇようですし
MsgEn:
Where do you think those drifting ships come from?
It doesn't seem like they're like the 
Western Expedition ships in Cave Harbor.

MsgJp:
海岸は見通しがききますねぇ
谷以外はそれほど視界を遮るモンも
ありませんし
MsgEn:
The coast has very good visibility.
Except for the valley, there isn't much
to obstruct the field of vision.

MsgJp:
南の浜はリンドブルムやら
厄介なヤツも出るようです
ローテス側たぁえらい差ですねぇ
MsgEn:
On the southern beach, 
there are troublesome creatures like Lindwurms. 
The difference on the Rotes' side
is quite significant.

MsgJp:
ブリアの浜辺をマスターと並んで歩くのって
なんだか素敵――ふふ
MsgEn:
Walking alongside Master on Breya's beach
feels somehow wonderful... Hehe.

MsgJp:
難破船があったら乗り込んでみない？
ちょっとしたモノが見つかるかも――
MsgEn:
If you find a shipwreck, why don't you go aboard?
You might find a little something...

MsgJp:
潮風が強いと少し髪がねとつくわ
日陰が少ないから肌も焼けちゃうし
MsgEn:
When the sea breeze is strong, 
my hair gets a little sticky. 
And because there's not much shade, 
my skin gets burnt too.

MsgJp:
たまには海岸で貝殻拾いや
ただのお散歩もいいですね
冒険にも多少のゆとりがなくっちゃ
MsgEn:
Sometimes it's nice to pick up seashells
on the beach and just go for a leisurely walk.
A little bit of flexibility during adventures
didn't hurt anyone!

MsgJp:
灯台があると、船にも人にも
旅する者にとってはよき標になりますね
MsgEn:
A lighthouse is a good beacon
for both ships and travelers alike!

MsgJp:
森の空気は気もちいいですね
――エイプのねぐら付近を除けば、ですが
MsgEn:
The forest air is pleasant.
... Except near the Ape den.

MsgJp:
ミスリウには洞窟も多いようです
森と洞窟となれば、魔物が多いのも
うなずけます
MsgEn:
There seem to be many caves in Mysree.
With dense forests and numerous caves, 
it's no wonder there are so many monsters.

MsgJp:
木材やキノコがあちこちにあります
伐採ナイフは多めに持っておくといいかも
しれません
MsgEn:
There is wood and mushrooms scattered around.
It might be good to pack extra lumber knives.

MsgJp:
大きな樹は登れそうですね
上になにかあるかもしれません
MsgEn:
Looks like you can climb the big tree.
There might be something up there.

MsgJp:
オオカミやフォレストゴブリンは
群れで襲ってきます
囲まれないよう目を光らせなければ
MsgEn:
Wolves and forest goblins hunt in packs.
Keep an eye out to avoid being surrounded.

MsgJp:
鬱蒼と樹が茂ったところは
見通しが悪くて、少しだけ怖いです――
MsgEn:
The place where the dense trees grow
is difficult to see through and a little scary.

MsgJp:
この辺り、洞窟がたくさんあるみたいです
きっと魔物もいっぱいいるはず――
MsgEn:
There seem to be many caves around here.
There must be a lot of enemies too.

MsgJp:
キノコがあちこちに生えてます
木材も、これだけあれば困りませんね
MsgEn:
Mushrooms are growing everywhere,
and with this much lumber, we won't run out.

MsgJp:
あの樹の上、登れそうですよ
――でも落ちたらかなりの高さです
MsgEn:
It looks like you can climb up that tree!
But if you fall, that's a nasty height!

MsgJp:
ところどころ、気味悪い廃屋があります
できるだけ近づかないほうが――
MsgEn:
The creepy abandoned buildings here and there...
It's better not to get too close if possible.

MsgJp:
ミスリウ森林は豊かですね！
キノコに木材、獣に木の実！
採取だけで生きていけそうです
MsgEn:
The Mysree Forest is rich! 
Mushrooms, lumber, nuts and beasts! 
It seems possible to live solely by gathering.

MsgJp:
マスター、ポーン郷やリンウッドなど、
休める場所がたくさんありますね
探索し甲斐があるというもの！
MsgEn:
Master, there are many places to rest, 
such as the Pawn Cathedral and Lynwood. 
It's worth exploring!

MsgJp:
ガラキノコはガラエキスの原料になります
たくさん収穫して、たっぷり絞り上げましょう！
MsgEn:
Gala mushrooms are the source of Gala Extract.
Harvest lots of them and squeeze up plenty!

MsgJp:
太い樹木は登れますよ
ツタが絡んでいるくらいがよいようです！
MsgEn:
You can climb thick trees.
It's best when they have entwined vines!

MsgJp:
廃屋周辺、臭いは気になりますが
様子を見てみませんか？
危険な所にこそ、チャンスもあるかと！
MsgEn:
Despite the foul odor emanating from the ruins...
Why don't we check it out?
There might be opportunities in dangerous places!

MsgJp:
森の探索にはポーン郷とリンウッド、
双方をうまく活用すべきと考える
MsgEn:
For the forest exploration, we should make
good use of both the Pawn Cathedral and Lynwood.
I believe it's the best strategy.

MsgJp:
木材に鉱石など、ミスリウ周辺の資源は豊富
採取ツールは常に欠かさぬよう
MsgEn:
Lumber and other resources
around Mysree are abundant. 
Make sure to always have gathering tools.

MsgJp:
森は群をなす小型の魔物が多く棲息する
囲まれぬよう、警戒を
MsgEn:
The forest is home to many small-sized 
enemy creatures that form groups.
Observe, so as not to be surrounded.

MsgJp:
大きく育った樹木には、登攀可能
樹の利用も計画的に
MsgEn:
Large, mature trees are climbable.
Let's plan to utilize the trees strategically.

MsgJp:
森には複数の廃屋が点在
いずれも、凶暴な野猿がテリトリーとしている模様
MsgEn:
There are several abandoned houses
scattered throughout the forest.
All of them seem to be claimed territory
of ferocious wild apes.

MsgJp:
豊かなるミスリウの森はまさに資源の宝庫――！
朝露光る野草、麗しい丸みのキノコに鹿など
見ているだけで――っと、失礼
MsgEn:
The abundant forest of Mysree
is truly a treasure trove of resources! 
From the morning dew on the wild grass,
to the beautiful rounded mushrooms
and delightful deer, just looking at them...
Oops, sorry.

MsgJp:
おぉ、爽やかな樹木の香がします
たまには森林浴も良いものですね
MsgEn:
Ah, I can smell the fresh scent of the trees.
A "forest bath" is a nice change sometimes.

MsgJp:
もしポーン郷に立ち寄られる場合は
ぜひアルヴァー殿とも面会を
何か役立つクレストがあるかもしれませんよ
MsgEn:
If you happen to stop by Pawn Cathedral,
please be sure to meet with Master Alvar.
He may have a helpful Crest or two.

MsgJp:
しかし――、エイプ達は騒々しい上
ねぐらの廃屋周囲はひどいありさまです
いっそ、取り壊してしまえればよいのですが
MsgEn:
However, the apes are noisy,
and the surroundings of their den
are in a terrible state. 
It would be best to just demolish it.

MsgJp:
森を囲むように洞窟がいくつもありますね
古の祭祀場も、大きな名所の一つです
どこへ向かわれるも、貴方さまの御心のままに
MsgEn:
There are several caves surrounding the forest.
The Ancient Ritual Ground is also one of
the prominent locations. Wherever you go, 
it shall be to your noble heart's desire.

MsgJp:
ねぇねぇ覚者さま！
今度じっくりキノコ狩りをしませんか？
で、神殿に帰ったらソテーにしたり、エキスを
絞ったり、みんなでやりましょうよ！
MsgEn:
Hey, hey, Master Arisen!
How about we go mushroom hunting next time?
And when we get back to the temple, 
we can sauté them or extract their essence.
Let's do it together!

MsgJp:
覚者さま！　大きな木がたくさんありますね
後で登ってみませんか？
MsgEn:
Master Arisen!
There are many big trees here. 
Wanna climb them later?

MsgJp:
オオカミとかフォレストゴブリンとか
森は小さな敵がたくさんいます
どいつもすばしっこそうですよ
MsgEn:
Wolves and forest goblins,
the forest is full of small enemies.
They are all very agile, you know.

MsgJp:
リンウッドとかポーン郷とか
ミスリウは一休みできる所が多くていいですね！
あ、そう言えば外で水浴びできる
お家とかもありましたよね
MsgEn:
Lynwood and the Pawn Cathedral, huh? 
Mysree has a lot of nice places to take a break! 
Oh, speaking of which, there was also a house 
where you could bathe outside, right?

MsgJp:
ミスリウの東にある古の祭祀場と、
南にある燐光虫の洞窟はかなり有名みたいです
大きな魔物もよく出てくるって聞きました
MsgEn:
To the east of Mysree, 
there is an Ancient Ritual Ground,
and to the south, there is Glowworm Cave
that seems to be quite famous.
I heard that large enemies often appear there.

MsgJp:
俺も森は好きなんですが
少々ミスリウは騒がしいように思いますねぇ
魔物が増えた最近じゃ、
どこも似たようなモンかもしれませんが
MsgEn:
I like the forest too, but
Mysree seems to be a bit noisy.
With the recent increase in monsters,
it may be similar everywhere.

MsgJp:
ガラエキスの補充をお考えなら
多めにガラキノコを採っときましょう
適当に歩いてりゃ、あっちこっちに生えてるでしょうし
MsgEn:
If you're considering replenishing Gala Extract,
let's gather plenty of Gala Mushrooms.
If you stroll around casually, 
they should be growing all over the place.

MsgJp:
ミスリウを南下すりゃ深部の森へ
東へ行きゃあボルド鉱山方面へ続いてます
どっちに行くにしろ、ここよりゃ危険ですがね
MsgEn:
If you head south in Mysree, 
you'll reach the Deep Forest.
If you go east, it will continue towards
the direction of the Volden Mines.
Whichever way you go, it's dangerous here.

MsgJp:
森は少々見通し悪ぃですね
物陰から狙ってくるヤツもいると思いますんで
注意してくださいよ
MsgEn:
The forest has somewhat poor visibility.
There are likely creatures lurking in the shadows,
so please be cautious.

MsgJp:
あとでどっか、洞窟か遺跡にでも行ってみますか
それなりの大物が棲みついてるはずですぜ
MsgEn:
Later, how about checking out a cave or ruins?
There should be some big creatures living there.

MsgJp:
ねぇマスター、せっかくだから
森の空気を楽しんで歩きません？
ハイデルやブリアよりしっとりして
お肌にも良さそうだし
MsgEn:
Hey, Master, since we're here,
why not take a walk and enjoy the forest air?
It's more refreshing than in Hidell or Breya,
and it seems good for the skin too.

MsgJp:
ガラキノコをたくさん収穫しなくちゃ
スタミナ剤にして、マスターに精力つけて
もらわないとね――！
MsgEn:
I have to harvest a lot of Gala Mushrooms
and turn them into stamina boosters,
so that I can give them to Master
and boost your energy!

MsgJp:
リンウッドからなら、森の東西南北どこへでも
それなりに行きやすいんじゃないかしら
ポーン郷は森の中心から少し離れているし
MsgEn:
From Lynwood, it's fairly easy to travel
to any direction—east, west, north, or south.
The Pawn Cathedral is a bit of a distance
from the forest's center.

MsgJp:
ここからだと、ボルド鉱山やミスリウ深部へも
徒歩で行けるわね
距離は結構あるけれど――
MsgEn:
From here, you can even hike
to the Volden Mines and the depths of Mysree. 
The distance is quite far, though...

MsgJp:
ミスリウにはスフィンクスにトロールに
大猿にエント、ほかにも色々な魔物がいるわ
戦うかどうかは、時と場合によりそうだけど
MsgEn:
In Mysree, there are sphinxes, trolls, ents,
and various other enemies.
Whether or not to fight depends
on the time and situation.

MsgJp:
鉱山の噴出物でしょうか
なんとも妙な臭いがしますね
MsgEn:
Could it be a mineral deposit from the mine?
There's a rather peculiar smell coming from it.

MsgJp:
ボルド鉱山は、レスタニアでもっとも
標高の高い山だとか
頂上はさぞよい景色でしょう
MsgEn:
The Volden Mines is said to be
the highest mountain in Lestania.
The summit must have a splendid view, I imagine.

MsgJp:
この辺りは、採掘場所に事欠きません
なにせ坑道がそこらじゅうにありますから
ピッケルはどうぞ、お忘れなく
MsgEn:
There's no shortage of mining spots around here. 
After all, tunnels are everywhere. 
Don't forget your pickaxe.

MsgJp:
ひと歩きしたら、キノザ鉱泉に
立ち寄るのもいいかもしれませんね
かなり汗をかきました
MsgEn:
After taking a stroll, it might be nice to make 
a stop at Kinoza Mineral Springs. 
I've worked up quite a sweat.

MsgJp:
高低差が多いですね
山道から落下したら大変です
MsgEn:
There are many elevation changes.
Falling from the mountain path would be dangerous.

MsgJp:
鉱山には毒や油の染み出す場所が
あるそうです――いつもより気をつけないと
MsgEn:
In the mine, there are places
where poison and oil seep out. 
You'll need to be more cautious than usual.

MsgJp:
少し空気が乾燥してますね
あまり植物も生えていませんし
MsgEn:
The air is a bit dry here. 
Not many plants growing either.

MsgJp:
覚者さま。ボルドは鉱山ですし
普段よりピッケルを多めに持っておいた方が――
MsgEn:
Master, since Volden is a mine,
it's best to carry more pickaxes than usual.

MsgJp:
キノザ鉱泉、あとで少しだけ行ってみませんか？
――その、せっかくですから
MsgEn:
Kinoza Mineral Springs, 
why don't we go there a little later?
Well, you know, since we're here...

MsgJp:
山頂から間違って落ちたりしたら――
この高さ。ただでは済まないです――！
MsgEn:
If you accidentally fall from the mountaintop— 
At this height, it won't end well—!

MsgJp:
そういえば、この辺りは毒泉や
油溜まりが多いとか
足場には普段以上に気を払わねば！
MsgEn:
By the way, I heard that this area
has a lot of poison springs and oil puddles. 
We must be especially careful with our footing!

MsgJp:
登山もなかなか、楽しいものですね！
山道の往復は足腰が鍛えられそうです
MsgEn:
Mountain climbing can be quite enjoyable! 
A round trip on the mountain path
should strengthen your legs and back.

MsgJp:
ボルドは採掘の名所といいます
さぁ、我々もピッケル片手に掘りまくりましょう！
MsgEn:
Volden is known as a mining hotspot.
Now, let us dig to our heart's 
content with pickaxes in hand!

MsgJp:
山があるなら、常に頂きを目指すべき！
そうは思いませんか、マスター！
MsgEn:
If there's a mountain,
you should always aim for the peak!
Don't you think so, Master?

MsgJp:
山の急斜面を一気にすべり降りられたら
さぞ爽快でしょう！
――しかし、この段差。そうしなければ到達
できない場所があるかもしれません
MsgEn:
Sliding down a steep mountain slope
all at once would be exhilarating!
But, this drop might lead to places 
you can't reach otherwise.

MsgJp:
ボルドは豊富な鉱物資源が最大の魅力
宝石類も期待できる
MsgEn:
Volden's greatest charm lies
in its abundant mineral resources. 
Finding gemstones is also to be expected.

MsgJp:
ボルド大鉱山はレスタニア一の標高を誇る
ぜひ、山頂から眺望を
MsgEn:
Volden Great Mines boasts
the highest elevation in Lestania.
Be sure to take in the view
from the top of the mountain!

MsgJp:
坑道は食人鬼の恰好の住処
探索の際は、慎重に
MsgEn:
The tunnels are the perfect lair for man-eaters.
Be cautious during your exploration.

MsgJp:
疲労が溜まったらキノザ鉱泉へ
心身のリフレッシュには最適かと
MsgEn:
When fatigue builds up, 
head to Kinoza Mineral Springs. 
It's perfect for refreshing both body and mind.

MsgJp:
ボルド一帯はグリフィンの目撃報告が多発
遭遇時、戦闘判断は主に
MsgEn:
Griffin sightings are frequent throughout Volden. 
In encounters, combat decisions
are primarily up to you.

MsgJp:
レスタニア一の高さを誇るボルド大鉱山――
山頂からの眺めはさぞ素晴らしいものでしょう！
MsgEn:
Volden Great Mines, 
boasting the highest peak in Lestania—
The view from the summit
must be truly magnificent!

MsgJp:
ボルド鉱山といえば、さまざまな名物がありますね
例えば、採掘、温泉、毒泉、登山――
あとはグリフィンの生息地としても知られていましたか
MsgEn:
When it comes to the Volden Mines, 
there are various special features. 
For example, mining, hot springs, 
poisonous springs, and mountain climbing—
Did you know that it is also known 
as the habitat of Griffins?

MsgJp:
ボルドといえば、何と言ってもキノザ鉱泉でしょう
日帰り入浴で楽しめる三つの泉は
疲労回復と精力増強に優れた効果があり、
美容にも良いと――あぁ、楽しみです！
MsgEn:
When it comes to Volden, one can't forget
about Kinoza Mineral Springs. 
The three springs, where you can enjoy 
a day trip bath, have excellent effects
for fatigue recovery and increased vitality. 
And they are also good for beauty... 
Oh, I'm looking forward to it!

MsgJp:
鉱石と宝石の採掘量が多いエリアです
とにかくピッケルは多めにお持ちください
輝く鉱脈を前に、ピッケルが無い時の
失望感ときたら――！
MsgEn:
This is an area with a high amount
of ore and gemstones for mining.
Make sure to bring plenty of pickaxes with you.
The disappointment when faced with
a shining vein of ore while without a pickaxe...!

MsgJp:
毒泉や油溜まりの近くはなるべく
歩きたくありませんね――
異常に掛かるのも服が濡れるのもご免です
MsgEn:
I prefer not to walk near 
toxic springs or oil puddles.
Getting soaked and dirtying my clothes
is not something I want to experience.

MsgJp:
覚者さま！　ぼく後で温泉に行きたいな！
キノザ鉱泉ってポーンの間でも評判いいんです
MsgEn:
Master Arisen! 
I would like to go to the hot springs later! 
Kinoza Mineral Springs is well-known 
even amongst us Pawns.

MsgJp:
毒や油まみれに
ならないようにしなくっちゃ
ボルドはそういうのが、あちこちから
湧いてるそうですから
MsgEn:
You must avoid getting covered in poison or oil. 
Volden has these substances 
bubbling up all over the place.

MsgJp:
ボルドは魔物のせいで
入れなくなった坑道が多いそうです
ぼく達で退治して、ぼく達で採掘しましょうよ！
MsgEn:
Many tunnels in Volden have become
inaccessible due to monsters. 
Let's clear them out and mine them for ourselves!

MsgJp:
グリフィンに掴まって空を飛んでみたいなぁ！
山頂からなら、もっとすごい景色ですよきっと！
MsgEn:
I'd love to try riding a griffin in the sky! 
From the mountaintop, 
the view must be even more amazing!

MsgJp:
この辺りの魔物って
泥っぽいのとかゴツゴツしたのとか
そういうのが多いですね
地形のせいかなぁ
MsgEn:
This area seems to have a lot
of muddy and rough monsters. 
It might be related to the terrain.

MsgJp:
覚者さま、ボルドっていや採掘です
そこらに鉱脈や坑道があるんで
掘る道具は必須ですぜ
MsgEn:
Master, when it comes to Volden, 
it's all about mining. 
There are ore veins and tunnels around, 
so you'll need mining tools for sure.

MsgJp:
山登りで疲れたら
キノザでひとっ風呂浴びていきましょう
MsgEn:
If you're tired of climbing mountains, 
let's take a bath at Kinoza.

MsgJp:
ボルド大鉱山か――
大陸じゃ一番の高さだそうで
どうせ目指すならてっぺんですかね
MsgEn:
The Volden Great Mines, huh? 
It's said to be the highest point on the continent.
If you're aiming for it, 
might as well go all the way to the top.

MsgJp:
ゴブリンどもの巣窟でもなんでも
使えるモンは利用してやりましょう
MsgEn:
Even if it's a goblin lair or whatever, 
we should make use of whatever we can.

MsgJp:
そういや、キノザは火薬の消費が多いそうで
ま、坑道で発破に使うんでしょうが――
厄介なことに、ゴブリンどももそれを真似する
ようになったそうですぜ
MsgEn:
By the way, it seems that Kinoza
uses a lot of gunpowder. 
Well, it's probably used for blasting in the mines.
But unfortunately, the goblins have caught on
and started to copy that too.

MsgJp:
登山も悪くありませんね
足腰が引き締まるし、高い場所は
見晴らしがいいし
MsgEn:
Mountain climbing isn't bad either. 
It strengthens your legs and back, 
and the view from up high is excellent.

MsgJp:
マスター、ピッケルは持ってきました？
ボルドは宝石や鉱石がごろごろ採れるそうよ
ふふ――！
MsgEn:
Master, did you bring a pickaxe? 
It seems that Volden is full of gems and ores. 
Hehe―!

MsgJp:
ねぇ、マスター
探索が一区切りついたら、温泉に行きません？
ゆっくりお湯に浸かって英気を養いましょう？
MsgEn:
Hey, Master,
once we're done exploring, 
shall we go to the hot springs?
Let's soak and recharge our energy, okay?

MsgJp:
グリフィンやオーガとかちあったら厄介ね――
戦うか逃げるかは、
マスターの判断に委ねますね
MsgEn:
It'll be tough if we encounter 
a Griffin or an Ogre—
I'll trust your judgment, Master,
on whether we fight or retreat.

MsgJp:
――ふぅ。坂道が続くわね
それに、意外と昇り降りが大変
上からでないと行けない場所もあるみたいだし
MsgEn:
Ugh. The slopes keep coming.
Going up and down is surprisingly tough,
and there are places you can 
only access from the top.

MsgJp:
美しい渓谷ですね
古城とも相まって、いつまでも眺めてしまいます
MsgEn:
Such a gorgeous valley.
The ancient fortress blends in perfectly,
I can't help but keep gazing.

MsgJp: 坂道が多くて、思ったより膝にきました――
MsgEn:
With all these inclines, 
my knees are feeling it more than I expected.

MsgJp:
ダウ渓谷は、城に塔、地下水路など旧時代の
遺構が多いようです
昔はさぞ栄えていたのでしょう
MsgEn:
The Dowe Valley is full of old structures, 
like castles, towers, and underground waterways. 
It must have been quite prosperous in the past.

MsgJp:
針葉樹林が広がっています
ハイデルと比べるとかなり涼しいですね
MsgEn:
A vast coniferous forest lies ahead. 
It's significantly cooler here than in Hidell.

MsgJp:
西はハイデル、北はバートランド平原高地と
接しています
確か、どちらも関所があったかと
MsgEn:
To the west is Hidell, 
and to the north lies the Betland Plains. 
If I remember correctly, both have checkpoints.

MsgJp:
谷あいの景色、木々とすごく調和しています
空気も澄んでいるようです
MsgEn:
The scenery in the valley harmonizes
perfectly with the trees, and the air feels fresh.

MsgJp:
ドリード城は昔、騎士団の城だったそうです
あれだけ立派なお城なのに
捨てられてしまうだなんて――
MsgEn:
They say Dreed Castle used to be
the knights' stronghold. 
For such a magnificent castle
to be abandoned is hard to imagine.

MsgJp:
かなり坂が多いですね
ボルドと同じくらい、大変かも――
MsgEn:
There are many slopes here. 
It could be just as tough as in Volden.

MsgJp:
遺構を探索するなら
渓谷の村ジンゲンを足がかりすれば――
MsgEn:
If you're going to explore the ruins, 
it would be wise to use the village of Jingen 
in the valley as your base of operations.

MsgJp: 川と滝、流れる水の音が爽やかです
MsgEn:
The river and waterfall...
The sound of flowing water is quite refreshing.

MsgJp:
雄大なる渓谷の景色は素晴らしいですね！
もっと高いところから一望しませんか、マスター！
MsgEn:
The breathtaking scenery of the valley is amazing! 
Wouldn't it be great to see it 
from a higher spot, Master?

MsgJp:
ドリード城は壮観ですね！
旧時代の遺物が眠っていると思うと
冒険心がくすぐられます！
MsgEn:
Dreed Castle is spectacular! 
Just thinking about the ancient artifacts
that might be hidden there
sparks my sense of adventure!

MsgJp:
滝があるようです、マスター！
近くまで見にいってみましょう
MsgEn:
I see there's a waterfall, Master! 
Let's head over and check it out!

MsgJp:
ボルドに負けず劣らず、高低差がありますね
うっかり足を滑らせないよう気をつけねば
MsgEn:
The elevation changes here
are as dramatic as in Volden. 
Let's be cautious not to slip.

MsgJp:
キメラなど、付近ではかなり獰猛な魔獣も
出現するようです
もちろん、何が来ようと受けて立つまでですが！
MsgEn:
It seems that fierce magickal beasts
like chimeras also appear around here. 
Of course, we'll face whatever comes our way!

MsgJp:
ダウは旧時代の騎士団領
かつては騎士団長が城主を兼ねたと
伝わっている
MsgEn:
Dowe was part of the old
knightly order's territory. 
Legend has it that the knight commander
was also the lord of the castle.

MsgJp:
谷道は起伏が多く、場所により足場が不安定
落下せぬよう十分に注意を
MsgEn:
The valley trail is uneven
and has unstable ground in certain spots. 
Take great care to avoid slipping.

MsgJp:
ダウはバートランドからハイデルを守る緩衝地帯
関所による厳重な管理は、おそらくそのため
MsgEn:
Dowe is a protective buffer
between Hidell and Betland. 
The tight security at the checkpoints 
is likely due to this.

MsgJp:
この辺りには遺構が多数、散在している
探索場所の選択肢もまた、多岐に渡る
MsgEn:
There are numerous ruins
scattered around this area. 
The options for exploration are quite varied.

MsgJp:
渓谷の景観は我が目にも優美
おそらくは、河川と針葉樹の調和ゆえ――
MsgEn:
The picturesque view of the valley
is likely a result of the harmonious interplay
between the rivers and the coniferous trees.

MsgJp:
涼やかなる渓流に、深き針葉樹林
その中に佇む悠久の古城――
あぁ、ダウの景観はなんと絵画的なのか――！
MsgEn:
The refreshing stream and dense coniferous forest, 
with the timeless ancient castle among them—
Ah, Dowe's landscape is so much like a painting!

MsgJp:
旧騎士団の城ドリードは、
今や魔物が溢れ遺物が眠る冒険舞台――！
貴方さまの活躍には相応しき場所かと
MsgEn:
The old knight's castle, Dreed, 
now brims with monsters and hidden relics...!
An adventure stage befitting your prowess!

MsgJp:
ダウ渓谷の魔物は、隣接するハイデルとは
比べ物にならぬ強力なものばかり
関所がなければ危ない所だったかもしれません
MsgEn:
The monsters here in Dowe Valley
are significantly stronger than those in Hidell. 
The area would have been dangerous 
without the checkpoints.

MsgJp:
火薬樽を背負った賢しい小鬼達め――
ここまであの戦法が広がっているとは
MsgEn:
Those cunning little goblins
with their barrels of gunpowder—
I never thought that strategy
would become so widespread.

MsgJp:
騎士団関連の遺構が多いようです
特にドリード城は、かなり多くの抜け道が
外へ伸びていると聞きました
MsgEn:
It looks like there are many ruins 
related to the knights.
Notably, Dreed Castle is said
to have many secret tunnels leading outside.

MsgJp:
この谷、すごくいい景色ですね。覚者さま！
高いところから全部まとめて眺めたいなぁ
MsgEn:
This valley has such a great view, Master!
I'd love to take it all in from up high.

MsgJp:
飛び降りられそうな所は
思い切っていってみませんか？
段差を回るより近道できるかもしれませんよ
MsgEn:
If there's a spot we can jump from,
why not go for it? It might be a shortcut
compared to going around the ledges.

MsgJp:
ドリード城かぁ、わくわくしますね！
きっとすごい宝がまだまだ残ってますよ
魔物もたくさんいるんだろうなぁ――
MsgEn:
Dreed Castle, huh? How exciting! 
There must still be great treasures left behind, 
and I bet there are lots of monsters too...

MsgJp:
切り立った崖際の道はちょっと怖いですね
ぼく、絶対いつか足を滑らしそうです
MsgEn:
It's a bit frightening along the cliff's edge. 
I have a feeling I might slip at some point.

MsgJp:
この辺り、山の魔物も森の魔物も
いろいろ棲んでるみたいですね
ハイデルにたまに居る大きいのは
ここから来たのかな？
MsgEn:
This area seems to be home to a variety
of mountain and forest monsters. 
Do you think the big ones we sometimes see
in Hidell might come from here?

MsgJp:
絶景たぁ聞いてましたが
たしかに結構いい景色ですね、ダウは
――やっぱ城と川ってのぁ相性がいいんでしょう
MsgEn:
They weren't lying about the magnificent views. 
Dowe truly has a wonderful landscape, 
with the castle and river pairing perfectly.

MsgJp:
いやぁ、さすがにボルド、ダウと坂道が
続くと地味に堪えますね
間違って滑り落ちねぇようにしねぇと
MsgEn:
Wow, just like in Volden, 
the endless slopes in Dowe are taking a toll. 
I'd better be careful not to slip and fall.

MsgJp:
ドリード城の内部はかなり広くて複雑ん
なってるようです
外部と通じてる水路やなんかもあるとかで
MsgEn:
Dreed Castle's interior is said
to be quite extensive and complex, 
with passages and waterways 
linking it to the outside.

MsgJp:
ひと仕事したら
ジンゲンあたりで一服しますか
MsgEn:
How about relaxing in Jingen
after we finish our work?

MsgJp:
ダウは西はハイデル、北はバートランドと
接してます
バートランドの方へ行くなぁ少々骨ですが
MsgEn:
Dowe borders Hidell to the west
and Betland to the north. 
Heading toward Betland
might prove to be challenging.

MsgJp:
ふふ、少しロマンチックですね
古城を見ながらマスターと
渓谷を散策するのって――
MsgEn:
It feels a bit romantic, doesn't it? 
Walking through the valley with the old castle 
in sight alongside you, Master—

MsgJp:
滝や川沿いを歩くほうが雰囲気いいけど
リザードが多いわね――
MsgEn:
The mood is nicer by the waterfalls and rivers, 
but there are a lot of lizards—

MsgJp:
ドリード城の調査、楽しみだわ
遺物が眠る旧騎士団の居城――
廃墟になっても壮観ね
MsgEn:
I'm looking forward to investigating Dreed Castle. 
The old knight's stronghold, 
with its hidden relics— 
even in ruins, it's majestic.

MsgJp:
ダウは木材の質がかなり良いみたい
針葉樹だから、まっすぐ育つ木が
多いんでしょうね
MsgEn:
Lumber in Dowe seems to be of excellent quality. 
The coniferous trees here
probably grow very straight.

MsgJp: 頑張って歩いて、足腰を引き締めなきゃ
MsgEn:
Walking diligently is key
to strengthening our legs and core.

MsgJp:
豊かな湖と森――
ミスリウ森林とはまた違う清らかさを感じます
MsgEn:
The rich lake and forest here offer a purity
of a different quality than Mysree Forest.

MsgJp:
この辺りには、やや文化の異なる
遺跡が散在しているようですね
MsgEn:
This region has various ruins
that hint at a culture distinct from others.

MsgJp:
この辺りは採れる木材やハーブも
かなり質がいいようです
MsgEn:
The Lumber and herbs collected in this area 
seem to be of very high quality.

MsgJp:
中央の湖はイニアス湖というそうですが
いかにも何か潜んでいそうですね
MsgEn:
Lake Inias, situated in the center, has an aura 
that suggests something might be lurking within.

MsgJp:
ミスリウ森林深部のさらに南は
ほとんど人の立ち入れぬ秘境の森です
MsgEn:
The deeper southern part of the Mysree Grove 
is a nearly uncharted, hidden wilderness.

MsgJp:
森林深部、地面の上まで水がひたひたです
木が水没しそう――
MsgEn:
In the forest's depths, the water level
is almost reaching the ground, making it seem like
the trees are on the verge of sinking.

MsgJp:
すごく古そうな遺跡が
森のところどころにありますよ――
かつては誰か住んでいたんでしょうか
MsgEn:
The forest has scattered ancient ruins. 
I wonder who might have lived here in the past.

MsgJp:
水辺で青いとかげが多いところとか
見ているだけで感電しそうです――！
MsgEn:
Seeing all those blue lizards by the water's edge, 
it almost feels like you might get shocked
just from looking at them!

MsgJp:
ミスリウとは別のハーブや木材が
採れそうです
MsgEn:
This area seems to offer herbs and wood
different from those in Mysree.

MsgJp:
森の真ん中に湖があって
ドーナツみたいな形をしていますね
MsgEn:
There's a lake in the middle of the forest.
It's shaped like a doughnut.

MsgJp:
湖の周囲に森が広がっていますね
ぐるっと探索していきましょう！
MsgEn:
The forest stretches around the lake. 
Let's explore it thoroughly!

MsgJp:
マスター、森の各所に点々と
遺跡があるようです！
なかなか秀麗な門構えですよ
MsgEn:
Master, 
you'll find various ruins across the forest! 
The gate designs are quite grand.

MsgJp:
イニアス湖には多くの水棲生物がいますが――
ビリビリ帯電しているヤツが多いようです
厄介ですね
MsgEn:
Lake Inias is home to many aquatic creatures, 
however, lot of them are electrically charged. 
It's quite a nuisance.

MsgJp:
深い森に生えている植物やキノコは
効き目が強そうです
たっぷり持ち帰りましょう！
MsgEn:
The plants and mushrooms growing
in the deep forest seem quite potent. 
Let's gather plenty to take back!

MsgJp:
ここまで来たらさらに森深くへと
足を伸ばしたくなりますね！
MsgEn:
We've come this far, 
so I'm keen to delve even further into the forest!

MsgJp:
ここより南は、長きに渡り
神殿の管理下になき森――
異なる者の領域であったことがうかがえる
MsgEn:
To the south, there's a forest that has been 
unmanaged by the temple for a long time. 
It seems to have been a different realm.

MsgJp:
標の祠を拠点登録し
イニアス湖沿いの探索を
MsgEn:
Register the Shrine as your base and explore 
the area around Lake Inias.

MsgJp:
点在する遺跡は、他エリアには見られぬ様式
装飾や文字も同様
MsgEn:
The scattered ruins exhibit a unique style
not found in other regions, 
with distinctive decorations and inscriptions.

MsgJp:
近辺のハーブや木材収集は積極的に
調合時に高い効果が期待できる
MsgEn:
Gathering herbs and wood found in this area 
will prove beneficial, as it can improve
the efficacy of your crafting.

MsgJp: より深き森へも、主の意志とあらば従うまで
MsgEn:
Should it be the Master's will, 
I will comply, no matter how deep
into the forest it takes me.

MsgJp:
しかし、少し南部へ脚を運ぶだけで
ずいぶんミスリウとは様子が変わるものですね
人の手もあまり入っていないようですし
MsgEn:
It's remarkable how different it looks
from Mysree with just a little travel south.

MsgJp:
異文化の面影残す翠の遺跡――
これらを築いた先人への敬意を忘れず
探訪するといたしましょう
MsgEn:
The ruins of emerald that hint
at a different civilization—
We must not forget to honor
the builders as we explore them.

MsgJp:
この地の祠に限らず、各地の祠は
いずれも３００年以上前に作られたものであると
伝え聞いた気がいたします
MsgEn:
According to what I've heard, 
the shrines here and in other places
were all constructed over 300 years ago.

MsgJp:
――ふむ
古の祭祀場は、この地にある遺跡群と
何か関係があるのでしょうか
MsgEn:
Hmm, could the Ancient Ritual Ground
be related to the ruins in this land...?

MsgJp:
イニアス湖――神秘の青き――ビリビリ水面

もっと美しい言葉が思いつきそうなのに！
MsgEn:
Lake Inias—mystical azure—crackling waters. 
Ah, if it weren't for those accursed
electric lizards, I'd surely come up
with more poetic words!

MsgJp:
こっちはミスリウとはかなり感じが違いますね
湖の水が溢れているみたいです
そのうち全部水没したりしないのかなぁ
MsgEn:
This area feels quite different from Mysree. 
It seems like the lake's water is overflowing. 
I wonder if it will eventually be completely 
submerged.

MsgJp:
ねぇ覚者さま！
湖の周りを一周してみませんか？
いい運動になりそうですよ
MsgEn:
Hey, Arisen! 
How about doing a lap around the lake? 
It seems like it would be great exercise.

MsgJp:
森は、奥に行けばいくほどおっかない獣が

どこにどんなのがいるか、祠の人に
ちゃんと聞いておきましょうか
MsgEn:
It's said that the deeper parts of the forest
are home to increasingly fearsome beasts. 
We should inquire at the shrine about 
where to find what.

MsgJp:
あっちこっちに遺跡がありますね

MsgEn:
Ruins are spread out all over the place. 
They've blended so seamlessly with the lush 
surroundings that they appear to be a natural 
part of the landscape

Perhaps a "lord" or something similar.

The air is so fresh here— 
this forest really feels pure.

MsgEn:
The things gathered from this forest
appear to be of excellent quality. 
The vegetation thrives in the rich, moist earth.

MsgJp:
小奇麗な遺跡がちょいちょいありますよ

Scattered around are some 
rather well-preserved ruins. 
They appear to be from very long ago.

MsgJp:
森は南の方ほど手つかずといいます

The forest is said to be
more untouched toward the south. 
There are likely many magickal beasts there.

MsgJp:

The lake appears
almost electrified.
Without defenses or
cures, it'll be challenging.

綺麗な森と湖よね――

forest.  A shame about the lizards.

why not cross the shallow parts?

Master, today I would like to make a hairstyle
suggestion!

MsgJp: マスター、今日は私から戦技の提案があるの
MsgEn:
Master, 
I have a proposal for combat techniques today.

MsgJp: マスター、道具とか依頼の確認はいいの？
MsgEn: Master, can we check on the tools and requests?

MsgJp: マスターに刃を向ける者は、あたしが許さない
MsgEn: I will not allow anyone to turn on the Master.

MsgJp: マスターのこと、よろしくお願いしますね
MsgEn: I look forward to working with you, Master.

MsgJp: 今までとは一味違う働きをお見せするわ、マスター
MsgEn:
I'll show you a different kind of performance 
from before, Master.

MsgJp: 今回のエリア探索、とても良い成果を上げられたのよ！
MsgEn:
We've had very good results exploring the area
this time!

MsgJp: 仰せのままに
任せてちょうだい
何かあるんじゃないかしら、この辺り
MsgEn: I think there's something around here.

MsgJp: 何かいるわ、近くに
何があっても、マスターの側にいるわ
MsgEn:
No matter what happens, I'll stay by your side,
Master.

MsgJp: 何だかお部屋の雰囲気が変わったみたい！
MsgEn:
It's like the atmosphere of the room has changed
somehow!

MsgJp: 何とか――耐えなくちゃ――！
MsgEn: Somehow - I have to endure - I have to endure!

MsgJp: 修練達成ね！　おめでとう、マスター！
MsgEn:
You've accomplished the ordeal! Congratulations,
Master!

MsgJp:
先日、別の覚者さまの冒険をサポートしてきたの
どう？　頑張ってきたのよ
MsgEn:
I recently assisted another Arisen lady 
with their adventure.
What do you think? I've been working hard!

MsgJp:
冒険に行くなら誘ってね
どこまでもお助けするわ、マスター
MsgEn:
Invite me if you're going on an adventure.
I'll help you everywhere, Master.

MsgJp:
別の覚者さまが、あたしを見て
センスが素敵だって褒めてらしたわ！
MsgEn:
Another Arisen looked at me and 
complimented me on my sense of style!

MsgJp: 力を溜めたこの攻撃、甘く見ないでね――
MsgEn:
Don't underestimate this attack 
that I've built up power for...

MsgJp: 反撃に出ましょう、この戦技で支援するわ！
MsgEn:
Let's counterattack, 
I'll support you with this technique!

MsgJp: 大丈夫、すぐに癒すわ
MsgEn: Don't worry, I'll heal you in no time.

MsgJp: 大丈夫よ、マスター
属性を付与するわ！　攻撃に出ましょう！
MsgEn:
I'll improve your attributes! Let's go on the
offensive!

MsgJp: 弱点は――、そこよ！
MsgEn: There is a weakness... right there!

MsgJp: 弱点は氷ね――
弱点は炎ね――
弱点は聖ね――
弱点は闇ね――
弱点は雷ね――
弱点を叩けば 立っていられないはず！
MsgEn:
If you hit the weak spots, they wouldn't be able
to stand!

MsgJp: 忘れ物はありません？　道具に、装備に――
MsgEn: Have you forgotten anything? Tools, equipment...

MsgJp: 戦って大丈夫？　かなり手ごわそうよ
MsgEn:
Are you sure you're up for this? 
They look pretty tough.

MsgJp: 掘り出し物、見つかるといいわね
揺さぶりに行くわね！
MsgEn: I'm going to go shake things up!

MsgJp: 敵が興奮してるみたい！　気を付けて！
MsgEn:
Be careful, it seems like the enemy is getting
excited!

MsgJp: 敵の能力、下げてみせる！

新しい家財を手に入れたのね
素敵なお部屋になりそう――
MsgEn:
You've got new household goods.
It's going to be a lovely room...

MsgJp: 新しい装備、似合ってるかしら？
MsgEn: Do I look good in my new gear?

MsgJp: 旅は長いわ、一休みしていきましょう
MsgEn: The journey is long. Let's take a break.

MsgJp: 次の冒険のためにも、しっかり休んでくださいね
MsgEn: Rest well for your next adventure!

MsgJp: 気に入って頂けるよう努力するわ
MsgEn: I'll try to make sure you like it.

MsgJp: 気をつけて。敵の気配が
MsgEn: Watch out. There's a sign of the enemy.

MsgJp: 気合入れていきましょ！
疲れてるわね、チャンスよ！
MsgEn: Look, it's tired, here's your chance!

MsgJp: 素敵な方。お目にかかれて光栄よ
MsgEn: What a lovely person. It's an honor to meet you.

MsgJp: 良い旅になるように精一杯尽くすわ
MsgEn: I'll do my best to make it a good trip.

MsgJp: 落ち着いて、もう大丈夫よ
見て！　庭に何か来てるわ！
MsgEn: Oh, Master Arisen!　There's something in the garden!

MsgJp: 解ったわ！
貴重な宝がある気がするわ、探してみない？
MsgEn:
I have a feeling there's some 
precious treasure in there, 
why don't we look for it?

MsgJp: 道具を確認するってことは、そろそろ出発かしら？
MsgEn:
If we're checking our gear, does that mean we're
about to leave?

MsgJp: 部屋に戻ると何だか力が抜けちゃうわね
MsgEn: It's kind of relaxing to be back in your room.

MsgJp:
いいか――
覚者の初陣には白竜の特別な加護がある
MsgEn:
Listen carefully.
The Arisen are blessed by the White Dragon
for their first battle.

MsgJp:
だから、実力以上の戦いができるはずだ
思う存分暴れてくれ
MsgEn:
Your strength will be far greater
than normal. Let loose and don't hold
anything back.

MsgJp: 砦の守備隊は、ヴァネッサをはじめ精鋭ぞろい
MsgEn:
The fort's troops are Vanessa's
handpicked elite!

MsgJp: 救援要請なんて、もしかして初めてかも？
MsgEn:
To even call for reinforcements...
Have they ever done that?

MsgJp:
ここまでオークに押し込まれることなど
この３００年、なかったことだ
MsgEn:
For 300 years, the Orcs haven't
managed to advance this far... until now.

MsgJp: 情勢はこの上なく深刻――さあ、急ぐぞ！
MsgEn:
'Tis more than a dire situation.
Now, advance!

MsgJp: 武器、用意！　構えろ！
走れ～！

隙あらば掴みかかるんだ
デカイ敵はよじ登って戦え
MsgEn:
Find an opportunity to grab them.
Climb onto larger foes and strike!

MsgJp: 体力減ったら回復アイテム！　自己責任だぞ！
MsgEn:
Use a recovery item should you falter!
That's your responsibility!

MsgJp: ほら、砦へ急いで！
立派立派、まだ生きてる！　やるねえ！
あのね――わたしの心配より自分の心配！
MsgEn: Hey now, your concerns are greater than mine!

MsgJp: ここはまだ演習のようなもの――さあ、砦へ急げ！
MsgEn:
'Tis just as we practiced!
Now, to the fort!

MsgJp:
バタバタしてるが、動きは悪くない
自信を持って戦え！
MsgEn:
A bit gaudy, but your movements
are good. Fight with confidence!

MsgJp: さあ、砦へ突入だ！
MsgEn: Now, we charge into the fort!

MsgJp: おい、どこへいく！
そっちじゃないぞ！
こっちへ来い！
おい、回復しておけ！
回復アイテムを使うんだ！
もっと体力に気を配れ！
くそ――回復してくれ
すまん――自力回復できん
MsgEn: My apologies... I am unable to heal myself.

MsgJp: 俺を見殺しにする気か！
MsgEn: You mean to let me die?!

MsgJp: そっちじゃないって！
ちゃんとついてきてよ！
どこいく気！？
ほら、回復しなさい、回復！
死にたいの？　いやなら回復！
MsgEn: Do you wish me to die? If not, heal me!

MsgJp: 回復しなさいってば！
わたし、回復してほしいんだけど
こっち見て――回復して――
お願い――見捨てないで――

戦場の咆哮が聞こえるか？　
扉の先は、おそらく敵味方入り交じる混戦状態――
MsgEn:
Hear the roar of the battleground?
'Tis a mix of both friend and foe clashing forces.

MsgJp:
さあ、やっちゃって！
今日のあんたには白竜の加護があるんだから！
MsgEn:
Alright, charge!
The White Dragon will protect you!

MsgJp: さあ！　全てのオークどもを切り倒せ！
MsgEn:
Okay! Cut down every one of
these foul Orcs!

MsgJp:
ぷんぷん臭ってくるね
ああ、腹立つ！　許さないから！
MsgEn:
What an intense odor.
Oh, I'm mad now! No mercy!

MsgJp: 次から次へと来るぞ！　体力に気をつけろ
MsgEn:
'Tis one after the other! Heed
your stamina!

MsgJp: ひとりで全部倒してしまえ！　遠慮は無用だ！
MsgEn:
Fell them all with reckless
abandon!

MsgJp: いいぞ！　その調子だ！
ほら、来てるよ！　やっちゃえ！
もう、鼻が曲がる～！　さっさと終わらせよう！
MsgEn:
Ah, my poor nose...! Let's finish
this quickly!

MsgJp: いいねえ！　あとはまかせちゃおうかな
いい調子だぞ！
敵は残り少ないぞ！　押せ！
追い風に乗れ！
くそっ！　敵、増兵だ！
増援だ！　気を引きしめろ！
まだいたのか！
もう少しだよ！
いい感じ！　このまま！
優勢優勢！
まだいたか！　くう～！
残念、敵が増えちゃった！
MsgEn: I'm afraid they've grown in number!

MsgJp: あーあ、敵、増援だ！
頼りにしてるぞ、新人！
ここまで攻め込まれるとは――不覚！
MsgEn: I never expected them to reach even here...

MsgJp:
オークはまだまだいる！
一匹残らず倒すぞ！
MsgEn:
Orcs still remain!
Fell them to the very last!

MsgJp:
さすが、レオ隊長が見込んだ新人だな！
このまま砦を掃除するぞ！
MsgEn:
Just as expected of a rookie 
picked by Captain Leo!
We'll have the fort cleared in no time!

MsgJp: 敵には<COL ff7575><KCT ATTACK1>／<KCT ATTACK2></COL>で基本攻撃！
MsgEn:
Use <COL ff7575><KCT ATTACK1>/
<KCT ATTACK2></COL> to attack enemies!

MsgJp: さらに<COL ff7575><PADM><KCT WEAPON_SUB>を押しながら</PADM><KEYM><KCT SKILL_CUSTOM3></COL>か</KEYM>
MsgEn: Additionally, while holding <COL ff7575><PADM><KCT WEAPON_SUB>, press </PADM><KEYM><KCT SKILL_CUSTOM3><KCT SKILL_CUSTOM3></COL></KEYM>

MsgJp: <COL ff7575><PADM><KCT ATTACK1></PADM><KEYM><KCT SKILL_CUSTOM1></KEYM></COL>でカスタムスキルだ！
MsgEn:
Use <COL ff7575><PADM><KCT ATTACK1>
</PADM><KEYM><KCT SKILL_CUSTOM1>
</KEYM></COL>
to perform custom skills!

MsgJp: <COL ff7575><PADM><KCT WEAPON_MAIN>を押しながら</PADM><KEYM><KCT SKILL_CUSTOM4></KEYM></COL>でもOKだ！
MsgEn: <COL ff7575><PADM><KCT WEAPON_MAIN>while pressing </PADM><KEYM><KCT SKILL_CUSTOM4></KEYM></COL> is OK too!

MsgJp: 技は画面右下のガイドで確認してくれ！
MsgEn:
Your skills are shown at the bottom
right of your screen!

MsgJp: オークや大型の敵には近づき、<COL ff7575><KCT TOUCH></COL>でしがみついて攻撃だ！
MsgEn:
To grab your enemies, press <COL ff7575><KCT TOUCH>
</COL>,
which can even be used to climb Orcs and
other larger foes!

MsgJp: 走る時は<COL ff7575><PADM>移動方向に<KEYN L_STICK>を倒しながら押し込み<KEYM>初期設定の場合、同じ移動キー２回押し</KEYM></COL>でダッシュだ！
MsgEn:
While running, <COL ff7575><PADM>press down on
the<KEYN L_STICK>while pushing in a
direction<KEYM>with the default setting,
tap the same directional key twice</KEYM></COL>
to sprint!

MsgJp:
【ヒント：新たなメインクエストについて】
新たな<COL ff7575>メインクエスト＜和解の使者＞</COL>が受注可能になりました
謁見の間にいるレオに話しかけて受注しましょう
MsgEn:
[Tip: About New Main Quests]
New <COL ff7575>Main Quest (Envoy of Reconciliation)</COL>
Gain new orders by speaking to Leo, who is in
the Audience Chamber.

MsgJp:
まず《謁見の間》へ行くこと
そのあとでまた会おう
少し話そうぜ
MsgEn:
First, go to the Audience Chamber. 
We'll talk again after that.

MsgJp:
画面右上のミニマップを見て、赤いマーカーが示す
《謁見の間》へ向かいましょう
MsgEn:
Look at the minimap on the top-right of
the screen, and head for the "Audience Chamber"
indicated by the red marker.

MsgJp: マップを拡大すると見やすくなります
MsgEn:
Expanding the map out makes it easier
to see everything.

MsgJp: 【ヒント：ミニマップのサイズ変更】
<COL ff7575><KCT UI_MINIMAP>を押しながら<KCT UI_MINIMAP_SCALING></COL>でサイズ変更
MsgEn:
<COL ff7575>While holding <KCT UI_MINIMAP>, change minmap
size by pressing <KCT UI_MINIMAP_SCALING></COL>

MsgJp: ついてきな――謁見の間の前まで案内してやるよ
MsgEn:
Follow me. I'll show you to
the Audience Chamber.

MsgJp: この神殿は白竜の守護のもと――神官によって統治されてるんだ
MsgEn:
This temple is under the protection
of the White Dragon, and governed by the
clergy.

MsgJp: 砦戦はどうだった？レオとイリスに相当いわれたようだな
MsgEn:
How fared the battle?
Leo and Iris seem to think it went fairly well.

MsgJp: 一人前の覚者になるためには――まだまだ戦い方を知る必要があるぜ
MsgEn:
In order to become an Arisen, you
still need to know how to fight properly.

MsgJp: 今のジョブが自分に合ってないと思うなら<COL ff7575>いつでも他のジョブに転職</COL>も可能だ
MsgEn:
If you feel your current vocation
does not suit you, <COL ff7575> it is possible to change
to another vocation at any time.</COL>

MsgJp: <COL ff7575>装備を強くしたりスキルの使い方</COL>などいろいろ教える事があるが――まずは白竜に挨拶が先だ
MsgEn:
There are many things to be taught,
such as <COL ff7575>enhancing equipment and properly
utilizing skills.</COL>
Before that however, it is time to greet 
the White Dragon.

MsgJp: <COL ff7575>他の覚者と一緒に冒険に出る</COL>――これもお前がもう少し一人前になってからだ
MsgEn:
<COL ff7575>Go out and adventure with other
Arisen</COL>, even if you feel you can handle
things on your own.

MsgJp: あと自分の容姿が気に入らないようなら<COL ff7575>＜商店区＞にある美容院</COL>にいくといいぜ
MsgEn:
If you're unsatisfied with your
appearance, seek out the hairdresser
<COL ff7575>located in the Shopping District's 
beauty salon.</COL>

MsgJp: ついたぞ――この先が謁見の間だ
MsgEn:
We've arrived. Beyond this
point lies the Audience Chamber.

MsgJp:
今さら自己紹介でもないが
俺は覚者の統率――まとめ役のレオだ
MsgEn:
Albeit a bit late for an introduction,
I am Leo, leader of the Arisen.

MsgJp:
俺が重要だと考えている
覚者の務めは、ふたつ
MsgEn:
I would like to think myself important,
as are the duties of the Arisen.

MsgJp:
ひとつは――
石化した白竜の回復を助け
完全なる復活への後押しをすること
MsgEn:
First of which, is to reverse the petrification of
the White Dragon, and strive towards its complete
revival.

MsgJp:
心臓を捧げた俺たちと
その心臓を預かる白竜は一心同体だ
MsgEn:
We who dedicated our hearts, and the
White Dragon whom safeguards the heart,
are all of one mind.

MsgJp:
白竜が力を取り戻せば、俺たち覚者の
力も増す――もちろん、その逆もしかり
MsgEn:
If the White Dragon regains their strength, so
too shall our strength increase, and of
course, the reverse is also true.

MsgJp:
加えて――
白竜はこのレスタニアの大地とも
深くつながっている
MsgEn:
Additionally, the White Dragon is also deeply
connected to this land of Lestania.

MsgJp:
つまり、レスタニアと、人々の未来は
我々の双肩にかかっているというわけだ
MsgEn:
In other words, Lestania and the people's
future, rests upon our shoulders.

MsgJp:
もうひとつの務めは
白竜の砦となり、盾として戦うこと
MsgEn:
Another duty of ours is to become a bulwark of
the White Dragon, to fight as their shield.

MsgJp:
このところ、オークどもの勢いが増している
防衛隊はあちこちの小競り合いで敗走を重ね
グリッテン砦への侵入まで許してしまった
MsgEn:
Recently, the Orc's offensive momentum has
increased, and the Defense Corps have been
repeatedly driven to defeat in skirmishes against
them. We've allowed this to continue, that is,
until the invasion of Fort Gritten.

MsgJp:
このきびしい季節の到来に合わせるように
覚者になった意味を考えてくれ
そうすれば、生き方が見えてくるだろう
MsgEn:
As this harsh season arrives,
consider the meaning of becoming an Arisen.
Then, you'll see a way to live.

MsgJp:
もちろん、苦難に背を向ける生き方もある
だが、おまえは誇り高き道を選ぶ――
MsgEn:
Of course, there are ways to live that keep one
away from suffering, but you chose to
live proudly...

MsgJp: ああ、俺の目にくるいはない
MsgEn: Yes... I can see it clearly.

MsgJp: （白竜は半ば石になっている――）
MsgEn: (The White Dragon is partially turned to stone--)

MsgJp:
グリッテン砦からのお帰りですね？
初陣、お疲れさまでした
MsgEn:
I see you are back from Fort Gritten?
Good job on your first mission!

MsgJp: ここであらためてお話ししたいことがあります
MsgEn:
There is something I would like to 
discuss.

MsgJp:
白竜様がここにいらっしゃる経緯と
現在の状況は知っていますね？
MsgEn:
Do you know the background and current situation 
of Lord White Dragon being here?

MsgJp:
白竜様は３００年前に竜力の大部分を使い果たし
残されていたのは
あなたたち覚者を生み出す力だけでした
MsgEn:
Lord White Dragon exhausted the majority of his 
Dragon Force 300 years ago. 

What remained was only 
the power to create you Arisen.

MsgJp:
白竜様は最後の力を振り絞って
幾人もの――異例なことですが――幾人もの
覚者を誕生させたのです
MsgEn:
Lord White Dragon exerted his last 
remaining strength, and remarkably, 
he gave birth to numerous Arisen,
despite it being an unusual occurrence.

MsgJp:
全身の石化が始まったのはその後のことで
今では時折目覚めては覚者を生み出すくらい――
MsgEn:
After this, his body began to petrify, 
and now he only occasionally 
wakes up and produces an Arisen...

MsgJp:
竜力の減退で野山の活力までもが弱まり
それに乗じてオークや魔物が力をつけています
MsgEn:
With the decline of his Dragon Force, 
even the vitality of the land has weakened. 
Taking advantage of this, 
the Orcs and other foes have only grown stronger.

MsgJp:
白竜様に心臓を預けたあなたたちは
時の流れから解放され、老いることはありません
MsgEn:
Those of you who have entrusted your hearts 
to Lord White Dragon are liberated from the flow 
of time and do not age.

MsgJp:
でも、忘れないでください
レスタニアの大地、そこに暮らす人々――
その上を、時は変わらず流れているのです
MsgEn:
But do not forget the land of Lestania, 
or the people who live there...
over which time flows unceasing.

MsgJp:
白竜様の復活がどうか間に合いますように
わたしはそう願わずにはいられません
あなたの力を、ぜひ、貸してください
MsgEn:
I can only hope that the resurrection of 
Lord White Dragon will not come too late.
Please, lend us your power.

MsgJp: わたしは神官のジョゼフだ

神官と言ってもぴんと来ないだろうが
この神殿を中心とする政（まつりごと）の
取りまとめが主な仕事だ
MsgEn:
Even if I say "priest", 
you probably won't understand, 
but the main job is to manage the ceremonies 
centered around this temple.

MsgJp:
オークどもとの戦争に加えて
味方同士である覚者と騎士団の反目もあってな――
MsgEn:
In addition to the war with the orcs,
there is also tension between the Arisen and 
the Knights' Order, who are allies...

MsgJp:
部隊編成やら任務の分担、あらゆる事に
口を出すことにしている
MsgEn:
I make it a point to involve myself
in everything, from forming squads
to assigning missions.

MsgJp: ところで、この神殿の歴史は知っているか？
MsgEn:
By the way, 
do you know the history of this temple?

MsgJp:
ふむ――簡単に説明しておこう
かれこれ、３００年前のことだ――
MsgEn:
Hmm―― let me explain it briefly. 
This happened about 300 years ago――

MsgJp:
この地に墜落し、身動きもならない白竜――
その身を案じたレスタニアの民が力を合わせ
長い時間をかけて造りあげたのがこの神殿だ
MsgEn:
The people of Lestania, 
concerned about the white dragon that crashed here
and was unable to move, joined forces
and built this temple over a long period of time.

MsgJp:
堅牢な神殿、覚者、騎士団――
そして戦えない者たちが捧げる祈り――
すべてが白竜を守る力となるのだ
MsgEn:
A solid temple, the Arisen, the Knights' Order――
And the prayers offered by those who cannot fight―
All become the power to protect the White Dragon.

MsgJp:
どれひとつとして、欠けてはいけない
――いいな？
すべてを尊重し、慈しむのだ
MsgEn:
None of them should be missing.
-- alright?
Respect and care for all of them.

MsgJp:
僕はクラウス
ジョゼフ様の助手さ
まあ、使いっ走りみたいなものだね
MsgEn:
I am Klaus,
the assistant of Master Joseph.
Well, I suppose I'm more like a errand boy.

MsgJp:
え？　
いやいや、僕は覚者じゃないんだ
MsgEn: Huh? No, no, I'm not an Arisen.

MsgJp:
覚者たちのほとんどは神殿の外――
レスタニアのあちこちを駆け巡っているよ
MsgEn:
Most of the Arisen are outside the temple - 
running around Lestania.

MsgJp:
もちろん、レオが一声かければ
大勢の覚者が集まるわけだけど
MsgEn:
Of course, if Leo were to call out,
many Arisen would gather together.

MsgJp:
ところで君は《ブラッドオーブ》を知ってるかい？
白竜様に捧げると石化の進行を
食い止めることができるんだ
MsgEn:
By the way, do you know about the "Blood Orb"? 
If you offer it to Lord White Dragon, 
you can halt the progression of petrification.

MsgJp:
でも、なかなか手に入らなくてさ
《ブラッドオーブ》のことは
いつでも頭の片隅で気にしておくといい
MsgEn:
But, it's quite hard to get, you know.
It's good to always keep the thought 
of the [Blood Orb]
in the back of your mind.

MsgJp:
わたしは白衛騎士団――通称白騎団の
団長を拝命しているゲルトだ
MsgEn:
I am Gerd, 
the Commander of the White Guard Knights, 
also known as the White Knights.

MsgJp: 見たところ、貴殿は覚者になって日も浅いようだ
MsgEn:
From what I can see, 
t seems that you have recently become an Arisen.

MsgJp:
これから見聞を広げるのだろうが、
先輩たち――特に覚者から、くだらない偏見を
吹き込まれないようにな
MsgEn:
You're about to broaden your horizons,
but make sure not to let the seniors,
especially among the Arisen, instill
foolish prejudices in you.

MsgJp:
残念なことに覚者の中には
我々騎士団を下に見る者もいる
例えば、こんな陰口をきいたことはないか？
MsgEn:
Unfortunately, among the Arisen, there are 
those who look down upon our Knights' Order. 
Have you ever heard such slander such as this?

MsgJp:
ミミズのフンほどのわずかな報酬のために
騎士になった者がいる――
MsgEn:
There are those who become knights 
for the sake of a reward as meager as worm dung.

MsgJp: 違うぞ！　断じて違う！
MsgEn: That's not true! Absolutely not true!

MsgJp:
我々は全て、白竜様のために
レスタニアのために！
そこに生きる人々のために剣と命を捧げたのだ
MsgEn:
For the sake of the White Dragon,
and for the sake of Lestania!
We have devoted our swords and lives
for the people who live there.

MsgJp: 貴殿たち覚者のように、運命でも使命でもなく――
MsgEn: Like you, noble Arisen, not bound by fate or purpose--

MsgJp:
戦いに背を向けることもできたのに
それをいさぎよしとせず、騎士になる道を選んだ
意志と奉仕の塊が、我々白衛騎士団なのだ
MsgEn:
Even though we could have turned 
our backs on the fight,
we chose the path to become knights.
The embodiment of will and service, 
we are the White Guard Knights.

MsgJp:
もし、貴殿の態度にナめた様子があれば
容赦なく思い知らせてやるからな
MsgEn:
If I see any nonsense in your attitude,
I will show you no mercy.

MsgJp:
ええと――
自己紹介はしたんだっけ？　まだだっけ？
ま、いいか――わたしはイリス
MsgEn:
Um... Did I introduce myself? Or not yet?
Well, it's okay... I'm Iris.

MsgJp:
たいていはレオとつるんでいて
あちこち走り回っているの
MsgEn:
I usually hang out with Leo and 
run around here and there.

MsgJp:
覚者の連絡係みたいなものだね
結構大変な仕事だから頼りになりそうなら
仕事、譲ってもいいよ
MsgEn:
It's like I'm the Arisen's liaison.
It's quite a demanding job,
so if you seem reliable,
I might pass it on to you.

MsgJp:
覚者ってさ、みんな基本的に、バラバラに
生きているんだよね
MsgEn:
The Arisen, you know, everyone basically lives
their own lives, scattered all over the place.

MsgJp:
心臓が時を刻まないから、時間が幾らでも
あるでしょ？
だからさ、いろんなこと考えちゃうんだ
MsgEn:
Since your heart doesn't beat time, 
you have all the time in the world, right?
That's why you think about all sorts of things.

MsgJp: 覚者とは？人生とは？自分って何？とかさ
MsgEn:
What is an Arisen? 
What is life? 
What is self? 
I wonder.

MsgJp:
もちろん、白竜を守るのが本業だけど
その守り方も、ただ戦うだけじゃなくて
覚者ならではの方法を探すべき――とか
いろいろな考え方があるわけよ
MsgEn:
Of course, 
protecting the White Dragon is our main duty,
but our approach to protecting it isn't just about 
fighting.

As Arisen, 
we should seek out methods unique to us――
there are various ways of thinking, you know.

MsgJp:
覚者も騎士団みたいにビシッと組織にした方が
いいって意見もあるけど――
どうなんだろうね
MsgEn:
There are also opinions that it would be better 
to organize the Arisen like a Knights' Order and 
be more organized.
I wonder how that would be.

MsgJp: あ、わたしは深く考えない派なので、よろしく！
MsgEn:
Ah, I'm not the type to think deeply, so, 
nice to meet you!

MsgJp:
白竜様が力を取り戻すまで
わたしたちが世の理を守らねばなりません
MsgEn:
Until Lord White Dragon regains his power,
we must protect the order of the world.

MsgJp:
特に、覚者の皆さんの責任は重大です
白竜様のご期待をゆめゆめお忘れなく
MsgEn:
In particular, the responsibility of 
all the Arisen is significant. 
Please never forget the 
expectations of Lord White Dragon.

MsgJp:
他の連中とも話して
顔を覚えてもらうんだな
MsgEn:
I'll talk to the others
and make sure they remember your face.

MsgJp:
レオがこんなに世話をやくなんて
どういう風の吹き回しだろうね
よっぽどあんたが気に入ったらしいよ
MsgEn:
Leo is really taking care of you.
I wonder what's got into him.
Seems like he really likes you.

MsgJp: あのさぁ――

神殿以外にも《拠点》があるのは
知っているよね？
MsgEn:
Did you know that there are 
other locations outside of the temple?

MsgJp:
村だったり、特別な施設があったり――
そこの住人が助けを求めていたり――
MsgEn:
It could be a village, or a special facility,
where the residents are looking for help--

MsgJp:
いろいろあるから、時間があるなら
あちこち行ってみた方がいいよ
MsgEn:
There's a lot going on, so if you have the time,
you should go all over the place.

MsgJp:
ここんところジョゼフ様が老け込んじゃって
結構重要な仕事を任せてもらえるようになったんだ
MsgEn:
Master Joseph has been getting old these days,
so I've been entrusted with quite important tasks.

MsgJp:
うれしいけど――重圧もあってさ――
時々、話しを聞いてくれるとうれしいな
MsgEn:
I'm glad you're here— 
but I'm also under a lot of pressure.
I'd love it if you'd talk to me from time to time.

MsgJp:
レオに期待されるということは――
危険な場所に行く機会が多いということだ
精進と用心を忘れなさんな
MsgEn:
What Leo expects is that you have a lot 
of opportunities to go to dangerous places.
Do not forget diligence and caution.

MsgJp:
オークどもとの戦争が続く限り
背中を預け合って戦う機会がすぐに来る
貴殿の力はその時に見せてもらおう
MsgEn:
As long as the war with the Orcs continues,
the opportunity to fight 
shoulder to shoulder will come soon.
I look forward to seeing your strength 
at that time.

MsgJp:
白竜様は一日の多くを眠って過ごしますが
ごくわずかながらお目覚めの時もあります
そんな時は、お話だってできますよ
MsgEn:
Lord White Dragon spends much of the day sleeping,
but there are also moments when he wakes up,
and during those times, 
he can have a conversation with you.

MsgJp:
まあ、最初のうちは言われるがままに
戦っていればいいさ
MsgEn:
Well, in the beginning, 
just do as you're told and fight.

MsgJp:
そのうち、自分なりの生き方が
見えてくるはずだ
MsgEn:
Eventually, 
you should be able to see your own way of living.

MsgJp: どれどれどれ？

レオはあんたのどこが気に入ったのかな？
それともただの気まぐれか――なんてね
MsgEn:
What does Leo like about you?
Or is it just a whim?

MsgJp: 君はどんな覚者人生を歩むんだろうね
MsgEn:
I wonder what kind of life as an 
Arisen you will lead.

MsgJp:
冒険者みたいな生き方もいいけど
僕としては神殿のために尽力して欲しい――
MsgEn:
You can live like an adventurer,
but for my part, 
I want you to do your best for the temple--

MsgJp: いや、最近、少ないんだよね、そういう覚者
MsgEn: No, there aren't many of those Arisen these days.

MsgJp:
ここで見聞したことを外で話す時は
その判断を慎重に行うようにな
MsgEn:
Be careful about your judgment when 
talking about what you have seen here outside.

MsgJp:
秘密は可能な限り少なくしたいが
内容によってはそうもいかん
MsgEn:
I want to minimize the secretkeeping 
as much as possible, 
but depending on the subject, 
it may not be possible.

MsgJp:
どうした？　時間を持て余しているのなら
オークの一匹でも倒してくるがいい
MsgEn:
What's wrong? If you're just wasting time, 
go ahead and defeat even one Orc.

MsgJp:
戦士に大切なことは
百の無駄口より剣のひと振り――忘れるな
MsgEn:
The important thing for a warrior is 
the swing of a sword, not empty words――
don't forget.

MsgJp: 【ヒント：マイ拠点の登録方法】
①各拠点に設置された《拠点の礎》に触れて解放
MsgEn:
Touch the "Portcrystal" placed at 
each location to unlock it.

MsgJp:
②タッチアクションから《マイ拠点に登録》を選択
※以降《リム転移》でいつでも瞬間移動できます
MsgEn:
Select "Register to My Favorites" 
from the touch action.
※ Afterwards, you can teleport 
instantly using "Rift Teleport" at any time.

MsgJp: 帰還、遠距離移動には《リム転移》が便利です
MsgEn:
Rift Teleport, or "Rift Teleportation," 
is useful for returning and long-distance travel.

MsgJp: 【ヒント：リム転移の使い方】
①ゲームメニューのワールドで《リム転移》を選択
MsgEn: Select "Rift Teleport" in the Game Menu's World.

MsgJp:
②移動したい場所を選択
※白竜神殿への帰還はノーコストです
MsgEn:
Select the location you want to move to.
※Returning to the White Dragon Temple is free of cost.

MsgJp: 【ヒント：スポット情報の見方】

採取アイテムや討伐対象の魔物を探すには、
エリアマスターの《スポット情報》が便利です
MsgEn:
To search for items and 
target monsters for suppression,
the Area Master's "Spot Info" is convenient.

MsgJp: ①《エリア情報》から《スポット情報》を選択

②スポット情報で、「入手可能アイテム」と
　「魔物情報」を確認
MsgEn:
In the spot information, 
check the "Available Items" and "Enemies".

MsgJp: テル村の場所は地図で確認してくれ
MsgEn:
Please check the location 
of Tel Village on the map.

MsgJp:
白竜様はまどろみの中――
お変わりはありません
MsgEn:
Lord White Dragon is in a slumber―― 
No changes have occurred.

MsgJp:
白竜は自らを守るために
大勢の覚者を生み出した――
MsgEn:
The White Dragon, in order to protect itself, 
gave birth to a multitude of Arisen――

MsgJp:
白竜自身の言葉だから
異論を唱えるものは誰もいない
MsgEn:
Because it is the White Dragon's own words,
there is no one who voices dissent.

MsgJp:
これは太古の昔から竜とともに戦ってきた
白衛騎士団を否定するものではないのだが
面白くないと思っている騎士もおり――
MsgEn:
This is not to deny the White Guard Knights, 
who have fought alongside dragons since ancient 
times, but some knights find it boring――

MsgJp: おまけに思い上がった覚者も少なくはない
MsgEn:
Moreover, 
there are also quite a few arrogant Arisen.

MsgJp:
わたしから見ると実にくだらない反目だが
だからといって鼻で笑うわけにもいかない
厄介な問題――というわけだ
MsgEn:
From my perspective, it's a truly trivial rivalry,
but that doesn't mean I can just laugh it off.
It's a troublesome issue—that's the gist of it.

MsgJp: ふふふ――

大きな仕事を任せてもらえそうなんだ
正式に決まったら話すよ
MsgEn:
I feel like I might be entrusted with a big job.
I'll talk about it once it's officially decided.

MsgJp: ガルドリンのところへ行くんだって？
MsgEn: I heard you're going to Gurdolin's place?

MsgJp:
あのおっさん、言われるほど面倒な人じゃ
ないと思うんだよね
かばう気は全然ないけどさ
MsgEn:
I don't think that old man is as 
troublesome as people say. 
I don't have any intent of defending him though.

MsgJp: こんにちは

あら？　さっき、そこに優しそうな顔の
青年がいませんでしたか？
MsgEn:
Oh? Didn't I see a young man with a kind face 
over there just now?

MsgJp:
優先権を主張するなら
さっさと終わらせてみやがれ
MsgEn:
If you're claiming priority,
finish it quickly!

MsgJp: 俺たちに任せればすぐに終わりだ
MsgEn: If you let us handle it, it'll be over soon.

MsgJp:
まずは調査を終えてからだ
それくらいわからんのか！？
MsgEn:
First, finish the investigation.
Do you not understand that much!?

MsgJp: 順序、秩序は貴殿らにはないのか！？
MsgEn: Do you not have order or discipline?!
column9: Knight of the White Guard Order

MsgJp:
時間の無駄だ！
おまえらの相手をしているひまなどない！
MsgEn:
What a waste of time! 
I don't have time to deal with you!

MsgJp: 覚者はなめられたら終わりだぞ、新入り
MsgEn:
Underestimating the Arisen will be your downfall, 
newcomer.

MsgJp: こっちに任せればすぐに終わるってのによ！
MsgEn: If you leave it to me, it'll be over soon!

MsgJp:
くそっ――
なに？　詳しい事情が知りたい？
MsgEn:
Damn it--
What?　You want to know what's going on?

MsgJp:
だったらこの村の黒ブドウ亭にいる
アルフレドから聞くんだな
MsgEn:
In that case, 
ask Alfred at the Black Grape Inn in this village.

MsgJp: どうしてあんな奴が覚者なんだ！？
MsgEn: Why is someone like that an Arisen?!
column9: Knight of the White Guard Order

MsgJp: おまえ、余計なことはするなよ
MsgEn: You, don't do anything you don't have to.

MsgJp:
貴君はレオの使者だな？
わたしからも状況を説明しておこう
MsgEn:
You are Leo's messenger, aren't you?
Let me explain the situation to you.

MsgJp:
村に魔物が出没するという問題に関連して
村はずれの廃屋から気味の悪い物音が
聞こえるという訴えがあった
MsgEn:
Related to the issue 
of monsters appearing in the village,
there have been reports of eerie sounds coming 
from an abandoned house 
on the outskirts of the village.

MsgJp:
棲みついた魔物がたてる音だろうと
我々は考えている
MsgEn: We think it's the sound of monsters.

MsgJp:
すでにガルドリンには伝えてあるが
あの覚者は動こうとはしない
MsgEn:
I have already informed Gurdolin,
but that Arisen has no intention of moving.

MsgJp:
口汚く騎士たちを侮辱するだけだ
いったい何を考えているのか――
MsgEn:
He just insults the knights with his foul mouth.
What in the world does he think he's doing...

MsgJp:
ともあれ、レオからの指示があるのだな？
それを尊重して、問題の解決を図ってくれ
差配は貴君に任せよう
MsgEn:
Anyway, Leo has given you instructions, right?
Just follow those and try to solve the problem.
I'll leave it to you to make a difference.

MsgJp:
ところで、廃屋へゆく前に村の
《拠点の礎》に触れて解放しておいてくれ
礎を解放しリム転移が使えるようになれば
神殿とテルの往来も楽になるだろう
MsgEn:
By the way, before you go to the abandoned house, 
please attune to the village's Portcrystal. 
Once you've attuned to the Portcrystal and 
gain the ability to use Rift Teleport, 
it will be easier to travel between the temple and Tel.

MsgJp:
怪しい物音のする廃屋はハイデル教会の
司祭が、代々使っていた家だ
MsgEn:
The abandoned house with strange noises used to 
be the home of the priests of Hidell Church, 
passed down through the generations.

MsgJp:
時代とともに教会の教えは廃れてしまい
やがて司祭も姿を消した
MsgEn:
Over time, the Church's teachings fell into disuse
and eventually the priests disappeared.

MsgJp:
しかも、最後の司祭が村を出るところを見た者が
誰もいなくてな――
MsgEn:
Moreover, there was nobody who saw the last 
priest leaving the village...

MsgJp:
気味の悪さと後ろめたさから
廃屋に近づく者はほとんどいない
MsgEn:
Due to the eerie feeling and guilt, 
very few people approach the abandoned house.

MsgJp:
今は魔物の巣窟となっていても不思議ではないと
わたしは思っている
MsgEn:
It is not strange that it has now become 
a den of monsters, I think.

MsgJp:
《廃屋の地下室》はどっちかって？
それなら村の西、そこにある《エテルナ装具屋》
の裏をまっすぐさ
MsgEn:
"Which way to the Abandoned House Cellar?"
If that's the case, 
go straight behind Eterna's Outfitter,
located in the west of the village.

MsgJp: しかし、あんな場所に何の用だい？
MsgEn: But what do you want in a place like that?

MsgJp:
ほう――
魔物は貴君が退治したのか
さすが、レオが見込んだ覚者だ
MsgEn:
I see...
So you're the one who vanquished the monsters.
Leo was right to place his trust in an Arisen
like you.

MsgJp:
あらためて自己紹介させてくれ
職はハイデル平原のエリアマスター
名はアルフレドだ
MsgEn:
Let me introduce myself again. 
I am the Area Master of Hidell Plains. 
My name is Alfred.

MsgJp:
長い付き合いになるだろう
よろしく頼む
MsgEn:
It will be a long-term relationship.
I'm counting on you.

MsgJp:
世話になったな
ガルドリンを連れて、神殿へ戻るがいい
後のことはわたしに任せてくれ
MsgEn:
I am grateful for your help.
Take Gurdolin with you and return to the Temple.
Leave the rest to me.

MsgJp: おい、テル村の連中の話を聞いたか？
MsgEn:
Hey, have you heard about the 
folks from Tel Village?

MsgJp:
あいつら、賭けをしていやがったんだ
魔物を倒すのは覚者か騎士団か――でな
MsgEn:
They made a bet that the one who would defeat the 
demon would be the Arisen or 
the Knights of the Order.

MsgJp:
騎士団に賭けていたのはたったひとり
――村の若い女だ
MsgEn:
There was only one person who 
bet on the Knights' Order
- a young woman from the village.

MsgJp:
魔物を倒したのは公式には騎士団
つまり、その女が金を全部受け取った
MsgEn:
The one who defeated the enemy was 
officially the Knights' Order.
In other words, the woman received all the money.

MsgJp:
おれの想像だがガルドリンは女から
金をむしり取ったに違いない
となれば、まったく、悪党だよ、あいつは
MsgEn:
My guess is that Gurdolin has been extorting 
money from women.
