ジリアンは既に出立した
おまえたちもジリアンの後を追ってくれ
MsgEn:
Gillian has already left.
You guys go after Gillian too.

MsgJp: おい、とっとと俺たちも行こうぜ
MsgEn: Hey, let's get the hell out of here.

MsgJp:
あー、野営地って、敵がうじゃうじゃいそうな
予感がするんだけれど
MsgEn:
Ah, I have a feeling that the encampment
is going to be crawling with enemies.

MsgJp:
野営地を探っていた仲間に
何かしらの動きがあったみたいです
MsgEn:
I've got a buddy who was exploring
the encampment and it looks like
there's been some movement.

MsgJp: どうやら怖じ気づきはしなかったみたいね
MsgEn: Apparently, it didn't scare him off.

MsgJp:
いい、仲間の工作によって
閉じられた野営地への突入路は確保した
MsgEn:
Certainly, with the aid of my allies, 
we have secured the route to the 
closed-off campsite for our approach.

MsgJp:
わたしは裏から忍び込むから
あなたたちは仲間と共に正面から切り込んで
派手に暴れてくれない？
MsgEn:
I'll sneak in from the back
and you guys can cut in from the front
with your buddies and go on a rampage
with a bang, right?

MsgJp:
わたしが囚われた仲間を見つけ出すあいだ
敵を引きつけてほしいの
MsgEn:
While I find my captive companions,
I want you to keep the attention of the enemies.

MsgJp:
それと、魔軍の中には戦甲で身を固めた敵が
いるみたいだから注意して
MsgEn:
Also, it seems there are foes among
the Demon Army clad in battle armor,
so be wary.

MsgJp:
野営地の中には、必ず囚われた仲間が
いるはずなんだ
MsgEn:
Within the encampment, there should 
definitely be captured allies.

MsgJp:
はじめて見る顔だな
だが、手を貸してくれるなら歓迎だ
MsgEn:
I've never seen your face before,
but you're welcome to lend a hand.

MsgJp:
作戦の手筈はジリアンから聞いて欲しい
突入路は既に開いている
MsgEn:
Please listen to the strategy from Gillian; 
the route for infiltration is already clear.

MsgJp:
新入りさん？
頑張ってね
MsgEn:
Fresh blood?
Good luck out there.

MsgJp:
待ち人は来ず――か
いや、こちらの話だ
MsgEn:
Our rendezvous has not come—
Don't mind, this is about us.

MsgJp: 解放されても未来があるわけじゃない――か
MsgEn:
Being released doesn't guarantee 
a future—does it?

MsgJp:
こりゃ助ける方にとってもキツい戦いだな
なんに命を賭けりゃいいんだ
MsgEn:
This battle is tough for the ones 
offering help too. What should 
we put our lives on the line for?

MsgJp: ジリアンさ、希望を探してるって言ってたよね
MsgEn: Gillian, you said you were looking for hope.

MsgJp:
それ、なんだろう
ここには無さそうだけど――
MsgEn:
What could that be? 
It seems it's not here, though―

MsgJp: 隊長、一度レスタニアに戻りませんか？
MsgEn: Captain, why don't you go back to Lestania?

MsgJp:
ここも気になるけど――
どうせ休むなら、あっちの方が
身体にはいいはずです
MsgEn:
This place interests me too, but― 
if we must rest, over there should be 
better for the body.

MsgJp:
おかげでみんな無事
相変わらず、疲れ切っているけどね
ねぎらいや感謝がなくても悪く思わないで
MsgEn:
Thanks to that, everyone is safe.
They're still exhausted as ever, though.
Don't take it badly if there's no praise
or gratitude.

MsgJp:
あの忌々しい戦車が立ち去った後――
敵が新たな部隊を配備する前に、あの野営地は
わたしたちで確保しておくつもり
MsgEn:
After that accursed tank has moved on, 
we will ensure that camp is secured 
before the enemy assigns a new force.

MsgJp:
けれど、アッカーシェランはもう終わりが
近いんだと思う
たとえ大地が生き続けても、人の心は死にかけている
MsgEn:
But I think the end is near for Acre Selund.
Even if the land continues to live, 
people's hearts are dying.

MsgJp:
火竜様が倒れてから――
大地を巡る竜力が変わったせいだと思う
MsgEn:
Since Lord Fire Dragon's defeat, 
I believe the dragon power that
circulates through the land has changed.

MsgJp:
あなたたちも休んでおくといいよ
ここだって、オークどもが来ないとも限らない
その時は戦ってもらうからね
MsgEn:
You all should take a rest as well.
Even here, there's no guarantee
that orcs won't appear.
If that happens, I'll need you to fight.

MsgJp: アッカーシェランか――

こことは違う歴史、こことは違う思想の人々が
暮らす世界
でもやっぱり、戦争だけはあるんだね
MsgEn:
People with a different history, 
a different ideology from the world we live in.
But still, there is always war, isn't it?

MsgJp:
なるほど――
アッカーシェランの民たちは
疲れ、絶望しているというわけか
MsgEn:
I see...
The people of Acre Selund
are tired and bereft of hope.

MsgJp:
そんな状態では、いくら戦いに勝利しても
ずるずると終焉に向かって滑り落ちるだけ――
MsgEn:
In such a state, no matter how many battles
you win, you will be battered down
toward the end, slowly but surely...

MsgJp:
こんな時こそ強い指導者が必要なのだが
聞く限り、ジリアンもクインタスもそういう人物では
なさそうだな
MsgEn:
It's times like this when the people
need strong figures to lead them.
From what I've heard, neither Gillian
nor Quintus seem to be that kind of person.

MsgJp:
アッカーシェランの人々は竜を失い
町や村も失ってしまった――
MsgEn:
The people of Acre Selund have lost their Dragon,
their towns and villages...

MsgJp:
想像を絶する苦境に立たされ
人々は生きる気力もなくしかけている
MsgEn:
In such unimaginable hardship,
people have almost lost the will to go on.

MsgJp:
しかし、そのような状況の中で
ジリアンという娘は"希望を探している"と
言った――
MsgEn:
Yet, in that situation, a girl named Gillian 
claimed she was "looking for hope"...

MsgJp:
それはいったいなんだ？　人か？　物か？
それとなく探るのだ
MsgEn:
What is it? Is it a person?
Is it a thing? I'll look for it implicitly.

MsgJp:
アッカーシェランの希望が
仮に、一撃で形勢を逆転するほどの
兵器であれば――
MsgEn:
If Acre Selund's hope were a weapon
that could, in a single blow, turn the tide...

MsgJp:
向こうとは距離を置いた方が良いという
判断になるだろう
おまえたちがもたらす情報は重要だぞ
MsgEn:
It would serve us well if you keep your distance
from the other side. Judgements will be made.
The information you bring is valuable, you know.

MsgJp: アッカーシェランは混乱しているんだろう？
MsgEn: Acre Selund is confusing, isn't it?

MsgJp:
ジョゼフ様はあからさまに警戒しているけど
今、交流を深めておくことは
両方の大陸にとって、良いことばかりだと
思うけどね
MsgEn:
Joseph is clearly on guard,
but I believe deepening our ties now
would be beneficial for both continents.

MsgJp:
待ち人が来なければ
こちらから行くしかない
MsgEn:
If the awaited one does not arrive,
then we must go to them ourselves.

MsgJp:
活動の方針を少しばかり変えることにしたから
詳しいことはジリアンから聞いてくれ
MsgEn:
I've decided to change the course
of our activities a bit.
You'll have to get more details from Gillian.

MsgJp:
しっかしアレだな
人が増えたら活気が出そうなもんだが――
MsgEn:
But really, it seems that if there were 
more people, the atmosphere would 
become more lively...

MsgJp:
こりゃ気をつけねえと、こっちの気分まで
どんよりしちまうぜ
MsgEn:
I must be cautious, or else this 
mood will darken my spirits too.

MsgJp: わからないな――

わたしたちは悪しき竜の意志で
ここに来たんだよね？
こっち側にいても、いいのかな？
MsgEn:
We came here by the will
of the Evil Dragon, didn't we?
Is it really alright for us to be on this side?

MsgJp:
方針を変えるなんて話が耳に入って
来ましたけど――
MsgEn:
I heard rumors of a shift in our 
approach, but...

MsgJp:
俺たち、そもそもの方針だって
知りませんよね
MsgEn:
We don't even know what 
our approach is to begin with.

MsgJp: メイロワ将軍のことは聞いた？
MsgEn: Have you heard about General Meirova?

MsgJp:
将軍はわたしたち解放軍の指導者
ちりぢりになっていた仲間たちを集めて
解放軍に仕立てあげた張本人だね
MsgEn:
The General leads our Liberation Army, 
having gathered our scattered comrades
from all over and shaped us
into a force that fights for freedom.

MsgJp:
将軍は、あなたたちが来る前に
用があってここを出て行ったんだけど
約束の日を過ぎても戻らないんだ
MsgEn:
Before you came, the General had to 
leave for an important matter,
yet the promised day has passed,
and they still haven't come back.

MsgJp:
待っているばかりじゃ何もできやしないから
こっちから探しに行こうと思う
MsgEn:
Waiting is not going to get us anywhere,
so I think I'll go look for him ourselves.

MsgJp:
将軍は黒い竜と火竜様の戦いを
間近で目撃した数少ない生き証人
MsgEn:
The General is among the rare
surviving witnesses who saw the clash
between the Black Dragon
and Lord Fire Dragon firsthand.

MsgJp:
一緒に来て欲しい
あなたたちの役に立つ話も
何か聞けるかもしれない
MsgEn:
I would like you to come with me.
I may have some information that
could be useful to you all.

MsgJp: 将軍の、だいたいの居場所はわかっているんだ
MsgEn: I have some idea of where the General is.

MsgJp:
危険な場所だけど――
だからこそ少数精鋭で乗り込みたくてね
MsgEn:
It's a dangerous place...
that's why I wanted to get in with a select few.

MsgJp:
わたしたち、信用されてるみたいだね
うれしくなっちゃうな
MsgEn:
It seems we are being trusted,
which makes me quite happy.

MsgJp: 期待に応えなくちゃね
MsgEn: You've got to live up to the expectations.

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍――
どんな人物でしょうね
MsgEn:
General Meirova—
What kind of person is he?

MsgJp:
ここの人たちはなかなか心を開いて
くれないので、少しでも親しみやすい人だと
いいのですが――
MsgEn:
The folks here are not very open,
so I hope I can come across
as someone more approachable.

MsgJp:
リズたちは喜んでるみてえだが
うまく使われてるだけじゃねえか？
MsgEn:
It seems Lise and the others are happy,
but are they just being used effectively?

MsgJp:
ま、流れに呑み込まれねえように
せいぜい気ぃつけようぜ
MsgEn:
Well, let us be cautious not to 
be swept up in the current.

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍はアッカー家に長く仕える
家臣団の長老のようなお方だ
MsgEn:
General Meirova is like an elder
of the vassals who have served
the Acre family for many years.

MsgJp: わたしの、かつての上官でもある
MsgEn: He is also my former superior officer.

MsgJp:
ピレモス村から来てくれたんだろう？
助けてくれ！
MsgEn:
You came from Piremoth village, right?
Please help me!

MsgJp:
なになに！？
状況が変わった感じ？
MsgEn:
What's happening!? 
Does it seem like the situation 
has shifted?

MsgJp: いま、伝令らしき兵士が来ましたが――
MsgEn:
Right now, a soldier that appears to be 
a messenger has come—

MsgJp:
何があったんでしょうね
悪い報せじゃなければいいんですが
MsgEn:
I wonder what happened.
I hope it's not bad news.

MsgJp:
予期せぬ、厄介ごとが起こった――
そんな空気だなこりゃあ
MsgEn:
It seems an unforeseen hassle
has occurred—it certainly looks that way.

MsgJp:
近くの村が敵に襲われているという
情報が入ったの
MsgEn:
We have received information that a nearby
village is under attack by the enemy.

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍の消息が途絶えたのは
このあたりだけど――
MsgEn:
This is the area where news
of General Meirova stops cold, but...

MsgJp:
まず、村を救おう
将軍は後まわし
MsgEn:
First, let's save the village.
The General will come later.

MsgJp: オークどもが村で暴れている
MsgEn: Orcs are running amok in the village.

MsgJp:
村にいる兵で、外へと抜け出せたのは
俺だけでね――
本当に、恩に着るよ
MsgEn:
Of the soldiers in the village, I'm the 
only one who got away outside― I truly 
thank you.

MsgJp:
将軍が気になるけど仕方ないよね
隊長、ひと暴れ、行こうか
MsgEn:
I'm concerned about the General,
but it can't be helped.
Captain, let's go out and make some noise!

MsgJp:
人捜しの旅気分でいましたけど――
気持ちを入れ替えて、戦いましょう！
MsgEn:
I thought I was on a quest to find someone,
but we'll put that aside and fight!

MsgJp: 人捜しなんてかったるいぜ
MsgEn: I'm tired of looking for people.

MsgJp:
俺は戦ってる方が楽でいいね
目の前の敵のことだけ考えてりゃ
いいからな
MsgEn:
I find it easier to do battle.
I just have to focus on the enemy in front of me.

MsgJp: おお、ジリアン、来てくれたか！
おぬしたち見ない顔だな？
何者であろうが、加勢、感謝するぞ！
MsgEn: Whoever you are, join us, and thank you!

MsgJp: ジリアン、ほれ、後ろだ
いいぞジリアン
どこにいる！？　大将を呼べ！
MsgEn:
Where is he?!
Bring out the General!

MsgJp: 誇りを捨てたオークなど虫けら以下！
MsgEn:
An orc that has abandoned its pride 
is less than even a mere insect!

MsgJp: その武器はどこであつらえた！？
MsgEn: Where did you get that weapon!?

MsgJp: もしや北の地の者たちか！？
MsgEn:
Is it possible they are from the 
northern lands?!

MsgJp: オークどもよ存分に吠えろ！　これが最期だ！
MsgEn:
Orcs, howl to your heart's content! 
This is the end!

MsgJp: 悪しき竜に仕えて何を得た！？　皆無だろう？
MsgEn:
What have you gained by serving a
wicked dragon?! Surely nothing, right?

MsgJp: ジリアン、この者達、何者だ！？
将軍を守って
ジイ、どいて！　退避して！
血気盛んなのはいいけど、自重して
MsgEn:
It's all well and good to get bloodthirsty, 
but don't lose your head.

MsgJp: 将軍がいないと軍がまとまらない！
MsgEn: Without a General, the army cannot be united!

MsgJp: うるさい？　いま、うるさいって言った！？
MsgEn: Huh? Did you just tell me to shut up!?

MsgJp: 将軍、あとは任せて
MsgEn: General, I'll take care of the rest.

MsgJp: 時間をかけると敵が増える！　急いで
MsgEn:
The longer we take, 
the more enemies will come! Hurry!

MsgJp: ジイ！　言うこと聞いて！　聞け！
MsgEn: Old man! Listen to what I say! Listen!

MsgJp: もう、勝手にして！

村人たちはもう連行されたあとだと思う
奴隷の烙印を押されて――
MsgEn:
I think the villagers have already been taken 
away after being branded as slaves...

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍には会えたが
村を救うことはできなかった――か
MsgEn:
We have General Meirova,
but we couldn't save the village in the end...

MsgJp: ケッ――知ったことかよ――なあ？
MsgEn: Hah, I know that well enough.

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍は――なんというか
大変に闊達なお方のようですね
ジョゼフ様とはまた違う人柄のお年寄りだ
MsgEn:
General Meirova is―how shall I put it?
He seems to exude magnanimity.
An elder with a personality that differs
quite a bit from Master Joseph's.

MsgJp:
――お年寄りなんて言ったら
大変なことになりそうですけど
MsgEn:
―Though, calling him an elder
may lead to serious trouble, I fear.

MsgJp:
ねえ、隊長――
わたしたちも一緒にネド王子を探すでしょう？
MsgEn:
Hey, Captain—
We'll look for Prince Nedo together, right?

MsgJp:
なんといっても、ジリアンたちの
希望だもんね！
MsgEn: After all, it's the hope of Gillian and her team!

MsgJp:
おぬしらがこのアッカーシェランで
悪しき竜の意図を探ろうというのであれば
MsgEn:
If you intend to uncover the Evil Dragon's plans
here in Acre Selund, then...

MsgJp:
解放軍は喜んで協力しよう
もちろん、見返りは期待させてもらうぞ
MsgEn:
The Liberation Army will 
gladly cooperate with you.
Of course, we'll expect something in return.

MsgJp:
腕の立つ戦士は
喉から手が出るほどほしいからな
MsgEn:
We seek the skill of brave warriors,
so much so that we cannot hide it.

MsgJp:
解放軍の希望は若干１２歳の王子――
そして王子を守るのは高齢の将軍――
MsgEn:
The hope of the Liberation Army 
lies with a Prince, just 12 years old—
And the prince's protector is an aging general...

MsgJp:
うーん、こんなことを言うと失礼だけど
先行きは、やっぱり不安だね
MsgEn:
Hmm, it might be rude to say this,
but I really feel uncertain about
what lies ahead.

MsgJp: ――なるほど

そのネド王子の存在が絶望的な状況ながらも
解放軍が戦い続ける理由というわけか
MsgEn:
I wonder if Prince Nedo's existence is the reason 
why the Liberation Army continues to fight even 
in such hopeless conditions.

MsgJp:
ふむ、王家の末裔ならば
人々をまとめる旗印としては適任だ
MsgEn:
Hmm, a descendant of a royal family
would be a good banner under
which to unite the people.

MsgJp:
しかも、王子が次代の竜になるという
習わしならばなおさらのこと――
MsgEn:
Even more so if it's the custom here
that the Prince becomes the next Dragon...

MsgJp:
いや待て
ネド王子は覚者なのか？
もし違うのであれば――
MsgEn:
Wait a moment.
Is Prince Nedo an Arisen? 
If that's not the case...

MsgJp: 希望と呼ぶには――なんとも心許ないな
MsgEn:
To call it hope—
It doesn't sit well with me.

MsgJp:
→弱ダンジョン（弱素材）解放
→生産素材解放（１～４）
MsgEn:
→ Weak Dungeon (Weak Materials) unlocked 
→ Production Materials (1-4) unlocked

MsgJp:
ネド王子が覚者ではない場合のことを
あれこれ考えてみたのだが――
MsgEn:
What if Prince Nedo is not an Arisen?
I've thought about it, but—

MsgJp:
それ以前に、安否さえもわからない状況だ
無事を祈らずにはいられんな
MsgEn:
Before that, we don't even know if he's safe.
I can't help but pray for him.

MsgJp:
なにしろ、アッカーシェランの情勢の正常化が
我々の平和にも繋がるわけだ
MsgEn:
Ultimately, solving Acre Selund's predicament
is likely the key to our peace.

MsgJp:
行って、王子の捜索を優先するように
進言してみるのはどうだ？
MsgEn:
Why don't you go and suggest
searching for the Prince to be the top priority?

MsgJp:
王子の無事を祈る気持ちにうそ偽りはないが
まずは安否の情報が欲しいところだ
MsgEn:
Though my prayers for the Prince's safety 
are genuine, what is his actual status?

MsgJp:
わたしにとってはレスタニアの平穏が最優先
この先に起こることは可能な限り早めに
知っておきたいからな

ネド王子の存在がどれほどの希望を
人々にもたらすのか――
それは僕たちにはわからないけど
MsgEn:
It is unclear to us the extent of hope 
Prince Nedo's existence brings to the 
people, yet we sense its significance.

MsgJp: 一番重要なことは――

王子は次の竜になれるのかという
ことだよね
MsgEn: Is whether the Prince can become the next Dragon

MsgJp: メイロワ将軍がさっそく張り切っているよ
MsgEn:
General Meirova is getting into 
the swing of things.

MsgJp:
あなたたちのこと、かなりあてにしているから
将軍のお相手、よろしく
MsgEn:
I have high hopes for you all,
so please take care of the General.

MsgJp: さーて、張り切って、貸しを作ろうぜ
MsgEn:
Alright, let's get fired up and
make some connections!

MsgJp:
俺の見たとろ、あの将軍は
恩義には必ず報いようとする典型だ
MsgEn:
From my observations, that General
is the type who will always repay a favor.

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍、なんだかうれしそう
何があったのかな？
MsgEn:
General Meirova looks to be in a good mood;
I wonder what has happened?

MsgJp:
将軍がああいう人で良かったですよね
ジョゼフ様みたいだったら――
MsgEn:
I'm glad the General is like that.
If he was like Master Joseph—

MsgJp: おっと、これ以上はやめておこう
MsgEn: Oops, let's not go any further.

MsgJp:
解放軍には、特に指令は出ていない
今のところ、将軍は全軍を動かすつもりは
ないらしいな
MsgEn:
There are no special orders
for the Liberation Army; for now,
it seems the General does not intend
to mobilize the entire force.

MsgJp: 戻ったか！

わしのこの破顔を見ればわかるだろうが
ネド王子の居場所がわかったのだ
MsgEn:
I bet you can tell by the grin on my face, 
I've figured out the location of Prince Nedo.

MsgJp:
ほれ、わしらの初対面の村――
あの村の民達がティネス砦に移されたという
情報を掴んだ
MsgEn:
See, the village where we first met—
I've obtained information that the people
of that village have been moved to Fort Thines.

MsgJp:
民達の中には、多くの子供の姿があったらしい
王子はきっとその中に紛れ、潜んでいるはず！
MsgEn:
Among the villagers,
there were many children, it seems.
The prince must be hiding amidst them!

MsgJp:
いやー、気が急いて仕方がないわ
ほれ、ティネス砦へ行くぞ
MsgEn:
I can't help but feel anxious—
let's head to Fort Thines!

MsgJp:
目的地はティネス砦――と言ってもわからんか
地図で確認してくれ
MsgEn:
The destination is Fort Thines— 
though that may not mean much. 
Please refer to the map for clarity.

MsgJp:
あなたたちの戦闘能力をあてにして
作戦を考えてみたんだ
MsgEn:
I've based the strategy on your
combat abilities—what do you think?

MsgJp: 精鋭部隊によるティネス砦強襲作戦――
MsgEn:
An elite force will execute
a surprise assault on Fort Thines—

MsgJp:
防戦一方だったわたしたちが攻勢に転じれば
向こうも混乱するだろうからね
MsgEn:
If we turn from defense to attack, 
they will likely be thrown into disarray.

MsgJp:
ティネス砦へは各自で向かうことになるから
場所は確認しておいてね
MsgEn:
Since everyone will head to Fort Thines
on their own, make sure to check the location.

MsgJp:
ティネス砦は、オークに奪われた
砦らしいな
MsgEn: I heard that Fort Thines was taken by orcs.

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍め、何も言わないが
砦の奪回も狙ってるはずだ
MsgEn:
Though General Meirova says nothing, 
he must also be aiming to reclaim the fort.

MsgJp: 王子って、１２歳なんでしょ？
MsgEn: The prince is 12 years old, right?

MsgJp:
どんな感じなのかな――
王子なんて、物語の中にしか
いないと思ってたよ
MsgEn:
I wonder what it's like—
I thought princes were only in stories.

MsgJp:
聞いた話ですけどね――
ネド王子は、素直で聡明な少年だということです
MsgEn:
Rumor has it that Prince Nedo
is an honest and intelligent young lad.

MsgJp:
素直で聡明――
本当でしょうかね
MsgEn:
Honest and intelligent—
Is it true?

MsgJp:
ティネス砦に王子がいると
決まったわけではない
MsgEn:
There's no guarantee that the Prince
is at Fort Thines.

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍が、そう推測しているだけ――
ということを忘れずに
MsgEn:
Remember that General Meirova
is only speculating that...

MsgJp:
砦の前に並んでる大砲が見える？
あれで撃たれたらこちらはひとたまりもないの
MsgEn:
Do you see the cannons lined up 
before the fortress? If they fire at us, 
we won't stand a chance.

MsgJp:
あれをね、使い物にならなくしてほしいんだ
いい？　なるべく全部――
MsgEn:
Render that thing useless, okay? 
As much as you can...

MsgJp:
とにかく、こっちが砦までたどり着けるくらいの
時間を稼いでほしいの
MsgEn:
Anyway, I need you to buy us enough
time to get to the fort.

MsgJp:
そっちの様子を見て、わたしたちも
突入するから、よろしく
MsgEn:
As we assess your situation,
we'll also move in, so take care of it for us.

MsgJp:
あと、偵察隊からの話しによると
砦の中には前回同様、戦甲で身を固めた
巨大な魔物がいるみたい
MsgEn:
Also, the scouting team told me that
there is a huge demon inside the fortress
that is clad in battle armor, just like last time!

MsgJp:
上手く戦甲をみんなで破壊しないと倒せないから
遭遇したら注意してね
MsgEn:
If we don't collectively destroy
the armored enemies, we cannot win. 
So be cautious if we meet them.

MsgJp: じゃあ、はじめよう

クインタスたちと手分けして
この砦に捕らわれた同志たちを見つけ出し
解放するのがわしの役目だ
MsgEn:
My task is to collaborate with Quintus 
and the others to locate and liberate 
our comrades trapped this fortress.

MsgJp:
仲間の救出は任せてくれ
あんたはひたすらに敵を蹴散らしてくれればいい
MsgEn:
Leave it up to me to rescue my comrades.
You should just scatter your enemies.

MsgJp:
ジリジリジリジリ、気分が
盛りあがってきたじゃねえか――なあ？
MsgEn:
The tension is building up, isn't it?
I can feel it rising—what do you think?

MsgJp: ネド王子、待っていて！
さあ、心おきなく暴れてやりましょう！
MsgEn: Now, let's go on a rampage without worrying!

MsgJp:
ここ、ティネス砦はな――
オークどもとの幾度とない激戦に耐え抜いた要衝だ
MsgEn:
This place, Fort Thines, has withstood 
many fierce battles against the orcs.

MsgJp: もう二度と手放してなるものか
MsgEn: I'll never give it up again.

MsgJp:
落胆？
そんなことはないぞ

王子への道は途絶えていないし
こうして砦を取り戻したんだからな
MsgEn:
The road to the Prince hasn't been severed,
and we've reclaimed the fort.

MsgJp:
王子はいなかったが、行方に関する情報が
入ったのは久しぶりだ
MsgEn:
Though the prince wasn't found,
it's been a while since we heard anything
about his whereabouts.

MsgJp:
砦も取り戻すことができたし――
ああ、追い風を感じるな
MsgEn:
We managed to regain the fort— 
Ah, I feel a surge of momentum.

MsgJp:
"契りの歌"は――
竜がもたらす有形無形の恵に感謝し
王家と竜の契りが未来永劫続くことを祈る歌なの
MsgEn:
The "Song of Covenant" is— 
a hymn of gratitude for the gifts,
both seen and unseen, that dragons bestow,
praying for the royal family's bond with dragons 
to last forevermore.

MsgJp:
くたびれ損ってやつだな
まあ、一回、二回は覚悟の上よ
MsgEn:
What a pointless endeavor. 
Still, I'm prepared for it once
or twice, no matter what.

MsgJp:
俺はちょっと砦見て回ってから
休ませてもらうわ
MsgEn:
I'm gonna take a little look around the fort
and then I'll take a break.

MsgJp:
竜に感謝する歌なんて、素敵だなあ
レスタニアにもあればいいのに
MsgEn:
Songs to thank dragons are wonderful.
I wish Lestania had them too.

MsgJp: わたし、毎日歌っちゃうと思う
MsgEn: I think I'd sing it every day.

MsgJp: ふう――

ここは身体を休めて次に備えましょう
王子と会うときは笑顔でいたいですからね
MsgEn:
Let's take a moment to rest our bodies
and prepare for what lies ahead.
I want to greet the prince with a smile
when we eventually meet.

MsgJp: ネド王子はどうだった？

そうか――まだ会えていないんだね
でも、望みは繋がっているんだろう？
MsgEn:
I see—so you still haven't met,
have you? But the hope remains,
doesn't it?

MsgJp:
アッカーシェランの人たちがそう信じているなら
大丈夫なんだろうね
MsgEn:
If the people of Acre Selund believe that,
then it should be fine, right?

MsgJp: そうか――

砦を奪回しただけではなくネド王子の手がかりまで
手に入れるとは上出来
MsgEn:
Reclaiming the fortress is one thing, 
but also a lead on Prince Nedo to boot.

MsgJp:
しかも、メイロワ将軍は、おまえたちのおかげで
運が巡ってきたと考えているのだな？
MsgEn:
Furthermore, General Meirova thinks
that luck has turned in his favor thanks to you.

MsgJp:
いいぞ
良い関係を築けそうではないか
MsgEn:
That's great! 
It looks like we can foster a good bond.

MsgJp: →時間経過スポット①（弱研磨剤？）解放
MsgEn: → Time Passage Spot ① (Weak Abrasive?) Unlocked

MsgJp:
歳を取ると、良いことばかりを
思い続けることが難しくなるのだ
MsgEn:
As you grow older, it becomes difficult 
to focus solely on the positives.

MsgJp:
特に、良い流れに乗っているように
見える時ほどな
MsgEn:
Especially when it seems like one is
riding a good wave, that's when it
happens.

MsgJp:
もし、ネド王子が行方不明のままだったら――
もし覚者ではなかったら――
そして、悪しき竜の目的――
MsgEn:
If Prince Nedo remains missing—
if he is not the Arisen—
and the purpose of the Evil Dragon...

MsgJp:
これらが最悪の形で結びついてしまう――
そんなことを考えてしまうのだ
MsgEn:
These might link in the worst manner— 
it's something I find myself considering.

MsgJp:
さあ、行け
ここにいると、わたしの不安がうつるぞ
MsgEn:
Now, go.
You're going to catch my anxiety if you stay here.

MsgJp:
ネド王子は盗賊と行動をともにしているという
話だったな
MsgEn:
There were stories that Prince Nedo is 
moving with a band of thieves, right?

MsgJp:
子供の頃に読んだ冒険譚のような状況だが
盗賊といっても色々いるからな――
MsgEn:
It's a situation like an adventure tale I
read as a child, but there are many kinds
of thieves, after all...

MsgJp:
ネド王子のことはもちろん気になるけど
砦を奪われた敵の反撃もあるだろうね
MsgEn:
While I'm worried about Prince Nedo, 
there's bound to be a counterattack by 
the foes we seized the fort from.

MsgJp: そのことは忘れないようにね

将軍がソワソワしてるぜ
かわいい王子との再会が近いってな
MsgEn:
The General is getting all weepy,
saying that a reunion with 
his adorable Prince is approaching.

MsgJp:
さっさと会わせてやらねえと、あの爺さん
倒れちまうぞ
MsgEn:
If we don't get them together soon, 
that old man will collapse.

MsgJp:
ネド王子と一緒にいる盗賊って
わたしが想像する盗賊と違うみたい
ゴブリンを思い浮かべちゃった
MsgEn:
The thieves with Prince Nedo
were different from the ones I imagined.
I pictured something akin to goblins.

MsgJp:
ジリアンとメイロワ将軍が言い争っていましたけど
大丈夫でしょうか
MsgEn:
Gillian and General Meirova were 
quarreling. I hope they're all right.

MsgJp:
今回はジリアンが正しい
わたしはそう思うね
MsgEn:
Gillian is right this time.
I agree.

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍が前に出ると
まとまる話もまとまらないよ
MsgEn:
When General Meirova takes the lead, 
even discussions that should be 
settled become disordered.

MsgJp:
おぬしたち、早速西へ向かおうではないか
実はな、ジリアンがすでに出発してしまったのだ
MsgEn:
You guys, let's head west as soon as possible.
In fact, Gillian has already left.

MsgJp:
国の治安を守るわしと盗賊どもの因縁を思うと
わしではなくジリアンが前に出て交渉した方がいい
――そういう意見が多くてな
MsgEn:
Reflecting on the connection between me,
the protector of the realm, and those thieves,
many believe it would be better for Gillian
to step forward and negotiate instead of me.

MsgJp:
おぬしたちを交えて検討しようと話し合って
いたのだが――ジリアンめ！
MsgEn:
We were having discussions to include 
you in our deliberations, but—Gillian!

MsgJp:
ともあれ、盗賊の地へ行くには、まず、敵の支配下の
西門を超えて西方へ行く必要がある
MsgEn:
That aside, to enter the thieves' territory,
we must first overcome the western gate
under enemy control and proceed west.

MsgJp:
西門を抜けた先に、城壁の村、ロスギルがある
わしの盟友がおる土地だ
きっと力になってくれるだろう
MsgEn:
Past the western gate, there is the 
walled village of Rothgill,
a place where my ally dwells.
They will surely be of help to us.

MsgJp: 西門周辺はオークの領土となってしまっておる
MsgEn:
The area around the West Gate
has become orc territory.

MsgJp:
そう簡単には通り抜けられないだろうから
準備の方、よろしく頼むぞ
MsgEn:
It won't be easy to pass through,
so I ask that you prepare well.

MsgJp: 王子に会うのはそう簡単じゃねえってことらしいな
MsgEn: It seems like it's not that easy to meet a Prince.

MsgJp:
ジリアン、大丈夫かなあ
結構危なっかしいよね
MsgEn:
I wonder if Gillian is okay;
things seem quite dangerous.

MsgJp: さあ隊長、俺たちも早めに行きましょう
MsgEn:
Come on, Captain. 
Let's go as soon as possible.

MsgJp:
わたしは砦に残るが――
将軍たちをよろしく頼むぞ
MsgEn:
I'll stay at the fort—
and take care of the General.

MsgJp:
道中に攻め落とした西門は
応援の解放軍が完全に制圧した
MsgEn:
The Western Gate we seized on the way
has been completely secured by the
Liberation Army reinforcements.

MsgJp:
おぬしたちは魔物の巣窟とやらへ行って
魔物退治を頼む
MsgEn:
You lot will venture into the lair
of the monsters and deal with
slaying them for me.

MsgJp:
一歩一歩、悪しき竜の勢力を
取り除こうではないか！
MsgEn:
Step by step, let us eliminate the
forces of the Evil Dragon!

MsgJp: それにしてもイェルハルドめ――

昔はわしの部下だったが、その頃から
面倒くさい奴だったわ
MsgEn:
He used to be my subordinate back in the day, 
but even then he was a pain in the ass.

MsgJp: 魔物退治は得意中の得意
MsgEn: Slaying monsters is one of my specialties.

MsgJp:
俺たちにとっちゃあ悪くねえ話だぜ？
さっさと片付けようぜ
MsgEn:
It's not a bad deal for us, right?
Let's get it done.

MsgJp:
魔物の巣窟って！？
はー、もしかして、あっちの水辺あたりから漂う
嫌な気配のこと？
MsgEn:
A monster's den!?
Is it that unsettling presence
drifting from the water's edge over there?

MsgJp:
イェルハルドはメイロワ将軍の部下から
転身して、ここの領主に収まったのだとか
MsgEn:
It seems that Gerhard went from being a 
subordinate of General Meirova, 
to the lord of this place.

MsgJp:
将軍の言い分もわかりますけど
領主なら、あれくらい慎重な方がいいかも
しれませんね
MsgEn:
I understand the general's point,
but for a lord, being that cautious
might be for the best, don't you think?

MsgJp:
ごくろうだったな
イェルハルドとの交渉はわしにまかせてくれ
MsgEn:
Good job. 
I'll handle the talks 
with Gerhard myself.

MsgJp: ふう――

俺は休んでるから、あとは適当に
話つけてくれ
MsgEn:
I'm taking a break, so just
wrap up the talk as
you see fit.

MsgJp: 王子の居場所って、ハッキリわかるのかな？
MsgEn: Do you have a clear idea of where the Prince is?

MsgJp:
なんとなく、メイロワ将軍の思い込みに
みんなで引きずられている気がしない？
MsgEn:
Doesn't it feel like we're all
being dragged along by 
General Meirova's assumptions?

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍は人をその気にさせるのが
上手ですけど、イェルハルドには
効かないみたいですね
MsgEn:
General Meirova is skilled at
motivating people, but it seems
it doesn't work on Gerhard.

MsgJp:
ようこそメイロワ将軍と
レスタニアから来た覚者のみなさん
MsgEn:
Welcome, General Meirova
and all the Arisen who 
have come from Lestania.

MsgJp:
色々と聞きたいこともあるでしょうが
まずはわたしから最新の情報です
MsgEn:
There are probably a lot of things you want to 
hear, but I'll start with the latest information.

MsgJp:
――王都メガドに続き、竜の神殿である
メガド離宮もついに堕ちたとのこと
MsgEn:
—Following the Royal Capital, Megado,
it is said that the Dragon's Temple,
the Megado Detached Palace, has finally fallen.

MsgJp:
執拗な包囲戦に長く耐えていましたが
敵方に強力な援軍が加わり
守備隊はあっという間に総崩れ――
MsgEn:
After enduring a relentless siege for so long, 
the defenders were quickly overwhelmed 
as powerful reinforcements joined the enemy.

MsgJp: これまで以上に厳しい状況になったようです
MsgEn:
It seems that the situation has become 
more difficult than ever.

MsgJp:
さて、将軍――みなさん――
わたしから言えることはただひとつ
MsgEn:
Well, General—everyone—
I can only say one thing.

MsgJp:
アッカーシェランの未来――ネド王子との再会を
本気で願っているのであれば
まず、メイロワ将軍が盗賊たちに頭を下げて
過去の仕打ちを詫びることですね
MsgEn:
The future of Acre Selund—
If you really hope for a reunion with 
Prince Nedo, the first thing to do is for 
General Meirova to bow before the bandits
and apologize for their past treatment.

MsgJp:
もちろん、将軍にしてみれば盗賊の処罰は
職務を忠実に遂行しただけのことでしょう
しかし、盗賊たちがそれで納得すると思いますか？
MsgEn:
Of course, for the general, punishing thieves
is simply a matter of faithfully carrying out
his duties. But do you think the bandits will
be satisfied with that?

MsgJp:
彼らの協力が不可欠だというのなら
メイロワ将軍――まずは真摯に頭を下げるのです
MsgEn:
If their cooperation is essential, then
General Meirova— first, you must sincerely
bow your head.

MsgJp:
王子と一緒にいる盗賊の名はベルタ
そうです、あのベルタです
ほら、将軍、そんな顔はいけません
MsgEn:
The bandit who is with the Prince
is called Bertha. That's right,
that very same Bertha. 
Now, General, don't make such a face.

MsgJp:
ふたりの確執はもちろん知っています
だからこそ頭を下げることには価値があるとは
思いませんか？
MsgEn:
I'm well aware of the feud between you two. 
And that's why bowing your head is worth it, 
don't you think?

MsgJp:
王都メガドの牢獄に囚われていたはずのベルタは
敵襲の混乱の中、脱獄してしまったとのこと
MsgEn:
Bertha was supposed to be imprisoned
in the dungeons of Megado, but she escaped
during the confusion of the attack.

MsgJp:
その後の行方は知れないが、神殿で目撃された
老婆がベルタだと考えることは理にかなっています
MsgEn:
Though her whereabouts remain unknown,
it makes sense to think that the old woman
spotted at the temple is Bertha herself.

MsgJp: ふーむ
王子と一緒にいるのはあの老盗賊ベルタか
MsgEn: That old rogue Bertha with the Prince, huh?

MsgJp:
あの婆さんに頭を下げろだと？
うーむ――
MsgEn:
You want me to bow to that crone? 
Hmph...

MsgJp:
盗賊のアジトはここよりさらに西方というだけで
具体的な場所はわかっておらん
MsgEn:
It's just that the bandits' hideout 
is further west than here.
I don't know the specific location.

MsgJp:
いずれにしても、場所の調査には時間がかかるだろう
わしはそれまでに心を決めねばな
MsgEn:
In any case, it will take some time 
to investigate the location.
I'll have to make up my mind by then.

MsgJp:
盗賊たちは一族郎党が集まって住んでいるらしい
いったん揉めたら大ごとだ
一度レスタニアに戻っておくか？
MsgEn:
The bandits appear to live with their family. 
If trouble starts, it'll be serious. 
Should we return to Lestania for now?

MsgJp:
ねえ隊長――
敵に新たな援軍があったってイェルハルドは
言ってたよね？
MsgEn:
Hey Captain—
Gerhard said that the enemy
had new reinforcements, right?

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍とベルタとかいう盗賊のあいだに
どんな因縁があるのか――
MsgEn:
What kind of ties are there between 
General Meirova and the thief Bertha?

MsgJp:
全然わかりませんけど、とりあえず将軍が
頭を下げないと物事が動かないようですね
MsgEn:
I have no idea, but it seems that unless
the General bows, nothing will move forward.

MsgJp:
ジョゼフ様はネド王子への贈り物を
考えているようだけど――
MsgEn:
Master Joseph seems to be thinking of
a gift for Prince Nedo...

MsgJp:
完全に無事が確認されてから――
あるいは生きていることを確認してからじゃないと
ネド王子に関してうかつなことは言えないね
MsgEn:
I can't say anything careless about Prince Nedo 
until we're completely sure he's okay—
or even alive.

MsgJp:
そうか――ネド王子はまだおらんか
しかし、そのイェルハルドなる者の情報は
信ぴょう性が高そうだな
MsgEn:
I see... Prince Nedo is still absent.
However, the information from that
Gerhard seems quite credible.

MsgJp:
そして気になるのは、メガド離宮が
援軍の登場で堕ちてしまったということ――
MsgEn:
And what's worrisome is that the 
Megado Detached Palace has fallen
with the arrival of reinforcements...

MsgJp:
レスタニアで言えば、この神殿が
敵の手に落ちたのと同じ
MsgEn:
In the context of Lestania,
it's like the Temple falling into enemy hands.

MsgJp: アッカーシェランの嘆きが聞こえるようだぞ
MsgEn: You can almost hear Acre Selund lamenting.

MsgJp:
さて――
ネド王子はベルタという老盗賊と
行動をともにしており――
MsgEn:
Well then— 
Prince Nedo is traveling with the 
old thief named Bertha...

MsgJp:
目下、かの地では、盗賊のアジト探しが
行われているのであろう
MsgEn:
As of now, they must be searching 
for the bandits' hideout in that area.

MsgJp:
ネド王子と早く会えると良いな
友好的な関係を築ける相手であることを祈ろう
MsgEn:
I hope you and Prince Nedo meet soon.
Let's hope it's someone with whom you can build 
an amicable relationship.

MsgJp: ここだけの話――

よその大陸の王子は凡庸であるほど
ありがたい
そうは思わんか
MsgEn:
The more ordinary the Prince
of another continent is, the more
reverence and appreciation he gets.
Don't you think so?

MsgJp: フィンダムの時もそうだったけど――
MsgEn: It was the same with Phindym's...

MsgJp:
よその大陸と交わると、ジョゼフ様はすぐに
どっちが上か――なんてことを考える
時々、いやになるんだ
MsgEn:
Whenever we cross with another continent, 
Master Joseph is quick to wonder 
which is the better continent.
That's what I don't like sometimes.

MsgJp:
将軍はもういねえぞ？
誰かと話して状況の確認といこうぜ
MsgEn:
The General's gone, okay?
Let's go talk to someone 
and see what's going on.

MsgJp:
交渉の主役はジリアンですよね？
今頃は敵陣にいて、熱弁を振るって
いるのかもしれませんよ
MsgEn:
Gillian is the star of the negotiations, right?
She's probably behind enemy lines by now, 
making impassioned speeches.

MsgJp:
あー、心配――
何もかもが心配！
MsgEn:
Oh, I'm worried—
Worried about everything!

MsgJp: わたしたちも早く動こうよ！

あんたが来たら状況を報告するようにと
将軍から仰せつかっている
MsgEn:
The General has asked me to inform you 
of the situation when you arrive.

MsgJp:
我々は盗賊のアジトに関する情報を集めるために
奔走した
MsgEn:
We worked hard to gather information 
about the bandit hideout.

MsgJp:
その結果、盗賊のアジトは、西の湖の畔にある
洞窟の一画にあることが分かった
MsgEn:
As a result, the bandits' hideout
was found to be in one of the caves
on the shores of the western lake.

MsgJp:
すでに洞窟に向かっているメイロワ将軍と合流して
一緒に事に当たってくれ
MsgEn:
Join up with General Meirova, 
who is already on his way to the cave, 
and work together on this.

MsgJp: ベルタのことは聞いているか？

メイロワ将軍とは同世代の古強者で――
狙いはいつも王家の財宝だった
MsgEn:
She and General Meirova have history
as old, powerful contemporaries.
She was always after the royal treasures.

MsgJp:
奪い、取り戻し、将軍とは因縁の仲
王家の財宝だの盗賊だの、今の状況を考えれば
古き良き時代の物語だがな
MsgEn:
The taking, the getting it back,
the General and the Foe, the royal treasure, 
the banditry, it's a tale of the good old days, 
considering the current state of affairs.

MsgJp:
行かねえのか？
西にある湖の湖畔だとよ
MsgEn:
Aren't you going?
They say it's on the shores of a lake to the west.

MsgJp:
急ぎましょう
将軍と盗賊ベルタの話を聞けば聞くほど
問題発生の予感しかしませんよ
MsgEn:
Let's hurry up.
The more I listen to the story of the General
and Bertha the Bandit, the more I have a hunch
that a problem will occur.

MsgJp:
王子は盗賊たちの人質にされたという
考えもあるみたいだよ
MsgEn:
Some people think the Prince
is held hostage by the bandits.

MsgJp: ネド王子はダクレイム砦か――
MsgEn: Prince Nedo is at Dacreim Fortress...

MsgJp:
ダクレイムもまたオークに奪われた砦よ
そんなところへ王子がなぜ――
MsgEn:
Dacreim is another fort lost to the orcs.
So why would a Prince come to such a place...

MsgJp:
盗賊との因縁が深い将軍よりも
わたしの方が、相手も交渉しやすい――
そう思っていたのに――ああ、やっちゃった
MsgEn:
I thought I would be easier for them
to negotiate with than the General, 
who has a long history with bandits.
I thought that was the case, but—ah, 
I've gone and done it!

MsgJp:
盗賊は生業だって開き直られたら
腹が立っちゃってね
MsgEn:
When a thief claims it's their livelihood,
it really makes me angry, you know?

MsgJp:
予想はしていたが、解放軍と盗賊団は
友好的な雰囲気とはいえねえ
MsgEn:
As expected, the Liberation Army and the bandits
don't exactly have a friendly atmosphere.

MsgJp:
出来ることなら、さっさとここから
立ち去りてえがな
MsgEn: If I could, I'd get the hell out of here.

MsgJp:
少々揉めましたけど
王子の居場所がはっきりしたのは
大きな収穫ですね
MsgEn:
It's been a bit of a struggle, 
but it's a huge victory for us
to know exactly where the Prince is.

MsgJp: ネド王子は何を考えているのかな――
MsgEn: I wonder what Prince Nedo is thinking...

MsgJp:
盗賊に連れ去られたというわけじゃあ
ないみたいだし
MsgEn: It seems he didn't get abducted by the bandits.

MsgJp: おまえたちが噂の異国の覚者たちか――
MsgEn:
You are the exotic Arisen 
we've heard so much about...

MsgJp:
王都メガドにある、メガド離宮が堕ちたのは
知っているだろう？
MsgEn:
You know that the Megado Detached Palace
in Megado, the Royal Capital, has fallen, right?

MsgJp:
メガド離宮の牢に捕えられていたお頭は
陥落寸前に神殿守護兵から王子を連れて
逃げるよう託されたんだ
MsgEn:
The Boss was held captive in the prison
of Megado's Detached Palace, 
and just before it fell, the temple guard 
entrusted her with escaping with the Prince.

MsgJp:
敵で埋め尽くされた辺境を切り抜け
この近くまで来たのだが、あと少しというところで
オークどもに見つかってしまった
MsgEn:
They cut through the enemy-infested frontier
to get this close, but just as they were about to leave...
Orcs found them.

MsgJp:
その時、お頭は王子を逃がして
自分は捕まっちまった
MsgEn:
At that time, the Boss let the Prince
escape while she herself was caught.

MsgJp:
俺たちはオークからもかっぱらっていたからな
奴らの法に従えば、処刑は確実だ
MsgEn:
We've been ripping off the orcs too.
If we follow their laws, execution is a certainty.

MsgJp:
俺たちはなんとしてもお頭を助けたい
おまえたちの力を貸してくれ
MsgEn:
We want to save the Boss any way we can. 
We need your help.

MsgJp:
ここからも腕の立つ連中が行っているが
相手はオークだからな
MsgEn:
There are some very skilled people here too, 
but they're up against orcs.

MsgJp:
俺たち盗賊には荷が重い
どうか、力を貸してくれ
MsgEn:
We bandits can't handle it. 
Please, we need your help.

MsgJp: これは難儀なことだ――

ダクレイム砦攻略は大変だぞ――
じっくり作戦を練らねば――
MsgEn:
We're going to have a tough time
capturing Dacreim Fortress.
We'll have to plan carefully...

MsgJp: おぬしら、一度国に帰ってはどうだ
MsgEn: Why don't you go back home for a time?

MsgJp: ダクレイムは難攻不落と名高い要衝
MsgEn:
Dacreim is long renowned
as an impregnable stronghold.

MsgJp:
潜入はそう簡単ではない
ここは思案のしどころだ
今少し、考える時間をもらおう
MsgEn:
Infiltration is not so simple.
This is a moment for deliberation.
Let us take a bit of time to think.

MsgJp:
いまだにネド王子と会えずにいるのは
巡り合わせが悪いとしか言いようがない
MsgEn:
Not having met Prince Nedo yet 
can only be described as bad luck.

MsgJp:
でも、これが運命とあきらめるわけにはいかない
王子が、最後の希望なんだから
もう、それしかないんだ
MsgEn:
However, I cannot simply give up
and accept this as fate,
for the Prince is our last hope.
There is nothing else.

MsgJp: 俺たちにとっちゃお頭の命が最優先
MsgEn: For us, the life of the Boss is our top priority.

MsgJp:
もちろんネド王子のことも忘れちゃいない
何かあったら、寝覚めが悪いからな
MsgEn:
Of course, I haven't forgotten about Prince Nedo. 
If anything happens to him, 
I won't be able to sleep at night.

MsgJp: 盗賊と手を組むことになるとはな
MsgEn: I never thought I'd join forces with bandits.

MsgJp:
ったく、何が起こるかわかんねえな
まあ、そこが人生の面白いところだけどよ
MsgEn:
You never know what's going to happen. 
Well, that's the interesting thing about life.

MsgJp:
王子の安否は気になりますけど
どうやらすぐには動きはないようです
MsgEn:
I am concerned about the Prince's safety,
but it seems there won't be any movement
for a while.

MsgJp: ここらでレスタニアに戻りましょう
MsgEn: Let's go back to Lestania at this point.

MsgJp:
なかなかお会いできないなあ
さすが王子だね
MsgEn:
It seems we cannot meet easily,
as expected of a Prince.

MsgJp: やあ、おかえり

アッカーシェランの方は小休止かい？
ゆっくり休むといいよ
MsgEn:
Is there a break at Acre Selund? 
Make sure to take your time to rest.

MsgJp: ついにネド王子の居場所がわかったのだな！
MsgEn: At last you know where Prince Nedo is!

MsgJp: しかし、敵の支配下の砦にいるとは――
MsgEn: But to be in a fortress under enemy control...

MsgJp:
事はそう簡単ではないだろうから
くれぐれも慎重にな
MsgEn:
It's not going to be easy.
So, be very careful.

MsgJp: →準最ダンジョン（準最素材）解放

順当に行けばアッカーシェランでは
ネド王子のベルタ救出作戦が始まることだろう
MsgEn:
If all goes as planned, in Acre Selund, 
the mission to save Prince Nedo
and Bertha is set to begin.

MsgJp:
存分に力を発揮して
白竜の覚者の力を見せつけてこい
味方で良かったと思わせるのだ
MsgEn:
Show them the power
of The White Dragons' Arisen to the fullest,
and make them glad they are on our side.

MsgJp: ネド王子はまだまだ子供だが――
MsgEn: Prince Nedo is still just a boy, but...

MsgJp:
話を聞く限り、義理堅く
人情にも篤い人物のようだ
MsgEn:
From what I've heard, he seems to be a man
of sound principle and of compassion.

MsgJp:
わかるな？
なんとかして、貸しを作ってくるのだ
MsgEn:
You understand? 
Find a way to create a debt of gratitude.

MsgJp:
いかにしてアッカーシェランの王家に
恩を売るか――
MsgEn:
How to earn the favor of Acre Selund's
Royal Family...

MsgJp:
ジョゼフ様は近頃そんなことばかり
考えているみたいなんだ
MsgEn:
Master Joseph seems to be thinking about 
that a lot these days.

MsgJp:
わたしの子供じみた振る舞いは忘れて欲しい
将軍にもたっぷり説教されたからね
MsgEn:
Forget my childish behavior,
the General already gave me 
quite a scolding for it.

MsgJp:
さて、ネド王子の行き先はダクレイム砦
でも、その前に、ロスギル村へ行ってほしいんだ
MsgEn:
Now, the destination for Prince Nedo
is Fort Dacreim. But first, 
I want you to go to the village of Rothgill.

MsgJp:
ダクレイム突入準備のために、イェルハルドを訪ねた
メイロワ将軍からの連絡が来ない
MsgEn:
I visited Gerhard to prepare for the Dacreim raid.
No word from General Meirova.

MsgJp:
行って、状況を確認して、必要であれば
将軍の力になってほしい
MsgEn:
Go, see what's going on, 
and if necessary, help the General.

MsgJp: わたしはここで連絡を待つよ
MsgEn: I'll wait to hear from you here.

MsgJp: ネド王子は――そうだね

年の割にはしっかりした子供だ
物事の道理をわきまえ、おごることなく
民たちにも平等に接してくれる――
MsgEn:
He's a strong kid for his age,
has a good mind for reason, doesn't get cocky, 
treats his people as equals...

MsgJp:
頼りないという声もあるけど
そこはわたしたちが補えばいい
MsgEn:
Some say he's unreliable, 
but we can make up for that.

MsgJp:
王子は幼い頃、わしのことをメロジイ、メロジイと
慕ってくださってな――
ほどなく会えるのかと思うとわしはもう――
MsgEn:
In his childhood, the Prince used to call me 
Uncle Meimei, Uncle Meimei, with such fondness— 
Just the thought of seeing him soon 
fills me with emotion...

MsgJp: さあ、頼むぞ、白竜の覚者たちよ
MsgEn: Now, please, Arisen of the White Dragon.

MsgJp:
どうやら、この大陸じゃあ、盗賊どもも
けっこう大きな勢力らしいな
MsgEn:
Apparently, bandits are quite a force
to be reckoned with on this continent.

MsgJp:
となれば、両方に恩を売っておくのは
悪くねえぞ
MsgEn:
If so, it's not a bad idea
to do them both a favor.

MsgJp:
ここの連中、少々気風が荒いようだけど
悪人ではなさそうですよね
MsgEn:
These people here, they're a little feisty,
but they don't seem to be bad people.

MsgJp:
職業には目をつぶる必要がありますけど
戦力として期待してもいいんじゃないですかね
MsgEn:
We might need to turn a blind eye
to their chosen profession,
but I think they can be relied upon 
as a strong ally in battle, don't you agree?

MsgJp:
こんなことを気にしているのは
わたしだけかもしれないけど――
MsgEn:
I know I'm probably the only one who 
cares about this stuff...

MsgJp: ネド王子、結構美形なんだって！
MsgEn: Prince Nedo, I hear, is quite handsome!

MsgJp:
アッカーシェランは遠からず
悪しき竜に踏みにじられて滅んでしまう
この運命はもう変えられないのだろう
MsgEn:
Acre Selund will soon be trampled
by the Evil Dragon and fall to ruin.
I doubt this fate can be changed now.

MsgJp:
だから最後の日々くらいは善人になろうとして
お頭は、王子を助けたんだろうよ
その王子が今度はお頭を助けようと
しているってわけだ
MsgEn:
So for the final days at least, 
she was trying to be a virtuous person.
The Boss must have saved the Prince.
Now, he is trying to help the Boss in return.

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍はネド王子が希望だというが――
俺たちに必要なのは希望じゃなくて
奇跡じゃねえのか？
MsgEn:
General Meirova says Prince Nedo is our hope— 
but isn't what we need not hope, but a miracle?

MsgJp: メイロワ将軍の様子？

ああ、ジリアンが心配したわけですね
将軍ならほら、そこに
MsgEn:
Oh, so Gillian was worried. 
If you want the General, he's over there.

MsgJp:
おお、来てくれたのか
思いのほか時間をくってしまったが
突撃の手はずは整ったぞ
MsgEn:
Well, you're here. 
We took longer than expected, 
but we're ready to launch the assault.

MsgJp:
ダクレイム砦の前には、敵が増築した
柵があってな――その柵を解放する下準備に
少々手間取ったというわけだ
もう、問題はない
MsgEn:
Before the Dacreim Fortress,
there is a fence that the enemy has reinforced.
The preparations to dismantle that fence
took some time, but there are no more issues.

MsgJp:
突撃を妨げる柵のことはもう気にしなくてもいい
王子のことだけ考えよう
MsgEn:
We don't have to worry about the fence
blocking the assault anymore, 
we just have to mind the Prince.

MsgJp:
まもなく伝令に走るはずだったんだ
来てくれて助かったよ
MsgEn:
I was going to make a run to the messenger soon.
Thank goodness you're here.

MsgJp:
ダクレイム砦は久しぶりだ
もう二度と行くことはないと思っていたが――
先のことなどわからないものだな
MsgEn:
It's been a long time
since I've been to Dacreim Fortress,
and I thought I'd never go back-
you never know what the future holds.

MsgJp: ひとつ忠告をさせて下さい
MsgEn: Let me give you one piece of advice.

MsgJp:
このダクレイムを奪い、支配しているのは
獣の将と呼ばれるオークです
これまでのオークとはまるで違う化け物です
MsgEn:
The one who has seized and now rules
Dacreim is the orc known as the Beast Commander. 
This is a monster unlike any orc
we have encountered before.

MsgJp:
ですが、砦の中ではすでに
ネド王子と盗賊たちが動いているとのことです
MsgEn:
But inside the fortress, it seems that 
Prince Nedo and the bandits are already 
taking action.

MsgJp:
今や一刻を争います
ジリアンとイェルハルド様には伝令を
走らせました――
MsgEn:
Now, in a race for time, 
I've sent word to Gillian and Master Gerhard to...

MsgJp:
みなさんはどうか急ぎ砦の中へ
王子をよろしくお願いします！
MsgEn:
Everyone, storm the fortress
and find the Prince!

MsgJp:
ジリアンは一緒じゃないのか？
解放軍本隊は！？
MsgEn:
Gillian is not with you?
What has happened to the main force
of the Liberation Army!?

MsgJp:
わたしは早々に負傷してしまいました
無念です――王子をよろしくお願いします――
MsgEn:
I was injured early on. I'm sorry—
Please take care of the Prince...

MsgJp: 忠義面下げて死にに来たか
MsgEn:
Have you come to throw away your life 
in the name of loyalty?

MsgJp: いいだろう――王子と一緒に死ね
MsgEn:
Fine—
Die along with your Prince.

MsgJp: もろとも魔物に喰われてしまえ
MsgEn:
May you be devoured by the monsters
alongside your companions!

MsgJp: 我がしもべたちよ！　焦るな！　じっくりとなぶれ！
MsgEn:
My faithful servants! Do not be hasty! 
Savor the moment and torment them!

MsgJp: なかなかやるな――人間にしてはな
我がしもべたちよ！　こやつらを引き裂いてしまえ！
MsgEn: My loyal servants! Tear these wretches apart!

MsgJp: ふん――面白い！
わははは！　愉快愉快！
人間め！　戦士というなら最期の戦いを楽しめ！
MsgEn:
Human!
If you are a true warrior, enjoy your last fight!

MsgJp: なんと――劣勢？
まだまだ！
くそう――力が入らぬ！　血肉をすすらせろ！
MsgEn:
Damn - no power!　
Let it rain flesh and blood!

MsgJp: みんな気をつけて！
王子、安全な場所に隠れて！
MsgEn: Prince, hide in a safe place!

MsgJp: ベルタ、聞こえるか！　身を潜めて！
MsgEn:
Bertha, can you hear me?
Hide yourself!

MsgJp: 隊長、こいつは強いよ
オーク四将軍、獣の将！
MsgEn:
The Beast Commander,
one of the Four Orc Generals!!

MsgJp: いける！　いけるよ！
MsgEn:
We can do this!
We can do it!

MsgJp: へへ、いかにも大将だな
ほーら、予想どおり手強いぜ
MsgEn: See, as expected, they are tough.

MsgJp: どんなに強くても俺にとっちゃ、オークはオークよ
MsgEn: No matter how strong it is, an orc is an orc.

MsgJp: 攻めろ攻めろ
くそ、強ええな
おらおら！
凄い臭い！　さすがオークの大将！
MsgEn:
What an awful stench!
As expected of the orcs' commander!

MsgJp: 隊長、見た？　王子、想像より子供！
MsgEn:
Captain, did you see that? 
The Prince is even younger than I thought!

MsgJp: 盗賊のお婆さんはどこ？
ジリアン、王子は無事なの？
MsgEn: Gillian, is the Prince all right?

MsgJp: もう！　オーク嫌い！
エリオット、もっと動け～！
王子救出に参加できるとは光栄！
MsgEn:
I am honored to be able to participate 
in the rescue of the prince!

MsgJp: 凄い武装ですね――
ああ、強いや――こいつは強い！
ネド王子、見てくれてますか～！
俺、そろそろ余裕ないかもです
MsgEn: I'm starting to feel a bit overwhelmed.

MsgJp: なんのこれしき！
異国の覚者の皆さん――
MsgEn: To all the Arisen from foreign lands...

MsgJp:
僕は、覚者のことを何も知りません
その自覚もなかったほどです
MsgEn:
I know nothing about the Arisen. So much so,
I wasn't even aware of how little I knew.

MsgJp:
それに、戦士としての力もありません
ですから、皆さんに教えて頂きたいことが
山ほどあるのです
MsgEn:
I lack the strength to be a warrior, 
so I have many questions I need you all 
to help me with.

MsgJp:
皆さんの武運をお借りして
解放軍はティネス砦を
取り戻すことができたと聞いています
MsgEn:
I am told that with the help
of your military might, the Liberation Army
was able to retake Fort Thines.

MsgJp:
そのティネス砦で、じっくりお話を
聞かせていただけませんか？
よろしくお願いします
MsgEn:
Would you be so kind as to sit down
and talk with us at Fort Thines? 
I look forward to working with you.

MsgJp:
こうして王子と再会できたのも
おぬしらの尽力があったからこそ
いくら感謝しても、し足りない
MsgEn:
I can't thank you enough for your efforts
in reuniting me with the Prince.

MsgJp:
しかし、わしらの戦いはこれが始まりだ
これからもよろしく頼むぞ
MsgEn:
But this is only the beginning of our fight.
I'm asking for your continued support.

MsgJp:
これだけ世話になっておいて厚かましいけど
ネド王子の手本になってほしい
MsgEn:
I apologize for being so brazen
after all you've done for me, but...
I want you to set an example for Prince Nedo.

MsgJp:
覚者のことは、覚者にしかわからない
わたしたちでは限界があるからね
MsgEn:
Only an Arisen can know
what is best for the Arisen.
We are all limited in what we can do.

MsgJp:
あんたたちの噂はちゃーんと
届いていたよ
よその大陸から来た覚者たちが
解放軍に参加しているってさ
MsgEn:
We've heard rumors about you, 
that Arisen from other continents
have joined the Liberation Army.

MsgJp:
ここへ来た目的はなんだい？
まさか、あたしのお宝を狙ってるんじゃ
ないだろうねえ
MsgEn:
What is your purpose for coming here? 
You're not after my treasure, are you?

MsgJp: こう言っちゃ悪いけど――
MsgEn: I'm sorry to say this, but...

MsgJp:
王子と言っても、普通の子供ですよね
正直、なーんだと思ったんですけど――
MsgEn:
Even if he is referred to as a Prince,
he is just an ordinary child.
To be frank, I thought, 
"How disappointing"...

MsgJp:
普通の子供だとしたら、この状況って
すごい重圧だと思うんですよ
支えてあげなくてはって使命感みたいな――
MsgEn:
The pressure of this situation is too much
for a normal child to bear.
It feels like a sense of obligation
to support them...

MsgJp: この感覚――新鮮です

まあ、王子なんてお飾りみたいなもんだ
覚者とは言え、まだガキだからな
MsgEn:
Well, a Prince is like a decoration.
He may be an Arisen, but he's still a kid.

MsgJp:
となれば、俺の出る幕じゃねえ
リズかエリオットに相手させとけ
MsgEn:
If that's the situation, I won't interfere. 
Let Lise and Elliot deal with it.

MsgJp: メイロワ将軍、見た？

孫でも見るみたいに目を細ーくするのかと思って
観察していたらね――
時々、寂しそうな悲しそうな顔するんだよね
MsgEn:
I thought he would smile
as if he were seeing his grandchild,
but he was observing him, and at times,
he looked sad or even lonely.

MsgJp:
それ見てさあ――
ああ、これはまだ始まりなんだ
本当の苦労はこれからなんだって
思ったよ
MsgEn:
When I saw that, I thought—
Oh, this is still the beginning.
The real hardships are yet to come.

MsgJp:
ここまで、おつかれさまでした
色々お話を――と思っていましたが
戻ってみると、対処しなくてはならない問題が
山積みのようです
MsgEn:
Thank you for your efforts thus far. 
I had planned to discuss various things, 
but upon returning, it seems that there 
are many issues piling up to be dealt with.

MsgJp: 虫のいいお願いで心苦しいのですが――
MsgEn: I'm sorry to be the one to ask for this, but...

MsgJp:
僕と共に、ここから全てを始めさせてください
この未熟な覚者のご指導を
どうかよろしくお願いいたします
MsgEn:
Please allow me to start everything
over from here with you; This inexperienced Arisen
humbly asks for your guidance.

MsgJp:
ふーむ
まずはどこから手をつけるべきか――
じっくりと思案しなくてはな
MsgEn:
Hmm...
Where should I start—
I have to think carefully.

MsgJp:
ネド王子が戻ったら戻ったで
色々と急がないとね
敵も黙ってはいないだろうし
MsgEn:
With Prince Nedo returned, we will
have to hurry with various matters.
The enemy won't just sit idly by either.

MsgJp: ネド王子――

あの年頃の少年は、少し見ないと
ずいぶん顔つきが変わるな
MsgEn:
Boys at that age change their appearance
quite a bit with just a little time apart.

MsgJp: 少しの間に、実にたくましくなられた
MsgEn: You have grown very strong in a short time.

MsgJp:
一度戻って少し骨休めといかねえか？
けっこう連戦してるぜ
MsgEn:
How about we head back for a brief rest?
We've been in quite a few battles already.

MsgJp:
ネド王子ったら――
あんな風に頼られると
張り切っちゃうよね
MsgEn:
Oh, Prince Nedo...
When he asks you for help like that...
I get all worked up!

MsgJp:
いい雰囲気に水を差すわけじゃありませんけど
これからですよね
ジリアンの言うとおりです
MsgEn:
I don't mean to put a damper on the good vibe, 
but it's just the beginning.
Gillian is right.

MsgJp:
ネド王子を無事に保護したんだろう？
まずは、おめでとう――だね
MsgEn:
I assume you have Prince Nedo
safely under your protection?
First of all, congratulations...

MsgJp:
希望が、グッと身近になったんだ
解放軍のひとたちは
これからは、希望とともに行動できる
さぞ、勢い付くことだろうね
MsgEn:
The hope has drawn much closer now. 
The Liberation Army will now 
be able to act alongside that hope. 
Surely, they will feel invigorated by this.

MsgJp:
ご苦労だったな
解放軍はついにネド王子をみこしに乗せることが
できるようになった
MsgEn:
You have done well. 
The Liberation Army has at last become 
capable of placing Prince Nedo
onto the palanquin.

MsgJp:
これが物語なら、さしずめ、第１章の
終わりというところだろうか――
MsgEn:
If this were like those tales,
it feels like this would be the end
of chapter one, does it not?

MsgJp: アッカーシェランにも覚者がいたというわけか
MsgEn: So there was an Arisen in Acre Selund.

MsgJp:
しかしその幼い覚者に力を継承すべきと
目される竜は、悪しき竜と呼ばれるほどに
憎まれている
MsgEn:
Yet the Dragon expected to pass on its power 
to that young Arisen is despised enough
to be called the "Evil Dragon."

MsgJp: 竜力の状態によっては――
MsgEn: Depending on the state of the Dragon's Force...

MsgJp: その覚者も悪しき心に呑み込まれてしまうやもしれず
MsgEn:
Even the Arisen may be swallowed 
up by the malicious mind.

MsgJp:
覚者たちよ――
目を凝らし、成り行きを見極めよ
MsgEn:
Arisen...
Let not thine eyes be clouded,
discern the truth behind these events.

MsgJp:
→エリアミッション解放
→王家の協力者解放
→アチーブ報酬官解放
→時間経過スポット②（経験値？）解放
MsgEn:
→ Area Mission Unlocked 
→ Cooperators of the Royal Family Unlocked 
→ Achievement Rewards Officer Unlocked 
→ Time Lapse Spot ② (Exp. Points?) Unlocked

MsgJp:
悪しき竜の思惑か――
どれ、その立場になって考えてみるか
MsgEn:
Is this the Evil Dragon's scheme— 
Well then, shall we consider it
from that position?

MsgJp:
ジョゼフ様の言い方を借りるなら
アッカーシェランは第２章に入ったようだね
MsgEn:
To paraphrase Master Joseph, 
it looks like Acre Selund has entered chapter two.

MsgJp:
そろそろ悪しき竜が動き出すだろうから
勢いにまかせた行動は危険だと思うよ
MsgEn:
Soon the Evil Dragon will start to move, 
so I believe that acting on impulse is dangerous.

MsgJp: この状況――

悪しき竜が望んだことなのか――
そうは思えぬ――
MsgEn:
Is it what the Evil Dragon wanted?—
I don't think so...

MsgJp: お待ちしていました

まずはメイロワ将軍とお話しください
僕は後ほど改めて挨拶させて頂きます
MsgEn:
Please speak with General Meirova first.
I will address you again later.

MsgJp: 砦の雰囲気が変わったと思わねえか？
MsgEn:
Don't you think the atmosphere 
at the fort has changed?

MsgJp:
賑やかになったっていうかよ
王子効果ってやつかね
MsgEn:
I wonder if it's become lively
because the Prince is here.

MsgJp:
――こんなこと、ここの人たちには
言えないけどさあ
MsgEn: —I can't say this to the people here, but...

MsgJp:
キラキラした場所にいないと
王子って、なんだか悲しいね
MsgEn:
If the Prince isn't in a shining place, 
it feels rather sad, doesn't it?

MsgJp:
砦の中が慌ただしいですね
出陣の準備でも始まったんでしょうか
MsgEn:
There's a flurry of activity in the fort. 
I wonder if they've started preparing 
to go into battle.

MsgJp:
今後のことを将軍やベルタと考えていたんだ
あなたたちは最初から数に入っている
頼りにしてるよ
MsgEn:
I was discussing future matters
with the General and Bertha.
You all have been part of the plan
from the very beginning.
I'm depending on you.

MsgJp:
大勢の人間が戦に備えるこの空気――
わかるだろう？
MsgEn:
A great many are preparing for battle; 
this atmosphere—do you feel it?

MsgJp: あんたたちのことだ――嫌いではないよな
MsgEn:
In regards to you guys—
You don't hate me?

MsgJp:
ジョゼフ殿のお気持ち、しかと受け取った
いつか恩返しをしなくてはな
MsgEn:
I have taken Master Joseph's kindness to heart.
I must return the favor one day.

MsgJp:
さて、早速だが――
ネド王子が戻られたことで
解放軍の士気はこの上なく高まっている
MsgEn:
Well, let's get right to it—
with Prince Nedo's return, the morale of 
the Liberation Army has never been higher.

MsgJp:
この機運をもってすれば
各地でくすぶっている戦士たちの説得も
不可能ではなかろう
MsgEn:
With this momentum, it may be possible
to persuade the warriors who have been
lying in wait across the lands.

MsgJp:
悪しき竜への反撃の時に備えて
解放軍の増強をはかりたいのだ
MsgEn:
In readiness for the moment
to retaliate against the Evil Dragon,
I want to bolster the Liberation Army's strength.

MsgJp:
そこでこのメイロワ、ネド王子をお連れして
イェルハルドに北への進軍協力を要請するつもりだ
MsgEn:
So I'm going to take Meirova and Prince Nedo
and ask Gerhard to cooperate in advancing north.

MsgJp: ついてはおぬしたち、先行して、魔物払いを頼む
MsgEn:
Therefore, we ask you to go ahead 
and clear the area of monsters.

MsgJp: ネド王子をイェルハルドのロスギルの村へお連れする
MsgEn: I'll take Prince Nedo to Gerhard in Rothgill Village.

MsgJp:
目立たぬよう、道中の魔物を速やかに排除しながら
先行してくれ
MsgEn:
Stay out of sight, quickly eliminate monsters 
along the way, and stay ahead of them.

MsgJp:
あらためまして――
アッカー家当主のネドと申します
MsgEn:
Allow me to reintroduce myself— 
I am Nedo, the head of House Acre.

MsgJp:
メイロワ将軍を始め、解放軍、民たちが
大変にお世話になったと聞いています
本当にありがとうございました
MsgEn:
I have heard that General Meirova, 
the Liberation Army and my people 
are very much indebted to you.
I offer you my deepest gratitude.

MsgJp:
今回はロスギルの村への先遣隊を
引き受けてくださるとのこと
MsgEn:
It seems you will undertake the 
advance party to Rothgill Village this time.

MsgJp:
噂の戦いぶり、間近で見られないのは残念ですが
また機会もあるでしょう
今後ともよろしく
MsgEn:
It's a pity I won't be able to see the rumored 
battle up close, but I'm sure there will be another 
opportunity. Keep up the good work.

MsgJp: ――お願いします

ロスギル村方面はこのあたりよりも
魔物が多い土地です
MsgEn:
The area around Rothgill Village
has more monsters than here.

MsgJp:
先駈けての魔物払いは大変と思いますが
どうぞよろしくお願いします
MsgEn:
I know it's a lot of work to exterminate the 
monsters ahead of time, but please do so.

MsgJp:
いいね
子守しながら戦えと言われなくてよ
MsgEn:
Sounds good. I won't be told to fight 
while babysitting.

MsgJp:
さーて、ネド王子と解放軍のために
もうひと肌脱ぎますか！
MsgEn:
Well then, shall I lend a hand for Prince Nedo 
and the Liberation Army?

MsgJp:
イェルハルドは動いてくれますかね――
ネド王子のご威光に期待ですね
MsgEn:
Will Gerhard make a move—
I'm hoping Prince Nedo's authority 
will do the trick.

MsgJp: わたしはここで留守番だ

王子の移動は目立たないように
ギリギリの少人数がいいはずだからね
MsgEn:
The Prince's relocation should be discreet.
A small group of people at the 
last minute should be good.

MsgJp: ここで君らの無事を祈らせてもらうよ
MsgEn: I'll stay here and pray for your safety.

MsgJp: ネド王子もご一緒ですかな？

イェルハルドめ――
王子を試すとは無礼このうえなし！
あとで叱っておかねばな
MsgEn:
Gerhard...
You are so rude to test the Prince!
I shall have to scold you later.

MsgJp: 癒しの泉はどこでしょうね？

イェルハルドめ、王子を試すとは
いい根性だぜ
本物だな、あいつは
MsgEn:
Gerhard, you've got some guts
trying to test the Prince.

MsgJp: 王家の秘蹟か――
MsgEn: The Sacrament of the Royal Family, is it...

MsgJp:
ネド王子、何をどうしたらいいかも
わからないみたいだけど、大丈夫かな
MsgEn:
It seems like Prince Nedo is lost
on what to do, but will he be okay?

MsgJp:
癒しの泉のあたりも魔物が多いんでしょうね
引き続き、魔物払いといきますか！
MsgEn:
It seems there are many monsters
near the Spring of Healing, huh?
Shall we continue our monster-clearing efforts?

MsgJp:
この村を出て北へ向かうと、やがて
関所に当たります
MsgEn:
If you leave this village and head north, 
you will eventually come to a gate.

MsgJp:
癒やしの泉は、その関所を越えた奥地にありますが
少なくともこの数十年――
この村から、泉のところまで行った者は
誰もいません
MsgEn:
The healing spring is located deep beyond 
the barrier, but no one from this village has 
made it to the spring in at least 
a couple of decades.

MsgJp:
そのようなわけで、泉の場所や現在の様子は
我々よりも詳しい者から直接聞いた方が
よろしいでしょう
MsgEn:
As such, it would be better to hear directly 
from someone who knows more about the location 
of the spring and its current condition than we do.

MsgJp: 北の関所を越えたその先に小さな村があります
MsgEn:
There is a small village just beyond 
the northern checkpoint.

MsgJp:
そこにはエリアマスターのナヤジークが
住んでいますから、尋ねてみてください
MsgEn:
The Area Master, Nazik, 
lives there, so ask her.

MsgJp:
彼女なら、わたしなどよりもずっと有益な
話を聞かせてくれるでしょう
MsgEn:
I'm sure she can tell you
a much more useful story than I can.

MsgJp: 北の関所を越えれば、村はその先です
MsgEn:
Once you cross the northern checkpoint, 
the village is just beyond it.

MsgJp:
まずはエリアマスターのナヤジークを
訪ねてください
MsgEn: First, please visit Area Master Nazik.

MsgJp:
こんなところにお客さまとは珍しい
いえ――噂はこの地まで届いております
わたしはここのエリアマスター、ナヤジーク
MsgEn:
It's unusual to have a visitor here. 
No, the rumors have reached this place. 
I am the Area Master here, Nazik.

MsgJp:
ご存じかも知れませんが
このエリアには王家代々と継がれてきた山城
展望城と呼ばれる要衝がございます
MsgEn:
As you may know, this area is home
to a mountain castle that has been
in the Royal Family for generations.
It is called Lookout Castle.

MsgJp:
しかし、いまやその城は魔軍の手に堕ち
王都メガドへの進行はおろか
ここより北に進むことすら危険な状態です
MsgEn:
But now that the castle has fallen into the hands 
of the Demon Army, it's not safe to proceed north 
of here, let alone to the Royal Capital of Megado.

MsgJp:
ただ耐えるしかない無為な日々でしたが
もし、ネド様のお役に立てるのならば
それが、わたしたちの喜びになるでしょう
MsgEn:
We have done nothing but endure, 
but if we can be of service to Lord Nedo, 
it will be our pleasure.

MsgJp:
癒しの泉ですね？
ここを出て、南西の崖へ向かってください
水路の入り口には、すぐにお気づきになられるかと
MsgEn:
It's the healing spring, isn't it?
Leave here and head southwest toward the cliffs. 
You'll soon find yourself at the entrance
to a waterway.

MsgJp:
その水路の最深部に、癒しの泉はあります
魔物の巣窟になっているはずですから
どうぞお気をつけください
MsgEn:
The healing spring is located
at the deepest part of the canal, 
which is supposed to be a den of monsters, 
so please be careful.

MsgJp:
南西の崖に向かってください
それから、礎の解放がまだでしたら
けして忘れないでくださいね
MsgEn:
Head for the southwest cliffs, 
and don't forget to attune to the Portcrystal
if you haven't already.

MsgJp:
イェルハルドが内密で話したいってよ
王子抜きだと
MsgEn:
Gerhard wants to speak to you in private, 
without the Prince present.

MsgJp: おかしな陰謀に巻きこまれたりしねえだろうな
MsgEn:
I hope you don't get caught up in some 
crazy conspiracy.

MsgJp:
どうやら王子たちは少し遅れているようですな
ならば、好都合です
MsgEn:
It seems that the Prince is running a bit late.
Well then, that works in our favor.

MsgJp: みなさん

時に王子の堅き盾として――
時に解放軍の鋭き剣として――
今後ともよろしくお願いします
MsgEn:
At times, the unwavering shield of the Prince— 
At times, the keen blade of the Liberation Army— 
Thank you for your continued support.

MsgJp:
ベルタとその一族郎党は、国が復興するその日まで
盗賊稼業は休止にして我々解放軍に全面協力する
とのことだ
MsgEn:
Bertha and her family will suspend their banditry 
and cooperate fully with the Liberation Army 
until the day the country is restored.

MsgJp: まあ、当然だがな
いろいろとありがとうございました

でも、竜力を使うと疲れるものですね
いつか慣れるのでしょうか
MsgEn:
But using Dragon Force can be tiring. 
I wonder if I'll get used to it someday.

MsgJp:
イェルハルドが加わるとなれば
相当な戦力だぜ
MsgEn:
With the addition of Gerhard,
we'll be quite a force to be reckoned with.

MsgJp:
盗賊団に加えて、辺境の知将が参加となれば
もっと多くの人たちが解放軍に
同調してくるれるでしょうね
MsgEn:
With the addition of the bandit band 
and the wise general from the frontier, 
more people will likely join the Liberation Army.

MsgJp:
思わず張り切っちゃったけど
ネド王子、ますます後に退けないよね
MsgEn:
I got a little too excited, but Prince Nedo,
there's no turning back now.

MsgJp: 退くつもりなんて、ないんだろうけどさあ
MsgEn: I know you have no intention of backing down.

MsgJp:
悪しき竜は現れぬか――
あやつめ何を考えている――
MsgEn:
Will the vile dragon not appear— 
What is it scheming...

MsgJp:
なんだか、意気揚々という感じだね
そうでもないのかな？
MsgEn:
It seems like there's a buoyant spirit here, 
or am I mistaken?

MsgJp:
戦いが好きな覚者――戦場でこそ輝く覚者
そういう覚者がいても当然だと思うよ
MsgEn:
An Arisen who loves to fight— 
the kind that truly shines on the battlefield. 
I think it's only natural for such Arisen to exist.

MsgJp: なるほど――

悪しき竜の竜力はネド王子が継承可能な――
つまり、王家伝来の竜力で
あるか否かが重要というわけか
MsgEn:
The Evil Dragon's power can be 
inherited by Prince Nedo— 
this means that the significance lies in
whether it is the Royal lineage's
Dragon Force or not.

MsgJp:
確かにこれはネド王子以外には
見極めが不可能だろうな
MsgEn:
Surely this would be impossible for anyone
but Prince Nedo to discern.

MsgJp:
しかし、一方で気味が悪いのは悪しき竜の動き
気を引き締めて動くのだぞ
MsgEn:
Yet, on the other hand, what is unsettling
is the Evil Dragon's actions. 
Keep your wits about you 
and proceed with care.

MsgJp: ネド王子とはうまくやっているのだろうな？
MsgEn:
You're probably getting along well
with Prince Nedo?

MsgJp:
王子は次代のアッカーシェランの王――
そして竜になる人だ
MsgEn:
The prince is the next king of Acre Selund—
and the one who will become the Dragon.

MsgJp:
おまえたちと王子の関係が
そのまま未来のレスタニアとアッカーシェランの
関係になるだろう
MsgEn:
Your relationship with the Prince 
will become the future link 
between Lestania and Acre Selund.

MsgJp:
責務は重いが――これもレスタニアのためだ
さあ、行きなさい
MsgEn:
It's a heavy responsibility, 
but it's for the good of Lestania. 
Now, be off.

MsgJp: アッカーシェランとどう付き合うべきか――
MsgEn: How should we deal with Acre Selund...

MsgJp:
これは追々考えるとして
まずは悪しき竜にまつわる問題を
解決しなくてはな
MsgEn:
We'll think about this later, but first we need 
to solve the problem of the Evil Dragon.

MsgJp:
解放軍はどうにか格好がついたんだよね？
となると、次は、戦略を決めるんだろうな
MsgEn:
The Liberation Army has finally
pulled itself together, so next, 
we'll have to decide on a strategy.

MsgJp:
出せるところは、口出しした方が
いいと思うけど、まあ、場の雰囲気も見ながら
判断するしかないよね
MsgEn:
I think it's better to speak your mind, but you 
need to judge based on the atmosphere.

MsgJp:
大変だ
オークがここに向かって進軍中だ
MsgEn:
Trouble is coming— 
the orcs are headed our way.

MsgJp: ネド王子の解放軍合流を知られたらしい
MsgEn:
It seems that they have learned that 
Prince Nedo joined the Liberation Army.

MsgJp:
王子率いる部隊が城壁近くに集まっている
まもなくここは封鎖する、急いで合流してくれ
ネド王子、たっての希望だ
MsgEn:
The troops led by the Prince
are gathering near the city walls.
We will seal off the area shortly.
Hurry and join up. It is Prince Nedo's request.

MsgJp:
王子たちの居場所は行けばわかるはず
急ぎ、合流してくれ
MsgEn:
You'll know where the Prince
and his men are when you get there.
Hurry and join up with them.

MsgJp:
王子たちは城壁の上で、迫り来る敵を
見計らっているはずだ
MsgEn:
The Prince and his men should be on the ramparts, 
watching the oncoming enemy.

MsgJp:
ふたたびここを失えば、もう後はないんだ
命に代えても守りきるよ
MsgEn:
If we lose this foothold again, 
there will be nothing left.
I'll defend it with my life.

MsgJp:
浅ましいオークどもめ！
さっそく反撃に来たってわけか
MsgEn:
Those vile orcs!
They've come to strike back so soon.

MsgJp:
あんた、すごく腕が立つんだってな！
頼りにしてるよ
MsgEn:
I hear you're very skilled! 
I'm counting on you.

MsgJp:
幼い王子が命を張っているんだ
俺もとにかくやってみるつもりさ
MsgEn:
The little prince is putting his life on the line.
I'm going to risk mine as well.

MsgJp:
まもなく敵がこの砦に到達する
もう時間がないぞ
MsgEn:
Soon the enemy will reach this fort. 
We are running out of time.

MsgJp: はやく！　城壁にいる王子の元へ急いで！
MsgEn:
Quickly!　
Hurry to the Prince on the ramparts!

MsgJp: 気づいてるだろうが――

こっちのオークどもの装備は
なかなかのもんだ
押しと引きの呼吸、間違えるなよ
MsgEn:
These orcs over here are pretty well equipped.
Don't mess up the timing of 
your advances and retreats.

MsgJp:
隊長、風にあの臭いが混じってる
オークの戦闘臭！
MsgEn:
Captain, the wind carries that scent... 
The foul odor of orc combat!

MsgJp:
これは、言わば王子の初陣ですね
気持ち良く勝たせてあげましょう！
MsgEn:
This is the prince's first battle, so to speak. 
Let's let him win comfortably!

MsgJp:
待っていたぞ！
まず、陣頭指揮を執るネド王子と
話してくれ
MsgEn:
We've been waiting for you!
First, you need to talk to Prince Nedo, 
who's in command of the group.

MsgJp:
実は迫り来る敵への対応策を決められなくて
困っています
MsgEn:
Actually, I'm having trouble deciding
what to do about the oncoming enemy.

MsgJp:
意見は出尽くし、決断しなくては
ならないのですが――
MsgEn:
All opinions have been exhausted
and decisions have to be made...

MsgJp: ――いや――いいえ

隊長さんの顔を見たら
勇気が出てきました！
MsgEn:
Seeing your face, Ser Captain, 
I feel my courage returning!

MsgJp: 無茶だって言われるかもしれないけど――

敵の部隊をこの砦に誘い込んで殲滅する
この作戦で行かせてください！
MsgEn:
We will lure the enemy's troops into this fort 
and destroy them.
Let us go with this strategy!

MsgJp:
我々は少数ですから戦力が拡散してしまうと
弱いと思うんです
MsgEn:
We are a small group, and I think we are 
vulnerable if our forces are spread out.

MsgJp:
だから、外に打って出るよりも
敵を砦に呼び込めば――
MsgEn:
So, rather than hitting them outside,
if you bring the enemies into the fort...

MsgJp:
向こうは兵を少しずつ送り込むことしか
できませんから、各個撃破で互角に
戦うことができるはずです
MsgEn:
They can only funnel in a small number of troops, 
so we should be able to fight them on equal terms
by cutting them down individually.

MsgJp: ではご一同様、よろしくお願いします
MsgEn: Well, I look forward to working with you all.

MsgJp:
折悪しく、ジリアンを遠方の斥候に
出してしまった
MsgEn:
Unfortunately, Gillian was sent 
on a distant scouting mission.

MsgJp:
おぬしたちの負担が増えるが
今さら遠慮もいらんと思ってな！
MsgEn:
It's going to be more of a burden on you guys, 
but I figured there's no need to hold back now!

MsgJp:
敵を砦に引き込むなんてのは――
好き嫌いで言えば大キライだが
MsgEn:
Drawing the enemy into the fortress— 
if I had to say, I'm not a fan.

MsgJp: ま、仕方がねえな
オークの臭い、強くなってきた？
MsgEn: Is the smell of orc getting stronger?

MsgJp:
気のせい？
もう、鼻が鈍感になっちゃってわからない！
MsgEn:
Is it my imagination?
I can't tell anymore, my nose has become so dull!

MsgJp:
砦の中に敵を引き入れるとなれば
取りこぼしは許されませんね
MsgEn:
When it comes to drawing the enemy into the fort, 
there's no room for error.

MsgJp:
ジリアンは、今頃は帰路だろう
だが、到着してすぐに戦闘では可哀想だ
MsgEn:
Gillian is probably on her way back by now, 
but it would be a pity if she had to head
into battle as soon as she arrived.

MsgJp:
だから、わたしたちで
一気に片をつけようではないか
MsgEn: So let's get this done in one fell swoop!

MsgJp:
僕の顔を見ればみんな勇気が
出るだろうなんて思い上がったことを
考えてるわけじゃないんです
MsgEn:
I'm not so conceited as to believe
that everyone would feel brave
just by seeing my face.

MsgJp:
ただ、砦でジッとしているのも
違うと思うんです
MsgEn:
However, I believe that simply staying 
still in the fortress is not the answer.

MsgJp:
王子はたった一戦で一皮むけた感じだね
さすが覚者――というべきなのかな
MsgEn:
It seems the Prince has evolved
after just a single battle, doesn't it? 
Perhaps it should be said—an Arisen indeed.

MsgJp: そうそう――

あちこち見てきたけど
オークどもの動きが活発になっているんだ
これからもっと忙しくなるよ
MsgEn:
I've been looking everywhere.
There's a lot of activity among the orcs.
It's going to get busier.

MsgJp:
オークどもにネド王子ここにありと
見せつけたわけだが、はてさて
吉と出るか凶と出るか――だな
MsgEn:
We have shown the orcs that Prince Nedo
is here to stay, and now we will see
if it is a good thing or a bad thing...

MsgJp: 王子め、なかなかやるな――

と、褒めてやりたいところだが
調子に乗られても困るからやめておくわ
MsgEn:
I'd like to give you a compliment, 
but I don't want you to get carried away, 
so I'll respectfully refrain.

MsgJp:
わたし、ネド王子の味方だからね
――というか、心配でたまらないの
MsgEn:
I'm on Prince Nedo's side.
—I mean, I'm worried about him.

MsgJp:
戦いがこれから本格化する――
みんなそう思っているみたいですね
もちろん、俺もです
MsgEn:
The battle is about to get serious— 
everyone seems to think so, 
including me, of course.

MsgJp:
解放軍はかつてないほどに勢い付いているが
実際の活動には少々準備時間が必要だ
MsgEn:
The Liberation Army is gaining momentum
like never before, but actual operations
require a bit of prep time.

MsgJp: おぬしら一度レスタニアへ戻ってはどうかな
MsgEn: I suggest you return to Lestania.

MsgJp:
解放軍の躍進か――と思ったら
攻め込まれたそうだね
MsgEn:
I thought the Liberation Army
was making progress,
but they've been attacked instead.

MsgJp:
士気だけは高いけど、まだ劣勢という
ところかな
MsgEn:
Morale is high, 
but they're likely still outnumbered.

MsgJp: やはり敵軍も動き出したな
MsgEn: The enemy forces are on the move, after all.

MsgJp:
悪しき竜が現れてからの戦いは
敗走につぐ敗走だったと聞いている
とすれば、本格的な反撃はこれから――
MsgEn:
I've heard that the battle since the appearance 
of the Evil Dragon has been one defeat
after another, and if that's the case,
a full-scale counterattack from the orcs
is just around the corner.

MsgJp:
わかっているな？
レスタニア覚者隊の、武勇見せどころだぞ
MsgEn:
Do you understand? 
This is chance to show valor
for the Lestanian Arisen Corps.

MsgJp:
さあ、アッカーシェランへ急ぐべきでは
ないか？
MsgEn:
Now come on, 
shouldn't you hurry to Acre Selund?

MsgJp:
ネド王子がどういう人物か知らなくても
解放軍が活気づいたことは敵にも伝わる
MsgEn:
Even if they don't know who Prince Nedo is, 
the enemy can tell that the Liberation Army 
forces have been energized.

MsgJp:
流れに乗り遅れないように――
いや、流れを生み出すくらいの勢いで
丁度良いかもしれないぞ
MsgEn:
To not fall behind the flow—
Nay, it might be just right to create
a flow of our own with enough momentum.

MsgJp:
悪しき竜の思惑はまだわからん
くれぐれも用心するのだぞ
MsgEn:
We still don't know what the Evil Dragon
has in store for us, so beware.

MsgJp:
戦いのことは素人だけどね――
防戦一方じゃ気持ちがふさぐと思う
MsgEn:
I'm not a battle expert, but I think that 
always being on the defensive could be 
quite discouraging.

MsgJp:
砦なんか、壁に囲まれているから
なおさらだ
MsgEn: Especially since the fort is surrounded by walls.

MsgJp:
各地から報告が入っています
状況はますます厳しくなってきたようです
MsgEn:
Reports are coming in from all over 
that the situation is getting tougher and tougher.

MsgJp: 詳しいことは将軍からお願いします
MsgEn: For more information, please ask the General.

MsgJp:
敵は同時にあちこちで動き出している
どこから手をつけたらいいのか――
MsgEn:
The enemy is moving all over the place
at the same time, where to start...

MsgJp:
増強されたと言ってもまだまだ
多勢に無勢
MsgEn:
Even though they are now stronger, 
they are still outnumbered.

MsgJp:
兵を効率的に動かさないと
勝利が遠のく
MsgEn:
If we don't move our troops efficiently, 
our victory will fall from certainty.

MsgJp:
ジタバタしても仕方がねえ
メイロワ将軍と話してこいよ
MsgEn:
There's no point in being jittery now.
Go talk to General Meirova.

MsgJp:
おそらく、部隊を分散することに
なるんでしょうね
その時は、僕にも考えがあります
MsgEn:
Perhaps the troops will be divided, then. 
When that happens, I have some plans
in mind too.

MsgJp: ネド王子の面倒はわたしに任せて
MsgEn: Let me take care of Prince Nedo.

MsgJp:
この気持ち、なんだろうね
お姉さん気分――え？　母親気分！？
MsgEn:
What is this feeling?
I feel like a big sister—huh?
Motherly instinct!?

MsgJp:
おお、おぬしら、状況は切迫しておるぞ
ロスギルの村、ベルタのアジトともに敵の攻撃を
受けている
MsgEn:
Oh, you all! The situation is urgent. 
Both Rothgill Village and Bertha's 
hideout are under enemy assault.

MsgJp: やつらめ、本腰を入れて攻めて来たようだ
MsgEn: They're getting serious about attacking us.

MsgJp:
ネド王子の合流で士気は高まったが
このまま劣勢になれば元も子もない
MsgEn:
Prince Nedo joining us has boosted morale, 
but if we continue to be outnumbered, 
we will be losing it all.

MsgJp:
起死回生――派手な戦果を上げて
士気を維持するのだ
MsgEn:
We need a comeback—
a significant war effort to keep morale up.

MsgJp:
派手な戦果を求めるとなれば
ネド王子の出陣は必須
MsgEn:
If we're seeking a flashy victory, 
then Prince Nedo's deployment is essential.

MsgJp:
危険ではあるがこれも王家の責務
武運は王子にあると信じて
前進あるのみだ
MsgEn:
It's dangerous, but it's also a royal duty, 
and we must move forward, believing that 
the Prince will be the one to carry the day.

MsgJp:
あなたはロスギルへ行ってくれる？
わたしはここでもう少し報告を聞いて
行き先を決めるから
MsgEn:
Can you go to Rothgill?
I'll stay here and listen to a few more reports 
and decide where to go.

MsgJp: ベルタのところか、それとも、他のところか

とにかく、ロスギルはあなたに任せるから
お願いね
MsgEn: Anyway, I'd like to leave Rothgill to you

MsgJp:
ロスギルは任せるから――
急いでね
MsgEn:
I'll leave Rothgill to you—
hurry up.

MsgJp: 僕はベルタのところへ行こうと思います
MsgEn: I think I'll go to Bertha's.

MsgJp:
あそこには子供が多いから――
子供たちなら、僕でも勇気づけて
やれるはずです
MsgEn:
There are a lot of children there— 
I think I can give them courage, 
even if it's just me.

MsgJp: この砦の留守はまかせてくれ
MsgEn: I'll take care of this fortress.

MsgJp:
ロスギルへ行くんだろ？
だったら、急ごうぜ
MsgEn:
You're going to Rothgill, right? 
Then hurry up.

MsgJp:
隊長、行ってきて
王子はわたしが守るから
MsgEn: Captain, go. I'll protect the prince.

MsgJp:
ロスギル村ですよね？
何度か行き来した村ですけど
間違えたら大変です
MsgEn:
It's Rothgill Village, right? 
I've traveled there a few times,
but getting lost would be a disaster.

MsgJp: 地図で確認しながら行きましょう
MsgEn: Check the map as you go.

MsgJp:
おお、ありがたい！
なんと心強い顔ぶれでしょうか
MsgEn:
Oh, thank you! 
What a reassuring face!

MsgJp:
ここまでは手勢で持ちこたえていますが
あらたな敵の情報が入りましてな――
MsgEn:
So far, our forces have held their own,
but we have received intelligence
of a new enemy appearing...

MsgJp:
わたしたちはここの防衛で手一杯
どうぞ、外の敵の相手をよろしくお願いします！
MsgEn:
We have our hands full defending here. 
Please take care of the enemies outside!

MsgJp:
敵の援軍は村の外です
中に入られては守り切れるかどうか――
どうぞ、よろしくお願いします！
MsgEn:
Enemy reinforcements are outside the village. 
If they get inside, I'm not sure we can defend 
against them—please!

MsgJp:
故郷は自分たちで守る――
そう言いたいところだが多勢に無勢
応援、感謝するよ
MsgEn:
We will protect our hometown ourselves—
I want to say so, but we're outnumbered. 
Thanks for the support.

MsgJp:
おう、俺とエリオットでロスギルを襲撃する
敵を防いでやるよ
MsgEn:
Alright, Elliot and I will go to Rothgill. 
We'll hold off the enemy for you.

MsgJp: それ以外は頼んだぜ
MsgEn: Other than that, I'm all yours.

MsgJp:
隊長、さっさと片付けましょう
ネド王子が心配ですから
いつでも向こうに行けるように！
MsgEn:
Captain, let's wrap this up quickly. 
Prince Nedo is at risk,
so we must be ready to go at any moment!

MsgJp:
倒したオークが捨て台詞を残しました――
ほどなくベルタも生きちゃいまい
オークからは逃げられない
MsgEn:
The defeated orc left some parting words— 
Bertha won't live for much longer, 
you can't escape from the orcs.

MsgJp: もちろん、王子も――

隊長、ここはもう我々で対処可能です
どうぞ、ベルタのところへ！
王子をお守りください
MsgEn:
Captain, we can handle this place now. 
Please, go to Bertha! Protect the Prince.

MsgJp:
ここはもう大丈夫です
どうぞ、盗賊のアジトへ――王子のところへ！
MsgEn:
You're all set here. 
Please, go to the bandit's hideout- 
to the Prince!

MsgJp:
おかげで助かったよ
あんた、やっぱりすごいな
MsgEn:
Thanks for saving me.
You're still amazing after all.

MsgJp:
話なら、あっちでしようぜ
王子と盗賊どもに何かあったら
俺たちが責められそうな勢いだ
MsgEn:
We'll talk when we get over there. 
If something happens to the Prince
and the bandits, we might end up getting blamed.

MsgJp:
王子の護衛が何人いるかなんて
隊長も聞いてないですよね
MsgEn:
The Captain didn't ask
how many guards the Prince had.

MsgJp:
リズだけってことはないですよねえ
不安です、早く行きましょう！
MsgEn:
It can't just be Lise...
I'm anxious, let's get going!

MsgJp: 何か――予感がするんです

吉兆か凶兆かわからないけど――
いいえ、その両方が混じり合ったような――
MsgEn:
I don't know if it's a good omen or a bad omen—
No, it's a mixture of both.

MsgJp:
こりゃあ、あれだ
嵐の前の静けさってやつだな
MsgEn: This is it, the calm before the storm.

MsgJp: 油断するなよ

隊長――
やっぱり顔見るとホッとするよ
MsgEn: Captain—it's a relief to see your face.

MsgJp:
ベルタはちょっと機嫌が悪いから
気をつけてね
MsgEn:
Bertha's in a bit of a bad mood, 
so watch your step.

MsgJp: ここは、戦いには不向きですね
MsgEn: This place is not suitable for fighting.

MsgJp: 攻め込まれたら、逃げ場がないですよ
MsgEn: If we are attacked, there is no way out.

MsgJp:
メイロワのじじいめ、ネド王子まで
寄越すなんて何を考えているんだい！？
MsgEn:
That geezer Meirova.
What were you thinking, 
sending Prince Nedo over here!?

MsgJp:
希望だ、旗印だ、と言われて懸命だけど
まだ子供じゃないか
MsgEn:
They call him hope, a symbol to rally around, 
but he's still just a child.

MsgJp:
――まあ、それはともかく、とりあえず
この急場をどう凌ぐかだよ
MsgEn:
—Well, anyway,
let's see how we can get out of this emergency.

MsgJp:
一番重要なことはね、ここで戦えば
こっちに勝ち目はないってことだ
MsgEn:
The most important thing to remember
is that if we fight here, we don't stand a chance.

MsgJp: その代わり、ほら――

迎え撃つにはうってつけの場所がある
地図に印をつけてやるから行ってみな
MsgEn:
There's a good place to intercept them. 
I'll mark it on the map, you go there.

MsgJp:
手下たちを走らせてあるから、そいつが
案内するよ
MsgEn:
I've got my guys running around, 
they'll show you the way.

MsgJp:
地図を見せてください
――ああ、やっぱりそうですね
MsgEn: Let me see the map—oh, I knew it.

MsgJp:
オークは洞窟の裏手の、地形が入り組んだ
山の中を進軍してくるはずです
MsgEn:
Orcs will likely march through the 
intricate mountain terrain behind the cave.

MsgJp:
谷間の道は狭くて大軍には不向き
この地の利を活用しなさい――
MsgEn:
The path through the valley is too tight
for a large force to pass through.
Make use of the terrain's advantage—

MsgJp: それがベルタの考えだと思います
さあ、隊長さん、行きましょう
なんだい――

王子は見違えたようだね
でも、まだまだ子供なんだからね
それを忘れたら後悔するよ
MsgEn:
The Prince seems to have changed, doesn't he? 
But he's still just a child, you know. 
Forget that, and you'll regret it.

MsgJp:
谷間の様子を見に行きませんか？
早い方がいいと思うんです
MsgEn:
Why don't we go check out the valley? 
I think the sooner the better.

MsgJp:
なるほど――谷底のオークどもを
山の上から奇襲するってわけだ
MsgEn:
I see... a surprise attack on orcs
on the valley floor from up the mountain.

MsgJp:
奇襲ってのがひっかかるが
戦上手は手段選ばずってな
MsgEn:
I'm not so sure
about the 'surprise attack' part, but...
They say a good fighter does whatever it takes.

MsgJp: 王子、頼もしいねえ
MsgEn: The Prince is quite reliable, isn't he?

MsgJp:
王子が精神的に成長したといっても
戦いに関してはまだまだです
MsgEn:
Even though the Prince has grown mentally,
when it comes to fighting, 
he still has a long way to go.

MsgJp: 俺たちの出番ですよ
この先は危険だ

おかしらに指示された
谷を見下ろせる場所があるから
そこまで登るんだ
MsgEn:
The old man told me there's a spot overlooking 
the valley, so we're going to climb up to it.

MsgJp: 仲間が待ってるはずだ、指示に従ってくれ
MsgEn:
Your friends will be waiting for you. 
Follow the instructions.

MsgJp:
来たね！
ほら、ここを登るんだよ
MsgEn:
You've arrived!
Look, we're going up here.

MsgJp:
おかげで、悪しき竜の竜力を
近くで感じることができました
MsgEn:
Thanks to your efforts,
I was able to feel the Dragon Force
of the Evil Dragon up close.

MsgJp: 僕は、あの竜力を継承することができます！
MsgEn: I believe can inherit that Dragon Force!

MsgJp:
邪悪な意識の奥深くに
火竜であった女王の力を感じました
MsgEn:
Deep within that evil consciousness, 
I felt the power of the Queen
who was once the Fire Dragon.

MsgJp:
悪しき竜に打ち勝つことができれば
竜力は僕に共鳴してくれるはずです
MsgEn:
If I can overcome the Evil Dragon, 
the Dragon Force will resonate with me.

MsgJp:
悪しき竜が、アッカーシェランの竜と
まったく異なる竜力を持つ存在であれば
僕はその力を継承できないのではないか――
MsgEn:
If the Evil Dragon possessed powers 
entirely different from those
of the Acre Selund Dragon,
then I may not be able to inherit that strength...

MsgJp:
そう思って不安だったのですが
確認できて良かったです
MsgEn:
That's what I was worried about, 
but I'm glad I got confirmation.

MsgJp:
悪しき竜のやつ――
俺たち――いや、隊長に用があったみたいだな
MsgEn:
The Evil Dragon...
I think he wanted us—
Nay, he wanted the Captain.

MsgJp: なんだってんだ、まったく

さっきの竜――
本気じゃないって言うか
あまり殺気を感じなかったっていうか――
MsgEn:
The Dragon from earlier— 
I can't say it was being serious,
nor did I feel much killing intent—

MsgJp:
悪しき竜の奴――
俺たちに何か期待してるんですかね
MsgEn: That Evil Dragon—what does he expect from us?

MsgJp:
悪しき竜は隊長に会いに来た――
僕など眼中にありませんでした
いったいどういうことでしょうね
MsgEn:
The Evil Dragon came to see the Captain— 
It had no interest in someone like me. 
What could this possibly mean?

MsgJp: 俺たちに何をさせようってんだ――
MsgEn: What the hell do you want us to do...

MsgJp:
隊長――
あの悪しき竜にとって
わたしたちは観客――
MsgEn:
Captain— 
To that wicked Dragon, 
we are mere spectators—

MsgJp: そんな気がしたんだけど――ちがうかな
MsgEn:
I felt that way, but— 
I could be wrong.

MsgJp: この絶望の大陸を楽しめって――
MsgEn: He told me to enjoy this land of despair...

MsgJp:
もしや、悪しき竜は自分の力を
見せつけるために俺たちを呼んだとか
MsgEn:
Maybe the Evil Dragon called us here
to show us his power.

MsgJp: 違いますかね！？

よくやってくれた！
おかげで仲間にはかすり傷ひとつないよ
MsgEn:
You did a great job! 
Not a scratch on my guys thanks to you.

MsgJp:
王子も、ずいぶん意気揚々と
引き上げてきたじゃないか
MsgEn:
The Prince has certainly come back
with great enthusiasm.

MsgJp: うん、見直したよ

でもね、王子だ覚者だと
もてはやされてもあの子はまだ子供
MsgEn:
But you know, even though he's being hailed
as a Prince and an Arisen, he's still just a kid.

MsgJp:
母親が恋しい年頃だ
それを忘れるんじゃないよ
MsgEn:
He's at that age where he still misses his mother.
Don't forget that.

MsgJp:
疲れただろう？
すこし、休むといい
MsgEn:
You're tired, aren't you?
It's good to take a break.

MsgJp:
聞いたよ
ついに悪しき竜が現れたんだってね
MsgEn: I heard that the Evil Dragon has finally appeared.

MsgJp:
しかも、君たちを呼びつけたのは
自分の力を見せつけるため――
そう言ったんだよね？
MsgEn:
Moreover, you all were summoned
so that he could demonstrate his power— 
That's what he said, right?

MsgJp:
そうか――
竜からの力の継承が可能となれば
ネド王子は正真正銘の希望というわけだ
MsgEn:
I see... If it is indeed possible to inherit power
from the Dragon, then Prince Nedo
is a genuine hope for Acre Selund.

MsgJp: ――が、しかし！

悪しき竜の傲慢な言葉が許せんな！
おまえたちの見聞が白竜の耳に入ることは必然だ
MsgEn:
Such arrogant words spouted by the Evil Dragon
are unacceptable! It is inevitable
that the White Dragon will hear of this!

MsgJp:
つまり、それは白竜を意識した言葉――
これはわたしの想像以上に厄介な
巻きこまれ方だぞ――うーむ
MsgEn:
I mean, these are words said
with the White Dragon in mind—
This is trickier foe than I envisaged it to be.

MsgJp: 悪しき竜はおまえに会いに来たのだな――
MsgEn: The Evil Dragon came to see you...

MsgJp:
これはフィンダムを巡る出来事を
思い出さずにはいられない――
MsgEn:
This can't help but remind me of the events 
surrounding Phindym...

MsgJp:
あの黒騎士と悪しき竜――
似ているとは思わぬか
MsgEn:
That Black Knight and the Evil Dragon—
don't you think they're similar?

MsgJp: 気になることがあるのだが――

ネド王子が竜力の継承者たり得るとして
しかしその場合でも竜にその気がなければ
どうしようもあるまい
MsgEn:
With the assumption that Prince Nedo
could be the heir to the Dragon's power...
But even in that case, 
if the Dragon is not willing...
There's nothing we can do about it.

MsgJp:
悪しき竜が好んで王子に竜力を継承するなど
ありえないことだろう？
MsgEn:
Surely, it is unthinkable for the Evil Dragon to
willingly pass on its Dragon Force to the Prince?

MsgJp:
何か別の方法があるのか、それとも
フィンダムの時のような結末になるのか――
MsgEn:
Is there any other way,
or will it end up like in Phindym...

MsgJp:
いやいや、"悪しき竜"は一筋縄では
いかなさそうだ
――うーむ
MsgEn:
No, no, it looks like the Evil Dragon
won't be so simple.
Hmm...

MsgJp: 悩ましいのはそれだけではない
MsgEn: That's not the only thing that bothers me.

MsgJp:
"悪しき竜"がおまえたちにアッカーシェランの
状況を見せつける意図は、ひとつしかない
すなわち、警告――いや予告というべきか
MsgEn:
The Evil Dragon has only one intention
in showing you the situation in Acre Selund,
and that is to warn you... or rather, an omen.

MsgJp: "悪しき竜"と呼ばれてはいても竜は竜――
MsgEn:
They may be called the Evil Dragon,
but a Dragon is still a Dragon.

MsgJp:
そんな気持ちもどこかにあったんだけど
倒しておかないと大変なことになりそうだね
MsgEn:
I had that feeling in the back
of my mind somewhere.
We're going to be in big trouble
if we don't defeat it soon.

MsgJp:
戦局を大きく変える、今がその好機
でも、急いては事をし損じるって言うからね
MsgEn:
Now is the time for a major change 
in the war situation.
But they say that haste makes waste.

MsgJp: おかえりなさい、隊長さん

突破口だ――突破口を開いて
戦局をひっくり返さねばならん
MsgEn:
A breakthrough— 
we must make a breakthrough
and turn the tide of the war.

MsgJp:
解放軍はまだまだ小さな組織です
しかし増強にはもっと時間が必要です
MsgEn:
The Liberation Army is still a small organization,
but it needs more time to build up.

MsgJp:
となればこの不利を利に変えるような
作戦を立案するしかありませんね
MsgEn:
Then we have no choice but to devise a strategy 
to turn this disadvantage into an advantage.

MsgJp: ここだけの話――

砦に盗賊の親玉がいるなんてゾッとするな
まあ、ここには盗られる物は何もないから
気にすることはないか
MsgEn:
The thought of a bandit leader 
being in the fortress is frightening.
