unknown, we need to search the area!

MsgJp:
一歩進めば作戦を１つ忘れてしまいそうだ！
さ、急いで探しに行こう！
MsgEn:
With every step, I feel like I'll forget 
another part of the strategy! 
Let's hurry up and search!

MsgJp:
よし、<STG 451>で待ち合わせをしよう！
ボクもすぐに行くよ！
MsgEn:
Great, let's meet at <STG 451>! 
I'll be there shortly!

MsgJp:
はぁ――妙な作戦だが――
言いたいことはわかった
MsgEn:
Well, it's an odd strategy, but I 
get what you mean.

MsgJp:
まぁ任せとけよ
"見分け方"なら大丈夫だ
MsgEn:
Well, don't worry; I can handle 
the "methods of identification."

MsgJp:
俺たちにとって、大事なのは作戦の内容じゃない
"ソネル様が考えた作戦"っていう
事実だけなんだ
MsgEn:
To us, the crucial part isn't the 
strategy's content, but simply the 
fact that it's "the plan from Ser 
Sonel."

MsgJp:
これはまたすごい作戦ですね
さすがはソネル様！
MsgEn:
This is an incredible plan, 
just as one would expect from Ser Sonel!

MsgJp:
"わら"がたくさんある場所は
いくつか心当たりがありますから
仲間をかき集めて探しますよ
MsgEn:
I know a few spots with plenty of 
"straw," so I'll gather our allies and 
start searching!

MsgJp:
ソネル様の作戦に疑問を持つ兵などおりません
そうやってここまで戦ってきたのですから
MsgEn:
There are no soldiers who question Ser 
Sonel's strategy, for we have come this 
far by following it.

MsgJp: 聞いただけで鳥肌が立ちそうな作戦ですね！
MsgEn:
This plan sounds so intense it gives me 
goosebumps just listening to it!

MsgJp:
ただ私、ちょっとあの見た目が苦手なんです――
でも、なんとかがんばって集めたいと思います！
MsgEn:
I have to admit, that appearance makes me 
uncomfortable, but I'll try my best to collect 
them!

MsgJp:
だだ、だいじょうぶです！
直接見ないようにすれば――
MsgEn:
No, it's okay!
If you don't look directly at it...

MsgJp:
でも、それじゃあ
さすがに危ないでしょうか――
MsgEn:
But is that truly safe, I can't help but 
wonder...

MsgJp: なにやらソネル様の様子が変なんだ
MsgEn: There's something strange about Master Sonel.

MsgJp:
理由を聞いても
「これ以上話すとキミのことから忘れそうだ」
とおっしゃるばかりで、俺にはどうにも――
MsgEn:
I asked for a reason, but they just replied, 
"If I say any more, I may forget you."

MsgJp:
すまないけど、ソネル様の様子を
見てきてもらえないか？
MsgEn:
I apologize, but could you go check 
on Master Sonel's state for me?

MsgJp:
なるほど、そういうことだったのか！
無事に事が済んで良かったよ
MsgEn:
I see, so that's what happened!
I'm glad it all worked out.

MsgJp:
まぁ、作戦については
指示を受けた兵たちがなんとかするだろう
MsgEn:
Well, the soldiers instructed about 
the strategy will manage it somehow.

MsgJp:
あ、隊長じゃないか
もしかして、自分の部屋に
くつろぎに来たのかな？
MsgEn:
Ah, it's the captain! 
Are you perhaps here 
to unwind in your room?

MsgJp:
"あること"を研究中でね
隊長にも協力してもらえると助かるよ！
MsgEn:
I'm in the midst of researching 
"something." I'd appreciate 
the captain's assistance!

MsgJp:
さすがは隊長だ！
ではさっそく始めたいんだけど
MsgEn:
That's my captain!
Well, I'd like to get started right away.

MsgJp:
ちょっと準備もあるから
先に<SPOT 1093>へ向かってくれないかな 
ボクもすぐに出発するよ！
MsgEn:
I'm busy with some preparations, 
so please head to <SPOT 1093> 
first. I'll be on my way soon!

MsgJp:
隊長！　こっちこっち！
わざわざこんな所まですまないね！
MsgEn:
Captain! This way, this way! 
I apologize for bringing you 
all the way out to such a place!

MsgJp:
いろいろと実験してるうちに
手元にあるのがなくなってしまってね
MsgEn:
As I was conducting several experiments, 
I found myself running out of what I 
had available at hand.

MsgJp:
隊長にも、探すのを手伝って欲しいんだ
この実験が成功すれば
計画も軌道に乗せられる
MsgEn:
I want you to help me look for it too, 
Captain. If this experiment works, the 
plan can get back on track.

MsgJp: それじゃあ、よろしく頼んだよ！
MsgEn: Well then, I'm counting on you!

MsgJp:
よしよし、これだけあれば
なんとかなりそうだ！
MsgEn:
Good, with this much, 
it looks like we should be fine!

MsgJp:
さっそくキャンプに戻って
実験再開だ！
MsgEn:
Let's return to camp right away 
and continue the experiment!

MsgJp:
ありがとう隊長！
遠慮なく、"自分の部屋"で
モフモフしてくれたまえ！
MsgEn:
Thank you, Captain! 
Don't hesitate to get 
cozy in your room!

MsgJp:
あ、隊長！
今、テレパシーを送っていたところさ！
MsgEn:
Ah, Captain!
I was just sending you a telepathic message!

MsgJp:
ちょっと困ったことがあってね
<STG 1001>へ行こうと思うんだ
MsgEn:
There's something troubling me, 
so I'm thinking of going to 
<STG 1001>.

MsgJp:
事が事だからね
隊長にも一緒に来てほしい
MsgEn:
Considering the circumstances, 
I want you to join me too, Captain.

MsgJp:
"ある計画"に必要な情報があってね
それに関わる案件なんだ
<STG 1001> で待ってるよ
MsgEn:
I possess information essential 
for "a certain plan." 
It's related to the matter at hand.
I'll be waiting at <STG 1001>.

MsgJp:
彼が昨日から戻って来ないんだ
今まで何の連絡もなしに
予定より遅れることはなかった
MsgEn:
He hasn't come back since yesterday. 
There has never been a delay without 
contacting me before.

MsgJp:
もしもの時は――
ここで落ち合うことにしてるから
ボクはここに残らないといけない
MsgEn:
If things go wrong, 
this is where we agreed to meet, 
so I must stay here.

MsgJp:
すまないが、隊長は
最後に目撃された場所へ向かって欲しい
MsgEn:
I'm sorry, but I need you to go 
to where the captain was last seen.

MsgJp:
こんなことを頼めるのは隊長しかいないんだ
厄介をかけるけど、頼んだよ
MsgEn:
You're the only one I can rely on for this. 
I know it's a bother, but I'm trusting you.

MsgJp:
もしもの時は――
ここで落ち合うことにしてるから
ボクはここに残らないといけない
MsgEn:
If things go wrong, 
this is where we agreed to meet, 
so I must stay here.

MsgJp:
すまないが、隊長は
最後に目撃された場所へ向かって欲しい
MsgEn:
I'm sorry, but I need you to go 
to where the captain was last seen.

MsgJp:
こんなことを頼めるのは隊長しかいないんだ
厄介をかけるけど、頼んだよ
MsgEn:
You're the only one I can rely on for this. 
I know it's a bother, but I'm trusting you.

MsgJp:
あんたは――？
え、ソネル様の！
そうか、助かった
MsgEn:
Who are you—? 
Oh, you're one of Sonel's! 
Got it, that's a great relief.

MsgJp:
情報を手に入れたはいいが
敵に襲われてこのザマだ――
MsgEn:
I got the information, 
but I was assaulted by enemies, 
and now I'm in this state...

MsgJp:
追っ手が近くまで来ている
奴らをなんとかしてくれ！
MsgEn:
The pursuers are getting close.
Do something about them!

MsgJp:
あんた腕が立つんだな！
さすが、ソネル様が寄越しただけのことはある
驚いたよ
MsgEn:
You're quite skilled!
As expected from someone
sent by Master Sonel; I'm impressed.

MsgJp: 奴らさえなんとかなれば後は一人で大丈夫だ
MsgEn:
If we can handle those foes,
I'll be fine on my own after that.

MsgJp:
ソネル様に「"例の情報"が手に入った」
と伝えてくれ！
俺もすぐ戻る――ありがとよ！
MsgEn:
Inform Master Sonel that "the info"
has been acquired! I'll be back shortly—thanks!

MsgJp:
そうか、敵の追っ手に――
奴らも相当必死ということか
隊長に頼んで正解だったよ
MsgEn:
I see, the enemies are pursuing us—
they must be quite desperate.
It was wise to ask the captain.

MsgJp:
よし！　彼が持ち帰った情報と
研究中の土が完成すれば
アレの"品種改良"が可能なはずさ
MsgEn:
Alright! Now that we have the information
he brought back and the soil to study,
we should be able to "cultivate" that!

MsgJp:
火薬の爆発に耐える固さと小型化が伴えば
《熟成爆弾カボチャ》を使った
"あの計画"がようやく実現できる！
MsgEn:
Now with its miniaturized form and toughness
to endure explosive gunpowder,
we can finally implement "that plan"
using the "Ripened bomb pumpkin!"

MsgJp:
いやぁ、ありがとう隊長！
おかげで助かったよ！
MsgEn:
Well, thank you captain!
You've been a big help!

MsgJp:
覚者、ちょうどいいところに来てくれた――
緊急の頼みがある
MsgEn:
Arisen, you've come just in time—
I have an urgent favor to ask.

MsgJp:
ついさっきのことだ
俺が留守にしていた時を狙ったのか
この屋敷に空き巣が入ったようだ――
<NPC 691>が目撃したらしい
MsgEn:
It just occurred a little while ago. 
It seems they targeted this place while 
I was away, and a burglar broke in— 
<NPC 691> reportedly saw it happen.

MsgJp:
奴が言うには、犯人は複数犯らしい
侯爵家の宝なんてものならまだしも、万が一
<NPC 681>の罪の痕跡を持ち出されたら
とんでもないことになる
MsgEn:
He mentioned that there are likely several culprits. 
If they only took the marquis' treasure, 
it wouldn't be as bad, but if they 
expose evidence of <NPC 681>'s wrongdoings, 
there will be severe consequences.

MsgJp:
まだ遠くへは逃げていないはずだ
頼む、犯人捕獲に協力してくれ！
MsgEn:
They should not be too far away yet. 
I beg you, assist me in capturing the 
criminals!

MsgJp:
この<STG 474>に盗みに入るとは
世間知らずの間抜けな泥棒か
何らかの意図を持って犯行に及んだ組織犯か――
MsgEn:
Breaking into <STG 474> means 
either a foolish, ignorant thief or 
an organized crime group acting with 
some ulterior motive.

MsgJp:
とにかく、追わないことには始まらない
用意は良いか？
MsgEn:
Regardless, we must pursue them to 
get started. Are you all set?

MsgJp: はい
いいえ

泥棒どもはまだ
そう遠くには逃げていないはずだ
急いで捜索しよう
MsgEn:
The thieves likely haven't 
escaped too far. Let's 
quickly begin the search!

MsgJp:
<NPC 691>が言うには
忍び込んだ奴らは、鎧下姿だったらしい
つまり――今は
鎧を着込んで変装している可能性がある
MsgEn:
<NPC 691> mentioned that the 
intruders were in their 
undergarments. So, they 
might be in armor to hide 
their identities now.

MsgJp:
挙動不審な怪しい兵士が、おそらく犯人だ
逃げられる前に、全員捕まえてくれ――
頼んだぞ
MsgEn:
The soldier acting suspiciously
is likely the one responsible. 
Apprehend them all before they can get away— 
I trust you to handle it.

MsgJp:
まさか、憲兵隊時代を忘れられない
憲兵どもの犯行だったとはな――
MsgEn:
I never thought I'd still 
remember the Military Police days. 
So, it was their crime after all.

MsgJp:
大方、<NPC 681>の証拠を隠滅して
もう一度返り咲かせるつもりだったのだろう
MsgEn:
Most likely, they aimed to 
destroy the evidence of <NPC 681> 
and rise to power again.

MsgJp: 捜査は順調か？
まずい、もうあまり時間が無いぞ――
MsgEn: Shit, we don't have much time...

MsgJp: もうダメだ――手遅れだろう
MsgEn: It's no use—it's probably too late.

MsgJp:
よし
それじゃあ、<STG 461>で落ち合おう
MsgEn:
Okay,
I'll meet you at <STG 461> then.

MsgJp:
そうか――
準備ができたら、声をかけてくれ
あまり時間は無いぞ
MsgEn:
Well...
give me a shout when you're ready
We don't have much time.

MsgJp:
泥棒どもはまだそう遠くへ行っていないはずだ
急いで捜索しよう
MsgEn:
The thieves must not be far away. 
We should quickly start the search.

MsgJp:
挙動不審な怪しい兵士が、おそらく犯人だ
逃げられる前に、全員捕まえてくれ――
頼んだぞ
MsgEn:
The soldier acting suspiciously
is likely the one responsible. 
Apprehend them all before they can get away— 
I trust you to handle it.

MsgJp:
泥棒はまだ、そう遠くは行っていないはずだ
<STG 461>を捜査しに行こう
MsgEn:
The thieves shouldn't be too far away.
Let's go investigate <STG 461>.

MsgJp: な、なんでしょうか――？

ひぃぃぃぃっ！！
すみません、勘弁してください！
MsgEn: Eek! I'm sorry, please spare me!

MsgJp:
先輩に脅されてやったんですぅぅ！
命だけは、勘弁して――
MsgEn:
I was forced to do it by my senior! 
Just spare my life, please!

MsgJp:
ひぃぃぃぃっ！！
すみません、勘弁してください！
MsgEn: Eek! I'm sorry, please spare me!

MsgJp:
先輩に脅されてやったんですぅぅ！
命だけは、勘弁して――
MsgEn:
I was forced to do it by my senior! 
Just spare my life, please!

MsgJp:
<STG 474>？
――あぁ、見た見た
あっちに逃げて行ったよ
MsgEn:
<STG 474>?
—Ah, yes, I saw them.
They ran off in that direction.

MsgJp:
あー、くそ！
だから俺は盗賊の変装して
侵入しようって言ったんだ！
MsgEn:
Ugh, damn it! 
That's why I said we should 
disguise ourselves as thieves!

MsgJp:
あ、あんた――覚者さぁん！！
良いところに来たな！
MsgEn:
A-Arisen!! You!!
You've come to the right place!

MsgJp:
大変なことがあってよぉ
この屋敷に――い、いいやとにかく
メフィスさんに聞いてくれ！
MsgEn:
I've got a big problem.
In this mansion—ahh, well anyway,
Go ask Ser Mephis!

MsgJp:
ホント、いいところに来てくれたよ！
危うく俺が駆り出されるところだっ――
MsgEn:
You've really come to the right place!
I'm in danger of being dragged out...

MsgJp:
――い、いいやとにかく
メフィスさんに聞いてくれ！
大変なことがあったんだよ！
MsgEn:
Yeah, well, anyway.
Go ask Mephis!
I'm in a rough spot!

MsgJp:
よぉ、相棒――
ちょうど良いところに来てくれた
MsgEn:
Yo, cuz.
Just the place to be.

MsgJp:
実は、<NPC 681>の部屋を改装しているんだが
ちょっとばかり、資材が足りなくてな
<STG 636>に質の良いのを手配しているから
取りに行こうと思ってる
MsgEn:
Actually, I'm renovating a room for <NPC 681>
and I'm a little short on materials.
Since I've arranged for <STG 636>
to get some good quality stuff,
I'm going to go get it.

MsgJp: よかったら、付き合ってくれないか？
MsgEn: If you'd like, you can join me.

MsgJp:
ありがとな
戦いでも諜報でもない、こんな雑務に
付き合ってくれて――
MsgEn:
I appreciate you sticking with me 
through this tedious work, 
something that's neither combat nor spycraft...

MsgJp:
それじゃあ、<STG 636>で落ち合おう
待ってるぞ
MsgEn:
Alright then, let's meet at <STG 636>. 
I'll be waiting.

MsgJp: 困ったな――

――おお、来たか相棒
迷わず来られたか？
MsgEn:
—Oh, you made it, cuz.
Did you find your way without trouble?

MsgJp:
――実はな
ちょうど資材の採取場辺りで
オークとの戦闘があったようで
搬入が遅れているらしい
MsgEn:
—Actually, 
it seems there was a battle with orcs 
near the resource gathering site, 
so the deliveries are delayed.

MsgJp:
だが――
あれが無いと、改装作業が進まないんだ
MsgEn:
But—without it,
I can't proceed with the renovations.

MsgJp:
なぁ覚者、もし良かったらでいいんだが――
資材が余っていたら、分けてくれないか？
MsgEn:
Hey, Arisen, if it's alright with you,
can you spare some of your excess supplies?

MsgJp:
ちょうど資材の採取場辺りで
オークとの戦闘があったようで
搬入が遅れているらしい
MsgEn:
It seems there was a battle with orcs 
near the resource gathering site, 
so the deliveries are delayed.

MsgJp:
もし資材が余っていたら
分けてくれると助かるんだが――
MsgEn:
If you have any surplus materials, 
I would appreciate it if you could share them.

MsgJp:
おい、これ――
本当に良いのか？
MsgEn:
Hey, is this—
really a good idea?

MsgJp:
ははっ――これで改装作業が進むぞ
ありがとうな、相棒！
お前のおかげで<STG 474>は生まれ変わるぞ
MsgEn:
Haha—
With this, the renovation work will progress.
Thanks, cuz!
Thanks to you, <STG 474> will be reborn.

MsgJp:
と、言ってもいつになるかは分からんが――
気長に待っててくれよな
MsgEn:
Though I can't say when it'll be— 
please wait patiently.

MsgJp:
相棒――良い所に来たな！
少し気になることがあってな
MsgEn:
Cuz—We've arrived at a good spot! 
There's something I'm curious about.

MsgJp:
実は、<STG 133>へ資材調達に行った
<NPC 691>の帰りが遅すぎるんだ
アイツのことだ
どこかで道草食っているんだろうが――
MsgEn:
The truth is, someone went to <STG 133>
for materials, and <NPC 691> is really late.
Knowing them,
they must be goofing off somewhere...

MsgJp:
万一のことがあっては困る
一緒に探しに行ってくれないか？
MsgEn:
It would be troubling if something happened.
Could you go look for them with me?

MsgJp: やっぱり、お前は頼りになるよ
MsgEn: I knew I could count on you.

MsgJp:
それじゃあ、出かける準備を済ませてくれ
<STG 461>の入口で落ち合おう
MsgEn:
Well then, please get ready to head out.
Let's meet at the entrance of <STG 461>.

MsgJp: ――来たか

近くに大きな危険はないはずだから
二手に分かれて捜索しよう
MsgEn:
There shouldn't be any major dangers nearby, 
so let's split into two groups for the search.

MsgJp:
俺はメガド内の<NPC 691>が
よく行く場所を当たってみる
お前は、街の周辺を探してみてくれ
MsgEn:
I'll look for the places in Megado that <NPC 691>
frequents.
You can check the area around the city.

MsgJp:
近くに大きな危険はないはずだから
二手に分かれて捜索しよう
MsgEn:
There shouldn't be any major dangers nearby, 
so let's split into two groups for the search.

MsgJp:
俺はメガド内の<NPC 691>が
よく行く場所を当たってみる
お前は、街の周辺を探してみてくれ
MsgEn:
I'll look for the places in Megado that <NPC 691>
frequents.
You can check the area around the city.

MsgJp: あ、あんたは――覚者さん！？

絶妙なタイミングで来てくれたな！
メガドの周りにオークの残党が潜んでたみたいで
散歩してたら、
うっかり鉢合わせちまったんだ！
MsgEn:
Wow, you really came at the perfect time!
It seems that there were some leftover orcs
lurking around the area of Megado.
While I was taking a stroll,
I accidentally ran into them!

MsgJp: で、今追いかけまわされてるってワケ――
MsgEn: And now they're chasing after me...!

MsgJp:
って、ホラ！
噂をすればまた来たぞ！
MsgEn:
Look! 
Just like I said, here they come again!

MsgJp:
いやー、助かった――
まさか覚者さん、あんたが来てくれるとはな
まさに、"ヒーロー！"って感じだったぜ
MsgEn:
Wow, you really came to my rescue!
I didn't expect to see you, Arisen. It felt like
something straight out of a heroic tale!

MsgJp: で、なんでここに？

へ――メフィスが？
ひぇ！！

お、俺はちゃんと資材集めてたって！
その――ちょっと足をくじいちまったんで
休んでたんだよ
な、メフィスにそう伝えてくれよ
MsgEn:
Oh, I was actually gathering materials!
But, umm, I twisted my foot...
So I was resting.
C-Can you please tell that to Mephis?

MsgJp: 頼むぜ！

メガドにはいないようだった――
そっちはどうだ？
MsgEn:
It seems they weren't in Megado...
How about over there?

MsgJp:
なっ――
足をくじいただと？
あのバカ！
MsgEn:
Oh...
Did you sprain your ankle?
You idiot!

MsgJp:
全く、手のかかる奴だな――
だが無事なことは分かって良かったな
MsgEn:
Oh, you are quite a handful...
But I'm glad you're safe.

MsgJp:
手伝ってくれて、助かった
――これに懲りず、また訪ねてくれよ
MsgEn:
Thanks for your help and for your assistance.
—Don't let this stop you from visiting us again!

MsgJp:
北部のオークどもに動きがあったようだ――
お前も戦に備えて準備してくれ
MsgEn:
It seems the Orcs in the north are on the move—
You should prepare for battle as well.

MsgJp:
オークとの戦争がはじまったなら
再度、私の元に訪れてエントリー
しにきてくれ
MsgEn:
If the war with the Orcs has begun,
visit me once again and come to enlist.
I await your arrival.

MsgJp:
グリッテン砦にて戦争が始まるみたいです
レスタニアニュースで確認くださいね
MsgEn:
It looks like the war is starting at Fort Gritten.
Check it out on Lestania News!

MsgJp:
詳しい情報は《中央広場》にいる白衛騎士団の
アランさんをお訪ねください
MsgEn:
For more information, please visit Knight Alan
of the White Guard at the Central Plaza.

MsgJp:
グリッテン砦で戦争が始まるらしいですわ
弟は大丈夫かしら、心配だわ
MsgEn:
I've heard there's a war going on at Fort Gritten.
I hope my brother is ok, I'm worried about him.

MsgJp:
まもなく砦で戦がはじまるって本当ですか！？
あー私も覚者さまのようになって
戦場を駆け抜けてみたいな
MsgEn:
Is it true that a battle will soon
take place at the fortress?
Oh, I want to be like you, Arisen,
and charge into the fray!

MsgJp:
もうすぐグリッテンで戦がはじまるそうだ
戦場ではとにかく気を抜くなよ
MsgEn:
They say the battle will start soon in Gritten.
Don't get distracted on the battlefield.

MsgJp:
オークの奴らめ
何度攻め入ろうとも無駄なこと
次も返り討ちにしてくれる
MsgEn:
Those damned orcs!
No matter how many times they try to invade,
I'll beat them back again.

MsgJp:
ヒルデ姉さんには無理するなといわれているけれど
次の戦で戦果を上げて昇進したいと思っているんだ
MsgEn:
I know sister Hilde told me not to push myself
too hard, but I still want to excel in the next
battle and get promoted.

MsgJp:
戦は稼ぎ時でもあるんだ――
思い切って投資すれば
それだけ得られるものも大きいぞ
MsgEn:
War is a great time to make money...
If you take a risk and invest, you can get a lot
in return.

MsgJp:
グリッテン砦の防衛は
バートランド平原でも重要な任務だ
MsgEn:
The defense of Fort Gritten is also an important
mission in the Betland Plains.

MsgJp:
優秀な戦果を収めたものには
それに応じた報酬も与えられるので
ぜひ防衛隊に参加してくれ
MsgEn:
Those who achieve outstanding results 
will receive appropriate rewards,
so please join the defense force.

MsgJp:
オークどもがついにグリッテン砦に攻めてきたぞ！
覚者は防衛隊に参加し砦を守ってくれ
MsgEn:
Orcs have finally attacked Fort Gritten!
Arisen, join the defenders and protect the fort!

MsgJp:
挑める準備ができてるなら
さっそくミッションエントリーしてみてくれ
MsgEn:
If you're ready to take on the challenge,
participate in the mission right away.

MsgJp:
また自分の成果がどの程度なのかは
神殿内の各所にあるランキングボードを
確認するといい
MsgEn:
You can also check the ranking boards located
throughout the temple to see how well you did.

MsgJp:
ついに開戦したみたいです
気を付けて立派に戦ってきてください
MsgEn:
It looks like the war has finally started.
Take care and go fight honorably!

MsgJp:
詳しい情報はレスタニアニュースを
確認の上、《中央広場》にいる覚者隊の
アランさんをお訪ねください
MsgEn:
For more information, please check
the Lestania News and visit Ser Alan
of the Arisen Corps in the "Central Plaza"!

MsgJp:
覚者さま、弟を戦場で見かけた時は
どうか、そのお力でお守りくださいませ
MsgEn:
Arisen, when you see my brother
out on the battlefield, please, 
use your strength to protect him.

MsgJp:
覚者さま、ついに戦が始まったって聞きました
ご武運をお祈りしていますね！
MsgEn:
Master Arisen, 
I've heard that the battle has finally begun. 
I pray for your good fortune!

MsgJp:
グリッテンの戦況はよく確認して向かうのだ
そうすれば色々見えてくるものもあるだろう
活躍を期待しているぞ
MsgEn:
Make sure to assess the conditions
in Gritten before you go.
It will provide you with valuable insights. 
I expect great things from you.

MsgJp:
オーク相手に情けは無用だ
魔物もろとも斬り捨ててくれる
MsgEn:
Show no mercy to the orcs.
Cut them down along with the monsters.

MsgJp:
君、強そうだね
僕の隊で一緒に戦ってくれよ
MsgEn:
You seem strong.
Fight alongside me in my squad.

MsgJp:
凶悪な魔物は討伐評価も高くなる
倒せる自信があるなら
強敵との遭遇は幸運と捉えるべきだな
MsgEn:
Powerful monsters have a higher rate on subjugation.
If you're confident you can defeat them,
look upon the encounter with those
formidable foes as a stroke of good luck.

MsgJp:
この戦いで戦果をあげることによって
バートランド平原のエリアポイントも
得ることができる
MsgEn:
By securing victories in this fight, 
you'll also obtain area points for 
the Betland Plains.

MsgJp: 頑張って奮戦してくれ
MsgEn: Please fight bravely and do your best.

MsgJp:
何とか砦を守り切れたな
今は各位の戦果を確認中だ
MsgEn:
We were somehow able to defend the fort.
We are currently confirming each person's
contribution.

MsgJp:
報酬は後に与えられる
確認が終わるまで待っていてくれ
MsgEn:
The rewards will be given later.
Please wait until the confirmation is complete.

MsgJp: オーク軍を退けることができたみたいですね
MsgEn: It seems that we were able to repel the Orc army.

MsgJp:
グリッテンの戦も落ち着いたようですわね
弟も無事でなによりです
MsgEn:
It seems that the battle in Gritten
has also settled down. It is a relief
that my younger brother is safe.

MsgJp:
お怪我はありませんか！？
覚者さまやみんなのおかげで敵を撃退できたこと
すごくうれしく思います――
MsgEn:
Are you injured!?
Thanks to the Arisen and everyone's efforts,
we were able to repel the enemy.
I am ever grateful...

MsgJp:
敵を撃退できて何よりだ
戦場を共にに切り抜けた仲間と
肩を並べて飲む一杯は格別だ！
MsgEn:
I'm glad we were able to fight off the enemy!
It's a special thing to drink a cup of wine
shoulder-to-shoulder with new friends
who've made it through the battlefield together!

MsgJp:
よく頑張ってくれた
皆のおかげで撃退できたのだ
感謝する
MsgEn:
You did well and worked hard.
We were able to repel the enemy
thanks to everyone.
I am grateful.

MsgJp:
はぁーなんとか無事だったけれど
活躍どころじゃなかったよ
MsgEn:
Ah, I managed to make it through safely,
but I didn't really have a chance to shine.

MsgJp:
俺がコツコツ稼いだところで
強い奴等は一度の戦いで
1年分は稼いでいっちまうんだ
MsgEn:
Even if I diligently earn little by little,
the strong ones can earn a year's worth
in just one battle.

MsgJp:
どうだ、戦果は期待できそうか？
俺の活躍も副隊長の目にとまってくれていると
いいんだが――
MsgEn:
What do you think?
I hope my successes have also caught
the attention of the Vice Captain.

MsgJp:
グリッテン砦防衛の功績に対し報酬が出ているぞ
各位、保管ボックスより受け取ってくれ
MsgEn:
A reward is available for your achievements
in defending Fort Gritten.
Please collect it from the Storage Box.

MsgJp:
防衛隊に参加してくれたものだな
こたびの協力に感謝する――
報酬を受け取ってくれ
MsgEn:
It seems you joined the defense force.
We appreciate your assistance this time.
Please accept your rewards.

MsgJp:
戦果に応じた報酬が出ているみたいです
レスタニアニュースにて確認くださいね
MsgEn:
It looks like rewards are provided 
according to the battle results. 
Check Lestania News for details.

MsgJp:
先の戦いで功績のあった方には報酬が
出たそうですわ――

I heard that there was a reward for those
who made a difference in the last battle!

MsgJp:
でも私にとっては弟の元気な姿が
何よりの報酬です
MsgEn:
But for me, the best reward is to see
my brother in good health.

MsgJp:
戦場で活躍したみんなに報酬が

MsgEn:
It seems that everyone who performed well
on the battlefield received a reward!

MsgJp:
私もいつか、みなさんの隣りで
活躍できたらなって思うんです
MsgEn:
I dream of being able to contribute
alongside everyone one day.

MsgJp:

という話だ

I heard that rewards were given for your
achievements in the previous battle.

MsgJp:

MsgEn:
For me, as your mentor,
your success is most important to me.
Furthermore, the litany of ancient scars
on one's body brings me great pride.

MsgJp:
こたびの戦いの戦果に応じた報酬を配布中だ
防衛に参加してくれた全ての者は受け取ってくれ
MsgEn:
We are currently distributing rewards based on
the results of the battle.
Please make sure to claim your rewards if you
participated in the defense.

I got the reward, but this isn't enough 
to report back to my sister yet.

How much did you earn?
You gotta share some of that with me.

集まると思うと複雑なんだよなぁ――
MsgEn:
Have you already received your rewards?
I'm happy about your achievements,
but I can't help feeling conflicted when
the Vice Captain's attention is drawn to you.

MsgEn: I have come to meet you, golden warrior.

MsgJp: 覚者の命は値千金！　奪え！
MsgEn: The life of an Arisen is invaluable! Seize it!

MsgJp: 楽しませてくれる
まさか――この――俺が――
存分に楽しませてもらったぞ――

《竜の巣》の魔物は
レスタニアのそれとは訳が違う
特にドラゴンはなおさらだ！
MsgEn:
The monsters of the "Dragon's Nest"
are different from those of Lestania,
especially the dragons!

MsgJp:
今のうちに夢とロマンで
心を満たしておくといい！
恐怖でチャンスを逃すことのないようにな
MsgEn:
Fill your heart with dreams and romance
while you still can!
Don't let fear keep you from taking chances.

MsgJp:
開催期間になったら
再度、俺の元に参加を申し出てくれ！
MsgEn:
When the event is held again,
please come back and participate!

MsgJp: ゼルキンさんが船の準備をはじめたそうよ
MsgEn:
It seems that Zerkin has started
preparing the ship.

MsgJp:
危ないことはしないでほしいけれど
夢を追いかけることは素敵なことですよね
MsgEn:
I don't want you to do anything dangerous, but...
it's nice to follow your dreams, isn't it?

MsgJp:
詳しい情報はレスタニアニュースを
確認の上、神殿内の《港洞》の船上にいる
ゼルキンさんをお訪ねください
MsgEn:
For more information,
please check the Lestania News and visit Zerkin,
who is on board the ship in the "Cave Harbor" 
within the Temple.

MsgJp:
船長はバカほど海とロマンを愛してるんだ
おっとあんたもその口だったけか
MsgEn:
Captains love the sea and romance
as much as any fool.
Oh wait, you're one of them, aren't you?

MsgJp: ま、俺もそうだがよ――
MsgEn: Well, I'm the same, you know...

MsgJp:
うん、まもなく船の修理もおわり出航の準備も
整いつつあるよ
MsgEn:
Yes, the repairs on the ship will be
finished soon and preparations for departure
are also coming together.

MsgJp:
君も《竜の巣》に渡るつもりなら十分に仕度すると
いいね
MsgEn:
If you're looking cross over
to the "Dragon's Nest" as well,
you'd better be well-prepared.

MsgJp:
《竜の巣》に向かう船の準備で
港もいつもより活気がありますよね
MsgEn:
When the ships start getting ready to head to the
"Dragon's Nest", the Harbor is always more lively
than usual.

MsgJp:
《竜の巣》では覚者の力をもってしても
まともに太刀打ちできんだろう
MsgEn:
Even with the power of Arisen,
one may not be able to stand a chance
in the "Dragon's Nest".

MsgJp:
だが、上手くやれば名を上げられる
上手くやれなくても誇れる挑戦を手にできる
心が決まれば、船はいつでも出そうではないか！
MsgEn:
But if you do well,
you can make a name for yourself.
If you don't, you can still get a challenge
that you can be proud of.
If your heart is set on it,
the ship can always set sail any time!

MsgJp:
挑もうという覚悟と準備ができたなら
さっそくミッションエントリーしてくれ
MsgEn:
If you've got the mettle to take it on,
enter the mission without delay!

MsgJp:
また自分の成果がどの程度なのかは
神殿内の各所にあるランキングボードを
確認するといい
ほら、ロマンが呼んでいるぞっ！！
MsgEn:
You can also check the ranking boards located
throughout the Temple to see how well you did.

MsgJp:
ついに洋撃船が出航するそうですよ！
港の方々は大忙しです
MsgEn:
It seems that the Western Expedition ship
will finally set sail!
The people at the port are very busy.

MsgJp:
覚者さまも行かれるのですか？
無事帰ってきてお話聞かせてくださいね
MsgEn:
Will you be going, Arisen?
Please return safely and tell us your story.

MsgJp:
詳しい情報はレスタニアニュースを
確認の上、神殿内の《港洞》の船上にいる
ゼルキンさんをお訪ねください
MsgEn:
For more information,
please check the Lestania News and visit Zerkin,
who is on board the ship in the "Cave Harbor"
within the Temple.

MsgJp:
さぁ、洋撃船はいつでも出航できるぜ
《竜の巣》に渡りたいモノ好きどもがいればの
話だがな――
MsgEn:
Come on, our ocean-going ship is ready to sail.
If there are those who want to cross over to the
"Dragon's Nest," this may be your opportunity...

MsgJp:
けど、あんた
もしも行って戻ってこれたら
話ぐらいは聞かせてくれよな
MsgEn:
Though, when you come back,
at least tell us your story.

MsgJp:
いよいよ出航だね――
僕はこの時の港の雰囲気がたまらなく好きなんだ
MsgEn:
It's finally time to set sail, huh――
I really love the atmosphere of the port at this time.

MsgJp: 覚者さまも《竜の巣》に向かうのですか？
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen, are you also heading to the Dragon's
Nest?

MsgJp:
あそこに行くのは
よほど腕の立つ奴かただの命知らずだって
船乗りの兄はよく言っていました
MsgEn:
My brother, who is a sailor, used to say that the
only people who go there are either very skilled
or just plain daredevils.

MsgJp:
今は《竜の巣》での戦果の確認中だ！
働いた分の報酬は出るから、そう焦るな
MsgEn:
I am currently verifying the results
of our battle at the Dragon's Nest!
Don't worry, you will receive your rewards for
the work you've done, so there's no need to rush.

MsgJp: 《竜の巣》で大きな戦果をあげた人がいるようです
MsgEn:
It seems that someone has achieved great results
at the Dragon's Nest.

MsgJp:
もしかして、覚者さまが大活躍されたんですか？
ゼルキンさんからの発表が待ち遠しいですね
MsgEn:
Could it be that the Arisen
has made a great contribution?
I can't wait for Zerkin's announcement.

MsgJp: 船長が《竜の巣》で戦果をあげたものを確認中だ
MsgEn:
The captain is currently confirming
the achievements at the Dragon's Nest.

MsgJp:
《竜の巣》なんざぁ俺は行きたくないが
あそこでく繰り広げられた冒険譚を聞くのが
楽しみなんだよ
MsgEn:
I don't want to go to the "Dragon's Nest",
but I'm looking forward to hearing about the
adventures that took place there.

MsgJp:
今回もまた船が派手に壊れちゃったなぁ
さっそく修理に必要な見積もりを出さなくちゃ
MsgEn:
Once again,
the ship has been spectacularly destroyed.
I must promptly request an estimate for repairs.

MsgJp:
船が無事に帰ってきてうれしいです
いったいどんな冒険が繰り広げられたのでしょうか？
MsgEn:
I am glad the ship returned safely.
I wonder what kind of adventure unfolded there?

MsgJp:
ああ、今回の取り分は送っておいたぞ！
保管ボックスから確認してくれ
MsgEn:
Ah, I've already sent your share for this time!
Please check it from the Storage Box.

MsgJp:
あそこはとんでもなく危険なのにまた行きたくなる
そうだろう？　覚者よ！
MsgEn:
It's a terribly dangerous place there, isn't it?
Yet you still want to go there, Arisen!

MsgJp:
また次の航海を思い描けば船の修理にも
自ずと精が出るというものだ！
がはははは！
MsgEn:
Just imagining the next voyage ahead
brings vigor to the ship repairs as well!
It's natural for spirits to rise, isn't it?
Gahahaha!

MsgJp:
おぅ、丁度、戦果の集計がついたとこだ
これはあんたの報酬だ、受け取りな
MsgEn:
Oh, just in time.
The results of the battle have been tallied.
This is your reward. Take it.

MsgJp: 覚者さまのお名前も載っていると良いですね
MsgEn:
It would be nice to have the name of the Arisen
included as well.

MsgJp:
ゼルキンさんからのお知らせが
レスタニアニュースに載っています
MsgEn:
There is an announcement from Zerkin
in the Lestania News.

MsgJp:
あんた、ドラゴンや魔物はどうだった！？
今度一杯ご馳走するから
ゆっくり話を聞かせてくれよな
MsgEn:
How were the dragons and monsters?!
I'll treat you to a drink next time,
so take your time and tell me your story.

MsgJp:
船長は手に入れた報酬を
毎回、次の航海の資金にしている
MsgEn:
The captain uses the rewards obtained
each time as funds for the next voyage.

MsgJp:
ほんとあきれるけど
その情熱には感服するよ
MsgEn: It's truly astounding, but I admire that passion.

MsgJp: 海と冒険と竜との戦い、ロマンですよね――
MsgEn:
The sea, adventure, and battles with dragons,
it's all so romantic, isn't it?

MsgJp: 勇敢なる覚者よ、竜族を狙うのだ！
MsgEn: Brave Arisen, aim for the Dragonkin!

MsgJp: さすれば大物、エルダードラゴンをおびき出せるはずだ！
MsgEn:
If we do that, we should be able to lure out a
formidable creature, the Elder Dragon!

MsgJp: 《時番》を発見したら優先的に討伐するのだ！
MsgEn:
When you find a [Time Bonus] enemy, prioritize
defeating it!

MsgJp: 奴らを倒せば残り時間が延長されるぞ
MsgEn: Defeating them will extend the remaining time!

MsgJp: おお！　ついにエルダードラゴンのお出ましだ！
MsgEn:
Oh! The Elder Dragon has finally made an
appearance!

MsgJp: 覚者たちよ、戦果を目指すなら討伐だ！
MsgEn:
Arisen, if you aim for achievements in battle,
focus on defeating it!

MsgJp: 勇敢なる覚者よ、竜族を狙うのだ！
MsgEn: Brave Arisen, aim for the Dragonkin!

MsgJp: さすれば大物、エルダードラゴンをおびき出せるはずだ！
MsgEn:
If we do that, we should be able to lure out a
formidable creature, the Elder Dragon!

MsgJp: 《時番》を発見したら優先的に討伐するのだ！
MsgEn:
When you find a [Time Bonus] enemy, prioritize
defeating it!

MsgJp: 奴らを倒せば残り時間が延長されるぞ
MsgEn: Defeating them will extend the remaining time!

MsgJp: おお！　ついにエルダードラゴンのお出ましだ！
MsgEn:
Oh! The Elder Dragon has finally made an
appearance!

MsgJp: 覚者たちよ、戦果を目指すなら討伐だ！
MsgEn:
Arisen, if you aim for achievements in battle,
focus on defeating it!

MsgJp: 3種の宝石を集めると、より強大な竜が現れるという噂だ
MsgEn:
Rumor has it that when you collect three types of
Gems, a more powerful dragon will appear.

MsgJp: さらなる大物を狙うならば、挑戦するがいい！
MsgEn: If you want to go even bigger, go for it!

MsgJp:
噂の大物が現れたぞ！
《エルダードラゴン・ブレイズ》のおでましだ！
MsgEn:
The rumored big fish has appeared! It's the Elder
Dragon Blaze!

MsgJp: 討伐できれば戦功をはずむぞ！
MsgEn: If we can subdue them, it will earn us War Merit!

MsgJp: 勇敢なる覚者よ、竜族を狙うのだ！
MsgEn: Brave Arisen, aim for the Dragonkin!

MsgJp: さすれば大物、エルダードラゴンをおびき出せるはずだ！
MsgEn:
If we do that, we should be able to lure out a
formidable creature, the Elder Dragon!

MsgJp: 《時番》を発見したら優先的に討伐するのだ！
MsgEn:
When you find a [Time Bonus] enemy, prioritize
defeating it!

MsgJp: 奴らを倒せば残り時間が延長されるぞ
MsgEn: Defeating them will extend the remaining time!

MsgJp: おお！　ついにエルダードラゴンのお出ましだ！
MsgEn:
Oh! The Elder Dragon has finally made an
appearance!

MsgJp: 覚者たちよ、戦果を目指すなら討伐だ！
MsgEn:
Arisen, if you aim for achievements in battle,
focus on defeating it!

MsgJp:
南の森で恐ろしい魔物を見たという
噂が広がっている
MsgEn:
People have been talking about seeing a terrible
monster in the southern forests.

MsgJp:
まもなく討伐が開始されるだろう――
おまえも参加するならば
準備しておくといい――
MsgEn:
The hunt will begin shortly.
If you're joining in too, be prepared...

MsgJp:
討伐が開始されたなら
再度、私の元に訪れてエントリー
しにきてくれ
MsgEn:
Once the hunt has begun,
visit me once again and come to enlist.
I await your arrival.

MsgJp:
ローガンさんが討伐準備をしている魔物は
異界を渡る力を持つそうです
MsgEn:
The monster that Ser Logan is preparing
to subdue seems to have the power
to travel through different realms.

MsgJp:
多くの覚者さまの力が必要になるため
是非協力してあげて下さいね
MsgEn:
We will need the power of many Arisen for this,
so please lend us your assistance.

MsgJp:
詳しい情報は
《商店区》にある白衛騎士団の詰所にいる
ローガンさんをお訪ねください
MsgEn:
For more information, please visit Ser Logan
at the White Knights' Headquarters
in the Shopping District.

MsgJp:
そういえば、《古の祭祀場》に
強い竜力の淀みが発生していることは
知っている？
MsgEn:
By the way, were you aware
that there is Dragon Force accumulating
in the "Ancient Place of Rituals"?

MsgJp:
オールドグロウエントか、それより
もっと恐ろしい何かか――
MsgEn:
Old Grove Ent, was it?
Or something even more terrifying?

MsgJp:
白衛騎士団も確認に動いているそうよ
神殿の騎士団本部にも
情報を取りに行ってみて
MsgEn:
The White Knights are working to confirm this.
You can also go to the Knights Headquarters
in the Temple to get more information.

MsgJp:
対峙した者の話によれば
相手はケタ違いの化け物らしい
MsgEn:
According to those who have confronted it,
our adversary is of a different caliber.

MsgJp:
命を落とすことのないよう
十分気をつけて戦ってくれ
MsgEn:
Please fight with utmost care,
should you perish.

MsgJp:
挑める準備ができてるなら
さっそくミッションエントリーしてみてくれ
MsgEn:
If you're ready to take on the challenge,
participate in the mission right away.

MsgJp:
また自分の成果がどの程度なのかは
神殿内の各所にあるランキングボードを
確認するといい
MsgEn:
You can also check the ranking boards located
throughout the temple to see how well you did.

MsgJp:
ローガンさんが討伐隊を
動かし始めたみたいです
MsgEn: Ser Logan looks to be preparing for a hunt.

MsgJp:
詳しい情報はレスタニアニュースを確認の上
《商店区》にある白衛騎士団の詰所にいる
ローガンさんをお訪ねください
MsgEn:
For more information, please check the Lestania
News and visit Ser Logan at the White Knights'
Headquarters in the "Shopping District".

MsgJp:
《古の祭祀場》に、恐ろしい魔物が
姿を現したの！
いつものエントなど比較にならない
強大な魔物よ
MsgEn:
A terrible monster has appeared
in the Ancient Place of Rituals!
It's a mighty monster that can't be compared to
the usual Ent...

MsgJp:
今、神殿の騎士団本部が中心となって
討伐隊を組織しているわ
MsgEn:
Right now the headquarters of the Temple Knight
Order is leading the way in organizing a hunting
party.

MsgJp:
貴方もぜひ力を貸して！
このミスリウのためにも――
MsgEn:
Please lend your strength as well!
For the sake of Mysree, too...

MsgJp:
討伐に参加してくれた
多くの勇気ある戦士達のおかげで
あの化け物を退けることができた
MsgEn:
Thanks to the brave soldiers who participated in
the subjugation, we were able to repel that
monster.

MsgJp: 心から礼を言わせてもらうよ
MsgEn: I want to thank you from the bottom of my heart.

MsgJp:
森に現れた魔物を
退けることができたそうです
MsgEn:
We hear that they were able to repel the monster
that appeared in the forest.

MsgJp:
レスタニアニュースでも
取り上げられていますよ
MsgEn: It has also been featured in Lestania News.

MsgJp:
先の森の
魔物討伐における報酬を支給している
MsgEn:
The reward for the forest monsters hunt is
currently being distributed.

MsgJp:
まだのものは
保管ボックスから受け取ってくれ
MsgEn:
Please retrieve the items that are still in the
storage box.

MsgJp:
先の戦闘評価が終わっている――
報酬を支給するので受け取ってくれ
MsgEn:
The previous combat evaluation has ended. Please
collect the reward.

MsgJp: 先の魔物討伐の戦果が発表されています
MsgEn:
The outcome of the previous enemy subjugation has
been announced.

MsgJp:
報酬も支給されていますので
レスタニアニュースにて確認くださいね
MsgEn:
Rewards are also being paid, so please check it
out on Lestania News!

MsgJp: 永遠不変をうそぶく厚顔なる白竜と覚者よ――
MsgEn:
Oh, the arrogant white dragon, who claims to be
eternal—, and you, Arisen――

MsgJp:
永遠なるは我が輝き、不変なるは我が志し――
思い知るがよい――
MsgEn:
My radiance is eternal, my determination
unwavering. You shall come to know this.

MsgJp:
うつろう世にしがみつく
哀れなる白竜と覚者よ――
MsgEn:
Oh pitiful White Dragon and Arisen, clinging to
this fleeting world...

MsgJp:
白がくすみ人が絶えても我が輝きは不滅――
この黄金こそが永遠の象徴――
MsgEn:
Even if the white fades and people disappear, my
brilliance is everlasting.
This gold is a symbol of eternity.

MsgJp: 世界は我が物と信じて疑わぬ白竜と覚者よ――
MsgEn:
O, white dragon who believes the world is theirs
without doubt, and you, Arisen――

MsgJp:
教えてやろう
貴様らが信じる理のもろさを――
MsgEn:
Allow me to show you the fragility of the world
order you believe in.

MsgJp:
伝説で語り継がれた黄金に輝く竜が
空で待っているそうだ
MsgEn:
It is said that a legendary dragon, shining with
golden light, awaits in the sky.

MsgJp:
相手は想像を絶する化け物だ
今から準備をはじめておくといい――
MsgEn:
The enemy is an unimaginable monster.
It's best to start preparing now--

MsgJp:
討伐が開始されたなら
再度、私の元に訪れてエントリー
しにきてくれ
MsgEn:
If the hunt has begun, visit me once again and
come to enlist.
I await your arrival.

MsgJp: 黄金の竜の討伐準備が進んでいます
MsgEn:
Preparations for the defeat of the Golden Dragon
are underway.

MsgJp:
一匹の魔物の討伐とは思えない
大部隊による長期戦になるそうです
MsgEn:
It doesn't seem it'll be like defeating a single
monster.
It appears it will be a long-term battle waged by
a large force.

MsgJp:
それでも――
伝説の竜を打ち倒すことなんて
できるのでしょうか
MsgEn:
Even so...
Is it possible to strike down the legendary
dragon?

MsgJp:
詳しい情報は《商店区》の
海辺の見える竜の礎前にいる
ハンコックさんをお訪ねください
MsgEn:
For more information, please visit Mr. Hancock in
the Shopping District near the Dragon's Portcrystal
with a view of the seashore.

MsgJp: いよいよ生ける伝説、黄金竜との決戦だ
MsgEn:
It's finally the decisive battle with the living
legend, the Golden Dragon.

MsgJp:
この戦いは奴が倒れるまで戦いは引き継がれる
最後まであきらるな
MsgEn:
This battle will not be over until they are
defeated.
We must not give up, no matter how long it takes.

MsgJp:
挑める準備ができてるなら
さっそくミッションエントリーしてみてくれ
MsgEn:
If you're ready to take on the challenge,
participate in the mission right away.

MsgJp:
また自分の成果がどの程度なのかは
神殿内の各所にあるランキングボードを
確認するといい
MsgEn:
You can also check the ranking boards located
throughout the temple to see how well you did.

MsgJp:
黄金の竜の討伐遠征が
始まっています
MsgEn:
The expedition to defeat the Golden Dragon has
begun.

MsgJp:
詳しい情報はレスタニアニュースを確認の上
《商店区》の海辺の見える竜の礎前にいる
ハンコックさんをお訪ねください
MsgEn:
For more information, please check Lestania News
and visit ser Hancock in the Shopping District
near the Dragon's Portcrystal with a view of the
seashore.

MsgJp: 戦果の報告をまとめているところだ
MsgEn:
I'm in the process of summarizing the results of
the battle.

MsgJp:
報酬はその後支給するので
待っていてくれ
MsgEn:
The reward will be distributed afterwards, please
wait.

MsgJp: 遠征が終わったようですね
MsgEn: It seems that the expedition has come to an end.

MsgJp: 本当にあの黄金の竜を倒せたのでしょうか――
MsgEn: Did we really manage to defeat the Golden Dragon?

MsgJp:
先の黄金竜討伐に対する
報酬を支給中だ
MsgEn:
Rewards for the recent defeat of the Golden
Dragon are now being distributed.

MsgJp: 保管ボックスより受け取ってくれ
MsgEn: Please retrieve it from the Storage Box.

MsgJp:
黄金竜討伐の戦果に対する
報酬を支給する
MsgEn:
The reward for the successful elimination of the
Golden Dragon.

MsgJp: 協力に感謝する――ありがとう
MsgEn: We appreciate your cooperation. Thank you.

MsgJp:
先の遠征における戦果が
発表されています
MsgEn:
The results of the recent expedition have been
published.

MsgJp:
報酬も支給されていますので
レスタニアニュースより確認くださいね
MsgEn:
Rewards are being paid, so please check it out in
Lestania News!

MsgJp: 完全なる者たちは何処に――

我に完全を与える主よ――
ここにはいないのか――
MsgEn:
O Lord, grant me perfection—
Is it not here—

MsgJp:
戦いは永遠を知る方便――
空しさなど覚えるものか――
MsgEn:
Battle is the means to know eternity――
Why remember emptiness――

MsgJp:
私の予感だが、ほどなくレスタニアに
暗雲が立ち込めようとしている
MsgEn:
I have a feeling that soon, a dark cloud will
loom over Lestania.

MsgJp:
これは凶悪な魔物があらわれる前兆だ
気をつけるといい
MsgEn:
This is an omen of the coming of a vicious demon.
Be careful.

MsgJp:
魔物が姿を現したならば
再度、私の元を訪れて
討伐隊への参加を期待しているぞ
MsgEn:
If the monsters show themselves, I hope you'll
visit me again and join the hunt team!

MsgJp:
レスタニアで恐ろしい気配を感じたという
噂が流れています
MsgEn:
Rumors are circulating of a frightening presence
in Lestania.

MsgJp:
詳しい情報は
《商店区》にいるコーネリアさんを
お訪ねください
MsgEn:
For more information, please visit ser Cornelia
in the "Shopping District"

MsgJp:
つい最近、レスタニアで
恐ろしい魔物の気配を感じたという
報告が舞い込んできたのだ
MsgEn:
We have recently received reports of a terrifying
demonic presence in Lestania.

MsgJp:
恐るべき魔力の息吹を持つという噂もある
十分に気を付けるといい
MsgEn:
There are rumors that it possesses a breath of
fearsome magickal power. It would be wise to be
extremely cautious.

MsgJp:
挑める準備と覚悟ができたなら
さっそく討伐隊に参加してくれ
ファビオ様は重大な用ゆえ
私が窓口を任されている
MsgEn:
If you are prepared and ready for the challenge,
please join the hunting party right away.
Lord Fabio has urgent matters to attend to, so I
have been entrusted with handling the
arrangements.

MsgJp:
また自分の成果がどれほどなのかは
神殿内の各所にあるランキングボードを
確認するといい
MsgEn:
Also, you should check the ranking boards located
throughout the Temple to see how well you did.

MsgJp:
恐るべき異界の魔物の気配が
確認されているそうです
MsgEn:
It seems that the presence of fearsome enemy
creatures from the Other World has been confirmed.

MsgJp:
詳しい情報はレスタニアニュースを確認の上
《商店区》にいるコーネリアさんを
お訪ねください
MsgEn:
For detailed information, please check Lestania
News, then visit Ms. Cornelia in the Commercial
District.

MsgJp:
何とか退けることができたようだな
さすがだ、覚者よ
MsgEn:
It seems that you were able to somehow fend it
off. Truly impressive, Arisen.

MsgJp:
戦果を集計しているところだ
報酬支給はもう少し時間をくれ
MsgEn:
We are currently tallying the results of the
battle. Please give us a little more time for
reward distribution.

MsgJp:
ただいま魔物と交戦した方々の戦果を
集計しています
MsgEn:
We are currently calculating the results of those
who have fought monsters just now.

MsgJp: 発表まで今しばらくお待ちください
MsgEn:
Please wait a little longer until the
announcement.

魔物討伐の報酬が支給されている

MsgEn:

MsgJp: 先の魔物討伐の戦果が発表されています

MsgEn:
Rewards are also being paid, so please check it
out on Lestania News!

MsgJp: オマイラ――覚えとけよ！
おいおい――調子にのるなって
MsgEn: Hey hey, don't get carried away.

MsgJp: 腐ってもやっぱり覚者か！？
MsgEn:
Even if you're rotten, you're still an Arisen,
huh!?

MsgJp:
２つ以上のミッションには
エントリーできないぞ
MsgEn: You can't enter more than one mission!

MsgJp:
先にエントリーしている方のミッションを
終わらせるか、エントリーを取り消して
再度こちらに来るんだ
MsgEn:
Either finish the mission you've already entered,
or cancel your entry, then come back again.

ボルド大坑道へ調査にいったゲルト団長から
緊急指令が届いているんだ
MsgEn:
I've got an urgent order from Commander Gerd, who
went to the Volden Large Tunnels to investigate.

MsgJp:
準備を整えたら、ミッションエントリーをしてくれ
俺も共に向かうぞ
MsgEn:
Once you're ready, please enter the mission.
I will also join you.

MsgJp:
――先のミッションで物凄い戦果を
挙げたそうだな
MsgEn:
I heard you achieved an amazing victory in the
previous mission.

MsgJp:
特別なアビリティを与えるよう言われている
ふん――役に立つと良いがな
MsgEn:
I've been told to give you a special Augment.
Well, I hope it proves useful.

MsgJp:
ボルド大坑道でのミッション、ご苦労だったな
――助かった、礼をいう
MsgEn:
Thank you for your hard work on the Volden Large
Tunnels mission. I am grateful for your help.

MsgJp:
戦果についての確認が終わり次第
保管ボックスにて報酬を受け取れるようになる
受け取りを忘れるなよ
MsgEn:
After the results have been confirmed, you will
be able to receive your reward in the Storage Box.
Don't forget to pick it up.

MsgJp: 魔赤島にアルタード・ズールが現れた
MsgEn: An Altered Zuhl has appeared on Bloodbane Isle.

MsgJp:
こんなことを覚者に頼むのも癪だが――
かなり切迫した状況だ
MsgEn:
Even though it pains me to have to burden the
Arisen with this, it's a very desperate situation.

して欲しい

Join the mission, now, please.
...Stop them!

over there first, and then come here again.

今回も何とか魔物を退けたな

MsgEn:
Once again, we managed to drive away the monsters.
Thank you for your cooperation.

storage box to those whose mission achievements

MsgJp:

多くの戦果を挙げた貴君に対して
特別なアビリティが送られることになった
MsgEn:

accomplishments achieved in that last battle,
you will receive a special Augment.

MsgJp: ぜひ受け取ってくれ――

"シェドレアン大神殿"での問題を
解決してくれたみたいね！
アデルドナハからも、礼をいっておいてくれと
言われたよ――
MsgEn:
It seems like you solved the problem
that beset the Shadolean Great Temple!
Adair Donnchadh told me to thank you...

MsgJp:
今は戦果の分析中だから
もうしばらく待っていてちょうだい
MsgEn:

MsgJp:
今回のミッションでは物凄いはたらきを

MsgJp:
街道のはずれに、崩れかけた城壁があるでしょう？
そのあたりで騎士団の団員が、物思いの顔で

On the outskirts of the street,
there's a crumbling castle wall, right? 
It seems that a member of the Knights' Order
has been standing there with a pensive look for a while. 
Recently, they've been conducting preliminary
investigations of suspicious places
and patrolling the houses in the area. 
I wonder if something has happened.

MsgJp:
商売人として成功したいなら
人の弱みにこそ商機があるって思えなくちゃね
私？　残念ながら、あまりその素質はないかも
こないだも道端で困っている風なご同業がいたけど
なんて言えばいいかわからなくて、通り過ぎたんだ
自分の思い切りのなさに、ほんと呆れるよ
MsgEn:
If you want to succeed as a business person,
you have to see the opportunities in other people's weaknesses.
As for me? Unfortunately, I may not have much of that talent.
The other day, I passed by a fellow professional
who seemed to be in trouble on the street,
but I didn't know what to say, so I just walked past.
I'm truly amazed at my own lack of initiative.

MsgJp:
困っている人がいたら、どうするかって？
そんなの放っとくに決まってるだろ
この世界、親切なヤツほど早死にするのさ
昨日見かけた騎士風の男も、しかめっ面でこっちを
見てくるから、とっとと離れてやったよ

MsgEn:
If someone is in trouble, what would you do?
Well, obviously you just leave them be.
In this world, the kind ones tend to die young.
Even that knight-like man I saw yesterday,
he frowned and looked at me, so I left quickly.
What do they expect from my frail body?

結婚を約束していた彼女が姿を消してからもう半年
僕の心はまだ癒えず、思い出の場所であるあの草原に

MsgEn:
It has been half a year since she, 
whom I had promised to marry, disappeared.
My heart is still not healed, 
so I went to that grassland, a place of memories.
Yesterday, I went there again,
And then, suddenly, 
I heard a voice from beyond the hill— 

Was that the growl of a monster, or... 
No, I know it's just my imagination.

MsgJp:
いままで家族全員、つつましくやってきました
多くを望まず、日々祈りを欠かさず――
それなのに、この３日だけで６回ですよ！
魔物の影に追われ、声に怯え、気配に身を竦ませ――
いったい私たちがどんな罪を犯したのですか！
もうこの地に留まる事はできません
MsgEn:
We have lived modestly with our whole family until 
now, desiring little and never missing a prayer.
Yet, in just these three days, six times!
Chased by the shadows of monsters,
terrified by the sounds, 
shivering at every presence—
what sin have we committed?
We can no longer stay here.

MsgJp:
あれは旅の資金が尽きたうえ雨に降られて
やむなく地下に潜ったときの話だ
深く立ち入らなければ安全だろうと思っていたら
奥の方から唸り声みたいなものが聞こえて――
だんだん近づいて来たんだ
驚いて、思わず外へ飛び出しちまったよ
MsgEn:
When our travel funds ran out and we were caught in the rain, we had no choice but to take refuge underground. 
I thought it would be safe as long as we didn't go too deep, 
but then I started hearing a growling noise from further in—
and it kept getting closer. 
I was so startled that I ended up rushing outside.

I want to test its power, so I'm looking for

need them. I heard that there are frequent sightings of 
enemies, so I came to check it out.

MsgEn:
Around the plains' highway, 
there was a slightly hesitant Arisen. 
Those who shy away from jumping into danger 
and rely on others, 
how will they ever amount to anything? 
What is the purpose of "living forever"? 

Well, it's troublesome when someone recklessly 
plunges in without thinking ahead, though.

when I go to different parts of Lestania to check

Last time, I went to encourage a unit that was 
troubled by frequent monster attacks. 
The hardships of the battlefield are best known 
by the leaders on the ground. 
I want to support them as much as possible, but 
manpower shortage is a serious issue everywhere. 
In these circumstances, 
it is necessary to cooperate with the Arisen.

such a thing could definitely happen, hehe.

By the way, do you like cemeteries?
Quiet, eerie, sorrowful, and pessimistic!
Truly the perfect location.
But sometimes, insensitive people come just to 
hunt monsters and stain it with unnecessary blood.
I wouldn't want to be buried in the same cemetery 
as those people, even in death.

individual enemy creatures has weakened.

energy still lingers, only a few are aware of it.

魔物どもを見つけても勝手に追いたてるんじゃねえ

I will declare it here.

have come to Dreed Castle,

Don't you dare chase away monsters on your own.
Anyone who gets in my way, 
even if they're fellow adventurers,

ドリード城を定例巡回している同僚も、
行くたびに新しいネタを聞かされるらしい
こないだは――あれ？　何だったかな
空飛ぶヨロイ、動くガイコツ、響く悪魔の歌声――
まあそんな感じの、珍しくもないネタだったと思う
MsgEn:
Ghosts stories are always associated with old castles.
My colleague, who regularly patrols Dreed Castle,
always seems to hear new stories 
every time he goes.

The other day... hmm, what was it again?
Flying armor, moving skeletons, 
the echoing voice of a demon's song...
Well, it was just a typical, 
not-so-unusual story, I think.

inexperienced hunters who desire items 
beyond their capabilities. 
It's troublesome when they come and disturb our 
hunting grounds. 
Currently, the presence of monsters in this 
area is just right. 
I hope these beginners will quickly retreat.

There have been reports of damage believed to be 
caused by violent creatures in 
<NAME AREA>,

MsgJp:
俺さ、情報屋、やろうと思ってんだ
噂話とか、騎士団の裏情報とかマジ詳しいし、ネタの
鮮度に敏感っつうの？
ついさっきも、騎士団が巡回した直後の地下墓地に
魔物の気配がしたんだ
どう？　俺の嗅覚、大したもんだろ
MsgEn:
I'm thinking of becoming an 
information broker,
I'm really knowledgeable about rumors, 
the secret information of the knights, 
and stuff like that.
I'm sensitive to the freshness of the 
news, you know?
Just a moment ago, I sensed the presence of a 
monster in the underground graveyard right after 
the knights patrolled it.
What do you think? 
My sense of smell is pretty good, right?

MsgJp:
赤ん坊が泣きやまないの
これはただの夜泣きじゃない、何かの気配に
怯えてるのよ
この子がお腹にいるときもそうだった
近くに魔物がいると暴れて――
なんてかわいそうな子！
MsgEn:
The baby won't stop crying.
This isn't just night crying; it's afraid of
something. It was the same when I was pregnant.
When there were monsters nearby, the baby would
writhe around. What a poor child!

MsgEn:
Rumors have been spreading lately that shadows 
are moving suspiciously in <NAME AREA>.

MsgJp:
なんかこう、シュッて感じの、影みたいな
塊みたいなもんがさ、こうガサガサっと動いてさ
そんでこう、へんな匂いっていうか
気配みたいなものが、ブワーっときて――
んあ？　よっぱらってねえよ、おいら
それがしょうこに、ほら、この目をみなよ、へへへ
MsgEn:
It's like, a bunch of, like, a shuffling,
shadow-like thing, moving quickly and rustling.
And then, like, a strange smell,
like a presence that goes "whoosh"—
Huh? I'm not drunk, hey!
See, look into these eyes, hehehe.

至急、魔物らしき脅威を排除されたし、とのこと
MsgEn:
Urgent report from <NAME AREA>
It is imperative to swiftly remove a threat
that appears to be monsters.

MsgJp:
沢の近くで洗いものをしていたら足を滑らせ
そのまま川でおぼれて――気付いたら洞窟の中でした
その奥から何か唸り声がして、逃げ出した私を
いつまでも追いかけてくるんです
もう必死で、まる半日走り続けました
あんな怖い思いはもう、二度とごめんです
MsgEn:
While washing near the stream, I slipped and fell,
and next thing I knew, I was trapped in a cave.
From deep within, I hear a growling voice,
chasing after me relentlessly.
I ran desperately for half a day.
I never want to experience such fear again.

Currently organizing eyewitness reports from 
<NAME AREA>.

enemy involvement.

MsgJp:
あたしは――あんなでも、やっぱり実の息子ですから
信じてやりたいんです
予言だ神のお告げだと、回りの人は不気味がりますが
あれは単に、怯えているだけなんです
みんなに災いに遭って欲しくない一心で
魔物が来る、近くまで来てる、と――
MsgEn:
I—despite everything, he's still my own son,
so I want to believe in him. People around
me are unnerved by prophecies and divine messages,
but he's just scared. With all my heart, I don't
want anyone to suffer. He says monsters are
coming, getting close, and—

The only way to restock is to go back to that 
path, but I've been hearing rumors about monsters

appearance cannot be ignored. Especially for
the Arisen, you base things on "strength."
That alone won't win over a person, especially
the opposite sex. When asked about appearance,
always start with a compliment! Keep that in mind.

覚者様は、キノザの温泉に行かれたことは

戦いの傷を、心身ともに癒せますよ
MsgEn:
Ser Arisen
Have you ever visited the hot springs in Kinoza?
If not, you should definitely try it! The
soothing quality of the water is superb, but
you can also enjoy relaxing conversations
with the locals. It's a great way to heal
both body and mind from battle.

MsgEn:
There's a cave in the mines where goblins 
have taken up residence.
Ordinary people would find it too dangerous 
to approach, but a seasoned Arisen might be able 
to speak with their leader.
Rumor has it that the leader is quite wise and 
enjoys conversing with strong warriors. 
― Though it takes courage to attempt such a thing.

MsgEn:
That man in the Volden Mines,
I feel like I've seen him somewhere before.
For some reason, what comes to 
mind is the liveliness of a tavern...
Hmm, if I can't remember, my nose starts to itch.

私、昔キノザで働いてたことがあるんです
毎年少しずつ泉質が変化するらしくて
常連客はその違いを楽しんでいるみたいですよ
そのへんを語るディープなお客が必ずいるそうです
面白いですよね
MsgEn:
I used to work in Kinoza in the past.
The mineral quality of the springs reportedly 
changes a bit each year, and regulars seem to 
enjoy these differences.
There are always dedicated customers who love to 
talk about these nuances. It's fascinating.

ボルド鉱山のキノザ鉱泉と周辺施設なんかを
管理している組織なんだ
温泉は娯楽施設だけれど、山間の険しい場所でも

いろいろ面倒なんだね
MsgEn:
Have you heard of the Kinoza Guild?
They manage the Kinoza Mineral Springs and nearby 
facilities in the Volden Mines. 
While the hot springs are for leisure, they also 
block off dangerous areas 
in the rugged mountain terrain.

It seems like quite a lot of work.

俺は戦士として体を鍛えるために

MsgEn:
The mountain paths around 
the mine area are very steep.
There are even places where you can't climb 
without clinging to sheer cliffs.
I often use that place to train my 
body as a warrior.
For an Arisen, the body is also an asset, 
so how about training by climbing cliffs?

extremely remote and rugged areas. 
It would be appreciated if the Arisen could 
assist in those areas.

さっき鉱山から帰ってきたんだけど

MsgEn:
I just returned from the mine earlier.
Right now, Captain Gerd of the Knights 
is staying in Kinoza, huh?
I wonder if he had some kind of mission?
His solemn expression was as usual, so I couldn't 
tell if it was work or recovery.

MsgJp:
鉱山で働いていると、落盤やがけ崩れの音には
どうしても神経質になる
判断が遅れれば命にかかわるからな
でも、昨日聞いたあの音――
土の音には違いないが、地崩れとは違う感じだった
悪い予感がしたんで、仕事は早々に引き揚げたよ
MsgEn:
When working in a mine, one becomes inevitably 
nervous at the sound of cave-ins or landslides. 
A delayed judgment can cost one's life. 
However, the sound I heard yesterday... 
While it was indeed the sound of dirt, 
it felt different from a landslide. 
I had a bad premonition, 
so I quickly withdrew from work.

危険な存在により住民が脅かされているらしい
MsgEn:
In the <NAME AREA>, 
it seems that the residents are being threatened

MsgJp:
<COL ffdc78>【 敵出現：夜 】</COL>
くそっ、せっかくまとまった銀が採れたってのに
ゆうべ仕事場からの帰りに落としちまった！
あのへんは夜になると魔物がうようよ出やがるから

Monsters swarm the area at night,
so I need to search for it during the
day before someone else finds it.
I hope it's still there.

<NAME AREA>で
魔物のものと思われる徘徊痕跡が見つかった
MsgEn:
In <NAME AREA>, 
traces of what seem to be wandering 
monsters have been found.

MsgJp:
商売柄、魔物の出没情報には常に注意を払っています
基本は彼らとの接近を避け、安全なルートで
物資を運ぶことを優先しますが、今回は参りました
どうやら八方を彼らの気配に囲まれたようで
ここから身動きできません
さてさて、どうしたものか――
MsgEn:
Due to the nature of my business, I always pay 
close attention to the appearance of monsters. 
My priority is to avoid contact with them and 
transport goods using safe routes. 
However, 
this time I find myself in quite a predicament. 
It seems that I am surrounded by their presence 
from all directions and cannot move from here. 

Now, what should I do...

MsgJp:
私が先日見つけたある魔道書に
ボルド鉱山にまつわる記述があった
魔の者を産む異界の裂け目――そんなものが
この地のどこかに現れるらしいのだ
なるほど、先日から感じるこの濃密な魔の気配は
それが由来なのか――興味深い
MsgEn:
In a certain grimoire I found the other day, 
there was a description 
related to the Volden Mines.
It seems that there is a rift to the Other World,
which gives birth to beings of darkness, 
somewhere in this land.
Ah, could it be that the dense aura of darkness
that I've been sensing since the other day is 
connected to this? How intriguing.

MsgJp:
このあたりに魔物？
バカ言うな、つい一週間前騎士団が来てやつらを
一掃していったぞ
１ヵ月くらいは何も寄りつかなくなるって言ってたぜ
そりゃあ、不審な物音は何度かあったけどよ――ん？
それって何が原因なんだ？
MsgEn:
Are there monsters around here?
Don't be stupid, just a week ago the Knights' Order 
came and completely wiped them out.
They said nothing would come 
near here for about a month.
Well, there have been some suspicious noises, 
but... hmm?
What could be the cause of that?

MsgJp:
穴ぐらの連中が、どうも最近騒いでましてねぇ
なんでも、ハイデルから来た魔物がどうとかで
まともに話もできないんですよ
それとは別に、《南壁谷》も近頃なにやら不穏でね
いやはや、ダウとの行き来がまた遮断されちゃあ
たまりませんな
MsgEn:
The cave dwellers have been quite
rowdy lately. They say something
about monsters coming from Hidell,
so I can't even have a proper chat
with them. Besides that, the
Southern Wall Gorge has been uneasy
recently. It's really frustrating
that travel to and from Dowe has
been cut off again.

おい、森をなめると痛い目見るぜ
とくにミスリウは、ハイキング気分で来られちゃ
困るんだ
見通しの悪い木々の間から、突然猛獣が襲う事もある
いっぱしの戦士を気取ってブラブラ歩いてる若造を

MsgEn:
Hey, don't underestimate the forest.
Especially in Mysree, it's no place
for a casual hike. Wild beasts can
attack suddenly from between the
dense trees. When I see some
young fool strutting around thinking
he's a big warrior, I just want to
give him a good smack.

MsgJp:
行商人？
ああ、うん確かにそんな感じの人、見かけたね
悩みがある感じ？　うんそう見えたね
でもさ、人を見たら泥棒と思えって
親に言われてきたからね
同情心をあおられても、そう簡単に助けられないよ
MsgEn:
A peddler? 
Ah, yeah, I think I saw someone like that. 
They seemed troubled, right? 
Yeah, that's how they looked. 
But you know, I've been taught to think of people 
as thieves when I see them. 
Even if I feel sympathy, 
it's not easy to help them.

MsgJp:
ふう、やっと着いた――
いえね、いまリンウッドのあたりで白衛騎士団が
展開してて、ものものしい状況なんですよ
私ら商売人も、安全のため離れるように言われたもん
で、こうして帰ってきたんです
いったい、何が起こるってんです？
MsgEn:
Phew, we finally made it—
You see, right around Lynwood, 
the White Guard Knights have established a 
presence, and it's quite an intense situation.
Even us merchants were told to stay away for 
safety, so that's why we've come back like this.
What exactly is happening?

MsgJp:
――聞いてくれます？
僕ね、燐光虫の洞窟に、エキセントリックで
エキゾチック、そのうえエキサイティングな女性が
居るっていうから、期待値最高で行ってみたんです
そしたら、もうアレで――
まあ、あなたも一度訪ねてみてくださいよ
MsgEn:
Will you listen?
You know, I went to the Glowworm Cave,
because I heard there was an eccentric,
exotic, and exciting woman there,
so I had high expectations.
But, well, 
you should go and see for yourself once.

あのミスリウにある洞窟はきれいよね
凶悪な魔物の存在を一瞬忘れて
見とれてしまいそうになるわ
でもここ数日、その魔物の数がやけに増えて
洞窟の外にあふれそうな勢いらしいの
誰か、様子を見にいける人はいない？
MsgEn:
The cave in Mysree is beautiful, isn't it?
It's easy to get lost in admiration and
forget about the fierce monsters.
But recently, the number of those monsters
has increased alarmingly, almost spilling
out of the cave. Is there anyone who can
check on the situation?

MsgJp:
最初に断るけど、これ、ヨタ話だからな
リンウッド近くの山小屋に、すげえ美人が住んでる話
――あれ？　興味ない？
まあいいさ、とにかくその彼女が
何か薬の材料を欲しがっているらしいんだ
どうよ？　コレ、イケんじゃない？
MsgEn:
Just to clarify, this is just a rumor.
There's a stunningly beautiful woman living
in a mountain cabin near Linwood.
—Oh? Not interested?
Well, anyway, it seems she's looking for
some kind of medicinal ingredients.
What do you think? 
Could be worth checking out, right?

MsgJp:
陽光あふれるミスリウは、どこか幻想的で
我ら音楽家にとっても格好のモチーフです
さらに感性を刺激するのは、誰が名付けたか
「古の祭祀場」――美しく朽ちたそのたたずまいは
官能さえ感じます
魔物たちも、魅せられて集まるのかも知れません
MsgEn:
Mysree, bathed in sunlight, has a
certain magickal quality, making it an
ideal motif for us musicians. What further
stimulates the senses is the so-called
"Ancient Ritual Ground"—its beautifully
dilapidated appearance is almost sensual.
Monsters might be drawn to its charm as well.

おそらくレスタニア中を巡って

MsgEn:

危険な存在により住民が脅かされているらしい
MsgEn:
In the <NAME AREA>, 
it seems that the residents are being threatened

MsgJp:
<COL ffdc78>【 敵出現：夜 】</COL>
南方の親類を訪ねて旅をしているものだが、昨夜は
金がなく道端の廃屋で素泊まりしていたんだ
あれは夜明け前の一番暗い時刻だったと思うが
ねばりつくような何者かの気配に、背筋がぞっとして
跳ね起きたんだ――何がいたんだろう
MsgEn:
<COL ffdc78>[Enemy appears during: Night]</COL> 
I'm traveling to visit relatives in the south,
but last night I had to stay at an abandoned
house by the roadside due to lack of money.
It was just before dawn, the darkest hour,
when I felt a creeping presence that chilled
my spine and made me jump awake—
what could it have been?

MsgJp: 遭遇した敵を討伐する
森に舞う妖鳥
MsgEn: A Strange Bird Dances in the Forest

MsgJp: 遭遇した敵を討伐する

<NAME AREA>付近で
不気味な物音が周辺に響いているらしい
MsgEn:
There seems to be an eerie sound echoing around 
the vicinity of <NAME AREA>.

MsgJp:
魔道研究にも資金が必要なので
弟子を取って簡易な魔法を教えているのですが
薬物調合のためこのミスリウの森に来て
弟子とはぐれてしまいました
ここはいやな気配が漂っています
彼の身になにかあっては大変だ――ああ誰か助けを！
MsgEn:
Funding is also needed for magickal research,
so I'm taking on apprentices to teach simple spells.
While here in the Mysree Forest for potion making,
I lost track of my apprentice.
This place has an unpleasant atmosphere.
Something terrible might have happened to him—
oh, someone please help!

MsgJp: 遭遇した敵を討伐する
ミスリウ洞の怪
MsgEn: The Mystery of Mysree Limestone Cave

MsgJp: 遭遇した敵を討伐する

原因不明の怪音や震動が続いているとの報せがあった
MsgEn:
There have been reports of unexplained noises 
and vibrations in the 
<NAME AREA> region.

MsgJp:
今日は戦闘を避けて、道具の手入れや
書物での戦術研究をしようと思っていたのだが
近隣に魔物の影を見かけてしまった
緊急性は低いと思うが、放置してはおけまい
やれやれだ
MsgEn:
I intended to avoid fighting today and instead
work on gear maintenance and study tactics.
But I've seen signs of monsters nearby.
The situation doesn't seem critical, 
but it can't be left unattended. 
What a bother.

MsgJp: 遭遇した敵を討伐する
魔洞にひしめく影
遭遇した敵を討伐する

<NAME AREA>で
魔物のものと思われる徘徊痕跡が見つかった
MsgEn:
In <NAME AREA>, 
traces of what seem to be wandering 
monsters have been found.

MsgJp:
ひと仕事終えてさあ帰ろうかって時に
めったに見ない立派な角の雄ジカを見かけて
欲をかいたのがいけなかった
奥へ奥へと進むうち、回りはもう魔物の気配だらけ！
こりゃ狩りどころじゃないって
あわてて引き返したよ
MsgEn:
Just when I finished my work and was about to 
head home, I spotted a magnificent stag with 
antlers I rarely see and got greedy. 
As I went deeper, the area was
filled with the presence of monsters!
It turned into a hunting nightmare, 
so I hurried back.

MsgJp: 遭遇した敵を討伐する
人攫いの正体
遭遇した敵を討伐する

<NAME AREA>から緊急報告
至急、魔物らしき脅威を排除されたし、とのこと
MsgEn:
Urgent report from <NAME AREA>
It is imperative to swiftly remove a threat
that appears to be monsters.

MsgJp:
年頃の娘が、騎士崩れの若造と
危険な場所に行きたがって困っている
昨日ははるか森の奥、壁が光る洞窟だとかに
日暮れ近くまで入り浸っていたというから
きつく叱ってやったよ
あそこは魔物の巣だというのに、愚かな娘だ
MsgEn:
My teenage daughter insists on going to dangerous
places with a young man who's a failed knight, 
and it's causing trouble. 
She was apparently in a cave with glowing walls 
deep in the forest until sunset yesterday. 
I scolded her harshly. 
It's a den of monsters—she's so foolish.

死を呼ぶはばたき
遭遇した敵を討伐する

大人たちがヒソヒソ話してたよ

Want to hear a scary story? 
In the forbidden area, there's a cursed monster— 
And even though it's in the forbidden area now, 
One day it'll leave and come to eat us— 
That's what I heard the adults whispering about.

MsgJp:
昔、物好きなヤツが住んでたっていう
地下の廃屋があるんだけどよ
最近中から物音がするんだ
動物か何かが住み付いちまってるのか
それとも盗賊の根城になってるのか――
とにかく気味が悪くて近寄れねぇよ
MsgEn:
There's an old, abandoned house underground 
where a peculiar person once lived.
Lately, strange noises have been coming from it. 
It might be animals living there, 
or it could have become a den for thieves— 
Anyway, it's so bizarre that I can't approach it.

先日から<NAME AREA>で

Rumors have been spreading lately that shadows

MsgJp:
まぁ、俺に言わせてみればだが
何も覚者ばかりが不老ではないということだ
俺の言葉を疑うならば、この場所を訪れてみると良い
きっと運が良ければ俺の言う
不老の戦士に会えるかもな
MsgEn:
From my perspective, 
immortality isn't exclusive to the Arisen. 
If you don't believe me, 
you should check out this location. 
With a bit of luck, you might encounter 
that such immortal warrior.

MsgEn:
Although the information is uncertain,
there have been reports of damage
believed to be caused by violent creatures
in <NAME AREA>.

MsgJp:
オークの残党を追っていたのだが
予想以上に我が隊の損害が大きく、
やむなく帰還した

あのオークどもを一人で討伐するのは無理がある
無事でいてくれればよいが――

We were tracking down the Orc remnants, 
but our unit took heavier losses than expected, 
forcing us to return. 
One of our men hasn't come back yet. 
There's no way they could handle the Orcs alone. 
I just hope they've escaped unharmed...

一日でも早く、俺は奴を故郷に

誰か奴を見かけたら、すぐに俺に知らせてくれ

It is imperative to swiftly remove
the presenting threat of monsters.

MsgJp:
地響きがしたから辺りの様子をうかがってたらよ、
全身がまるで炉みたいな
でっかい魔物がのし歩いてやがったんだ
もちろん一目散に逃げ帰ったね
MsgEn:
I heard a rumble, so I went to check things out, 
and there it was, a massive creature, 
its entire body burning like a furnace. 
Naturally, I turned and ran as fast as I could.

If you're coming near 
<NAME AREA> at the moment,

for an enemy assault.

しかし呆れた男もいたもんだよ
いくら恋人に頼まれたからって
物珍しい毛皮を持つ動物を狩りに
あんな場所に行くなんてねぇ
なんでも、そびえたつ黒い魔物に襲われたとか
ほんとは怖くなって行かなかったんじゃないのねぇ
MsgEn:
You'd have to be crazy, going to that place
to hunt an animal with a unique pelt
just because your lover asked. 
They say he was attacked by a huge black beast, 
but maybe he chickened out and didn't go at all.

思わず、おら、大丈夫かと、声を掛けたら
「あっち行って」って――
まいったね、ありゃ
MsgEn:
A little while ago, deep in the forest, 
I spotted a girl, stranded, unable to move.
I called out, "You alright?"
She just said, "Go away"!
Unbelievable, right?

あの手の高名な先生が、命の危険もかえりみず
こんな場所まで来ているかなんて
俺にはさっぱり分からないねぇ
ただ、彼の生み出す料理の美味さには
いつも感動しちまうね！
MsgEn:
You know, that guy is pretty famous.
Why a prestigious teacher would risk their life
to come to a place like this, I can't fathom it. 
But their cooking always amazes me, without fail!

ああ、魔術師仲間のクリストフのことなんだが
かなりぶっ飛んでる奴だけど
悪い奴じゃあないんだよ、研究熱心なだけなんだ
今はこの辺りに出向いているんだが
良ければ彼の仕事を手伝ってやってくれないか
MsgEn:
Ah, it's about my fellow mage, Christoph. 
He's quite eccentric, but he's not a bad guy, 
just deeply passionate about his research. 
He's currently around here, so if you don't mind,
could you help him out with his work?

MsgEn:
It seems that in <NAME AREA>, 
there are people seeking the Arisen's aid.

MsgJp:
つい先日、森深くに迷い込んでしまった時の話だよ
突然背後から、妙に不気味な男に声を掛けられてね
うわずったかすれ声で
何かをひどく、欲しがっていたな
僕は怖くなって、すぐにその場を離れたけれど
興味があるなら行ってみるといいね
MsgEn:
Not long ago, I wandered deep into the forest. 
Out of nowhere, a strange man beckoned me
from behind. His voice was high and hoarse, 
and he was really desperate for something. 
I was frightened and quickly left, 
but if you're interested, 
you could go see for yourself.

<NAME AREA>で
魔物のものと思われる徘徊痕跡が見つかった
MsgEn:
In <NAME AREA>, 
traces of what seem to be wandering monsters
have been found.

MsgJp:
そりゃぁ、驚いたのなんのって！
この奥深い森で、もう何十年と暮らしちゃいるが
この時期にやつらが、こんなところまで
やってくるなんて滅多にないよ
はやく去ってくれるといいんだがね
MsgEn:
I was so surprised! 
I've been living in this forest for years, 
and it's uncommon for them
to come here during this season. 
I just hope they leave soon.

<NAME AREA>の調査が必要そうだ
MsgEn:
There seems to be a need for an investigation
in <NAME AREA> 
regarding the recent increase in bloodstains
and corpses of wild animals littered about.

MsgJp:
おらの可愛がっていたブタのメアリーが
小屋から、さらわれちまったんだ
ズタズタに壊された小屋から想像するに
犯人はゾッとするような大きな獣かも知れない
誰かメアリーを救い出してきて欲しい
MsgEn:
My beloved pig, Mary, was taken from her pen. 
Seeing the wreckage of the pen, 
the culprit might be a horrifyingly big creature. 
Please, anyone, save Mary from a terrible fate.

<NAME AREA>は

<NAME AREA> seems to be filled

MsgJp:
かの恐ろしい魔物の皮で、わしはかねがね
立派な外套をあしらえたいと思っておったんじゃよ
とうとうその機が訪れた
見事に魔物を倒してくれた者には
十分な謝礼を用意しておるつもりだ
MsgEn:
I've always wanted to craft a fine cloak
made from the hide of that dreadful beast. 
My chance has finally come. 
A substantial reward awaits those who defeat
the monster. That glorious pelt shall be mine.

<NAME AREA>方面から

MsgEn:
There have been reports of unexplained noises 
and tremors in the regions around
<NAME AREA>

MsgJp:
先日、あの場所に出かけた時のことなんだが
今でも脳裏にこびりついて離れない
動物を絞めたようなつんざく魔物の
禍々しい咆哮――
あれ以来、一小節も譜面が進みやしないよ
MsgEn:
Recently, when I visited that place, 
the image still lingers in my mind. 
The cursed roar of a monster 
that sounded like an animal being choked— 
Since then, I haven't progressed on a single note.

遭遇した敵を討伐する

MsgEn:
There have been eyewitness reports
coming from <NAME AREA>.
It seems that a sinister shadow
is frightening the residents and wildlife.

MsgJp:
ついに奴が現れた――
俺たち狩人の間では
奴を狩ることができた者こそ敬われ
一目置かれることになっている
又とないこの機会に
みな、色めき立っているところだ
MsgEn:
Finally, it has shown itself— 
Among hunters, 
those who manage to slay it 
are revered and earn great respect. 
Everyone is thrilled for this unique chance.

MsgJp:
俺の祖父さんの、そのまた祖父さんから
ずっと聞かされている話だがね
その昔、あそこはそれは美しいところだったんだよ
なんでも妖精なんかもいたそうだ
今じゃ、恐ろしい魔物としか出くわさないがね
MsgEn:
This is a tale passed down from my grandfather 
to his grandfather before him. 
Once upon a time, that place
was exceptionally beautiful. 
They say even fairies used to inhabit it. 
Now, all that's left are horrible beasts.

MsgEn:
It seems that there is someone seeking assistance 
for issues occurring at night in the <NAME AREA>.

MsgJp:
<COL ffdc78>【 敵出現：夜 】</COL>
ほんとあの時はたまげたね、何がだって！？
あんな奥深い森の廃墟で、夜な夜な艶やかな
女の声が聞こえてくるんだから
え！？猿か魔物の声だろうって
僕がそんなに酔っぱらって見えるのかい！？
MsgEn:
<COL ffdc78>[Enemy appears during: Night]</COL>
I was really taken aback back then. 
What do you mean by "what"? 
In those deep, desolate woods, every night I heard
the voice of a captivating woman. 
What!? 
You think it's the sound of monkeys or monsters?
Do I seem that drunk to you!?

<NAME AREA>からの報告によると
魔物の勢力が一時的に増し、危険な状況にあるという
MsgEn:
According to reports from <NAME AREA>, 
enemy forces have temporarily increased,

MsgJp:
なんとも恥ずべき失態だが
俺たちは、敵にまんまと一杯喰わされちまったんだ
仲間は傷を負い
ほうほうの体で逃げ出すしかなかったよ
仇を頼みたい、まだ敵はあのあたりにいるはずだ
MsgEn:
It's a shameful blunder, but we were thoroughly
outwitted by the enemy. 
Our comrades were injured, and we had no choice 
but to flee in a sorry state. I seek vengeance...!
The enemy should still be around that area.

どうにも森の魔女が子どもらと親しいようでな――
村の大人たちは、この状況を危惧しておる
とって喰われでもするんじゃないかってのう――
子どもが呪文なんか唱えた日にゃ
驚いてそのまま昇天しそうじゃわい
MsgEn:
It seems the forest witch is quite friendly 
with the children— 
The village adults are worried about this 
situation, fearing they might be eaten— 
If the children start chanting spells, 
they might be so frightened they could 
drop dead from shock.

Since I've become one of the Arisen, 
I thought I could manage a forest patrol 
by myself. But with the creepy monsters
wandering about, I came back right away. 
Combat isn't my strong suit— 
I'll spend my time studying and 
looking for books when I return.

あのよぅ、噂に聞いたんだが――
なんでも島の中に小金を貯めこんでる
魔物がいるらしいんだよ
どっかの洞窟にいて、そこに集めてるらしいぜ――
まったく、魔物のくせに貯金たぁ世も末だぜ
俺の給料より多かったら嫌になっちまうぜ――
MsgEn:
So, I heard a rumor... 
There's a monster on the island
that apparently hoards a bit of cash. 
It's supposedly stashing it away
in some cave— 
Seriously, it's a sign of the times
if a monster is saving up money. 
If it turns out to have more than my salary,
I'd be pretty annoyed――

MsgJp:
正直、疲れたんだ
この島、いくら魔物を討伐しても際限なく
また湧いてくるだろ？　一体どうなってるんだ？
一つコツがあるとすれば、死なずに倒すこと、だな
ああ――駐屯地の宿で、あの人に会うことだけが
俺の楽しみさ――おっと、これはコツじゃないからな
MsgEn:
Honestly, I'm exhausted. 
No matter how many monsters I take down 
on this island, they just keep coming back. 
What's going on here?
If there's one tip I have, it's to defeat 
them without dying. 
Ah―― meeting that person at the 
barracks is my only pleasure―― 
Oh, but that's not really a tip!

いや、笑い事じゃねえんだよ
はびこる魔物のせいで、負傷する奴が後を絶たない

forming at the outpost inn on the island? 
This isn't funny. 
The monsters are so rampant that 
injured folks just keep showing up. 
Even when wounded, they have to 
wait for treatment— 
But honestly, it's a far bigger issue 
if I can't see that person!

MsgJp:
突然目の前が暗くなったと思ったら
仲間は皆倒れていました
次の瞬間、自分も奇っ怪な光に包まれたと思ったら
意識が遠のいて――
その時、妻の顔が脳裏に浮かびました
歯を食いしばって走ったら帰ってこれたんです
MsgEn:
Everything went dark in front of me,
and my comrades were all lying down.
In the next moment, I found myself suddenly
engulfed in a bizarre light,
and my consciousness slipped away— 
At that moment, my wife's face flashed in my mind.
I bit down and ran, managing to get back somehow.

it seems like they've been struggling recently.
The monsters are messing up their supply,
and they can't get a decent selection. 
I don't want fewer choices for dinner, either.

Napping in the sea breeze on this 
island is just the best— 
but then some fool showed up 
to ruin my fun. 
They were making such a fuss 
that I couldn't catch a nap! 
And just so you know, 
I'm not slacking on my 
mission while napping here!

いえ、私近くに住む者なんですが

魔物の被害だとか、住民同士のいざこざだとか
レスタニアで一番のどかな村だと思っていたのですが
なかなか難しいんでしょうね――

The crisis in Tel Village! 
Maybe that's a bit of an exaggeration? 
Well, I live nearby, and 
things have been feeling off lately. 
There's the damage from monsters, 
and disputes among residents. 
I always thought it was the most peaceful village 
in Lestania, but it seems things are quite 
difficult now――

しかし今回はなんだ？　随分と立派なのが
湧いちまったようだな、こんなの、始末できるのか？
MsgEn:
I warned you not to neglect it, right? 
Leaving abandoned houses like that 
unattended will invite all sorts 
of monsters. We need to either 
patrol regularly or destroy them. 
But what's going on this time? 
It seems quite the impressive one 
has shown up. Can we take care 
of something like this?

like something making noise. 
But I felt a mysterious power 
behind it. Even though it was eerie, 
it made me feel at ease. 
I wonder why? Am I the strange one?

子どもを連れて散歩に行ってみたんだ
でも、ちょっと深い所まで行き過ぎてね――
見たこともない魔物が飛び回ってるじゃないか

I thought a forest bath would be good 
for us, so I took my child for a stroll. 
But we ventured too far in— 
I spotted monsters I'd never seen 
flying around. Yet the child was 
so delighted to see them. Boys 
really do seem to love that sort of thing!

相棒と二人でちょっと魔物を討伐しに行ったんだ――
そしたらアイツ、魔物の餌食になっちまって――
俺がこんなことしようなんて言うから――

じゃあ俺と一緒だったあれは――

I went out with my buddy to hunt 
some monsters—then he ended up 
becoming prey for one of them— 
it's my fault for suggesting 
this in the first place— 
Oh? Partner, you're here! 
Wait, you never said we were 
hunting monsters, did you? 
Then what exactly were we doing?

MsgJp:
あんな物騒な場所に行った僕も悪いんだけど――
目の前の光景、全てが凶気に満ちている
そんな風に感じたんだ――
もう二度とあんな場所には近づかないと誓うよ
好奇心？　そんなものは命の重さに比べれば
いつだって粉々にできるさ――
MsgEn:
I admit I was foolish to go 
to such a dangerous place— 
but everything I saw was 
filled with malice. 
That's how it felt to me— 
I swear I'll never go near 
such a place again. 
Curiosity? That can always be 
shattered against the weight of life.

み、みたの！　あたし、みたんだよ
灯台の古井戸の近くで、おばけがいるところ――
でもね、ふしぎと怖くなかったの
ふわふわ揺れて、淡い光をまとってて――
あの時、お母さんに呼ばれなかったら
あたしついて行っちゃったかもしれない
MsgEn:
I—I saw it! I really saw it!
Near the old well by the lighthouse,
there was a ghost!
But strangely, I wasn't scared.
It was floating and glowing softly—
if my mom hadn't called me,
I might have followed it.

墓場の方から、空気をつんざくような声がしたから
行ってみたらさ――見たこともない化け物が！
それから毎晩夢に見てうなされるぜ――
誰か、助けてくれ
MsgEn:
They say curiosity can lead to fear,
right?
I heard a voice piercing the air from
the direction of the graveyard,
so I went to check it out—
and there it was, a monster I'd never
seen!
Now, I can't sleep at night,
haunted by nightmares.
Someone, please help me!

know?
The other day, I heard the knights were
going on patrol, so I decided to follow
them to see if it was true. But those
guys—
there were monsters around, and they
acted like they didn't even notice! Now,
with the knights throwing in the towel
on this monster,
what are we supposed to do?

front of the barracks, looking
incredibly dejected. They seemed to be
blaming themselves and were deeply
troubled. They must be a person with a
strong sense of justice. I hope that
people like them find their
reward someday.

nature, yet dangerous monsters wander
around as if they own the place. It's a
strange island, truly.

That's how it feels to me right now.

Recently, the vice captain has 
been looking quite troubled. They 
always seem to have their head 
down. Apparently, they're dealing 
with a lot of paperwork outside 
the battlefield and are getting 
really frustrated. Plus, they 
have many useless subordinates 
making things even tougher. Me? 
Oh no, I'm different—hahaha!

なあに――この地に伝わる伝承に過ぎん
《罪人の修堂》は知っておろう
その奥深くに、それはそれは惨烈な魔物がおるのじゃ

挑んでいったが、誰一人戻ってはこない
MsgEn:
Are you aware of this? It's merely a
tale passed down in this region. Surely
you know of the "Sanctuary of the
Guilty." Deep within lies an incredibly
fierce creature. Many capable warriors
have ventured in,
but none have come back.

lived here for ages must find it hard to

Could it be that I really love this
forest after all?

The earthy trails gouged into the rough
mountains—exposed ore and seasoned
scaffolding—
ah, it's just heavenly!
Yet, a creepy monster has shown up in
this beloved spot of mine.
What a hassle! Can't it be
removed quickly?

MsgEn:
This is a story from long ago,
when I had a dear comrade.
Day after day, we tirelessly hunted
monsters together until we met that
beast—
we should have only dealt with monsters
that matched our own strength.
Even now, such regrets haunt my heart.

permanently. If this town thrives
because of that, I have no issues
with it at all.

relishing something without anyone
finding out is just too tempting!

world?

No matter the mission or the money
offered,
I never want to go back to that place
again.
Honestly, I'd rather be dead—ugh!

I-I really heard it—I swear!
From that creepy fortress, a sinister
voice—
It must be attacking the villagers!
N-No? I'm not afraid, really!
I'm definitely not stumbling over
my words!

Damn―― I don't want to admit it,

of the area's captivating beauty.

this enemy was far too much 
for someone as inexperienced as me. 
However, I think experiences like this 
are necessary. It was a good chance 
to understand my current strength. 
I consider myself fortunate to have 
survived this encounter.

In a place like this, unless you rely on the Arisen, 
it would be tough to acquire, I bet.

some thefts occurring in the garrison. 
Given the limited number of people here, 
I don't believe anyone would commit such acts.

弱き者は軽んじられる、そういう文化のようだ
しかし滞在している間――自分に親身に接し
優しくしてくれたのは、弱き者達なのだ――

and scorn the weak. Yet during my stay,
it was the weak who were caring and kind
to me.
I wish I could find a way to repay
their kindness.

Have they surrendered to our resistance?
Or――No, that can't be.

they're losing! What seem like ordinary monsters
can quickly be surrounded by elite Orcs!
I can't even properly handle monster cleanup.

For the sake of peace,

'Twould be nice if we could reward them somehow.

MsgJp:
今の世の中、信念とか覚悟を持つことは大切だ
さりとて過度な信念や覚悟ってやつは
時に周囲の人間を振り回し、迷惑の渦に叩き込む

いざって時には頼りになるもんなんだぜ
MsgEn:
In this era, 
having beliefs and determination is crucial.
Still, extreme beliefs or determination can
sometimes disrupt and trouble those around you.
But, individuals who assert their personal beliefs
can often be dependable in crucial situations.

王都を取り戻しても、すぐにオーク軍によって
奪い返されて戦乱は続き、そしてさらにそれを
取り戻すための戦いが起きて――ただの妄想ですが
そうならないという保証はどこにもないのです
MsgEn:
Recently, I'm trapped in aimless thoughts.
Even if we recover the capital, the Orcs might
swiftly retake it, leading to ongoing strife.
Then we'd face more battles to regain it—
It's just a baseless fear, but there's no assurance
it won't become reality.
